The combined photocatalytic and electrochemical performances demonstrate that Ca–BaCeO₃ nanoperovskites are promising dual-functional materials for pharmaceutical pollutant remediation and pharmaceutical sensing applications.

articles.title: Multiscale autoregressive modeling generates ordered protein conformational trajectories
articles.abstract: Protein function depends on transitions among conformational states, but generating long, ordered structural sequences by molecular dynamics (MD) remains computationally expensive at the scale of large protein panels. Many generative approaches emphasize conformational ensembles, whereas sequential trajectory generators must also control error accumulation over long rollouts. We present TEMPO, a hierarchical autoregressive model trained on MD trajectories to generate ordered protein-backbone conformations at two temporal resolutions. A slow-scale model advances anchor conformations at the 20-ns sampling stride used for training, and a fast-scale model generates 1-ns-spaced frames conditioned on the slow-scale context. On held-out mdCATH and ATLAS proteins, TEMPO reproduced MD-derived ensemble observables. On ATLAS, Pearson correlations were 0.91 for ensemble-averaged pairwise RMSD and 0.89 for residue-level RMSF; the leading principal-component direction agreed with MD in 76% of cases, compared with 44% for AlphaFlow. Relative to a single-scale autoregressive model, the hierarchy reduced long-horizon RMSD error from 8.62 to 1.78~Å, and a 400-frame rollout required less than 1 min. Across 10 endpoint-conditioned adenylate kinase rollouts, progression along a shared time-lagged coordinate was accompanied by progressive contact exchange during opening. Inference-time steering yielded conformations satisfying predefined DFG-in- and DFG-out-like local backbone criteria in 68 of 100 kinases. Across 252 kinases, fluctuation profiles showed variable agreement with crystallographic B-factors (mean Spearman ρ=0.358; 22% with ρ≥0.5). TEMPO provides a framework for generating and comparing ordered protein conformational sequences.

articles.title_zh: 混合金刚石芯片增强了光和量子比特之间的相互作用
articles.abstract: Researchers have developed and demonstrated a new hybrid photonic platform that integrates quantum emitters with photonic devices, providing a way to reliably control the interaction between photons and quantum information carriers. The chip-based platform, which combines gallium phosphide (GaP) with a diamond substrate, could help make quantum networks more practical by providing a way to connect quantum devices over long distances.

articles.title: Correcting AI-generated false criminal allegations: a human-rights framework for remedial closure
articles.title_zh: 纠正人工智能生成的虚假刑事指控：补救性结案的人权框架
articles.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) can fabricate criminal allegations about identifiable people, but the legal difficulty is not confined to correcting the visible output. A false claim may persist in service-side memory, retrieval systems, application programming interface transmissions, risk fields and downstream institutional decisions. Existing scholarship on data rectification, AI supply chains, algorithmic contestability and model correction addresses parts of this problem but does not provide a unified legal test for when distributed remediation is complete. This article develops a propagation-aware standard of remedial closure: a structured test for determining when corrective action has been completed across relevant stages of an AI system. It combines doctrinal analysis of international and regional human-rights law, European Union data-protection law and business-and-human-rights standards with technical literature on memory, retrieval, model editing and unlearning. China’s Personal Information Protection Law is used as a limited comparative portability test, and a publicly documented complaint concerning an AI-generated false criminal allegation provides a case-informed scenario. The framework requires five functions: accessible challenge and reasoned determination; cessation at reasonably identifiable nodes; correction of inaccurate records and reassessment of materially affected decisions where applicable law permits or requires; verifiable implementation; and proportionate non-recurrence safeguards. Responsibility remains actor- and operation-specific, and tracing may cease where further inquiry is objectively impossible or disproportionate considering severity and expected remedial value. Rectification is treated as legally complete only when the responsible actor can provide reasonable, demonstrable assurance that the verified false allegation has been corrected or contained across reasonably identifiable, materially relevant processing nodes within its authority, with applicable downstream effects addressed and residual risks documented.
articles.abstract_zh: 生成式人工智能（AI）可以捏造有关可识别人员的刑事指控，但法律上的困难并不局限于纠正可见的输出。错误声明可能会持续存在于服务端内存、检索系统、应用程序编程接口传输、风险领域和下游机构决策中。现有的关于数据修正、人工智能供应链、算法可竞争性和模型修正的学术研究解决了这个问题的部分问题，但没有为分布式修复何时完成提供统一的法律测试。本文开发了一种补救性关闭的传播感知标准：一种结构化测试，用于确定人工智能系统的相关阶段的纠正措施何时完成。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 生成式人工智能（AI）可以捏造有关可识别人员的刑事指控，但法律上的困难并不局限于纠正可见的输出。错误声明可能会持续存在于服务端内存、检索系统、应用程序编程接口传输、风险领域和下游机构决策中。现有的关于数据修正、人工智能供应链、算法可竞争性和模型修正的学术研究解决了这个问题的部分问题，但没有为分布式修复何时完成提供统一的法律测试。本文开发了一种补救性关闭的传播感知标准：一种结构化测试，用于确定人工智能系统的相关阶段的纠正措施何时完成。它将国际和区域人权法、欧盟数据保护法以及商业与人权标准的理论分析与有关记忆、检索、模型编辑和遗忘的技术文献结合起来。中国的《个人信息保护法》被用作有限的可移植性比较测试，一份关于人工智能生成的虚假犯罪指控的公开记录的投诉提供了一个案例场景。该框架需要五个功能：易于接受的挑战和合理的决定；在合理可识别的节点处停止；在适用法律允许或要求的情况下，纠正不准确的记录并重新评估受到重大影响的决定；可验证的实施；以及相应的不再发生保障措施。责任仍然是特定于参与者和操作的，如果考虑到严重性和预期的补救价值，进一步的调查客观上不可能或不成比例，则追踪可能会停止。仅当责任行为者能够提供合理的、可证明的保证，证明已验证的虚假指控已在其权限范围内的合理可识别的、实质性相关的处理节点中得到纠正或包含，并解决了适用的下游影响并记录了残余风险时，纠正才被视为法律上完成的。

articles.abstract: Quantum computers represent a next step in the fast-paced evolution of technology. Using quantum bits (qubits), they have the potential to run certain calculations exponentially faster than conventional computers. However, developing and fine-tuning quantum computers requires an enormous number of repetitive tests. To accelerate quantum technology development, we need a method that can read quantum states at ultrafast speeds.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子计算机代表了技术快速发展的下一步。使用量子比特（qubit），它们有可能比传统计算机以指数速度运行某些计算。然而，开发和微调量子计算机需要大量的重复测试。为了加速量子技术的发展，我们需要一种能够超快读取量子态的方法。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子计算机代表了技术快速发展的下一步。使用量子比特（qubit），它们有可能比传统计算机以指数速度运行某些计算。然而，开发和微调量子计算机需要大量的重复测试。为了加速量子技术的发展，我们需要一种能够超快读取量子态的方法。

articles.title: Study on Influence of Reaction time and process environment conditions on Heterogeneous Hydrogenation of HTPB using a Pd-Zr-charcoal catalyst
articles.title_zh: 反应时间和工艺环境条件对Pd-Zr-炭催化剂HTPB多相加氢影响的研究
articles.abstract: This paper outlines the influence of reactor environment conditions in synthesizing hydrogenated HTPB (HHTPB) using Hydroxyl-terminated polybutadiene (HTPB) polymer by catalytic hydrogenation method using bi-solvent system using iso-propyl alcohol and toluene as active solvent media. A novel synthesis approach to understand the effect of various reactor environment conditions such as nitrogen gas, H2 gas and hydrogen-air environments to hydrogenate HTPB using a catalyst made up of palladium and zirconium as base metals supported on activated charcoal was demonstrated. Experiments were conducted in a 100 mL Inconel made batch type reactor with a magnetically driven variable speed impeller. Optimization of process time is demonstrated and fixed as 6 h for the study. HTPB and HHTPB polymers were characterized by NMR, FTIR, and chemical analysis. The results showed that the degree of hydrogenation of HTPB is ~ 87.5% which is a waxy solid under hydrogen-air environment conditions for the given reactor volume with the chosen operating conditions. After hydrogenation of HTPB, no significant change in hydroxyl value was noticed, and the HHTPB formed is of vinyl-type functional isomer in H2 environment. A marginal increase in molecular weight was observed after hydrogenation in all cases. HTPB and HHTPB were subjected to TG- DSC studies and it was found that the thermal stability of HHTPB marginally increased.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文概述了反应器环境条件对端羟基聚丁二烯（HTPB）聚合物采用异丙醇和甲苯作为活性溶剂介质的双溶剂体系催化加氢法合成氢化HTPB（HHTPB）的影响。展示了一种新颖的合成方法，以了解各种反应器环境条件（例如氮气、氢气和氢气-空气环境）对使用由钯和锆作为贱金属组成的负载在活性炭上的催化剂氢化 HTPB 的影响。实验在 100 mL Inconel 制造的带有磁力驱动变速叶轮的间歇式反应器中进行。研究中展示了工艺时间的优化并固定为 6 小时。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文概述了反应器环境条件对端羟基聚丁二烯（HTPB）聚合物采用异丙醇和甲苯作为活性溶剂介质的双溶剂体系催化加氢法合成氢化HTPB（HHTPB）的影响。展示了一种新颖的合成方法，以了解各种反应器环境条件（例如氮气、氢气和氢气-空气环境）对使用由钯和锆作为贱金属组成的负载在活性炭上的催化剂氢化 HTPB 的影响。实验在 100 mL Inconel 制造的带有磁力驱动变速叶轮的间歇式反应器中进行。研究中展示了工艺时间的优化并固定为 6 小时。通过 NMR、FTIR 和化学分析对 HTPB 和 HHTPB 聚合物进行了表征。结果表明，在给定的反应器体积和选定的操作条件下，HTPB的加氢度约为87.5%，在氢气-空气环境条件下为蜡状固体。 HTPB加氢后，羟值没有明显变化，在H2环境下形成的HHTPB为乙烯基型功能异构体。在所有情况下，氢化后均观察到分子量略有增加。对 HTPB 和 HHTPB 进行了 TG-DSC 研究，发现 HHTPB 的热稳定性略有增加。

articles.title: Robust Bilayer Electronic Structure and Reduced Magnetic Exchange in La2SmNi2O7
articles.title_zh: La2SmNi2O7 中稳健的双层电子结构和减少的磁交换
articles.abstract: Rare-earth substitution provides an effective route to enhance superconductivity in bilayer nickelates, but its influence on the local electronic structure and magnetic exchange interactions remains unclear. Here we report Ni-L₃-edge resonant inelastic x-ray scattering (RIXS) measurements on single crystals of La₂SmNi₂O₇, a Sm-substituted bilayer nickelate with enhanced in-plane lattice distortion and a reduced interlayer Ni--Oᵣₘ AP--Ni bond angle. Despite these structural modifications, the local electronic excitations associated with NiO₆ crystal-field and charge-transfer processes occur at essentially the same energies as in La₃Ni₂O₇, including features near 0.3~eV, 1.0~eV, and 1.5~eV. This shows that Sm substitution does not substantially alter the local NiO₆ crystal-field and charge-transfer energy scales of the corner-shared bilayer. In contrast, high-resolution RIXS reveals well-defined spin-wave-like excitations whose band top is reduced by sim7~meV. A bilayer J_c-J₁-J₂ Heisenberg analysis of the spin excitation dispersion indicates an approximately 10% reduction of the effective magnetic exchange scale, which correlates with the reduced interlayer Ni--Oᵣₘ AP--Ni bond angle. The small intrinsic damping of these modes further points to robust local-moment-like spin dynamics in the ambient-pressure parent phase.These results reveal a dichotomy in the response to Sm substitution, with largely preserved local electronic excitation energies but a reduced magnetic exchange scale. They identify the Ni--Oᵣₘ AP--Ni geometry as an important structural parameter influencing magnetism in Ruddlesden--Popper nickelates and provide spectroscopic constraints on microscopic models of high-T_c superconductivity in this family.
articles.abstract_zh: 稀土替代提供了增强双层镍酸盐超导性的有效途径，但其对局部电子结构和磁交换相互作用的影响仍不清楚。在这里，我们报告了 La2SmNi2O7 单晶的 Ni-L₃ 边缘共振非弹性 X 射线散射 (RIXS) 测量，La2SmNi2O7 是一种 Sm 取代的双层镍酸盐，具有增强的面内晶格畸变和减小的层间 Ni--Oᵣₘ AP--Ni 键角。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 稀土替代提供了增强双层镍酸盐超导性的有效途径，但其对局部电子结构和磁交换相互作用的影响仍不清楚。在这里，我们报告了 La2SmNi2O7 单晶的 Ni-L₃ 边缘共振非弹性 X 射线散射 (RIXS) 测量，La2SmNi2O7 是一种 Sm 取代的双层镍酸盐，具有增强的面内晶格畸变和减小的层间 Ni--Oᵣₘ AP--Ni 键角。尽管进行了这些结构修改，与 NiO₆ 晶体场和电荷转移过程相关的局域电子激发的能量基本上与 La₃Ni2O₇ 中相同，包括接近 0.3~eV、1.0~eV 和 1.5~eV 的特征。这表明 Sm 取代并没有显着改变局部 NiO6 晶体场和角共享双层的电荷转移能级。相比之下，高分辨率 RIXS 揭示了定义明确的类自旋波激发，其带顶降低了 sim7~meV。自旋激发色散的双层 J_c-J1-J2 海森堡分析表明有效磁交换规模减少了约 10%，这与层间 Ni--Oᵣₘ AP-Ni 键角的减小相关。这些模式的小固有阻尼进一步表明环境压力母相中具有强大的类局部矩自旋动力学。这些结果揭示了对 Sm 替代的响应的二分性，局部电子激发能大部分保留，但磁交换规模减小。他们将 Ni--Oᵣₘ AP--Ni 几何形状确定为影响 Ruddlesden-Popper 镍酸盐磁性的重要结构参数，并为该族高温超导微观模型提供了光谱约束。

articles.title: Composition-structure-property relationships in thermally evaporated ZnS thin films and Ag/n-ZnS/FTO Schottky barrier diodes
articles.title_zh: 热蒸发 ZnS 薄膜和 Ag/n-ZnS/FTO 肖特基势垒二极管的成分-结构-性能关系
articles.abstract: Nanostructured zinc sulphide (ZnS) thin films were deposited by thermal evaporation under high-vacuum conditions. We systematically investigated how film thickness and substrate temperature affect their structural, optical, and electrical properties. EDS and XPS analyses confirmed a near-stoichiometric to slightly Zn-rich composition, with Zn2+ and S2- as the predominant chemical states. Variations in Zn/S stoichiometry correlated with changes in the structural, optical, photoluminescence, and electrical properties of the ZnS films. X-ray diffraction confirmed the formation of cubic ZnS layers with a pronounced (111) preferred orientation and a lattice parameter of 5.396 Å. The 300 nm films deposited at 323 K exhibited a mean crystallite size of ~ 25 nm, microstrain of 1.45 × 10− 3, and dislocation density of 1.61 × 1015 m-2. The optimized film exhibited n-type conductivity with a mobility of 49.3 cm2 V-1 s-1, a resistivity of 2.35 × 10− 2 Ω cm, and a carrier concentration of 5.38 × 1018 cm-3. The films showed visible-region transparency up to 92%, direct bandgaps of 3.40–3.50 eV, and an absorption coefficient > 1 × 104 cm-1. Ag/n-ZnS/FTO Schottky diodes exhibited rectifying characteristics, yielding barrier heights of 0.67 and 0.72 eV from I-V and C-V measurements, respectively, an ideality factor of 1.03, and a rectification ratio of 5.95. These findings support the potential of grown ZnS thin films as window/buffer layers in photovoltaic cells and in Schottky-barrier electronic applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 在高真空条件下通过热蒸发沉积纳米结构硫化锌（ZnS）薄膜。我们系统地研究了薄膜厚度和基底温度如何影响其结构、光学和电学性能。 EDS 和 XPS 分析证实了接近化学计量至微富锌的成分，其中 Zn2+ 和 S2- 为主要化学状态。 Zn/S 化学计量的变化与 ZnS 薄膜的结构、光学、光致发光和电学性质的变化相关。 X 射线衍射证实了立方 ZnS 层的形成，具有明显的 (111) 择优取向和 5.396 Å 的晶格参数。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在高真空条件下通过热蒸发沉积纳米结构硫化锌（ZnS）薄膜。我们系统地研究了薄膜厚度和基底温度如何影响其结构、光学和电学性能。 EDS 和 XPS 分析证实了接近化学计量至微富锌的成分，其中 Zn2+ 和 S2- 为主要化学状态。 Zn/S 化学计量的变化与 ZnS 薄膜的结构、光学、光致发光和电学性质的变化相关。 X 射线衍射证实了立方 ZnS 层的形成，具有明显的 (111) 择优取向和 5.396 Å 的晶格参数。在 323 K 下沉积的 300 nm 薄膜的平均晶粒尺寸为 ~ 25 nm，微应变为 1.45 × 10− 3，位错密度为 1.61 × 1015 m-2。优化后的薄膜表现出n型导电性，迁移率为49.3 cm2 V-1 s-1，电阻率为2.35 × 10− 2 Ω cm，载流子浓度为5.38 × 1018 cm-3。该薄膜的可见光区透明度高达 92%，直接带隙为 3.40–3.50 eV，吸收系数 > 1 × 104 cm-1。 Ag/n-ZnS/FTO 肖特基二极管表现出整流特性，I-V 和 C-V 测量的势垒高度分别为 0.67 和 0.72 eV，理想因子为 1.03，整流比为 5.95。这些发现支持生长的 ZnS 薄膜作为光伏电池和肖特基势垒电子应用中的窗口/缓冲层的潜力。

articles.title: Achieving simultaneous flame retardancy and mechanical reinforcement in PLA via PAPP/La 2 O 3 synergistic catalysis and uniaxial pre-stretching
articles.title_zh: 通过PAPP/La 2 O 3 协同催化和单轴预拉伸同时实现PLA的阻燃和机械增强
articles.abstract: Polylactic acid (PLA) is a promising bioplastic but its high flammability and poor toughness severely restrict its practical applications. Herein, we report a dual-strategy to simultaneously address these limitations by combining piperazine pyrophosphate (PAPP)/nano-La2O3 synergistic flame-retardant system with uniaxial pre-stretching post-treatment. Compared with pure PLA, the PLA composite containing 13 wt% PAPP and 2 wt% nano-La2O3 demonstrated the optimal performance, with an increase in LOI from 19.8% to 34.6% and achieving a UL‑94 V‑0 rating. Cone calorimetry revealed significant reductions in total heat release (from 79.6 to 27.8 MJ/m2) and peak heat release rate (from 368.0 to 185.6 kW/m2). Comprehensive char residue analyses (SEM, EDS, FTIR, Raman, XPS) confirmed that nano-La2O3 catalyzed the formation of a dense, highly graphitized carbon layer, effectively suppressing heat and mass transfer in the condensed phase, while gas-phase radical scavenging (PO·, PO₂·, HPO·) further interrupted combustion. Remarkably, uniaxial pre-stretching at 60°C transformed the brittle composites into ductile materials: the tensile strength of PLA/13%PAPP/2%La2O3 composite increased from 53.8 MPa to 67.4 MPa, and elongation at break dramatically increased from 4.8% to 84.5% (an 18-fold improvement). This work provides a feasible and effective strategy for developing high-performance flame-retardant PLA material with balanced fire safety and mechanical properties, offering great potential for packaging, electronics, and transportation applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 聚乳酸（PLA）是一种很有前景的生物塑料，但其高可燃性和较差的韧性严重限制了其实际应用。在此，我们报告了一种双策略，通过将焦磷酸哌嗪（PAPP）/纳米La2O3协同阻燃系统与单轴预拉伸后处理相结合来同时解决这些限制。与纯 PLA 相比，含有 13 wt% PAPP 和 2 wt% 纳米 La2O3 的 PLA 复合材料表现出最佳性能，LOI 从 19.8% 增加到 34.6%，并达到 UL-94 V-0 等级。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 聚乳酸（PLA）是一种很有前景的生物塑料，但其高可燃性和较差的韧性严重限制了其实际应用。在此，我们报告了一种双策略，通过将焦磷酸哌嗪（PAPP）/纳米La2O3协同阻燃系统与单轴预拉伸后处理相结合来同时解决这些限制。与纯 PLA 相比，含有 13 wt% PAPP 和 2 wt% 纳米 La2O3 的 PLA 复合材料表现出最佳性能，LOI 从 19.8% 增加到 34.6%，并达到 UL-94 V-0 等级。锥形量热法显示总热量释放（从 79.6 至 27.8 MJ/m2）和峰值热量释放率（从 368.0 至 185.6 kW/m2）显着降低。综合残炭分析（SEM、EDS、FTIR、拉曼、XPS）证实，纳米La2O3催化形成致密、高度石墨化的碳层，有效抑制凝聚相中的传热和传质，而气相自由基清除（PO·、PO2·、HPO·）进一步中断燃烧。值得注意的是，60°C 下的单轴预拉伸将脆性复合材料转变为韧性材料：PLA/13%PAPP/2%La2O3 复合材料的拉伸强度从 53.8 MPa 增加到 67.4 MPa，断裂伸长率从 4.8% 急剧增加到 84.5%（提高了 18 倍）。这项工作为开发具有平衡的防火安全和机械性能的高性能阻燃PLA材料提供了可行且有效的策略，为包装、电子和运输应用提供了巨大的潜力。

articles.title: Integrating GIS and machine learning for pollution vulnerability mapping in South Africa’s Kruger National Park
articles.title_zh: 集成 GIS 和机器学习来绘制南非克鲁格国家公园的污染脆弱性地图
articles.abstract: Pollution in protected areas can affect ecosystem integrity, biodiversity conservation, and the long-term sustainability of natural resource management. This study developed an integrated GIS and machine learning framework to assess and map pollution vulnerability in South Africa’s Kruger National Park (KNP). Environmental and atmospheric variables, including the Normalised Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI), nitrogen dioxide (NO₂), sulphur dioxide (SO₂), carbon monoxide (CO), methane (CH₄), particulate matter (PM₂.₅), rainfall, and temperature, were integrated within Google Earth Engine and Python-based analytical environments. Random Forest (RF), Support Vector Machine (SVM), and Gradient Boosting Machine (GBM) algorithms were applied to classify spatial patterns of pollution vulnerability and identify the variables contributing most strongly to the observed patterns. The results showed that GBM achieved an overall classification accuracy of 0.76, while RF produced an area under the curve (AUC) of 0.96 and SVM achieved an AUC of 0.90. SO₂ and NO₂ were among the most influential variables in the modelling framework, indicating the importance of atmospheric pollution indicators in explaining spatial variations in vulnerability. The resulting vulnerability maps identified areas with moderate to high pollution vulnerability that can support targeted environmental monitoring and conservation planning. By integrating remote sensing, GIS, and machine learning, the study provides a spatial decision-support framework for sustainable environmental management in a large, protected area. The findings contribute particularly to Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) 15 (Life on Land) through improved protection and management of terrestrial ecosystems, while also supporting SDG 13 (Climate Action) through climate-sensitive environmental planning and contributing to SDG 3 (Good Health and Well-being) through improved management of environmental pollution.
articles.abstract_zh: 保护区的污染会影响生态系统的完整性、生物多样性的保护以及自然资源管理的长期可持续性。本研究开发了一个集成的 GIS 和机器学习框架，用于评估和绘制南非克鲁格国家公园 (KNP) 的污染脆弱性。环境和大气变量，包括归一化植被指数 (NDVI)、二氧化氮 (NO2)、二氧化硫 (SO2)、一氧化碳 (CO)、甲烷 (CH4)、颗粒物 (PM2.5)、降雨量和温度，均集成在 Google Earth Engine 和基于 Python 的分析环境中。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 保护区的污染会影响生态系统的完整性、生物多样性的保护以及自然资源管理的长期可持续性。本研究开发了一个集成的 GIS 和机器学习框架，用于评估和绘制南非克鲁格国家公园 (KNP) 的污染脆弱性。环境和大气变量，包括归一化植被指数 (NDVI)、二氧化氮 (NO2)、二氧化硫 (SO2)、一氧化碳 (CO)、甲烷 (CH4)、颗粒物 (PM2.5)、降雨量和温度，均集成在 Google Earth Engine 和基于 Python 的分析环境中。应用随机森林 (RF)、支持向量机 (SVM) 和梯度提升机 (GBM) 算法对污染脆弱性的空间模式进行分类，并识别对观察到的模式影响最大的变量。结果表明，GBM 的总体分类精度为 0.76，而 RF 的曲线下面积 (AUC) 为 0.96，SVM 的 AUC 为 0.90。 SO2 和 NO2 是建模框架中最具影响力的变量之一，表明大气污染指标在解释脆弱性空间变化方面的重要性。由此产生的脆弱性地图确定了具有中度至高度污染脆弱性的区域，可以支持有针对性的环境监测和保护规划。通过整合遥感、GIS 和机器学习，该研究为大型保护区的可持续环境管理提供了空间决策支持框架。研究结果特别有助于通过改善陆地生态系统的保护和管理实现可持续发展目标 (SDG) 15（陆地生命），同时还通过气候敏感的环境规划支持 SDG 13（气候行动），并通过改善环境污染管理为 SDG 3（良好健康和福祉）做出贡献。

articles.abstract: For the first time, scientists have achieved strong coupling between light and long-lived acoustic vibrations in an optical fiber. Optical fibers are used in both classical telecommunications and quantum communication and could serve not only as connections between computing nodes but also as quantum processors themselves in the future. The results, published in Nature Physics, pave the way for new technologies in quantum signal processing.

articles.title: Hybridization–Ionicity Mapping for Descriptor-Guided Design of Amorphous Ge–Sb–Se Selector-Only Memory
articles.title_zh: 用于非晶 Ge-Sb-Se 仅选择器存储器描述符引导设计的杂交离子度映射
articles.abstract: Quantitative relationships among composition, bonding, and functional properties are essential for the rational design of amorphous chalcogenides. Here, we examine whether hybridization and ionicity, established composition-derived bonding descriptors, can guide selector-only memory (SOM) design. Mapping of reported SOM compositions reveals systematic correlations with the read-window margin (RWM) and identifies a favorable region for threshold-state differentiation. Guided by these trends, amorphous Ge–Sb–Se compositions with increasing Sb content were fabricated and evaluated, and all exhibited programmable SOM behavior with nonmonotonic electrical and reliability trends. Up to an intermediate Sb content, higher ionicity within an appropriate hybridization range increased polar heteropolar bonding, enlarged trap-energy separation and RWM, and improved threshold-voltage stability and endurance. Further Sb incorporation increased hybridization beyond the favorable range and promoted Sb–Sb-rich homopolar bonding, reducing trap-state differentiation and memory performance. X-ray photoelectron and Raman spectroscopy confirmed the corresponding bonding evolution, while temperature-dependent transport analyses linked these changes to trap energetics. These results establish a composition–bonding–trap–property relationship and show that hybridization–ionicity mapping can narrow candidate compositions before extensive fabrication and characterization.
articles.abstract_zh: 组成、键合和功能特性之间的定量关系对于非晶硫属化物的合理设计至关重要。在这里，我们研究了杂交和离子性以及已建立的成分衍生键合描述符是否可以指导纯选择器记忆（SOM）设计。所报道的 SOM 成分的映射揭示了与读取窗口边缘 (RWM) 的系统相关性，并确定了阈值状态分化的有利区域。在这些趋势的指导下，制备并评估了 Sb 含量增加的非晶 Ge-Sb-Se 组合物，并且所有组合物均表现出具有非单调电气和可靠性趋势的可编程 SOM 行为。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 组成、键合和功能特性之间的定量关系对于非晶硫属化物的合理设计至关重要。在这里，我们研究了杂交和离子性以及已建立的成分衍生键合描述符是否可以指导纯选择器记忆（SOM）设计。所报道的 SOM 成分的映射揭示了与读取窗口边缘 (RWM) 的系统相关性，并确定了阈值状态分化的有利区域。在这些趋势的指导下，制备并评估了 Sb 含量增加的非晶 Ge-Sb-Se 组合物，并且所有组合物均表现出具有非单调电气和可靠性趋势的可编程 SOM 行为。直到中间的 Sb 含量，在适当的杂化范围内较高的离子度增加了极性异极键合，扩大了陷阱能量分离和 RWM，并提高了阈值电压稳定性和耐久性。进一步的 Sb 掺入使杂化超出了有利范围，并促进了 Sb-Sb 富集同极键合，减少了陷阱态分化和记忆性能。 X射线光电子和拉曼光谱证实了相应的成键演化，而温度依赖性输运分析将这些变化与陷阱能量学联系起来。这些结果建立了成分-键合-陷阱-性质关系，并表明杂交-离子映射可以在广泛的制造和表征之前缩小候选成分的范围。

articles.title: Features of the crystal structure and long-range magnetic order in honeycomb layered K2Ni2TeO6
articles.title_zh: 蜂窝状层状K2Ni2TeO6晶体结构和长程磁序特征
articles.abstract: Layered honeycomb oxides A2Ni2TeO6 are emerging as promising candidates for advanced spintronic devices and potassium-ion energy storage systems due to their unique quasi-two-dimensional magnetic and transport properties. In this work, we present a neutron powder diffraction study of the crystal and magnetic structure of K2Ni2TeO6 over the temperature range 4–300 K. The sample crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P63/mcm featuring alternating magnetic and non-magnetic layers. Below the Néel temperature (TN ≈ 22.8 K) the material exhibits a complex, incommensurate amplitude-modulated magnetic structure with a propagation vector k = (1/2-δ; δ; 1/3 + δ) with a relatively small incommensurability δ = 0.03. Within the honeycomb layers, Ni2+ ions form a hexagonal honeycomb lattice centered on Te6+ ions. Crucially, the large interlayer spacing in K2Ni2TeO6 significantly suppresses the interlayer exchange interaction compared to its lithium analog Li2Ni2TeO6, stabilizing a quasi-two-dimensional magnetic ground state. These findings provide critical insights into the magneto-structural coupling in frustrated honeycomb lattices and highlight the potential of K2Ni2TeO6 for applications in 2D magnetism, quantum materials, and high-voltage electrochemical energy storage.
articles.abstract_zh: 层状蜂窝状氧化物 A2Ni2TeO6 由于其独特的准二维磁性和传输特性而成为先进自旋电子器件和钾离子储能系统的有希望的候选者。在这项工作中，我们对 K2Ni2TeO6 在 4–300 K 温度范围内的晶体和磁性结构进行了中子粉末衍射研究。样品在六方空间群 P63/mcm 中结晶，具有交替的磁性层和非磁性层。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 层状蜂窝状氧化物 A2Ni2TeO6 由于其独特的准二维磁性和传输特性而成为先进自旋电子器件和钾离子储能系统的有希望的候选者。在这项工作中，我们对 K2Ni2TeO6 在 4–300 K 温度范围内的晶体和磁性结构进行了中子粉末衍射研究。样品在六方空间群 P63/mcm 中结晶，具有交替的磁性层和非磁性层。在尼尔温度 (TN ≈ 22.8 K) 以下，材料表现出复杂的、不可通约的调幅磁结构，其传播矢量 k = (1/2-δ; δ; 1/3 + δ) 以及相对较小的不可通约性 δ = 0.03。在蜂窝层内，Ni2+ 离子形成以 Te6+ 离子为中心的六角形蜂窝晶格。至关重要的是，与锂类似物 Li2Ni2TeO6 相比，K2Ni2TeO6 中的大层间距显着抑制了层间交换相互作用，从而稳定了准二维磁性基态。这些发现为受挫蜂窝晶格中的磁结构耦合提供了重要的见解，并凸显了 K2Ni2TeO6 在二维磁性、量子材料和高压电化学储能方面应用的潜力。

articles.title: Classification of Welds Using Neural Networks trained on Syntetic Data
articles.title_zh: 使用基于综合数据训练的神经网络对焊缝进行分类
articles.abstract: The advancement of digital inspection systems has enabled data-driven visual testing of welds, allowing systematic, repeatable, and quantitative assessment. These improvements can be implemented in the fatigue assessment of structures subjected to cyclic loading, particularly where local weld imperfections govern overall strength. With resolutions significantly finer than traditional analogue methods, imperfections can be identified more systematically and reliably than with manual visual testing. However, digital representations of welds introduce the challenge of reliably identifying and classifying weld regions and imperfections, a task that is straightforward for a human inspector but non-trivial to perform numerically. Neural networks are well-established for segmentation tasks and have recently been applied to weld inspection, where their compatibility with digital measurement data makes them suitable for classifying imperfections. When using real-world training data, the network requires ground truth labels, which are labour-intensive to produce and may introduce subjectivity. An alternative is synthetic data with deterministic ground truth, offering access to large, controlled datasets. However, the question remains how well a network trained on synthetic data generalize to real-world data. This work presents an approach for classification of weld surfaces using synthetic training data. The proposed method employs a U-net-based neural network architecture to classify unwelded base material, the weld bead, and the transition zone. The training data consists of synthetic butt and fillet welds generated with varying global and local geometric parameters. A stochastic data generation framework is proposed that uses an Ornstein–Uhlenbeck process to emulate natural variability in welds and measurement systems. The statistical properties of the generated welds are based on previously reported measurements, while parameter distributions are uniformly sampled from ISO 5817 quality levels. The trained model is evaluated qualitatively on scans of real welds, demonstrating that models trained on synthetic data can identify and classify weld regions.
articles.abstract_zh: 数字检测系统的进步使得数据驱动的焊缝可视化测试成为可能，从而实现系统、可重复和定量的评估。这些改进可以在承受循环载荷的结构的疲劳评估中实施，特别是在局部焊缝缺陷控制整体强度的情况下。其分辨率明显优于传统模拟方法，与手动视觉测试相比，可以更系统、更可靠地识别缺陷。然而，焊缝的数字表示带来了可靠地识别和分类焊缝区域和缺陷的挑战，这项任务对于检查员来说很简单，但以数字方式执行却并非易事。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 数字检测系统的进步使得数据驱动的焊缝可视化测试成为可能，从而实现系统、可重复和定量的评估。这些改进可以在承受循环载荷的结构的疲劳评估中实施，特别是在局部焊缝缺陷控制整体强度的情况下。其分辨率明显优于传统模拟方法，与手动视觉测试相比，可以更系统、更可靠地识别缺陷。然而，焊缝的数字表示带来了可靠地识别和分类焊缝区域和缺陷的挑战，这项任务对于检查员来说很简单，但以数字方式执行却并非易事。神经网络在分割任务方面已经很完善，最近已应用于焊缝检测，它们与数字测量数据的兼容性使其适合对缺陷进行分类。当使用现实世界的训练数据时，网络需要地面实况标签，这些标签的制作需要大量劳动力，并且可能会引入主观性。另一种选择是具有确定性基本事实的合成数据，提供对大型受控数据集的访问。然而，问题仍然在于，经过合成数据训练的网络能否很好地推广到现实世界的数据。这项工作提出了一种使用合成训练数据对焊接表面进行分类的方法。该方法采用基于 U-net 的神经网络架构对未焊接母材、焊道和过渡区进行分类。训练数据由使用不同的全局和局部几何参数生成的合成对接焊缝和角焊缝组成。提出了一种随机数据生成框架，该框架使用 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck 过程来模拟焊缝和测量系统的自然变化。生成的焊缝的统计属性基于之前报告的测量结果，而参数分布则从 ISO 5817 质量水平中统一采样。通过对真实焊缝的扫描对训练后的模型进行定性评估，证明根据合成数据训练的模型可以识别和分类焊缝区域。

articles.title: Mitigation of Common Mode Voltage in Multilevel Inverters for Linear and Non-linear Resistive Loads
articles.title_zh: 线性和非线性电阻负载的多电平逆变器中共模电压的缓解
articles.abstract: Multilevel inverters (MLIs) are popular due to their ability to provide voltage quality and reduce harmonics. However, common mode voltage (CMV) can undermine these advantages by affecting systems and electromagnetic compatibility. CMV can lead to electrical noise, Electromagnetic Interference (EMI), and potential damage to connected devices. To address this issue, a novel circuit is proposed in this paper aimed at effectively mitigating CMV in multilevel inverters when driving both linear and non-linear resistive loads. The modified circuit is designed to minimize CMV with experimental validation, and the results are graphically presented. The study encompasses a comprehensive analysis of CMV reduction and the effectiveness of the circuit modification in achieving significantly reduced CMV, contributing to improved system performance and reliability. The experimentation offers valuable insights in the field of power electronics, providing a practical solution for CMV reduction in multilevel inverter applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 多电平逆变器 (MLI) 因其提供电压质量和减少谐波的能力而广受欢迎。然而，共模电压 (CMV) 可能会影响系统和电磁兼容性，从而削弱这些优势。 CMV 可能会导致电噪声、电磁干扰 (EMI) 以及对连接设备的潜在损坏。为了解决这个问题，本文提出了一种新颖的电路，旨在在驱动线性和非线性电阻负载时有效减轻多电平逆变器中的 CMV。修改后的电路旨在通过实验验证最大限度地减少 CMV，并以图形方式呈现结果。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 多电平逆变器 (MLI) 因其提供电压质量和减少谐波的能力而广受欢迎。然而，共模电压 (CMV) 可能会影响系统和电磁兼容性，从而削弱这些优势。 CMV 可能会导致电噪声、电磁干扰 (EMI) 以及对连接设备的潜在损坏。为了解决这个问题，本文提出了一种新颖的电路，旨在在驱动线性和非线性电阻负载时有效减轻多电平逆变器中的 CMV。修改后的电路旨在通过实验验证最大限度地减少 CMV，并以图形方式呈现结果。该研究包括对 CMV 降低的全面分析以及电路修改在显着降低 CMV 方面的有效性，从而有助于提高系统性能和可靠性。该实验为电力电子领域提供了宝贵的见解，为多电平逆变器应用中的 CMV 降低提供了实用的解决方案。

articles.title: Physics-Informed Multimodal Learning for Wheel-Force Prediction and Grip Utilization Optimization Using Image Detection and Chassis Sensors in Electric Vehicles
articles.title_zh: 在电动汽车中使用图像检测和底盘传感器进行基于物理的多模态学习，用于车轮力预测和抓地力利用率优化
articles.abstract: Accurate, real-time knowledge of the forces generated at each tire contact patch is central to electronic stability control, traction control, and learning-based driver-assistance functions in electric vehicles (EVs). Conventional model-based observers assume a single friction coefficient and degrade under the transient, spatially varying friction conditions typical of real roads, while purely data-driven estimators can output forces that violate the friction-ellipse constraint, undermining safety-critical decisions. This paper proposes a physics-informed multimodal learning framework that fuses forward-facing camera imagery with in-vehicle chassis-sensor streams to predict per-wheel longitudinal and lateral tire forces and quantify a grip-utilization ratio for early loss-of-traction warning. A vision branch, calibrated to the reported accuracy of convolutional road-surface classifiers trained on the public Road Surface Classification Dataset (RSCD), supplies a road-friction class posterior; a chassis branch summarizes a 0.8 s sliding window of inertial, wheel-speed, steering and powertrain signals via a time-delay neural network encoding; the two modalities are combined through a lightweight cross-modal feature-wise linear modulation (FiLM) fusion gate. Training combines a data-fidelity loss with physics-informed soft constraints derived from a quasi-static load-transfer model and the Pacejka Magic-Formula friction ellipse. Using a hybrid dataset of 9,000 samples from a validated four-wheel vehicle-dynamics simulator spanning five friction classes, from dry asphalt to ice, and five manoeuvres, the proposed model reduces wheel-force RMSE by 22–42 percent relative to chassis-only and naive multimodal baselines on wet, snow-covered and icy surfaces, lowers the deployable friction-ellipse violation rate to 13.5 percent, and improves accuracy under distribution shift to unseen low-friction conditions relative to a non-physics-informed ablation. The complete model contains only 4,200 parameters and executes in under one millisecond per inference, supporting real-time deployment on embedded control units. These results indicate that lightweight cross-modal fusion combined with physics-informed regularization is a practical route to safer, more generalizable grip-utilization estimation in production EVs.
articles.abstract_zh: 准确、实时地了解每个轮胎接触面产生的力对于电动汽车 (EV) 中的电子稳定性控制、牵引力控制和基于学习的驾驶员辅助功能至关重要。传统的基于模型的观测器假设单个摩擦系数，并在真实道路典型的瞬态、空间变化的摩擦条件下退化，而纯粹的数据驱动估计器可以输出违反摩擦椭圆约束的力，从而破坏安全关键决策。本文提出了一种基于物理的多模态学习框架，该框架将前向摄像头图像与车载底盘传感器流相融合，以预测每个车轮的纵向和横向轮胎力，并量化抓地力利用率，以进行早期牵引力损失警告。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 准确、实时地了解每个轮胎接触面产生的力对于电动汽车 (EV) 中的电子稳定性控制、牵引力控制和基于学习的驾驶员辅助功能至关重要。传统的基于模型的观测器假设单个摩擦系数，并在真实道路典型的瞬态、空间变化的摩擦条件下退化，而纯粹的数据驱动估计器可以输出违反摩擦椭圆约束的力，从而破坏安全关键决策。本文提出了一种基于物理的多模态学习框架，该框架将前向摄像头图像与车载底盘传感器流相融合，以预测每个车轮的纵向和横向轮胎力，并量化抓地力利用率，以进行早期牵引力损失警告。视觉分支根据在公共道路表面分类数据集（RSCD）上训练的卷积路面分类器报告的准确性进行校准，提供道路摩擦类别后验；底盘分支通过延时神经网络编码总结惯性、轮速、转向和动力系统信号的 0.8 秒滑动窗口；这两种模态通过轻量级跨模态特征线性调制（FiLM）融合门进行组合。训练将数据保真度损失与源自准静态载荷传递模型和 Pacejka Magic-Formula 摩擦椭圆的物理软约束相结合。使用来自经过验证的四轮车辆动力学模拟器的 9,000 个样本的混合数据集，涵盖从干沥青到冰的五个摩擦等级和五种机动，所提出的模型相对于潮湿、积雪和结冰表面上的纯底盘和天真的多模态基线，将轮力 RMSE 降低了 22-42%，将可部署的摩擦椭圆违规率降低到 13.5%，并提高了分布转移到看不见的情况下的精度相对于非物理消融的低摩擦条件。完整的模型仅包含 4,200 个参数，每次推理的执行时间不到一毫秒，支持嵌入式控制单元上的实时部署。这些结果表明，轻量级跨模态融合与物理信息正则化相结合是在量产电动汽车中实现更安全、更通用的抓地力利用率估计的实用途径。

articles.title: BiOBr/MoWO4 p-n heterojunction photoanode for photodegradation of norfloxacin in water
articles.title_zh: BiOBr/MoWO4 p-n 异质结光阳极光降解水中的诺氟沙星
articles.abstract: In the quest for alternative, complementary, and sustainable water treatment methods. We report the photoelectrocatalytic degradation of norfloxacin in an aqueous medium using an in situ hydrothermally synthesised bismuthoxybromide-molybdenum tungstate (BiOBr/MoWO4) p–n heterojunction photoanode. The BiOBr/MoWO4 heterojunction was strategically used to improve the photoelectrocatalytic performance by lowering photogenerated electron-hole pair recombination, optimising band edge alignment, and elevating the visible light absorption capacity. The BiOBr/MoWO4 heterojunction was deposited onto a fluorine-doped tin oxide (FTO) substrate to serve as a photoanode for the photoelectrocatalytic breakdown of norfloxacin under visible light irradiation. The structural, morphological, optical, and surface properties of the as-prepared BiOBr/MoWO4 photoanode were comprehensively characterised using XRD, FTIR, SEM, FE-SEM coupled with  EDX, HRTEM, and BET. Under optimized conditions, the BiOBr/MoWO4 photoanode achieved norfloxacin degradation of 85%, surpassing both pristine BiOBr (71%) and MoWO4 (56%) photoanodes, thereby confirming the synergistic enhancement conferred by heterojunction formation. Scavenger studies revealed that the photogenerated holes () and superoxide anion radicals ()  played a significant role in the degradation of norfloxacin. TOC analysis demonstrated mineralisation efficiency of 41% and 70% in synthetic water and real wastewater matrices, respectively, confirming the effective conversion of norfloxacin into innocuous end products.  Reusability studies confirmed the structural stability and sustained catalytic performance of the BiOBr/MoWO4 photoanode over multiple degradation cycles, underscoring its potential for practical application in the treatment of pharmaceutical-contaminated wastewater.
articles.abstract_zh: 寻求替代、补充和可持续的水处理方法。我们报道了使用原位水热合成的溴氧化铋-钨酸钼（BiOBr/MoWO4）p-n异质结光电阳极在水介质中光电催化降解诺氟沙星。 BiOBr/MoWO4 异质结被战略性地用于通过降低光生电子-空穴对复合、优化能带边缘排列和提高可见光吸收能力来提高光电催化性能。 BiOBr/MoWO4 异质结沉积在氟掺杂氧化锡 (FTO) 基板上，作为光电阳极在可见光照射下光电催化分解诺氟沙星。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 寻求替代、补充和可持续的水处理方法。我们报道了使用原位水热合成的溴氧化铋-钨酸钼（BiOBr/MoWO4）p-n异质结光电阳极在水介质中光电催化降解诺氟沙星。 BiOBr/MoWO4 异质结被战略性地用于通过降低光生电子-空穴对复合、优化能带边缘排列和提高可见光吸收能力来提高光电催化性能。 BiOBr/MoWO4 异质结沉积在氟掺杂氧化锡 (FTO) 基板上，作为光电阳极在可见光照射下光电催化分解诺氟沙星。使用 XRD、FTIR、SEM、FE-SEM 以及 EDX、HRTEM 和 BET 对所制备的 BiOBr/MoWO4 光阳极的结构、形态、光学和表面性能进行了全面表征。在优化条件下，BiOBr/MoWO4 光阳极实现了 85% 的诺氟沙星降解，超过了原始 BiOBr (71%) 和 MoWO4 (56%) 光阳极，从而证实了异质结形成带来的协同增强作用。清除剂研究表明，光生空穴（）和超氧阴离子自由基（）在诺氟沙星的降解中发挥了重要作用。 TOC 分析表明，合成水和实际废水基质中的矿化效率分别为 41% 和 70%，证实诺氟沙星有效转化为无害的最终产品。  可重复使用性研究证实了 BiOBr/MoWO4 光阳极在多个降解循环中的结构稳定性和持续催化性能，强调了其在药物污染废水处理中的实际应用潜力。

articles.title: A Restricted No-Go Theorem for Exact, Coherent, and Isolated Quantum Learning Architectures
articles.title_zh: 精确、相干和孤立量子学习架构的受限禁止定理
articles.abstract: The straightforward translation of classical machine learning models into the quantum domain is obstructed by fundamental structural constraints of quantum mechanics. In this work, we rigorously examine the interplay between universality, coherent training, and isolation in quantum learning systems. We prove a restricted no-go theorem: within the setting of exact continuous unitary hypothesis classes, finite-dimensional closed quantum systems, and fully coherent parameter-update rules with no intermediate measurement or classical feedback, no architecture can simultaneously satisfy universality (U), coherent training (C), and isolation (I). This result follows from a synthesis of the no-programming theorem, linearity of quantum dynamics, and the necessity of measurement for performance evaluation. Crucially, we distinguish between (i) nonlinear functions applied to classical parameter values encoded in a computational basis, which are permitted, and (ii) deterministic nonlinear transformations on arbitrary unknown quantum states, which are forbidden. Our analysis shows that many naively quantized models, such as fully coherent versions of neural networks, support vector machines, and principal component analysis, either incur substantial state-preparation overheads or violate the structural rules of quantum theory. We conclude that viable quantum machine learning (QML) architectures must relax the isolation condition, thereby justifying the dominant hybrid classical-quantum paradigm not as a mere engineering compromise, but as a physical necessity imposed by the UCI constraints.
articles.abstract_zh: 经典机器学习模型到量子领域的直接转换受到量子力学基本结构约束的阻碍。在这项工作中，我们严格研究了量子学习系统中的普遍性、连贯训练和隔离之间的相互作用。我们证明了一个受限的不可行定理：在精确连续酉假设类、有限维封闭量子系统和没有中间测量或经典反馈的完全相干参数更新规则的设置下，没有任何体系结构可以同时满足普遍性（U）、相干训练（C）和隔离性（I）。这一结果是综合了无编程定理、量子动力学的线性以及性能评估测量的必要性而得出的。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 经典机器学习模型到量子领域的直接转换受到量子力学基本结构约束的阻碍。在这项工作中，我们严格研究了量子学习系统中的普遍性、连贯训练和隔离之间的相互作用。我们证明了一个受限的不可行定理：在精确连续酉假设类、有限维封闭量子系统和没有中间测量或经典反馈的完全相干参数更新规则的设置下，没有任何体系结构可以同时满足普遍性（U）、相干训练（C）和隔离性（I）。这一结果是综合了无编程定理、量子动力学的线性以及性能评估测量的必要性而得出的。至关重要的是，我们区分（i）应用于计算基础上编码的经典参数值的非线性函数（这是允许的）和（ii）对任意未知量子态的确定性非线性变换（这是禁止的）。我们的分析表明，许多简单的量化模型，例如完全相干版本的神经网络、支持向量机和主成分分析，要么会产生大量的状态准备开销，要么违反了量子理论的结构规则。我们的结论是，可行的量子机器学习 (QML) 架构必须放宽隔离条件，从而证明占主导地位的混合经典量子范式的合理性不仅仅是工程妥协，而是 UCI 约束所强加的物理必要性。

articles.title: Experimental Statistical and Explainable Machine Learning Prediction of Surface Roughness in Cryogenically Pre-Cooled Machining of Inconel 718
articles.title_zh: Inconel 718 低温预冷加工中表面粗糙度的实验统计和可解释机器学习预测
articles.abstract: Cryogenic machining offers a sustainable route for improving the machinability of nickel-based superalloys by reducing thermal loading and improving surface quality. This study develops an experimental-statistical-explainable machine learning framework for predicting surface roughness during cryogenically pre-cooled machining of Inconel 718. Spindle speed, feed rate, and depth of cut were varied through a 20-run face-centered central composite design. Each trial was repeated three times, and surface roughness was measured at three locations. The response surface model explained 91.95% of the measured variation and was used to generate a 1,387-point model-based dataset. Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, Support Vector Regression, XGBoost, and Artificial Neural Network models were compared. To test whether the inputs made non-redundant contributions, an XGBoost feature-ablation study was performed using ten repeated train-test partitions. The full model achieved a mean R² of 0.9922 and RMSE of 0.0170 µm. Removing spindle speed produced the largest deterioration (R² = 0.3200), followed by feed rate (R² = 0.4408) and depth of cut (R² = 0.6976). SHAP analysis attributed 41.85% of the global contribution to spindle speed, 37.04% to feed rate, and 21.11% to depth of cut. At the independently tested RSM-optimized condition, XGBoost predicted surface roughness with an error of 4.89%, compared with 8.25% for RSM. The explainability results show how each machining parameter shapes the learned response surface while also demonstrating that predictions remain constrained by the experimental RSM model from which the expanded dataset was generated.
articles.abstract_zh: 低温加工通过减少热负荷和提高表面质量，为提高镍基高温合金的机械加工性提供了一条可持续的途径。本研究开发了一种实验统计可解释的机器学习框架，用于预测 Inconel 718 低温预冷加工过程中的表面粗糙度。通过 20 次运行的面心中心复合材料设计来改变主轴速度、进给率和切削深度。每个试验重复三次，并在三个位置测量表面粗糙度。响应面模型解释了 91.95% 的测量变化，并用于生成基于模型的 1,387 点数据集。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 低温加工通过减少热负荷和提高表面质量，为提高镍基高温合金的机械加工性提供了一条可持续的途径。本研究开发了一种实验统计可解释的机器学习框架，用于预测 Inconel 718 低温预冷加工过程中的表面粗糙度。通过 20 次运行的面心中心复合材料设计来改变主轴速度、进给率和切削深度。每个试验重复三次，并在三个位置测量表面粗糙度。响应面模型解释了 91.95% 的测量变化，并用于生成基于模型的 1,387 点数据集。比较了随机森林、梯度提升、支持向量回归、XGBoost 和人工神经网络模型。为了测试输入是否做出非冗余贡献，使用十个重复的训练测试分区进行了 XGBoost 特征消融研究。完整模型的平均 R² 为 0.9922，RMSE 为 0.0170 µm。去除主轴速度造成的恶化最大（R² = 0.3200），其次是进给速率（R² = 0.4408）和切削深度（R² = 0.6976）。 SHAP 分析将全球贡献的 41.85% 归因于主轴转速，37.04% 归因于进给速度，21.11% 归因于切削深度。在独立测试的 RSM 优化条件下，XGBoost 预测表面粗糙度的误差为 4.89%，而 RSM 的误差为 8.25%。可解释性结果显示了每个加工参数如何塑造学习的响应面，同时还证明预测仍然受到生成扩展数据集的实验 RSM 模型的限制。

articles.title: High-Precision and Low-Complexity ToA Estimation for Sensor Networks in GNSS-Denied Scenarios via Waveform–Algorithm Co-Design
articles.title_zh: 通过波形算法协同设计对 GNSS 拒绝场景中的传感器网络进行高精度、低复杂度的 ToA 估计
articles.abstract: In disaster zones or infrastructure-less areas, Global Navigation Satellite Systems (GNSS) are vulnerable to jamming and spoofing attacks, often leading to signal denial. Radio positioning serves as a critical backup for high-precision spatiotemporal reference measurement, particularly for wireless sensor networks (WSNs) operating in GNSS-denied environments. However, long-range radio signal propagation faces challenges such as extreme path loss, severe multipath effects, and insufficient chip-level delay resolution. These factors make Time-of-Arrival (ToA) estimation extremely difficult, limiting pseudorange accuracy and consequently constraining overall navigation performance. To address this, we propose a System-Aware Time-of-Arrival (SA-ToA) method that synergistically integrates waveform design and algorithm processing. First, we define a four-dimensional orthogonal spread spectrum signal architecture (Time-Frequency-CDMA-Time Hopping, T-F-CDMA-TH), which provides the necessary prior knowledge for sensor node acquisition. Subsequently, we design a three-stage collaborative mechanism comprising scheduling-guided coarse acquisition, an improved CLEAN-based multipath separation, and parabolic fitting-based sub-sample fine estimation. This approach optimizes ranging performance in complex environments. Theoretically, we derive that under ideal single-path conditions with a 40 MHz bandwidth and a 16 dB despread Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR), the Cramér-Rao Lower Bound (CRLB) for ToA estimation is 0.46 meters. Monte Carlo simulations validate the robustness of the SA-ToA method against typical disturbances, including fractional sampling delays, timing jitter, and strong multipath interference. Results show that under Line-of-Sight (LoS) conditions, the Root Mean Square (RMS) ranging error is better than 1.65 m for short ranges (10-100 m) and better than 5 m for long ranges (200 km). Even under severe near-end multipath interference (NLoS1/NLoS2) and low‑SNR conditions (down to 0 dB), the proposed method achieves robust numerical convergence with 100% availability across all Monte‑Carlo test runs. Comparative analysis with classical estimation methods demonstrates that the SA-ToA method reduces the RMS error by an order of magnitude, approaching the theoretical limit most closely. Thus, the proposed method holds significant potential for enhancing radio positioning system performance in GNSS-denied scenarios.
articles.abstract_zh: 在灾区或基础设施匮乏的地区，全球导航卫星系统 (GNSS) 容易受到干扰和欺骗攻击，常常导致信号被拒绝。无线电定位是高精度时空参考测量的关键备份，特别是对于在 GNSS 拒绝环境中运行的无线传感器网络 (WSN) 而言。然而，长距离无线信号传播面临路径损耗极大、多径效应严重、芯片级时延分辨率不足等挑战。这些因素使得到达时间 (ToA) 估计极其困难，限制了伪距精度，从而限制了整体导航性能。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在灾区或基础设施匮乏的地区，全球导航卫星系统 (GNSS) 容易受到干扰和欺骗攻击，常常导致信号被拒绝。无线电定位是高精度时空参考测量的关键备份，特别是对于在 GNSS 拒绝环境中运行的无线传感器网络 (WSN) 而言。然而，长距离无线信号传播面临路径损耗极大、多径效应严重、芯片级时延分辨率不足等挑战。这些因素使得到达时间 (ToA) 估计极其困难，限制了伪距精度，从而限制了整体导航性能。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种系统感知到达时间（SA-ToA）方法，该方法协同集成波形设计和算法处理。首先，我们定义了一个四维正交扩频信号架构（时频-CDMA-跳时，T-F-CDMA-TH），它为传感器节点采集提供了必要的先验知识。随后，我们设计了一个三阶段协作机制，包括调度引导的粗采集、改进的基于 CLEAN 的多径分离和基于抛物线拟合的子样本精细估计。这种方法优化了复杂环境中的测距性能。理论上，我们得出在 40 MHz 带宽和 16 dB 解扩信噪比 (SNR) 的理想单路径条件下，ToA 估计的 Cramér-Rao 下界 (CRLB) 为 0.46 米。蒙特卡罗仿真验证了 SA-ToA 方法针对典型干扰（包括分数采样延迟、定时抖动和强多径干扰）的鲁棒性。结果表明，在视距（LoS）条件下，短距离（10-100 m）均方根（RMS）测距误差优于1.65 m，长距离（200 km）优于5 m。即使在严重的近端多径干扰 (NLoS1/NLoS2) 和低 SNR 条件（低至 0 dB）下，所提出的方法也能实现鲁棒的数值收敛，并且在所有蒙特卡罗测试运行中具有 100% 的可用性。与经典估计方法的对比分析表明，SA-ToA方法将RMS误差降低了一个数量级，最接近理论极限。因此，所提出的方法对于增强 GNSS 拒绝场景中的无线电定位系统性能具有巨大的潜力。

articles.title: Metastable nanoparticle cores amplify single-ion quantum level crossings
articles.title_zh: 亚稳态纳米粒子核心放大单离子量子能级交叉
articles.abstract: Classical size dispersion and experimental artefacts have long obscured the discrete quantum energy levels of individual magnetic sites in disordered nanoparticle ensembles. We report a field-periodic, phase-coherent switching resonance—robust under instrumental and processing controls—in the first-order reversal curve (FORC) response of biogenic magnetoferritin at 2 and 5 K. The period, μ₀ΔH = 11.9 ± 1.6 mT, is invariant and phase-coherent (p ≈ 10⁻³), and the resonance disappears above the blocking temperature. Cross-correlation shows the ridges tilt in proportion to the core remanence slope (ρ ≈ 0.78): the structure tracks the internal hysteretic state of the core, not the applied field, excluding instrumental and processing origins. The spacing gives an axial zero-field splitting D = 0.016 ± 0.002 K, identifying the active unit as an individual surface Fe³⁺ ion (S = 5/2), whose relaxation is exponentially amplified by cores thermally poised at their switching threshold (Γt ≈ 1). The resulting size–temperature window (TB/9.0 ≤ T ≤ TB) accounts for the thirty-year absence of resolved resonances in conventional magnetometry and predicts the geometric signature recovered in independent data at 6.9σ. This establishes a paradigm where macroscopic metastability serves as a quantum amplifier, enabling benchtop spectroscopy of single-ion quantum states in inherently disordered nanomaterials.
articles.abstract_zh: 经典的尺寸色散和实验假象长期以来一直掩盖了无序纳米颗粒集合中各个磁性位点的离散量子能级。我们报告了生物磁性铁蛋白在 2 和 5 K 的一阶反转曲线 (FORC) 响应中存在场周期性、相位相干的开关谐振，在仪器和处理控制下具有鲁棒性。周期 μ₀ΔH = 11.9 ± 1.6 mT，是不变的和相位相干的 (p ≈ 10³)，并且谐振在高于阻断温度时消失。互相关显示脊倾斜与磁芯剩磁斜率 (ρ ≈ 0.78) 成比例：该结构跟踪磁芯的内部磁滞状态，而不是应用场，不包括仪器和加工源。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 经典的尺寸色散和实验假象长期以来一直掩盖了无序纳米颗粒集合中各个磁性位点的离散量子能级。我们报告了生物磁性铁蛋白在 2 和 5 K 的一阶反转曲线 (FORC) 响应中存在场周期性、相位相干的开关谐振，在仪器和处理控制下具有鲁棒性。周期 μ₀ΔH = 11.9 ± 1.6 mT，是不变的和相位相干的 (p ≈ 10³)，并且谐振在高于阻断温度时消失。互相关显示脊倾斜与磁芯剩磁斜率 (ρ ≈ 0.78) 成比例：该结构跟踪磁芯的内部磁滞状态，而不是应用场，不包括仪器和加工源。该间距给出了轴向零场分裂 D = 0.016 ± 0.002 K，将活性单元识别为单个表面 Fe3+ 离子 (S = 5/2)，其弛豫通过核心热平衡在其切换阈值 (Γt ≈ 1) 呈指数放大。由此产生的尺寸-温度窗口 (TB/9.0 ≤ T ≤ TB) 解释了传统磁力测量中三十年没有解析共振的情况，并预测在 6.9σ 的独立数据中恢复的几何特征。这建立了一个范式，其中宏观亚稳定性充当量子放大器，从而能够对固有无序纳米材料中的单离子量子态进行台式光谱分析。

articles.title: Supercritical water gasification of legume residues for hydrogen production catalysed by natural minerals
articles.title_zh: 天然矿物催化豆类残渣超临界水气化制氢
articles.abstract: Agricultural residues from legume processing, particularly peapods and red kidney bean shells (RKBS), are underutilised lignocellulosic resources with potential for thermochemical valorisation. This study investigates their supercritical water gasification (SCWG) at 300–600°C for 60 min using natural minerals (Trona, Dolomite and Borax) and conventional alkali catalysts (KOH and NaOH) at 10 wt% loading. Feedstock composition influenced hydrogen production, with carbohydrate-rich RKBS generally giving higher H2 yields than peapods. Two-way additive ANOVA identified temperature as the dominant factor governing H2 yield, while the effect of catalyst type was feedstock dependent. At 600°C, KOH produced the maximum H2 yield for RKBS (15.3 mol kg⁻¹ biomass), whereas Trona reached 14.6 mol kg-1 under the same conditions and gave the highest H2 yield for peapod (13.8 mol kg-1). For RKBS, Trona increased the combined H2 + CH4 chemical energy yield from 9.85 to 11.71 MJ kg-1 biomass and reduced the solid-phase carbon yield from 12.6% to 4.7%. Polynomial regression models described the temperature–Trona response within the investigated domain with R2 values of 0.992–0.993, while indicating diminishing incremental gains in H2 yield at the upper end of the temperature range. Aqueous-phase analyses further showed lower TOC and suppression of several furanic intermediates with Trona. These results demonstrate that Trona can approach the hydrogen-production performance of KOH while substantially reducing solid-phase carbon retention during SCWG.
articles.abstract_zh: 豆类加工产生的农业残留物，特别是豌豆和红芸豆壳 (RKBS)，是未充分利用的木质纤维素资源，具有热化学增值潜力。本研究研究了使用天然矿物质（天然碱、白云石和硼砂）和传统碱催化剂（KOH 和 NaOH）在 10 wt% 负载量下在 300–600°C 下进行超临界水气化 (SCWG) 60 分钟。原料成分影响氢气的产生，富含碳水化合物的 RKBS 通常比豌豆产生更高的氢气产量。双向添加剂方差分析确定温度是控制氢气产量的主要因素，而催化剂类型的影响取决于原料。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 豆类加工产生的农业残留物，特别是豌豆和红芸豆壳 (RKBS)，是未充分利用的木质纤维素资源，具有热化学增值潜力。本研究研究了使用天然矿物质（天然碱、白云石和硼砂）和传统碱催化剂（KOH 和 NaOH）在 10 wt% 负载量下在 300–600°C 下进行超临界水气化 (SCWG) 60 分钟。原料成分影响氢气的产生，富含碳水化合物的 RKBS 通常比豌豆产生更高的氢气产量。双向添加剂方差分析确定温度是控制氢气产量的主要因素，而催化剂类型的影响取决于原料。在600°C时，KOH为RKBS产生最大的氢气产量（15.3 mol kg-1生物质），而天然碱在相同条件下达到14.6 mol kg-1，并为豌豆提供最高的氢气产量（13.8 mol kg-1）。对于 RKBS，天然碱将 H2 +CH4 化学能产量从 9.85 增加到 11.71 MJ kg-1 生物质，并将固相碳产量从 12.6% 减少到 4.7%。多项式回归模型描述了研究范围内的温度-天然碱响应，R2 值为 0.992-0.993，同时表明在温度范围的上限，氢气产量的增量增益逐渐减少。水相分析进一步表明，天然碱具有较低的 TOC 和对几种呋喃中间体的抑制作用。这些结果表明，天然碱可以接近 KOH 的制氢性能，同时大大减少 SCWG 期间的固相碳保留。

articles.title: Multi-objective Optimization of the Laser Cladding Process for Cr12MoV die Steel based on RBF–NSGA-II
articles.title_zh: 基于RBF-NSGA-II的Cr12MoV模具钢激光熔覆工艺多目标优化
articles.abstract: To rapidly fabricate Cr12MoV die-steel cladding layers with balanced metallurgical and mechanical properties meeting stringent engineering requirements, laser power (P), scanning speed (V), and feeding rate (S) were systematically optimized using surface roughness (Sa), dilution rate (η), and microhardness (HV) as quantitative evaluation metrics. Sixteen orthogonal experiments were conducted to develop a radial basis function (RBF) neural network prediction model, which was subsequently coupled with the non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm II (NSGA-II) for multi-objective optimization. The orthogonal experimental results and model predictions revealed a complex nonlinear relationship between the laser cladding process parameters and cladding-layer properties. Laser power exerted the dominant influence on surface roughness, whereas feeding rate governed both dilution rate and microhardness most significantly; the established RBF model effectively captured these nonlinear mappings. Following Pareto front identification and experimental validation of seven representative parameter combinations, the engineering-optimal solution was determined as follows: P = 921.07 W, V = 2.28 mm·s⁻¹, and S = 0.26 r·min⁻¹, resulting in Sa = 11.717 µm, η = 19.76%, and HV₀.₀₂₅ = 671.57. The results demonstrate that the RBF–NSGA-II multi-objective optimization framework effectively addresses the limitation of orthogonal experimental design associated with discrete factor levels by enabling continuous optimization within the experimentally investigated parameter space, thereby offering a robust, efficient, and scalable methodology for optimizing laser cladding parameters to achieve target-oriented cladding-layer performance fulfilling engineering requirements.
articles.abstract_zh: 为了快速制造满足严格工程要求的冶金性能和机械性能均衡的Cr12MoV模具钢熔覆层，以表面粗糙度（Sa）、稀释率（η）和显微硬度（HV）作为定量评价指标，对激光功率（P）、扫描速度（V）和进给速度（S）进行系统优化。进行了十六次正交实验来开发径向基函数（RBF）神经网络预测模型，随后将其与非支配排序遗传算法II（NSGA-II）相结合以进行多目标优化。正交实验结果和模型预测揭示了激光熔覆工艺参数和熔覆层性能之间复杂的非线性关系。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 为了快速制造满足严格工程要求的冶金性能和机械性能均衡的Cr12MoV模具钢熔覆层，以表面粗糙度（Sa）、稀释率（η）和显微硬度（HV）作为定量评价指标，对激光功率（P）、扫描速度（V）和进给速度（S）进行系统优化。进行了十六次正交实验来开发径向基函数（RBF）神经网络预测模型，随后将其与非支配排序遗传算法II（NSGA-II）相结合以进行多目标优化。正交实验结果和模型预测揭示了激光熔覆工艺参数和熔覆层性能之间复杂的非线性关系。激光功率对表面粗糙度影响最大，而进给速率对稀释率和显微硬度的影响最为显着；建立的RBF模型有效地捕捉了这些非线性映射。经过Pareto前沿识别和7个代表性参数组合的实验验证，确定了工程最优解：P = 921.07 W，V = 2.28 mm·s-1，S = 0.26 r·min-1，得到Sa = 11.717 µm， η = 19.76%，HV₀.₀25=671.57。结果表明，RBF-NSGA-II多目标优化框架通过在实验研究的参数空间内实现连续优化，有效解决了与离散因子水平相关的正交实验设计的局限性，从而提供了一种稳健、高效和可扩展的方法来优化激光熔覆参数，以实现满足工程要求的面向目标的熔覆层性能。

articles.title: Electronic structure and optical properties of antiferromagnetic 3d-oxides from a Wannier-localized optimally tuned screened range-separated hybrid functional
articles.title_zh: 来自Wannier局部优化调谐筛选范围分离混合功能的反铁磁性3D氧化物的电子结构和光学性质
articles.abstract: Author(s): Alexander B. Shick, Guy Ohad, Jeffrey B. Neaton, and Leeor Kronik The authors assess the performance of the recently developed non-empirical Wannier-localized, optimally tuned, screened range-separated hybrid (WOT-SRSH) functional for prototypical antiferromagnetic insulators: MnO, NiO, hematite, and chromia. By comparing WOT-SRSH with established hybrid functionals, self-consistent quasiparticle GW, dynamical mean-field theory, and available experimental data, they demonstrate its ability to offer quantitative improvement in the description of fundamental band gaps, spin magnetic moments, photoemission, and optical spectra. These results establish WOT-SRSH as a promising framework for predictive studies of the electronic, magnetic, and optical properties of magnetic insulators. [Phys. Rev. Materials 10, 103804] Published Fri Oct 16, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 作者： Alexander B. Shick、Guy Ohad、Jeffrey B. Neaton和Leeor Kronik作者评估了最近开发的用于原型反铁磁绝缘体的非经验Wannier局部化、优化调谐、筛选范围分离混合（ WOT-SRSH ）功能的性能： MNO、NIO、赤铁矿和铬铁矿。通过将WOT-SRSH与已建立的混合函数、自洽准粒子GW、动态平均场理论和可用的实验数据进行比较，它们证明了其在描述基本带隙、自旋磁矩、光发射和光谱方面提供定量改进的能力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 作者： Alexander B. Shick、Guy Ohad、Jeffrey B. Neaton和Leeor Kronik作者评估了最近开发的用于原型反铁磁绝缘体的非经验Wannier局部化、优化调谐、筛选范围分离混合（ WOT-SRSH ）功能的性能： MNO、NIO、赤铁矿和铬铁矿。通过将WOT-SRSH与已建立的混合函数、自洽准粒子GW、动态平均场理论和可用的实验数据进行比较，它们证明了其在描述基本带隙、自旋磁矩、光发射和光谱方面提供定量改进的能力。这些结果确立了WOT-SRSH作为磁绝缘体电子、磁和光学特性预测研究的有希望的框架。[Phys. Rev. Materials 10, 103804] 2026年10月16日发布

articles.title: Tunable coherent coupling in a trispin vapor via random spin-exchange collisions
articles.title_zh: 通过随机自旋交换碰撞在三自旋蒸汽中实现可调相干耦合

articles.title: Physics-guided AI reconstructs hidden patterns inside ultrathin magnets from external fields
articles.title_zh: 物理引导的人工智能从外部磁场重建超薄磁体内部的隐藏图案
articles.abstract: To build faster and more energy-efficient computers, researchers need to understand nanoscale magnetic materials. But looking inside these tiny magnets is surprisingly difficult: Modern microscopes only measure the magnetic field outside the material, not the magnetic pattern inside. Because many different internal patterns can produce the exact same field, working backwards has long been a challenge.
articles.abstract_zh: 为了构建更快、更节能的计算机，研究人员需要了解纳米级磁性材料。但是，要查看这些微小的磁铁内部是令人惊讶的困难：现代显微镜只测量材料外部的磁场，而不是内部的磁场图案。由于许多不同的内部模式可以产生完全相同的场，因此向后工作长期以来一直是一个挑战。

articles.title: All-temperature superfluidity in two dimensions
articles.title_zh: 二维全温超流
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20717v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In local theories with short-range interactions, continuous symmetries cannot be spontaneously broken in two spatial dimensions at nonzero temperature. U(1)-symmetric models instead admit a Berezinskii--Kosterlitz--Thouless (BKT) phase with quasi-long-range order and nonzero phase stiffness, which is normally destroyed at high temperatures by vortex proliferation. Here, we show that a BKT phase, and with it superfluidity, can persist to arbitrarily high temperatures. Using the large-N expansion, we study a (2+1)-dimensional quantum field theory in which a complex scalar is coupled to the critical O(N) model. At the biconical fixed point, where the inter-sector coupling is negative, the thermal effective potential has a circle of minima with nonzero U(1) amplitude. Integrating out the gapped fluctuations yields an effective theory for the compact phase mode at distances large compared to 1/T. Since temperature is the only scale at the fixed point, the phase stiffness grows linearly with temperature, with a proportionality factor that scales linearly with N and is fixed entirely by the fixed point. This renders vortex operators irrelevant for sufficiently large N. We further show that the vortex fugacity is exponentially small in N.
articles.abstract_zh: 在具有短程相互作用的局部理论中，连续对称性不能在非零温度下在两个空间维度中自发破裂。U （ 1 ） -对称模型相反承认Berezinskii-Kosterlitz--具有准长程有序和非零相刚度的无相（ BKT ）相，其通常在高温下被涡旋扩散破坏。在这里，我们展示了BKT相，以及它的超流性，可以持续到任意高的温度。使用大N展开，我们研究了(2 +1)维量子场理论，其中复标量耦合到临界O (N)模型。在扇形间耦合为负的双锥定点处，热有效电位具有非零U （ 1 ）幅度的最小值圆。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在具有短程相互作用的局部理论中，连续对称性不能在非零温度下在两个空间维度中自发破裂。U （ 1 ） -对称模型相反承认Berezinskii-Kosterlitz--具有准长程有序和非零相刚度的无相（ BKT ）相，其通常在高温下被涡旋扩散破坏。在这里，我们展示了BKT相，以及它的超流性，可以持续到任意高的温度。使用大N展开，我们研究了(2 +1)维量子场理论，其中复标量耦合到临界O (N)模型。在扇形间耦合为负的双锥定点处，热有效电位具有非零U （ 1 ）幅度的最小值圆。与1/T相比，积分间隙波动为大距离的紧凑相位模式提供了一个有效的理论。由于温度是固定点的唯一标度，因此相位刚度随温度线性增长，其比例因子与N线性缩放，并且完全由固定点固定。这使得涡旋算子与足够大的N无关。我们进一步表明，涡旋逸度在N中呈指数级小。

articles.title: Boundary-induced geometrical frustration in a square Rydberg-atom lattice
articles.title_zh: 方形Rydberg原子晶格中边界诱导的几何挫折
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20723v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study geometric defects in square-lattice Rydberg-atom arrays induced by lattice-size parity in the striated density-wave phase. While odd-sized lattices select a single striated domain, even-sized lattices seed incompatible domains at the four corners, resulting in a π/2-rotation invariant state with a geometrical defect emanating from the lattice center. At larger detunings, we instead identify a π-rotation-invariant state with two domains nucleated by opposite corners and separated by a one-dimensional diagonal defect. We probe the state-preparation protocol on the Aquila atomic quantum processor and benchmark it with equilibrium and real-time dynamics tensor-network simulations. Our results assess the role of boundaries and lattice size in determining the global ordering in programmable quantum matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了条纹密度波相中由晶格大小奇偶引起的方格Rydberg原子阵列的几何缺陷。虽然奇数大小的晶格选择单个条纹结构域，但均匀大小的晶格在四个角处播种不相容的结构域，导致π/2-旋转不变状态，具有从晶格中心发出的几何缺陷。相反，在较大的调谐中，我们识别出π旋转不变状态，其中两个结构域由相对的角成核，并由一维对角线缺陷分开。我们探索Aquila原子量子处理器上的状态准备协议，并通过平衡和实时动态张量网络模拟对其进行基准测试。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了条纹密度波相中由晶格大小奇偶引起的方格Rydberg原子阵列的几何缺陷。虽然奇数大小的晶格选择单个条纹结构域，但均匀大小的晶格在四个角处播种不相容的结构域，导致π/2-旋转不变状态，具有从晶格中心发出的几何缺陷。相反，在较大的调谐中，我们识别出π旋转不变状态，其中两个结构域由相对的角成核，并由一维对角线缺陷分开。我们探索Aquila原子量子处理器上的状态准备协议，并通过平衡和实时动态张量网络模拟对其进行基准测试。我们的结果评估了边界和晶格大小在确定可编程量子物质的全局排序中的作用。

articles.title: Quantum oscillations in a solvable model of a Kondo insulator
articles.title_zh: 近藤绝缘子可解模型中的量子振荡
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20734v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the effects of interactions on the low-energy density of states (SdH) and magnetization (dHvA) quantum oscillations (QOs) in a Kondo insulator. Toward this end we introduce a generalization of the periodic Anderson model with Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) interactions at each site that is exactly solvable in the large-N limit, where N is the number of flavors of the heavy f electrons. We show analytically and numerically that the insulating state remains stable in terms of spectrum, thermodynamics, and transport at low temperatures even for interaction strengths much larger than non-interacting band gap of the hybridization-gap insulator. We analytically derive generalizations of Lifshitz-Kosevich (LK) formulae, distinct for the SdH and dHvA QOs, for the interacting insulator. We find that the SdH oscillation frequencies, F₀± δ F, corresponding to the conduction and valence band edges, can be weakly renormalized by interaction relative to their non-interacting values. In contrast, dHvA QO frequency F₀ is not renormalized by interactions, and remains the same as that for the non-interacting unhybridized bands. The QO amplitudes show a remarkable difference: the dHvA amplitude is essentially unaffected by interactions, while the SdH amplitude is strongly enhanced due to gap renormalization.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了相互作用对近藤绝缘体中低能态密度(SdH)和磁化强度(dHvA)量子振荡(QO)的影响。为此，我们引入了在每个位点具有Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev （ SYK ）相互作用的周期Anderson模型的推广，该模型在大N极限中完全可解，其中N是重f电子的味道数。我们在分析和数值上表明，即使相互作用强度远大于杂交间隙绝缘体的非相互作用带隙，绝缘状态在低温下的光谱、热力学和传输方面仍然保持稳定。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了相互作用对近藤绝缘体中低能态密度(SdH)和磁化强度(dHvA)量子振荡(QO)的影响。为此，我们引入了在每个位点具有Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev （ SYK ）相互作用的周期Anderson模型的推广，该模型在大N极限中完全可解，其中N是重f电子的味道数。我们在分析和数值上表明，即使相互作用强度远大于杂交间隙绝缘体的非相互作用带隙，绝缘状态在低温下的光谱、热力学和传输方面仍然保持稳定。我们分析性地推导了Lifshitz-Kosevich （ LK ）公式的推广，对于相互作用的绝缘体， SdH和dHvA QO是不同的。我们发现，对应于传导带边缘和价带边缘的SdH振荡频率F恤± δ F ，相对于它们的非相互作用值，可以通过相互作用弱重整化。相比之下， dHvA QO频率F ”不通过相互作用重新归一化，并且与非相互作用的非杂交条带保持相同。QO振幅显示出显着差异： dHvA振幅基本上不受相互作用的影响，而SdH振幅由于间隙重整而强烈增强。

articles.title: Enabling large language model agents for high-fidelity many-body perturbation theory calculations
articles.title_zh: 使大型语言模型代理能够进行高保真多体扰动理论计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20779v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Many-body perturbation theory (MBPT) methods, including the GW approximation, the GW plus Bethe-Salpeter equation (GW-BSE) method, and GW perturbation theory (GWPT), among others, provide accurate first-principles descriptions of excited-state properties and multiparticle interactions of materials. However, their use remains limited due to complex multi-software workflows, interdependent physical parameters, and substantial theoretical expertise. Large language model (LLM) agents, which couple a language model to software tools, show potential in automating computational tasks, but MBPT remains an unaddressed challenge. We show that LLM agents tested in our work, including frontier models such as Opus 4.7 and GPT-5.5, do not reliably construct MBPT workflows in one attempt, suggesting that correct setup requires expert knowledge and consistency that current models lack. Across tested model-harness combinations, out-of-the-box agents average 54%, 36%, and 19% on GW, GW-BSE, and GWPT workflow benchmarks, with strong model dependence and large run-to-run variation. Errors typically originate from cross-stage inconsistencies that surface only several stages after they are introduced. We therefore develop AI-Donkey, an agentic framework that combines expert-curated knowledge with deterministic execution to enable high-fidelity GW, GW-BSE, and GWPT calculations and analyses. With AI-Donkey, all tested agents, from frontier proprietary models to open-weight models, produce complete, runnable MBPT workflows with no observed run-to-run variation. We further demonstrate autonomous calculations and post-processing on 1D, 2D, and bulk materials, including the many-body enhancement of Fröhlich electron-phonon coupling in polar semiconductors. Our approach provides a general framework for knowledge engineering to enable reliable agentic workflows in computational materials science.
articles.abstract_zh: 多体扰动理论（ MBPT ）方法，包括GW近似、GW加Bethe-Salpeter方程（ GW-BSE ）方法和GW扰动理论（ GWPT ）等，为材料的激发态性质和多粒子相互作用提供了准确的第一原理描述。然而，由于复杂的多软件工作流程、相互依赖的物理参数和大量的理论专业知识，它们的使用仍然有限。大型语言模型（ LLM ）代理将语言模型与软件工具相结合，显示出自动化计算任务的潜力，但MBPT仍然是一个未解决的挑战。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 多体扰动理论（ MBPT ）方法，包括GW近似、GW加Bethe-Salpeter方程（ GW-BSE ）方法和GW扰动理论（ GWPT ）等，为材料的激发态性质和多粒子相互作用提供了准确的第一原理描述。然而，由于复杂的多软件工作流程、相互依赖的物理参数和大量的理论专业知识，它们的使用仍然有限。大型语言模型（ LLM ）代理将语言模型与软件工具相结合，显示出自动化计算任务的潜力，但MBPT仍然是一个未解决的挑战。我们表明，在我们的工作中测试的LLM代理（包括Opus 4.7和GPT-5.5等前沿模型）一次无法可靠地构建MBPT工作流程，这表明正确的设置需要专业知识和当前模型缺乏的一致性。在测试的模型-线束组合中， GW、GW-BSE和GWPT工作流程基准的开箱即用代理平均为54%、36%和19% ，具有很强的模型依赖性和较大的运行间差异。错误通常源于跨阶段的不一致性，这些不一致性在引入后仅出现几个阶段。因此，我们开发了AI-Donkey ，这是一个代理框架，将专家策划的知识与确定性执行相结合，以实现高保真GW、GW-BSE和GWPT计算和分析。借助AI-Donkey ，所有经过测试的代理，从前沿专有模型到开放式权重模型，都可以生成完整、可运行的MBPT工作流程，没有观察到运行间差异。我们进一步演示了1D、2D和体材料的自主计算和后处理，包括极性半导体中Fröhlich电子-声子耦合的多体增强。我们的方法为知识工程提供了一个通用框架，以实现计算材料科学中的可靠代理工作流程。

articles.title: Modeling Transport and Mechanics in Anion Exchange Membranes to Optimize Continuous CO2 Separations
articles.title_zh: 对阴离子交换膜中的传输和力学进行建模，以优化连续的CO2分离
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20812v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Water transport in charged polymer membranes is strongly influenced by hydration-dependent transport properties and polymer-network deformation. Under water-activity gradients, spatial variations in water concentration induce swelling and mechanical stresses, while the resulting deformation can influence water transport. Capturing this bidirectional interaction is important for predicting membrane behavior under nonuniform hydration conditions. This study develops a transient finite element model of water transport and mechanical deformation in a Fumasep FAA-3-50 anion exchange membrane. The framework incorporates concentration-dependent water diffusivity, hygroscopic swelling, and nonlinear viscoelastic polymer response. Uncoupled, one-way coupled, and fully coupled formulations are compared to distinguish the effects of hydration-dependent diffusivity and mechanical coupling. In the fully coupled model, local water concentration governs swelling and mechanical response, while deformation, evolving membrane geometry, and mechanical pressure feed back into water transport. Simulations predict spatially and temporally nonuniform swelling and deformation that track the evolving water-concentration field. Relative to the uncoupled concentration-dependent diffusion model, mechanical feedback alters the predicted transport response, although transport remains primarily diffusion-driven. The fully coupled model is validated against steady-state water-transport measurements across water-activity gradients and reproduces the experimentally observed hydration dependence, with strongest agreement at intermediate hydration levels. These results highlight the importance of coupled hydration, swelling, deformation, and transport processes in models of hydrated anion exchange membranes and provide a framework for evaluating membrane behavior in moisture-facilitated transport applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 带电聚合物膜中的水传输受到依赖于水合的传输特性和聚合物网络变形的强烈影响。在水活度梯度下，水浓度的空间变化会引起膨胀和机械应力，而由此产生的变形会影响水的运输。捕获这种双向相互作用对于预测非均匀水合条件下的膜行为非常重要。本研究建立了Fumasep FAA-3-50阴离子交换膜中水输运和机械变形的瞬态有限元模型。该框架结合了浓度依赖性水扩散率、吸湿膨胀和非线性粘弹性聚合物响应。比较非耦合、单向耦合和完全耦合制剂，以区分依赖于水合的扩散率和机械耦合的影响。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 带电聚合物膜中的水传输受到依赖于水合的传输特性和聚合物网络变形的强烈影响。在水活度梯度下，水浓度的空间变化会引起膨胀和机械应力，而由此产生的变形会影响水的运输。捕获这种双向相互作用对于预测非均匀水合条件下的膜行为非常重要。本研究建立了Fumasep FAA-3-50阴离子交换膜中水输运和机械变形的瞬态有限元模型。该框架结合了浓度依赖性水扩散率、吸湿膨胀和非线性粘弹性聚合物响应。比较非耦合、单向耦合和完全耦合制剂，以区分依赖于水合的扩散率和机械耦合的影响。在完全耦合模型中，局部水浓度控制膨胀和机械响应，而变形、演变的膜几何形状和机械压力反馈到水输送中。模拟预测了跟踪水浓度场演变的空间和时间非均匀膨胀和变形。相对于非耦合浓度依赖性扩散模型，机械反馈改变了预测的传输响应，尽管传输仍然主要由扩散驱动。完全耦合的模型针对跨水活度梯度的稳态水输送测量值进行了验证，并重现了实验观察到的水合作用依赖性，在中间水合作用水平上具有最强的一致性。这些结果强调了水合阴离子交换膜模型中耦合水合、膨胀、变形和运输过程的重要性，并为评估水分促进运输应用中的膜行为提供了框架。

articles.title: Transition-Metal-Oxygen Covalency Controls Ligand-Hole Stability in Li-Rich Cathode
articles.title_zh: 过渡金属氧共价控制富锂阴极中的配体-空穴稳定性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20837v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Lithium-rich cathodes boast a large specific capacity due to the presence of excess lithium per transition metal. However, making use of that excess Li drives the cathodes to unusually high formal oxidation states, often triggering unwanted side reactions, typically signaled by gas release and commonly associated with oxygen oxidation. By varying the transition metal (TM) chemistry in Li-rich materials, cyclability can vary drastically, with some materials suffering rapid capacity fade while others are able to maintain large and stable voltage windows. Such observations indicate a crucial role for both TM and O activities, but the details remain elusive. Here, we model core-level spectroscopy to understand differences in the charge compensation mechanism between different Li2MO3 (M = Mn, Ru, Ir) cathode materials. We find that ligand holes are important throughout the series, but their stability depends strongly on the transition-metal-oxygen electronic structure. In Li2MnO3, the ground state is already strongly negative-charge-transfer-like, so further delithiation rapidly increases ligand-hole character and promotes instability. Moving from Mn to Ru and Ir increases TM-O hybridization while reducing the tendency toward an extreme negative-charge-transfer state, allowing additional holes to remain delocalized over the covalent TM-O network over a wider range of charge. These results identify TM-O covalency, rather than the absence of oxygen-hole character, as a key factor controlling reversible high-valent redox and suggest a route for stabilizing high-energy-density cathodes without invoking reversible molecular oxygen formation.
articles.abstract_zh: 由于每种过渡金属存在多余的锂，富锂阴极具有较大的比容量。然而，利用过量的Li将阴极驱动到异常高的形式氧化状态，通常引发不需要的副反应，通常由气体释放发出信号并且通常与氧氧化相关。通过改变富锂材料中的过渡金属（ TM ）化学性质，可循环性可能会有很大差异，一些材料会出现快速电容衰减，而另一些材料则能够保持大而稳定的电压窗口。这些观察表明TM和O活动都起着至关重要的作用，但细节仍然难以捉摸。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 由于每种过渡金属存在多余的锂，富锂阴极具有较大的比容量。然而，利用过量的Li将阴极驱动到异常高的形式氧化状态，通常引发不需要的副反应，通常由气体释放发出信号并且通常与氧氧化相关。通过改变富锂材料中的过渡金属（ TM ）化学性质，可循环性可能会有很大差异，一些材料会出现快速电容衰减，而另一些材料则能够保持大而稳定的电压窗口。这些观察表明TM和O活动都起着至关重要的作用，但细节仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们对芯级光谱进行建模，以了解不同Li2MO3 （ M = Mn ， Ru ， Ir ）阴极材料之间的电荷补偿机制的差异。我们发现配体孔在整个系列中都很重要，但它们的稳定性在很大程度上取决于过渡金属氧电子结构。在Li2MnO3中，基态已经是强负电荷转移样，因此进一步脱锂会迅速增加配体空穴特征并促进不稳定性。从Mn移动到Ru和Ir增加了TM-O杂交，同时减少了极端负电荷转移状态的趋势，允许额外的孔在更宽的电荷范围内在共价TM-O网络上保持去定位。这些结果确定TM-O共价性，而不是氧空穴特征的缺失，是控制可逆高价氧化还原的关键因素，并提出了一种在不引起可逆分子氧形成的情况下稳定高能密度阴极的途径。

articles.title: Sb-5p-mediated antiparallel Nd-Fe coupling in Nd₃Fe₃Sb₇
articles.title_zh: Nd中Sb-5p介导的反平行Nd-Fe耦合Fe Sb
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20883v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We uncover the microscopic mechanism underlying the antiparallel Nd-Fe coupling in the intermetallic 4f-3d-5p compound Nd₃Fe₃Sb₇ by means of high-field x-ray magnetic circular dichroism (XMCD) spectroscopy, complemented by magnetization measurements and density-functional-theory (DFT) calculations. This coupling is unexpected for intermetallics composed of light rare-earth and transition-metal elements. Sb M₄,₅-edge XMCD measurements indicate a clear spin polarization of Sb 5p states antiparallel to the Fe 3d moments. DFT calculations reveal the site-dependent character of the Sb moments and, together with the Fe-Sb antiparallel alignment seen by XMCD, identify a Fe 3d-Sb 5p-Nd 5d hybridization pathway for the antiparallel Nd-Fe coupling. Pulsed-field XMCD reveals a field-induced spin reorientation through the evolution of the c-axis projections of the Nd and Fe moments. Nd₃Fe₃Sb₇, thus, provides a platform for exploring antiparallel rare-earth-transition-metal (R-T) coupling mediated by transition-metal 3d-ligand p-rare-earth 5d hybridization in light-R-T intermetallics with p-elements.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们通过高场x射线磁圆二色性（ XMCD ）光谱，以磁化测量和密度泛函理论（ DFT ）计算为补充，揭示了金属间化合物4f-3d-5p中反平行Nd-Fe耦合的微观机制。这种耦合对于由轻稀土和过渡金属元素组成的金属间化合物来说是出乎意料的。SbM ，边缘XMCD测量表明Sb5p状态的明显自旋极化与Fe3d矩反平行。DFT计算揭示了Sb矩的位点依赖性特征，并与XMCD观察到的Fe-Sb反平行比对相结合，确定了反平行Nd-Fe偶联的Fe 3d-Sb 5p-Nd 5d杂交途径。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们通过高场x射线磁圆二色性（ XMCD ）光谱，以磁化测量和密度泛函理论（ DFT ）计算为补充，揭示了金属间化合物4f-3d-5p中反平行Nd-Fe耦合的微观机制。这种耦合对于由轻稀土和过渡金属元素组成的金属间化合物来说是出乎意料的。SbM ，边缘XMCD测量表明Sb5p状态的明显自旋极化与Fe3d矩反平行。DFT计算揭示了Sb矩的位点依赖性特征，并与XMCD观察到的Fe-Sb反平行比对相结合，确定了反平行Nd-Fe偶联的Fe 3d-Sb 5p-Nd 5d杂交途径。脉冲场XMCD通过Nd和Fe矩的c轴投影的演化揭示了场诱导的自旋重新定向。因此， Nd Fe Sb提供了一个探索反平行稀土-过渡金属（ R-T ）耦合的平台，该耦合通过过渡金属3d配体p-rare-earth 5d杂交在光-R-T金属间化合物与p元素中介导。

articles.title: Modified anisotropy and distinct phase diagrams in the nearly isotropic S=1 triangular-lattice antiferromagnet Rb₂Ni(SeO₃)₂
articles.title_zh: 近似各向同性S = 1三角晶格反铁磁体Rb ₂ Ni (SeO ”) ₂中的修正各向异性和独特相图
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21154v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The triangular-lattice antiferromagnet serves as a benchmark platform for realizing exotic quantum phases, in which magnetic anisotropy plays an essential role. In this work, we report modified magnetic anisotropy and phase diagrams in the nearly isotropic S=1 triangular-lattice antiferromagnet Rb₂Ni(SeO₃)₂, compared with those of its isostructural analog K₂Ni(SeO₃)₂. The magnetic susceptibility of Rb₂Ni(SeO₃)₂ exhibits an easy-axis anisotropy with g_c > gₐb, opposite to the easy-plane anisotropy observed in K₂Ni(SeO₃)₂. The single Néel transition observed at zero field splits into two transitions at around 10~T, and a magnetization plateau is observed between 21~T and 37~T for both out-of-plane (Hparallel c) and in-plane (Hparallel ab) field directions in Rb₂Ni(SeO₃)₂. We construct magnetic phase diagrams that are distinct between Rb₂Ni(SeO₃)₂ and K₂Ni(SeO₃)₂. These findings highlight the sensitivity of field-induced magnetic phase behavior to anisotropy in nearly isotropic triangular-lattice antiferromagnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 三角晶格反铁磁体是实现奇特量子相的基准平台，其中磁各向异性起着至关重要的作用。在本文中，我们报告了近各向同性S = 1三角晶格反铁磁体Rb ₂ Ni (SeO ”) ₂与其同构模拟K ₂ Ni (SeO”) ₂的修正磁各向异性和相图。Rb ₂ Ni (SeO ”) ₂的磁化率呈现易轴各向异性， g_c > g_b ，与K ₂ Ni (SeO”) ₂中观察到的易平面各向异性相反。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 三角晶格反铁磁体是实现奇特量子相的基准平台，其中磁各向异性起着至关重要的作用。在本文中，我们报告了近各向同性S = 1三角晶格反铁磁体Rb ₂ Ni (SeO ”) ₂与其同构模拟K ₂ Ni (SeO”) ₂的修正磁各向异性和相图。Rb ₂ Ni (SeO ”) ₂的磁化率呈现易轴各向异性， g_c > g_b ，与K ₂ Ni (SeO”) ₂中观察到的易平面各向异性相反。在零场处观测到的单个Néel跃迁在10 ~ T左右分裂为两个跃迁，在Rb ₂ Ni (SeO ”) ₂中，平面外(Hparallel c)和平面内(Hparallel ab)场方向的磁化平台都在21 ~ T和37 ~ T之间。我们构建了区分Rb ₂ Ni (SeO ”) ₂和K ₂ Ni (SeO”) ₂的磁相图。这些发现突出了近各向同性三角晶格反铁磁体中磁场诱导磁相行为对各向异性的敏感性。

articles.title: Broadband radio-frequency TEM specimen holders for in situ biasing excitation and 100-ps-scale electron beam control
articles.title_zh: 用于原位偏置激励和100-ps电子束控制的宽带射频TEM样品架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21275v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Broadband electrical excitation inside a transmission electron microscope (TEM) is required to investigate electrically driven nanodevices at their actual operating frequencies and to develop fully electrical time-resolved experiments at a sub-nanosecond range. Here, we report the performances of homemade two- and four-channel radio-frequency (RF) TEM specimen holders based on a hybrid architecture combining coaxial transmission lines with miniaturized impedance-controlled printed circuit boards (PCB). Removable mechanical contacts provide direct electrical connection to interchangeable TEM chips without wire bonding. Vector network analyzer measurements demonstrate broadband transmission through the complete electrical path up to the specimen. With a representative TEM chip, the two-channel holder exhibits a -3 dB bandwidth of 7.9 GHz, while insertion losses remain below 12 dB up to 18 GHz. The same RF holder architecture was used to drive a miniaturized electrostatic electron-beam deflector. The measured temporal response indicates that the holder deflector assembly remains compatible with electrical pulse durations approaching 100 ps, with the shortest accessible times presently limited by the available waveform generator. High-resolution TEM imaging with a 200 ps probe window does not show detectable degradation of spatial resolution, while off-axis electron holography is successfully performed for probe durations down to 0.5 ns under conditions representative of operando measurements. These results establish a versatile broadband platform combining GHz electrical excitation and sub-nanosecond electron-beam control. The dual-stage configuration of our Hitachi HF3300 microscope further provides the basis for a future fully electrical pump-probe TEM approach using independently driven RF holders for specimen excitation and electron-probe control.
articles.abstract_zh: 需要在透射电子显微镜 (TEM) 内进行宽带电激发，以研究电驱动纳米器件在实际工作频率下的情况，并在亚纳秒范围内开发完全电时间分辨实验。在这里，我们报告了基于同轴传输线与小型阻抗控制印刷电路板 (PCB) 相结合的混合架构的自制两通道和四通道射频 (RF) TEM 样品架的性能。可拆卸机械触点提供与可互换 TEM 芯片的直接电气连接，无需引线键合。矢量网络分析仪测量显示了通过整个电气路径直至样品的宽带传输。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 需要在透射电子显微镜 (TEM) 内进行宽带电激发，以研究电驱动纳米器件在实际工作频率下的情况，并在亚纳秒范围内开发完全电时间分辨实验。在这里，我们报告了基于同轴传输线与小型阻抗控制印刷电路板 (PCB) 相结合的混合架构的自制两通道和四通道射频 (RF) TEM 样品架的性能。可拆卸机械触点提供与可互换 TEM 芯片的直接电气连接，无需引线键合。矢量网络分析仪测量显示了通过整个电气路径直至样品的宽带传输。采用代表性 TEM 芯片时，双通道支架具有 7.9 GHz 的 -3 dB 带宽，而插入损耗在高达 18 GHz 时仍保持在 12 dB 以下。相同的射频支架架构用于驱动小型静电电子束偏转器。测量的时间响应表明支架偏转器组件仍然与接近 100 ps 的电脉冲持续时间兼容，而最短可访问时间目前受到可用波形发生器的限制。使用 200 ps 探针窗口的高分辨率 TEM 成像没有显示出可检测到的空间分辨率下降，而在代表操作测量的条件下，离轴电子全息术成功执行了探针持续时间低至 0.5 ns 的情况。这些结果建立了一个结合了 GHz 电激励和亚纳秒电子束控制的多功能宽带平台。我们的 Hitachi HF3300 显微镜的双级配置进一步为未来的全电动泵浦探针 TEM 方法奠定了基础，该方法使用独立驱动的 RF 支架进行样品激发和电子探针控制。

articles.title: Transdimensional Chern insulators in rhombohedral multilayer graphene superlattices
articles.title_zh: 菱形多层石墨烯超晶格中的跨维陈绝缘体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21310v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent experiments on lightly electron-doped rhombohedral multilayer graphene (RMG) in the "transdimensional" regime revealed anomalous Hall hysteresis under both perpendicular and in-plane magnetic fields, pointing to the emergence of transdimensional orbital magnetism in an interaction-driven "Fermi-lune" metal. Here we demonstrate that, by coupling to the moiré potential, this transdimensional orbital ferromagnetic metal can evolve into quantized Chern insulator phases in twisted RMG/hBN moiré superlattices. Using unrestricted Hartree-Fock calculations, we find that interaction-driven reconstruction isolates a spin-valley-polarized |C| = 1 Chern band, leading to a "transdimensional Chern insulator" (TDCI) state exhibiting both in-plane and out-of-plane orbital magnetizations. A minimal two-band model is introduced to describe the unique properties of TDCI, which unveils the intimate connection between non-reciprocal velocity and in-plane orbital magnetization. We further analyze the collective excitations of TDCIs, and identify soft charge and spin modes that may lead to density wave instabilities in certain cases. An in-plane magnetic field can harden the soft density-wave mode and may drive a transition from density-wave state to TDCI. Finally, when the |C| = 1 band is fractionally filled, the many-body ground state may be a fractional Chern insulator with broken rotation and mirror symmetries.
articles.abstract_zh: 最近在“跨维度”状态下进行的轻电子掺杂菱面体多层石墨烯（RMG）实验揭示了垂直磁场和面内磁场下的异常霍尔磁滞，表明在相互作用驱动的“费米月形”金属中出现了跨维度轨道磁性。在这里，我们证明，通过与莫尔势耦合，这种跨维轨道铁磁金属可以演化成扭曲 RMG/hBN 莫尔超晶格中的量子化陈绝缘体相。使用无限制的 Hartree-Fock 计算，我们发现相互作用驱动的重建隔离了自旋谷极化 |C| = 1 陈能带，导致“跨维陈绝缘体”(TDCI) 状态，表现出面内和面外轨道磁化强度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 最近在“跨维度”状态下进行的轻电子掺杂菱面体多层石墨烯（RMG）实验揭示了垂直磁场和面内磁场下的异常霍尔磁滞，表明在相互作用驱动的“费米月形”金属中出现了跨维度轨道磁性。在这里，我们证明，通过与莫尔势耦合，这种跨维轨道铁磁金属可以演化成扭曲 RMG/hBN 莫尔超晶格中的量子化陈绝缘体相。使用无限制的 Hartree-Fock 计算，我们发现相互作用驱动的重建隔离了自旋谷极化 |C| = 1 陈能带，导致“跨维陈绝缘体”(TDCI) 状态，表现出面内和面外轨道磁化强度。引入最小二能带模型来描述 TDCI 的独特性质，揭示了非互易速度与面内轨道磁化强度之间的密切联系。我们进一步分析了 TDCI 的集体激发，并确定了在某些情况下可能导致密度波不稳定的软电荷和自旋模式。面内磁场可以硬化软密度波模式并且可以驱动从密度波状态到TDCI的转变。最后，当 |C| = 1 能带被分数填充，多体基态可能是具有破缺旋转和镜像对称性的分数陈绝缘体。

articles.title: Thermodynamic-limit bootstrap: Solving fractional quantum Hall ground states
articles.title_zh: 热力学极限自举：求解分数量子霍尔基态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21317v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Strongly interacting ground states are usually computed in finite systems and then extrapolated to the thermodynamic limit (TDL). Here we develop a quantum many-body bootstrap that solves fractional quantum Hall ground states directly in the TDL. The method gives rigorous and quantitatively tight lower bounds on the ground-state energy and identifies the ground-state structure and topological order. For Laughlin and Pfaffian parent Hamiltonians, it reproduces exact pair-correlation functions and low-lying orbital entanglement spectrum (OES) nearly level by level. For Coulomb interactions, the rigorous TDL energy bounds closely match thermodynamic estimates from exact diagonalization and density-matrix renormalization group (DMRG) extrapolations, and the local diagnostics recover established Laughlin and Moore--Read OES counting and Friedel oscillations of the composite Fermi liquid.
