We derive the "coupled channel" representation of the scattering problem with correct asymptotic behaviour and introduce Numerov's method to obtain time-independent wavefunctions, from which we calculate cross sections, the observables measured in scattering experiments. Starting from single channel scattering, we build up to the realistic collision of a ground-state atom with a diatomic molecule.

articles.title: Displacement-noise-free gravitational-wave detector using quantum tomography of photon orbital angular momentum states
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21112v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Gravitational waves (GWs) induce quantum transitions between photon orbital-angular-momentum (OAM) states with amplitudes α±. Exploiting this effect, we present a displacement-noise-free detection framework that extracts GW information from the OAM Hilbert space. Parametrized quantum state tomography of the GW-induced OAM sidebands enables a single V-shaped detector to resolve all seven wave parameters: the frequency, propagation direction, two polarization amplitudes, and initial phase of each polarization. Direct detection of the sidebands yields a weak signal of approximately 10⁻¹⁵,W. We therefore introduce a stronger reference state r |0>P, with r=0.01, to enhance the detected signal. For an arm length of L=4,m, N=160 round trips, a paraxial parameter of γ=0.1, an incident light power of PBS=10,kW, a wavelength of λₒₚₜ=1064,nm, and GW amplitudes of A=10⁻¹⁸, we estimate sideband transition amplitudes of |α±|sim10⁻¹⁰ and signal powers of order 1,nW, scaling as PBSα±propto PBSANLγ/λₒₚₜ. The shot-noise-limited sensitivity floor is S¹/²ₙ=1.6×10⁻²⁰,Hz⁻¹/². Because the scheme measures OAM transition amplitudes rather than differential arm lengths, it is intrinsically free from displacement noise and provides a broadband probe of GWs, specifically bridging the 0.1--10,Hz mid-frequency gap.

articles.title: Gas release from metals under irradiation with elliptic Gaussian laser beam during LID-QMS analysis
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23604v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Laser-induced-desorption quadrupole-mass-spectrometry (LID-QMS) diagnostics is considered as one of the candidate methods for the remote control of tritium inventory in the ITER first wall. Studies involving LID-QMS generally assume the circular shape of the laser spot on the analyzed surface. At the same time, the diagnostics laser source cannot be always positioned so as to irradiate tokamak tiles under normal angles, which results in the laser spot shape differing from the circular one. In this contribution, we analyze the tritium removal process under sample irradiation by an elliptic Gaussian laser beam, extending the results of our previous analysis [A.A. Stepanenko, Yu.M. Gasparyan, Physica Scripta 99 (8), 085604 (2025)]. The thermal desorption model governing the heat transport and tritium removal from the solid is formulated. The new analytical expression describing the sample temperature dynamics is derived. The developed model is used to examine the impact of the laser beam/spot ellipticity on the tritium desorption process from a tungsten sample. The conditions, under which the elliptic beam can be approximated with the circular one for the rapid assessment of the amount of desorbed tritium, are assessed.

articles.title: Empirical Quantum Advantage in Constrained Optimization from Encoded Unitary Designs
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.14296v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We introduce the Constraint-Enhanced Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (CE-QAOA), a shallow, constraint-aware ansatz that operates inside the one-hot product space [n]^m, where m is the number of blocks and each block is initialized in an n-qubit Wₙ state. We give an ancilla-free, depth-optimal encoder that prepares Wₙ using n-1 two-qubit rotations per block, and a two-local block-XY mixer that preserves the one-hot manifold and has a constant spectral gap on the one-excitation sector. At the level of expressivity, we establish per-block controllability, implying approximate universality per block. At the level of distributional behavior, we show that, after natural block and symbol permutation twirls, shallow CE-QAOA realizes an encoded unitary 1-design and supports approximate second-moment (2-design) behavior; combined with a Paley-Zygmund argument, this yields finite-shot anticoncentration guarantees. Algorithmically, we wrap constant-depth sampling with a deterministic feasibility checker to obtain a polynomial-time hybrid quantum-classical solver (PHQC) that returns the best observed feasible solution in O(S n²) time, where S is a polynomial shot budget. We obtain two advantages. First, when CE-QAOA fixes r >= 1 locations different from the start city, we achieve a Theta(n^r) reduction in shot complexity even against a classical sampler that draws uniformly from the feasible set. Second, against a classical baseline restricted to raw bitstring sampling, we show an exp(Theta(n²)) minimax separation. In noiseless circuit simulations of traveling salesman problem instances with n in 4,...,10 locations from the QOPTLib benchmark library, we recover the global optimum at depth p = 1 using polynomial shot budgets and coarse parameter grids defined by the problem size.

articles.title: RDL-Bench: A Benchmark for Task-Aware Question Answering over Relational Databases
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21382v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Relational databases (RDBs) remain the primary infrastructure for storing and managing structured data across enterprise and scientific domains. Natural-language (NL) interfaces to RDBs aim to let users ask questions without writing SQL, but real user needs go beyond SQL-style lookup: some questions require reasoning over the observable database state, while others require predictive inference from historical relational records under temporal constraints. Existing benchmarks address these goals in isolation. To address this gap, we introduce RDL-Bench, a benchmark for task-aware question answering (QA) over real RDBs. RDL-Bench organizes diverse user questions into reasoning-oriented questions, whose answers are determined by the current database state, and prediction-oriented questions, whose answers depend on future outcomes under temporal constraints. Each instance contains an NL question, task metadata, schema information, temporal context, either executable evidence or target-construction logic, and denotation-level ground truth. RDL-Bench supports two evaluation settings: native solvers under their intended capabilities, and task-aware modular systems where a router dispatches each question to an appropriate execution module.

articles.title: Diffusion Language Models as Open Quantum Systems
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21672v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Diffusion language models generate text by reversing a classical diffusion process over token sequences. We show that their continuous-time forward and reverse dynamics can be embedded in the framework of open quantum systems, which describes quantum systems interacting with their environment. This connection provides a basis for extending diffusion sampling to superpositions of sentence states and for modifying the underlying generation dynamics. We construct a τ-leaping unraveling scheme that simulates stochastic trajectories of these states while updating multiple token positions at each step. This enables generation conditioned on superposed prompts or thoughts, which we call Superposition of Prompts (SoP) and Superposition of Thoughts (SoT). The same formulation yields Quantum-Inspired Remasking (QIR): perturbing the masked-diffusion dynamics produces a confidence-based rule for revising previously generated tokens. Experiments with pretrained diffusion language models show that superposition-based generation can retain information from conditioning components not selected at the final measurement, while QIR improves LLM-assessed text quality when applied at an appropriate stage of generation.

articles.title: Effectiveness of Hidden-State Probes for Localizing Reasoning Failures
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22046v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Verifying the final answer of a long reasoning trace may show that the trace is wrong but it does not distinguish three cases. The problem may lie beyond the model's capability, another attempt would succeed, or one step in an otherwise recoverable trace made the trace fail. Standard hidden-state probes are trained on final-answer correctness, a label that conflates these cases. Monte Carlo rollouts distinguish the cases and locate the failing step at additional inference cost. We test the hidden states of 4B and 8B reasoning models for the failure type and the failing step and compare each probe with the strongest baseline that uses no hidden states. On incorrect 8B traces, the confidence probe, a calibrated correctness probe at a midpoint cutoff, misses 81% of cases in which a single step makes the trace unrecoverable and 47% of cases in which another attempt would succeed. A probe with a different training design over the same states reverses the ordering of these two kinds of failure, so either ordering can be read from those states. At both scales, no single tested probe locates the failing step more accurately than a rule based only on trace length, and at 4B a probe trained to predict that step fails to outperform this rule in any of 10 runs on identical traces. The confidence probe therefore indicates that an answer is wrong, but its failure-type ordering depends on its training design.

articles.title: Topology-Inspired Fine-Tuning for Wind-Field Super-Resolution
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22262v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Scientific super-resolution (SR) models are typically optimized with pointwise reconstruction losses, yet scientific interpretation often hinges on extrema, connected regions, and multiscale scalar structure. We characterize this tension with pretrained CNN and GAN wind-field SR models. Pointwise metrics, bottleneck persistence-diagram (PD) distance, and merge-tree (MT) distance favor the CNN, whereas order-2 Wasserstein PD distances favor the sharper GAN, so even different distances on the same topological descriptor reward different properties. Motivated by this disagreement, we fine-tune the pretrained CNN with differentiable topology-inspired auxiliary losses on scalar speed, gradient magnitude, soft high-speed level sets, and local maxima, and with fixed-pair supervision, which constrains predicted values and persistence at ground-truth persistence-pair endpoints located offline with the Topology ToolKit. A loss study of 16 fine-tuning configurations, each compared with a matched standard fine-tuning control that uses only the original reconstruction loss, on a fixed 168-field benchmark (with topology evaluated on a fixed 160 by 160 subregion of each field), shows that, among the scalar-field losses, gradient supervision provides the strongest PD improvement but does not improve mean MT distance, whereas fixed-pair supervision gives the largest and most consistent joint improvement in PD and MT distances. The final objective combines these two signals. Relative to the pretrained CNN, it lowers mean bottleneck, W₂,ᵢₙfₜy, and W₂,₂ distances by 31%, 25%, and 27% (and by 32-35% relative to the control, which on its own worsens all three), lowers all three on 150 of 168 fields, and gains 1.30 dB PSNR, about half the gain of standard fine-tuning. Mean MT distance also improves, but on only 91 of those 150 fields, indicating that PD and MT capture complementary structure.

articles.title: Value-Informed Schedule Trimming for Accelerated Sequential Monte Carlo Guidance in Discrete Diffusion
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20669v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Reward-guided discrete diffusion enables test-time alignment with downstream objectives, but applying Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) guidance at every denoising step is computationally expensive. Active guidance steps require additional reward evaluations and, for gradient-based proposals, value-gradient computations. Sparse guidance reduces this cost by guiding only a subset of timesteps, but commonly used schedules are fixed heuristics whose effectiveness can vary substantially across tasks. We propose VISTA, a training-free method that automatically selects guided timesteps under a fixed budget. VISTA formulates sparse guidance as approximation of the ideal full-guidance probability path and derives an estimable upper bound on (ell₁) path deviation. Using value statistics collected from a small number of full-guidance warmup generations, VISTA optimizes the resulting empirical surrogate exactly via dynamic programming. The warmup generations can be retained as model outputs, and after schedule selection VISTA has the same per-generation guidance complexity as other sparse schedules with the same budget. Across text, biological sequence, and image generation tasks, VISTA discovers task-dependent schedules and outperforms hand-designed sparse schedules in most tested settings, while approaching or exceeding full-guidance performance on several task metrics. In toxic-text generation, for example, VISTA attains a 0.99 unique-toxic ratio compared with 1.00 for full guidance while reducing post-selection per-generation latency from 204.23 s to 38.16 s, a 5.35× speedup.

articles.title: AlphaDiana: A Measurement System for Agents in Verifiable Reasoning Tasks
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20675v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Agents pair reasoning models with harnesses that organize model calls, execute tools, load skill instructions, and retain history in memory. Understanding agent performance requires linking execution conditions to outcomes, behavior, and resource use. We introduce AlphaDiana, a measurement system with modular interfaces for datasets, agents, environments, and scorers. It preserves harness-native control loops while controlling file reuse and memory retention separately. AlphaDiana supports macro analyses of complete agents and micro interventions on agent components such as tools, skills, and memory under matched conditions. We study three open-source models and three open-source harnesses on five answer-based benchmarks, with two models also tested on two interactive benchmarks. We find that harnesses do not consistently improve the accuracy of reasoning: gains on questions unsolved by the model alone can be outweighed by losses on questions it answers correctly without tools. This inconsistency extends to component interventions: neither skill guidance nor retained history reliably improves accuracy. Behavior and output-token use must be assessed with correctness: low token entropy can accompany wrong answers, and less output per execution can mean more output tokens per correct answer when accuracy falls. AlphaDiana links answer correctness and execution status to traces and resource records for comparing agents and diagnosing failures under shared task and resource policies.

articles.title: IneqAgent: Agentic Inequality Proving in Lean with Symbolic Computation
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20681v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Formal inequality proving requires mathematical reasoning and exact computation, often connected through intermediate lemmas and goal reformulations. We introduce IneqAgent, an agentic framework combining LLM reasoning with symbolic computation for inequality proving in Lean4. Lemma-level Monte Carlo Tree Search coordinates lemma construction, goal reformulation, and symbolic backend selection. Complementary sum-of-squares, Bernstein, and successive difference-substitution backends produce exact certificates for local Lean proof generation. The agent integrates these proofs with LLM-generated steps and uses Lean feedback to construct complete proofs checked against the original theorem statements. On four benchmarks, IneqAgent with DeepSeek-V4-Flash solves 175 of 186 problems (94.09%), achieving the highest overall success rate among the evaluated methods. Across four backbones, it achieves higher success rates at low LLM inference cost thresholds than Direct Agent using the same backbone, with lower mean inference costs over each method's successful runs. We also obtain Lean-verified strengthenings of Dittert's conjecture in dimensions four and five, and certify the Holens--Djokovic (4,4) inequality, implying Merris's conjecture in dimension four.

articles.title: Jev-LiteMAS: Separating Decisions from Generation in Multi-Agent Workflows
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.21411v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems rely on generative models for expert execution, workflow planning, and artifact review. Yet many coordination operations require only bounded decisions, such as selecting the next expert or judging artifact quality. Profiling three representative MAS frameworks, we find that routing and review account for 31.7-43.5% of generative-LLM tokens. However, replacing these operations with low-cost decision models introduces two interface gaps: generative planners produce execution plans and handoff instructions (planning gap), while reviewers provide actionable feedback for repairing flawed artifacts (review gap), which bounded decisions alone cannot provide. We introduce Jev-LiteMAS, a multi-agent framework that bridges both gaps by combining a lightweight decision model (Jev) with generative execution and feedback. To address the planning gap, Jev selects experts dynamically from the task and prior expert outputs, using accumulated context to ground subsequent execution without a pre-generated trajectory. To address the review gap, Jev screens intermediate artifacts against task criteria: passing artifacts proceed directly, whereas flagged ones undergo LLM re-review for acceptance or corrective feedback. Across four benchmarks and two backbones, Jev-LiteMAS reduces generative-LLM tokens by 12.7-54.6% over LAS, maintaining accuracy within 1.34 percentage points and lowering latency in seven of eight settings. Grounding routing in substantive expert outputs prevents up to 18.0 points in accuracy loss.

articles.title: Prism-1: Position- and Rival-Independent Scoring for System One Models
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22066v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Given a state and a set of options, such as intents, tools or interface elements, System One decision models return a distribution over the options in one forward pass, without generated reasoning. Web systems increasingly build them by reading decisions from language models. Two axioms of rational choice are natural requirements for such decisions, because in web systems the listing and the option set are determined by other components and can change or be manipulated: the order in which the options are listed should not matter, and adding an option should not change the relative odds of the others (Luce's choice axiom). We test the standard reads, namely single-choice question (SCQ) prompting, with shuffled-order training, order averaging or sorted options, and invariant set architectures, and find that each violates at least one axiom: one shuffle changes 12-20% of SCQ answers, sorting only freezes an arbitrary convention, and a well-chosen added option steers 4-34% of decisions. By Luce's theorem, a read satisfies both axioms only if it is a softmax over scores that each depend on one option alone, so in a transformer they hold by construction only if no token that scores an option sees another. We implement this as Prism-1 (Position- and Rival-Independent Scoring for System One Models): every option is read in its own block at shared positions, with the model's usual left-to-right attention, in one forward pass. On five benchmark sets with Qwen3-8B and Gemma 4 12B, SCQ prompting trained on the same data still changes 7% of its answers under one shuffle, and an added irrelevant option steers 12% of its decisions. Prism-1 stays within one point of that baseline's accuracy and is 2-4 points more accurate once only answers that survive a reordering are counted, while no shuffle changes any of its answers and no added irrelevant option moves its choice among the others.

articles.title: RAG-RST: Retrieved Exemplars as In-Context Discourse Schema for RST Parsing
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.22150v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In Rhetorical Structure Theory (RST), each edge of a discourse tree carries a nuclearity label, marking which span holds the central content, and a relation drawn from a closed inventory of functional categories. Neither label is a surface property: the same two clauses can be Elaboration or Background depending on rhetorical intent, and the boundary between them is fixed by annotation convention rather than by lexical cues. Predicting these labels therefore requires a formal discourse schema, and exposure to discourse-rich pretraining text does not supply it: given only a target EDU pair, a strong LLM recovers nuclearity at 0.794 F1 and relation at 0.738 F1. We propose RAG-RST, a retrieval-augmented framework that supplies this schema as in-context demonstration rather than through parameter updates, raising nuclearity to 0.846 F1 and relation to 0.788 F1 with no training. Two configurations are compared: a precomputed strategy that labels all EDU pairs before parsing, and a dynamic strategy that retrieves at each reduce step, so that the exemplars reaching the generator depend on the reductions the parser has already committed to. Both outperform existing RST parsers across span, nuclearity, relation, and full tree metrics, with the dynamic variant consistently strongest. Two properties of the retrieved schema emerge: its utility is bounded in number, saturating and then declining beyond fifty exemplars, and it depends on structural position. Both indicate that a formal linguistic schema can be supplied to a foundation model as a demonstration rather than trained into its parameters.

articles.title: One Is Not Enough: How People Use Multiple AI Models in Everyday Life
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.26107v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: People increasingly use multiple Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) concurrently, selecting each based on its perceived strengths. This cross-platform practice creates coordination challenges: adapting prompts to different interfaces, calibrating trust against inconsistent behaviors, and navigating separate conversation histories. Prior HCI research focused on single-agent interactions, leaving multi-MLLM orchestration underexplored. Through a diary study and semi-structured interviews (N=10), we examine how individuals organize work across competing AI systems. Our findings reveal that users construct primary and secondary hierarchies among models that shift over usage context. They also develop personalized switching patterns triggered by task aggregation to adjust effort and latency, and output credibility. These insights inform future tool design opportunities, supporting users to coordinate multi-MLLM workflows.

articles.title: INFUSE: A Unified Surface Benchmark for Indirect Prompt Injection in Agentic Systems
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20776v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: LLM-based agents increasingly execute long-horizon, end-to-end workflows involving shell commands, code modification, dependency installation, and interaction with remote services. This growing autonomy expands their exposure to indirect prompt injection (IPI), where adversarial instructions embedded in external content are interpreted as legitimate task directives. Existing evaluations, however, often focus on isolated malicious strings, single-step tool calls, or narrowly scoped agent configurations. We introduce INFUSE, an end-to-end benchmark for evaluating IPI throughout the lifecycle of long-horizon agent workflows. INFUSE comprises 40 realistic tasks and a structured taxonomy of 56 attack scenarios spanning five threat categories. Attacks are injected through realistic interaction surfaces encountered during task execution, extending evaluation beyond attacks placed only in initial prompts or isolated tool interactions. We evaluate 19 LLMs from the GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, Gemma, and Qwen families, producing 41,824 adversarial trajectories (26,220 without defenses) and 720 benign reference runs. Across the benchmark, mean attack success reaches 19.6% under LLM-based evaluation and 15.4% under heuristic verification, with per-model ASR-L ranging from 3.2% to 41.9%. Existing guard models provide limited protection, while prompt-level instructional hardening reduces mean attack success from 58.2% to 14.3%, revealing substantial but model-dependent security-utility trade-offs. Our code is available at https://github.com/judydnguyen/infuse.

articles.title: TGrasp6D: Task-Informed Vision-Language Priors and Pose Refinement enable Zero-Shot Task-Oriented 6DoF Grasping
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20901v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Task-Oriented Grasping (TOG) has emerged as an important skill for purposeful robotic manipulation. Given the task of using a knife to "slice bread," a robot must choose to grasp from the handle, whereas for "hand[ing] the knife over," it is preferable for the handle to remain unobstructed for safe handoff. Current approaches for TOG either focus on 2D planar grasping, remain limited by their reliance on task-agnostic grasp generators, or are constrained by reliance on finite, manually-annotated, task-specific grasp datasets that cannot cover all possible grasp-task pairs. To that end, we present TGrasp6D, a vision-language based approach for generating task-oriented 6DoF grasps in a zero-shot manner. Given a task and a single RGB-D image of an associated object, TGrasp6D reasons about the appropriate semantic affordance for the given task and object geometry to produce an initial task- informed prior. This generated prior is further refined via 6DoF pose optimization for collision avoidance while preserving task consistency. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art success rate of 94% on the TaskGrasp dataset, with the best baseline at 74%. We also deploy our approach on a Franka Research 3 robot to demonstrate zero-shot generalization to real world objects

articles.title: Chemical and ATR-FTIR characterisation of olive oils from small-scale producers in San Lorenzo Maggiore, Southern Italy
articles.abstract: Olive oil production in small rural areas is often dispersed among family-run farms, and many of these territories remain poorly represented scientifically. This study reports the first coordinated chemical and attenuated total reflectance Fourier-transform infrared (ATR-FTIR) characterisation of oils collected from small-scale producers across San Lorenzo Maggiore, Southern Italy. Forty-five samples were collected through direct contact with producers and municipal coordination. Free acidity, peroxide value and ultraviolet indices were measured alongside the ATR-FTIR profiles. Free acidity ranged from 0.08 to 1.01% oleic acid and peroxide value from 2.5 to 40.5 meq O₂ kg⁻¹. Forty-one samples were within both individual limits for these two parameters, while four exceeded one of them; a formal commercial classification was not assigned because the complete regulatory and sensory assessment was outside the scope of the campaign. Chemical PCA showed a continuous distribution, with samples exceeding an individual limit located toward the edge of the score space. The spectra displayed the characteristic lipid bands of olive oil and provided a complementary view of variation within the collection. An exploratory PLSR analysis of free acidity gave limited cross-validated performance (R²CV = 0.032; RMSECV = 0.169%; RPD = 1.03), indicating that the present dataset is more suitable for descriptive spectral characterisation than for quantitative replacement of titration. Taken together, the results provide an analytical baseline for a previously undocumented local production area and show the value, as well as the practical constraints, of studying heterogeneous oils collected under real small-producer conditions.

articles.title: Atmospheric and oceanic pathways linking the Pacific–Japan pattern to summer salinity variability in the Bay of Bengal
articles.abstract: The Pacific–Japan (PJ) pattern is a leading mode of boreal-summer atmospheric variability that influences Indo–Pacific hydroclimate through large-scale atmospheric teleconnections. Here, we demonstrate that the PJ pattern also exerts a significant influence on sea surface salinity (SSS) variability in the Bay of Bengal (BoB) during June–August. The positive PJ phase is associated with a pronounced meridional SSS dipole, characterized by salinification in the northern BoB and freshening farther south. This relationship persists after removing the combined influence of El Niño–Southern Oscillation and the Indian Ocean Dipole, indicating a distinct PJ influence on BoB salinity. Mixed-layer salinity-budget analysis reveals contrasting mechanisms across the basin. Horizontal advection provides the dominant resolved contribution to northern BoB salinification, whereas anomalous surface freshwater forcing associated with enhanced precipitation primarily drives southern BoB freshening. Sea-level propagation further reveals a dynamical pathway connecting remote forcing to the BoB: equatorial and coastal Kelvin-wave signals propagate toward the eastern and northern boundaries and subsequently radiate westward into the basin interior as Rossby waves, modifying sea surface height and upper-ocean circulation. Composite analyses show that the dominant salinity, rainfall, and circulation responses broadly reverse between positive and negative PJ phases, indicating an approximately linear response, while weaker asymmetric anomalies over the northern BoB point to nonlinear oceanic adjustment and phase-dependent freshwater redistribution. These results establish the PJ pattern as an important remote driver of BoB salinity variability through coupled atmospheric freshwater forcing and ocean dynamical adjustment, providing a pathway linking western North Pacific climate variability to the northern Indian Ocean.

articles.title: Severity-Conditioned Pixel-Wise Asynchronous Diffusion for Semi-Transparent Mural Restoration
articles.abstract: Murals are important carriers of cultural-heritage documentation and research, yet long-term environmental exposure and material aging can cause fading, discoloration, surface contamination, mold, cracking, and local detachment. For semi-transparent degradations that still preserve part of the original pigment, texture, and contour information, a binary damage mask specifies only the degraded support and cannot represent continuously varying degradation severity within the same affected region. Moreover, standard diffusion models assign a shared temporal progress to the entire image, making spatially differentiated restoration dynamics difficult to represent explicitly. We therefore propose Severity-Conditioned Pixel-Wise Asynchronous Diffusion (SC-PAD). SC-PAD first estimates a continuous terminal severity field from the degraded observation and a coarse binary support using bounded refinement and risk-oriented constraints to suppress large local errors and isolated high responses. It then predicts a bounded temporal-warping field conditioned on terminal severity and image evidence, reparameterizing a shared global progress into pixel-wise local restoration progress. A dynamic Alpha state satisfying endpoint consistency, temporal monotonicity, and the Alpha composition law subsequently controls the activation of the image-space residual. Experiments show that continuous severity representation and pixel-wise asynchronous progress are the two components most clearly supported by the current results, while the remaining gap between predicted and ground-truth severity indicates that severity estimation is still an important performance bottleneck. The proposed formulation provides a controllable diffusion framework for spatially non-uniform semi-transparent mural restoration.

articles.title: Shaping the Extracellular Pectinolytic Activity Profile of Trametes Hirsuta Ibk 1569 Through Multi-Response Cultivation Optimization
articles.abstract: Background. Pectinolytic enzyme systems comprise functionally distinct hydrolases, lyases and esterases whose coordinated action is required for efficient pectin degradation. However, optimization of fungal pectinase production is commonly focused on a single enzyme activity, whereas the cultivation conditions required for the simultaneous formation of different components of a pectinolytic complex may not coincide. This study aimed to optimize the nutrient medium composition for the balanced production of a multicomponent pectinolytic system by the basidiomycete Trametes hirsuta IBK 1569 under submerged cultivation.Results. Response surface methodology based on a Box–Behnken design was used to evaluate the effects of sugar beet pulp concentration, ammonium sulfate concentration and initial pH on endopolygalacturonase, exopolygalacturonase, pectin lyase and pectin esterase activities. The four responses showed distinct factor dependencies and substantially different individual optima, demonstrating that maximization of a single activity did not provide a balanced pectinolytic activity profile. Multi-response optimization using a max–min criterion identified compromise conditions under which the minimum predicted relative response reached 73.3% of the corresponding individual maxima. Experimental validation yielded endopolygalacturonase, exopolygalacturonase, pectin lyase and pectin esterase activities of 64.11 ± 7.18 U/mL, 798.26 ± 72.15 U/L, 3.82 ± 0.49 U/mL and 205.56 ± 17.78 U/L, respectively, with relative prediction errors of 2.81–17.32%. Time-course analysis revealed asynchronous accumulation of the individual activities, and 144 h was identified as a rational cultivation time for obtaining the enzyme complex.Conclusions. The results demonstrate that cultivation conditions can be used to shape the functional profile of the pectinolytic system of T. hirsuta IBK 1569 and that multi-response optimization is more appropriate than single-response maximization when several complementary enzyme activities are targeted simultaneously. The study also supports the use of sugar beet pulp as a renewable substrate for producing multicomponent fungal pectinase systems.

articles.title: Consensus-Based Coordinated Frequency Regulation for VSC-HVDC Interconnected Power Systems with Heterogeneous Resources
articles.abstract: As converter-interfaced renewable generation continues to increase, voltage-source-converter-based high-voltage direct current (VSC-HVDC) interconnected power systems suffer from reduced inertia, heterogeneous frequency responses, and limited inter-area frequency support. To address these issues, this paper proposes a consensus-based coordinated frequency regulation method for VSC-HVDC interconnected power systems with heterogeneous frequency regulation resources (HFRRs). Firstly, a unified multi-area frequency response model is developed to characterize the coordinated dynamics of synchronous generators (SG), grid-forming converters (GFM), grid-following converters (GFL), and VSC-HVDC links, where VSC-HVDC links are modeled as dual-role agents providing both local frequency support and inter-area power coordination. Then, a two-layer consensus control method is developed according to the multiple frequency regulation process. At the resource layer, a frequency-deviation-driven consensus algorithm coordinates inertial response and primary frequency regulation among HFRRs to provide fast intra-area support after disturbances. At the area layer, the consensus algorithm coordinates VSC-HVDC power transmission and secondary frequency regulation power distribution to achieve steady-state frequency recovery. Furthermore, frequency security indicators and operational constraints on HFRRs are incorporated into the iterative control process. Finally, case studies on a modified IEEE 39-bus three-area VSC-HVDC interconnected system demonstrate that the proposed method improves transient frequency performance and reduces regulation cost.

articles.title: SWOT-Based 3D Mapping of an Ice-Dammed Lake Outburst Flood: A Case Study of Merzbacher Lake
articles.abstract: Glacial lake outburst floods (GLOFs) are among the most destructive hazards in high-mountain regions and are expected to become increasingly important under ongoing glacier retreat and climate warming. However, quantifying the magnitude of individual GLOFs remains challenging because satellite observations typically capture changes in lake area but lack direct measurements of water-level drawdown, leading to large uncertainties in released-water estimates. Here, we develop a satellite-based framework that integrates Sentinel-2 imagery and Surface Water and Ocean Topography (SWOT) observations to reconstruct the three-dimensional evolution of an ice-dammed lake outburst flood. Using the July 2025 drainage of Merzbacher Lake in the central Tian Shan as a case study, we combine optical observations of lake-area collapse with SWOT-derived water-surface elevation changes to quantify event-scale water loss. Sentinel-2 observations show that the lake area decreased from 1.560 to 0.008 km², while SWOT measurements reveal a concurrent water-level decline from 3270.38 to 3257.83 m, corresponding to a drawdown of 12.55 m. Integrating these horizontal and vertical constraints yields an estimated drained-water volume of (9.84 ± 2.4) × 10⁶ m³. Residual water bodies concentrated near the glacier-contact outlet indicate an inferred outlet-control sector governing drainage. Our results demonstrate that SWOT enables GLOF assessment to move beyond two-dimensional lake-change detection toward quantitative stage–area–volume reconstruction. This approach provides a practical framework for estimating flood magnitude in remote glacierized regions where field observations are unavailable and offers new opportunities for satellite-based assessment of cryosphere-related hazards under a warming climate.

articles.title: How tropical instability waves impact the equatorial Pacific interannual SST variability and heat budget in 2024
articles.abstract: Tropical instability waves (TIWs) are mesoscale waves in the Pacific cold tongue that induce sea surface temperature (SST) perturbations, playing a significant role in modulating the El Niño-Southern Oscillation (ENSO). Observation and model simulations indicate that strong TIW activity occurred during the 2023/24 El Niño decaying phase (July–August). However, it remained unclear how TIWs influenced the spatiotemporal evolution of SST and to what extent they contributed to the suppressed development of the anticipated La Niña in 2024. In this study, we use an ocean general circulation model (OGCM) to quantify the contribution of TIWs to equatorial heat transport and their feedback on ENSO by comparing two simulations with and without TIWs. Results show that the 2024 TIWs acted as an important factor suppressing the transition to a La Niña event, weakening cold SST anomalies in the Niño3 region by 49%. A heat budget analysis further reveals that TIW-induced advection promoted warming of the cold tongue by up to 0.81°C month− 1, around 2.8 times larger than the net heat flux. These findings offer critical insights into the physical mechanisms governing TIW–climate interactions and provide a valuable foundation for improving ENSO prediction, particularly in accounting for the suppressed La Niña development in 2024.

articles.title: Nudged elastic membranes for constructing reduced two-dimensional potential energy surfaces
articles.abstract: Minimum-energy paths and intrinsic reaction coordinates are central tools for analyzing chemical reactions. As one-dimensional objects, however, individual paths do not provide a continuous representation of the surrounding potential energy surface (PES), including the arrangement of adjacent valleys, ridges, and higher-order saddle regions. We introduce the nudged elastic membrane method, which constructs a two-dimensional reduced PES in a selected region of configuration space using energies and forces, without requiring Hessian evaluations. The method is demonstrated for a three-dimensional analytical model and for triplet formaldehyde. In both cases, the membrane recovers known reaction-path and stationary-point regions. For formaldehyde, it also reveals a previously unreported second-order saddle point on the fitted PES. Structures extracted from the membrane provide starting points for subsequent stationary-point refinement.

articles.title: Stepwise unknotting of complex polymer knots under nanochannel confinement
articles.abstract: We performed Langevin dynamics simulations to investigate the unknotting dynamics of knotted DNA molecules confined within nanochannels, specifically examining three different torus knot types: 3 1 , 5 1 , and 7 1 knots, and the 6 1 twist knot. 5 1 and 7 1 knots typically undergo stepwise unknotting, in which knots are partially untied into a simpler knot topology when they first reach the chain end, subsequently requiring multiple rounds of topological simplification before being fully untied. In contrast, as would be expected, simple trefoil knots untie directly as they approach the chain ends, following a one-step process. We further examined the impact of nanochannel size on unknotting dynamics and topological changes across different knot types. For the complex 5 1 and 7 1 knots, stepwise unknotting is the prevalent mechanism, and increasing the spatial confinement prolongs the entire stepwise unknotting process. For the 6 1 knot, the primary mechanism of untying is also sequential, with ∼20% of the knots untying in a single step. In addition, the topological changes induced by both confinement and knot types are found to be correlated with the extended unknotting times; while the topology of the knot (twist vs torus) dictates the possible unknotting pathways, the rate of unknotting is modulated by the channel size.

articles.title: On the connections between microcanonical and isothermal–isobaric ensemble dynamics in liquids
articles.abstract: A new approach for calculating activation energies, activation volumes, and their thermodynamic derivatives is developed within the framework of fluctuation theory for dynamics. The method provides the analytical version of an Arrhenius analysis, enabling activation parameters associated with dynamical processes to be obtained from simulations at a single temperature and pressure. Extending a recently developed approach for activation energies [Bartlett et al. , J. Chem. Phys. 163 , 134114 (2025)], we derive relationships connecting dynamics in constant-energy and volume (and hence constant-enthalpy) ensembles with those in constant-temperature and pressure simulations. Using the diffusion coefficient as an example of a representative dynamical timescale, we show that, for neat water and water in an aqueous dimethyl sulfoxide solution, activation energies and activation volumes can be efficiently computed. In addition, this approach enables direct access to non-Arrhenius behavior through determination of the temperature and pressure dependence of the activation energy and volume.

articles.title: A tiny magnetic whirlpool could point to a new kind of ultra-efficient memory
articles.title_zh: 微小的磁漩涡可能指向一种新型的超高效存储器
articles.abstract: Every time a computer stores or erases information, it uses energy. The amount is tiny for a single operation, but those operations happen billions of times every second. For decades, scientists have wondered just how little energy a memory device could use before reaching the fundamental theoretical limit set by the laws of physics. Now, researchers have shown that it is possible to come close.

A new result from the U.S. Department of Energy's (DOE) Argonne National Laboratory and the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign (U. of I.) marks an important step toward enabling magnetic spins—a quantum property of matter that can be used to store and manipulate information—to play a role in the future of quantum information processing.

articles.title: Archaeometallurgical Study of a Han Dynasty Thin-Walled Bronze Basin Excavated from the Fengzhou Cemetery, Baoji, Shaanxi, China
articles.title_zh: 陕西宝鸡丰州墓地出土汉代薄壁青铜盆的考古冶金研究
articles.abstract: Archaeometallurgy of Han Dynasty thin-walled bronzes is a hot topic of current research and has made some achievements. But several issues remain insufficiently understood. These include alloying and production strategies, technological variation among social groups, and metal-resource circulation. This study analyze a thin-walled bronze basin excavated in Feng County, Baoji, using SEM–EDS, metallography, and MC–ICP–MS to investigate alloy composition, production techniques, and lead provenance. The basin was made from a ternary Cu–Sn–Pb alloy through casting, repeated hot forging and hammering, followed by trimming. Its thin walls were formed through combined hot forging and cold working. Lead isotope ratios suggest that the lead was derived from the Xiaoqinling region of western Henan and may have circulated through established transportation networks. Comparative analysis shows regional and social variation in alloy composition and production practices. The results indicate that Han Dynasty thin-walled bronze vessels shifted from ritual functions toward everyday use and commodity circulation, reflecting changes in production organization, social demand, and metal-resource circulation.
articles.abstract_zh: 汉代薄壁青铜器的考古冶金是当前研究的热点，并取得了一定的成果。但仍有几个问题尚未得到充分理解。其中包括合金和生产策略、社会群体之间的技术差异以及金属资源循环。本研究利用 SEM-EDS、金相和 MC-ICP-MS 分析了宝鸡丰县出土的一个薄壁青铜盆，以研究合金成分、生产技术和铅来源。该盆由三元 Cu-Sn-Pb 合金通过铸造、反复热锻和锤击制成，然后进行修整。其薄壁是通过热锻和冷加工相结合形成的。铅同位素比值表明，铅来自河南西部的小秦岭地区，可能通过现有的运输网络进行流通。

articles.title: Dust-ion-acoustic Flat-top Solitons and Supersolitons in dusty plasma with two superthermal electrons: Application to the Earth's Ionosphere
articles.title_zh: 具有两个超热电子的尘埃等离子体中的尘埃离子声平顶孤子和超孤子：在地球电离层中的应用
articles.abstract: The nonlinear propagation of dust-ion-acoustic (DIA) structures is investigated in a homogeneous, unmagnetized dusty plasma containing positive cold ions, negatively charged cold dust grains, and cold and hot superthermal electrons. The Sagdeev pseudopotential approach is employed to investigate the existence and characteristics of nonlinear electrostatic structures, including compressive and rarefactive solitary waves, double layers, flat-top solitons, and supersolitons. The negatively charged dust significantly modifies the equilibrium charge balance and nonlinear response, allowing the existence of both positive- and negative-potential supersolitons, whereas the corresponding dust-free system supports only positive-potential supersolitons in the plasma. The transition from ordinary solitons to flat-top solitons and supersolitons is associated with changes in the Sagdeev potential and the emergence of complex, wiggle-like electric-field profiles. The propagation domains are strongly affected by electron superthermality and the relative densities of the cold and hot electron populations. Increasing the spectral index generally shifts the admissible Mach-number limits toward higher values and, as the electron distributions approach the Maxwellian limit, modifies and broadens the corresponding propagation domains. The dust-free limit recovers previously reported results, confirming the consistency of the model. Furthermore, the coexistence of compressive double layers with rarefactive solitons is identified, with their distinct phase-space trajectories reflecting the difference between homoclinic and separatrix-connected nonlinear states. The results demonstrate that negatively charged dust and non-Maxwellian electrons play a crucial role in determining the polarity and nonlinear characteristics of DIA excitations in the Earth’s ionosphere dusty plasmas.
articles.abstract_zh: 在含有正冷离子、带负电的冷尘埃颗粒以及冷和热超热电子的均匀、未磁化的尘埃等离子体中研究了尘埃离子声（DIA）结构的非线性传播。 Sagdeev 赝势方法用于研究非线性静电结构的存在和特性，包括压缩和稀疏孤立波、双层、平顶孤子和超孤子。带负电的灰尘显着改变了平衡电荷平衡和非线性响应，允许正电势和负电势超孤子同时存在，而相应的无尘系统仅支持等离子体中的正电势超孤子。从普通孤子到平顶孤子和超孤子的转变与萨格杰夫势的变化以及复杂的、类似摆动的电场分布的出现有关。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在含有正冷离子、带负电的冷尘埃颗粒以及冷和热超热电子的均匀、未磁化的尘埃等离子体中研究了尘埃离子声（DIA）结构的非线性传播。 Sagdeev 赝势方法用于研究非线性静电结构的存在和特性，包括压缩和稀疏孤立波、双层、平顶孤子和超孤子。带负电的灰尘显着改变了平衡电荷平衡和非线性响应，允许正电势和负电势超孤子同时存在，而相应的无尘系统仅支持等离子体中的正电势超孤子。从普通孤子到平顶孤子和超孤子的转变与萨格杰夫势的变化以及复杂的、类似摆动的电场分布的出现有关。传播域受到电子超热性以及冷热电子群体相对密度的强烈影响。增加光谱指数通常会将允许的马赫数限制移向更高的值，并且当电子分布接近麦克斯韦极限时，会修改并加宽相应的传播域。无尘极限恢复了之前报告的结果，证实了模型的一致性。此外，还发现了压缩双层与稀疏孤子的共存，它们不同的相空间轨迹反映了同宿和分界连接非线性状态之间的差异。结果表明，带负电的尘埃和非麦克斯韦电子在确定地球电离层尘埃等离子体中 DIA 激发的极性和非线性特征方面发挥着至关重要的作用。

articles.title: Test-Retest Reliability of Motor Evoked Potentials Across Eight Bilateral Lower-Limb Muscles
articles.title_zh: 双侧八块下肢肌肉运动诱发电位的重测可靠性
articles.abstract: Objectives TMS is widely used to probe corticospinal excitability by eliciting MEPs in targeted muscles, with MEP characteristics such as magnitude and latency reflecting the physiological state of the pathways being stimulated. Although numerous studies have examined MEP reliability in upper extremity muscles, less is known about the reliability of this measurement across the lower extremity. We hypothesized that inter-session, test-retest reliability of MEPs recorded simultaneously from multiple lower-limb muscles, from a single TMS location, would differ by muscle, stimulation intensity, and quantification method.Materials and Methods Ten healthy participants (5 males, 5 females) completed three TMS sessions separated by one week. At each session, the stimulation hotspot was identified using a five-location virtual grid anchored at the vertex, with EMG recorded from all eight muscles of interest at each grid location; the grid location producing the largest and most consistent MEPs in the TA, the primary target muscle, was selected as the stimulation site and held constant across all three sessions. MEPs were then recorded bilaterally from the TA, soleus, rectus femoris, and biceps femoris muscles at two stimulation intensities (110% and 120% RMT). MEP size was quantified using mean rectified magnitude and peak-to-peak amplitude, and inter-session reliability was assessed using ICC. Bland-Altman analysis was used to characterize the range of measurement variability across all eight muscles.Results MEP size differed across sessions, and reliability varied by muscle, intensity, and quantification method. The highest reliability was observed in the right TA, the muscle used to establish the stimulation hotspot, using mean rectified magnitude at 120% RMT. Reliability was comparatively lower in the seven non-target muscles recorded from the same fixed stimulation site, indicating that MEP consistency was not uniform across the lower-limb musculature.Conclusions MEP reliability in the lower extremity varies by muscle, stimulation intensity, and quantification method. MEPs were most reliable in the TA, the muscle used to establish the stimulation site, while reliability was lower in the other seven muscles.
articles.abstract_zh: 目标 TMS 广泛用于通过在目标肌肉中引发 MEP 来探测皮质脊髓兴奋性，MEP 特征（例如幅度和潜伏期）反映了受刺激通路的生理状态。尽管大量研究已经检验了上肢肌肉 MEP 的可靠性，但人们对下肢肌肉测量的可靠性知之甚少。我们假设，从单个 TMS 位置的多个下肢肌肉同时记录的 MEP 的会话间、重测可靠性会因肌肉、刺激强度和量化方法而异。 材料和方法 10 名健康参与者（5 名男性，5 名女性）完成了 3 次 TMS 会话，间隔一周。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 目标 TMS 广泛用于通过在目标肌肉中引发 MEP 来探测皮质脊髓兴奋性，MEP 特征（例如幅度和潜伏期）反映了受刺激通路的生理状态。尽管大量研究已经检验了上肢肌肉 MEP 的可靠性，但人们对下肢肌肉测量的可靠性知之甚少。我们假设，从单个 TMS 位置的多个下肢肌肉同时记录的 MEP 的会话间、重测可靠性会因肌肉、刺激强度和量化方法而异。 材料和方法 10 名健康参与者（5 名男性，5 名女性）完成了 3 次 TMS 会话，间隔一周。在每次训练中，使用固定在顶点的五个位置的虚拟网格来识别刺激热点，并记录每个网格位置的所有八块感兴趣的肌肉的肌电图；选择在 TA（主要目标肌肉）中产生最大且最一致的 MEP 的网格位置作为刺激位置，并在所有三个会话中保持不变。然后在两种刺激强度（110% 和 120% RMT）下记录 TA、比目鱼肌、股直肌和股二头肌的双侧 MEP。 MEP 大小使用平均校正幅度和峰峰值幅度进行量化，并使用 ICC 评估会话间可靠性。 Bland-Altman 分析用于描述所有八块肌肉的测量变异范围。结果 MEP 大小在不同训练中有所不同，并且可靠性因肌肉、强度和量化方法而异。在右侧 TA（用于建立刺激热点的肌肉）中观察到最高的可靠性，使用 120% RMT 的平均校正幅度。从同一固定刺激部位记录的七个非目标肌肉的可靠性相对较低，表明下肢肌肉组织的 MEP 一致性并不均匀。 结论 下肢 MEP 的可靠性因肌肉、刺激强度和量化方法而异。 MEP 在 TA（用于建立刺激部位的肌肉）中最可靠，而其他七块肌肉的可靠性较低。

articles.title: Decoupling Steric-Dependent Adsorption Mechanisms in "Covalent-Ionic" Dual-Orthogonal Crosslinked GO/CS Hydrogels for Efficient Dye Sequestration
articles.title_zh: 解偶联“共价离子”双正交交联 GO/CS 水凝胶中的空间依赖性吸附机制，实现高效染料螯合
articles.abstract: Bulk hydrogel adsorbents show great promise in water remediation, yet overcoming the intrinsic contradiction between mechanical skeleton stability and high-density active sites remains a core challenge. Herein, a novel "covalent-ionic" dual-orthogonal crosslinking strategy based on sodium tripolyphosphate (TPP) and genipin was proposed to construct hierarchical mesoporous graphene oxide/chitosan (GO/CS) composite hydrogels. Compared to traditional highly toxic single-crosslinked systems, this strategy achieves robust spatial confinement of GO sheets while preserving abundant polar adsorption sites. By integrating comprehensive characterizations (SEM, BET, XRD, FT-IR, Raman, and XPS), the microscopic physicochemical synergistic adsorption mechanisms of the hydrogel toward planar methylene blue (MB) and bulky malachite green (MG) were systematically elucidated. The results suggest a strong steric-dependent interfacial behavior: the capture of MB primarily relies on face-to-face π-π conjugated stacking with the GO basal plane and localized charge transfer, whereas the adsorption of sterically hindered MG is dominantly driven by Coulombic electrostatic attraction and hydrogen bonding provided by deprotonated carboxyl and polar nitrogen sites. Furthermore, the hydrogel maintained over 80% of its retention capacity after five consecutive adsorption-desorption cycles without macroscopic structural deterioration or GO leakage. This study offers an engineering solution to the solid-liquid separation difficulties of powdered adsorbents and establishes a theoretical paradigm for steric-dependent confined adsorption in complex polymer networks.

articles.title: Virtual-Alloy Physics-Aware Semantic System for extrapolative prediction of perovskite solar cells
articles.title_zh: 用于钙钛矿太阳能电池外推预测的虚拟合金物理感知语义系统
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18949v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Existing machine-learning models for perovskite solar cells struggle to predict devices made from new materials. Most treat device layers as arbitrary categorical labels and represent perovskite absorbers either through featureless composition vectors or through rigid crystal graphs that require a pre-solved unit cell. As a result, they cannot generalize to unrecorded alloys or unfamiliar cell architectures. We present the Virtual-Alloy Physics-Aware Semantic System (V-PaSS), an architecture built around the physical continuity of perovskite solid solutions. V-PaSS represents arbitrary mixed-cation, mixed-halide absorbers by interpolating relaxed crystal graphs of 23 pure ABX₃ endpoint compounds via Vegard's law with learned bandgap bowing. For the device stack, it couples layer sequence and cell polarity (n-i-p or p-i-n) with interfacial band offsets and encodes chemical descriptions with a scientific language model. Evaluated under an institution-grouped protocol where test devices come exclusively from unseen laboratories, an untuned default configuration of V-PaSS achieves the lowest error among fourteen tested models (2.861% MAE, a 5.2% relative reduction over a gradient-boosted baseline at 3.017%, and outperforming the best tuned benchmark at 2.912%). V-PaSS pulls furthest ahead where test devices differ most from training: reducing error by 15.7-19.0% on unseen absorber alloys, by 16.1% on mixed absorbers from new laboratories, and widening its lead over the baseline by 3.6× on devices with unobserved transport layers. Combined with tree ensembles, V-PaSS sets a new state of the art across all five benchmark splits.

articles.abstract_zh_full: 现有的钙钛矿太阳能电池机器学习模型难以预测由新材料制成的设备。大多数人将器件层视为任意分类标签，并通过无特征的组合矢量或通过需要预先解决的单元格的刚性晶体图来表示钙钛矿吸收剂。因此，它们无法推广到未记录的合金或不熟悉的电池架构。我们提出了虚拟合金物理感知语义系统（ V-PaSS ） ，这是一种围绕钙钛矿固体解决方案的物理连续性构建的架构。V-PaSS代表任意混合阳离子、混合卤化物吸收剂，通过Vegard定律通过学习带隙弯曲插值23种纯ABX ”端点化合物的弛豫晶体图。对于器件堆栈，它将层序列和细胞极性（ n-i-p或p-i-n ）与界面带偏移相结合，并用科学语言模型编码化学描述。根据机构分组方案进行评估，其中测试设备完全来自看不见的实验室，未经调整的V-PaSS默认配置在14个测试模型中实现了最低的误差（ 2.861% MAE ，相对于梯度提升的基线3.017%降低了5.2% ，优于最佳调谐基准2.912% ）。V-PaSS在测试设备与培训最不同的地方遥遥领先：在看不见的吸收体合金上减少了15.7-19.0%的误差，在新实验室的混合吸收体上减少了16.1%的误差，在未观察到传输层的设备上扩大了3.6倍的领先优势。结合树形集成， V-PaSS在所有五个基准分割中设置了新的先进水平。

articles.title: Measurement-induced criticality for non-Abelian anyons: The monitored golden chain
articles.title_zh: 非阿贝尔任意子的测量引起的临界性：受监控的金链
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18965v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Non-Abelian anyon chains whose interactions favor a single fusion channel host quantum critical ground states described by minimal-model conformal field theories (CFTs) protected by a topological symmetry. We show that their measurement-only counterpart, where non-commuting fusion charge measurements act locally on the anyons of a chain of L sites, provides a fundamental example of a non-unitary CFT controlling a non-Abelian learning problem. Mapping the monitored dynamics to a random tensor network, we numerically find 1/L scaling Lyapunov gaps, logarithmic entanglement scaling with the chord length, and an effective central charge in the Shannon entropy of the measurement record. The conserved topological charge sharpens with dynamical exponent z= 1 and is learnable by a decoder on an O(L) time scale. As the topological symmetry is a non-invertible symmetry of the SU(2)ₖ anyon theories, we establish the monitored golden chain (k=3) as a non-Abelian generalization of the weakly (Kramers-Wannier) self-dual quantum critical point of the toric code (k=2), and the first of a family for k≥ 3.
articles.abstract_zh: 非阿贝尔任意子链，其相互作用有利于由拓扑对称保护的最小模型共形场理论（ CFT ）描述的单融合通道主机量子临界基态。我们表明，他们的仅测量对应物，其中非通勤融合电荷测量局部作用于L位点链的任意子，提供了控制非阿贝尔学习问题的非单一CFT的基本示例。将监测到的动力学映射到随机张量网络，我们在数值上找到1/L缩放Lyapunov间隙，与弦长缩放的对数纠缠，以及测量记录的Shannon熵中的有效中心电荷。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 非阿贝尔任意子链，其相互作用有利于由拓扑对称保护的最小模型共形场理论（ CFT ）描述的单融合通道主机量子临界基态。我们表明，他们的仅测量对应物，其中非通勤融合电荷测量局部作用于L位点链的任意子，提供了控制非阿贝尔学习问题的非单一CFT的基本示例。将监测到的动力学映射到随机张量网络，我们在数值上找到1/L缩放Lyapunov间隙，与弦长缩放的对数纠缠，以及测量记录的Shannon熵中的有效中心电荷。保守的拓扑电荷随着动态指数z = 1而尖锐化，并且可由解码器在O （ L ）时间尺度上学习。由于拓扑对称性是SU （ 2 ）任意子理论的不可逆对称性，我们将监控金链（ k = 3 ）建立为弱（ Kramers-Wannier ）自对偶量子临界点（ k = 2 ）的非阿贝尔推广，并且是k ≥ 3的一族中的第一个。

articles.title: Non-Abelian quantum Hall states at strong Landau level mixing: finding anyons with first-principles AI
articles.title_zh: 非阿贝尔量子霍尔在强朗道水平混合状态：使用第一原理AI寻找任意子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18967v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Non-Abelian anyons, strange particles forming the basis of fault-tolerant topological quantum computing, are predicted to emerge in fractional quantum Hall states at even-denominator filling factors. Identifying which topological order is realized has proven to be a challenging problem that requires an accurate, non-perturbative treatment of realistic Landau level mixing, which has so far been missing from theoretical studies. Here we present the first complete solution of non-Abelian quantum Hall problem that includes all electrons and all Landau levels, for spin-polarized electrons at filling factor ν = 3/2. We develop a momentum-resolved neural-network variational wave function, optimized solely on the microscopic Hamiltonian, which gives direct access to the topologically degenerate ground states. Without any physics input about the expected outcome, it discovers a degenerate ground-state manifold whose entanglement reveals anyons with quantum dimension sqrt2, the hallmark of Ising-type non-Abelian order. By directly computing the overlap with trial wave functions, we further show that Landau level mixing favors the anti-Pfaffian over other candidate states. Our results demonstrate the power of neural-network wave functions in finding and characterizing non-Abelian anyons from first principles, in regimes of strong Landau level mixing, relevant to many recent experiments.
articles.abstract_zh: 非阿贝尔任意子，即构成容错拓扑量子计算基础的奇异粒子，预计将在偶分母填充因子下以分数量子霍尔态出现。确定实现了哪种拓扑顺序已被证明是一个具有挑战性的问题，需要对逼真的朗道水平混合进行准确的、非扰动的处理，迄今为止理论研究中一直缺少这种处理。在这里，我们提出了非阿贝尔量子霍尔问题的第一个完整解，其中包括所有电子和所有朗道能级，用于填充因子ν = 3/2的自旋极化电子。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 非阿贝尔任意子，即构成容错拓扑量子计算基础的奇异粒子，预计将在偶分母填充因子下以分数量子霍尔态出现。确定实现了哪种拓扑顺序已被证明是一个具有挑战性的问题，需要对逼真的朗道水平混合进行准确的、非扰动的处理，迄今为止理论研究中一直缺少这种处理。在这里，我们提出了非阿贝尔量子霍尔问题的第一个完整解，其中包括所有电子和所有朗道能级，用于填充因子ν = 3/2的自旋极化电子。我们开发了一个动量分辨的神经网络变分波函数，仅在微观Hamiltonian上进行优化，从而直接访问拓扑退化的基态。在没有任何关于预期结果的物理输入的情况下，它发现了一个退化的基态流形，其纠缠揭示了具有量子维度sqrt2的任何子，量子维度sqrt2是伊辛型非阿贝尔阶的特征。通过直接计算与试验波函数的重叠，我们进一步表明， Landau水平混合比其他候选状态更有利于反Pfaffian。我们的结果证明了神经网络波函数在寻找和表征非阿贝尔任意子的能力，从第一原理，在强朗道水平混合的方案中，与许多最近的实验相关。

articles.title: Nanoscale Mapping of Strain-engineered Excitons in Monolayer WSe₂
articles.title_zh: 单层WSe ₂中应变工程激子的纳米尺度映射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19006v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Excitons in monolayer transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs) are highly sensitive to external stimuli, allowing control of resonance energies and lifetimes through electric and magnetic fields, heterostructures, moire potentials and mechanical strain. Observations of single-photon emission (SPE) near sample edges, wrinkles, and strained nanobubbles have motivated strain-engineering aimed at realizing localized emitters in 2D materials. The origin of these emitters remains unclear and prior studies have relied on far-field spectroscopy with strain profiles inferred separately through topography, limiting direct correlation between local strain and excitonic response. We directly probe strain-modified excitonic spectra in monolayer WSe₂ using cryogenic scattering-type scanning near-field optical microscopy (s-SNOM). We compare two strain-engineering techniques, nano-indentation and patterned substrates, used to produce SPEs. At 9 K, we spatially resolve exciton resonance shifts with sub-diffraction limit resolution, simultaneously measuring near-field optical response and topography. We observe that strain transferred from nano-indentation into a deformable polymer substrate differs from that produced by draping TMDs over patterned dielectric pillars. Adhesion and tearing during plastic deformation drive a compressive exciton blueshift, while draping produces dominant tensile strain. Comparing the strain model results to the experimentally observed energy shifts shows that the nano-indentation strain is over an order of magnitude smaller than previously inferred, due to puncturing of the fragile monolayer, whereas pillar-strained devices remain intact under more modest strain. These differences suggest SPE arises from complex, strain-mediated interactions rather than simple confinement potentials, establishing s-SNOM as a powerful probe of quantum emission in strained 2D materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 单层过渡金属二硫化物（ TMD ）中的激子对外部刺激高度敏感，允许通过电场和磁场、异质结构、莫尔电位和机械应变控制共振能量和寿命。对样品边缘、皱纹和应变纳米气泡附近的单光子发射（ SPE ）的观察激发了应变工程，旨在实现二维材料中的局部发射器。这些发射器的起源仍不清楚，之前的研究依赖于远场光谱，通过地形图单独推断应变分布，限制了局部应变与激子响应之间的直接相关性。我们使用低温散射型扫描近场光学显微镜（ s-SNOM ）直接探测单层WSe ₂中的应变修饰激子光谱。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 单层过渡金属二硫化物（ TMD ）中的激子对外部刺激高度敏感，允许通过电场和磁场、异质结构、莫尔电位和机械应变控制共振能量和寿命。对样品边缘、皱纹和应变纳米气泡附近的单光子发射（ SPE ）的观察激发了应变工程，旨在实现二维材料中的局部发射器。这些发射器的起源仍不清楚，之前的研究依赖于远场光谱，通过地形图单独推断应变分布，限制了局部应变与激子响应之间的直接相关性。我们使用低温散射型扫描近场光学显微镜（ s-SNOM ）直接探测单层WSe ₂中的应变修饰激子光谱。我们比较了两种应变工程技术，纳米压痕和图案化衬底，用于生产SPE。在9 K处，我们使用亚衍射极限分辨率在空间上分辨激子共振位移，同时测量近场光学响应和地形。我们观察到，从纳米压痕转移到可变形聚合物基底的应变不同于在图案化介电柱上悬垂TMD产生的应变。塑性变形过程中的粘附和撕裂驱动压缩激子蓝移，而悬垂产生显着的拉伸应变。将应变模型结果与实验观察到的能量转移进行比较表明，由于脆弱的单层的穿刺，纳米压痕应变比先前推断的要小一个数量级，而柱状应变器件在更适度的应变下保持完整。这些差异表明， SPE源于复杂的应变介导的相互作用，而不是简单的限制电位，从而将s-SNOM确立为应变二维材料中量子发射的强大探针。

articles.title: Topological superconductivity in layered d-wave altermagnetic metals
articles.title_zh: 层状d波变磁金属的拓扑超导性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19017v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate multilayer d-wave altermagnetic metals with odd-parity helical p-wave pairing. In the minimal bilayer system, interlayer tunneling reconstructs the spin-split Fermi surfaces and generates two layer-hybridized sectors with distinct effective chemical potentials. Without Rashba spin-orbit coupling (RSOC), the emergent mirror symmetry and subsystem chiral symmetry stabilize phases with different numbers of helical Majorana edge-mode pairs and additional counterpropagating pairs, jointly characterized by the mirror Chern number and the winding numbers defined along high-symmetry lines. The combination of RSOC and the altermagnetic exchange field gaps out the helical Majorana pairs while, in a certain parameter regime, leaving another pair of counterpropagating Majorana edge modes gapless, giving rise to second-order topological phases with isolated or twofold Majorana corner modes, as well as a hybrid-order phase in which gapless Majorana edge modes coexist with Majorana corner modes. We identify a layer symmetry that elucidates the physical origin of these phases. For an arbitrary N-layer system, such a symmetry naturally arises from the interlayer-coupling matrix, allowing N-fold Majorana corner modes to emerge when all layer-hybridized sectors enter the nontrivial second-order regime. Our results establish the interplay among the layer degree of freedom, odd-parity pairing, and Fermi-surface configurations as a controllable route to engineering topological superconductivity in layered altermagnetic systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了具有奇偶校验螺旋p波配对的多层d波改变磁性金属。在最小双层系统中，层间隧穿重建自旋分裂的费米表面，并生成具有独特有效化学势的两个层杂化扇区。在没有Rashba自旋轨道耦合（ RSOC ）的情况下，出现镜对称性和子系统手性对称性通过不同数量的螺旋Majorana边模对和额外的反向传播对来稳定相位，共同表征镜Chern数和沿高对称线定义的绕组数。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了具有奇偶校验螺旋p波配对的多层d波改变磁性金属。在最小双层系统中，层间隧穿重建自旋分裂的费米表面，并生成具有独特有效化学势的两个层杂化扇区。在没有Rashba自旋轨道耦合（ RSOC ）的情况下，出现镜对称性和子系统手性对称性通过不同数量的螺旋Majorana边模对和额外的反向传播对来稳定相位，共同表征镜Chern数和沿高对称线定义的绕组数。RSOC和Altermagnetic交换场的组合使螺旋Majorana对产生间隙，同时在某种参数条件下，使另一对反向传播的Majorana边模无间隙，产生具有孤立或双重Majorana角模态的二阶拓扑相位，以及无间隙Majorana边模态与Majorana角模态共存的混合阶相位。我们确定了一种层对称性，它阐明了这些相的物理起源。对于任意N层系统，这种对称性自然产生于层间耦合矩阵，当所有层杂交扇区进入非平凡的二阶模式时，允许N-折叠Majorana角模式出现。我们的研究结果确立了层自由度、奇偶对和费米表面构型之间的相互作用，作为在层状变磁系统中工程拓扑超导性的可控途径。

articles.title: A Conservative Darcy-Brinkman-Stokes Formulation for PHREEQC-Coupled Reactive Transport with Cell-Based Surface Complexation
articles.title_zh: 基于细胞表面络合的PHREEQC耦合反应性转运的保守Darcy-Brinkman-Stokes公式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19057v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a mass-conservative Darcy-Brinkman-Stokes (DBS) formulation for reactive transport with cell-based surface complexation in image-based porous media, coupled to PHREEQC and implemented in GeoChemFoam, an OpenFOAM-based toolbox. Dissolved species are transported in the physical mobile-water fraction, adsorbed species are stored as conservative cell-scale surface inventories, and each reactive cell is coupled to PHREEQC. Reactive surface area is prescribed independently as a cell field, so that internal area left unresolved by segmentation of microporous phases can be represented while DBS flow and transport are retained in the resolved pore space. The implementation is verified with a test suite that isolates the coupling of transport and chemistry from the construction of reactive surface area. Aqueous and adsorbed mass balance is evaluated against a one-dimensional analytical retardation benchmark and closed-system batch calculations. The smooth-interface surface-area algorithms are tested on idealised two- and three-dimensional geometries. In a two-scale lithium micromodel, DBS reproduces fully resolved aqueous and sorbed inventories within 0.6% across Pe=0.1-10. The applications comprise Pb2+ retardation by hydrous ferric oxide coatings in a two-dimensional fracture network, competitive Mn2+/Mg2+ exchange in a three-dimensional Kelvin-cell sorbent, and Sr2+/Ca2+ exchange in Estaillades limestone. In the fracture-network and limestone cases, the formulation yields spatially resolved aqueous and adsorbed inventories even where reactive surface area is only partly resolved at the image scale. The framework therefore supports conservative surface-complexation modelling in both resolved and unresolved pore structures, with relevance to contaminant retention, selective ion capture, and radionuclide transport.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种质量保守的Darcy-Brinkman-Stokes （ DBS ）配方，用于在基于图像的多孔介质中进行基于细胞的表面络合的反应性运输，该配方与PHREEQC相结合，并在基于OpenFOAM的工具箱GeoChemFoam中实施。溶解的物质在物理流动水馏分中运输，吸附的物质作为保守的细胞尺度表面库存储存，每个反应性细胞与PHREEQC偶联。反应表面积独立地规定为细胞场，因此可以表示由于微孔相的分割而未分辨的内部区域，同时DBS流动和运输保留在已分辨的孔隙空间中。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一种质量保守的Darcy-Brinkman-Stokes （ DBS ）配方，用于在基于图像的多孔介质中进行基于细胞的表面络合的反应性运输，该配方与PHREEQC相结合，并在基于OpenFOAM的工具箱GeoChemFoam中实施。溶解的物质在物理流动水馏分中运输，吸附的物质作为保守的细胞尺度表面库存储存，每个反应性细胞与PHREEQC偶联。反应表面积独立地规定为细胞场，因此可以表示由于微孔相的分割而未分辨的内部区域，同时DBS流动和运输保留在已分辨的孔隙空间中。实施通过测试套件进行验证，该测试套件将运输和化学的耦合与反应表面区域的构造隔离开来。根据一维分析延迟基准和封闭系统批量计算评估水溶液和吸附的质量平衡。光滑界面表面积算法在理想化的二维和三维几何形状上进行测试。在双尺度锂微型模型中， DBS在Pe = 0.1-10范围内复制0.6%以内的全分辨水溶液和吸附库存。这些应用包括在二维断裂网络中通过水合氧化铁涂层进行Pb2 +延迟，在三维开尔文细胞吸附剂中进行竞争性Mn2 +/Mg2 +交换，以及在Estaillades石灰石中进行Sr2 +/Ca2 +交换。在裂缝网络和石灰石情况下，即使在图像尺度上仅部分分辨出反应性表面积，制剂也能产生空间分辨的水和吸附库存。因此，该框架支持在已分辨和未分辨的孔隙结构中进行保守的表面络合建模，与污染物保留、选择性离子捕获和放射性核素运输相关。

articles.title: Pseudo-relativistic fermions and topological states in zinc-blende semiconductors and their heterostructures (Habilitation thesis)
articles.title_zh: 锌掺杂半导体及其异质结构中的伪相对论费米子和拓扑状态（适应能力论文）
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19140v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Tracing my scientific path from many-body physics in semiconductor nanostructures to topological quantum matter, this Habilitation à diriger des recherches (HDR) memoir presents only part of my research since defending two PhD theses in Toulouse and Nizhny Novgorod in 2011. Focusing on pseudo-relativistic fermions and topological states in zinc-blende semiconductors and their heterostructures, it highlights my independent research program: identifying physical problems, developing predictive theories, and initiating new directions with experimentalists. The first part addresses Kane fermions in bulk HgCdTe: temperature-driven band inversion, domain-wall states, the collapse of Landau levels in crossed electric and magnetic fields, and disorder-induced topological transitions. The second examines pressure-, temperature-, and disorder-driven phase transitions in single and double HgTe quantum wells (QWs), including bilayer-graphene-like semimetals and a two-dimensional higher-order topological insulator (2D HOTI) phase beyond the minimal BHZ model. The third develops three-layer InAs/Ga(In)Sb QWs as a III-V platform for massless Dirac fermions, large-gap quantum spin Hall insulators, 2D HOTI phases, and semimetals with quadratic band touching, and discusses InAsₓSb₁₋ₓ/InAsySb₁₋y heterostructures as a promising alternative. Several of these predictions are supported by experimental observations, including quantized helical edge transport up to 60 K and the unconventional quantum Hall effect. Defended on March 25, 2026, at the University of Montpellier. Jury: Michel GOIRAN (chair and rapporteur, LNCMI-CNRS, Toulouse); Alexey KAVOKIN (rapporteur, Westlake University, Hangzhou); Robson FERREIRA (rapporteur, LPENS-CNRS, Paris); Alexei BARANOV (member, IES-CNRS, Montpellier); Benoit JOUAULT and Frédéric TEPPE (members, L2C-CNRS, Montpellier).
articles.abstract_zh: 这本《研究人员资格》(HDR) 回忆录追溯了我从半导体纳米结构中的多体物理到拓扑量子物质的科学道路，仅介绍了我自 2011 年在图卢兹和下诺夫哥罗德答辩两篇博士论文以来的部分研究成果。它重点关注闪锌矿半导体及其异质结构中的伪相对论费米子和拓扑态，重点介绍了我的独立研究计划：识别物理问题、开发预测能力理论，并与实验学家一起开创新的方向。第一部分讨论了 HgCdTe 中的凯恩费米子：温度驱动的能带反转、畴壁态、交叉电场和磁场中朗道能级的崩溃以及无序引起的拓扑转变。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 这本《研究人员资格》(HDR) 回忆录追溯了我从半导体纳米结构中的多体物理到拓扑量子物质的科学道路，仅介绍了我自 2011 年在图卢兹和下诺夫哥罗德答辩两篇博士论文以来的部分研究成果。它重点关注闪锌矿半导体及其异质结构中的伪相对论费米子和拓扑态，重点介绍了我的独立研究计划：识别物理问题、开发预测能力理论，并与实验学家一起开创新的方向。第一部分讨论了 HgCdTe 中的凯恩费米子：温度驱动的能带反转、畴壁态、交叉电场和磁场中朗道能级的崩溃以及无序引起的拓扑转变。第二个研究检查单和双 HgTe 量子阱 (QW) 中压力、温度和无序驱动的相变，包括双层石墨烯类半金属和超出最小 BHZ 模型的二维高阶拓扑绝缘体 (2D HOTI) 相。第三部分开发了三层 InAs/Ga(In)Sb QW 作为无质量狄拉克费米子、大间隙量子自旋霍尔绝缘体、2D HOTI 相和具有二次能带接触的半金属的 III-V 平台，并讨论了 InAsₓSb₁₋ₓ/InAsySb₋y 异质结构作为一种有前途的替代品。其中一些预测得到了实验观察的支持，包括高达 60 K 的量子化螺旋边缘传输和非常规量子霍尔效应。 2026 年 3 月 25 日在蒙彼利埃大学答辩。评审团：Michel GOIRAN（主席兼报告员，LNCMI-CNRS，图卢兹）； Alexey KAVOKIN（杭州西湖大学报告员）； Robson FERREIRA（巴黎 LPENS-CNRS 报告员）； Alexei BARANOV（成员，IES-CNRS，蒙彼利埃）； Benoit JOUAULT 和 Frédéric TEPPE（成员，L2C-CNRS，蒙彼利埃）。

articles.title: Beyond the lemon: Spectra of random Lindblad operators with a Hamiltonian component
articles.title_zh: 超越柠檬：具有哈密顿分量的随机 Lindblad 算子的谱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19261v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Generators of continuous-time quantum Markovian evolution, known as Lindblad operators, play a key role in the theory of open quantum systems. The question of how to define and characterize random Lindblad operators has attracted considerable attention in recent years. Purely dissipative random Lindbladians have been extensively studied using toolboxes of free probability and non-Hermitian random matrix theories, which helped, among other results, to uncover a characteristic lemon-like spectral support. In this work, we focus on random Lindbladians with a Hamiltonian component. We analyze three ensembles of increasing complexity, designed to illustrate the joint effects of dissipative and Hamiltonian dynamics. While the first two ensembles allow for an exact analytic treatment with standard probabilistic and free-probability methods, the generic case of independently random Hamiltonian and dissipative components requires a novel framework that combines operator-valued free probability with sequential noise averaging. For this ensemble, our approach preserves the underlying tensor-product structure of the Lindblad operator and derives a general equation for the spectral boundary. We characterize the effect of Hamiltonian-induced spectral squeezing and explain how the spectral support changes with the relative Hamiltonian strength and the rank of the dissipative component.
articles.abstract_zh: 连续时间量子马尔可夫演化的生成器，称为 Lindblad 算子，在开放量子系统理论中发挥着关键作用。近年来，如何定义和表征随机 Lindblad 算子的问题引起了相当多的关注。纯耗散随机 Lindbladians 已经使用自由概率和非厄米随机矩阵理论的工具箱进行了广泛的研究，这有助于揭示特征性的柠檬状光谱支持。在这项工作中，我们关注具有哈密顿分量的随机 Lindbladians。我们分析了三个复杂性不断增加的系综，旨在说明耗散动力学和哈密顿动力学的联合效应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 连续时间量子马尔可夫演化的生成器，称为 Lindblad 算子，在开放量子系统理论中发挥着关键作用。近年来，如何定义和表征随机 Lindblad 算子的问题引起了相当多的关注。纯耗散随机 Lindbladians 已经使用自由概率和非厄米随机矩阵理论的工具箱进行了广泛的研究，这有助于揭示特征性的柠檬状光谱支持。在这项工作中，我们关注具有哈密顿分量的随机 Lindbladians。我们分析了三个复杂性不断增加的系综，旨在说明耗散动力学和哈密顿动力学的联合效应。虽然前两个集成允许使用标准概率和自由概率方法进行精确的分析处理，但独立随机哈密顿量和耗散分量的一般情况需要一个新颖的框架，将算子值自由概率与顺序噪声平均相结合。对于这个系综，我们的方法保留了 Lindblad 算子的底层张量积结构，并导出了谱边界的一般方程。我们描述了哈密顿量引起的谱压缩的影响，并解释了谱支持如何随着相对哈密顿量强度和耗散分量的等级而变化。

articles.title: Spectral signatures of spin textures and the emergence of a pseudogap
articles.title_zh: 自旋纹理的光谱特征和赝能隙的出现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19269v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Periodic solids with strongly interacting electrons display phenomena -- from Mott localization to high-temperature superconductivity -- that escape conventional band theory. Efforts to address this unconventional physics have been typically cast in the language of Green's function theories and the associated frequency- and momentum-dependent self-energies capturing strong correlations beyond the reach of mean-field theories. Here, we underscore that frequency- and momentum-dependent self-energies emerge also from mean-field solutions that break translational symmetry, and that these self-energies can display the characteristic fingerprints of strong correlations for certain, physically meaningful, spatial patterns. We showcase this perspective by studying the paradigmatic case of the 2D Hubbard model. We find that already at the mean-field level the doped antiferromagnet displays, in addition to stripes, many quasi-degenerate self-consistent solutions with antiferromagnetic textures organized into antiphase domains separated by hole-rich interfaces, reminiscent of the phase-separation scenario. Remarkably, these solutions map into spectral functions that display very distinctively the phenomenology of the pseudogap, including the nodal-antinodal dichotomy of the self-energy, Fermi arcs, and a complementary Luttinger surface. The result is a conceptually simple description of such an intricate many-body state: the pseudogap emerges as the momentum-space spectral portrait of the real-space interplay between antiferromagnetic domains and the metallic interfaces, which echoes the role of spin-fluctuations identified by nonperturbative methods.
articles.abstract_zh: 具有强相互作用电子的周期性固体显示出从莫特局域化到高温超导性的现象，这些现象逃脱了传统的能带理论。解决这一非常规物理问题的努力通常采用格林函数理论的语言，以及相关的频率和动量相关的自能，这些自能捕获了超出平均场理论范围的强相关性。在这里，我们强调频率和动量相关的自能也来自打破平移对称性的平均场解，并且这些自能可以显示某些具有物理意义的空间模式的强相关性的特征指纹。我们通过研究二维哈伯德模型的范例案例来展示这一观点。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 具有强相互作用电子的周期性固体显示出从莫特局域化到高温超导性的现象，这些现象逃脱了传统的能带理论。解决这一非常规物理问题的努力通常采用格林函数理论的语言，以及相关的频率和动量相关的自能，这些自能捕获了超出平均场理论范围的强相关性。在这里，我们强调频率和动量相关的自能也来自打破平移对称性的平均场解，并且这些自能可以显示某些具有物理意义的空间模式的强相关性的特征指纹。我们通过研究二维哈伯德模型的范例案例来展示这一观点。我们发现，在平均场水平上，除了条纹之外，掺杂反铁磁体还显示出许多准简并自洽解，其反铁磁纹理组织成由富空穴界面分隔的反相域，让人想起相分离场景。值得注意的是，这些解映射到谱函数中，这些函数非常独特地显示了赝能隙的现象学，包括自能的节点-反节点二分法、费米弧和互补的卢廷格表面。结果是对这种复杂的多体状态的概念上的简单描述：赝能隙作为反铁磁域和金属界面之间的真实空间相互作用的动量空间谱图出现，这与非微扰方法识别的自旋涨落的作用相呼应。

articles.title: Evidence for hidden order and its potential correlation with electron-hole asymmetry in iridate superlattices
articles.title_zh: 虹彩超晶格中隐藏序及其与电子空穴不对称性的潜在相关性的证据
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19334v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hidden order refers to an order that shapes the properties of quantum materials yet remains difficult to identify. Here we report signatures of a hidden order in doped iridate superlattices through an unexpected electron-hole asymmetry in the coupling between the insulating state and the antiferromagnetic (AFM) state. While carrier doping suppresses both states, they remain coupled in the electron-doped regime but decouple in the hole-doped regime. Structural analysis rules out octahedral rotation and tilting as the dominant origin of this asymmetry. Instead, magnetic characterization reveals evidences of a hidden order that only appears in the hole-doped regime. This hidden order emerges above TN and is closely associated with the AFM state, coinciding with an exceptionally strong magnetic scattering intensity and an anomalously robust magnetic coherence. Our results highlight that hole-doped iridates can be a promising platform for exploring hidden and unconventional ordering phenomena in spin-orbit-entangled quantum materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 隐藏秩序是指塑造量子材料特性但仍难以识别的秩序。在这里，我们通过绝缘态和反铁磁（AFM）态之间的耦合中意外的电子空穴不对称性报告了掺杂铱酸盐超晶格中隐藏顺序的特征。虽然载流子掺杂抑制这两种状态，但它们在电子掺杂状态下保持耦合，但在空穴掺杂状态下解耦。结构分析排除了八面体旋转和倾斜作为这种不对称性的主要根源。相反，磁性表征揭示了仅出现在空穴掺杂区域中的隐藏有序的证据。这种隐藏秩序出现在 TN 之上，并与 AFM 状态密切相关，与异常强的磁散射强度和异常鲁棒的磁相干性相一致。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 隐藏秩序是指塑造量子材料特性但仍难以识别的秩序。在这里，我们通过绝缘态和反铁磁（AFM）态之间的耦合中意外的电子空穴不对称性报告了掺杂铱酸盐超晶格中隐藏顺序的特征。虽然载流子掺杂抑制这两种状态，但它们在电子掺杂状态下保持耦合，但在空穴掺杂状态下解耦。结构分析排除了八面体旋转和倾斜作为这种不对称性的主要根源。相反，磁性表征揭示了仅出现在空穴掺杂区域中的隐藏有序的证据。这种隐藏秩序出现在 TN 之上，并与 AFM 状态密切相关，与异常强的磁散射强度和异常鲁棒的磁相干性相一致。我们的结果强调，空穴掺杂虹彩可以成为探索自旋轨道纠缠量子材料中隐藏的非常规有序现象的有前途的平台。

articles.title: Phase Stability and Anisotropic Superconductivity in Ternary M2B4C2 (M=Ca, Mg) Monolayer
articles.title_zh: 三元 M2B4C2 (M=Ca, Mg) 单层的相稳定性和各向异性超导
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19383v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work, we investigate the phase stability, electronic structure, and superconducting properties of the two-dimensional ternary borocarbides MB₄C₂ (M = Ca, Mg) using first-principles calculations and fully anisotropic Migdal-Eliashberg theory. Ab initio molecular dynamics, phonon dispersion, and elastic constant calculations confirm that both monolayers are dynamically, thermally, and mechanically stable.
