Electronic structure analysis reveals an intrinsic metallic nature with a multiband Fermi surface, where states near the Γ point are dominated by in-plane B-pₓ, p_y orbitals, while zone-boundary states are primarily derived from out-of-plane B-p_z orbitals. The electron-phonon coupling is determined to be λ = 0.64 for both materials, driven by the rigid covalent B-B and B-C honeycomb networks. By solving the anisotropic Eliashberg equations, we predict that CaB₄C₂ and MgB₄C₂ are nodeless two-gap superconductors with critical temperatures (T_c) of 33.4 K and 33.8 K, respectively, at a Coulomb pseudopotential of μ = 0.10. Furthermore, the superconducting state remains robust under increased Coulomb repulsion (μ = 0.13), retaining elevated T_c values of 31.2 K and 30.9 K, respectively. These findings establish MB₄C₂ monolayers as promising candidates for nanoscale superconducting applications and enrich the family of two-dimensional multigap superconductors.
articles.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们利用第一性原理计算和完全各向异性 Migdal-Eliashberg 理论研究了二维三元硼碳化物 MB₄C2 (M = Ca, Mg) 的相稳定性、电子结构和超导性能。从头算分子动力学、声子色散和弹性常数计算证实这两个单层都是动态、热和机械稳定的。电子结构分析揭示了多能带费米面的固有金属性质，其中 Γ 点附近的态主要由面内 B-pₓ、p_y 轨道主导，而区域边界态主要源自面外 B-p_z 轨道。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在这项工作中，我们利用第一性原理计算和完全各向异性 Migdal-Eliashberg 理论研究了二维三元硼碳化物 MB₄C2 (M = Ca, Mg) 的相稳定性、电子结构和超导性能。从头算分子动力学、声子色散和弹性常数计算证实这两个单层都是动态、热和机械稳定的。电子结构分析揭示了多能带费米面的固有金属性质，其中 Γ 点附近的态主要由面内 B-pₓ、p_y 轨道主导，而区域边界态主要源自面外 B-p_z 轨道。在刚性共价 B-B 和 B-C 蜂窝网络的驱动下，两种材料的电子-声子耦合被确定为 λ = 0.64。通过求解各向异性 Eliashberg 方程，我们预测 CaB₄C2 和 MgB₄C2 是无节点双能隙超导体，其临界温度 (T_c) 分别为 33.4 K 和 33.8 K，库仑赝势为 μ = 0.10。此外，超导状态在库仑斥力增加 (μ = 0.13) 的情况下仍然保持稳健，分别保持较高的 T_c 值 31.2 K 和 30.9 K。这些发现使 MB₄C2 单层成为纳米级超导应用的有希望的候选者，并丰富了二维多间隙超导体家族。

articles.title: ActMOF: Mapping Reticular Synthesis through Active Learning
articles.title_zh: ActMOF：通过主动学习绘制网状综合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19404v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reticular chemistry allows metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) to be designed from their building units, yet their synthesis remains constrained by sparse experimental data, noisy crystallization outcomes, and the absence of benchmarks for comparing active-learning strategies. While data-driven approaches such as Bayesian optimization (BO) can improve synthesis success rates, selecting appropriate optimizers beforehand for mapping MOF crystallization landscapes remains largely empirical. Here we present ActMOF, an experiment-grounded benchmark for comparing search strategies in aluminum-carboxylate MOF synthesis. ActMOF is emulated from experimentally measured microwave syntheses with each encoded condition assigned a crystallinity index calculated based on diffraction peak intensity and full width at half-maximum. By benchmarking policies guided by Gaussian processes (GP), tree ensembles and large language models (LLM), ActMOF placed the GP family among the leading policies for active learning in sparse synthesis landscapes. It then demonstrated transferability by guiding the microwave synthesis of six reticularly related aluminum MOFs. All six campaigns gave crystalline products within a fixed budget of 12 experiments each, and established a reusable testbed for AI-driven MOF synthesis.
articles.abstract_zh: 网状化学允许从其构建单元设计金属有机框架（MOF），但其合成仍然受到实验数据稀疏、结晶结果嘈杂以及缺乏比较主动学习策略的基准的限制。虽然贝叶斯优化 (BO) 等数据驱动方法可以提高合成成功率，但预先选择合适的优化器来绘制 MOF 结晶图谱在很大程度上仍然是凭经验得出的。在这里，我们提出 ActMOF，一个基于实验的基准，用于比较羧酸铝 MOF 合成中的搜索策略。 ActMOF 是通过实验测量的微波合成来模拟的，每个编码条件都分配了一个基于衍射峰强度和半峰全宽计算的结晶度指数。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 网状化学允许从其构建单元设计金属有机框架（MOF），但其合成仍然受到实验数据稀疏、结晶结果嘈杂以及缺乏比较主动学习策略的基准的限制。虽然贝叶斯优化 (BO) 等数据驱动方法可以提高合成成功率，但预先选择合适的优化器来绘制 MOF 结晶图谱在很大程度上仍然是凭经验得出的。在这里，我们提出 ActMOF，一个基于实验的基准，用于比较羧酸铝 MOF 合成中的搜索策略。 ActMOF 是通过实验测量的微波合成来模拟的，每个编码条件都分配了一个基于衍射峰强度和半峰全宽计算的结晶度指数。通过对高斯过程 (GP)、树集成和大型语言模型 (LLM) 指导的政策进行基准测试，ActMOF 将 GP 系列置于稀疏合成环境中主动学习的领先政策之列。然后，它通过引导微波合成六种网状相关的铝 MOF 来证明可转移性。所有六项活动均在 12 次实验的固定预算内提供了晶体产品，并为人工智能驱动的 MOF 合成建立了可重复使用的测试平台。

articles.title: Multiple Superconducting Phases under Pressure for Different Field Directions in UTe2
articles.title_zh: UTe2 中不同场向压力下的多个超导相
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19406v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The existence of multiple superconducting phases is a striking feature of UTe2, arising from the spin and orbital degrees of freedom and supporting a spin-triplet superconducting state. We present field-temperature phase diagrams under pressure for fields applied along the three principal crystallographic axes, as determined by AC calorimetry measurements. The pressure evolution of the multiple superconducting phases is highly anisotropic with respect to magnetic field direction, revealing rich superconducting phenomena arising from complex fluctuations.
articles.abstract_zh: 多个超导相的存在是 UTe2 的一个显着特征，它源于自旋和轨道自由度，并支持自旋三重态超导态。我们展示了通过交流量热法测量确定的沿三个主晶轴施加的场在压力下的场-温度相图。多个超导相的压力演化相对于磁场方向具有高度各向异性，揭示了复杂涨落产生的丰富超导现象。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 多个超导相的存在是 UTe2 的一个显着特征，它源于自旋和轨道自由度，并支持自旋三重态超导态。我们展示了通过交流量热法测量确定的沿三个主晶轴施加的场在压力下的场-温度相图。多个超导相的压力演化相对于磁场方向具有高度各向异性，揭示了复杂涨落产生的丰富超导现象。

articles.title: Pressure engineering of the excitonic moiré-potential landscape and exciton-charge interplay in semiconductor moiré superlattices
articles.title_zh: 半导体莫尔超晶格中激子莫尔势景观和激子电荷相互作用的压力工程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19542v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Semiconductor moiré superlattices, owing to strongly bound excitons and pronounced electronic correlation, have emerged as an intriguing solid platform for exploring correlated bosonic phenomena, where the moiré potential landscape plays a central role. Hydrostatic pressure allows continuous, in-situ tuning of this landscape, but remains underexplored because of experimental challenges. Here we integrate a diamond anvil pressure cell with high quality dual gated WSe2/WS2 twisted bilayers and perform cryogenic optical spectroscopy. We observe distinct pressure evolutions of moiré intralayer excitons, which reveal drastic modulation of the excitonic moiré-potential landscape captured by a continuum model and suggest the capability of engineering the exciton-band topology. Moreover, we demonstrate efficient pressure control over the interplay between charges and both intralayer and interlayer excitons: the intralayer charge-transfer exciton becomes less sensitive to doping, likely due to reduced charge-transfer character; in contrast, the interlayer exciton exhibits enhanced exciton-charge repulsion. Our results establish hydrostatic pressure as a powerful tuning knob for engineering bosonic quasiparticles and Bose-Fermi interactions in moiré materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 半导体莫尔超晶格由于强束缚激子和明显的电子相关性，已成为探索相关玻色子现象的一个有趣的固体平台，其中莫尔势景观起着核心作用。静水压力允许对这种景观进行连续的原位调整，但由于实验的挑战，仍未得到充分探索。在这里，我们将金刚石砧压力盒与高质量双门控 WSe2/WS2 扭曲双层集成，并进行低温光谱分析。我们观察到莫尔层内激子的独特压力演化，这揭示了连续介质模型捕获的激子莫尔势景观的剧烈调制，并表明了设计激子带拓扑的能力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 半导体莫尔超晶格由于强束缚激子和明显的电子相关性，已成为探索相关玻色子现象的一个有趣的固体平台，其中莫尔势景观起着核心作用。静水压力允许对这种景观进行连续的原位调整，但由于实验的挑战，仍未得到充分探索。在这里，我们将金刚石砧压力盒与高质量双门控 WSe2/WS2 扭曲双层集成，并进行低温光谱分析。我们观察到莫尔层内激子的独特压力演化，这揭示了连续介质模型捕获的激子莫尔势景观的剧烈调制，并表明了设计激子带拓扑的能力。此外，我们证明了对电荷与层内和层间激子之间相互作用的有效压力控制：层内电荷转移激子对掺杂变得不太敏感，可能是由于电荷转移特性降低；相反，层间激子表现出增强的激子电荷排斥。我们的研究结果表明，静水压力是设计莫尔材料中的玻色准粒子和玻色-费米相互作用的强大调谐旋钮。

articles.title: Magnetic proximity beyond the interface: Layer-sequence-dependent exchange in WSe₂/CrI₃ heterostructures
articles.title_zh: 界面之外的磁接近度：WSe2/CrI3 异质结构中层序相关的交换
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19582v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetic proximity effects in transition metal dichalcogenide (TMD)/2D-magnet heterostructures are often described in terms of the magnetization of the interfacial magnetic layer. Here, we show that this picture is sufficient to describe the neutral-exciton valley splitting of the TMD, but incomplete for its hole-doped electronic structure. We study a gate-tunable van der Waals heterostructure composed of monolayer WSe₂ in direct contact with trilayer CrI₃. By combining spatially and helicity-resolved reflection-contrast spectroscopy with magnetic circular dichroism, we identify two distinct magnetic domains in the trilayer CrI₃: one with purely antiferromagnetic interlayer coupling and one with a mixed antiferromagnetic (AFM)/ferromagnetic~(FM) coupling. In both domains, the sign of the neutral-exciton valley splitting of WSe₂ switches with the magnetization reversal of the adjacent CrI₃ layer. In contrast, helicity-resolved positive-trion spectroscopy of WSe₂ reveals a qualitatively different response. While the AFM domain shows a strongly helicity-selective trion resonance, the mixed AFM/FM domain exhibits trion resonances in both helicities. This behavior disappears when all CrI₃ layers are aligned in a parallel magnetization direction. Our results demonstrate that charged excitons are sensitive to the full layer-resolved magnetic sequence of the adjacent 2D-magnet, revealing magnetic proximity beyond the interface.
articles.abstract_zh: 过渡金属二硫属化物 (TMD)/2D 磁体异质结构中的磁邻近效应通常用界面磁性层的磁化强度来描述。在这里，我们证明这张图片足以描述 TMD 的中性激子谷分裂，但对于其空穴掺杂电子结构来说并不完整。我们研究了由单层 WSe2 与三层 CrI3 直接接触组成的栅极可调范德华异质结构。通过将空间和螺旋分辨反射对比光谱与磁圆二色性相结合，我们在三层 CrI₃ 中识别出两个不同的磁畴：一个具有纯反铁磁层间耦合，另一个具有混合反铁磁 (AFM)/铁磁~(FM) 耦合。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 过渡金属二硫属化物 (TMD)/2D 磁体异质结构中的磁邻近效应通常用界面磁性层的磁化强度来描述。在这里，我们证明这张图片足以描述 TMD 的中性激子谷分裂，但对于其空穴掺杂电子结构来说并不完整。我们研究了由单层 WSe2 与三层 CrI3 直接接触组成的栅极可调范德华异质结构。通过将空间和螺旋分辨反射对比光谱与磁圆二色性相结合，我们在三层 CrI₃ 中识别出两个不同的磁畴：一个具有纯反铁磁层间耦合，另一个具有混合反铁磁 (AFM)/铁磁~(FM) 耦合。在这两个域中，WSe2 的中性激子谷分裂的符号随着相邻 CrI3 层的磁化反转而变化。相比之下，WSe2 的螺旋性分辨正三重子光谱揭示了性质不同的响应。虽然 AFM 域表现出强烈的螺旋选择性 trion 共振，但混合 AFM/FM 域在两个螺旋中都表现出 trion 共振。当所有 CrI₃ 层沿平行磁化方向排列时，这种行为就会消失。我们的结果表明，带电激子对相邻二维磁体的全层分辨磁序列敏感，揭示了界面之外的磁接近度。

articles.title: Emergent medium-range order in amorphous silicon
articles.title_zh: 非晶硅中出现的中程有序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19620v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Medium-range order (MRO) is an important feature of amorphous materials, but its nature in terms of atomic arrangement has remained elusive. Here, using large-scale machine-learning-driven atomistic simulations of amorphous silicon, we probe the MRO of this archetypal network glass. By characterizing the structure in three dimensions, we reveal that the symmetry of the atomic arrangement around a central atom shows a crossover as a function of distance. At short distances, the structure is determined by local bonding constraints, which evolve from predominantly tetrahedral environments in low-density amorphous silicon to highly coordinated and strongly disordered local environments in very-high-density amorphous silicon. At larger distances, however, distinct cubic- and octahedral-symmetry patterns emerge in the three-dimensional atomic-density distribution, despite the absence of these symmetries at shorter length scales. We find that this crossover is accompanied by a quasi-periodic spatial organization of the topological rings in the structure. The characteristic spacing between ring centers matches the length scale of the first sharp diffraction peak (FSDP) in the structure factor, establishing a direct connection between this reciprocal-space signature of MRO and its real-space organization. These results demonstrate that the FSDP, the spatial correlation of the rings, and emergent orientational symmetries are not independent manifestations of MRO, but reflect different aspects of a common structural organization. Our findings provide a unified real-space picture of MRO in amorphous silicon and suggest that intermediate-range structural order in network glasses emerges from the interplay between local bonding constraints and extended atomic arrangements driven by efficient packing.
articles.abstract_zh: 中程有序（MRO）是非晶材料的一个重要特征，但其原子排列的本质仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们利用大规模机器学习驱动的非晶硅原子模拟，探索了这种典型网络玻璃的 MRO。通过在三个维度上表征结构，我们揭示了中心原子周围原子排列的对称性显示出作为距离函数的交叉。在短距离处，结构由局部键合约束决定，该约束从低密度非晶硅中以四面体为主的环境演变为极高密度非晶硅中高度协调和强烈无序的局部环境。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 中程有序（MRO）是非晶材料的一个重要特征，但其原子排列的本质仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们利用大规模机器学习驱动的非晶硅原子模拟，探索了这种典型网络玻璃的 MRO。通过在三个维度上表征结构，我们揭示了中心原子周围原子排列的对称性显示出作为距离函数的交叉。在短距离处，结构由局部键合约束决定，该约束从低密度非晶硅中以四面体为主的环境演变为极高密度非晶硅中高度协调和强烈无序的局部环境。然而，在较大的距离处，三维原子密度分布中出现了不同的立方和八面体对称图案，尽管在较短的长度尺度上不存在这些对称性。我们发现这种交叉伴随着结构中拓扑环的准周期空间组织。环中心之间的特征间距与结构因子中第一个锐衍射峰 (FSDP) 的长度尺度相匹配，在 MRO 的倒易空间特征与其真实空间组织之间建立了直接联系。这些结果表明，FSDP、环的空间相关性和出现的方向对称性并不是 MRO 的独立表现，而是反映了共同结构组织的不同方面。我们的研究结果提供了非晶硅中 MRO 的统一真实空间图像，并表明网络玻璃中的中间范围结构顺序是由局部键合约束和有效堆积驱动的扩展原子排列之间的相互作用产生的。

articles.title: Room-Temperature Metallic 2D Ferromagnetism Stabilized by Quantum Metric
articles.title_zh: 通过量子度量稳定的室温金属二维铁磁性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19713v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The recent discovery of long-sought dice-lattice bands in layered electride YCl opens up unprecedented opportunities for studying correlated electrons in real dice lattice systems. While the weakly dispersive band at the Fermi level is partially filled and density-wave states are expected due to Fermi surface nesting based on conventional theories, the ARPES measurement nevertheless revealed a uniform flat band splitting of 0.5 eV, suggesting unusual ferromagnetism (FM) borne out of the metallic 2D dice lattice. In this Letter, we propose that the uniform metallic FM order is stabilized by the prominent quantum metric near topological band crossing points at K and K', which reconstructs the magnetic instability in the dice metal and tips the density-wave instability toward a uniform FM order. Importantly, our analysis based on random phase approximation (RPA) and Hartree-Fock theory predicts a remarkably high Curie temperature above room temperature for the 2D FM order. These findings establish the first example of a room-temperature 2D metallic magnet stabilized by quantum metric, which not only exemplifies the fundamental significance of quantum geometry in solids but also bears far-reaching applications in energy-efficient high-density magnetic memories.
articles.abstract_zh: 最近在层状电子化合物 YCl 中发现了人们长期寻找的骰子晶格能带，为研究真实骰子晶格系统中的相关电子提供了前所未有的机会。虽然费米能级的弱色散带被部分填充，并且由于基于传统理论的费米表面嵌套，预计会出现密度波态，但 ARPES 测量仍然显示出 0.5 eV 的均匀平带分裂，表明金属二维骰子晶格产生了不寻常的铁磁性 (FM)。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 最近在层状电子化合物 YCl 中发现了人们长期寻找的骰子晶格能带，为研究真实骰子晶格系统中的相关电子提供了前所未有的机会。虽然费米能级的弱色散带被部分填充，并且由于基于传统理论的费米表面嵌套，预计会出现密度波态，但 ARPES 测量仍然显示出 0.5 eV 的均匀平带分裂，表明金属二维骰子晶格产生了不寻常的铁磁性 (FM)。在这封信中，我们提出通过 K 和 K' 处拓扑带交叉点附近的突出量子度量来稳定均匀金属 FM 阶，这重建了骰子金属中的磁不稳定性并将密度波不稳定性转向均匀 FM 阶。重要的是，我们基于随机相位近似 (RPA) 和 Hartree-Fock 理论的分析预测，对于 2D FM 阶数，居里温度会比室温高得多。这些发现建立了第一个通过量子度量稳定的室温二维金属磁体的例子，这不仅体现了固体中量子几何的基本意义，而且在节能高密度磁存储器中具有深远的应用。

articles.title: Role of Gd 5d-Au 5d hybridization for the magnetic properties of Au-Al-Gd quasicrystal approximants
articles.title_zh: Gd 5d-Au 5d 杂化对 Au-Al-Gd 准晶近似体磁性能的作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19727v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We have studied the electronic states of magnetic Au-Al-Gd quasicrystal approximants, which exhibit different magnetic ground states at low temperatures, by orbital-selective soft and hard x-ray electron spectroscopies in the paramagnetic phase. Our results reveal that the valence electronic states vary among the Au-Al-Gd approximants with different magnetic ground states, whereas the Gd 4f electrons are localized in all of them. In particular, we find that the Gd 5d states are hybridized with the Au 5d states around the Fermi level, providing information about a local pathway for the intersite exchange interaction between the localized Gd 4f electrons. This hybridization strength varies among these samples. Our findings bring an orbital-resolved microscopic picture to the magnetism of rare-earth-based quasicrystals and approximants.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们通过顺磁相中的轨道选择性软和硬 X 射线电子能谱研究了磁性 Au-Al-Gd 准晶近似材料的电子态，这些准晶近似材料在低温下表现出不同的磁基态。我们的结果表明，具有不同磁基态的 Au-Al-Gd 近似体之间的价电子态有所不同，而 Gd 4f 电子在所有这些近似体中都局域化。特别是，我们发现 Gd 5d 态与费米能级周围的 Au 5d 态杂化，提供了有关局域 Gd 4f 电子之间位点间交换相互作用的局部路径的信息。这些样品之间的杂交强度各不相同。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们通过顺磁相中的轨道选择性软和硬 X 射线电子能谱研究了磁性 Au-Al-Gd 准晶近似材料的电子态，这些准晶近似材料在低温下表现出不同的磁基态。我们的结果表明，具有不同磁基态的 Au-Al-Gd 近似体之间的价电子态有所不同，而 Gd 4f 电子在所有这些近似体中都局域化。特别是，我们发现 Gd 5d 态与费米能级周围的 Au 5d 态杂化，提供了有关局域 Gd 4f 电子之间位点间交换相互作用的局部路径的信息。这些样品之间的杂交强度各不相同。我们的研究结果为稀土准晶体和近似晶体的磁性提供了轨道分辨的微观图像。

articles.title: Resolving Structural Uncertainty in Stochastic Dynamical Systems via Ensemble-Based Bayesian Inference
articles.title_zh: 通过基于集合的贝叶斯推理解决随机动力系统中的结构不确定性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19744v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recovering the interaction structure of complex stochastic dynamical systems from sparse time-series observations is an inherently ill-posed inverse problem. The posterior over network configurations is high-dimensional, highly degenerate, and shaped by the non-equilibrium nature of the available data. To address this, we propose a fully Bayesian, ensemble-based inference framework. Our approach grounds a continuous-time Stochastic Differential Equation (SDE) likelihood formulation---acting mathematically as an Onsager-Machlup quasi-potential for non-equilibrium paths---within a non-parametric Minimum Description Length (MDL) structural prior. This framework rigorously penalizes model complexity and avoids kinetic overfitting by forcing continuous parameters into a finite vocabulary of discrete categories. The joint posterior is optimized using a block-coordinate scheme combining sub-quadratic Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) topological sampling with deterministic Nelder-Mead parameter optimization. Using highly non-linear macroscopic population dynamics as a benchmark, we demonstrate that inference requires non-stationary transient data to resolve causal information. Furthermore, we prove that propagating structural uncertainty via ensemble-based posterior analysis produces significantly more robust and reliable predictions for downstream perturbation outcomes than traditional single-point (MAP) estimates. The framework is highly generalizable, capturing fundamental topological constraints even under severe generative model mismatches, offering a robust tool for uncertainty-aware inference in complex stochastic systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 从稀疏时间序列观测中恢复复杂随机动力系统的相互作用结构本质上是一个不适定的反问题。网络配置的后验是高维、高度退化的，并且由可用数据的非平衡性质决定。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一个完全贝叶斯、基于集成的推理框架。我们的方法基于连续时间随机微分方程 (SDE) 似然公式——在数学上充当非平衡路径的 Onsager-Machlup 准势——在非参数最小描述长度 (MDL) 结构先验中。该框架严格惩罚模型的复杂性，并通过将连续参数强制放入离散类别的有限词汇中来避免动力学过度拟合。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 从稀疏时间序列观测中恢复复杂随机动力系统的相互作用结构本质上是一个不适定的反问题。网络配置的后验是高维、高度退化的，并且由可用数据的非平衡性质决定。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一个完全贝叶斯、基于集成的推理框架。我们的方法基于连续时间随机微分方程 (SDE) 似然公式——在数学上充当非平衡路径的 Onsager-Machlup 准势——在非参数最小描述长度 (MDL) 结构先验中。该框架严格惩罚模型的复杂性，并通过将连续参数强制放入离散类别的有限词汇中来避免动力学过度拟合。使用块坐标方案对联合后验进行优化，该方案将次二次马尔可夫链蒙特卡罗 (MCMC) 拓扑采样与确定性 Nelder-Mead 参数优化相结合。使用高度非线性的宏观群体动态作为基准，我们证明推理需要非平稳瞬态数据来解析因果信息。此外，我们证明，通过基于集合的后验分析传播结构不确定性，可以比传统的单点（MAP）估计对下游扰动结果产生更加稳健和可靠的预测。该框架具有高度通用性，即使在严重的生成模型不匹配的情况下也能捕获基本的拓扑约束，为复杂随机系统中的不确定性感知推理提供了强大的工具。

articles.title: Beyond Kitaev exchange: Γ'-driven magnetism in Ag₃LiRh₂O₆
articles.title_zh: 超越基塔耶夫交换：Ag₃LiRh2O₆ 中 γ' 驱动的磁性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19770v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In Kitaev magnets, frustration arises from bond-dependent spin anisotropic interactions, which can potentially realize sought-after quantum spin liquid phases. However, material realizations with dominating Kitaev exchange are scarce and the broad parameter space of extended Kitaev models remains largely unexplored experimentally. Here, we use density-functional theory, cluster many-body, spin-wave, and density-matrix renormalization calculations to show that the recently discovered honeycomb rhodate Ag₃LiRh₂O₆ hosts an off-diagonal exchange Γ₁' that is second in magnitude only to the ferromagnetic Kitaev exchange K₁. This combination of K₁ and Γ₁' explains key experimental observations, an unusually high magnetic ordering temperature of 94 K at ambient pressure and its rapid decrease under hydrostatic pressure as Ag₃LiRh₂O₆ evolves from ferromagnetic toward zigzag order within the honeycomb planes. Our spin-wave calculations further predict an unusual topology of the magnon bands arising from the Γ₁' term in the spin Hamiltonian of the honeycomb layer. We show that the large trigonal splitting of t₂g states enhances Γ₁', the hitherto underappreciated term in Kitaev magnets, and opens the way to new interesting regimes of the extended Kitaev model.
articles.abstract_zh: 在基塔耶夫磁体中，挫折来自于键依赖性自旋各向异性相互作用，这有可能实现备受追捧的量子自旋液相。然而，以基塔耶夫交换为主的材料实现很少，并且扩展基塔耶夫模型的广泛参数空间在很大程度上仍未通过实验进行探索。在这里，我们使用密度泛函理论、簇多体、自旋波和密度矩阵重正化计算来表明，最近发现的蜂窝状铑酸盐Ag₃LiRh2O₆具有非对角线交换Ђ'，其数量级仅次于铁磁Kitaev交换K₁。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在基塔耶夫磁体中，挫折来自于键依赖性自旋各向异性相互作用，这有可能实现备受追捧的量子自旋液相。然而，以基塔耶夫交换为主的材料实现很少，并且扩展基塔耶夫模型的广泛参数空间在很大程度上仍未通过实验进行探索。在这里，我们使用密度泛函理论、簇多体、自旋波和密度矩阵重正化计算来表明，最近发现的蜂窝状铑酸盐Ag₃LiRh2O₆具有非对角线交换Ђ'，其数量级仅次于铁磁Kitaev交换K₁。 K₁ 和 Ђ' 的这种组合解释了关键的实验观察结果，即环境压力下异常高的磁有序温度 94 K，以及当 Ag3LiRh2O6 在蜂窝平面内从铁磁性演化为锯齿形有序时，其在静水压力下迅速降低。我们的自旋波计算进一步预测了由蜂窝层自旋哈密顿量中的 Γ₁' 项引起的不寻常的磁振子带拓扑。我们证明，t2g 态的大三角分裂增强了 Γ₁'（基塔耶夫磁体中迄今为止未被充分重视的术语），并为扩展基塔耶夫模型的新的有趣状态开辟了道路。

articles.title: Orientation-Dependent Universality of Spin-Transport Fluctuations in Two-Dimensional Altermagnets
articles.title_zh: 二维交替磁体中自旋输运涨落的方向相关普遍性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19793v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Universal conductance fluctuations are conventionally organized by symmetry class, but crystalline anisotropy introduces additional structure in spin transport. Here we demonstrate orientation-dependent universal spin-transport fluctuations in disordered two-dimensional d-wave altermagnets without spin-orbit coupling. Rotating the altermagnetic orientation changes both longitudinal spin-conductance and transverse spin-Hall conductance fluctuations, while each conserved-spin sector remains in class AI. Altermagnetic orientation controls both the fluctuation amplitudes and the development of disorder-insensitive plateaus. These plateaus become flatter and less sensitive to the altermagnetic strength over the studied parameter ranges as the orientation approaches 45^circ, with representative fluctuation amplitudes of approximately 0.60e/(4π) for the longitudinal spin conductance and 0.40,e/(4π) for the spin-Hall conductance. The longitudinal fluctuation amplitude correlates strongly with anisotropy of the clean-band Fermi-velocity tensor. Spin-sector covariances explain how the conserved channels combine into total fluctuations. Our results extend anisotropy-sensitive universal-fluctuation physics to conserved-spin altermagnetic transport and establish crystalline orientation as a control parameter within a fixed symmetry class.
articles.abstract_zh: 通用电导涨落通常按对称性类别组织，但晶体各向异性在自旋输运中引入了额外的结构。在这里，我们证明了无自旋轨道耦合的无序二维 d 波交替磁体中与方向相关的通用自旋输运涨落。旋转交变磁方向会改变纵向自旋电导和横向自旋霍尔电导波动，而每个守恒自旋扇区仍处于 AI 类。交变磁方向控制波动幅度和无序不敏感平台的发展。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 通用电导涨落通常按对称性类别组织，但晶体各向异性在自旋输运中引入了额外的结构。在这里，我们证明了无自旋轨道耦合的无序二维 d 波交替磁体中与方向相关的通用自旋输运涨落。旋转交变磁方向会改变纵向自旋电导和横向自旋霍尔电导波动，而每个守恒自旋扇区仍处于 AI 类。交变磁方向控制波动幅度和无序不敏感平台的发展。当取向接近 45^circ 时，这些平台变得更加平坦，并且对所研究的参数范围内的交变磁场强度不太敏感，纵向自旋电导的代表性波动幅度约为 0.60e/(4π)，自旋霍尔电导的代表性波动幅度约为 0.40,e/(4π)。纵向波动幅度与干净带费米速度张量的各向异性密切相关。自旋扇区协方差解释了保守通道如何组合成总波动。我们的结果将各向异性敏感的通用涨落物理学扩展到守恒自旋交磁输运，并将晶体取向建立为固定对称类内的控制参数。

articles.title: Interplay of electric field and electronic correlations in pairing competition in bilayer nickelates
articles.title_zh: 双层镍酸盐配对竞争中电场和电子相关性的相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19809v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Layer polarization provides a means of tuning the competition between interlayer and intralayer pairing in bilayer nickelates. Using ground-state constrained-path quantum Monte Carlo, we study interlayer s± and intralayer d pairing in a bilayer two-orbital Hubbard model with a layer potential-energy difference ε representing an effective perpendicular electric field. Within the parameter range studied, increasing ε generally enhances the finite-size pairing vertex contribution V_d and reduces Vₛ±, shifting the relative pairing preference toward the d-wave channel. Increasing the onsite repulsion enhances both vertex contributions, more strongly in the d-wave channel, whereas increasing the crystal-field splitting reduces both and makes s± pairing relatively more competitive. Hund's coupling increases the relative competitiveness of s± pairing at weak bias, while enhancing the relative strength of d-wave pairing at large bias. The bias primarily redistributes charge between layers within each orbital sector, accompanied by an increase in the antiferromagnetic spin structure factor. Hund's coupling also enhances local interorbital parallel-spin correlations. These observations suggest possible connections between charge redistribution, magnetic correlations, and pairing competition, offering insight into how layer polarization and multiorbital interactions influence the relative pairing tendencies in the bilayer nickelate model.
articles.abstract_zh: 层极化提供了一种调节双层镍酸盐中层间和层内配对之间竞争的方法。使用基态约束路径量子蒙特卡罗，我们研究了双层双轨道哈伯德模型中的层间 s± 和层内 d 配对，其中层势能差 ε 代表有效垂直电场。在研究的参数范围内，增加 ε 通常会增强有限尺寸配对顶点贡献 V_d 并降低 Vₛ±，从而将相对配对偏好转向 d 波通道。增加现场斥力会增强两个顶点的贡献，在 d 波通道中更为强烈，而增加晶体场分裂会减少这两个顶点的贡献，并使 s± 配对相对更具竞争力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 层极化提供了一种调节双层镍酸盐中层间和层内配对之间竞争的方法。使用基态约束路径量子蒙特卡罗，我们研究了双层双轨道哈伯德模型中的层间 s± 和层内 d 配对，其中层势能差 ε 代表有效垂直电场。在研究的参数范围内，增加 ε 通常会增强有限尺寸配对顶点贡献 V_d 并降低 Vₛ±，从而将相对配对偏好转向 d 波通道。增加现场斥力会增强两个顶点的贡献，在 d 波通道中更为强烈，而增加晶体场分裂会减少这两个顶点的贡献，并使 s± 配对相对更具竞争力。 Hund 耦合增加了弱偏压下 s± 配对的相对竞争力，同时增强了大偏压下 d 波配对的相对强度。偏置主要在每个轨道扇区内的层之间重新分配电荷，同时伴随着反铁磁自旋结构因子的增加。洪德耦合还增强了局部轨道间平行自旋相关性。这些观察结果表明电荷重新分布、磁相关性和配对竞争之间可能存在联系，从而深入了解层极化和多轨道相互作用如何影响双层镍酸盐模型中的相对配对趋势。

articles.title: Magnetic field induced modulation of heat transport in CrPS₄ probed by TaIrTe₄ transverse Seebeck thermometry
articles.title_zh: 通过 TaIrTe₄ 横向塞贝克测温法探测 CrPS₄ 中热传输的磁场诱导调制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19833v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding and controlling heat flow in low-dimensional magnetic materials is central to thermoelectrics and spin caloritronics. One of the challenges is the absence of sensitive probes of small, field-dependent modulations in thermal transport. Here we demonstrate transverse Seebeck thermometry using exfoliated TaIrTe₄ as a probe of thermal conductivity modulated by an external magnetic field on a van der Waals magnet, CrPS₄. With a temperature gradient oriented at 45^circ to its principal crystallographic axes, TaIrTe₄ exhibits a transverse thermopower exceeding 200~mathrmμ V,K⁻¹ for 900 nm wide and 30 μm long electrodes, enabling precise detection of variations in the local temperature gradients. Exploiting this with CrPS₄ in a nonlocal geometry, we resolve distinct field dependent thermal conductivity changes associated with both the spin-flip and spin-flop magnetic transitions which we attribute to variations in the magnon-phonon coupling in CrPS₄. At 5 K, the transverse Seebeck response is modulated by more than 8% by an external magnetic field, demonstrating strong magnetic control of heat transport in CrPS₄. This all van der Waals platform offers high sensitivity to modulations of thermal conductivity and a broad adaptability to a wide range of exfoliated magnetic systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 了解和控制低维磁性材料中的热流是热电学和自旋热电子学的核心。挑战之一是缺乏对热传输中小型、场相关调制的敏感探针。在这里，我们展示了横向塞贝克测温法，使用剥离的 TaIrTe₄ 作为热导率探针，通过范德华磁体 CrPS₄ 上的外部磁场进行调制。 TaIrTe4 的温度梯度与其主晶轴成 45^circ 角，对于 900 nm 宽和 30 μm 长的电极，其横向热电势超过 200~mathrmμ V,K-1，从而能够精确检测局部温度梯度的变化。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 了解和控制低维磁性材料中的热流是热电学和自旋热电子学的核心。挑战之一是缺乏对热传输中小型、场相关调制的敏感探针。在这里，我们展示了横向塞贝克测温法，使用剥离的 TaIrTe₄ 作为热导率探针，通过范德华磁体 CrPS₄ 上的外部磁场进行调制。 TaIrTe4 的温度梯度与其主晶轴成 45^circ 角，对于 900 nm 宽和 30 μm 长的电极，其横向热电势超过 200~mathrmμ V,K-1，从而能够精确检测局部温度梯度的变化。在非局域几何中利用 CrPS₄ 来利用这一点，我们解决了与自旋翻转和自旋翻转磁转变相关的明显场相关热导率变化，我们将其归因于 CrPS₄ 中磁振子-声子耦合的变化。在 5 K 时，外部磁场对横向塞贝克响应的调制超过 8%，这表明 CrPS₄ 中热传输的强磁控制。这种全范德华平台对热导率调制具有高灵敏度，并且对各种剥离磁性系统具有广泛的适应性。

articles.title: Error-controlled switching between discrete and continuum dislocations in a unified defect framework
articles.title_zh: 统一缺陷框架中离散位错和连续位错之间的误差控制切换
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19841v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Simulating defects of every dimension together is expensive, and the savings of adaptive methods are rarely tested at equal accuracy. We present a variational framework in which fields, dislocation lines and defect densities share one free energy, one dissipation law and exact ledgers of mass and Burgers vector, so that a region can change its representation without gaining or losing defects. On this basis, an allocator switches the dislocations themselves between discrete particles, where they are sparse, and a continuous density, where they are dense. The switch is made block by block from local counts, conserves the Burgers vector exactly and is controlled by a single threshold. For 5×10⁵ dislocations, the allocator reproduces the discrete model to within 1% in the sparse region at 14-37 times lower cost, depending on the machine; the advantage grows to 81 times at 10⁶ dislocations, and a threshold calibrated on one ensemble meets its error target on an independent one. For an idealized array of dislocation walls in copper, the allocator is 37.5 times cheaper than particle dislocation dynamics and, at almost the same cost, six times more accurate than continuum dislocation dynamics between the walls. In a three-dimensional copper model coupling grain-boundary cavitation with damage, ligaments left at nominal coalescence delay creep rupture by 25-48% (post hoc sweep). By contrast, grids refined at interfaces gain less than twofold once the active region exceeds about 30% of the domain, so representation switching, rather than grid refinement, is the effective form of adaptivity for defect-rich microstructures.
articles.abstract_zh: 一起模拟每个维度的缺陷是昂贵的，并且自适应方法的节省很少以相同的精度进行测试。我们提出了一种变分框架，其中场、位错线和缺陷密度共享一种自由能、一种耗散定律以及精确的质量分类账和伯格斯矢量，以便一个区域可以在不增加或丢失缺陷的情况下改变其表示。在此基础上，分配器在离散粒子（稀疏粒子）和连续密度（密集粒子）之间切换位错本身。该切换是根据本地计数逐块进行的，精确地保存 Burgers 向量并由单个阈值控制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 一起模拟每个维度的缺陷是昂贵的，并且自适应方法的节省很少以相同的精度进行测试。我们提出了一种变分框架，其中场、位错线和缺陷密度共享一种自由能、一种耗散定律以及精确的质量分类账和伯格斯矢量，以便一个区域可以在不增加或丢失缺陷的情况下改变其表示。在此基础上，分配器在离散粒子（稀疏粒子）和连续密度（密集粒子）之间切换位错本身。该切换是根据本地计数逐块进行的，精确地保存 Burgers 向量并由单个阈值控制。对于 5×10⁵ 位错，分配器以 14-37 倍的成本在稀疏区域中将离散模型再现到 1% 以内，具体取决于机器；在 10⁶ 位错处，优势增长到 81 倍，并且在一个集合上校准的阈值满足其在独立集合上的误差目标。对于铜中的理想化位错壁阵列，分配器比粒子位错动力学便宜 37.5 倍，并且在几乎相同的成本下，比壁之间的连续位错动力学精确六倍。在将晶界空化与损伤耦合的三维铜模型中，名义聚结处留下的韧带将蠕变断裂延迟了 25-48%（事后扫描）。相比之下，一旦活动区域超过域的约 30%，在界面处细化的网格增益不到两倍，因此表示切换（而不是网格细化）是缺陷丰富的微结构自适应的有效形式。

articles.title: Nonadiabatic polaron dynamics from machine-learned hopping trajectories
articles.title_zh: 来自机器学习跳跃轨迹的非绝热极化子动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19842v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The formation and motion of small polarons are ubiquitous in energy materials and influence photoinduced processes. Polaron transport is governed by thermally activated lattice dynamics and rare hopping events, requiring spatial and temporal scales only attainable with machine-learning molecular dynamics, which enables extensive sampling of atomic trajectories and polaron configurations over nanoseconds. Moreover, the Born-Oppenheimer approximation underlying standard ab initio molecular dynamics cannot describe the nonadiabatic coupling between electronic states mediated by nuclear motion, which controls energy exchange and excited-state relaxation. Here, we develop a simulation framework that combines machine-learning-assisted polaron dynamics with nonadiabatic molecular dynamics to bridge these complementary aspects of polaron physics, and determine how different polaron-hopping mechanisms affect excited-state dynamics. The enlarged trajectory space allows us to provide the first direct dynamical confirmation of the adiabatic or nonadiabatic classification of polaron hopping regimes originally proposed on the basis of static Marcus-theory arguments, and to connect individual hopping events directly to nonadiabatic electronic transitions. In bulk TiO₂, nonadiabatic hoppings occur preferentially when the energy of the polaron-induced gap state approaches the conduction-band manifold, promoting both electronic de-excitation and, via a Landau-Zener mechanism, excitation from the ground state. In MgO, the predominantly adiabatic character of hole-polaron hopping suppresses these effects, leading to longer charge-carrier lifetimes and an absence of thermally activated excitations. At the rutile TiO₂(110) surface, hopping events are rarer than in bulk because the excess electron is strongly stabilized in the subsurface region, leading to correspondingly longer de-excitation times.
articles.abstract_zh: 小极化子的形成和运动在能源材料中普遍存在，并影响光诱导过程。极化子传输受热激活晶格动力学和罕见的跳跃事件控制，需要只能通过机器学习分子动力学才能实现的空间和时间尺度，这使得能够在纳秒内对原子轨迹和极化子配置进行广泛采样。此外，标准从头算分子动力学基础的玻恩-奥本海默近似无法描述核运动介导的电子态之间的非绝热耦合，核运动控制着能量交换和激发态弛豫。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 小极化子的形成和运动在能源材料中普遍存在，并影响光诱导过程。极化子传输受热激活晶格动力学和罕见的跳跃事件控制，需要只能通过机器学习分子动力学才能实现的空间和时间尺度，这使得能够在纳秒内对原子轨迹和极化子配置进行广泛采样。此外，标准从头算分子动力学基础的玻恩-奥本海默近似无法描述核运动介导的电子态之间的非绝热耦合，核运动控制着能量交换和激发态弛豫。在这里，我们开发了一个模拟框架，将机器学习辅助的极化子动力学与非绝热分子动力学相结合，以桥接极化子物理的这些互补方面，并确定不同的极化子跳跃机制如何影响激发态动力学。扩大的轨迹空间使我们能够对最初基于静态马库斯理论论证提出的极化子跳跃机制的绝热或非绝热分类提供第一个直接的动力学确认，并将单个跳跃事件直接与非绝热电子跃迁联系起来。在块体 TiO2 中，当极化子引起的带隙态的能量接近导带流形时，会优先发生非绝热跳跃，从而促进电子去激发，并通过朗道-齐纳机制从基态激发。在氧化镁中，空穴极化子跳跃的主要绝热特性抑制了这些效应，从而导致载流子寿命更长并且不存在热激活激发。在金红石 TiO2(110) 表面，跳跃事件比本体中少见，因为多余的电子在次表面区域高度稳定，导致相应更长的去激发时间。

articles.title: A practical route to amorphous solid-state electrolyte structures by hybrid reverse Monte Carlo with foundation potentials
articles.title_zh: 具有基础电位的混合逆蒙特卡罗非晶固态电解质结构的实用途径
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19846v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Amorphous alkali oxychlorides are fast ion conductors, but their atomic structure remains unresolved. Total scattering sums all partial pair correlations into one curve that has no unique inversion, so the structure must be modeled. Melt-quench molecular dynamics builds a model from the interatomic potential alone, and reverse Monte Carlo (RMC) builds one from the measurement alone. The two have rarely been compared with all else held fixed. We benchmark both routes and two hybrid schemes on amorphous ceLi₀.₉NbO₀.₉Cl₄.₁ against one neutron pair distribution function with one foundation potential. The hybrid schemes put the energy either in the acceptance rule (inline) or in short relaxations between blocks of refinement (alternating). Each refinement starts from a melt-quench glass or from a random packing of isolated units. The glass has the lowest energy and places the first-shell peaks correctly, but carries almost none of the oscillation beyond 6~Å{} (goodness of fit R² = 0.29). Pure RMC fits the measurement to within its counting noise (R² = 0.99), but at more than 1.3~eV/atom above the glass, and niobium loses about half of its first-shell chlorine. Started from the glass, both hybrid schemes reach R² = 0.92 within 0.1~eV/atom of its energy and keep its coordination chemistry. Structures from the two inputs fit almost equally well and differ in energy by a tenth of the RMC penalty, yet they differ in whether their polyhedra are connected. The input is therefore part of the method. We recommend quenching a glass with a foundation potential and refining it against the measurement with a hybrid scheme. The resulting structure carries both the local chemistry and the medium-range order, and it is the starting point for modeling ion transport in these conductors.
articles.abstract_zh: 无定形碱金属氯氧化物是快离子导体，但其原子结构仍未解决。全散射将所有部分对相关性汇总为一条没有唯一反演的曲线，因此必须对结构进行建模。熔融淬火分子动力学仅根据原子间势建立模型，而逆蒙特卡罗 (RMC) 仅根据测量建立模型。很少有人将这两者与其他固定不变的因素进行比较。我们将非晶 ceLi₀.₉NbO₀.₉Cl₄.₁ 上的两种路线和两种混合方案与具有一个基础势的一个中子对分布函数进行基准测试。混合方案将能量放入接受规则（内联）或细化块之间的短暂松弛（交替）中。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 无定形碱金属氯氧化物是快离子导体，但其原子结构仍未解决。全散射将所有部分对相关性汇总为一条没有唯一反演的曲线，因此必须对结构进行建模。熔融淬火分子动力学仅根据原子间势建立模型，而逆蒙特卡罗 (RMC) 仅根据测量建立模型。很少有人将这两者与其他固定不变的因素进行比较。我们将非晶 ceLi₀.₉NbO₀.₉Cl₄.₁ 上的两种路线和两种混合方案与具有一个基础势的一个中子对分布函数进行基准测试。混合方案将能量放入接受规则（内联）或细化块之间的短暂松弛（交替）中。每一次改进都从熔融淬火玻璃或孤立单元的随机包装开始。玻璃具有最低的能量，并且正确放置第一壳层峰值，但几乎没有任何超过 6~Å{} 的振荡（拟合优度 R² = 0.29）。纯 RMC 使测量结果符合其计数噪声 (R² = 0.99)，但在玻璃上方超过 1.3~eV/原子，并且铌损失了大约一半的第一层氯。从玻璃开始，两种混合方案在其能量的 0.1~eV/atom 范围内达到 R² = 0.92，并保持其配位化学。两个输入的结构几乎同样吻合，并且能量差异为 RMC 惩罚的十分之一，但它们的不同之处在于多面体是否连接。因此，输入是该方法的一部分。我们建议对具有基础潜力的玻璃进行淬火，并根据混合方案的测量进行精炼。由此产生的结构同时具有局域化学和中程有序，它是对这些导体中离子传输进行建模的起点。

articles.title: Understanding the Mpemba Effect through a Rule of Thumb
articles.title_zh: 通过经验法则了解姆潘巴效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19870v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In the Mpemba effect, a system prepared farther from equilibrium relaxes faster than one prepared closer to it. Its persistence across diverse systems, and under different dynamics of the same system, suggests that it is largely rooted in equilibrium properties, with the dynamics deciding only which mode relaxes slowest. Here we propose a simple rule of thumb for anticipating the Mpemba effect: the effect is expected when a single low-order equilibrium moment is nonmonotonic in temperature. The bath singles out this moment as the slowest to relax, so that its displacement from its bath value sets the amplitude of the slowest relaxation mode. We establish this relation exactly for low-dimensional Ornstein--Uhlenbeck processes. We then extend the rule to mean-field models by approximating their relaxation near the final equilibrium state by an Ornstein--Uhlenbeck process. For the mean-field Ising antiferromagnet, which we solve exactly in the thermodynamic limit, this approximation reproduces the main structure of the Mpemba phase diagram, including strong effects far from any phase transition. Finally, we give a general prescription for mean-field systems: identify the slowest symmetry-allowed moment of the normal coordinates at the bath, and follow its equilibrium value as a function of preparation temperature. This offers a practical route from equilibrium observables to anomalous relaxation without diagonalizing the dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 在姆彭巴效应中，远离平衡状态的系统比接近平衡状态的系统松弛得更快。它在不同系统中以及同一系统的不同动态下的持久性表明，它很大程度上植根于平衡特性，动态仅决定哪种模式松弛最慢。在这里，我们提出了一个预测 Mpemba 效应的简单经验法则：当单个低阶平衡矩在温度上非单调时，可以预期该效应。浴将这一时刻选为松弛最慢的时刻，因此其浴值的位移设置了最慢松弛模式的幅度。我们为低维奥恩斯坦-乌伦贝克过程准确地建立了这种关系。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在姆彭巴效应中，远离平衡状态的系统比接近平衡状态的系统松弛得更快。它在不同系统中以及同一系统的不同动态下的持久性表明，它很大程度上植根于平衡特性，动态仅决定哪种模式松弛最慢。在这里，我们提出了一个预测 Mpemba 效应的简单经验法则：当单个低阶平衡矩在温度上非单调时，可以预期该效应。浴将这一时刻选为松弛最慢的时刻，因此其浴值的位移设置了最慢松弛模式的幅度。我们为低维奥恩斯坦-乌伦贝克过程准确地建立了这种关系。然后，我们通过奥恩斯坦-乌伦贝克过程在最终平衡状态附近近似松弛，从而将该规则扩展到平均场模型。对于我们在热力学极限下精确求解的平均场伊辛反铁磁体，这种近似再现了 Mpemba 相图的主要结构，包括远离任何相变的强效应。最后，我们给出了平均场系统的一般规定：确定浴槽处法向坐标的最慢对称允许矩，并遵循其平衡值作为制备温度的函数。这提供了一条从平衡可观测量到反常松弛的实用途径，而无需对动力学进行对角化。

articles.title: Deep Learning of Phase Transitions for Bilinear-Biquadratic Spin-1 Chains from Correlation Aspects
articles.title_zh: 从相关性角度深度学习双线性双二次自旋 1 链的相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.19995v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the role of different correlation functions in reconstructing the phase diagram of the spin-1 bilinear-biquadratic chain, parametrized by the angle θ between the bilinear and biquadratic couplings, using our previously developed label-free machine-learning pipeline citeMing21, Ming23, in which an autoencoder compresses iDMRG correlation matrices into latent features and K-means clustering with silhouette analysis groups them into phases. Without any prior labels, the scheme reveals four natural phases, the Haldane, dimerized, critical trimerized, and ferromagnetic phases, and accurately locates the Takhtajan-Babujian (θ=-π/4), SU(3)-symmetric Uimin-Lai-Sutherland (θ=π/4), and Ferro-Dimer (θ=5π/4) transition points; a shallow supervised refinement further sharpens the phase boundaries. We find that different correlation functions play fundamentally different roles in phase identification. The SU(3)-symmetric correlation alone selects a four-cluster partition that can be associated with the four phases, whereas the spin-spin and dimer-dimer correlations must be combined to recover the complete phase diagram. In contrast, the trimer-trimer correlation behaves as a marginal correlation: it is insufficient for phase identification by itself but improves the precision of the predicted phase boundaries when combined with the other correlations. Furthermore, the latent representations and silhouette values reveal signatures that we relate to the θ dependence of the correlations within each phase and, tentatively, to the underlying renormalization-group structure. These results demonstrate that machine learning can not only identify quantum phases but also uncover the physical information encoded in different correlation functions.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们使用我们之前开发的无标签机器学习管道 citeMing21、Ming23 研究了不同相关函数在重建 spin-1 双线性双二次链相图中的作用，通过双线性和双二次耦合之间的角度 θ 进行参数化，其中自动编码器将 iDMRG 相关矩阵压缩为潜在特征，并通过轮廓分析进行 K 均值聚类将它们分组为相。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们使用我们之前开发的无标签机器学习管道 citeMing21、Ming23 研究了不同相关函数在重建 spin-1 双线性双二次链相图中的作用，通过双线性和双二次耦合之间的角度 θ 进行参数化，其中自动编码器将 iDMRG 相关矩阵压缩为潜在特征，并通过轮廓分析进行 K 均值聚类将它们分组为相。在没有任何预先标记的情况下，该方案揭示了四个自然相，Haldane相、二聚相、临界三聚相和铁磁相，并准确定位了Takhtajan-Babujian (θ=-π/4)、SU(3)-对称Uimin-Lai-Sutherland (θ=π/4)和Ferro-Dimer (θ=5π/4)转变点；浅层监督细化进一步锐化了相边界。我们发现不同的相关函数在相位识别中发挥着根本不同的作用。 SU(3)-对称相关性单独选择可与四个相相关的四簇分区，而自旋-自旋和二聚体-二聚体相关性必须组合起来才能恢复完整的相图。相反，三聚体-三聚体相关性表现为边际相关性：它本身不足以进行相识别，但与其他相关性结合时可以提高预测相边界的精度。此外，潜在表示和轮廓值揭示了我们与每个相内相关性的 θ 依赖性相关的特征，并且暂时与底层重整化群结构相关。这些结果表明，机器学习不仅可以识别量子相，还可以揭示不同相关函数中编码的物理信息。

articles.title: Transverse magneto-gyrotropy driven by spin-induced ferroaxiality
articles.title_zh: 自旋诱导铁轴性驱动的横向磁陀螺
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20061v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Photon chirality is inherently sensitive to structural handedness and magnetism, which break spatial inversion and time-reversal symmetries, respectively. Ferroaxial order, by contrast, hosts two-dimensional chirality while preserving both symmetries, thereby precluding its direct coupling to photon chirality. Intertwining ferroaxiality with magnetic order, however, may lift such constraints and enable unconventional coupling to photon chirality. Nevertheless, the optical response arising from such intertwined order has yet to be demonstrated experimentally. Here, we demonstrate transverse magneto-gyrotropy arising from spin-driven ferroaxiality in the Weyl magnet EuCd2Sb2. Whereas the conventional polar magneto-optical Kerr effect is governed by magnetization parallel to the light-propagation direction, we observe a gyrotropic response associated with magnetization transverse to the light-propagation direction. The optical rotation exhibits a characteristic 120-degree periodicity upon rotation of the in-plane magnetic field, reflecting the threefold symmetry of the emergent ferroaxial state and revealing the ferroaxial origin of the transverse gyrotropic response. This coupling to photon chirality enables vectorial control of the gyrotropic response through the magnetic field direction. Our findings establish an interaction between photon chirality and transverse magnetization enabled by intertwined ferroaxial and magnetic orders, demonstrating a novel form of multiferroicity with functional light-matter interaction.
articles.abstract_zh: 光子手性本质上对结构旋向和磁性敏感，这分别打破了空间反转和时间反转对称性。相比之下，铁轴序具有二维手性，同时保留两种对称性，从而排除了其与光子手性的直接耦合。然而，铁轴性与磁序的交织可能会解除这种限制，并实现与光子手性的非常规耦合。然而，这种相互交织的秩序所产生的光学响应尚未得到实验证明。在这里，我们展示了 Weyl 磁体 EuCd2Sb2 中自旋驱动的铁轴性引起的横向磁旋变性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 光子手性本质上对结构旋向和磁性敏感，这分别打破了空间反转和时间反转对称性。相比之下，铁轴序具有二维手性，同时保留两种对称性，从而排除了其与光子手性的直接耦合。然而，铁轴性与磁序的交织可能会解除这种限制，并实现与光子手性的非常规耦合。然而，这种相互交织的秩序所产生的光学响应尚未得到实验证明。在这里，我们展示了 Weyl 磁体 EuCd2Sb2 中自旋驱动的铁轴性引起的横向磁旋变性。虽然传统的极磁光克尔效应受平行于光传播方向的磁化强度控制，但我们观察到与横向于光传播方向的磁化强度相关的陀螺响应。面内磁场旋转时，旋光表现出特征性的 120 度周期性，反映了出射铁轴态的三重对称性，并揭示了横向陀螺响应的铁轴起源。这种与光子手性的耦合使得能够通过磁场方向对陀螺响应进行矢量控制。我们的研究结果建立了光子手性和横向磁化之间的相互作用，这是由交织的铁轴和磁序实现的，展示了一种具有功能性光-物质相互作用的新型多铁性。

articles.title: Disorder-Induced Griffiths like Phase and Charge Localization in Sr2FeRuO6
articles.title_zh: Sr2FeRuO6 中无序诱发的格里菲斯像相位和电荷局域化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20128v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A comprehensive understanding of complex transition-metal oxides is key to designing next-generation spintronic materials with tailored magnetic and transport functionalities. We investigate the interplay among structural disorder, frustrated magnetism, and localized charge transport in the 3d-4d hybrid double perovskite Sr2FeRuO6. The compound adopts a monoclinic structure with significant B-site antisite disorder that drives its unconventional behavior. Magnetic measurements uncover a robust Griffiths phase extending well above the ordering temperature, evidencing stable short-range ferromagnetic clusters within a disordered matrix. Electrical transport remains strongly localized, transitioning from small-polaron hopping at high temperatures to variable-range hopping at intermediate temperatures. These results position Sr2FeRuO6 as a representative 3d-4d hybrid system in which quenched disorder stabilizes spin inhomogeneity, while polaronic and hopping transport are also observed.
articles.abstract_zh: 对复杂过渡金属氧化物的全面了解是设计具有定制磁性和传输功能的下一代自旋电子材料的关键。我们研究了 3d-4d 杂化双钙钛矿 Sr2FeRuO6 中结构紊乱、受挫磁性和局域电荷传输之间的相互作用。该化合物采用单斜结构，具有显着的 B 位反位无序，从而驱动其非常规行为。磁性测量发现了一个远高于有序温度的鲁棒格里菲斯相，证明了无序矩阵内存在稳定的短程铁磁簇。电传输仍然强烈局域化，从高温下的小极化子跳跃过渡到中间温度下的可变范围跳跃。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 对复杂过渡金属氧化物的全面了解是设计具有定制磁性和传输功能的下一代自旋电子材料的关键。我们研究了 3d-4d 杂化双钙钛矿 Sr2FeRuO6 中结构紊乱、受挫磁性和局域电荷传输之间的相互作用。该化合物采用单斜结构，具有显着的 B 位反位无序，从而驱动其非常规行为。磁性测量发现了一个远高于有序温度的鲁棒格里菲斯相，证明了无序矩阵内存在稳定的短程铁磁簇。电传输仍然强烈局域化，从高温下的小极化子跳跃过渡到中间温度下的可变范围跳跃。这些结果将 Sr2FeRuO6 定位为代表性的 3d-4d 杂化系统，其中猝灭无序稳定了自旋不均匀性，同时还观察到了极化和跳跃传输。

articles.title: Access Rate-Dependent Endurance Behavior of Ferroelectric Hafnium Zirconium Oxide Capacitors
articles.title_zh: 铁电铪锆氧化物电容器与接入速率相关的耐久性行为
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20154v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fluorite-structured ferroelectrics, such as hafnium zirconium oxide (Hf₁₋ₓZrₓO₂), are among the most promising materials for developing the next generation of low-power nonvolatile memories. Emulating realistic operating scenarios for ferroelectric memories requires performing access rate-dependent endurance tests. The access rate-dependent reduction of the switched polarization cannot be described as a mere superposition of fatigue and imprint effects, which are observed in conventional endurance and retention tests, respectively. The interplay between these degradation mechanisms and its correlation with the delay time in between the programming pulses remains unclear. Combining electrical testing through voltage pulses with ab initio and drift-diffusion simulations provides a comprehensive perspective on the microscopic origin of the access rate-dependent reduction of the switched polarization of ferroelectric capacitors based on product-relevant 5 nm thick Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂ films. The role of oxygen vacancy defects accumulating at the electrode-ferroelectric interface with delay time in reducing the fraction of switchable domains is elucidated considering electron transfer processes which change the defect charge state. Building upon this theoretical understanding, a physics-based model to extrapolate the long-term access rate-dependent endurance performance is developed and experimentally verified for temperatures up to 135degC and delay times up to 2 ms.
articles.abstract_zh: 萤石结构铁电体，例如氧化铪锆（Hf₁₋ₓZrₓO2），是开发下一代低功耗非易失性存储器最有前途的材料之一。模拟铁电存储器的实际操作场景需要执行与访问速率相关的耐久性测试。切换偏振的依赖于访问速率的减少不能被描述为疲劳和印记效应的单纯叠加，这分别在传统的耐久性和保持测试中观察到。这些退化机制之间的相互作用及其与编程脉冲之间的延迟时间的相关性仍不清楚。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 萤石结构铁电体，例如氧化铪锆（Hf₁₋ₓZrₓO2），是开发下一代低功耗非易失性存储器最有前途的材料之一。模拟铁电存储器的实际操作场景需要执行与访问速率相关的耐久性测试。切换偏振的依赖于访问速率的减少不能被描述为疲劳和印记效应的单纯叠加，这分别在传统的耐久性和保持测试中观察到。这些退化机制之间的相互作用及其与编程脉冲之间的延迟时间的相关性仍不清楚。将通过电压脉冲进行的电气测试与从头算和漂移扩散模拟相结合，可以全面了解基于产品相关的 5 nm 厚 Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O2 薄膜的铁电电容器开关极化与访问速率相关的减少的微观起源。考虑到改变缺陷电荷状态的电子转移过程，阐明了氧空位缺陷在电极-铁电界面处累积的延迟时间在减少可切换域分数中的作用。基于这一理论理解，我们开发了一个基于物理的模型来推断长期访问速率相关的耐久性能，并针对高达 135 摄氏度的温度和高达 2 毫秒的延迟时间进行了实验验证。

articles.title: A Topological-Geometrical Descriptor (TGD) for Scalable and Interpretable Modeling of Two-Dimensional Carbon Networks
articles.title_zh: 用于二维碳网络可扩展和可解释建模的拓扑几何描述符（TGD）
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20216v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce a compact Topological-Geometrical Descriptor (TGD) for planar two-dimensional carbon networks. Atomic coordinates are mapped to a periodic planar graph and represented through ring populations, topological-charge statistics, projected ring geometry, and dual-graph defect adjacency. The resulting modeling vector contains 19 physically interpretable features. We evaluate TGD on 120 published planar carbon allotropes using the DFT relative energy per atom with respect to graphene as the target. Repeated five-fold cross-validation with gradient boosting yields a mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.0826 +/- 0.0138 eV/atom and R2 = 0.803 +/- 0.074. Under the same validation protocol, TGD gives a mean MAE of 0.0828 eV/atom, compared with 0.0929 eV/atom for a 203-feature Matminer representation. We further analyze 360 vacancy-defected graphene configurations spanning 12 vacancy concentrations from 2 to 24 percent. When entire vacancy concentrations are held out, TGD gives a pooled MAE of 0.269 eV/vacancy and R2 = 0.861, outperforming simple baselines based on vacancy concentration alone or non-hexagonal-ring fraction alone. Sensitivity tests show that the inferred edge sets are stable to moderate changes in the adaptive bond factor. Finally, the mean absolute topological charge is examined as a one-variable empirical surrogate for the allotrope dataset and is treated explicitly as dataset-specific rather than universal. These results show that TGD combines compact prediction with direct structural interpretation while making clear the present restriction to single-layer planar carbon networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们为平面二维碳网络引入了一种紧凑的拓扑几何描述符（TGD）。原子坐标被映射到周期性平面图，并通过环布居、拓扑电荷统计、投影环几何形状和双图缺陷邻接来表示。生成的建模向量包含 19 个物理上可解释的特征。我们使用相对于石墨烯的每个原子的 DFT 相对能量作为目标，对 120 种已发表的平面碳同素异形体进行 TGD 评估。使用梯度增强的重复五倍交叉验证产生的平均绝对误差 (MAE) 为 0.0826 +/- 0.0138 eV/原子，R2 = 0.803 +/- 0.074。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们为平面二维碳网络引入了一种紧凑的拓扑几何描述符（TGD）。原子坐标被映射到周期性平面图，并通过环布居、拓扑电荷统计、投影环几何形状和双图缺陷邻接来表示。生成的建模向量包含 19 个物理上可解释的特征。我们使用相对于石墨烯的每个原子的 DFT 相对能量作为目标，对 120 种已发表的平面碳同素异形体进行 TGD 评估。使用梯度增强的重复五倍交叉验证产生的平均绝对误差 (MAE) 为 0.0826 +/- 0.0138 eV/原子，R2 = 0.803 +/- 0.074。在相同的验证协议下，TGD 给出的平均 MAE 为 0.0828 eV/atom，而 203 个特征的 Matminer 表示的平均 MAE 为 0.0929 eV/atom。我们进一步分析了 360 个空位缺陷石墨烯构型，涵盖 12 个空位浓度（从 2% 到 24%）。当保持整个空位浓度时，TGD 给出的合并 MAE 为 0.269 eV/空位，R2 = 0.861，优于仅基于空位浓度或仅基于非六角环分数的简单基线。敏感性测试表明，推断的边缘集对于自适应粘合因子的适度变化是稳定的。最后，平均绝对拓扑电荷被检查为同素异形体数据集的一变量经验替代，并被明确视为数据集特定的而不是通用的。这些结果表明，TGD 将紧凑预测与直接结构解释相结合，同时明确了目前对单层平面碳网络的限制。

articles.title: Bulk superconductivity in quintuple-layer square-planar nickelate La6Ni5O12
articles.title_zh: 五层方形平面镍盐La6Ni5O12的体超导性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20249v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nickelate superconductors, sharing a similar electronic environment with cuprate superconductors, offer a promising platform for unraveling the mechanism of high-temperature superconductivity. However, the realization of superconductivity in these systems has so far been restricted to thin films or bulk samples under high-pressure. This limits the applicability of various experimental probes to study the mechanism of superconductivity, and hinders the potential application of the nickelate superconductors. Exploring bulk superconductivity at ambient pressure is therefore essential to understand its origin and enable broader experimental research. Here, we report the realization of bulk superconductivity at ambient-pressure in quintuple-layer square-planar (SP) nickelate La6Ni5O12. The SP phase is obtained by performing topotactic reaction on the quintuple-layer Ruddlesden-Popper (RP) compound La6Ni5O16. Optimized reduction condition endows La6Ni5O12 with a superconducting state that exhibits onset transition temperature of ~ 18 K, as verified by both zero resistance and diamagnetic shielding effect. Pronounced hysteresis loops revealed by magnetization and torque magnetometry demonstrate the occurrence of vortex pinning. Specific heat measurements on a polycrystalline pellet of La6Ni5O12 reveal a clear superconducting transition at ~18 K and a superconducting volume fraction of ~ 25%, which strongly supports the presence of bulk superconductivity. Our results establish an unprecedented bulk sample platform for investigating superconductivity in nickelates at ambient pressure, which paves the way for further experimental studies into the superconducting mechanism.
articles.abstract_zh: 镍酸盐超导体与铜酸盐超导体具有相似的电子环境，为揭示高温超导机制提供了一个有前景的平台。然而，迄今为止，这些系统中超导性的实现仅限于高压下的薄膜或块状样品。这限制了各种实验探针研究超导机理的适用性，并阻碍了镍酸盐超导体的潜在应用。因此，探索环境压力下的体超导性对于了解其起源并实现更广泛的实验研究至关重要。在这里，我们报告了在五层方形平面（SP）镍酸盐 La6Ni5O12 中在环境压力下实现了体超导性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 镍酸盐超导体与铜酸盐超导体具有相似的电子环境，为揭示高温超导机制提供了一个有前景的平台。然而，迄今为止，这些系统中超导性的实现仅限于高压下的薄膜或块状样品。这限制了各种实验探针研究超导机理的适用性，并阻碍了镍酸盐超导体的潜在应用。因此，探索环境压力下的体超导性对于了解其起源并实现更广泛的实验研究至关重要。在这里，我们报告了在五层方形平面（SP）镍酸盐 La6Ni5O12 中在环境压力下实现了体超导性。 SP相是通过对五层Ruddlesden-Popper（RP）化合物La6Ni5O16进行拓扑反应得到的。优化的还原条件赋予 La6Ni5O12 超导态，其起始转变温度约为 18 K，零电阻和抗磁屏蔽效应均证实了这一点。磁化和扭矩磁力测量揭示的明显磁滞回线证明了涡旋钉扎的发生。对 La6Ni5O12 多晶颗粒的比热测量表明，在约 18 K 时发生明显的超导转变，超导体积分数约为 25%，这有力地支持了体超导的存在。我们的研究结果建立了一个前所未有的大样本平台，用于研究环境压力下镍酸盐的超导性，这为进一步研究超导机制铺平了道路。

articles.title: Transport regimes in tunnel ferromagnetic Josephson junctions
articles.title_zh: 隧道铁磁约瑟夫森结中的传输机制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20268v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a systematic study of the temperature-dependent transport properties of Nb- and Al-based superconductor--insulator--thin superconductor--ferromagnet--superconductor (SIsFS) Josephson junctions. By varying the superconducting material and the thickness of the intermediate superconducting layer, we identify three distinct transport regimes: a tunnel-dominated SIS-like regime, a temperature-driven crossover, and a complex weak-link regime. A unified Usadel-based description connects these regimes through the self-consistent pair potential of the intermediate s-layer. While for Al-based devices an SIS-like transport regime is observed, a self-consistent calculation of the s/F/S proximity electrode, combined with perturbative tunnel coupling to the outer electrode, accounts for Nb devices with different thickness of the superconducting interlayer. The calculation places the 10-nm-interlayer sample in a proximity-supported, strongly suppressed s state, close to the SInFS limit in which the interlayer is effectively driven normal (n). A reduced nonlinear long-junction description captures the same limiting physics. The evolution of I_cR_N(T) thereby provides a direct experimental signature of the three transport regimes. Beyond the fundamental interest, the results establish practical design guidelines: Nb junctions with sufficiently thick s interlayers are well suited for high-speed cryogenic memory elements and tunable superconducting parametric amplifiers, while Al junctions are natural candidates for coherent superconducting quantum circuits
articles.abstract_zh: 我们对铌基和铝基超导体-绝缘体-薄超导体-铁磁体-超导体（SIsFS）约瑟夫森结的温度依赖性输运特性进行了系统研究。通过改变超导材料和中间超导层的厚度，我们确定了三种不同的传输机制：隧道主导的 SIS 类机制、温度驱动的交叉机制和复杂的弱连接机制。基于 Usadel 的统一描述通过中间 s 层的自洽对势将这些状态连接起来。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们对铌基和铝基超导体-绝缘体-薄超导体-铁磁体-超导体（SIsFS）约瑟夫森结的温度依赖性输运特性进行了系统研究。通过改变超导材料和中间超导层的厚度，我们确定了三种不同的传输机制：隧道主导的 SIS 类机制、温度驱动的交叉机制和复杂的弱连接机制。基于 Usadel 的统一描述通过中间 s 层的自洽对势将这些状态连接起来。虽然对于基于 Al 的器件，观察到类似 SIS 的传输机制，但 s/F/S 邻近电极的自洽计算，结合与外部电极的微扰隧道耦合，解释了具有不同超导夹层厚度的 Nb 器件。计算将 10 nm 夹层样品置于邻近支撑、强抑制 s 状态，接近 SInFS 极限，其中夹层被有效驱动为法向 (n)。简化的非线性长结描述捕获了相同的限制物理现象。因此，I_cR_N(T) 的演化提供了三种传输机制的直接实验特征。除了基本利益之外，结果还建立了实用的设计指南：具有足够厚夹层的铌结非常适合高速低温存储元件和可调谐超导参量放大器，而铝结是相干超导量子电路的天然候选者

articles.title: Coherent and dissipative coupling of multiple photon-magnon hybrids in a chiral microwave resonator
articles.title_zh: 手性微波谐振器中多个光子-磁振子混合体的相干和耗散耦合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20314v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We demonstrate control between level repulsion and level attraction of photon-magnon coupling spectra in a chiral microwave-photon resonator loaded with a 2 mm YIG sphere. By systematically varying the coupling mode volume via the YIG position and the dc-field orientation, we tune the ratio between coherent and dissipative coupling strengths, J/Γ, and thereby switch between level repulsion and level attraction in the hybrid spectra. Full-wave electromagnetic and magnetization-dynamics simulations reveal multiple photon-magnon hybrid modes with distinct spatial overlap factors, which quantitatively account for gap sizes and their angular dependence. Strong nonreciprocity appears near J/Γ approx 1, yielding 28.6 dB isolation ratio in agreement with a unified single-bath input-output model and full-wave simulations. Angular dependence of spectral characterization confirms a picture of the chirality-selection rule and our method of geometric tuning might be useful for considering reconfigurable on-chip isolators.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们证明了在装有 2 mm YIG 球体的手性微波光子谐振器中光子-磁振子耦合光谱的能级排斥和能级吸引之间的控制。通过通过 YIG 位置和直流场方向系统地改变耦合模式体积，我们调整了相干耦合强度和耗散耦合强度之间的比率 J/Γ，从而在混合光谱中的能级排斥和能级吸引之间切换。全波电磁和磁化动力学模拟揭示了具有不同空间重叠因子的多种光子-磁振子混合模式，这些模式定量地解释了间隙尺寸及其角度依赖性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们证明了在装有 2 mm YIG 球体的手性微波光子谐振器中光子-磁振子耦合光谱的能级排斥和能级吸引之间的控制。通过通过 YIG 位置和直流场方向系统地改变耦合模式体积，我们调整了相干耦合强度和耗散耦合强度之间的比率 J/Γ，从而在混合光谱中的能级排斥和能级吸引之间切换。全波电磁和磁化动力学模拟揭示了具有不同空间重叠因子的多种光子-磁振子混合模式，这些模式定量地解释了间隙尺寸及其角度依赖性。在 J/Γ 约 1 附近出现强非互易性，产生 28.6 dB 隔离比，与统一的单浴输入输出模型和全波模拟一致。光谱表征的角度依赖性证实了手性选择规则的图景，并且我们的几何调谐方法可能有助于考虑可重新配置的片上隔离器。

articles.title: Designing Hamiltonians with Exactly Flat Higher-Vortexable Bands
articles.title_zh: 设计具有精确平坦的高涡能带的哈密顿量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20380v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The zero modes of the Aharonov-Casher Hamiltonian form an exactly flat, vortexable Chern band in any nonuniform magnetic field, analogous to the lowest Landau level. We ask which local Hamiltonians host exactly flat higher-vortexable bands. For a scalar Hamiltonian, an exactly flat first-vortexable band requires a mass proportional to the local field; the Dirac analogue has the same structure. For periodic Bernal bilayer graphene with nonzero mean flux, the exact zero-mode pair is genuinely first-vortexable if and only if the interlayer hopping has nonzero mean; zero-mean hopping instead gives a decomposable pair. Multiorbital models yield exact higher-vortexable chains to arbitrary order, while remaining first order in momentum.
articles.abstract_zh: 阿哈罗诺夫-卡舍尔哈密顿量的零模在任何非均匀磁场中形成完全平坦的可涡旋陈氏带，类似于最低的朗道能级。我们询问哪些本地哈密顿主义者拥有完全平坦的高涡旋能带。对于标量哈密顿量，精确平坦的第一可涡带需要与局部场成比例的质量；狄拉克类似物具有相同的结构。对于具有非零平均通量的周期性伯纳尔双层石墨烯，当且仅当层间跳跃具有非零均值时，精确的零模对才是真正可第一涡旋的；相反，零均值跳跃给出了可分解的对。多轨道模型产生任意阶的精确高涡链，同时保持一阶动量。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 阿哈罗诺夫-卡舍尔哈密顿量的零模在任何非均匀磁场中形成完全平坦的可涡旋陈氏带，类似于最低的朗道能级。我们询问哪些本地哈密顿主义者拥有完全平坦的高涡旋能带。对于标量哈密顿量，精确平坦的第一可涡带需要与局部场成比例的质量；狄拉克类似物具有相同的结构。对于具有非零平均通量的周期性伯纳尔双层石墨烯，当且仅当层间跳跃具有非零均值时，精确的零模对才是真正可第一涡旋的；相反，零均值跳跃给出了可分解的对。多轨道模型产生任意阶的精确高涡链，同时保持一阶动量。

articles.title: Influence of the Néel vector on the bulk electronic structure of MnTe measured from the (1 bar1 00) surface
articles.title_zh: 从 (1 bar1 00) 表面测量的 Néel 矢量对 MnTe 体电子结构的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20383v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnetism gives rise to momentum-dependent spin splitting without net magnetization. Here, we use angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) to investigate bulk α-MnTe single crystals cleaved along the (1bar100) plane - an orientation that preserves the compensated magnetic symmetry at the surface and substantially reduces surface effects and k_z broadening. We resolve the three-dimensional bulk band structure with markedly enhanced spectral clarity. The d-wave band splitting, driven by the altermagnetic order and spin-orbit coupling in the Γ-K-M nodal plane, shows a perfect match to theoretical predictions. We further establish that the valence-band maximum occurs near the A point, identifying the corresponding hole pockets as the states governing the transport properties. Spatially resolved measurements reveal systematic variations of the band dispersion along Γ-K and A-L, associated with different pinning of the Néel vector at the surface. Our results establish a surface-sensitive route to resolving the bulk altermagnetic electronic structure of MnTe and provide direct spectroscopic evidence for Néel-vector-dependent band splitting.
articles.abstract_zh: 交变磁性会产生动量相关的自旋分裂，而无需净磁化。在这里，我们使用角分辨光电子能谱 (ARPES) 来研究沿 (1bar100) 平面劈裂的块体 α-MnTe 单晶，该平面保留了表面补偿磁对称性，并大大减少了表面效应和 k_z 展宽。我们解析了三维体能带结构，光谱清晰度显着增强。由 Γ-K-M 节面中的交变磁序和自旋轨道耦合驱动的 d 波段分裂与理论预测完美匹配。我们进一步确定价带最大值出现在 A 点附近，将相应的空穴袋识别为控制输运特性的状态。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 交变磁性会产生动量相关的自旋分裂，而无需净磁化。在这里，我们使用角分辨光电子能谱 (ARPES) 来研究沿 (1bar100) 平面劈裂的块体 α-MnTe 单晶，该平面保留了表面补偿磁对称性，并大大减少了表面效应和 k_z 展宽。我们解析了三维体能带结构，光谱清晰度显着增强。由 Γ-K-M 节面中的交变磁序和自旋轨道耦合驱动的 d 波段分裂与理论预测完美匹配。我们进一步确定价带最大值出现在 A 点附近，将相应的空穴袋识别为控制输运特性的状态。空间分辨测量揭示了沿 Γ-K 和 A-L 的能带色散的系统变化，与表面 Néel 矢量的不同钉扎相关。我们的结果建立了一种表面敏感途径来解析 MnTe 的体相变磁电子结构，并为依赖于尼尔矢量的能带分裂提供了直接的光谱证据。

articles.title: Large-Tiny Spin-Stripe SDW Order in La₃Ni₂O₇ via ¹³⁹La-NQR Spectroscopy: Reconsideration Based on the Am2m Structure
articles.title_zh: 通过 13⁹La-NQR 光谱获得 La₃Ni2O₇ 中的大-微小自旋条纹 SDW 有序：基于 Am2m 结构的重新考虑
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20446v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The lower-symmetry Am2m structure was recently proposed as the intrinsic ambient-pressure phase of La₃Ni₂O₇ based on synchrotron x-ray diffraction, whereas earlier studies investigated its properties assuming the commonly accepted Amam structure. Here, we reexamine the crystal structure in La₃Ni₂O₇ and the spin configuration of spin-density-wave (SDW) state via ¹³⁹La nuclear quadrupole resonance (NQR). The observation of two distinct La(2) sites in the NQR spectra is naturally accounted for by the Am2m structure without any special assumptions, whereas it cannot be reconciled within the Amam framework. Within the Am2m framework, we reanalyze the spin configuration of the SDW phase and identify it as a large-tiny spin-stripe structure, arising naturally from two inequivalent Ni sites with large and tiny magnetic moments. These results establish the itinerant nature of the SDW order at ambient pressure in La₃Ni₂O₇, providing a basis for understanding its relationship to the emergence of high-T_c superconductivity under high pressure.
articles.abstract_zh: 最近，基于同步加速器 X 射线衍射，提出了较低对称性的 Am2m 结构作为 La₃Ni2O₇ 的固有环境压力相，而早期的研究则假设普遍接受的 Amam 结构来研究其性质。在这里，我们通过 139La 核四极共振（NQR）重新研究了 La₃Ni2O₇ 的晶体结构和自旋密度波（SDW）态的自旋构型。 NQR 光谱中观察到的两个不同的 La(2) 位点自然由 Am2m 结构解释，无需任何特殊假设，但在 Amam 框架内无法协调。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 最近，基于同步加速器 X 射线衍射，提出了较低对称性的 Am2m 结构作为 La₃Ni2O₇ 的固有环境压力相，而早期的研究则假设普遍接受的 Amam 结构来研究其性质。在这里，我们通过 139La 核四极共振（NQR）重新研究了 La₃Ni2O₇ 的晶体结构和自旋密度波（SDW）态的自旋构型。 NQR 光谱中观察到的两个不同的 La(2) 位点自然由 Am2m 结构解释，无需任何特殊假设，但在 Amam 框架内无法协调。在Am2m框架内，我们重新分析了SDW相的自旋构型，并将其识别为一种大而小的自旋条纹结构，自然产生于两个具有大和小磁矩的不等价的Ni位点。这些结果确立了La₃Ni2O₇中常压下SDW序的巡回性质，为理解其与高压下高温超导性的出现的关系提供了基础。

articles.title: Orbitronics in Zero-dimensional Graphene Nanoflakes via Electrode Coupling
articles.title_zh: 通过电极耦合实现零维石墨烯纳米片中的轨道电子学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20454v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We show that graphene nanoflakes realize a previously unexplored form of orbitronics in which orbital currents emerge in the absence of intrinsic angular momentum of the constituent atoms. Starting with a hexagonal graphene nanoflake, we demonstrate the presence of energy-degenerate eigenstates with opposite non-zero expectation values of the angular momentum. Placing electrodes in an appropriate configuration on the flake couples the reservoirs more strongly to one of the two opposite-angular-momentum states, yielding a chiral current that carries a net orbital angular momentum. The resulting circulating orbital currents generate magnetic fringe fields that are experimentally accessible with spin centers or superconducting quantum interference magnetometers, providing avenues for their experimental realization. Finally, our work establishes a new platform for exploring and studying orbitronics in zero-dimensional systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们表明，石墨烯纳米片实现了一种以前未探索过的轨道电子学形式，其中轨道电流在组成原子不存在固有角动量的情况下出现。从六边形石墨烯纳米片开始，我们证明了具有相反的非零角动量期望值的能量简并本征态的存在。将电极以适当的配置放置在薄片上，可以使储层与两种相反角动量状态之一更强地耦合，从而产生携带净轨道角动量的手性电流。由此产生的循环轨道电流产生磁边缘场，可以通过自旋中心或超导量子干涉磁力计进行实验访问，为其实验实现提供途径。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们表明，石墨烯纳米片实现了一种以前未探索过的轨道电子学形式，其中轨道电流在组成原子不存在固有角动量的情况下出现。从六边形石墨烯纳米片开始，我们证明了具有相反的非零角动量期望值的能量简并本征态的存在。将电极以适当的配置放置在薄片上，可以使储层与两种相反角动量状态之一更强地耦合，从而产生携带净轨道角动量的手性电流。由此产生的循环轨道电流产生磁边缘场，可以通过自旋中心或超导量子干涉磁力计进行实验访问，为其实验实现提供途径。最后，我们的工作为探索和研究零维系统中的轨道电子学建立了一个新的平台。

articles.title: Magnetic Susceptibility of Superconducting Films in the Meissner-London Regime
articles.title_zh: 迈斯纳-伦敦体系中超导薄膜的磁化率
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20455v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Extracting the London penetration depth, λ(T), from the measured magnetic susceptibility, χ(T), of a superconducting platelet in a perpendicular magnetic field requires knowing the function χ(λ) computed for the actual sample geometry. Thin films are increasingly important in quantum computing and superconducting electronics, most of which operate at ultra-low excitation fields in the vortex-free regime. Understanding their electromagnetic response in the Meissner--London (finite-λ, no vortices) state is therefore essential for extracting intrinsic properties such as the London penetration depth and superfluid phase stiffness. While numerous prior works have addressed different aspects of this problem, here we focus on providing an analytical semi-empirical representation of χ(λ) based on the 2D sheet-current model and establishing the limits of its applicability using two independent full 3D numerical solutions: finite-element modeling and a volume-current integral equation. As a result, we provide χ(λ) for a disc of radius a and thickness d in closed form, valid for all λ and for aspect ratios δequiv d/(2a)le0.05, and accurate to 0.1%. The two-dimensional sheet description with Pearl length Λ=2λ²/d is adequate for δ lesssim10⁻⁴ and λ gtrsim 4d. Thicker films require the full closed form, which includes the three-dimensional corrections. Using the same numerical analysis, we provide an empirical formula that maps rectangular samples---the geometry most commonly used in experiments---onto a disc with an ``effective radius'' for subsequent calculation of χ(λ), and formulate a complete calibration protocol for whole-sample susceptibility measurements.
articles.abstract_zh: 从垂直磁场中测量的超导片的磁化率 χ(T) 中提取伦敦穿透深度 λ(T) 需要了解针对实际样品几何形状计算的函数 χ(λ)。薄膜在量子计算和超导电子学中变得越来越重要，其中大多数在无涡流状态下的超低激发场下运行。因此，了解它们在迈斯纳-伦敦（有限 λ，无涡流）状态下的电磁响应对于提取伦敦穿透深度和超流体相刚度等固有特性至关重要。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 从垂直磁场中测量的超导片的磁化率 χ(T) 中提取伦敦穿透深度 λ(T) 需要了解针对实际样品几何形状计算的函数 χ(λ)。薄膜在量子计算和超导电子学中变得越来越重要，其中大多数在无涡流状态下的超低激发场下运行。因此，了解它们在迈斯纳-伦敦（有限 λ，无涡流）状态下的电磁响应对于提取伦敦穿透深度和超流体相刚度等固有特性至关重要。虽然许多先前的工作已经解决了这个问题的不同方面，但在这里我们重点关注提供基于 2D 片电流模型的 χ(λ) 的分析半经验表示，并使用两个独立的全 3D 数值解（有限元建模和体积电流积分方程）确定其适用性的限制。因此，我们以封闭形式提供半径为 a、厚度为 d 的圆盘的 χ(λ)，对于所有 λ 和长宽比 δequiv d/(2a)le0.05 均有效，并且精确到 0.1%。珍珠长度 Λ=2λ²/d 的二维片描述足以满足 δ lesssim10⁻⁴ 和 λ gtrsim 4d。较厚的薄膜需要完全封闭的形式，其中包括三维校正。使用相同的数值分析，我们提供了一个经验公式，将矩形样本（实验中最常用的几何形状）映射到具有“有效半径”的圆盘上，以便随后计算 χ(λ)，并为全样本磁敏度测量制定完整的校准协议。

articles.title: Testing Replica Symmetry Breaking in the three-dimensional Edwards-Anderson model by using vanishing fields
articles.title_zh: 使用消失场测试三维 Edwards-Anderson 模型中的副本对称性破缺
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20491v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Replica Symmetry Breaking (RSB) theory for spin glasses, which is exact in infinite dimensions, provides detailed predictions for the behavior of these systems. One of these predictions is that vanishing magnetic fields induce chaotic behavior. Here, vanishing has a precise meaning: we refer to an externally applied magnetic field with intensity scaling as 1/sqrtN, where N is the number of spins in the system. RSB predicts that this chaotic behavior depends only on the probability density function of the overlap, P(q), as computed at zero field. We proceed to test the RSB prediction in the 3D Edwards-Anderson model, by first computing the P(q) numerically in the absence of a magnetic field. We then use this function as input to analytically compute the statistics of the states in the regime of a vanishing magnetic field, using a representation based on the Bolthausen-Sznitman coalescent process (which is exact for the mean-field Sherrington-Kirkpatrick model). This mixed numerical-analytical approach allows us to determine the prediction of RSB for the overlap distribution function measured in the presence of a small vanishing field, as well as the increase in chaoticity as the field strength grows. The above RSB predictions are quantitatively compared with the outcome of numerical simulations of the three-dimensional Edwards-Anderson in the presence of a small vanishing field, finding very good agreement. This agreement provides strong support for the idea that three-dimensional spin glass at zero magnetic field and low temperature is well described by RSB theory.
articles.abstract_zh: 自旋玻璃的复制对称破缺（RSB）理论在无限维度上是精确的，为这些系统的行为提供了详细的预测。这些预测之一是消失的磁场会引发混沌行为。在这里，消失有一个精确的含义：我们指的是强度缩放为 1/sqrtN 的外部施加磁场，其中 N 是系统中的自旋数。 RSB 预测这种混沌行为仅取决于在零场计算的重叠概率密度函数 P(q)。我们首先在没有磁场的情况下数值计算 P(q)，从而继续测试 3D Edwards-Anderson 模型中的 RSB 预测。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自旋玻璃的复制对称破缺（RSB）理论在无限维度上是精确的，为这些系统的行为提供了详细的预测。这些预测之一是消失的磁场会引发混沌行为。在这里，消失有一个精确的含义：我们指的是强度缩放为 1/sqrtN 的外部施加磁场，其中 N 是系统中的自旋数。 RSB 预测这种混沌行为仅取决于在零场计算的重叠概率密度函数 P(q)。我们首先在没有磁场的情况下数值计算 P(q)，从而继续测试 3D Edwards-Anderson 模型中的 RSB 预测。然后，我们使用这个函数作为输入，使用基于 Bolthausen-Sznitman 聚结过程的表示（这对于平均场 Sherrington-Kirkpatrick 模型来说是精确的）来分析计算消失磁场范围内状态的统计数据。这种混合数值分析方法使我们能够确定在存在小消失场的情况下测量的重叠分布函数的 RSB 预测，以及随着场强的增加而增加的混沌度。上述 RSB 预测与存在小消失场的三维 Edwards-Anderson 数值模拟的结果进行了定量比较，发现非常一致。该协议为RSB理论很好地描述了零磁场和低温下三维自旋玻璃的观点提供了有力的支持。

articles.title: Structural identification in general crystalline systems via Voronoi cell topology
articles.title_zh: 通过 Voronoi 单元拓扑结构识别一般晶体系统
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20498v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Widely used methods for identifying crystal structure in atomistic simulations are limited in practice to a handful of simple structures, leaving many important crystalline systems without automated classification techniques. Voronoi topology analysis offers a route to classifying arbitrary crystalline and defect environments, but realizing this potential first requires enumerating the Voronoi cell topologies that can arise under thermal perturbation of a structure of interest. We present an algorithm that deterministically enumerates all Voronoi cell topologies arising from generic infinitesimal perturbations of an arbitrary crystal structure, producing structural classifiers that extend automated identification to general crystalline systems. We demonstrate the approach on several structures of general interest.
articles.abstract_zh: 在原子模拟中广泛使用的晶体结构识别方法在实践中仅限于少数简单的结构，使得许多重要的晶体系统没有自动分类技术。 Voronoi 拓扑分析提供了一种对任意晶体和缺陷环境进行分类的途径，但要实现这一潜力，首先需要枚举在感兴趣结构的热扰动下可能出现的 Voronoi 单元拓扑。我们提出了一种算法，可以确定性地枚举由任意晶体结构的一般无穷小扰动产生的所有 Voronoi 单元拓扑，生成结构分类器，将自动识别扩展到一般晶体系统。我们在几种普遍感兴趣的结构上演示了该方法。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在原子模拟中广泛使用的晶体结构识别方法在实践中仅限于少数简单的结构，使得许多重要的晶体系统没有自动分类技术。 Voronoi 拓扑分析提供了一种对任意晶体和缺陷环境进行分类的途径，但要实现这一潜力，首先需要枚举在感兴趣结构的热扰动下可能出现的 Voronoi 单元拓扑。我们提出了一种算法，可以确定性地枚举由任意晶体结构的一般无穷小扰动产生的所有 Voronoi 单元拓扑，生成结构分类器，将自动识别扩展到一般晶体系统。我们在几种普遍感兴趣的结构上演示了该方法。

articles.title: Anyons at impurities: Fractional charge measurement and "wrong sign" binding
articles.title_zh: 杂质处的任意子：分数电荷测量和“错误符号”结合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20522v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent photoluminescence experiments in twisted MoTe₂ have reported signatures of anyons binding to trapped trions. The measured binding energies near the fractional Chern insulators at fillings of ν=-2/3 and -3/5 have a ratio close to the fractional-charge ratio 5/3, even though such scaling is not generally guaranteed for the expected short-range trion-anyon interaction. We model the trapped trion as a fixed impurity, and investigate anyon-impurity binding using a lowest-Landau-level model with exact diagonalization and Jain wavefunctions. Surprisingly, we find that the anyon-impurity binding energy ratio between ν=-2/3 and -3/5 is close to 5/3 for either short- or long-ranged impurity-electron interactions. However, the ratio departs strongly from the charge ratio at intermediate ranges or different Jain states. Remarkably, we also uncover "wrong-sign" binding, whereby both quasiholes and quasiparticles can bind to either sign of a short-range impurity potential by selecting orbital channels with favorable local density oscillations. Our findings show that localized excitons or trions can be used to probe the internal density profile of anyons.
articles.abstract_zh: 最近在扭曲 MoTe2 中进行的光致发光实验报告了任意子与捕获的三重子结合的特征。在 ν=-2/3 和 -3/5 填充时，在分数陈绝缘体附近测得的结合能具有接近分数电荷比 5/3 的比率，尽管对于预期的短程三重子-任意子相互作用通常不能保证这种缩放。我们将捕获的 Trion 建模为固定杂质，并使用具有精确对角化和 Jain 波函数的最低朗道能级模型研究任意子杂质结合。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 最近在扭曲 MoTe2 中进行的光致发光实验报告了任意子与捕获的三重子结合的特征。在 ν=-2/3 和 -3/5 填充时，在分数陈绝缘体附近测得的结合能具有接近分数电荷比 5/3 的比率，尽管对于预期的短程三重子-任意子相互作用通常不能保证这种缩放。我们将捕获的 Trion 建模为固定杂质，并使用具有精确对角化和 Jain 波函数的最低朗道能级模型研究任意子杂质结合。令人惊讶的是，我们发现对于短程或长程杂质-电子相互作用，ν=-2/3 和-3/5 之间的任意子-杂质结合能比接近 5/3。然而，该比率与中间范围或不同耆那教状态下的电荷比率有很大差异。值得注意的是，我们还发现了“错误符号”结合，即准空穴和准粒子都可以通过选择具有有利局部密度振荡的轨道通道来与短程杂质势的任一符号结合。我们的研究结果表明，局域激子或三重子可用于探测任意子的内部密度分布。

articles.title: Exchange Interactions and Magnon Spectra in bcc Fe(001) Thin Films: A Computational Study
articles.title_zh: bcc Fe(001) 薄膜中的交换相互作用和磁振子谱：计算研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20564v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We combined density functional theory with atomistic spin dynamics to understand how surfaces influence magnon dispersion. For this purpose, we investigate thin layers of body-centered cubic iron and compare them with the bulk material. We present how the broken symmetry affects exchange interactions and magnon behavior. Our results reveal enhanced magnetic moments and exchange interactions for surface atoms compared to bulk Fe. The increase in exchange interaction integrals is mostly visible for first- and second-nearest neighbors. We also find a significant spread in exchange values within each coordination shell. Magnon dispersion analysis shows, for the layered system, pronounced band blurring, a significant reduction of maximum frequencies relative to the previously reported bulk values, and the emergence of a low-frequency band outside the g{}-point. Our study shows that relying on bulk exchange parameters introduces errors in the magnon spectra of ultrathin systems, underscoring the need for a detailed, system-specific approach.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们将密度泛函理论与原子自旋动力学相结合，以了解表面如何影响磁振子色散。为此，我们研究了体心立方铁的薄层并将其与块状材料进行比较。我们展示了对称性破缺如何影响交换相互作用和磁振子行为。我们的结果表明，与块状铁相比，表面原子的磁矩和交换相互作用增强。交换相互作用积分的增加对于第一和第二最近邻居来说最为明显。我们还发现每个协调壳内的交换价值存在显着差异。磁振子色散分析表明，对于分层系统，明显的频带模糊，相对于先前报告的体积值，最大频率显着降低，并且在 g{} 点之外出现了低频带。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们将密度泛函理论与原子自旋动力学相结合，以了解表面如何影响磁振子色散。为此，我们研究了体心立方铁的薄层并将其与块状材料进行比较。我们展示了对称性破缺如何影响交换相互作用和磁振子行为。我们的结果表明，与块状铁相比，表面原子的磁矩和交换相互作用增强。交换相互作用积分的增加对于第一和第二最近邻居来说最为明显。我们还发现每个协调壳内的交换价值存在显着差异。磁振子色散分析表明，对于分层系统，明显的频带模糊，相对于先前报告的体积值，最大频率显着降低，并且在 g{} 点之外出现了低频带。我们的研究表明，依赖批量交换参数会在超薄系统的磁振子谱中引入误差，这强调了对详细的、针对系统的方法的需要。

articles.title: Droplets obstruct Onsager-type solutions of the Ising model in a magnetic field
articles.title_zh: 磁场中液滴阻碍伊辛模型的 Onsager 型解
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20569v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Onsager solved the two-dimensional Ising model in zero field, but no solution is known in a magnetic field. We prove that in any dimension dge2, at every fixed dimensionless field outside a countable set, the free energy obeys no algebraic differential equation in the coupling, even locally. The obstruction arises from droplet geometry: the maximal droplet volume grows as the d/(d-1) power of its boundary size, while an integer band in the pressure coefficients protects the extremal contributions against cancellation. Our result excludes Onsager-type solutions and closed forms in elliptic, hypergeometric, or Painlevé functions of the coupling at these fields.
articles.abstract_zh: Onsager 在零场中求解了二维伊辛模型，但在磁场中尚无解。我们证明，在任何维度 dge2 中，在可数集之外的每个固定无量纲场，自由能在耦合中不服从代数微分方程，即使是局部的。障碍源于液滴几何形状：最大液滴体积随着其边界尺寸的 d/(d-1) 次方而增长，而压力系数中的整数带可保护极值贡献不被抵消。我们的结果排除了 Onsager 型解以及这些场耦合的椭圆、超几何或 Painlevé 函数的封闭形式。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Onsager 在零场中求解了二维伊辛模型，但在磁场中尚无解。我们证明，在任何维度 dge2 中，在可数集之外的每个固定无量纲场，自由能在耦合中不服从代数微分方程，即使是局部的。障碍源于液滴几何形状：最大液滴体积随着其边界尺寸的 d/(d-1) 次方而增长，而压力系数中的整数带可保护极值贡献不被抵消。我们的结果排除了 Onsager 型解以及这些场耦合的椭圆、超几何或 Painlevé 函数的封闭形式。

articles.title: Nodal nematic superconductivity in moiré graphene
articles.title_zh: 莫尔石墨烯中的节点向列超导
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.20605v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Unconventional superconductivity can emerge in various forms in strongly correlated systems. Historically, the most extensively studied examples include nodal and triplet pairing, which were experimentally detected in cuprates and superfluid helium-3, respectively. Beyond these canonical cases, there are also nematic superconductors, in which the rotational symmetry of the lattice is broken in the superconducting state. While there are several examples of nematic superconductors whose pairing emerges inside a preexisting nematic normal state, experimental evidence for superconducting states that intrinsically break rotational symmetry on their own has been exceedingly scarce. Here, we report the experimental realization and identification of an intrinsic multi-component nodal nematic superconducting state in magic-angle twisted trilayer graphene (MATTG). By integrating tunneling spectroscopy with quantum transport measurements, we directly probe the symmetry of low-energy superconducting quasiparticles. Deep inside the superconducting state, we observe a pronounced two-fold anisotropy in the zero-bias tunneling conductance under an in-plane magnetic field, which is strongly suppressed together with superconductivity as the temperature or perpendicular magnetic field is increased. Remarkably, the major axis of anisotropy rotates by up to 90cⁱrc across the superconducting dome, indicating an intrinsic, field- and density-tunable symmetry of the low-energy excitations. These behaviors imply a nodal superconducting state in MATTG that spontaneously breaks the six-fold rotational symmetry of the moiré superlattice. Our results establish moiré graphene as a versatile platform for realizing and interrogating nodal nematic superconductivity, opening a new avenue for exploring unconventional symmetry-breaking superconducting states in two-dimensional materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 在强相关系统中，非常规超导性可以以各种形式出现。历史上，最广泛研究的例子包括节点配对和三重态配对，它们分别在铜酸盐和超流氦 3 中通过实验检测到。除了这些典型情况之外，还存在向列超导体，其中晶格的旋转对称性在超导状态下被破坏。虽然有几个向列超导体的配对出现在预先存在的向列正常状态内的例子，但本质上打破旋转对称性的超导状态的实验证据却极其稀少。在这里，我们报告了魔角扭曲三层石墨烯（MATTG）中本征多组分节点向列超导态的实验实现和识别。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在强相关系统中，非常规超导性可以以各种形式出现。历史上，最广泛研究的例子包括节点配对和三重态配对，它们分别在铜酸盐和超流氦 3 中通过实验检测到。除了这些典型情况之外，还存在向列超导体，其中晶格的旋转对称性在超导状态下被破坏。虽然有几个向列超导体的配对出现在预先存在的向列正常状态内的例子，但本质上打破旋转对称性的超导状态的实验证据却极其稀少。在这里，我们报告了魔角扭曲三层石墨烯（MATTG）中本征多组分节点向列超导态的实验实现和识别。通过将隧道光谱与量子输运测量相结合，我们直接探测低能超导准粒子的对称性。在超导态深处，我们观察到面内磁场下零偏置隧道电导具有明显的两倍各向异性，随着温度或垂直磁场的增加，这种各向异性与超导性一起受到强烈抑制。值得注意的是，各向异性的主轴在超导穹顶上旋转了高达 90cⁱrc，这表明低能激发具有固有的、场和密度可调的对称性。这些行为意味着 MATTG 中的节点超导状态会自发打破莫尔超晶格的六重旋转对称性。我们的研究结果将莫尔石墨烯确立为实现和探究节点向列超导性的多功能平台，为探索二维材料中非常规对称破缺的超导态开辟了新途径。

articles.title: A Boson-informed neural network for Ground States of Many-Body Schrödinger equations
articles.title_zh: 用于多体薛定谔方程基态的玻色子神经网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.18875v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We propose a symmetry-preserving Boson-informed neural network (BINN) for the variational Monte Carlo computation of interacting-boson ground states in continuous space. The framework explicitly separates the two dominant physical scales of the system. At the microscopic interaction scale, a cell Jastrow factor absorbs the leading near-contact stiffness, while at the macroscopic scale, a potential-aware envelope encodes the external confinement, leaving the neural network to capture a smoother many-body residual. Across both two- and three-dimensional tests, the BINN approaches the Hartree and Gross-Pitaevskii limits with an empirical O(N⁻¹) finite-size trend in both energy and density. The energies agree with diffusion Monte Carlo to within 0.06% for the particle number tested up to 350 in the three-dimensional shrinking-range case. Applications are made under various trapping scenarios, justifying robust performance of BINN.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种保对称玻色子神经网络（BINN），用于连续空间中相互作用玻色子基态的变分蒙特卡罗计算。该框架明确区分了系统的两个主要物理尺度。在微观相互作用尺度上，细胞贾斯特罗因子吸收了主要的近接触刚度，而在宏观尺度上，电位感知包络对外部限制进行编码，使神经网络能够捕获更平滑的多体残差。在二维和三维测试中，BINN 在能量和密度方面均以经验 O(N⁻1) 有限尺寸趋势接近 Hartree 和 Gross-Pitaevskii 极限。
