articles.abstract: This article presents an investigation of the surface roughness response behavior (Ra and Rt) in AISI 304 and ASTM A297 HH steels modified with Nb, C, Mo, W, and Co, subjected to end milling under dry milling conditions, varying the cutting parameters. The presence of niobium carbide was characterized by SEM/EDS image analysis in the modified ASTM A297 HH steel and by XRD. The microhardness values of the studied steel samples were measured. Tool wear during steel milling was not controlled, as only one cutting edge was used in each milling operation, avoiding interference from tool wear in the roughness measurement. The study applied experimental design techniques using Response Surface Methodology (RSM). The parameters used in the experiments were cutting speed (m/min) and feed per tooth (mm/tooth), without variation in depth of cut. The results showed that the linear parameter fz caused the greatest effects on the roughness response (Ra and Rt) in both steels analyzed. In the modified ASTM A297 HH steel, the interaction between the parameters Vc and fz caused a small influence on the roughness response (Ra), and the quadratic interaction of Vc on the roughness response (Rt). A mathematical model of the roughness behavior as a function of the cutting parameters was developed. The results of the X-ray diffraction (XRD) test showed that there was no transformation of the austenitic phase during milling in the modified ASTM A297 HH steel.

articles.title: Mechanism of the influence of structural parameters on local buckling of composite functional skins
articles.abstract: Composite functional skins are increasingly being applied to aircraft structures. To meet the service requirements of high load-bearing capacity and large deformation, the in-plane tensile/compressive stiffness and out-of-plane bending stiffness of the structure need to be carefully designed. Local or global buckling exhibited during the deformation process of functional skins is a primary concern that structural optimization design must avoid. Based on the finite element method, this paper establishes a simulation analysis model for the deformation process of functional skins. The trailing edge deformation modes under various layup conditions are calculated, and the distribution of trailing edge strain along the spanwise direction is presented. The results indicate that, under different layup conditions, the trailing edge exhibits four distinct deformation modes during the deformation process: conventional deformation, critical buckling deformation, local buckling deformation, and wavy buckling deformation. The relationship between the structural deformation state and stiffness is thoroughly analyzed, a dimensionless parameter characterizing the relative magnitude of bending stiffness and compressive stiffness is proposed, and the mechanisms of the trailing edge deformation modes and buckling deformation of the functional skin are explained. It is found that there exists a competitive relationship between bending stiffness and compressive stiffness during the deformation of functional skins. The larger the ratio of bending stiffness to compressive stiffness, the less likely buckling deformation will occur during the deformation process. The critical buckling load of the structure decreases with a decrease in the relative value of bending stiffness. When the relative value of bending stiffness continues to decrease to below 0.243, the compressive load generated during the deformation of the functional skin reaches the structural critical buckling load over a large spanwise region, and wavy buckling deformation occurs at the trailing edge of the structure.

articles.title: Exergy Studies on Process Components of a Low Temperature Thermal Desalination (LTTD) Plant using Field Experiments
articles.abstract: The present paper discusses about the experimental studies carried out to analyze the Exergy losses encountered in flash evaporation and condensation process of Low Temperature Thermal Desalination plant (LTTD). LTTD process works due to the thermal gradient available between the surface seawater and the cooling deep seawater. In this work, the flow exergy, exergy losses and exergy efficiency of the flash evaporation and condensation process was carried out by conducting suitable experiments in the running LTTD plant. From the experiment it was noted that the overall exergy efficiency of the LTTD process comes around 22.15% on an average. Similarly the evaporation process exergy efficiency was around 33.9% average and condensation exergy efficiency was around 67.2% average. Exergy efficiency of Condensation process was found to be greater than flashing process and possible reasons were discussed in this work. This study is very much useful to identify the areas where energy losses can be minimized by determining exergy losses in the desalination process and to improve overall efficiency of plant. The present work can provide at least some guidance for scientific community to determine the exergy losses in the similar kind of application and also helps in identifying area where improvement can be made for better utilization of energy.

articles.title: The critical role of interface electrons in modulating the sensing behavior of Au/Pd and Pt/Pd resistive hydrogen sensors
articles.abstract: Due to the advantages of scalability and cost-effectiveness, Palladium (Pd) has demonstrated great promise in developing high-performance H₂ gas sensors. However, poor stability and reliability remain obstacles. In this work, we theoretically devised Pd-based heterostructures Au/Pd(111) and Pt/Pd(111) for high-performance H₂ gas sensing. The density functional theory (DFT) calculations for H₂ response mechanism of Pd unambiguously elucidate that the rate-determining step dominating the response performance of Pd-based hydrogen sensors is the surface dissociative adsorption of H₂, rather than the subsequent bulk diffusion of dissociated H atoms. By integrating reaction kinetics energy barrier calculations with Bader charge analysis, we found that the electron redistribution at the Au/Pd(111) and Pt/Pd(111) heterointerface forms targeted negatively charged Au and Pt active sites, respectively, which can effectively activate the H-H bond and reduce the H₂ dissociation energy barrier. The climbing image nudged elastic band (CI-NEB) calculations confirm that the H₂ dissociative adsorption barrier at the Au/Pd(111) and Pt/Pd(111) heterointerface is lowered by 0.32 eV and 0.85 eV relative to Pd (111), which indicates that Pt/Pd(111) heterostructure can drastically accelerate the H₂ dissociative adsorption rate and increase the Pd surface H coverage, thus producing more β-phase PdHx and greatly shortening the sensor's response time to H₂ gas. The H2 desorption barrier at the Au/Pd(111) and Pt/Pd(111) heterointerface is lowered by 1.02 eV and 0.93 eV compared with Pd (111). It demonstrates that the sensing response of Au/Pd(111) and Pt/Pd(111)-based sensor can swiftly revert to its original baseline performance once the H₂ atmosphere is replaced by air.

articles.title: Bandwidth, Representation Loss, and Temporal Drift in Quantum Kernel Fraud Detection: A Pre-Specified Falsification Study
articles.abstract: Quantum kernel results are often reported without holding the input representation, training sample, tuning budget and temporal evaluation protocol fixed against a matched classical kernel. This pre-specified, protocol-locked falsification study uses the Elliptic++ transaction tables (203,769 transactions, 49 time steps) under a locked temporal split (training steps 1–24, validation 25–29, test 30–49 in 4 locked windows). The primary metric is pooled Recall@5%. A frozen full-dimensional gradient-boosting model reached 0.381, and every model, including this one, collapsed in the final window. Graph structure and selective reranking were tested first and falsified. Compressing 182 features to 4, 6 and 8 principal components retained 34%, 43% and 51% of the variance and 64%, 50% and 33% of the full-dimensional model’s pooled Recall@5%. In the primary, default-bandwidth analysis, an entangling fidelity quantum kernel was below the strongest matched classical kernel at 4, 6 and 8 qubits (pooled Recall@5% differences −0.078, −0.203 and −0.146). In a secondary, post hoc bandwidth correction, explicit scale tuning raised the entangling kernel’s Recall@5% by 0.070, 0.121 and 0.109; the corrected kernel remained below the strongest matched classical kernel at 6 and 8 qubits and was statistically unresolved at 4 qubits. The selected scale lay at the lower boundary of the tested grid, and the apparent effect of entanglement depended on bandwidth. No repeatable predictive benefit of the quantum kernel over matched classical kernels was observed in the tested setting; the findings do not extend beyond this dataset, protocol, representation, feature-map family, sample size and bandwidth range.

articles.title: Near infrared salinity sensing with an asymmetric silicon nanodisk dimer metasurface
articles.abstract: Optical salinity sensing needs a transducer whose spectrum changes predictably with the refractive index of the water. We simulate a near infrared metasurface made of two unequal silicon nanodisks (radii 180 and 170 nm, height 280 nm, gap 80 nm) on fused silica and immersed in saline water. Three-dimensional finite difference time domain calculations were run at 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, and 50 ppt with the index relation n = 1.3330 + 1.7×10− 4S. The transmission spectrum contains one narrow dip with a Fano line shape that moves from 1567.47 to 1571.33 nm. A linear calibration gives 77.10 ± 0.10 pm/ppt (95% confidence interval), or 453.5 ± 0.6 nm/RIU, and the slope changes by less than 0.2 pm/ppt when the dip is located in seven different ways. The half depth width falls from 2.57 to 2.51 nm, which gives Q between 610 and 626 and a figure of merit between 177 and 181 RIU− 1; Q moves by about 4% depending on the baseline used for the half depth. Read at a fixed wavelength on the steepest flank, the transmission changes by 4.7 to 4.95 percentage points per ppt. Near field exports at 0 and 50 ppt are included for reference, but they were recorded at 1530 and 1590 nm and not at the dip, so they are not used to assign the resonance. Estimates from seawater optics indicate that a 1 K temperature change mimics 0.5 to 0.7 ppt, so a practical device needs a temperature reference.

articles.title: Synergistic Effect of Cu Doping and g-C 3 N 4 /BiVO 4 Heterojunction for Boosted Visible-Light Photocatalytic Degradation of RhB
articles.abstract: The construction of semiconductor heterojunctions combined with elemental doping is a feasible and efficient strategy to optimize the optical properties of photocatalytic materials. In this work, Cu-doped g-C3N4/BiVO4 composite photocatalysts were successfully fabricated via a facile synthetic route. Characterization confirmed that BiVO4 nanoparticles uniformly grow on g-C3N4 nanosheets, with Cu species coordinating with the triazine ring to form a well-contacted heterojunction interface. Under visible-light irradiation, the optimized Cu/g-C3N4/BiVO4 composite achieved a rhodamine B (RhB) degradation efficiency of 92.01% within 60 min, significantly outperforming pure g-C3N4, BiVO4, and Cu/g-C3N4. In addition, the composite maintains excellent cyclic stability after four repeated degradation tests, with only a slight decrease in catalytic activity. Radical trapping experiments verify that ·O2- and h⁺ are the dominant active species responsible for RhB photodegradation. To further clarify the intrinsic enhancement mechanism at the atomic level, density functional theory (DFT) calculations were performed. The theoretical results intuitively reveal the electronic structure modulation and interfacial charge transfer behavior induced by Cu doping and heterojunction construction, confirming the establishment of a Type-II charge transfer pathway. The synergistic effect between Cu doping and heterojunction structure effectively broadens the visible-light absorption range and suppresses the recombination of photogenerated carriers. This work clarifies the structure-activity relationship of modified g-C3N4-based composites via combined experimental and theoretical investigations, providing a reliable reference for the design and preparation of high-efficiency visible-light photocatalysts.

articles.title: Precise and Scalable Synthesis of Dual-Atom Catalysts via Stepwise Microwave-Assisted Atomic Assembly
articles.abstract: Dual-atom catalysts (DACs) offer high atom utilization and tunable synergistic interactions, yet scalable synthesis with uniformity and atomic precision remains challenging. Here, we report a stepwise microwave-assisted atomic assembly strategy for constructing dual-atom sites on nitrogen-doped reduced graphene oxide (NG). Cu single-atom sites are first generated by microwave heating of Cu2+-anchored amine-functionalized graphene oxide (NH2-GO). Subsequent microwave irradiation induces localized electron enrichment around Cu sites, enabling adjacent metal ion anchoring (M = Fe, Co, Ni, Cu, and Zn) for DAC construction. This strategy enables gram-scale synthesis, demonstrating its scalability. CuCu-NG exhibits outstanding methane oxidation performance, yielding 8693 µmol gcat−1 h− 1 oxygenates with ~ 100% selectivity and a Cu-Cu dual-atom site-based turnover frequency of 218 h− 1. Mechanistic studies reveal that Cu-Cu coupling induces electronic redistribution and modulates d-band center, promoting H2O2 activation and C-H bond cleavage. This stepwise microwave-driven strategy provides a precise and scalable approach for DACs construction via atomic assembly.

articles.title: Solvated Br- Disrupting Interfacial Proton Transfer in Alkaline Water Oxidation
articles.abstract: For alkaline oxygen evolution reaction (OER) on Ni-based electrocatalysts, surface Ni(OH)2 moiety is transformed to NiOOH before OER, both of which involve proton-coupled electron transfer. Herein, we report the rapid, dramatic, and partially reversible poisoning of Br− toward the OER activity of Ni-based catalysts, and highlight the markedly different hydration effects of interfacial Br− and Cl− in modulating interfacial water orientation and proton transfer efficiency. Water molecules surrounding Br− preferentially orient with their H termini facing the anion, opposite to those in the Cl− hydration shell. This difference in hydration shell polarity propagates to the first interfacial water layer on the electrode, where Br− enrichment substantially reduces the population of O-down-oriented interfacial water during Ni(OH)2-to-NiOOH transformation and the subsequent OER process. Consequently, compared with pure or Cl−-containing electrolytes, interfacial Br− blocks efficient transfer of surface protons into the bulk solution and disfavors OH− adsorption on the electrode. The electrode thus suffers from low surface OH− density, resulting in rapid poisoning of OER kinetics. By revealing the opposing influences of interfacial Cl− and Br− on alkaline water oxidation, this work emphasizes the distinctive and non-negligible role of anion hydration behavior in modulating the microenvironment and governing OER kinetics.

articles.title: Comparative Energy Efficiency Analysis of PV–BESS Systems in Net Zero Energy Buildings Using PID and Model Predictive Control
articles.abstract: This study presents a comparative energy efficiency analysis of photovoltaic (PV) and battery energy storage system (BESS) systems in Net Zero Energy Buildings (NZEBs) using Proportional–Integral–Derivative (PID) and Model Predictive Control (MPC) strategies. Despite the increasing deployment of PV–BESS systems to support NZEB operation, the influence of real-time control strategies on energy efficiency and battery sustainability remains insufficiently explored. A MATLAB/Simulink model is developed using 5-minute resolution PV generation and load data from a university building in Malaysia to evaluate system performance under identical operating conditions.  The analysis focuses on key performance indicators including grid energy import, state-of-charge stability, depth of discharge, and battery cycling behaviour. Results show that the PID controller achieves lower grid energy import through aggressive battery utilisation, resulting in improved short-term energy efficiency. However, this leads to deeper discharge cycles and increased cycling intensity, indicating higher battery stress. In contrast, MPC provides a more balanced energy management approach by maintaining smoother battery operation and reducing degradation effects, albeit with slightly higher grid dependency.  These findings reveal a fundamental trade-off between short-term energy efficiency and long-term system sustainability. Overall, MPC demonstrates superior suitability for PV–BESS systems in NZEB applications, where both operational performance and battery longevity are critical.

articles.title: Woody Species Diversity and Conservation Value of Ethiopian Orthodox Church Forests: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
articles.title_zh: 埃塞俄比亚东正教教堂森林的木本物种多样性和保护价值：系统回顾和荟萃分析
articles.abstract: Background Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahido Church (EOTC) forests are small, isolated sacred groves that have persisted for centuries within a landscape that has been largely deforested. These church forests are increasingly recognized as critical refugia for the nation's native woody flora. However, the evidence base for their conservation value remains fragmented across numerous primary studies, and no comprehensive quantitative synthesis has been conducted to date. This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to synthesize empirical evidence on woody species diversity and conservation contributions of Ethiopian Orthodox Church forests.Methods A systematic literature search was conducted across Scopus, Web of Science, ScienceDirect, Google Scholar, and the Ethiopian National Academic Digital Repository (NADRE). Studies were included if they focused on EOTC church forests, monastery forests, or sacred groves; reported quantitative data on woody species composition, richness, or diversity; and provided species-level data. Data were extracted on study metadata, church forest characteristics, species composition (scientific name, family, local name, growth habit, origin status), and diversity metrics. All scientific names were standardized against the iNaturalist/Kew taxonomic backbone. A random-effects meta-analysis was performed to estimate pooled mean species richness per church forest. Heterogeneity was assessed using the I² statistic, and subgroup analyses were conducted by region and church forest type.Results A total of 14 studies met the inclusion criteria, representing approximately 80 church forests across four major regions of Ethiopia (Amhara, Oromia, Tigrai, and South Ethiopia) and Addis Ababa. A total of 330 woody species records were compiled, of which 310 were retained after excluding herbaceous species and unresolved taxa. These species belonged to approximately 85 families, with Fabaceae being the most species-rich family (n = 42), followed by Euphorbiaceae (n = 18), Asteraceae (n = 15), Malvaceae (n = 12), and Rubiaceae (n = 11). Of the 310 species, 180 (58.1%) were trees, 108 (34.8%) were shrubs, and 22 (7.1%) were lianas. A total of 280 species (90.3%) were indigenous, 27 (8.7%) were exotic, and 3 (1.0%) were endemic to Ethiopia. The most frequently recorded species were Juniperus procera, Olea europaea subsp. cuspidata, Croton macrostachyus, Cordia africana, Ficus sur, Carissa spinarum, and Maytenus arbutifolia. Species richness per church forest ranged from 7 to 166 species, with a mean of 62.4 species (SD = 38.7) across single-church studies. The random-effects meta-analysis estimated a pooled mean species richness of 74.8 species per church forest (95% CI: 58.3–91.4), with high heterogeneity (I² = 87.4%). Subgroup analysis revealed significant regional differences (p = 0.001), with the highest species richness in the Amhara region (mean = 84.2) and the lowest in the Tigrai region (mean = 52.7). Egger's regression test indicated no significant publication bias (p = 0.238).Conclusion This systematic review and meta-analysis demonstrates that Ethiopian Orthodox Church forests are critical in-situ conservation sites for the nation's native woody flora. The 310 woody species documented in this review represent at least 12.5% of Ethiopia's estimated woody plant diversity and 48% of its endemic species. The dominance of indigenous species (90.3%) confirms that traditional EOTC management practices are effective in conserving native biodiversity. These findings justify the formal recognition of church forests as priority sites for national biodiversity conservation and call for enhanced support for traditional management practices. Future research should prioritize floristic surveys in underrepresented regions and longitudinal monitoring of church forest dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 背景 埃塞俄比亚东正教特瓦希多教堂 (EOTC) 森林是小型、孤立的神圣树林，在森林大部分被砍伐的景观中已经存在了几个世纪。这些教堂森林越来越被认为是该国本土木本植物的重要避难所。然而，其保护价值的证据基础在众多初步研究中仍然支离破碎，迄今为止尚未进行全面的定量综合。本系统综述和荟萃分析旨在综合有关木本物种多样性和埃塞俄比亚东正教教堂森林保护贡献的经验证据。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 背景 埃塞俄比亚东正教特瓦希多教堂 (EOTC) 森林是小型、孤立的神圣树林，在森林大部分被砍伐的景观中已经存在了几个世纪。这些教堂森林越来越被认为是该国本土木本植物的重要避难所。然而，其保护价值的证据基础在众多初步研究中仍然支离破碎，迄今为止尚未进行全面的定量综合。本系统综述和荟萃分析旨在综合有关木本物种多样性和埃塞俄比亚东正教教堂森林保护贡献的经验证据。方法通过 Scopus、Web of Science、ScienceDirect、Google Scholar 和埃塞俄比亚国家学术数字存储库 (NADRE) 进行系统文献检索。如果研究重点是 EOTC 教堂森林、修道院森林或神圣树林，则纳入研究；报告木本物种组成、丰富度或多样性的定量数据；并提供了物种层面的数据。提取了研究元数据、教堂森林特征、物种组成（学名、科、地方名称、生长习性、起源状态）和多样性指标的数据。所有学名均根据 iNaturalist/Kew 分类学主干进行标准化。进行随机效应荟萃分析来估计每个教堂森林的汇总平均物种丰富度。使用 I² 统计数据评估异质性，并按地区和教会森林类型进行亚组分析。 结果 共有 14 项研究符合纳入标准，代表埃塞俄比亚四个主要地区（阿姆哈拉、奥罗米亚、提格莱和埃塞俄比亚南部）和亚的斯亚贝巴的约 80 个教会森林。共编制了330个木本物种记录，其中排除草本物种和未解决的类群后保留了310个。这些物种大约属于 85 个科，其中豆科植物种类最丰富 (n = 42)，其次是大戟科 (n = 18)、菊科 (n = 15)、锦葵科 (n = 12) 和茜草科 (n = 11)。 310种中，乔木180种（58.1%），灌木108种（34.8%），藤本植物22种（7.1%）。共有 280 种（90.3%）为本土物种，27 种（8.7%）为外来物种，3 种（1.0%）为埃塞俄比亚特有物种。最常记录的物种是 Juniperus procera、Olea europaea subsp。 cuspidata、Croton macrostachyus、Cordia africana、Ficus sur、Carissa spinarum 和 Maytenus arbutifolia。每个教堂森林的物种丰富度从 7 到 166 个物种不等，在单个教堂研究中平均有 62.4 个物种 (SD = 38.7)。随机效应荟萃分析估计，每个教堂森林的平均物种丰富度为 74.8 个物种（95% CI：58.3–91.4），具有较高的异质性（I² = 87.4%）。亚组分析显示显着的区域差异（p = 0.001），阿姆哈拉地区的物种丰富度最高（平均值 = 84.2），提格莱地区最低（平均值 = 52.7）。 Egger 的回归测试表明不存在显着的发表偏差 (p = 0.238)。 结论 这项系统评价和荟萃分析表明，埃塞俄比亚东正教教堂森林是该国本土木本植物区系的重要原地保护地。本次审查记录的 310 种木本物种至少占埃塞俄比亚估计木本植物多样性的 12.5% 和特有物种的 48%。本土物种占主导地位 (90.3%) 证实了传统的 EOTC 管理做法在保护本土生物多样性方面是有效的。这些发现证明正式承认教堂森林是国家生物多样性保护的优先地点是合理的，并呼吁加强对传统管理做法的支持。未来的研究应优先考虑代表性不足地区的植物区系调查和教堂森林动态的纵向监测。

articles.title: Unveiling the synergetic effectiveness of PTFE and MWCNTs as additives under steel-steel contact
articles.title_zh: 揭示 PTFE 和 MWCNT 作为钢-钢接触添加剂的协同效应
articles.abstract: Investigating the tribological performance of multiwalled carbon nanotubes (MWCNTs), polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE), and MWCNT/PTFE blended as lubricant additives in commercially available base jatropha oil (BJO) during body-body contact was conducted in this work. Using a four-ball tribo tester, the tribological tests were carried out on alloy-steel contacts. To assess the best performance, several concentrations of MWCNT, PTFE, and MWCNTs + PTFE nanomaterials were also varied. The tribological results showed that compared to the BJO, individual MWCNTs, and PTFE, the MWCNTs + PTFE blended nanomaterials in the BJO demonstrated significantly improved friction reduction and higher anti-wear capability. In terms of friction, wear resistance and surface roughness, 1 wt.% MWCNTs (40.08% and 0.33 mm) exhibited outstanding performance wear mitigation while 0.4 wt.% PTFE (49.77%) produced optimal coefficient of friction. In comparison to the BJO, the BJO with an ideal concentration of 0.8 wt.% MWCNTs + 0.4 wt.% PTFE nanoparticles significantly reduced the wear and friction coefficient by 44.43% and 55.11%, respectively. A 3D optical profilometer and a field emission scanning electron microscope were used to analyse the morphology and chemical content of the worn steel substrate surfaces, thus detected elements of the formulations as revealed by energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy.
articles.abstract_zh: 这项工作研究了多壁碳纳米管 (MWCNT)、聚四氟乙烯 (PTFE) 和 MWCNT/PTFE 作为润滑剂添加剂混合在市售基础麻风树油 (BJO) 中在身体接触过程中的摩擦学性能。使用四球摩擦试验机，对合金钢接触件进行摩擦学试验。为了评估最佳性能，还改变了 MWCNT、PTFE 和 MWCNTs + PTFE 纳米材料的几种浓度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 这项工作研究了多壁碳纳米管 (MWCNT)、聚四氟乙烯 (PTFE) 和 MWCNT/PTFE 作为润滑剂添加剂混合在市售基础麻风树油 (BJO) 中在身体接触过程中的摩擦学性能。使用四球摩擦试验机，对合金钢接触件进行摩擦学试验。为了评估最佳性能，还改变了 MWCNT、PTFE 和 MWCNTs + PTFE 纳米材料的几种浓度。摩擦学结果表明，与BJO、单独的MWCNT和PTFE相比，BJO中的MWCNTs + PTFE共混纳米材料表现出显着改善的减摩性能和更高的抗磨损能力。在摩擦、耐磨性和表面粗糙度方面，1 wt.% MWCNT（40.08% 和 0.33 mm）表现出出色的磨损缓解性能，而 0.4 wt.% PTFE（49.77%）则产生最佳摩擦系数。与BJO相比，理想浓度为0.8 wt.% MWCNTs++0.4 wt.% PTFE纳米粒子的BJO显着降低了磨损和摩擦系数，分别降低了44.43%和55.11%。使用 3D 光学轮廓仪和场发射扫描电子显微镜分析磨损钢基材表面的形态和化学含量，从而检测能量色散 X 射线光谱仪揭示的配方元素。

articles.title: Correlating Charge-Storage Kinetics, Quantum Capacitance, and Surface Charge Density in Bi2O2S: An Experimental-DFT Study
articles.title_zh: Bi2O2S 中电荷存储动力学、量子电容和表面电荷密度的关联：实验 DFT 研究
articles.abstract: Understanding charge storage in layered electrode materials requires distinguishing electrochemical kinetics from the intrinsic ability of the electrode to accumulate electronic charge. Here, phase-pure Bi2O2S was investigated using electrochemical measurements and density functional theory (DFT) calculations to establish this relationship. Cyclic voltammetry, galvanostatic charge-discharge, and electrochemical impedance spectroscopy revealed a strongly rate-dependent charge-storage response, with a specific capacitance of 866 F g⁻¹ at 1 A g⁻¹. The scan-rate dependence gave an average b-value of ~ 0.61, while Dunn analysis showed that diffusion-dependent processes dominate the charge-storage response. DFT calculations further demonstrated that surface modification alters the electronic charge-storage ability of Bi2O2S. The calculated quantum capacitance increased from 493.14 (:μ:Fcm⁻²) for the pristine surface to 638.75 (:μ:Fcm⁻²) following OH adsorption. Surface charge densities of 513.46 and 506.76 (:μ:C:cm⁻²) were obtained for K-top and K-hollow configurations, respectively. Experimental surface charge densities approached the DFT-derived range at higher current densities, whereas larger deviations at lower current densities indicate additional contributions from electrolyte-mediated and Faradaic processes. These results establish an experimental-DFT framework for relating rate-dependent electrochemical charge storage to the intrinsic electronic charge-accumulation behaviour of Bi2O2S.
articles.abstract_zh: 了解层状电极材料中的电荷存储需要将电化学动力学与电极积累电子电荷的固有能力区分开来。在这里，使用电化学测量和密度泛函理论 (DFT) 计算研究了相纯 Bi2O2S，以建立这种关系。循环伏安法、恒电流充放电和电化学阻抗谱揭示了强烈的速率依赖性电荷存储响应，在 1 A g-1 时比电容为 866 F g-1。扫描速率依赖性给出的平均 b 值为 ~ 0.61，而 Dunn 分析表明，扩散依赖性过程主导着电荷存储响应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 了解层状电极材料中的电荷存储需要将电化学动力学与电极积累电子电荷的固有能力区分开来。在这里，使用电化学测量和密度泛函理论 (DFT) 计算研究了相纯 Bi2O2S，以建立这种关系。循环伏安法、恒电流充放电和电化学阻抗谱揭示了强烈的速率依赖性电荷存储响应，在 1 A g-1 时比电容为 866 F g-1。扫描速率依赖性给出的平均 b 值为 ~ 0.61，而 Dunn 分析表明，扩散依赖性过程主导着电荷存储响应。 DFT 计算进一步表明，表面改性改变了 Bi2O2S 的电子电荷存储能力。计算出的量子电容从原始表面的 493.14 (:μ:Fcm-2) 增加到 OH 吸附后的 638.75 (:μ:Fcm-2)。 K-top 和 K-hollow 配置的表面电荷密度分别为 513.46 和 506.76 (:μ:C:cm -2 )。实验表面电荷密度在较高电流密度下接近 DFT 导出的范围，而在较低电流密度下较大偏差表明电解质介导和法拉第过程的额外贡献。这些结果建立了一个实验 DFT 框架，用于将速率依赖性电化学电荷存储与 Bi2O2S 固有的电子电荷积累行为联系起来。

articles.title: Spatio-temporal analysis of land subsidence in Rajshahi District, Bangladesh, using Sentinel-1 SBAS-InSAR
articles.title_zh: 使用 Sentinel-1 SBAS-InSAR 对孟加拉国拉杰沙希区地面沉降进行时空分析
articles.abstract: Land subsidence, a gradual downward movement of the land surface with respect to a fixed surface, is one of the most significant slow-onset geohazards in deltaic and fast urbanizing areas, and it poses a risk to the drainage, built infrastructure, and long-term sustainability of groundwater resources. This study describes the characteristics of land subsidence in northwesternBangladesh, an area that lies between the recent floodplain terraces of the Padma and the older Barind Tract. A total of 45 Sentinel-1A Single Look Complex (SLC) scenes acquired from 2021 to 2025 have been processed usingSmall Baseline Subset interferometric synthetic aperture radar (SBAS-InSAR) technique, which includes interferometric preprocessing, phase unwrapping, line of sight (LOS) displacement estimation, range-Doppler terrain correction,and time-series inversion. The resulting deformation field was analyzed in conjunction with surface geology and land use and land cover (LULC) data and groundwater records to determine spatial patterns and their possible controlling factors. The mean-velocity field shows a significant north-south gradient, with the mean line-of-sight (LOS) deformation rate in Boalia (south) being approximately -11.89 mm/year, and in the northern Barind upazilas, itis approximately -6.81 mm/year. The data used were only ascending-track Sentinel-1, and the deformation reported is along the radar line of sight, which is interpreted as the majority of subsidence being mostly vertical. Themost rapid subsidence falls along the southern floodplain and the urbanizing corridor, while the Barind Tract is comparatively stable. The water table at the Paba monitoring well dropped from approximately 11.55 m during January2024 to 15.70 m during May 2024, and the cumulative InSAR displacement values became increasingly negative; but this seasonal trend, from a single monitoring well, does not necessarily reflect it district-wide and does not imply a groundwater contribution. Together, the results indicate the comprehensive effect of groundwater stress, sediment compressibility, and land surface alteration. The study presents a district-scale deformation inventory and a transferable approach for prioritizing future deformation monitoring in the district of Rajshahi.
articles.abstract_zh: 地面沉降是地表相对于固定地表逐渐向下的运动，是三角洲和快速城市化地区最严重的缓发地质灾害之一，对排水、基础设施建设和地下水资源的长期可持续性构成风险。这项研究描述了孟加拉国西北部的地面沉降特征，该地区位于帕德玛最近的洪泛区阶地和旧巴林德地区之间。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 地面沉降是地表相对于固定地表逐渐向下的运动，是三角洲和快速城市化地区最严重的缓发地质灾害之一，对排水、基础设施建设和地下水资源的长期可持续性构成风险。这项研究描述了孟加拉国西北部的地面沉降特征，该地区位于帕德玛最近的洪泛区阶地和旧巴林德地区之间。使用小基线子集干涉合成孔径雷达（SBAS-InSAR）技术对2021年至2025年获取的总共45个Sentinel-1A单视复合体（SLC）场景进行了处理，其中包括干涉预处理、相位展开、视线（LOS）位移估计、距离多普勒地形校正和时间序列反演。结合地表地质、土地利用和土地覆盖 (LULC) 数据以及地下水记录对所得变形场进行分析，以确定空间模式及其可能的控制因素。平均速度场显示出明显的南北梯度，Boalia（南部）的平均视线（LOS）变形率约为-11.89毫米/年，而在巴林德乌帕齐拉斯北部，平均视线（LOS）变形率约为-6.81毫米/年。使用的数据仅是上升轨迹 Sentinel-1，报告的变形是沿着雷达视线的，这被解释为大部分沉降大多是垂直的。南部洪泛区和城市化走廊的沉降速度最快，而巴林德地区则相对稳定。帕巴监测井地下水位从2024年1月的约11.55 m下降到2024年5月的15.70 m，累计InSAR位移值越来越负；但来自单个监测井的季节性趋势并不一定反映整个地区的情况，也不意味着地下水的贡献。总之，这些结果表明了地下水压力、沉积物压缩性和地表变化的综合影响。该研究提出了一个地区规模的变形清单和一种可转移的方法，用于优先考虑拉杰沙希地区未来的变形监测。

articles.title: An analytical framework for modeling pollutant transport in a thermally stratified atmosphere with tempered fractional dynamics
articles.title_zh: 用缓和分数动力学模拟热分层大气中污染物传输的分析框架
articles.abstract: This study develops a two-dimensional, two-layer tempered time-fractional diffusion–reaction model for pollutant transport in a thermally stratified atmosphere. The model represents a temperature inversion through a lower turbulent layer and an upper stable layer, with continuity of pollutant concentration and diffusive flux imposed at the layer interface. An exact analytical solution is derived using eigenfunction expansion and the Laplace transform and is expressed in terms of coupled spatial eigenfunctions and tempered Mittag–Leffler functions. The existence, uniqueness, and Hadamard well-posedness of the model are established. Numerical analysis demonstrates that the fractional order strongly influences pollutant trapping and vertical redistribution, with smaller fractional orders producing greater pollutant accumulation beneath the inversion layer. The tempering parameter primarily controls concentration attenuation while preserving the characteristic layered spatial structure. Limiting-case analysis recovers both the classical diffusion–reaction equation and the standard fractional diffusion–reaction equation, confirming the consistency of the formulation. The framework is further illustrated using an idealized representation of the Kathmandu Valley, Nepal, where the results demonstrate the effects of anomalous diffusion and memory attenuation on pollutant retention under inversion conditions. The proposed model provides an analytical framework for investigating pollutant transport in vertically heterogeneous atmospheric environments and offers a basis for further data-driven and observational studies. Mathematical Subject Classification (MSC): 35R11, 35K57, 26A33, 76R50.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究开发了一种二维、两层回火时间分数扩散反应模型，用于热分层大气中污染物的传输。该模型表示通过下部湍流层和上部稳定层的温度反转，在层界面处施加污染物浓度和扩散通量的连续性。使用本征函数展开和拉普拉斯变换导出精确的解析解，并用耦合空间本征函数和缓和的 Mittag-Leffler 函数表示。模型的存在性、唯一性和Hadamard适定性成立。数值分析表明，分数阶强烈影响污染物捕获和垂直重新分布，较小的分数阶会在逆温层下方产生更大的污染物积累。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本研究开发了一种二维、两层回火时间分数扩散反应模型，用于热分层大气中污染物的传输。该模型表示通过下部湍流层和上部稳定层的温度反转，在层界面处施加污染物浓度和扩散通量的连续性。使用本征函数展开和拉普拉斯变换导出精确的解析解，并用耦合空间本征函数和缓和的 Mittag-Leffler 函数表示。模型的存在性、唯一性和Hadamard适定性成立。数值分析表明，分数阶强烈影响污染物捕获和垂直重新分布，较小的分数阶会在逆温层下方产生更大的污染物积累。回火参数主要控制浓度衰减，同时保留特征层状空间结构。极限情况分析恢复了经典扩散反应方程和标准分数扩散反应方程，证实了公式的一致性。使用尼泊尔加德满都谷地的理想化表示进一步说明了该框架，其中结果证明了反演条件下反常扩散和记忆衰减对污染物保留的影响。所提出的模型为研究垂直异质大气环境中的污染物传输提供了一个分析框架，并为进一步的数据驱动和观测研究提供了基础。数学科目分类 (MSC)：35R11、35K57、26A33、76R50。

articles.title: An in silico pipeline prioritizes candidate viral and bacterial mimics of hybrid insulin peptide autoantigens in type 1 diabetes
articles.title_zh: 计算机模拟管道优先考虑 1 型糖尿病中混合胰岛素肽自身抗原的候选病毒和细菌模拟物
articles.abstract: Hybrid insulin peptide (HIP) fusion junctions are not encoded in the germline proteome and may be absent during thymic negative selection, allowing microbial mimics to encounter T cells that escaped central tolerance. We present a structure-first screening pipeline for HIP mimics in type 1 diabetes, dataset-scoped negative results for motif yield and backbone RMSD, and ten peptides prioritized for experimental testing. Five reference HIP–TCR–MHC systems guided motif construction. The Swiss-Prot screen targeted ten taxa; a contemporary reconstruction contains reviewed sequences for nine. Of 1,092 motif hits, 55 passed predicted HLA-binding and AlphaFold 3 confidence filters and were modelled with TCRModel2 across five stochastic seeds. A composition-preserving shuffled-proteome control showed no aggregate motif-yield enrichment in the contemporary reconstruction (observed/null ratio 0.97). Candidate backbone RMSD had median 0.315 Å and interquartile range 0.274–0.389 Å; the three controls lay inside the candidate distribution at the 21.8th, 61.8th, and 81.8th percentiles. No single RMSD cutoff perfectly separated these sampled groups. A three-metric native-HIP gate using TCR–pMHC ipTM, interface-pLDDT, and ΔG retained 13 candidates; exclusion of three animal-associated Rotavirus A peptides left ten nominees. The nominated set was unchanged by dropping the redundant Kd criterion but was sensitive to the acceptance thresholds. Supporting comparisons found higher ipTM for 48 of 55 candidates, robust to nonparametric testing and multiple-comparison correction, but the candidate-only AlphaFold 3 pre-filter confounds that separation. RRNVATLQAENVTG from SARS-CoV-2 and SDLLKSVDSEEVRE from human rhinovirus 3 are co-priorities undergoing experimental testing: confidence and directional agreement favor the former, whereas interface energetics favor the latter. Their relative ordering is not statistically established. The pipeline supplies testable peptide–TCR–MHC combinations and documents the limits of motif-yield and backbone-similarity filters in these analyses.
articles.abstract_zh: 混合胰岛素肽 (HIP) 融合连接不在种系蛋白质组中编码，并且在胸腺阴性选择过程中可能不存在，从而允许微生物模拟物遇到逃脱中枢耐受的 T 细胞。我们提出了 1 型糖尿病中 HIP 模拟物的结构优先筛选流程、基序产量和骨架 RMSD 的数据集范围的阴性结果，以及优先用于实验测试的 10 种肽。五个参考 HIP-TCR-MHC 系统指导基序构建。 Swiss-Prot 筛选针对十个类群；现代重建包含九个经过审查的序列。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 混合胰岛素肽 (HIP) 融合连接不在种系蛋白质组中编码，并且在胸腺阴性选择过程中可能不存在，从而允许微生物模拟物遇到逃脱中枢耐受的 T 细胞。我们提出了 1 型糖尿病中 HIP 模拟物的结构优先筛选流程、基序产量和骨架 RMSD 的数据集范围的阴性结果，以及优先用于实验测试的 10 种肽。五个参考 HIP-TCR-MHC 系统指导基序构建。 Swiss-Prot 筛选针对十个类群；现代重建包含九个经过审查的序列。在 1,092 个主题命中中，有 55 个通过了预测的 HLA 结合和 AlphaFold 3 置信度过滤器，并使用 TCRModel2 在五个随机种子中进行建模。保留组成的改组蛋白质组对照显示在当代重建中没有聚合基序产量富集（观察/无效比率0.97）。候选骨干 RMSD 的中位数为 0.315 Å，四分位数范围为 0.274–0.389 Å；三个控件位于候选分布内的第 21.8、61.8 和 81.8 个百分位数。没有一个 RMSD 截止值可以完美地分离这些采样组。使用 TCR-pMHC ipTM、接口-pLDDT 和 ΔG 的三度量天然 HIP 门保留了 13 个候选者；排除三种与动物相关的轮状病毒 A 肽后，剩下 10 种被提名者。提名集通过删除冗余 Kd 标准而保持不变，但对接受阈值敏感。支持比较发现 55 个候选者中的 48 个具有较高的 ipTM，对非参数测试和多重比较校正具有鲁棒性，但仅候选者的 AlphaFold 3 预过滤器混淆了这种分离。来自 SARS-CoV-2 的 RRNVATLQAENVTG 和来自人鼻病毒 3 的 SDLLKSVDSEEVRE 是正在进行实验测试的共同优先事项：置信度和方向一致性有利于前者，而界面能量学有利于后者。它们的相对顺序没有统计确定。该管道提供可测试的肽-TCR-MHC 组合，并记录这些分析中基序产量和骨架相似性过滤器的限制。

articles.title: Optimize the Optimization: QPU-Efficient Quantum Graph Optimization through HPC-First Experimentation
articles.title_zh: 优化优化：通过 HPC 优先实验进行 QPU 高效量子图优化
articles.abstract: This paper studies how much Quantum Processing Unit (QPU) work can be avoided while preserving optimization quality in the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA). Using exact statevector simulation of QAOA on six graph optimization problems across seven graph families, three baselines are compared: a naive QPU-centric workflow with 30 quantum evaluations, a best-practice workflow that separates classical parameter optimization from a single QPU evaluation, and a classical-only solver. Six QPUminimization strategies are evaluated: preprocessing, pretraining, surrogate modeling, adaptive stopping, adaptive shots, and measurement reuse. Quality is measured using normalized expected value rather than the saturated best-of-b metric. The key findings are: the best-practice baseline achieves 510- to 2070-fold shot reduction across 8 to 16 qubits with at most 0.4 percent quality loss relative to naive QAOA; quality improves with QAOA depth from 0.82 to 0.91 while the gap between naive and best-practice remains negligible; four of six strategies achieve 100 percent quality retention at depth 3; quality is stable across graph families ranging from 0.77 to 0.87; and a structural predictor achieves perfect prediction on held-out graph families. These results support the thesis that the required QPU budget is a structured, predictable function of the problem instance and workflow policy, rather than a fixed algorithmic constant.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在量子近似优化算法 (QAOA) 中，在保持优化质量的同时可以避免多少量子处理单元 (QPU) 工作。对七个图族中的六个图优化问题使用 QAOA 的精确状态向量模拟，比较了三个基线：具有 30 个量子评估的以 QPU 为中心的简单工作流程、将经典参数优化与单个 QPU 评估分开的最佳实践工作流程以及纯经典求解器。评估了六种 QPU 最小化策略：预处理、预训练、代理建模、自适应停止、自适应镜头和测量重用。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文研究了在量子近似优化算法 (QAOA) 中，在保持优化质量的同时可以避免多少量子处理单元 (QPU) 工作。对七个图族中的六个图优化问题使用 QAOA 的精确状态向量模拟，比较了三个基线：具有 30 个量子评估的以 QPU 为中心的简单工作流程、将经典参数优化与单个 QPU 评估分开的最佳实践工作流程以及纯经典求解器。评估了六种 QPU 最小化策略：预处理、预训练、代理建模、自适应停止、自适应镜头和测量重用。质量是使用归一化期望值而不是饱和的 best-of-b 指标来衡量的。主要发现是：最佳实践基线在 8 至 16 个量子位上实现了 510 至 2070 倍的射击减少，相对于原始 QAOA 最多有 0.4% 的质量损失；随着 QAOA 深度从 0.82 提高到 0.91，质量得到提高，而原始实践和最佳实践之间的差距仍然可以忽略不计；六种策略中有四种在深度 3 处实现了 100% 的质量保留；各图族的质量在 0.77 到 0.87 之间保持稳定；结构预测器对保留的图族实现了完美的预测。这些结果支持这样的论点：所需的 QPU 预算是问题实例和工作流程策略的结构化、可预测函数，而不是固定的算法常数。

articles.title: Toward statistically optimal temperature extreme detection
articles.title_zh: 实现统计上最佳的温度极限检测
articles.abstract: Temperature extremes are commonly detected relative to climatological baselines estimated from short observational records, but the statistical reliability of these definitions remains poorly constrained. We develop an observation-constrained framework for objectively evaluating and optimizing temperature-extreme detection from finite records. Using marine heatwaves as a case study, we first compare uncorrected moving-window methods with anomaly-based corrected methods and show that the conventional approach introduces systematic biases in the mean occurrence and seasonal amplitude of detected events. The corrected formulation substantially reduces these biases. We then generate large ensembles of synthetic global sea surface temperature time series constrained by observations. These synthetic records reproduce key observed statistical properties, including seasonal structure, temporal persistence, and large-scale variability, and provide a long reference state against which detection choices can be tested. Defining optimality as the minimization of errors in marine-heatwave severity relative to this reference state, we show that optimal moving-window lengths vary with record length and regional dynamics. For satellite-era sea surface temperature records, a 31-day window provides a robust global choice. Applying optimized and conventional definitions to observations demonstrates that methodological choices can substantially alter inferred marine-heatwave metrics, with discrepancies increasing rapidly for shorter records and becoming largest for baselines shorter than about 15 years. The framework provides a reproducible basis for selecting detection methods and baseline parameters when temperature extremes must be defined from limited observations.
articles.abstract_zh: 极端温度通常是相对于根据短期观测记录估计的气候基线来检测的，但这些定义的统计可靠性仍然受到很少的限制。我们开发了一个观测约束框架，用于客观评估和优化有限记录中的极端温度检测。以海洋热浪为案例研究，我们首先将未校正的移动窗口方法与基于异常的校正方法进行比较，并表明传统方法在检测到的事件的平均发生率和季节性幅度方面引入了系统偏差。修正后的公式大大减少了这些偏差。然后，我们生成受观测限制的合成全球海面温度时间序列的大型集合。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 极端温度通常是相对于根据短期观测记录估计的气候基线来检测的，但这些定义的统计可靠性仍然受到很少的限制。我们开发了一个观测约束框架，用于客观评估和优化有限记录中的极端温度检测。以海洋热浪为案例研究，我们首先将未校正的移动窗口方法与基于异常的校正方法进行比较，并表明传统方法在检测到的事件的平均发生率和季节性幅度方面引入了系统偏差。修正后的公式大大减少了这些偏差。然后，我们生成受观测限制的合成全球海面温度时间序列的大型集合。这些合成记录再现了观察到的关键统计特性，包括季节性结构、时间持久性和大规模变异性，并提供了可以测试检测选择的长期参考状态。将最优性定义为相对于该参考状态的海洋热浪严重程度的误差最小化，我们表明最佳移动窗口长度随记录长度和区域动态变化。对于卫星时代的海面温度记录，31 天的窗口提供了稳健的全球选择。将优化的和传统的定义应用于观测表明，方法选择可以极大地改变推断的海洋热浪指标，对于较短的记录，差异会迅速增加，对于短于约 15 年的基线，差异会变得最大。当必须根据有限的观测来定义极端温度时，该框架为选择检测方法和基线参数提供了可重复的基础。

articles.title: Local chemical softness as a reactivity probe in mixed-valence compounds of class I and class II (Cr 2 F 5 and Co 3 O 4 ): The importance of site-dependent Hubbard U parameters
articles.abstract: In this work, we employ local softness as a key reactivity descriptor to systematically analyze class I (Cr 2 F 5 ) and class II (Co 3 O 4 ) mixed-valence materials. We evaluated the performance of several exchange–correlation functionals, including PBEsol, NCAPR (Nearly Correct Asymptotic Potential Revised), SCAN (Strongly Constrained and Appropriately Normed), and PBE+U (Perdew–Burke–Ernezerhof + Hubbard U), to determine their ability to resolve electron donor and acceptor capacities. Our results demonstrated that local softness is a powerful tool for distinguishing non-equivalent metallic centers and coexisting oxidation states. Crucially, we found that the PBE+U functional, utilizing site-specific Hubbard parameters (U) calculated via density functional perturbation theory, is the most robust approach, consistently reproducing the expected one-electron transfer. This study highlights the necessity of integrating local reactivity descriptors with differentiated Hubbard corrections for the accurate design and characterization of redox-active functional materials.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Noise-resilient training of machine learning interatomic potentials
articles.abstract: The accuracy of machine learning interatomic potentials suffers from reference data that contain numerical noise. Often originating from unconverged or inconsistent electronic-structure calculations, this noise is challenging to identify. Existing mitigation strategies, such as manual filtering or iterative refinement of outliers, require either substantial expert effort or multiple expensive retraining cycles, making them difficult to scale to large datasets. Here, we introduce a noise-resilient training method that automatically down-weighs noisy samples, without requiring additional reference calculations. By tracking the loss distribution via an exponential moving average, this unsupervised method identifies outliers throughout a single training run. We show that this approach prevents overfitting and matches the performance of iterative refinement baselines with significantly reduced overhead. The method’s effectiveness is demonstrated by recovering accurate physical observables for liquid water from unconverged reference data, including diffusion coefficients. Furthermore, we validate its scalability by training a foundation model for organic chemistry on the SPICE dataset, where it reduces both energy and force errors. This framework provides a simple, automated solution for training robust models on imperfect datasets across dataset sizes.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Building new non-empirical hybrid and double-hybrid density functionals from the TCA family of GGA expressions
articles.abstract: The Tognetti–Cortona–Adamo (TCA) correlation functional, and their subsequent variants, constitutes an important family of nonempirical generalized gradient approximations that have found successful applications in molecular and solid-state electronic structure calculations. In this work, we present a systematic assessment of the original TCA functional together with the revTCA, gracTCA, and transTCA variants within nonempirical hybrid (TCA0) and double-hybrid (TCA-QIDH) frameworks. Their performance is evaluated using the comprehensive GMTKN55 benchmark database, including more detailed analysis of the challenging MB16-43 and SIE4x4 subsets, as well as three different global performance metrics: WTMAD-2A, WTMAD-2B, and the recently proposed WTMAD-4. The results reveal a consistent improvement in accuracy upon ascending “Jacob’s ladder,” with the nonempirical double-hybrid models reducing the global errors by approximately a factor of 2–3 relative to their GGA counterparts. Among the semilocal functionals, the original TCA correlation provides the most balanced overall performance, while the differences among the various TCA-based models become much less pronounced at the double-hybrid level. Importantly, the relative ranking of the functionals is essentially unaffected by the choice of the WTMAD metric, demonstrating the robustness of the conclusions with respect to the weighting scheme adopted for the GMTKN55 database. The remaining deficiencies are associated with dispersion-dominated intermolecular interactions, highlighting the potential use of some long-range correlation corrections. Overall, this study confirms that the TCA functional, particularly when adopted in a double-hybrid scheme, constitutes a reliable and transferable framework for the development of accurate density functional approximations applicable to a broad range of chemical problems.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Cooling down trees for finite-temperature quantum dynamics: Purification within ML-MCTDH
articles.abstract: Simulating multidimensional quantum systems at finite temperature is inherently challenging as the system is no longer described by a single, pure-state wavefunction but by a density operator, squaring an already exponential scaling of the Hilbert space. Building upon the compact wavefunction ansatz of the multi-layer multiconfiguration time-dependent Hartree (ML-MCTDH) method, we present a new scheme for simulating finite-temperature quantum dynamics based on purification. Here, a density operator is mapped to a single ML-MCTDH wavefunction in an enlarged Hilbert space, comprising physical and auxiliary degrees of freedom. In the key step, one obtains a pure-state representation of the canonical density operator via imaginary time-propagation of the infinite-temperature state. The most important observation is that this state can be exactly decomposed as a Hartree product of maximally entangled combined modes, each combined mode consisting of a physical degree of freedom and its auxiliary counterpart. Through dynamically pruning the node ranks of the ML-tree during the “cool down” stage yields a compact finite-temperature wavefunction, thus accelerating the real-time propagation and enabling finite-temperature simulations of multidimensional, correlated molecular systems. Our method circumvents both intensive statistical sampling and costly tensor-decomposition of the full density-operator, while being broadly applicable to model Hamiltonians and general ab initio potential energy surfaces alike. Two applications of the method are presented: benchmark results on the thermal ground-state of H 2 O, as well as temperature-dependent infrared absorption spectra of the more challenging, floppy H3O2− anion.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Cluster-resolved associating-fluid theory for patch-geometry-dependent phase behavior in patchy particle mixtures
articles.abstract: The spatial arrangement of binding patches is a key design variable in programmable self-assembly because it determines which local motifs, network connectivities, and ordered states are accessible at equilibrium. Yet this geometric information is often lost in analytical theories of associating fluids, which typically distinguish particles by valence and interaction strength but not by local patch arrangement. This limitation is especially pronounced in quasi-two-dimensional and interfacial assemblies, where reduced coordination enhances the thermodynamic impact of steric and bonding constraints. Here, we present a cluster-resolved statistical associating fluid theory (SAFT-P) that promotes a chosen local cluster (superparticle) to an explicit thermodynamic degree of freedom. This approach preserves an analytical free-energy description while retaining local motif information. Using binary and ternary patchy mixtures on two-dimensional square lattices with identical valence but different patch arrangements, we show that local geometry can shift phase boundaries and bias demixing in ways that conventional monomer-level SAFT does not capture. In particular, SAFT-P predicts an excess-composition coexistence curve for a mixture of four-patch geometric isomers that conventional monomer-level SAFT cannot distinguish at matched valence and interaction strengths. We also test the theory on two-dimensional triangular and three-dimensional cubic lattices, which are included primarily to demonstrate the extensibility of the framework. SAFT-P therefore provides a practical route to connect nanoscale patch placement with mesoscopic assembly and macroscopic thermodynamics in patchy colloids and related interfacial assemblies.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Tensor train compression of molecular orbitals
articles.abstract: This work systematically investigates the tensor train (TT) compressibility of grid-represented Hartree–Fock (HF) and Density Functional Theory (DFT) orbitals across a range of molecular systems and TT formats (standard, quantized, and z-permuted quantized). To overcome limitations of current TT solvers, we employ a novel orthogonal tensor train cross approximation (TT-Cross-Orth) to decompose Hartree–Fock and DFT orbitals into TTs, enabling the study of large molecules. We find that the approximation error decreases exponentially with TT-rank for all systems studied and identify quantized tensor train as the most efficient TT format. Furthermore, we identify quasi-periodic and symmetric structures—including graphene, graphite layers, and polyalanine helices—as particularly favorable candidates exhibiting sublinear rank growth with system size. The tensor train approach automatically compresses quasi-symmetries and systems with symmetry defects, which makes it an attractive approach for materials science applications. TT-Cross-Orth enforces orthogonality during the decomposition, thereby improving stability and reducing the number of function evaluations compared to standard TT-Cross. These findings establish an empirical foundation for the development of scalable tensor network methods for HF and DFT.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Algorithmic construction and exploitation of topology-constrained refinement models for semiexperimental equilibrium structures
articles.abstract: Semiexperimental equilibrium structures combine high-resolution rotational spectroscopy with computed vibrational and electronic corrections. Although the least-squares solution is well established, constructing the inverse model still requires expert choices of coordinates, symmetry, constraints, and parameter classes. We introduce MORPHEUS (Model Optimization and Refinement from Perceived Hierarchy, Equivalence, Uncertainty, and Symmetry), a reproducible framework that makes these choices explicit and tests them against topology, symmetry, rank, isotope coverage, and external reference information. Starting from Cartesian geometry, it builds non-redundant internal coordinates and a refinement model before fitting. Two alternative active spaces are supported: symmetry-adapted generalized internal coordinates and symmetry-adapted Cartesian displacements with translations and rotations removed. Across acyclic, cyclic, planar, fused, bridged, and flexible molecules, the workflow recovers effective dimensions, residuals, structural parameters, and uncertainties without manual construction of the active coordinate model. In camphor, the chemically validated model gives sub-milliangstrom bond corrections and remains stable under basis changes, robust losses, predicate-width scans, and multi-starts. A 49-atom testosterone demonstration shows how QC geometries, accelerated vibrational corrections, and class-constrained refinement models can be combined when isotope-rich data are unavailable.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Hidden magnetic complexity in the simple van der Waals ferromagnet Ce₂Te₅
articles.abstract: Author(s): Rajesh Tripathi, D. T. Adroja, C. Ritter, Leandro Liborio, Manuel dos Santos Dias, Leon Petit, D. Khalyavin, Yu Liu, T. Shiroka, M. Aouane, S. Langridge, S. Patil, and Eric D. Bauer Van der Waals magnets provide a platform for exploring how reduced dimensionality, competing interactions, and local electronic degrees of freedom shape magnetic order. Here, the authors uncover hidden complexity in Ce 2 Te 5 , a layered f -electron ferromagnet whose apparently simple magnetic ground state masks a richer microscopic landscape. Although the system develops a single long-range ferromagnetic structure, the two inequivalent Ce sites play markedly different roles in the ordered state, and subtle magnetic changes persist well below the ordering temperature. The combination of site-selective magnetism and strong single-ion anisotropy highlights how competing interactions can produce complex low-temperature behavior without generating additional long-range magnetic phases. [Phys. Rev. Materials 10, 104407] Published Tue Oct 13, 2026

articles.title: Current-induced magnetization control in dipolar-coupled nanomagnet pairs and artificial spin ice
articles.abstract: Author(s): A. Pac, G. M. Macauley, J. A. Brock, A. Hrabec, A. Kurenkov, V. Raposo, E. Martinez, and L. J. Heyderman Here, the authors demonstrate how, in single nanomagnets and pairs of dipolar-coupled nanomagnets, the orientation of the applied electric current affects the threshold current density for field-free, all-electrical magnetization switching. Caprio A new capability of describing charge-exchange and transfer reactions by coupling different mass/charge partitions of the compound nucleus was developed within a b i n i t i o nuclear theory. We apply this capability to 7 Li, employing the no-core shell model with continuum for the first time in a calculation that couples three mass/charge partitions, namely 4 He + 3 H, 6 Li + n, and 6 He + p, using a chiral nucleon-nucleon interaction as input. Specifically, we investigate the effect of interpartition coupling on the spectrum of 7 Li and calculate cross sections for the 6 Li(n,p) 6 He, 6 He(p,n) 6 Li, and 6 He(p,t) 4 He reactions. The results show that coupling the relevant mass/charge partitions is important for a consistent description of the 7 Li spectrum and reaction cross sections, and offers a useful framework for interpreting existing data and guiding future measurements. articles.title: Holographic generative flows with AdS/CFT
articles.title_zh: 使用AdS/CFT的全息生成流
articles.abstract: Holography, in the form of the anti-de Sitter/conformal field theory correspondence, offers a natural setting for generative modelling. Data on a boundary manifold lifts into a higher-dimensional bulk through a propagator, and this extra dimension plays the role of a flow parameter. We exploit this structure to build Generative AdS (GenAdS), an approach to generative flow matching in which the dynamics are represented by the evolution of fields in AdS, together with a residual correction learned by a neural network. Boundary samples are encoded as scalar sources, transported into the bulk along the flow, and decoded after numerical integration. Our paradigm combines a Fourier-space encoding scheme for the data as AdS sources, a normalised radial phase space in which to stage the flow-matching dynamics, and a Klein–Gordon backbone to guide the flow. On a two-dimensional checkerboard benchmark, our experiments show that most of the benefit of GenAdS comes from the Fourier representation and convolutional architecture. However, when we remove momentum-channel regularisation, our most physics-informed GenAdS variant rivals the strongest physics-free control on boundary violation. On modified National Institute of Standards and Technology, GenAdS models remain close to a convolutional baseline on fidelity while achieving significantly higher recall at comparable precision, suggesting a fidelity-coverage trade-off. Our findings establish GenAdS as a physically interpretable and experimentally controllable framework for generative modelling, with many avenues for future extension.
articles.abstract_zh: 全息术以反德西特/共形场论对应的形式，为生成建模提供了自然环境。边界流形上的数据通过传播器提升到更高维的体积，并且这个额外的维度起到流量参数的作用。我们利用这种结构来构建生成式AdS （ GenAdS ） ，这是一种生成式流匹配的方法，其中动态由AdS中的场演化以及神经网络学习的残差校正表示。边界样本被编码为标量源，沿着流动传输到散装，并在数值积分后解码。我们的范例将数据的傅里叶空间编码方案作为AdS源，将归一化的径向相位空间与引导流的Klein-Gordon主干相结合。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 全息术以反德西特/共形场论对应的形式，为生成建模提供了自然环境。边界流形上的数据通过传播器提升到更高维的体积，并且这个额外的维度起到流量参数的作用。我们利用这种结构来构建生成式AdS （ GenAdS ） ，这是一种生成式流匹配的方法，其中动态由AdS中的场演化以及神经网络学习的残差校正表示。边界样本被编码为标量源，沿着流动传输到散装，并在数值积分后解码。我们的范例将数据的傅里叶空间编码方案作为AdS源，将归一化的径向相位空间与引导流的Klein-Gordon主干相结合。在二维棋盘基准上，我们的实验表明， GenAdS的大部分优势来自傅里叶表示和卷积架构。然而，当我们删除动量通道正则化时，我们最了解物理的GenAdS变体可以与最强的无物理边界违规控制相媲美。在修改后的美国国家标准与技术研究所上， GenAdS模型仍然接近保真度的卷积基线，同时以可比的精度实现更高的召回率，这表明保真度-覆盖率权衡。我们的研究结果确立了GenAdS作为生成建模的物理可解释和实验可控框架，有许多未来扩展的途径。

articles.title: Frustrated Topological Orbital Magnetism
articles.title_zh: 受挫拓扑轨道磁性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12557v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: By studying the interplay of geometric frustration with Aharonov-Bohm fluxes in three dimensions, we unveil a rich playground exhibiting topological semimetallic ground states with orbital magnetic dipole, quadrupole and ferrotoroidic orders, akin to spin patterns in classical spin ices - a class of phenomena which we dub frustrated topological orbital magnetism. We demonstrate that the ground-state toroidizations underpinned by non-Abelian topological nodal lines induce measurable current-induced Hall phenomena. We further find that distinct 2-in-2-out and 3-in-1-out frustrated orbital current patterns can be associated with topological Weyl node charges, and corresponding anisotropic linear and nonlinear Hall effects. We propose signatures for experimental validation of distinct frustrated topological orbital magnetic orders in candidate materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 通过研究几何挫折与三维Aharonov-Bohm通量的相互作用，我们揭示了一个丰富的游乐场，该游乐场表现出拓扑半金属基态，具有轨道磁偶极子，四极子和铁环面阶，类似于经典自旋冰中的自旋模式-我们称之为挫折拓扑轨道磁性的一类现象。我们证明了由非阿贝尔拓扑节点线支撑的基态环面化诱导了可测量的电流诱导霍尔现象。我们进一步发现，不同的2合2出和3合1挫折轨道电流模式可以与拓扑Weyl节点电荷以及相应的各向异性线性和非线性霍尔效应相关联。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 通过研究几何挫折与三维Aharonov-Bohm通量的相互作用，我们揭示了一个丰富的游乐场，该游乐场表现出拓扑半金属基态，具有轨道磁偶极子，四极子和铁环面阶，类似于经典自旋冰中的自旋模式-我们称之为挫折拓扑轨道磁性的一类现象。我们证明了由非阿贝尔拓扑节点线支撑的基态环面化诱导了可测量的电流诱导霍尔现象。我们进一步发现，不同的2合2出和3合1挫折轨道电流模式可以与拓扑Weyl节点电荷以及相应的各向异性线性和非线性霍尔效应相关联。我们提出了候选材料中不同受挫拓扑轨道磁序的实验验证特征。

articles.title: Odd-parity surface magnetism in a Kondo insulator
articles.title_zh: 近藤绝缘子中的奇偶表面磁性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12573v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We formulate a theory of spin-polarized tunneling between a nanowire tip of a topological Kondo insulator SmB₆ and the bi-collinear antiferromagnet Fe₁₊ₓTe in which the tunneling conductance which measures magnetic contrast changes sign when the bias is reversed. First we show that no time reversal symmetric tip, however strong its spin-momentum locking is, can produce experimentally observed magnetic contrast, which implies that time reversal must be broken at the tip surface. Within a mean-field treatment of the surface theory of SmB₆ we find that the interaction between conduction d-and f-electrons drives a surface phase transition near T_c ~10 K in which the time reversal odd component of the Kondo hybridization amplitude condenses in the same symmetry channel as an out-of-plane surface magnetization, gapping out the Dirac surface states. Below the transition the spin-resolved spectral function of each gapped surface Dirac cone is odd in energy about its node. For a charge-neutral apex the Fermi level lies between the surface Γ and X Dirac nodes, so the spin-polarized conductance, which is determined by this function at the bias energy, reverses its sign close to zero bias. This sign change is thus a spectroscopic signature of time reversal symmetry breaking on the surface of SmB6.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种自旋极化隧穿理论，该理论是在拓扑Kondo绝缘体的纳米线尖端SmB ”和双共线反铁磁体Fe”之间建立的，其中测量磁对比度变化的隧穿电导在偏置反转时是符号。首先我们表明，没有时间反转的对称尖端，无论其自旋动量锁定有多强，都可以产生实验观察到的磁对比度，这意味着尖端表面的时间反转必须被打破。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一种自旋极化隧穿理论，该理论是在拓扑Kondo绝缘体的纳米线尖端SmB ”和双共线反铁磁体Fe”之间建立的，其中测量磁对比度变化的隧穿电导在偏置反转时是符号。首先我们表明，没有时间反转的对称尖端，无论其自旋动量锁定有多强，都可以产生实验观察到的磁对比度，这意味着尖端表面的时间反转必须被打破。在SmB表面理论的平均场处理中，我们发现传导d和f电子之间的相互作用驱动了T_c ~ 10 K附近的表面相变，其中近藤杂交振幅的时间反转奇数分量与平面外表面磁化在同一对称通道中聚集，从而弥补了狄拉克表面状态。在跃迁下方，每个间隙表面狄拉克锥的自旋分辨光谱函数在其节点周围的能量为奇数。对于电荷中性顶点，费米能级位于表面Γ和X狄拉克节点之间，因此由该函数在偏置能量处确定的自旋极化电导将其符号反转接近零偏置。因此，这种符号变化是SmB6表面时间反转对称性断裂的光谱特征。

articles.title: Homogeneous to multi-scale inhomogeneous complex magnetism in Ba3LnRu2O9 (Ln = Gd, Ho), Revealed by muSR and Machine-Learned Muon-Site Calculations
articles.title_zh: 通过muSR和机器学习Muon-Site计算揭示的Ba3LnRu2O9 （ Ln = Gd ， Ho ）中的均匀至多尺度不均匀复合磁性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12726v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report a comprehensive muon spin rotation and relaxation (muSR) study of the hexagonal 6H-perovskites Ba3LnRu2O9 (Ln = Gd, Ho) to investigate the role of rare-earth anisotropy in the magnetic ground state of 4d-4f coupled systems. Ba3HoRu2O9 exhibits two successive magnetic orderings at TN1 = 46 K and TN2 = 10 K, leading to a complex magnetic ground state, whereas Ba3GdRu2O9, with Gd3+ (L = 0) S-state ions, shows primarily single magnetic ordering at TN = 14.5 K. Zero-field (ZF) and longitudinal-field (LF) muSR measurements reveal markedly different magnetic behavior despite their structural similarity. Ba3HoRu2O9 displays a multi-scale inhomogeneous magnetic state characterized by two-component exponential relaxation, broad local-field distributions, incomplete LF decoupling, and persistent spin dynamics. The muSR results identify two characteristic magnetic energy scales near 46 and 10 K, associated with correlated Ru-Ho interactions and quasistatic magnetic ordering, respectively. Redfield analysis further demonstrates strong local magnetic fields and distributed spin fluctuation timescales, confirming magnetic inhomogeneity. Machine-learning-assisted muon-site and dipolar-field calculations show that the broad field distribution naturally arises from muons sensing distinct coexisting magnetic domains at different structural sites. In contrast, Ba3GdRu2O9 exhibits a comparatively homogeneous antiferromagnetic ground state below 14.5 K, with Gaussian relaxation consistent with a narrow static field distribution. These results establish that the rare-earth ion in Ba3LnRu2O9 is a powerful tuning parameter, driving the ground state from homogeneous to complex, multi-scale inhomogeneous behavior through competing 4d-4f magnetic interactions.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们报告了六方6H-钙钛矿Ba3LnRu2O9 （ Ln = Gd ， Ho ）的综合介子自旋旋转和弛豫（ muSR ）研究，以研究稀土各向异性在4d-4f耦合系统磁基态中的作用。Ba3HoRu2O9在TN1 = 46 K和TN2 = 10 K时表现出两个连续的磁有序，导致复杂的磁基态，而Ba3GdRu2O9在Gd3 + (L = 0) S态离子下，在TN = 14.5 K时主要表现出单一的磁有序。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们报告了六方6H-钙钛矿Ba3LnRu2O9 （ Ln = Gd ， Ho ）的综合介子自旋旋转和弛豫（ muSR ）研究，以研究稀土各向异性在4d-4f耦合系统磁基态中的作用。Ba3HoRu2O9在TN1 = 46 K和TN2 = 10 K时表现出两个连续的磁有序，导致复杂的磁基态，而Ba3GdRu2O9在Gd3 + (L = 0) S态离子下，在TN = 14.5 K时主要表现出单一的磁有序。零场（ ZF ）和纵场（ LF ） muSR测量显示，尽管它们的结构相似，但磁性行为却明显不同。Ba3HoRu2O9呈现多尺度不均匀磁态，其特征为双分量指数弛豫、广域分布、不完全LF解耦和持续自旋动力学。MuSR结果确定了46和10 K附近的两个特征磁能量尺度，分别与相关的Ru-Ho相互作用和准静态磁有序性相关。雷德菲尔德分析进一步证明了强大的局部磁场和分布式自旋波动时间尺度，证实了磁不均匀性。机器学习辅助μ子位点和偶极场计算表明，宽场分布自然源于μ子在不同结构位点感应到不同的共存磁畴。相比之下， Ba3GdRu2O9在14.5 K以下表现出相对均匀的反铁磁基态，高斯弛豫与狭窄的静态场分布一致。这些结果表明， Ba3LnRu2O9中的稀土离子是一个强大的调谐参数，通过竞争性的4d-4f磁相互作用，将基态从均匀驱动到复杂、多尺度的不均匀行为。

articles.title: The quantum geometry of the chemical bond
articles.title_zh: 化学键的量子几何
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12746v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electronic properties of materials depend both on band energies and quantum geometry of electronic states. We relate bonding indices to the quantum geometric tensor (QGT), showing how chemical bonding dictates the momentum-space texture of bands, bridging chemical and physical descriptions of solids. We show the QGT decomposed into the three center bond index, weighted by their oriented area. Resolving these contributions by orbital pair reveals the donor--acceptor character that distinguish ionic, covalent, hypervalent, and metavalent bonding. We identify the bonding pattern for topology in materials: noncollinear three center bonds, which are the source of Berry curvature in solids. Bond fluctuation can be directly linked to electromagnetic response by resolving their energy spectrum, opening a quantitative route towards the design of physical properties of materials from bonding motifs.
articles.abstract_zh: 材料的电子特性既取决于能带能量，也取决于电子态的量子几何。我们将键合指数与量子几何张量（ QGT ）相关联，展示化学键合如何决定带的动量空间纹理，桥接固体的化学和物理描述。我们展示了QGT分解为三个中心债券指数，由其定向区域加权。通过轨道对解决这些贡献揭示了区分离子、共价、高价和亚价键的供体-受体特征。我们确定了材料中拓扑的键合模式：非共线三中心键，这是固体中Berry曲率的来源。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 材料的电子特性既取决于能带能量，也取决于电子态的量子几何。我们将键合指数与量子几何张量（ QGT ）相关联，展示化学键合如何决定带的动量空间纹理，桥接固体的化学和物理描述。我们展示了QGT分解为三个中心债券指数，由其定向区域加权。通过轨道对解决这些贡献揭示了区分离子、共价、高价和亚价键的供体-受体特征。我们确定了材料中拓扑的键合模式：非共线三中心键，这是固体中Berry曲率的来源。粘结波动可以通过解析其能谱直接与电磁响应联系起来，从而为从粘结基序设计材料的物理特性开辟一条定量路线。

articles.title: Nonlocal Josephson coupling and current redistribution in a large-area graphene multiterminal Josephson junction
articles.title_zh: 大面积石墨烯多端子约瑟夫森结中的非局部约瑟夫森耦合和电流再分布
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12753v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multiterminal Josephson junctions (MTJJs) extend conventional two-terminal Josephson physics to devices defined by multiple superconducting phases, where rich phenomena have been predicted. However, in conventional MTJJs, superconducting transport is often dominated by local coupling between neighboring leads, obscuring physics that goes beyond simple connectivity. Here, we realize a multiterminal Josephson network in a graphene Hall bar geometry with micron-scale dimensions, enabling substantial nonlocal coupling between distant terminals. Our key observation is a pronounced negative differential longitudinal resistance (NDLR) in the four-probe response near switching currents, while no such feature appears in two-terminal measurements. We reproduce the NDLR response with a network containing the interplay between two distinct forms of nonlocality: nonlocal Josephson coupling, which determines the switching sequence of the superconducting network, and nonlocal normal-state conductance, which redistributes current after different regions switch. Our results highlight the potential of the emergent NDLR for characterizing superconductor--semiconductor hybrid systems and for nonlinear circuits. Further, this Josephson Hall bar geometry provides a platform for exploring the interplay between mesoscopic superconductivity and many-body ground states in graphene-based heterostructures.
articles.abstract_zh: 多端约瑟夫森结（ MTJJ ）将传统的双端约瑟夫森物理学扩展到由多个超导相定义的器件，在这些器件中已经预测到丰富的现象。然而，在传统的MTJJ中，超导传输通常由相邻引线之间的局部耦合主导，模糊了超出简单连接的物理特性。在这里，我们实现了微米级尺寸的石墨烯霍尔棒几何结构中的多端子约瑟夫森网络，从而实现了远端子之间的实质性非局部耦合。我们的关键观察结果是，在接近开关电流的四探针响应中出现明显的负微分纵向电阻（ NDLR ） ，而在两端测量中则没有出现这样的特征。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 多端约瑟夫森结（ MTJJ ）将传统的双端约瑟夫森物理学扩展到由多个超导相定义的器件，在这些器件中已经预测到丰富的现象。然而，在传统的MTJJ中，超导传输通常由相邻引线之间的局部耦合主导，模糊了超出简单连接的物理特性。在这里，我们实现了微米级尺寸的石墨烯霍尔棒几何结构中的多端子约瑟夫森网络，从而实现了远端子之间的实质性非局部耦合。我们的关键观察结果是，在接近开关电流的四探针响应中出现明显的负微分纵向电阻（ NDLR ） ，而在两端测量中则没有出现这样的特征。我们使用包含两种不同形式非局部性之间相互作用的网络再现NDLR响应：非局部约瑟夫森耦合，确定超导网络的切换顺序；非局部正常状态电导，在不同区域切换后重新分配电流。我们的研究结果突出了新兴的NDLR在表征超导-半导体混合系统和非线性电路方面的潜力。此外，这种约瑟夫森霍尔棒几何结构为探索石墨烯基异质结构中介观超导性和多体基态之间的相互作用提供了一个平台。

articles.title: Dynamic Chemical Changes of Ti3C2Tx MXenes in Halide Perovskite Precursor Environments
articles.title_zh: 卤化物钙钛矿前驱体环境中Ti3C2Tx MXenes的动态化学变化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12771v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The integration of two-dimensional Ti3C2Tx MXenes into Halide Perovskite (HaP) optoelectronics has shown immense potential for enhancing device performance, yet the fundamental chemical interactions within the precursor ink (a critical stage determining the final material state) remain largely unexplored. This study presents a comprehensive investigation into the chemical stability and surface evolution of Ti3C2Tx MXenes when exposed to the individual and combined components of a model methylammonium lead iodide (MAPbI3) solution. By combining detailed X-ray Photoelectron Spectroscopy (XPS) analysis with Density Functional Theory (DFT) calculations, we decouple the complex interactions between MXenes and the ink constituents. We demonstrate that elemental iodine (I2) and polyiodides (In-) act as aggressive oxidizers, triggering rapid degradation and dissolution of the MXene flakes. Conversely, lead iodide (PbI2) induces a slower oxidation process driven by the strong adsorption of Pb2+ ions onto oxygen terminated sites. In stark contrast, methylammonium iodide (MAI) exhibits a stabilizing effect: it adsorbs onto the MXene surface via hydrogen bonding, effectively passivating the flakes and retarding degradation. In addition, our results reveal that the sequence of precursor addition governs the MXene surface state, requiring extra caution, but also enabling further tunability. These findings provide a critical view on how MXene integration with materials, in general, and HaP in particular, should be perceived, providing a fundamental for their rational engineering.
articles.abstract_zh: 将二维Ti3C2Tx MXenes集成到卤化物钙钛矿（ HaP ）光电子学中已显示出增强器件性能的巨大潜力，但前体油墨（决定最终材料状态的关键阶段）中的基本化学相互作用在很大程度上仍未得到探索。本研究对Ti3C2Tx MXenes暴露于模型甲基碘化铅（ MAPbI3 ）溶液的单个和组合组分时的化学稳定性和表面演变进行了全面研究。通过将详细的X射线光电子能谱（ XPS ）分析与密度泛函理论（ DFT ）计算相结合，我们解耦了MXenes与油墨成分之间的复杂相互作用。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 将二维Ti3C2Tx MXenes集成到卤化物钙钛矿（ HaP ）光电子学中已显示出增强器件性能的巨大潜力，但前体油墨（决定最终材料状态的关键阶段）中的基本化学相互作用在很大程度上仍未得到探索。本研究对Ti3C2Tx MXenes暴露于模型甲基碘化铅（ MAPbI3 ）溶液的单个和组合组分时的化学稳定性和表面演变进行了全面研究。通过将详细的X射线光电子能谱（ XPS ）分析与密度泛函理论（ DFT ）计算相结合，我们解耦了MXenes与油墨成分之间的复杂相互作用。我们证明元素碘（ I2 ）和多碘化物（ In- ）充当侵蚀性氧化剂，引发MXene薄片的快速降解和溶解。相反，碘化铅（ PbI2 ）诱导较慢的氧化过程，其驱动因素是Pb2 +离子强烈吸附到氧封端位点上。与此形成鲜明对比的是，甲基碘化铵（ MAI ）表现出稳定作用：它通过氢键吸附在MXene表面，有效地钝化薄片并阻止降解。此外，我们的研究结果表明，前体添加序列控制着MXene的表面状态，需要格外谨慎，但也实现了进一步的可调性。这些发现为如何看待MXene与材料的集成，特别是与HaP的集成提供了批判性视角，为它们的合理工程提供了基础。

articles.title: Realizing Two-Dimensional Altermagnets with 100% Spin Polarization along the [110] Direction in Ambidentate-Ligand Based Square Organometallic Lattices
articles.title_zh: 在基于Ambidentate-Ligand的正方形有机金属晶格中实现沿[110]方向具有100 ％自旋极化的二维Altermagnets
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12791v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnetism, as a novel magnetic paradigm, not only possesses a zero net magnetic moment, but also exhibits a substantial nonrelativistic spin-splitting effect. Currently, developing a simple and experimentally feasible method for designing altermagnets is eagerly pursued. Moreover, achieving 100% spin polarization along certain directions in valence or conduction bands for altermagnets remains challenging. To address these issues, based on a tight-binding model, we propose a viable chemical strategy for constructing organometallic altermagnets by using ambidentate ligands. Furthermore, in these organometallic altermagnets, direction-dependent 100% spin polarization along the [110] direction in band edges can be induced via the coexistence of altermagnetically spin-split dispersive and flat bands, where the flat band suppresses electron transport in one spin channel and the dispersive band enables conduction in the other spin channel. Then, via first-principles calculations, a screening of 90 two-dimensional ambidentate-ligand based square organometallic lattices leads to the identification of three altermagnetic materials, namely Fe(taz)2Cl2 (taz = 1,2,4- triazine), Co(app)2Cl2, and Fe(app)2Cl2 (app = 1,4-azaphosphinine), all of which possess 100% spin polarization along the [110] direction in valence bands, as well as notable piezomagnetic behavior. This study paves the way for achieving direction-dependent fully spin-polarization in altermagnetic materials.

articles.title: Quadratic XY-anisotropy correction to the spontaneous staggered magnetization of the gapped XYZ spin-1/2 chain
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12798v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The staggered order parameter of the gapped XYZ spin-1/2 chain follows from the eight-vertex solution, but in elliptic variables that fix the Hamiltonian couplings only implicitly. We derive a closed form for the coefficient governing the leading quadratic response of the spontaneous staggered magnetization to the XY anisotropy at fixed longitudinal anisotropy in the gapped antiferromagnetic regime. Starting from the Baxter--Kelland--Jimbo--Miwa--Nakayashiki polarization formula, we show that at fixed longitudinal anisotropy both the modular nome and the crossing-parameter variable of the formula move with the XY anisotropy, and that the motion of the crossing-parameter variable reverses the sign of the expansion at fixed elliptic variables. The coefficient is a rational term plus a Lambert series. It is strictly negative and bounded above by a rational function of the longitudinal anisotropy, to which it is asymptotic in the Ising limit. At the isotropic point it diverges as the inverse five-halves power of the distance to that point, and since the Lambert sum has an asymptotic expansion with exponentially small remainder, the subleading terms of the divergence also follow in closed form. When the XY anisotropy vanishes as the five-fourths power of the distance to the isotropic point, the ratio of the perturbed to the unperturbed order parameter tends to a Gaussian in the scaling variable, and the quadratic truncation is controlled when that variable is small. A fourth-order perturbative calculation in the spin chain, with no input from the eight-vertex solution, reproduces the leading strong-coupling behaviour, and infinite-DMRG calculations at four anisotropies in the gapped regime are consistent with the closed form.

articles.title: Drude, Where's My Charge? End-to-End Learning of Polarizable Drude Force Fields for Polymer Electrolytes
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12799v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Molecular dynamics simulations of solid polymer electrolytes require force fields that are fast enough to converge ion transport over hundreds of nanoseconds, yet accurately describe the ion-polymer interactions that govern it. Fixed-charge force fields meet the first requirement but neglect electronic polarization, an effect often approximated by scaling ionic charges using empirically chosen factors. Here we present AutoDrude, a differentiable framework that parametrizes polarizable Drude force fields directly from DFT energies, forces, and dipoles, with no empirical tuning and at only 1.20 times the cost of a fixed-charge simulation. For PEO-LiTFSI, the dipole-constrained (hard-constraint) AutoDrude model reproduces the experimental ionic conductivity as accurately as the best charge-scaled model (17% versus 16% mean absolute percentage error). We compare the polarizable forcefield to fixed charge ones models by fitting a fixed charge model. Unlike the charge-scaled models tested here, however, AutoDrude also reproduces the dilute-limit cation transference number, its increase with salt concentration, and the absence of Li-TFSI contact ion pairs at low concentration. A penalty-based (soft-constraint) variant yields a closer fit to the DFT reference yet underestimates the conductivity by up to an order of magnitude, demonstrating that closer agreement with DFT training data alone does not guarantee accurate ion transport. These results indicate that although charge scaling can reproduce ionic conductivity the explicit inclusion of polarization is necessary to capture the concentration dependence of cation transport in PEO-LiTFSI.

articles.title: Ground-State Phase Diagram of the Effective Model with Antiferromagnetic Nearest-Neighbor and Ferromagnetic Next-Nearest-Neighbor Interactions in 1/1 Periodic Approximants to Icosahedral Quasicrystals
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12840v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: By performing complete enumeration of all configurations of magnetic moments, we have determined the ground-state phase diagram of the effective model with antiferromagnetic nearest-neighbor interactions J₁ and ferromagnetic next-nearest-neighbor interactions J₂ on the 1/1 periodic approximant to icosahedral quasicrystal. Depending on the ratio of J₂/J₁ and the magnetic anisotropy arising from the crystalline electric field, various non-collinear ferrimagnetic orders and antiferromagnetic orders are shown to be stabilized, whose magnetic space groups are identified as Rbar3, C2'/m', Pm'm'2 and Iᵣₘ Pm'bar3'. We have revealed the topological as well as magnetic property of each ground state with degeneracy, which is useful to understand experimental observations of magnetic structures and domains in the rare-earth-based 1/1 approximants.

articles.title: Room-temperature ferroelectric p-wave magnet
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12892v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: P -wave magnets exhibit odd-parity spin polarization in momentum space while retaining zero net magnetization, offering a promising route toward nonrelativistic spintronics. Previously reported p-wave magnets based on combined time-reversal and lattice-translation symmetry, Tt, have thus far exhibited ordering temperatures below the liquid-nitrogen range. Here, we demonstrate a distinct route to a pristine p-wave magnetism that does not require T t symmetry, and instead is based on incommensurate spin-spiral order. Specifically, the cycloidal magnetic structure of the multiferroic BiFeO3 (BFO) intrinsically realizes p-wave magnetism coexisting with ferroelectric polarization at room temperature. Combining symmetry analysis, density-functional-theory calculations, and circular photogalvanic-effect (CPGE) measurements, we find a large nonrelativistic spin splitting of approximately 100 meV associated with the cycloidal order.
