articles.title: Bio-based benzoxazine electrically conductive adhesives for sustainable and epoxy-free hybrid printed electronics
articles.title_zh: 用于可持续、无环氧树脂混合印刷电子产品的生物基苯并恶嗪导电粘合剂
articles.abstract: Electrically conductive adhesives (ECAs) are critical for the assembly of surface-mounted devices in printed and hybrid electronics; however, conventional epoxy-based systems are associated with toxicity and limited working life. In this work, we present a benzoxazine-based anisotropic conductive adhesive (ACA) derived from a bio-based diphenolic acid benzoxazine (DPA-Bz) copolymerized with 1,12-diaminododecane (DIADO), combined with environmentally preferable metallic fillers. The developed system enables reduced curing temperatures (~ 150°C) compared to conventional benzoxazines, improving compatibility with temperature-sensitive substrates. From an electrical standpoint, the optimized Cu-based ACA exhibits low contact resistance and clear anisotropic conductivity with electrical performance comparable to a commercial epoxy-based adhesive. Furthermore, the ACA maintains stable electrical behavior under accelerated aging (85°C / 85% RH) and thermal shock testing, indicating robust reliability under environmental stress. Finally, life cycle assessment reveals a reduced global warming potential (5.48 kg CO₂/kg) compared to a reference Ni-based adhesive (6.27 kg CO₂/kg), with further reduction potential through solvent-free formulations and increased recycled copper content. The presented benzoxazine-based ACA achieves comparable electrical and mechanical performance to commercial systems while delivering improved environmental performance and reduced toxicity, highlighting its potential as a sustainable alternative for next-generation electronic assembly and opening the path towards greener electronics.
articles.abstract_zh: 导电粘合剂 (ECA) 对于印刷和混合电子产品中表面安装器件的组装至关重要；然而，传统的环氧基系统具有毒性且使用寿命有限。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种基于苯并恶嗪的各向异性导电粘合剂（ACA），其源自生物基二酚酸苯并恶嗪（DPA-Bz）与1,12-二氨基十二烷（DIADO）的共聚，并结合了环保的金属填料。与传统的苯并恶嗪相比，开发的系统能够降低固化温度（~ 150°C），从而提高与温度敏感基材的相容性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 导电粘合剂 (ECA) 对于印刷和混合电子产品中表面安装器件的组装至关重要；然而，传统的环氧基系统具有毒性且使用寿命有限。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种基于苯并恶嗪的各向异性导电粘合剂（ACA），其源自生物基二酚酸苯并恶嗪（DPA-Bz）与1,12-二氨基十二烷（DIADO）的共聚，并结合了环保的金属填料。与传统的苯并恶嗪相比，开发的系统能够降低固化温度（~ 150°C），从而提高与温度敏感基材的相容性。从电气角度来看，优化的铜基 ACA 具有低接触电阻和明显的各向异性导电性，其电气性能可与商用环氧基粘合剂相媲美。此外，ACA 在加速老化（85°C / 85% RH）和热冲击测试下保持稳定的电气行为，表明在环境压力下具有强大的可靠性。最后，生命周期评估显示，与参考镍基粘合剂（6.27 千克二氧化碳/千克）相比，全球变暖潜力降低（5.48 千克二氧化碳/千克），并且通过无溶剂配方和增加回收铜含量进一步降低了减排潜力。所提出的基于苯并恶嗪的 ACA 实现了与商业系统相当的电气和机械性能，同时改善了环境性能并降低了毒性，凸显了其作为下一代电子组装的可持续替代品的潜力，并为绿色电子产品开辟了道路。

articles.title: Unsteady MHD flow of Heat generating / absorbing fluid through porous plate with variable temperature and concentration in a slip flow regime
articles.title_zh: 发热/吸热流体通过多孔板的不稳定 MHD 流动，温度和浓度在滑流状态下变化
articles.abstract: The present study investigates the unsteady magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) free convective heat and mass transfer flow via an infinite vertical porous plate immersed in a porous material under slip flow circumstances of a viscous, incompressible, electrically conducting fluid. The plate is subjected to a consistent transverse magnetic field. The perturbation approach provides an analytical solution to the non-dimensional governing equations. Physical parameters that affect velocity, temperature, and concentration distributions are graphically analyzed and thoroughly discussed. These parameters include thermal Grashof number, modified Grashof number, magnetic parameter, permeability parameter, radiation parameter, heat generation/absorption, Prandtl number, Schmidt number, chemical reaction parameter, as well as Soret number. According to the findings, the velocity profile rises as the buoyancy and permeability parameters increase, while it falls with the magnetic parameter and slip effects due to the resistive Lorentz force. Thermal radiation and heat source significantly enhance the temperature distribution and thermal boundary layer thickness, while higher Prandtl number reduces the temperature field because of lower thermal diffusivity. The concentration profile decreases with increasing Schmidt number and chemical reaction parameter, whereas it increases with increasing Soret number due to enhanced thermal diffusion effects. The effects of the governing parameters on engineering quantities such as skin friction coefficient, Nusselt number, and Sherwood number are also discussed. The present investigation provides valuable insight into radiative MHD transport phenomena through porous media and has potential applications in geothermal engineering, chemical reactors, nuclear reactor cooling systems, petroleum engineering, energy transport systems, and thermal insulation technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究研究了在粘性、不可压缩、导电流体的滑流情况下，通过浸入多孔材料中的无限垂直多孔板进行的非定常磁流体动力学（MHD）自由对流传热和传质。该板受到一致的横向磁场的作用。扰动方法为无量纲控制方程提供了解析解。对影响速度、温度和浓度分布的物理参数进行了图形分析和深入讨论。这些参数包括热格拉霍夫数、修正格拉霍夫数、磁参数、磁导率参数、辐射参数、热量产生/吸收、普朗特数、施密特数、化学反应参数以及索雷特数。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本研究研究了在粘性、不可压缩、导电流体的滑流情况下，通过浸入多孔材料中的无限垂直多孔板进行的非定常磁流体动力学（MHD）自由对流传热和传质。该板受到一致的横向磁场的作用。扰动方法为无量纲控制方程提供了解析解。对影响速度、温度和浓度分布的物理参数进行了图形分析和深入讨论。这些参数包括热格拉霍夫数、修正格拉霍夫数、磁参数、磁导率参数、辐射参数、热量产生/吸收、普朗特数、施密特数、化学反应参数以及索雷特数。根据研究结果，速度剖面随着浮力和磁导率参数的增加而上升，而随着磁参数和由于洛伦兹力的阻性滑移效应而下降。热辐射和热源显着增强了温度分布和热边界层厚度，而较高的普朗特数由于较低的热扩散率而减小了温度场。浓度分布随着施密特数和化学反应参数的增加而减小，而由于热扩散效应的增强，浓度分布随着索雷特数的增加而增加。还讨论了控制参数对表面摩擦系数、努塞尔数和舍伍德数等工程量的影响。目前的研究为通过多孔介质的辐射MHD传输现象提供了有价值的见解，并且在地热工程、化学反应堆、核反应堆冷却系统、石油工程、能量传输系统和隔热技术方面具有潜在的应用。

articles.title: Assessing Climate Change Impacts on Wetland Vegetation and Water Resources through Rainfall-Driven Ecohydrological Indices: Satellite-based evidence from the Kabartal Wetland Region, Bihar
articles.title_zh: 通过降雨驱动的生态水文指数评估气候变化对湿地植被和水资源的影响：来自比哈尔邦卡巴特尔湿地地区的卫星证据
articles.abstract: Wetlands are dynamic socio-ecological systems whose persistence and ecological functioning are strongly regulated by hydroclimatic variability. Changes in precipitation, surface-water availability, vegetation dynamics, and atmospheric evaporative demand can alter wetland hydrology, ecosystem productivity, and resilience, particularly under increasing climatic and anthropogenic pressures. This study evaluates the long-term ecohydrological transformation of the Kabartal Wetland Region (KWR) sBihar, India, by integrating climatic, hydrological, evapotranspiration, and satellite-derived ecological indicators. Long-term rainfall variability and trends were assessed for 1901–2024 using the Seasonality Index (SI), Rainfall Anomaly Index (RAI), 90% dependable rainfall, Modified Mann–Kendall (MMK) test, and Sen’s slope, while actual evapotranspiration (ET) and potential evapotranspiration (PET) were analysed for 2002–2024. Landsat-derived Modified Normalized Difference Water Index (MNDWI) and Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) were used to quantify changes in surface-water extent and vegetation cover during pre- and post-monsoon periods between 1989 and 2024. The results reveal a substantial contraction of wetland surface-water extent, declining from 31 to 14 km² (54.83%) during pre-monsoon and from 44 to 19 km² (56.81%) during post-monsoon between 1989 and 2024. Rainfall exhibited strong seasonality, with SI values predominantly ranging from 0.8 to 1.4, indicating prolonged dry periods and concentration of precipitation within a short monsoonal window. RAI analysis indicates a progressive shift from predominantly wet conditions towards more frequent negative rainfall anomalies, particularly after 2000. Annual rainfall declined significantly across Begusarai, Samastipur, and Khagaria, with Sen’s slopes of − 1.54, − 1.72, and − 2.34 mm yr⁻¹, respectively, while monsoonal rainfall also exhibited significant decreasing trends. Historical mean annual rainfall of approximately 1,131, 1,170, and 1,154 mm in the three districts is projected to decline to about 1,025, 1,054, and 985 mm by 2044, respectively. Despite the region's generally humid, water-surplus character, the ET–PET relationship shows pronounced seasonal moisture limitation, with annual PET ranging from approximately 1,950–2,450 mm compared with ET of only 350–650 mm. Rainfall was positively correlated with ET (r = 0.5) and latent heat flux (r = 0.5) but negatively correlated with PET (r = − 0.5), demonstrating the sensitivity of ecosystem water use to precipitation availability and atmospheric demand. The convergence of declining rainfall, increasing rainfall variability, reduced surface-water extent, vegetation degradation, and persistent ET–PET disequilibrium indicates that KWR is undergoing a progressive transition from a predominantly water-surplus wetland system towards increasing seasonal hydro ecological stress. These findings highlight the need to restore river–wetland connectivity, protect wetland catchments and vegetation, regulate water extraction and land-use conversion, enhance monsoon-water retention, and strengthen community-based and climate-resilient wetland governance. Such integrated interventions are essential to maintain wetland ecological integrity, strengthen regional water security, and advance Sustainable Development Goal 6 (SDG 6) on sustainable water management.
articles.abstract_zh: 湿地是动态的社会生态系统，其持久性和生态功能受到水文气候变化的强烈调节。降水、地表水可用性、植被动态和大气蒸发需求的变化可以改变湿地水文、生态系统生产力和恢复力，特别是在气候和人为压力不断增加的情况下。本研究通过整合气候、水文、蒸散量和卫星衍生的生态指标，评估了印度比哈尔邦卡巴特尔湿地地区 (KWR) 的长期生态水文转变。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 湿地是动态的社会生态系统，其持久性和生态功能受到水文气候变化的强烈调节。降水、地表水可用性、植被动态和大气蒸发需求的变化可以改变湿地水文、生态系统生产力和恢复力，特别是在气候和人为压力不断增加的情况下。本研究通过整合气候、水文、蒸散量和卫星衍生的生态指标，评估了印度比哈尔邦卡巴特尔湿地地区 (KWR) 的长期生态水文转变。使用季节性指数（SI）、降雨异常指数（RAI）、90%可靠降雨量、修正曼-肯德尔（MMK）检验和森斜率评估了1901-2024年的长期降雨变化和趋势，同时分析了2002-2024年的实际蒸散量（ET）和潜在蒸散量（PET）。利用陆地卫星衍生的修正归一化水分指数 (MNDWI) 和归一化植被指数 (NDVI) 来量化 1989 年至 2024 年季风前后期间地表水范围和植被覆盖的变化。结果显示，湿地地表水范围大幅收缩，季风前从 31 平方公里减少到 14 平方公里（54.83%），季风期间从 44 平方公里减少到 19 平方公里1989年至2024年季风后期间，降雨量呈现较强的季节性，SI值主要分布在0.8至1.4之间，表明干旱期较长，降水集中在较短的季风窗口内。 RAI 分析表明，从以潮湿为主的条件逐步转变为更频繁的负降雨异常，特别是在 2000 年之后。贝古萨拉伊、萨马斯蒂普尔和卡加里亚的年降雨量显着下降，森斜率分别为 - 1.54、- 1.72 和 - 2.34 毫米年⁻1，而季风降雨也表现出显着减少的趋势。这三个地区的历史平均年降雨量约为 1,131、1,170 和 1,154 毫米，预计到 2044 年将分别下降至约 1,025、1,054 和 985 毫米。尽管该地区总体上潮湿、水过剩，但蒸散量与蒸发量之间的关系显示出明显的季节性湿度限制，年蒸发量约为 1,950–2,450 毫米，而蒸散量仅为 350–650 毫米。降雨量与 ET (r = 0.5) 和潜热通量 (r = 0.5) 呈正相关，但与 PET (r = − 0.5) 呈负相关，表明生态系统用水对降水可用性和大气需求的敏感性。降雨量减少、降雨量变率增加、地表水范围缩小、植被退化和持续的 ET-PET 不平衡的综合表明，KWR 正在经历从水过剩湿地系统向季节性水生态压力增加的逐步转变。这些发现强调需要恢复河流与湿地的连通性、保护湿地集水区和植被、规范取水和土地利用转换、加强季风水保留以及加强基于社区和气候适应能力的湿地治理。这种综合干预措施对于维护湿地生态完整性、加强区域水安全以及推进可持续水管理的可持续发展目标 6 (SDG 6) 至关重要。

articles.title: Hybrid quantum computer observes foundational quantum effect in a new setting
articles.title_zh: 混合量子计算机在新环境中观察基础量子效应
articles.abstract: Physicists in the Department of Physics at the University of Oxford have used a hybrid quantum computer, made up of qubits and quantum oscillators, to observe the Aharonov–Bohm effect in a quantum simulation. The effect is a quantum phenomenon in which a particle can acquire a measurable phase by traveling around a magnetic flux, even though it never passes through a region where a magnetic field is present.
articles.abstract_zh: 牛津大学物理系的物理学家使用由量子位和量子振荡器组成的混合量子计算机来观察量子模拟中的阿哈罗诺夫-玻姆效应。这种效应是一种量子现象，其中粒子可以通过围绕磁通量运动来获得可测量的相位，即使它从未穿过存在磁场的区域。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 牛津大学物理系的物理学家使用由量子位和量子振荡器组成的混合量子计算机来观察量子模拟中的阿哈罗诺夫-玻姆效应。这种效应是一种量子现象，其中粒子可以通过围绕磁通量运动来获得可测量的相位，即使它从未穿过存在磁场的区域。

articles.title: Quantum chip holds multiple photons at once, opening path to scalable memory
articles.title_zh: 量子芯片可同时容纳多个光子，为可扩展存储器开辟道路
articles.abstract: For highly fragile quantum information systems, the ability to store quantum information is vital—but also challenging. Quantum information is transported in particles of light called photons, which often must be temporarily paused (or "stored") while other, slower quantum operations catch up. This storage must be performed on microchips as small as 1 centimeter (0.4 inches)—a distance covered by light in a few trillionths of a second. Storing photons for a microsecond would represent a massive leap forward for the capabilities of quantum chips.
articles.abstract_zh: 对于高度脆弱的量子信息系统，存储量子信息的能力至关重要，但也具有挑战性。量子信息以称为光子的光粒子形式传输，光子通常必须暂时暂停（或“存储”），同时其他较慢的量子操作才能赶上。这种存储必须在小至 1 厘米（0.4 英寸）的微芯片上进行——光在几万亿分之一秒内覆盖的距离。将光子存储一微秒将代表量子芯片功能的巨大飞跃。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 对于高度脆弱的量子信息系统，存储量子信息的能力至关重要，但也具有挑战性。量子信息以称为光子的光粒子形式传输，光子通常必须暂时暂停（或“存储”），同时其他较慢的量子操作才能赶上。这种存储必须在小至 1 厘米（0.4 英寸）的微芯片上进行——光在几万亿分之一秒内覆盖的距离。将光子存储一微秒将代表量子芯片功能的巨大飞跃。

articles.title: Regulation mechanism of lanthanum chloride on germination
articles.title_zh: 氯化镧对发芽的调控机制
articles.abstract: The purpose of this study to investigate the regulatory effects of exogenous 18 lanthanum chloride (LaCl3) on wheat seed germination and seedling physiological 19 characteristics, in order to screen for the optimal treatment concentration that is most 20 conducive to its growth and development.Wheat seeds were used as experimental 21 materials, and a blank control group (CK) and six gradient treatment groups (T1 to T6) 22 were set up, with three biological replicates in each group. Inoculate 25 seeds into 23 each culture dish and apply 10 mL of LaCl3 solution at concentrations of 0 (CK), 60, 24 120, 180, 240, 300, and 360 mg·L⁻¹, respectively, while keeping the filter paper moist. After 3 days of germination, relevant indicators will be measured. In the pot experiment, when the seedling height reaches 5 cm, 10 mL of corresponding treatment solution is sprayed every 3 days. After 20 days of cultivation, the root length, number of fibrous roots, fresh weight, plant height, chlorophyll content, as well as key enzyme activities such as superoxide dismutase (SOD), peroxidase (POD), and catalase (CAT) are measured.The experiment showed that lanthanum chloride exhibited a dual effect of "Minimal stimulation and strong suppression" on wheat growth. Among them, the T4 to T6 groups suffered severe growth inhibition due to excessive concentration, and effective enzyme activity data could not be obtained. Physiological indicators testing showed that compared with the CK group, the low concentration T1 group (60 mg·L-1) significantly increased the activities of SOD, POD, and CAT by 31.43%, 71.82%, and 69.74%, respectively (P<0.05). The synergistic effect of the medium concentration T3 group (180 mg·L-1) was more significant, with the activities of the three enzymes increasing by 44%, 135.16%, and 114.47%, respectively. The chlorophyll content in T1, T2, and T3 groups also significantly increased by 39.84%, 20.86%, and 33.69%, respectively. Correlation analysis revealed that the activities of SOD, POD, and CAT were negatively correlated with seed germination rate, number of fibrous roots, and root length. There was also a significant negative correlation between chlorophyll content and number of fibrous roots. In summary, the optimal concentration for this experiment was 180 mg·L-1 LaCl3 treatment. Under these conditions, the germination rate of wheat seeds and the comprehensive physiological growth indicators of seedlings showed the best performance.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探讨外源~(18)氯化镧(LaCl3)对小麦种子萌发及幼苗生理特性的调节作用[20]，以筛选最有利于其生长发育的最佳处理浓度[20]。以小麦种子为实验材料[21]，设空白对照组(CK)和6个梯度处理组(T1~T6)[22]，每组设3个生物重复。每个培养皿 23 个，接种 25 粒种子，分别加入 10 mL 浓度为 0（CK）、60、24 120、180、240、300 和 360 mg·L-1 的 LaCl3 溶液，同时保持滤纸湿润。发芽3天后，测定相关指标。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本研究旨在探讨外源~(18)氯化镧(LaCl3)对小麦种子萌发及幼苗生理特性的调节作用[20]，以筛选最有利于其生长发育的最佳处理浓度[20]。以小麦种子为实验材料[21]，设空白对照组(CK)和6个梯度处理组(T1~T6)[22]，每组设3个生物重复。每个培养皿 23 个，接种 25 粒种子，分别加入 10 mL 浓度为 0（CK）、60、24 120、180、240、300 和 360 mg·L-1 的 LaCl3 溶液，同时保持滤纸湿润。发芽3天后，测定相关指标。盆栽试验中，当苗高达到5厘米时，每3天喷洒10毫升相应的处理液。培养20天后，测定根长、须根数、鲜重、株高、叶绿素含量以及超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）、过氧化物酶（POD）、过氧化氢酶（CAT）等关键酶活性。实验表明，氯化镧对小麦生长具有“微刺激、强抑制”的双重作用。其中，T4至T6组由于浓度过高，生长受到严重抑制，无法获得有效的酶活性数据。生理指标检测显示，与CK组相比，低浓度T1组（60 mg·L-1）SOD、POD、CAT活性分别显着升高31.43%、71.82%、69.74%（P<0.05）。中浓度T3组(180 mg·L-1)协同作用更显着，三种酶活性分别增加44%、135.16%和114.47%。 T1、T2和T3组的叶绿素含量也显着增加，分别增加了39.84%、20.86%和33.69%。相关分析表明，SOD、POD、CAT活性与种子发芽率、须根数、根长呈负相关。叶绿素含量与须根数量也呈显着负相关。综上所述，本实验的最佳浓度为180 mg·L-1 LaCl3处理。在此条件下，小麦种子的发芽率和幼苗的综合生理生长指标均表现出最好的表现。

articles.title: Cognitive Work and Interface Requirements in Autonomous Passenger Mobility: A Taxonomy-Based Analysis of Public Incident Reports
articles.title_zh: 自动乘客出行中的认知工作和界面要求：公共事件报告的基于分类的分析
articles.abstract: Autonomous passenger mobility changes the distribution of human work rather than removing it from transport operations. Driverless robotaxis, supervised passenger automated driving systems, autonomous shuttles, and remotely assisted mobility services create new cognitive work for passengers, in-vehicle operators, remote supervisors, emergency responders, and surrounding road users. This study analyzes public automated-driving incident records as traces of human-autonomy interaction and develops a taxonomy-based account of interface requirements. A curated corpus of 2,760 latest public report versions was filtered to 2,646 autonomous passenger mobility records and 1,411 interface-relevant report-level cases, aggregated into 1,158 incident clusters. The coding taxonomy links recurring incident patterns to ergonomics constructs including mode awareness, control authority, remote cognitive work, degraded-state communication, external legibility, passenger guidance, and operational boundary management. Results show that the most frequent primary interface families concern curbside, parking, or stop-state interaction; remote or shared supervision; control transfer; fallback or degraded operation; and operational-boundary stressors. The findings indicate that safety in autonomous passenger mobility depends on making system state, authority, fallback behavior, and expected human action legible across multiple actors and interface layers. The study contributes a requirements-oriented framework for designing and verifying human-autonomy interfaces in autonomous passenger mobility operations.
articles.abstract_zh: 自主乘客流动改变了人类工作的分配，而不是将其从运输业务中移除。无人驾驶机器人出租车、受监督的乘客自动驾驶系统、自动班车和远程辅助移动服务为乘客、车内操作员、远程监管人员、应急响应人员和周围道路使用者创造了新的认知工作。这项研究分析了公共自动驾驶事件记录作为人类与自主交互的痕迹，并开发了基于分类的界面需求帐户。包含 2,760 个最新公开报告版本的精选语料库被过滤为 2,646 个自动乘客移动记录和 1,411 个与界面相关的报告级案例，汇总为 1,158 个事件集群。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自主乘客流动改变了人类工作的分配，而不是将其从运输业务中移除。无人驾驶机器人出租车、受监督的乘客自动驾驶系统、自动班车和远程辅助移动服务为乘客、车内操作员、远程监管人员、应急响应人员和周围道路使用者创造了新的认知工作。这项研究分析了公共自动驾驶事件记录作为人类与自主交互的痕迹，并开发了基于分类的界面需求帐户。包含 2,760 个最新公开报告版本的精选语料库被过滤为 2,646 个自动乘客移动记录和 1,411 个与界面相关的报告级案例，汇总为 1,158 个事件集群。编码分类将重复发生的事件模式与人体工程学结构联系起来，包括模式意识、控制权限、远程认知工作、降级状态通信、外部可读性、乘客引导和操作边界管理。结果表明，最常见的主要界面系列涉及路边、停车或停车状态交互；远程或共享监督；控制转移；回退或降级操作；和操作边界压力源。研究结果表明，自动乘客出行的安全性取决于系统状态、权限、后备行为和预期的人类行为在多个参与者和接口层之间的清晰性。该研究为设计和验证自动乘客移动操作中的人机界面提供了一个以需求为导向的框架。

articles.title: Carbonylation of Glycerol with CO2 to Glycerol Carbonate over Zinc Hydroxystannate
articles.title_zh: 羟基锡酸锌上甘油与 CO2 羰基化生成甘油碳酸酯
articles.abstract: This study investigates the direct carbonylation of glycerol with CO2 over zinc hydroxystannate (ZHS) catalysts for the synthesis of glycerol carbonate (GLC) under relatively milder reaction conditions. Reactions were conducted in a semi-batch reactor at 120 °C and 5 bar CO2 for 6 h. ZHS catalysts were prepared by Zn2+–Sn4+ coprecipitation with NaOH (ZSCP), ZSCP by further hydrothermal treatment, or by alkaline-assisted surface treatment (CPAST), and their catalytic performances were compared. Among the catalysts examined, ZHS prepared by CPAST afforded the highest GLC yield of 17.1%, compared with 15.9% for ZSCP-derived ZHS. XPS analysis indicated that the surface basicity of ZHS is associated with partial reduction of Sn4+ to Sn2+ and the concomitant formation of surface oxygen vacancies. In the absence of ZHS, glycerol predominantly underwent oligomerization, whereas ZHS promoted the activation and incorporation of CO2 into glycerol to form GLC. Notably, the GLC yield exhibited a strong linear correlation with the surface basicity of the ZHS catalysts determined by the Hammett indicator method, demonstrating that surface basicity is a key descriptor governing catalytic activity.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究研究了在羟基锡酸锌 (ZHS) 催化剂上甘油与 CO2 的直接羰基化反应，在相对温和的反应条件下合成碳酸甘油酯 (GLC)。反应在半间歇式反应器中在 120°C 和 5 bar CO2 下进行 6 小时。采用Zn2+–Sn4+与NaOH共沉淀(ZSCP)、ZSCP进一步水热处理或碱辅助表面处理(CPAST)制备ZHS催化剂，并比较其催化性能。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本研究研究了在羟基锡酸锌 (ZHS) 催化剂上甘油与 CO2 的直接羰基化反应，在相对温和的反应条件下合成碳酸甘油酯 (GLC)。反应在半间歇式反应器中在 120°C 和 5 bar CO2 下进行 6 小时。采用Zn2+–Sn4+与NaOH共沉淀(ZSCP)、ZSCP进一步水热处理或碱辅助表面处理(CPAST)制备ZHS催化剂，并比较其催化性能。在所检查的催化剂中，由 CPAST 制备的 ZHS 提供了最高的 GLC 产率，为 17.1%，而 ZSCP 衍生的 ZHS 为 15.9%。 XPS分析表明ZHS的表面碱度与Sn4+部分还原为Sn2+以及随之形成的表面氧空位有关。在没有 ZHS 的情况下，甘油主要发生低聚，而 ZHS 则促进 CO2 活化并掺入甘油中形成 GLC。值得注意的是，GLC 产率与哈米特指示剂法测定的 ZHS 催化剂的表面碱度表现出很强的线性相关性，表明表面碱度是控制催化活性的关键描述符。

articles.title: Reading the Reader: When Do News Interactions Reveal Momentary Viewpoint Openness?
articles.title_zh: 阅读读者：新闻互动什么时候会表现出短暂的观点开放性？
articles.abstract: What does a news interaction show about a reader's willingness to engage with politically different sources? Selecting an opposing-side article records a choice, opening it records access, and a trustworthiness rating records judgment. We examine viewpoint openness using three datasets: trustworthiness ratings in NewsLens, choices from a displayed list in NeMig, and openings of recommended articles in IDEA. Each covers one period, interface, and action, so none can establish a lasting disposition. We call the time-bounded inference emphmomentary viewpoint openness: how favorably a reader responds to opposing-side sources relative to same-side sources during the observed period. We test whether early responses improve prediction of later ones after accounting for what was offered, political side, and the reader's usual response level. In NewsLens, readers consistently differ in how much political alignment between themselves and the outlet changes their trustworthiness ratings, beyond article differences and usual scoring; this supports momentary viewpoint openness in trustworthiness judgments. In NeMig, political position and the sources in each list predict which side is chosen, while earlier choices and migration attitudes do not identify an additional preference that repeats across rounds. In IDEA, readers differ consistently in overall political-news opening frequency, but not in which side they open more often across weeks. The NeMig history therefore supports prediction from the choice situation, and the IDEA history supports an overall opening tendency; neither reveals a recurring personal source-side difference. A reader model should preserve these differences rather than label every opposing-side interaction as openness.
articles.abstract_zh: 新闻互动如何表明读者愿意与不同政治来源互动？选择对方文章记录选择，打开记录访问，可信度记录判断。我们使用三个数据集检查观点开放性：NewsLens 中的可信度评级、NeMig 中显示列表中的选择以及 IDEA 中推荐文章的开篇率。每一个都涵盖一个时期、一个界面、一个动作，因此没有一个能够建立持久的性格。我们将限时推理称为强调观点开放性：在观察期间，相对于同方来源，读者对对方来源的反应如何。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 新闻互动如何表明读者愿意与不同政治来源互动？选择对方文章记录选择，打开记录访问，可信度记录判断。我们使用三个数据集检查观点开放性：NewsLens 中的可信度评级、NeMig 中显示列表中的选择以及 IDEA 中推荐文章的开篇率。每一个都涵盖一个时期、一个界面、一个动作，因此没有一个能够建立持久的性格。我们将限时推理称为强调观点开放性：在观察期间，相对于同方来源，读者对对方来源的反应如何。在考虑了所提供的内容、政治方面和读者通常的反应水平后，我们测试早期的反应是否可以改善对后来的反应的预测。在 NewsLens 中，除了文章差异和通常的评分之外，读者与媒体之间的政治联盟对他们的可信度评级的影响程度始终存在差异；这支持了可信度判断中的暂时观点开放性。在 NeMig 中，政治立场和每个列表中的来源预测选择哪一方，而早期的选择和移民态度并不能确定在各轮中重复的额外偏好。在 IDEA 中，读者在总体政治新闻打开频率上存在差异，但在几周内他们打开哪一边的频率没有差异。因此，NeMig 历史支持从选择情况进行预测，IDEA 历史支持整体开放趋势；两者都没有揭示出反复出现的个人来源差异。读者模型应该保留这些差异，而不是把每一个对立面的互动都标记为开放性。

articles.title: Investigation of Stress Analysis on Copper Material in Slurry Erosion Wear
articles.title_zh: 铜材料浆料侵蚀磨损应力分析研究
articles.abstract: In erosion wear the impacting particles called as erodent are responsible to generate stress on target specimen significantly. The severity of contact stress depends on erodent size and shape, erodent velocity, etc. In present work mild steel erodent impacted on copper specimen. The impact energy of mild steel erodent kept constant by varying their velocities. The optical microscope is used to determine the diameter of indentation craters on copper specimen due to impact of mild steel spherical shape particles. Hertz equation is used to calculate contact area and stress concentration at target material surface. Similar conditions are simulated in ANSYSY software.  Stress concentration findings with experimental method almost in line with the ANSYS explicit dynamics software results. Finally it is concluded that stress concentration is dominant factor in erosion wear which needs to investigate further in detail by investigators.
articles.abstract_zh: 在侵蚀磨损中，称为侵蚀剂的冲击颗粒会在目标样本上产生显着的应力。接触应力的严重程度取决于侵蚀物的大小和形状、侵蚀物的速度等。在目前的工作中，低碳钢侵蚀物撞击铜样本。低碳钢侵蚀剂的冲击能量通过改变其速度保持恒定。光学显微镜用于测定铜样品上由于低碳钢球形颗粒的撞击而产生的压痕坑的直径。赫兹方程用于计算目标材料表面的接触面积和应力集中。 ANSYSY 软件模拟了类似的条件。  用实验方法得到的应力集中结果与ANSYS显式动力学软件的结果几乎一致。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在侵蚀磨损中，称为侵蚀剂的冲击颗粒会在目标样本上产生显着的应力。接触应力的严重程度取决于侵蚀物的大小和形状、侵蚀物的速度等。在目前的工作中，低碳钢侵蚀物撞击铜样本。低碳钢侵蚀剂的冲击能量通过改变其速度保持恒定。光学显微镜用于测定铜样品上由于低碳钢球形颗粒的撞击而产生的压痕坑的直径。赫兹方程用于计算目标材料表面的接触面积和应力集中。 ANSYSY 软件模拟了类似的条件。  用实验方法得到的应力集中结果与ANSYS显式动力学软件的结果几乎一致。最后得出结论，应力集中是侵蚀磨损的主导因素，需要研究人员进一步详细研究。

articles.title: In Vitro Evaluation of Activated Bentonite and Biochar: T-2 Toxin and Zearalenone Adsorption and Intestinal Barrier Protection
articles.title_zh: 活化膨润土和生物炭的体外评价：T-2 毒素和玉米赤霉烯酮吸附和肠道屏障保护
articles.abstract: Mycotoxin adsorbents are usually evaluated solely by toxin-binding capacity. However, adsorption alone does not reflect binding stability under gastrointestinal conditions or biological protection of the intestinal epithelium. This study compared commercial and experimental bentonite- and biochar-based adsorbents against T-2 toxin and zearalenone (ZEN) using an integrated physicochemical and biological approach. Seven materials were tested: one commercial activated bentonite, two experimental bentonites and their NaCl-activated variants, and two experimental biochars. The evaluation combined physicochemical characterization, sequential adsorption-desorption (simulating gastric-to-intestinal transitions), and biological efficacy assessment using continuous transepithelial electrical resistance (ECIS-TEER) monitoring in IPEC-J2 cells. NaCl activation altered bentonite surface properties depending on the parent material without disrupting the smectite framework. Sequential testing revealed differences in toxin retention hidden by initial adsorption alone. Experimental biochar 1 showed complete binding efficiency for both toxins, while commercial activated bentonite exceeded 93%. Physicochemical binding did not reliably predict biological protection. Commercial bentonite protected barrier function against both toxins. Experimental bentonite 2 and biochar 1 protected against T-2 toxin, whereas experimental bentonite 1 best supported protection against ZEN, with its activated form altering barrier-response kinetics. These findings demonstrate that adsorption capacity, binding stability, and preservation of epithelial barrier function represent complementary dimensions of adsorbent efficacy. Integrating sequential adsorption–desorption with continuous ECIS-TEER monitoring provides a comprehensive framework for evaluating mycotoxin adsorbents.
articles.abstract_zh: 霉菌毒素吸附剂通常仅通过毒素结合能力来评价。然而，单独的吸附并不能反映胃肠道条件下的结合稳定性或肠上皮的生物保护。本研究采用综合物理化学和生物学方法，比较了基于膨润土和生物炭的商业和实验吸附剂对 T-2 毒素和玉米赤霉烯酮 (ZEN) 的影响。测试了七种材料：一种商业活化膨润土，两种实验膨润土及其 NaCl 活化变体，以及两种实验生物炭。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 霉菌毒素吸附剂通常仅通过毒素结合能力来评价。然而，单独的吸附并不能反映胃肠道条件下的结合稳定性或肠上皮的生物保护。本研究采用综合物理化学和生物学方法，比较了基于膨润土和生物炭的商业和实验吸附剂对 T-2 毒素和玉米赤霉烯酮 (ZEN) 的影响。测试了七种材料：一种商业活化膨润土，两种实验膨润土及其 NaCl 活化变体，以及两种实验生物炭。该评估结合了物理化学表征、连续吸附-解吸（模拟胃到肠的转变）以及使用 IPEC-J2 细胞中的连续跨上皮电阻 (ECIS-TEER) 监测的生物功效评估。氯化钠活化根据母体材料改变膨润土表面特性，而不破坏蒙皂石框架。后续测试揭示了仅通过初始吸附隐藏的毒素保留差异。实验生物炭 1 显示出对两种毒素的完全结合效率，而商业活性膨润土则超过 93%。物理化学结合不能可靠地预测生物保护。商业膨润土可保护两种毒素的屏障功能。实验膨润土 2 和生物炭 1 可防止 T-2 毒素，而实验膨润土 1 则能最好地支持对 ZEN 的保护，其活化形式会改变屏障反应动力学。这些发现表明，吸附能力、结合稳定性和上皮屏障功能的保留代表了吸附剂功效的互补维度。将顺序吸附-解吸与连续 ECIS-TEER 监测相结合，为评估霉菌毒素吸附剂提供了一个全面的框架。

articles.title: Multiscale mechanical performance of plant-based and hybrid yarns for biodegradable fishing Net
articles.title_zh: 用于可生物降解渔网的植物基和混合纱的多尺度机械性能
articles.abstract: Marine plastic pollution from abandoned fishing gear has intensified the search for lower-persistence netting materials that retain adequate mechanical performance. This study investigated how yarn composition and twisting influence plant-based and polyester-containing two-ply yarns across three structural scales: yarns, double-weaver knots, and nets. Six yarn systems were produced at 200–500 TPM. Two-way ANOVA confirmed significant effects of composition, twist, and their interaction, whereas Grey Relational Analysis identified 400 TPM as the most suitable common twist condition. At the yarn scale, PALF/PALF showed the highest breaking force, whereas PES/PES exhibited the greatest extensibility. At the knot scale, PALF/PALF achieved the highest knot load and substantial geometric rearrangement, while PES/HF showed the greatest proportional strength retention. At the net scale, PALF/PALF maintained the strongest overall load-bearing response and was mechanically competitive with the PES/PES reference, although the polyester retained advantage. The numerical comparison favored the 10 cm over the 5 cm mesh-bar configuration under the adopted conditions. Seawater exposure caused greater surface deterioration in PALF and hemp than polyester. Overall, the results demonstrate that material ranking changes across structural scales and identify PALF-containing systems as promising candidates for further lower-persistence fishing-net development
articles.abstract_zh: 废弃渔具造成的海洋塑料污染加剧了对保留足够机械性能的低持久性渔网材料的寻找。本研究研究了纱线成分和捻度如何在三种结构尺度上影响植物基和含聚酯的双层纱线：纱线、双织结和网。在200–500 TPM下生产六种纱线系统。双向方差分析证实了成分、扭曲及其相互作用的显著影响，而灰色关联分析确定400 TPM是最常见的扭曲条件。在纱线尺度上， PALF/PALF表现出最高的断裂力，而PES/PES表现出最大的延展性。

articles.title: Layered semiconductor unlocks magnetic control of light emitted by quantum condensates
articles.title_zh: 层状半导体解锁了对量子凝聚体发出的光的磁控制
articles.abstract: Quantum technologies are considered key technologies of the future. However, research in this field requires not only scientific expertise but sometimes also highly specialized laboratory conditions. Bose–Einstein condensates are a remarkable example, in which atoms move in lockstep, making quantum-mechanical effects visible not only at the level of individual atoms but also on a macroscopic scale. The first Bose–Einstein condensates were observed in ultracold atomic gases at temperatures close to absolute zero. The cooling required to achieve this was technically demanding, costly and restricted to specialized laboratories.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子技术被认为是未来的关键技术。然而，这一领域的研究不仅需要科学专业知识，有时还需要高度专业化的实验室条件。玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚就是一个显着的例子，其中原子同步运动，使得量子力学效应不仅在单个原子水平上可见，而且在宏观尺度上也可见。第一个玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚是在接近绝对零温度的超冷原子气体中观察到的。实现这一目标所需的冷却技术要求高、成本高并且仅限于专业实验室。

articles.title: Liquid-crystal-like magnetism explains puzzling properties in a rare-earth compound
articles.title_zh: 类液晶磁性解释了稀土化合物中令人费解的特性
articles.abstract: In some materials, physical properties don't emerge from their individual particles, but from the collective behavior of their quantum spins. Now, researchers led by Pengcheng Dai at Rice University in the U.S. have discovered that in one compound containing the rare-earth element ytterbium, these spins can behave much like the molecules in a liquid crystal: favoring a certain direction without lining up to create magnetism on larger scales.
articles.abstract_zh: 在某些材料中，物理特性并不是来自其单个粒子，而是来自其量子自旋的集体行为。现在，美国莱斯大学戴鹏程领导的研究人员发现，在一种含有稀土元素镱的化合物中，这些自旋的行为与液晶中的分子非常相似：偏向某个方向，而不是排列起来以在更大范围内产生磁性。

articles.title: Development of yeast-based integrated bioprocess for xylitol and ethanol production from xylan-rich lignocellulosic materials
articles.title_zh: 开发基于酵母的集成生物工艺，用于从富含木聚糖的木质纤维素材料生产木糖醇和乙醇
articles.abstract: Xylan-rich agricultural residues can serve as cheap and abundant raw materials for biorefinery processes, however development of efficient and sustainable processes for their bioconversion into high-value products is still a major challenge. Integrated bioprocess, combining enzyme production, substrate hydrolysis and product formation into a single process by using a single microorganism, represents a promising strategy for overcoming this issue. In this study, selected nonconventional wild-type yeast strains were screened for their ability to produce extracellular xylanases and xylitol, aiming to identify multifunctional biocatalysts that are suitable for an integrated bioprocess of xylan-rich lignocellulosic residues. Among the investigated strains, Sugiyamaella novakii NCAIM Y.00987 was found to be suitable for xylan-based integrated bioprocess applications due to its revealed capability of producing extracellular xylanases and xylitol. Process parameters affecting xylanases production and xylitol fermentation were determined and optimised, and the scalability of the optimised conditions was verified in batch processes performed in 500-mL bench-top bioreactor. The strain maintained stable enzyme production and product formation under the controlled cultivation conditions in bench-top bioreactor, forecasting its applicability in an industrial bioprocess. Application of Su. novakii in integrated bioprocess for xylitol and ethanol was subsequently assessed using xylan and barley husk as model and real lignocellulosic substrates, respectively. Although a two-stage bioprocess was proposed to provide optimal conditions for both xylanases and xylitol productions, enzyme and product synthesis was simultaneously obtained, indicating the possibility of using the strain as a microorganism for consolidated bioprocessing of lignocellulosic materials. The developed bioprocess resulted in direct substrate conversions, producing 1.1 g/L xylitol and 1.8 g/L ethanol after 48 h on xylan, while 0.12 g/L xylitol was obtained from barley husk, without external enzyme supplementation. In addition, Candida allociferrii NCAIM Y.02114 was confirmed experimentally for the first time, identifying it as an industrially relevant strain. The findings contribute to advancing sustainable biomass processing and support the implementation of circular bioeconomy strategies through the direct conversion of agricultural by-products into value-added biochemicals. Overall, this study highlights the potential of nonconventional yeasts as multifunctional platforms for the integrated valorisation of hemicellulose-rich residues and provides a basis for the development of lignocellulose-based consolidated bioprocesses. The findings contribute to advancing sustainable biomass processing and support the implementation of circular bioeconomy strategies through the direct conversion of agricultural by-products into value-added biochemicals.
articles.abstract_zh: 富含木聚糖的农业残留物可以作为生物精炼工艺的廉价且丰富的原材料，然而开发高效且可持续的工艺将其生物转化为高价值产品仍然是一个重大挑战。集成生物过程，即使用单一微生物将酶生产、底物水解和产物形成结合到一个过程中，代表了克服这一问题的有前途的策略。在这项研究中，筛选了选定的非常规野生型酵母菌株产生胞外木聚糖酶和木糖醇的能力，旨在鉴定适合富含木聚糖的木质纤维素残基的集成生物过程的多功能生物催化剂。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 富含木聚糖的农业残留物可以作为生物精炼工艺的廉价且丰富的原材料，然而开发高效且可持续的工艺将其生物转化为高价值产品仍然是一个重大挑战。集成生物过程，即使用单一微生物将酶生产、底物水解和产物形成结合到一个过程中，代表了克服这一问题的有前途的策略。在这项研究中，筛选了选定的非常规野生型酵母菌株产生胞外木聚糖酶和木糖醇的能力，旨在鉴定适合富含木聚糖的木质纤维素残基的集成生物过程的多功能生物催化剂。在所研究的菌株中，Sugiyamaella novakii NCAIM Y.00987 由于具有产生细胞外木聚糖酶和木糖醇的能力，被发现适合基于木聚糖的集成生物工艺应用。确定并优化了影响木聚糖酶生产和木糖醇发酵的工艺参数，并在 500 mL 台式生物反应器中执行的批量工艺中验证了优化条件的可扩展性。该菌株在台式生物反应器的受控培养条件下保持稳定的酶生产和产物形成，预示着其在工业生物过程中的适用性。苏的应用。随后分别使用木聚糖和大麦壳作为模型和真实的木质纤维素底物对木糖醇和乙醇的综合生物过程中的novakii进行了评估。尽管提出了两阶段生物过程来为木聚糖酶和木糖醇生产提供最佳条件，但同时获得了酶和产物合成，表明使用该菌株作为微生物来进行木质纤维素材料的综合生物加工的可能性。所开发的生物工艺导致直接底物转化，在木聚糖上 48 小时后产生 1.1 g/L 木糖醇和 1.8 g/L 乙醇，而从大麦壳中获得 0.12 g/L 木糖醇，无需外部酶补充。此外，首次通过实验证实了Candida allociferrii NCAIM Y.02114，将其鉴定为工业相关菌株。研究结果有助于推进可持续生物质加工，并通过将农业副产品直接转化为增值生物化学品来支持循环生物经济战略的实施。总体而言，这项研究强调了非常规酵母作为富含半纤维素残留物综合增值的多功能平台的潜力，并为开发基于木质纤维素的综合生物工艺提供了基础。研究结果有助于推进可持续生物质加工，并通过将农业副产品直接转化为增值生物化学品来支持循环生物经济战略的实施。

articles.title: Excitation-Aware On-Track System Identification at Full Scale
articles.title_zh: 全面的励磁感知在轨系统识别
articles.abstract: On-track system identification learns tire models from ordinary racing laps instead of dedicated manoeuvres. We study one such residual-learning pipeline at full vehicle scale, inside a simulator that publishes per-wheel forces as ground truth. Transplanted unchanged from a 1:10 platform, it converges on a tire with less than half the vehicle’s grip ceiling and most Pacejka coefficients resting on their bounds. The cause is a loss of excitation created by the pipeline’s own virtual-data step: the friction the synthetic rollout can demand is a property of the rollout configuration and not of the tire, as a grid on a known tire con-firms. Two further defects share that source. The objective the coefficients are fitted against depends on them only through one product, so the peak factor is not recoverable from the rollout at any excitation, and the loop that feeds each fit its own previous answer is not a contraction. We correct all three, and gate the controller interface on derived physical quantities rather than on coefficient bounds. On a static surface 33% below the one the tire prior was measured on,axle cornering stiffness is recovered to within 3.2% and the peak factor to 11%. On a surface losing half its grip under the moving vehicle, the corrected pipeline tracks the decay rate to 7% and completes three timed laps at unchanged lateral tracking error for 18% of lap time, where the inherited configuration holds a grip ceiling nearly four times the plant’s and leaves the track.
articles.abstract_zh: 赛道系统识别从普通赛车圈中学习轮胎模型，而不是专门的操作。我们在模拟器中研究了这样一个全车规模的残差学习管道，该模拟器将每个车轮的力作为地面实况发布。它从 1:10 的平台移植过来，没有变化，但其轮胎的抓地力上限还不到车辆抓地力上限的一半，而且大多数 Pacejka 系数都在其范围内。原因是管道自身的虚拟数据步骤造成的激励损失：合成卷展所需的摩擦力是卷展配置的属性，而不是轮胎的属性，正如已知轮胎上的网格所证实的那样。另外两个缺陷也有同样的来源。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 赛道系统识别从普通赛车圈中学习轮胎模型，而不是专门的操作。我们在模拟器中研究了这样一个全车规模的残差学习管道，该模拟器将每个车轮的力作为地面实况发布。它从 1:10 的平台移植过来，没有变化，但其轮胎的抓地力上限还不到车辆抓地力上限的一半，而且大多数 Pacejka 系数都在其范围内。原因是管道自身的虚拟数据步骤造成的激励损失：合成卷展所需的摩擦力是卷展配置的属性，而不是轮胎的属性，正如已知轮胎上的网格所证实的那样。另外两个缺陷也有同样的来源。系数拟合的目标仅取决于它们通过一个乘积，因此峰值因子在任何激励下都无法从推出中恢复，并且为每个拟合提供其自己的先前答案的循环不是收缩。我们纠正所有这三个问题，并根据导出的物理量而不是系数界限来对控制器接口进行门控。在比之前测量的轮胎低 33% 的静态表面上，车轴侧偏刚度恢复到 3.2% 以内，峰值系数恢复到 11%。在移动车辆下失去一半抓地力的表面上，校正后的管道跟踪衰减率达到 7%，并在 18% 的单圈时间内以不变的横向跟踪误差完成三圈计时，其中继承的配置保持了近四倍于工厂的抓地力上限并离开轨道。

articles.title: I ∝ √V characteristic resulting from a Fermi pinning region in polysilicon nanowire Schottky-contacted resistors
articles.title_zh: I ∝ √V 特性由多晶硅纳米线肖特基接触电阻器中的费米钉扎区域产生
articles.abstract: Herein, we present an analytical formulation for the current-voltage characteristic of an undoped polycrystalline silicon nanowire Schottky-contacted resistor. This type of nanowire is characterised by high defect density, which is modelled using a double-exponential density of states (DOS) describing both band-tail states and deep states within the bandgap for acceptor and donor traps. At equilibrium, the potential profile reveals an electrostatic screening effect: perturbation induced by the contact is attenuated by the trapped charge over a characteristic screening length, beyond which the potential stabilises to a typical value determined by the DOS parameters. Out of equilibrium, a Fermi pinning region forms near the metal/polycrystalline silicon nanowire interface, which is distinct from depletion regions observed in classical Schottky junctions. This Fermi pinning region exhibits a quasi-frozen trap occupancy and a free-hole concentration around the intrinsic concentration. Beyond this region, quasi-neutrality is restored, with a residual electric field deep in the nanowire ensuring the drift of free holes. The model shows that this field, proportional to the square root of the voltage, is an attenuated replica of the field at the metal/polycrystalline silicon nanowire interface transmitted through the Fermi pinning region and screening region into the core of the nanowire. Based on the drift-diffusion equation, the current-voltage characteristic exhibits a distinctive dependence of the form (:Ipropto:sqrtV). The developed analytical expressions are quantitatively supported by numerical simulations.
articles.abstract_zh: 在此，我们提出了未掺杂多晶硅纳米线肖特基接触电阻器的电流-电压特性的分析公式。这种类型的纳米线的特点是高缺陷密度，它是使用双指数态密度（DOS）建模的，描述了受体和施主陷阱带隙内的带尾态和深态。在平衡状态下，电势分布揭示了静电屏蔽效应：由接触引起的扰动在特征屏蔽长度内被捕获的电荷衰减，超过该长度电势稳定到由 DOS 参数确定的典型值。失去平衡时，费米钉扎区在金属/多晶硅纳米线界面附近形成，这与经典肖特基结中观察到的耗尽区不同。

articles.title: Multi-class quantum k-nearest-neighbour classification in a single quantum circuit
articles.title_zh: 单量子电路中的多类量子 k 最近邻分类
articles.abstract: In this paper we present a novel quantum k-nearest-neighbour circuit. The k-nearest-neighbour problem asks for the K closest stored points to a query among all data; quantum interference allows every stored point of every class to be compared in a single execution, a substantial computational gain. Quantum k-nearest-neighbour designs to date have rested on assumed primitives—quantum random-access memory, oracle access, amplitude-amplified search—which remain hypothetical and serve mainly to set limits on what the algorithms could achieve, or they restrict the distance metric or the number of classes. Our design uses none of these: no quantum random-access memory, no oracle, no metric restriction, no binary-class limit, and every operation is a practically implementable gate. Training members of each class are loaded into a dedicated register in superposition, a butterfly network of controlled-SWAP stages routes all classes to a common comparison position, and the class and member identity of every neighbour is read directly from the measurement statistics. The architecture rests on closed-form expressions for the post-selected probabilities and a geometric analysis showing that inverse stereographic projection carries the Euclidean nearest-neighbour ranking onto state fidelity with a sharp distortion bound. In simulation the circuit reproduces its intended decision rule exactly, and its accuracy matches classical k-nearest neighbours across a controlled benchmark at a realistic measurement budget. Every loading and sampling cost is stated in full—costs that most prior work hides by assuming quantum random-access memory.
articles.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的量子 k 最近邻电路。 k近邻问题要求所有数据中距离查询最近的K个存储点；量子干涉允许在单次执行中比较每个类别的每个存储点，这是一个巨大的计算增益。迄今为止，量子 k 最近邻设计都依赖于假设的原语——量子随机存取存储器、预言机访问、幅度放大搜索——这些仍然是假设的，主要用于限制算法可以实现的目标，或者限制距离度量或类的数量。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的量子 k 最近邻电路。 k近邻问题要求所有数据中距离查询最近的K个存储点；量子干涉允许在单次执行中比较每个类别的每个存储点，这是一个巨大的计算增益。迄今为止，量子 k 最近邻设计都依赖于假设的原语——量子随机存取存储器、预言机访问、幅度放大搜索——这些仍然是假设的，主要用于限制算法可以实现的目标，或者限制距离度量或类的数量。我们的设计没有使用这些：没有量子随机存取存储器，没有预言机，没有度量限制，没有二进制类限制，并且每个操作都是一个实际上可实现的门。每个类别的训练成员都以叠加方式加载到专用寄存器中，受控交换阶段的蝶形网络将所有类别路由到公共比较位置，并且每个邻居的类别和成员身份直接从测量统计数据中读取。该架构依赖于后选择概率的封闭形式表达式和几何分析，显示逆立体投影将欧几里得最近邻排序带到具有尖锐失真界限的状态保真度上。在仿真中，电路准确地再现了其预期的决策规则，其精度在实际测量预算下与受控基准上的经典 k 最近邻相匹配。每个加载和采样成本都以完整的方式列出——大多数先前的工作通过假设量子随机存取存储器来隐藏这些成本。

articles.title: Analytical Construction of the CKM Matrix Using a Single Electroweak Constant
articles.title_zh: 使用单个电弱常数解析构建 CKM 矩阵
articles.abstract: We present closed analytical expressions for all nine elements of the Cabibbo-Kobayashi-Maskawa (CKM) quark mixing matrix within the (SU(2)_LotimesSU(2)_RotimesU(1)B₋L) model, based on a (emphmixing-equilibrium condition) for a quark flavour state, postulated as beginequation*     α_q (1 - α_q) = C_q , λ², endequation* where (0 < α_q < 1 - α_q) represents the equilibrium mixing-weight of the sector, (λ² = 1/(2π²)) is the inverse Haar volume measure of (SU(2)_L), and (C_q = 1 + (B-L)_q/2) is the quark coupling factor, with ((B - L)_q) denoting the gauge charge. We define (λ) as the fermion mixing constant, which numerically matches the empirical Cabibbo scale ((λ approx sinθ_C)) and serves as the baseline mixing scale for both the quark and lepton sectors. We have constructed the CKM matrix as the Hadamard product of the isospin activity matrix G and the inter-generational suppression matrix S, followed by exact row unitarization. The matrix elements are expressed directly in terms of λ and α_q, with exact analytical forms provided for every component of G and S. The proposed closed-form formulation of the CKM matrix achieves sub-sigma agreement with 2024 Particle Data Group (PDG) world averages (mean absolute pull of 0.22,σ, maximum pull of 0.59,σ at vert{}Vᵤbvert{}), offering clear advantages over the standard Wolfenstein expansion.   The mixing scale λ_W = λ and the Wolfenstein amplitude A approx 0.819 (0.58,σ from PDG), alongside the CKM unitarity triangle coordinates barρ approx 0.143 and barη approx 0.379 derived from the equilibrium retention-weight 1 - α_q = sinδ₁₃, achieve agreement with global fits within 0.02,σ (for the unitarity apex). Consequently, the phase angle γ = arcsin(1 - α_q) approx 69.54^circ uniquely determines the Jarlskog invariant as Jᵣₘ CP^q approx 3.22 × 10⁻⁵, matching the PDG global fit to within 0.82,σ. The same constant λ underpins the closed-form formulation of the PMNS lepton mixing matrix, where the lepton-sector coupling factor C_ell = 1/2 yields the corresponding lepton parameter α_ell via α_ell(1-α_ell) = C_ellλ², demonstrating that λ = 1/(πsqrt2) is the single universal invariant for quarks as well as leptons. Regardless of the broader interpretation of electroweak symmetry breaking, the proposed analytical approach provides closed-form, parameter-free expressions for CKM observables, with potential insight into flavour-mixing behaviour.

articles.title: Pformer: a plug-and-play periodicity-aware embedding for crystal property prediction
articles.title_zh: Pformer：用于晶体特性预测的即插即用周期性感知嵌入
articles.abstract: Predicting macroscopic properties of crystalline materials from atomic structure remains a central challenge in computational materials science. We introduce Pformer, a modular crystal representation framework built around a Fourier-inspired source encoder. The source model is trained by supervised scalar-property regression from atom attributes and Cartesian coordinates; its Fourier analysis network (FAN) transformation applies sine, cosine, and GELU branches to learned latent projections before Transformer encoding. After source training, Pformer extracts the learned atom-embedding weight matrix, adapts its width when required, and uses it to initialize message-passing graph neural networks and transformer-based crystal encoders for downstream property prediction. We denote each initialized downstream variant as FAN-Backbone (e.g. FAN-PotNet); here FAN identifies the source-encoder component that produced the transferred weights, whereas Pformer denotes the complete transfer framework. On the Materials Project benchmark, FAN-PotNet reduces the bandgap mean absolute error (MAE) from 0.204 to 0.149 eV, and FAN-GATGNN lowers the shear modulus MAE from 0.075 to 0.022 log(GPa). On JARVIS-DFT, FAN-PotNet decreases the total energy MAE from 0.032 to 0.017 eV atom , and FAN-ComFormer improves the MAE from 0.048 to 0.045 eV. These benchmark comparisons show lower MAE for selected backbone–property combinations and ties for others, indicating that the effect of FAN-derived initialization depends on the downstream architecture and target property.
articles.abstract_zh: 从原子结构预测晶体材料的宏观特性仍然是计算材料科学的核心挑战。我们介绍 Pformer，这是一个围绕傅立叶启发的源编码器构建的模块化晶体表示框架。源模型通过原子属性和笛卡尔坐标的有监督标量属性回归进行训练；其傅里叶分析网络 (FAN) 变换在 Transformer 编码之前应用正弦、余弦和 GELU 分支来学习潜在投影。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 从原子结构预测晶体材料的宏观特性仍然是计算材料科学的核心挑战。我们介绍 Pformer，这是一个围绕傅立叶启发的源编码器构建的模块化晶体表示框架。源模型通过原子属性和笛卡尔坐标的有监督标量属性回归进行训练；其傅里叶分析网络 (FAN) 变换在 Transformer 编码之前应用正弦、余弦和 GELU 分支来学习潜在投影。在源训练之后，Pformer 提取学习到的原子嵌入权重矩阵，在需要时调整其宽度，并使用它来初始化消息传递图神经网络和基于变压器的晶体编码器以进行下游属性预测。我们将每个初始化的下游变体表示为 FAN-Backbone（例如 FAN-PotNet）；这里，FAN 标识产生传输权重的源编码器组件，而 Pformer 表示完整的传输框架。在 Materials Project 基准上，FAN-PotNet 将带隙平均绝对误差 (MAE) 从 0.204 eV 降低至 0.149 eV，FAN-GATGNN 将剪切模量 MAE 从 0.075 log(GPa) 降低至 0.022 log(GPa)。在 JARVIS-DFT 上，FAN-PotNet 将原子总能量 MAE 从 0.032 eV 降低到 0.017 eV，FAN-ComFormer 将 MAE 从 0.048 eV 提高到 0.045 eV。这些基准比较显示，所选骨干属性组合的 MAE 较低，而其他组合的 MAE 较低，表明 FAN 派生初始化的效果取决于下游架构和目标属性。

articles.title: Two-stage projection physics-informed neural networks for preserving conservation laws
articles.title_zh: 用于保持守恒定律的两阶段投影物理通知神经网络
articles.abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) can attain small residuals for partial differential equations while drifting from global invariants. We separate residual-based training from invariant enforcement: a standard PINN is trained first, and its output is then projected onto a selected invariant manifold at inference. The correction requires neither retraining nor a conservation penalty in the training objective. We derive explicit projection maps for the Korteweg–de Vries and nonlinear Schrödinger equations and for a mean-conserving Kuramoto–Sivashinsky benchmark. Spatial field evaluation and quadrature are accelerated on a graphics processing unit, while one scalar update is computed for each evaluation time. Across these three one-dimensional benchmarks, projection reduces the selected-invariant violation by a factor of approximately – relative to the unprojected PINN, while prediction errors against the supplied numerical comparison trajectories change little. These results establish a benchmark-level post-processing correction over a unit time horizon; they do not establish long-horizon stability or generality beyond equations with a tractable scalar invariant.
articles.abstract_zh: 物理信息神经网络 (PINN) 可以获得偏微分方程的小残差，同时偏离全局不变量。我们将基于残差的训练与不变执行分开：首先训练标准 PINN，然后在推理时将其输出投影到选定的不变流形上。修正既不需要再训练，也不需要训练目标中的保护惩罚。我们为 Korteweg-de Vries 和非线性薛定谔方程以及均值守恒 Kuramoto-Sivashinsky 基准推导了显式投影图。空间场评估和求积在图形处理单元上加速，同时为每个评估时间计算一个标量更新。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 物理信息神经网络 (PINN) 可以获得偏微分方程的小残差，同时偏离全局不变量。我们将基于残差的训练与不变执行分开：首先训练标准 PINN，然后在推理时将其输出投影到选定的不变流形上。修正既不需要再训练，也不需要训练目标中的保护惩罚。我们为 Korteweg-de Vries 和非线性薛定谔方程以及均值守恒 Kuramoto-Sivashinsky 基准推导了显式投影图。空间场评估和求积在图形处理单元上加速，同时为每个评估时间计算一个标量更新。在这三个一维基准中，相对于未投影的 PINN，投影将选定不变违规减少了大约 1 倍，而针对所提供的数值比较轨迹的预测误差几乎没有变化。这些结果建立了单位时间范围内的基准级后处理校正；它们没有建立超出具有易处理标量不变量的方程的长期稳定性或普遍性。

articles.title: Projected Hessian learning: fast curvature supervision for accurate machine-learning interatomic potentials
articles.title_zh: 投影 Hessian 学习：快速曲率监督，实现准确的机器学习原子间势
articles.abstract: The Hessian matrix of second derivatives contains substantially richer information about the local geometry of the potential energy surface than energies and forces alone. Although incorporating full Hessians into machine-learning interatomic potential (MLIP) training can significantly improve accuracy and robustness, the quadratic computational and memory cost of explicitly constructing and storing Hessian matrices has limited its practical use. Here, we introduce Projected Hessian Learning (PHL), a scalable second-order training framework that incorporates curvature information using only Hessian–vector products (HVPs). By avoiding explicit Hessian construction and instead projecting curvature along stochastic probe directions, PHL reduces the cost of second-derivative supervision to near force-level complexity. The resulting dense-probe trace estimator is unbiased and exhibits favorable scaling with system size, enabling curvature-informed training without quadratic memory growth. We evaluated various training approaches on a chemically diverse dataset of reactants, products, transition states, intrinsic reaction coordinates, and normal-mode sampled geometries generated at the theoretical level B97XD/6-31G(d). Four training schemes are considered: energy-force training (E-F), two HVP-based approaches (E-F-HVP with one-hot or dense Gaussian vectors) and energy-force-Hessian training (E-F-H). When probe vectors are randomized for each minibatch, both HVP-based approaches achieve energy, force, and Hessian accuracy comparable to full Hessian training while providing more than speedups per epoch for the small molecular systems studied here. In a more realistic fixed-vector regime with only one HVP per molecule, dense Gaussian projections consistently outperform one-column probing, particularly for far-from-equilibrium geometries. Paired follow-up training with Rademacher probes gives no statistically significant change in model accuracy relative to the original Gaussian choice, although Rademacher probes have lower single-probe estimator variance and bounded component magnitudes. Overall, PHL effectively replaces explicit Hessian supervision with force-complexity curvature training, retaining most of the accuracy benefits of full second-order methods while enabling scalable MLIP development for larger and more complex molecular systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 二阶导数的 Hessian 矩阵包含比单独的能量和力更丰富的关于势能表面的局部几何形状的信息。尽管将完整的 Hessian 矩阵纳入机器学习原子间势 (MLIP) 训练中可以显着提高准确性和鲁棒性，但显式构建和存储 Hessian 矩阵的二次计算和内存成本限制了其实际使用。在这里，我们介绍投影 Hessian 学习 (PHL)，这是一种可扩展的二阶训练框架，仅使用 Hessian 向量积 (HVP) 来合并曲率信息。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 二阶导数的 Hessian 矩阵包含比单独的能量和力更丰富的关于势能表面的局部几何形状的信息。尽管将完整的 Hessian 矩阵纳入机器学习原子间势 (MLIP) 训练中可以显着提高准确性和鲁棒性，但显式构建和存储 Hessian 矩阵的二次计算和内存成本限制了其实际使用。在这里，我们介绍投影 Hessian 学习 (PHL)，这是一种可扩展的二阶训练框架，仅使用 Hessian 向量积 (HVP) 来合并曲率信息。通过避免显式 Hessian 构造，而是沿着随机探测方向投影曲率，PHL 将二阶导数监督的成本降低到接近力级的复杂性。由此产生的密集探针轨迹估计器是无偏的，并且随着系统大小表现出良好的缩放性，从而无需二次内存增长即可实现曲率通知训练。我们在理论水平 B97XD/6-31G(d) 生成的反应物、产物、过渡态、固有反应坐标和法向模式采样几何形状的化学多样性数据集上评估了各种训练方法。考虑四种训练方案：能量-力训练 (E-F)、两种基于 HVP 的方法（具有单热或密集高斯向量的 E-F-HVP）和能量-力-Hessian 训练 (E-F-H)。当每个小批量的探针向量被随机化时，两种基于 HVP 的方法都实现了与完整 Hessian 训练相当的能量、力和 Hessian 精度，同时为这里研究的小分子系统提供了超过每个周期的加速。在每个分子只有一个 HVP 的更现实的固定矢量方案中，密集高斯投影始终优于单柱探测，特别是对于远离平衡的几何形状。尽管 Rademacher 探针具有较低的单探针估计方差和有界分量幅度，但使用 Rademacher 探针进行配对后续训练相对于原始高斯选择，模型精度没有出现统计学上的显着变化。总体而言，PHL 有效地用力复杂性曲率训练取代了显式 Hessian 监督，保留了完整二阶方法的大部分准确性优势，同时为更大、更复杂的分子系统提供了可扩展的 MLIP 开发。

articles.title: Deterministic and probabilistic neural surrogates of global hybrid-Vlasov simulations
articles.title_zh: 全局混合 Vlasov 模拟的确定性和概率神经代理
articles.abstract: Hybrid-Vlasov simulations resolve ion-kinetic effects in the solar wind–magnetosphere interaction, but even 5D (2D + 3 V) configurations are computationally expensive. We show that graph-based machine learning emulators can learn the spatiotemporal evolution of electromagnetic fields and lower-order moments of the ion velocity distribution function (VDF) in near-Earth space from four 5D Vlasiator runs, each driven by steady solar wind conditions. The upstream ion number density is varied between runs at fixed grid spacing, scanning the ratio of ion inertial length to grid size. Using a graph neural network (GNN) operating on the 2D spatial simulation grid comprising 670k cells, we demonstrate that both a deterministic forecasting model (Graph-FM) and a probabilistic ensemble forecasting model (Graph-EFM) based on a latent variable formulation produce accurate predictions of future plasma states. A divergence penalty is incorporated to encourage divergence-freeness in the magnetic fields. For the probabilistic model, a continuous ranked probability score objective is added to improve the calibration of the ensemble forecasts. In terms of wall time per output step, the trained emulators run over two orders of magnitude faster on a single GPU than the Vlasiator simulations on 100 CPUs, although this comparison involves different hardware and the emulators predict only moments of the ion VDF rather than the full distribution. Most forecasted fields have Pearson correlations above 0.95 at 50 s lead time. Fields that exhibit degenerate (near-zero) distributions in the 5D setting are more challenging for the emulator to keep well correlated. The ensemble forecasts remain underdispersive, with spread–skill ratios of approximately 0.2–0.3, and thus provide spatially structured relative uncertainty estimates. Overall, GNNs offer a viable framework for rapid ensemble generation in hybrid-Vlasov modeling. We diagnose where such moment-based emulation succeeds and fails, and release the dataset and code as an open benchmark for the community.
articles.abstract_zh: 混合-Vlasov 模拟解决了太阳风-磁层相互作用中的离子动力学效应，但即使是 5D (2D + 3 V) 配置的计算成本也很高。我们证明，基于图的机器学习模拟器可以通过四个 5D Vlasiator 运行来学习近地空间中电磁场的时空演化和离子速度分布函数 (VDF) 的低阶矩，每个运行都由稳定的太阳风条件驱动。上游离子数密度在固定网格间距的运行之间变化，扫描离子惯性长度与网格尺寸的比率。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 混合-Vlasov 模拟解决了太阳风-磁层相互作用中的离子动力学效应，但即使是 5D (2D + 3 V) 配置的计算成本也很高。我们证明，基于图的机器学习模拟器可以通过四个 5D Vlasiator 运行来学习近地空间中电磁场的时空演化和离子速度分布函数 (VDF) 的低阶矩，每个运行都由稳定的太阳风条件驱动。上游离子数密度在固定网格间距的运行之间变化，扫描离子惯性长度与网格尺寸的比率。使用在包含 670k 个单元的 2D 空间模拟网格上运行的图神经网络 (GNN)，我们证明了基于潜变量公式的确定性预测模型 (Graph-FM) 和概率集合预测模型 (Graph-EFM) 都能对未来等离子体状态产生准确的预测。引入发散惩罚是为了鼓励磁场中的无发散。对于概率模型，添加连续排序的概率得分目标以改进集合预测的校准。就每个输出步骤的壁时间而言，经过训练的模拟器在单个 GPU 上的运行速度比 Vlasiator 在 100 个 CPU 上的模拟快两个数量级，尽管这种比较涉及不同的硬件，并且模拟器仅预测离子 VDF 的矩而不是完整的分布。大多数预测字段在 50 秒的前置时间内具有高于 0.95 的 Pearson 相关性。在 5D 设置中表现出简并（接近零）分布的场对于模拟器来说保持良好的相关性更具挑战性。集合预报仍然分散不足，传播技能比约为 0.2-0.3，因此提供了空间结构化的相对不确定性估计。总体而言，GNN 为混合 Vlasov 建模中的快速集成生成提供了一个可行的框架。我们诊断这种基于矩的仿真的成功和失败之处，并发布数据集和代码作为社区的开放基准。

articles.title: Magnetic localization and spectral asymmetry of a charged particle at a screw dislocation
articles.title_zh: 带电粒子在螺旋位错处的磁定位和光谱不对称性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.10555v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study a charged particle moving outside a spiral (screw) dislocation in a uniform magnetic field. Although the geometry is locally Euclidean, its global screw identification couples the conserved axial and azimuthal quantities through the combination (J=ell-β k) After eliminating the cyclic coordinates, the radial motion is governed by an inverse-square term determined by J and a harmonic confining term generated by the magnetic field. The corresponding reduced quantum problem is exactly solvable for qB₀≠0, yielding an equally spaced spectrum with an orientation-dependent energy shift. The radial probability density depends on J, and opposite values of the screw-modified quantum number have identical spatial profiles but different energies for a fixed magnetic-field orientation. The radial size scales as (sqrtlangle r²rangleₙpropto |qB₀|⁻¹/²), with the magnetic length setting the localization scale. At qB₀=0, the confining term vanishes, and the problem reduces to a scale-free inverse-square system. Thus, the screw parameter enters the dynamics through the global coupling of the conserved axial and azimuthal quantities, whereas the magnetic field provides radial confinement and its orientation determines the spectral asymmetry.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究在均匀磁场中在螺旋位错外移动的带电粒子。虽然几何形状是局部欧几里德几何，但其全局螺杆识别通过组合 (J=ell-β k) 耦合了守恒的轴向量和方位角量。消除循环坐标后，径向运动由 J 确定的平方反比项和磁场生成的谐波限制项控制。当 qB₀≠0 时，相应的简化量子问题完全可解，产生具有方向相关能量偏移的等距光谱。径向概率密度取决于 J，并且对于固定磁场方向，螺旋修正量子数的相反值具有相同的空间分布但不同的能量。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究在均匀磁场中在螺旋位错外移动的带电粒子。虽然几何形状是局部欧几里德几何，但其全局螺杆识别通过组合 (J=ell-β k) 耦合了守恒的轴向量和方位角量。消除循环坐标后，径向运动由 J 确定的平方反比项和磁场生成的谐波限制项控制。当 qB₀≠0 时，相应的简化量子问题完全可解，产生具有方向相关能量偏移的等距光谱。径向概率密度取决于 J，并且对于固定磁场方向，螺旋修正量子数的相反值具有相同的空间分布但不同的能量。径向尺寸缩放为 (sqrtlangle r²rangleₙpropto |qB₀|⁻1/²)，磁性长度设置定位缩放。当 qB₀=0 时，限制项消失，问题简化为无标度平方反比系统。因此，螺旋参数通过守恒轴向量和方位角量的全局耦合进入动力学，而磁场提供径向限制，其方向决定光谱不对称性。

articles.title: Competing symmetry breaking and topology in quantum spin chains
articles.title_zh: 量子自旋链中的竞争性对称破缺和拓扑
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.10694v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate how spontaneous symmetry breaking and symmetry-protected topology compete and cooperate in one-dimensional quantum spin-1/2 systems. We introduce two families of local Hamiltonians with Z,₂timesZ,₂timesZT₂ symmetry which host a zoo of broken-symmetry phases with and without gapless boundary spins, namely, six long-range-ordered gapped phases that differ by their Z,₂-symmetry-breaking patterns (FM,ₓ,y,z and Neel,ₓ,y,z), their partner symmetry-protected topological phases (FMSPTₓ,y and NeelSPTₓ,y), and two gapless phases (gFM,z and gNeel,z) with incommensurate ZT₂-breaking magnetic long-range order and central charge mathsfc=1. Direct transitions between competing gapped phases can be continuous or weakly first order. We demonstrate that continuous phase transition lines have exotic critical properties. For example, a line of deconfined quantum critical points (between the Neel,ₓ and Neel,y phases) described by Tomonaga-Luttinger liquid theory is terminated by the gFM,z phase at a Lifshitz tricritical point which exhibits spontaneous breaking of the continuous U(1) symmetry despite the locality and one-dimensionality of the Hamiltonian, contrary to a naive expectation from the Hohenberg-Mermin-Wagner-Coleman theorem. Furthermore, critical lines between symmetry-protected topological phases with different Z,₂-symmetry breaking (e.g., NeelSPTₓ and NeelSPTy) additionally retain low-energy boundary degrees of freedom, realizing symmetry-enriched criticality (or a gapless SPT phase). Our results reveal unconventional mechanisms by which competing symmetry breaking and topology generate ordered critical phases and multicriticality.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究自发对称破缺和对称保护拓扑如何在一维量子自旋 1/2 系统中竞争和合作。我们引入了两个具有 Z,2timesZ,2timesZT2 对称性的局部哈密顿量家族，它们拥有一系列具有和不具有无间隙边界自旋的对称破缺相，即六个长程有序有隙相，其不同之处在于其 Z,2 对称破缺模式（FM,ₓ,y,z 和 Neel,ₓ,y,z），以及它们的伙伴对称保护拓扑相（FMSPTₓ,y 和NeelSPTₓ,y) 和两个无间隙相（gFM,z 和 gNeel,z），具有不相称的 ZT2 破坏磁…
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究自发对称破缺和对称保护拓扑如何在一维量子自旋 1/2 系统中竞争和合作。我们引入了两个具有 Z,2timesZ,2timesZT2 对称性的局部哈密顿量家族，它们拥有一系列具有和不具有无间隙边界自旋的对称破缺相，即六个长程有序有隙相，其不同之处在于其 Z,2 对称破缺模式（FM,ₓ,y,z 和 Neel,ₓ,y,z），以及它们的伙伴对称保护拓扑相（FMSPTₓ,y 和NeelSPTₓ,y) 和两个无间隙相（gFM,z 和 gNeel,z），具有不相称的 ZT2 破坏磁长程有序和中心电荷 mathsfc=1。竞争间隙相之间的直接转变可以是连续的或弱一阶的。我们证明连续相变线具有奇特的临界特性。例如，Tomonaga-Luttinger 液体理论描述的一条解禁量子临界点线（Neel,ₓ 和 Neel,y 相之间）在 Lifshitz 三临界点被 gFM,z 相终止，尽管哈密顿量具有局域性和一维性，但表现出连续 U(1) 对称性的自发破缺，这与 Hohenberg-Mermin-Wagner-Coleman 定理的天真的期望相反。此外，具有不同 Z,2 对称性破缺（例如 NeelSPTₓ 和 NeelSPTy）的对称保护拓扑相之间的临界线还保留了低能边界自由度，实现了对称丰富的临界性（或无间隙 SPT 相）。我们的结果揭示了非常规机制，通过竞争对称破缺和拓扑生成有序临界相和多临界性。

articles.title: Symmetric Mode Ansatz: Theory of Magnon Collective Modes in Chern Insulators
articles.title_zh: 对称模 Ansatz：陈绝缘体磁振子集体模理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.10706v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Moiré materials host integer and fractional Chern insulators (FCIs) where time-reversal is broken spontaneously by flat band ferromagnetism. In twisted MoTe2, unlike in quantum Hall, opposite spins carry opposite Chern numbers and realize Ising ferromagnetism with gapped magnon excitations. Clarifying the nature of these collective modes and the origin of the magnon gap is key to understanding the stability of the Chern magnets in these materials. To do so, we develop a generalized single-mode approximation, which we call the symmetric mode ansatz (SyMA), to describe the low-energy magnon spectrum. We find it to be in exceptional agreement with numerical calculations at integer filling, and qualitatively accurate across fractional fillings including FCIs. To explain the accuracy of the SyMA, we present two families of Hubbard models (including the Haldane model and continuum ideal bands) whose collective modes are analytically solvable and for which the SyMA is either exact or an accurate approximation. For a class of these models where SyMA is exact, we prove two-sided bounds on the zero-momentum magnon gap in terms of the Chern number, Berry curvature, and quantum metric, revealing that uniform quantum geometry is sufficient for stabilizing magnetism in Chern bands.
articles.abstract_zh: 莫尔材料具有整数和分数陈绝缘体 (FCI)，其中时间反转会被平带铁磁性自发破坏。与量子霍尔不同，在扭曲的 MoTe2 中，相反的自旋具有相反的陈数，并通过带隙磁振子激发实现伊辛铁磁性。澄清这些集体模式的性质和磁振子能隙的起源是理解这些材料中陈磁铁稳定性的关键。为此，我们开发了一种广义的单模近似，我们称之为对称模 ansatz (SyMA)，来描述低能磁振子谱。我们发现它与整数填充时的数值计算非常一致，并且在包括 FCI 在内的分数填充中质量准确。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 莫尔材料具有整数和分数陈绝缘体 (FCI)，其中时间反转会被平带铁磁性自发破坏。与量子霍尔不同，在扭曲的 MoTe2 中，相反的自旋具有相反的陈数，并通过带隙磁振子激发实现伊辛铁磁性。澄清这些集体模式的性质和磁振子能隙的起源是理解这些材料中陈磁铁稳定性的关键。为此，我们开发了一种广义的单模近似，我们称之为对称模 ansatz (SyMA)，来描述低能磁振子谱。我们发现它与整数填充时的数值计算非常一致，并且在包括 FCI 在内的分数填充中质量准确。为了解释 SyMA 的准确性，我们提出了两个 Hubbard 模型系列（包括 Haldane 模型和连续理想带），它们的集体模式是可分析求解的，并且 SyMA 是精确的或精确的近似。对于 SyMA 精确的一类模型，我们用陈数、贝里曲率和量子度量证明了零动量磁振子能隙的两侧界限，揭示了均匀量子几何足以稳定陈能带中的磁性。

articles.title: Cooper Instability of a Magnetic Wigner Crystal
articles.title_zh: 磁性维格纳晶体的库珀不稳定性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.10710v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent scanning tunneling microscopy has directly imaged electronic crystals in rhombohedral hexalayer graphene, and magnetotransport measurements suggest that superconductivity and charge-density-wave order emerge from a common spin-valley-polarized ferromagnetic metal at nearby carrier densities. Motivated by these observations, we ask whether collective modes in a magnetic Wigner crystal can mediate pairing in this setting. We address this question by studying the Cooper problem for two electrons in the first conduction band of the Wigner crystal. Unlike conventional phonon-mediated pairing, the collective mode (boson) energies and single-particle (fermion) dispersion are comparable scales controlled by the electron density, leaving no small parameter for an adiabatic expansion. Moreover, because the magnetic Wigner crystal is not time-reversal invariant, the usual Cooper logarithmic divergence in the pairing susceptibility is absent, so the attraction must exceed a finite threshold for pairing to occur. These unusual features motivate a numerical experiment to see whether the crystal's own vibrations can bind electrons. We obtain the crystalline ground state and its collective mode spectrum within Hartree--Fock and time-dependent Hartree--Fock approximation, and derive the electron--phonon Hamiltonian using the quasiboson approximation. Solving the resulting two-electron problem, we find that phonon-mediated attraction exceeds the pairing threshold, with chiral p-wave pairing as the leading instability. Within these approximations, we show that collective modes of a Wigner crystal can indeed favor chiral pairing despite broken time-reversal symmetry. Our results provide an encouraging starting point for developing a full many-body theory to study electronic crystallization and superconductivity.
articles.abstract_zh: 最近的扫描隧道显微镜直接对菱面体六层石墨烯中的电子晶体进行了成像，并且磁输运测量表明，超导性和电荷密度波序是在附近的载流子密度下从常见的自旋谷极化铁磁金属中出现的。受这些观察的启发，我们询问磁性维格纳晶体中的集体模式是否可以在这种情况下介导配对。我们通过研究维格纳晶体第一导带中两个电子的库珀问题来解决这个问题。与传统的声子介导配对不同，集体模式（玻色子）能量和单粒子（费米子）色散是由电子密度控制的可比尺度，为绝热膨胀留下了不小的参数。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 最近的扫描隧道显微镜直接对菱面体六层石墨烯中的电子晶体进行了成像，并且磁输运测量表明，超导性和电荷密度波序是在附近的载流子密度下从常见的自旋谷极化铁磁金属中出现的。受这些观察的启发，我们询问磁性维格纳晶体中的集体模式是否可以在这种情况下介导配对。我们通过研究维格纳晶体第一导带中两个电子的库珀问题来解决这个问题。与传统的声子介导配对不同，集体模式（玻色子）能量和单粒子（费米子）色散是由电子密度控制的可比尺度，为绝热膨胀留下了不小的参数。此外，由于磁性维格纳晶体不是时间反转不变的，配对敏感性中常见的库珀对数散度不存在，因此吸引力必须超过配对发生的有限阈值。这些不寻常的特征激发了数值实验的兴趣，以了解晶体自身的振动是否可以束缚电子。我们在Hartree-Fock和时间相关的Hartree-Fock近似中获得了晶体基态及其集体模式谱，并使用准玻色子近似推导了电子-声子哈密顿量。解决由此产生的双电子问题，我们发现声子介导的吸引力超过了配对阈值，手性 p 波配对是主要的不稳定性。在这些近似值中，我们表明，尽管时间反转对称性被打破，维格纳晶体的集体模式确实有利于手性配对。我们的结果为开发完整的多体理论来研究电子结晶和超导性提供了一个令人鼓舞的起点。

articles.title: Quantum simulation of material-specific Hubbard models with alkaline-earth atoms
articles.title_zh: 使用碱土原子对特定材料哈伯德模型进行量子模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.10713v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A long-term goal of quantum simulation is to faithfully reproduce the low-energy Hamiltonians of correlated quantum materials, establishing a direct connection between solid-state experiment, electronic-structure theory, and programmable many-body systems. Here, we introduce an integrated quantum-simulation architecture based on fermionic alkaline-earth atoms that enables programmable control over the key ingredients of multi-orbital material Hamiltonians. Long-lived clock states encode synthetic orbitals, their differential polarizabilities generate orbital-selective tunneling, and contact interactions provide multi-orbital Hubbard and Hund couplings. Spatially structured coherent driving on the ultra-narrow clock transition further realizes symmetry-selective inter-orbital hybridization, while the clock detuning independently controls orbital energy offsets. In this way, the spatial symmetries of solid-state orbitals can be encoded directly into the effective Hamiltonian, even though the atoms themselves remain in conventional s-wave Wannier orbitals of the lowest optical-lattice bands. We demonstrate the resulting integrated control using the four-band low-energy Hamiltonian of the bilayer nickelate La₃Ni₂O₇ as a demanding benchmark. Self-consistent calculations show that the microscopic parameters obtained from first-principles modeling can be reproduced within a single experimentally accessible lattice configuration and independently programmed over substantial parameter ranges. Our results establish a general route for translating material-derived multi-orbital Hamiltonians into programmable ultracold-atom quantum simulators.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子模拟的长期目标是忠实地再现相关量子材料的低能哈密顿量，在固态实验、电子结构理论和可编程多体系统之间建立直接联系。在这里，我们介绍了一种基于费米子碱土原子的集成量子模拟架构，该架构能够对多轨道材料哈密顿量的关键成分进行可编程控制。长寿命时钟状态编码合成轨道，它们的不同极化率产生轨道选择性隧道，接触相互作用提供多轨道哈伯德和亨德耦合。超窄时钟跃迁上的空间结构相干驱动进一步实现了对称选择性轨道间杂化，而时钟失谐独立控制轨道能量偏移。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子模拟的长期目标是忠实地再现相关量子材料的低能哈密顿量，在固态实验、电子结构理论和可编程多体系统之间建立直接联系。在这里，我们介绍了一种基于费米子碱土原子的集成量子模拟架构，该架构能够对多轨道材料哈密顿量的关键成分进行可编程控制。长寿命时钟状态编码合成轨道，它们的不同极化率产生轨道选择性隧道，接触相互作用提供多轨道哈伯德和亨德耦合。超窄时钟跃迁上的空间结构相干驱动进一步实现了对称选择性轨道间杂化，而时钟失谐独立控制轨道能量偏移。通过这种方式，固态轨道的空间对称性可以直接编码到有效哈密顿量中，即使原子本身仍然处于最低光学晶格带的传统 s 波万尼尔轨道中。我们使用双层镍酸盐 La₃Ni2O₇ 的四带低能哈密顿量作为严格的基准来演示由此产生的集成控制。自洽计算表明，从第一原理建模获得的微观参数可以在单个实验可访问的晶格配置中重现，并在相当大的参数范围内独立编程。我们的结果建立了将材料衍生的多轨道哈密顿量转化为可编程超冷原子量子模拟器的通用途径。

articles.title: Gauging Modulated Symmetries: Bond Algebras, Higher-Form Symmetries, and Symmetry-Enriched Topological Order
articles.title_zh: 测量调制对称性：键代数、高阶对称性和丰富对称性的拓扑顺序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.10764v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop a constructive framework for characterizing modulated symmetries and their gauging in d-dimensional lattice systems. The modulation profiles are organized as a finite-dimensional representation of the space group acting on a finite Abelian internal symmetry group. Since the corresponding automorphism group is finite, the nontrivial spatial action factors through a finite quotient of the space group, leading to periodic modulation patterns and providing a classification framework for discrete Abelian modulated symmetries. The symmetry-allowed local interactions are systematically obtained from a kernel construction, which also yields an algebra of open operators. Upon gauging, its elements are transmuted into extended Wilson and boundary operators while retaining their algebraic relations. In the deconfined regime, the resulting algebra realizes a mixed 't Hooft anomaly, providing a microscopic route to Abelian crystalline symmetry-enriched topological phases (SETs). These SETs do not mix electric and magnetic sectors, which transform in mutually contragredient representations, thereby preserving their braiding pairing. We illustrate the framework through explicit examples and show that several models present in the literature fit naturally within our construction.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们开发了一个构建性框架来表征调制对称性及其在 d 维晶格系统中的测量。调制轮廓被组织为作用于有限阿贝尔内部对称群的空间群的有限维表示。由于相应的自同构群是有限的，非平凡的空间作用因素通过空间群的有限商，导致周期性调制模式并为离散阿贝尔调制对称性提供分类框架。对称性允许的局部相互作用是从核构造中系统地获得的，这也产生了开算子的代数。经过测量，它的元素被转换为扩展的威尔逊和边界算子，同时保留它们的代数关系。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们开发了一个构建性框架来表征调制对称性及其在 d 维晶格系统中的测量。调制轮廓被组织为作用于有限阿贝尔内部对称群的空间群的有限维表示。由于相应的自同构群是有限的，非平凡的空间作用因素通过空间群的有限商，导致周期性调制模式并为离散阿贝尔调制对称性提供分类框架。对称性允许的局部相互作用是从核构造中系统地获得的，这也产生了开算子的代数。经过测量，它的元素被转换为扩展的威尔逊和边界算子，同时保留它们的代数关系。在解除限制的情况下，由此产生的代数实现了混合't Hooft异常，为阿贝尔晶体对称性丰富的拓扑相（SET）提供了微观途径。这些 SET 不混合电磁扇区，它们以相互矛盾的表示形式进行转换，从而保留了它们的编织配对。我们通过明确的例子来说明该框架，并表明文献中存在的几个模型自然适合我们的构建。

articles.title: Supercurrent as a bulk probe for topological phase
articles.title_zh: 超电流作为拓扑相的体探针
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.10814v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Distinguishing trivial from topological superconducting phase remains a central and contested experimental challenge, since most existing probes infer the bulk phase transition indirectly, from boundary signatures that can be sensitive to local physics. Here, we propose an alternative that probes the bulk topological phase and is based on supercurrent response. We study a one-dimensional Rashba spin-orbit-coupled superconducting nanowire with an applied magnetic field that opens a topological gap. We show that for strong spin-orbit coupling, the superfluid stiffness, and consequently the supercurrent, is suppressed by a factor of two inside the topological phase, producing a non-monotonic signature of the bulk phase transition as a function of chemical potential. We further use a low-energy helical model to understand this suppression analytically. Our results show that the bulk topological phase transition can be detected through kinetic inductance measurements.
articles.abstract_zh: 区分平凡相和拓扑超导相仍然是一个中心且有争议的实验挑战，因为大多数现有探针从对局部物理敏感的边界特征间接推断体相变。在这里，我们提出了一种基于超电流响应探测体拓扑相的替代方案。我们研究了一种一维 Rashba 自旋轨道耦合超导纳米线，其施加的磁场打开了拓扑间隙。我们表明，对于强自旋轨道耦合，超流体刚度以及由此产生的超电流在拓扑相内被抑制为两倍，从而产生作为化学势函数的体相变的非单调特征。我们进一步使用低能量螺旋模型来分析理解这种抑制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 区分平凡相和拓扑超导相仍然是一个中心且有争议的实验挑战，因为大多数现有探针从对局部物理敏感的边界特征间接推断体相变。在这里，我们提出了一种基于超电流响应探测体拓扑相的替代方案。我们研究了一种一维 Rashba 自旋轨道耦合超导纳米线，其施加的磁场打开了拓扑间隙。我们表明，对于强自旋轨道耦合，超流体刚度以及由此产生的超电流在拓扑相内被抑制为两倍，从而产生作为化学势函数的体相变的非单调特征。我们进一步使用低能量螺旋模型来分析理解这种抑制。我们的结果表明，可以通过动态电感测量来检测体拓扑相变。

articles.title: EPR as a probe for the mechanisms of chirality-induced spin selectivity in photoinduced charge transfer
articles.title_zh: EPR 作为光致电荷转移中手性诱导自旋选择性机制的探针
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.10839v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Several models for chirality-induced spin selectivity (CISS) in charge transfer have been proposed, but rarely compared directly with experiments. This step is essential for their validation and future progress of the field. Here we investigate a broad class of radical pair states associated with different microscopic models by computing the related electron-paramagnetic resonance spectra. This allows us to evidence peculiar signatures of different radical pair states, to study their experimental accessibility and identify conditions to verify proposed microscopic models.
articles.abstract_zh: 人们已经提出了电荷转移中手性诱导自旋选择性（CISS）的几种模型，但很少直接与实验进行比较。这一步对于他们的验证和该领域的未来进展至关重要。在这里，我们通过计算相关的电子顺磁共振谱来研究与不同微观模型相关的一类广泛的自由基对态。这使我们能够证明不同自由基对状态的特殊特征，研究它们的实验可访问性并确定验证所提出的微观模型的条件。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 人们已经提出了电荷转移中手性诱导自旋选择性（CISS）的几种模型，但很少直接与实验进行比较。这一步对于他们的验证和该领域的未来进展至关重要。在这里，我们通过计算相关的电子顺磁共振谱来研究与不同微观模型相关的一类广泛的自由基对态。这使我们能够证明不同自由基对状态的特殊特征，研究它们的实验可访问性并确定验证所提出的微观模型的条件。

articles.title: Data driven screening of CaCu₅-type magnetic structures
articles.title_zh: CaCu₅型磁性结构的数据驱动筛选
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.10891v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop a machine learning assisted workflow for the rapid screening of permanent magnet candidates within the CaCu₅ structure family. We generated more than 60,000 structures through substitutions. These compositions were screened using a combination of pretrained materials models, Materials Project data, and a machine-learning model for magnetization prediction. Four criteria, namely, metallicity, negative formation energy, energy above the convex hull ≤ 50~meV/atom, and predicted magnetization above the adopted ≥ 0.75~T threshold reduced the initial chemical space to 439 candidates for first-principles calculations. Density functional theory calculations revealed that 159 compounds exhibit positive axial magnetic anisotropy energy, favoring [001] over the tested in-plane directions. The resulting dataset reveals chemical trends in magnetic anisotropy across the CaCu₅ compositional space and provides a set of candidates for further investigation. More broadly, this work demonstrates a practical strategy for combining existing machine learning models with first-principles calculations to systematically reduce large chemical spaces to tractable sets for computationally intensive materials screening.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们开发了机器学习辅助工作流程，用于快速筛选 CaCu₅ 结构系列中的候选永磁体。我们通过替换生成了 60,000 多个结构。使用预训练材料模型、材料项目数据和用于磁化强度预测的机器学习模型的组合来筛选这些成分。四个标准，即金属丰度、负形成能、凸包之上的能量≤50~meV/原子以及高于采用的≥0.75~T阈值的预测磁化强度将第一性原理计算的初始化学空间减少到439个候选者。密度泛函理论计算表明，159 种化合物表现出正轴向磁各向异性能量，比测试的面内方向更有利于 [001]。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们开发了机器学习辅助工作流程，用于快速筛选 CaCu₅ 结构系列中的候选永磁体。我们通过替换生成了 60,000 多个结构。使用预训练材料模型、材料项目数据和用于磁化强度预测的机器学习模型的组合来筛选这些成分。四个标准，即金属丰度、负形成能、凸包之上的能量≤50~meV/原子以及高于采用的≥0.75~T阈值的预测磁化强度将第一性原理计算的初始化学空间减少到439个候选者。密度泛函理论计算表明，159 种化合物表现出正轴向磁各向异性能量，比测试的面内方向更有利于 [001]。由此产生的数据集揭示了 CaCu₅ 成分空间中磁各向异性的化学趋势，并为进一步研究提供了一组候选数据。更广泛地说，这项工作展示了一种实用策略，将现有的机器学习模型与第一原理计算相结合，系统地将大型化学空间减少为易于处理的集合，以进行计算密集型材料筛选。

articles.title: Band Tail States: Speed Bump or End of the Road for Two-Dimensional Semiconductors?
articles.title_zh: 带尾态：二维半导体的减速带还是道路的尽头？
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.10953v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose that the path to realizing the full potential of two-dimensional (2D) electronics lies in understanding and mastering their energy band tail states (BTS). Unlike silicon, which benefits from sharp band edges (Urbach energy E_rm U ~ 10 meV), today's monolayer 2D semiconductors have rough band edges (E_rm U ~ 100 meV) caused by spatial potential inhomogeneity. Comparing a physics-based electrical model to experiments, we demonstrate that BTS cause reduced effective mobility and "slow" transistor turn-on with excessive gate voltage in monolayer 2D transistors, which sets a fundamental limit for their energy-efficient operation. We also show that BTS effects in 2D transistors could be mitigated with higher gate capacitance, with strain engineering, and by using bilayer instead of monolayer 2D channels, as long as E_rm U is reduced below ~ 50 meV. This work provides a theoretical framework and design guidelines to navigate these fundamental limits, and to enable successful integration of 2D semiconductors into low-power nanoelectronics.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出，实现二维（2D）电子学全部潜力的途径在于理解和掌握其能带尾态（BTS）。与受益于尖锐能带边缘（Urbach 能量 E_rm U ~ 10 meV）的硅不同，当今的单层二维半导体具有由空间电位不均匀性引起的粗糙带边缘（E_rm U ~ 100 meV）。通过将基于物理的电气模型与实验进行比较，我们证明 BTS 会导致有效迁移率降低，并且单层 2D 晶体管中栅极电压过高，导致晶体管开启“缓慢”，这为其节能运行设定了基本限制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出，实现二维（2D）电子学全部潜力的途径在于理解和掌握其能带尾态（BTS）。与受益于尖锐能带边缘（Urbach 能量 E_rm U ~ 10 meV）的硅不同，当今的单层二维半导体具有由空间电位不均匀性引起的粗糙带边缘（E_rm U ~ 100 meV）。通过将基于物理的电气模型与实验进行比较，我们证明 BTS 会导致有效迁移率降低，并且单层 2D 晶体管中栅极电压过高，导致晶体管开启“缓慢”，这为其节能运行设定了基本限制。我们还表明，只要 E_rm U 降低到约 50 meV 以下，就可以通过更高的栅极电容、应变工程以及使用双层而不是单层 2D 通道来减轻 2D 晶体管中的 BTS 效应。这项工作提供了理论框架和设计指南，以克服这些基本限制，并使二维半导体成功集成到低功耗纳米电子学中。

articles.title: Reading Altermagnetic Domains with Photon Drag
articles.title_zh: 用光子拖动读取交变磁畴
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.10970v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Finite photon momentum allows second-order photocurrents in centrosymmetric space groups, where the conventional bulk photovoltaic effect is forbidden. Here we study the photon-drag response of altermagnets and show that its angular dependence reveals both the symmetry of the magnetic order and the Néel domain of the sample. For example, when a crystal rotation exchanges the two domains, the domain-even and domain-odd parts of the current appear in different angular harmonics, 4n and 4n+2 for tetragonal d-wave altermagnets, so that two measurements rotated by 90^circ on a single domain isolate the domain-odd current. We also find that these microscopic contributions exhibit opposite domain parities depending on light polarization. Under linear light, only the shift term is domain odd, while under circular light, the domain-odd channel switches to the injection, Fermi-surface, and contact principal-value terms. Mirror symmetries fix the angular phase of each harmonic and distinguish dₓ^₂₋y^₂, dₓy, and g-wave order. In contrast, conventional collinear antiferromagnets show no domain-odd photon-drag current, and in tetragonal ferromagnets the two parts share the same harmonics. Although the altermagnetic spin splitting does not require spin-orbit coupling (SOC), SOC is essential to observe the domain-odd charge current. Our work uncovers distinct signatures of altermagnetism in photon drag and provides a route to all optical magnetic readouts of altermagnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 有限的光子动量允许在中心对称空间群中产生二阶光电流，而传统的体光伏效应是被禁止的。在这里，我们研究了交流磁体的光子拖曳响应，并表明其角度依赖性揭示了磁序和样品的尼尔磁域的对称性。例如，当晶体旋转交换两个磁畴时，电流的偶磁畴和奇磁畴部分出现在不同的角谐波中，对于四方 d 波交流磁体，为 4n 和 4n+2，因此在单个磁畴上旋转 90^circ 的两个测量会隔离奇磁畴电流。我们还发现，这些微观贡献根据光偏振表现出相反的域奇偶性。
