articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12041v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Owing to their atomically clean interfaces and extreme thinness, two-dimensional (2D) materials are ideal hosts for strong proximity effects, whereby contact with an adjacent material reshapes their ground state. Here, we demonstrate such an effect within a hybrid heterostructure, between the 2D antiferromagnet FePS₃ and an ultrathin gold film. Rather than a passive support, the latter profoundly changes the nature of the magnetism in the 2D magnet, inducing a sizeable interfacial moment. Large-area flakes from Au-assisted exfoliation, combined with element-selective X-ray absorption mapping, enable a layer-by-layer study from monolayer to bulk, benchmarked against an inert SiO₂ substrate reference. At 9 T and 5 K, the monolayer on gold shows a three-fold enhanced X-ray magnetic circular dichroism relative to SiO₂, with a sim40% reduction of the orbital-to-spin moment ratio. Resonant inelastic X-ray scattering reveals a collapse of the crystal-field (d-d) excitations and a massive spectral-weight transfer to the charge-transfer region, unveiling the microscopic mechanism behind this change. Supported by atomic multiplet calculations, we identify interfacial charge transfer and Fe 3d-Au hybridization as the origin of these effects, which decay over the first three layers and vanish at the pentalayer, establishing layer number combined with substrate engineering as an atomically precise handle.
articles.abstract_zh: 由于其原子级清洁的界面和极薄的特性，二维 (2D) 材料是强邻近效应的理想主体，通过与邻近材料的接触重塑其基态。在这里，我们证明了二维反铁磁体 FePS₃ 和超薄金膜之间的混合异质结构中的这种效应。后者不是被动支撑，而是深刻改变了二维磁体的磁性性质，产生了相当大的界面力矩。 Au 辅助剥离产生的大面积薄片与元素选择性 X 射线吸收图谱相结合，能够以惰性 SiO2 基板为基准进行从单层到块体的逐层研究。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 由于其原子级清洁的界面和极薄的特性，二维 (2D) 材料是强邻近效应的理想主体，通过与邻近材料的接触重塑其基态。在这里，我们证明了二维反铁磁体 FePS₃ 和超薄金膜之间的混合异质结构中的这种效应。后者不是被动支撑，而是深刻改变了二维磁体的磁性性质，产生了相当大的界面力矩。 Au 辅助剥离产生的大面积薄片与元素选择性 X 射线吸收图谱相结合，能够以惰性 SiO2 基板为基准进行从单层到块体的逐层研究。在 9 T 和 5 K 下，金上的单分子层表现出相对于 SiO2 增强三倍的 X 射线磁圆二色性，轨道与自旋矩比降低了 sim40%。共振非弹性 X 射线散射揭示了晶体场 (d-d) 激发的崩溃以及向电荷转移区域的大量光谱权重转移，揭示了这种变化背后的微观机制。在原子多重计算的支持下，我们将界面电荷转移和 Fe 3d-Au 杂化确定为这些效应的根源，这些效应在前三层中衰减并在五层中消失，将层数与基底工程结合起来作为原子精确的处理。

articles.title: Field-resolved hierarchy of superconducting energy gaps in PdTe
articles.title_zh: PdTe 中超导能隙的场分辨层次
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12075v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Resolving how multiple superconducting energy scales evolve under magnetic field is important for distinguishing multiband, anisotropic, and surface-sensitive superconducting responses. Here, we investigate the superconducting state of PdTe using low-temperature soft point-contact spectroscopy in a sealed ³He immersion environment. The resulting Andreev-reflection spectra reveal two characteristic superconducting energy scales near 0.5 and 1.1 meV that are not adequately described by a single-gap BTK model. Both energy scales are progressively suppressed upon warming toward the same superconducting transition temperature T_c. In contrast, their magnetic-field evolution reveals two distinct characteristic fields near 4.5 and 7.5 kG. The lower scale is associated with the loss of the zero-resistance superconducting state, whereas the higher-energy spectroscopic response persists to substantially larger fields. Independent field-dependent gap analysis yields suppression scales consistent with those identified from the zero-bias conductance. These results reveal a field-resolved hierarchy of superconducting energy scales in PdTe and indicate superconducting responses with distinct magnetic-field robustness.
articles.abstract_zh: 解决磁场下多个超导能尺度如何演化对于区分多带、各向异性和表面敏感的超导响应非常重要。在这里，我们在密封的氦气浸没环境中使用低温软点接触光谱研究了 PdTe 的超导状态。由此产生的安德烈夫反射光谱揭示了两个接近 0.5 和 1.1 meV 的特征超导能级，单能隙 BTK 模型无法充分描述这些能级。当升温至相同的超导转变温度 T_c 时，两个能级都逐渐受到抑制。相比之下，它们的磁场演化揭示了 4.5 kG 和 7.5 kG 附近的两个不同的特征场。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 解决磁场下多个超导能尺度如何演化对于区分多带、各向异性和表面敏感的超导响应非常重要。在这里，我们在密封的氦气浸没环境中使用低温软点接触光谱研究了 PdTe 的超导状态。由此产生的安德烈夫反射光谱揭示了两个接近 0.5 和 1.1 meV 的特征超导能级，单能隙 BTK 模型无法充分描述这些能级。当升温至相同的超导转变温度 T_c 时，两个能级都逐渐受到抑制。相比之下，它们的磁场演化揭示了 4.5 kG 和 7.5 kG 附近的两个不同的特征场。较低的尺度与零电阻超导状态的丧失相关，而较高能量的光谱响应持续到更大的场。独立的场相关间隙分析产生的抑制尺度与从零偏置电导中确定的抑制尺度一致。这些结果揭示了 PdTe 中超导能量尺度的场分辨层次结构，并表明具有不同磁场鲁棒性的超导响应。

articles.title: A structure-preserving neural density functional for the ions of a polymer electrolyte
articles.title_zh: 聚合物电解质离子的结构保持神经密度函数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12132v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Predicting the structure and response of inhomogeneous polymer electrolytes requires a description of ion correlations that retains molecular-scale accuracy while remaining transferable across spatial scales and geometries. We develop a neural density functional for electrolytes that preserves spatial symmetries, thermodynamic integrability and the Noether identities, with perfect screening recovered in stable, noncritical bulk states. Its nonlinear density dependence captures the concentration-dependent correlations missed by a pair closure, including a crossover from enhanced to suppressed long-wavelength number fluctuations at strong coupling. The functional describes density profiles at an untrained salt concentration and predicts bulk structure factors and the long-wavelength number response. Trained solely on planar density and internal-force profiles from molecular dynamics, the functional predicts ionic structure in larger domains and in two-dimensional external fields. On the same ion data, it is more accurate than three other neural density-functional architectures and keeps its accuracy with a quarter of the training runs, where the errors of the best alternative grow by about two thirds. The spatial transferability provides a necessary foundation for connecting molecular correlations to continuum predictions at larger scales.
articles.abstract_zh: 预测非均质聚合物电解质的结构和响应需要对离子相关性的描述，该描述保留分子尺度的准确性，同时保持跨空间尺度和几何形状的可转移性。我们开发了一种适用于电解质的神经密度函数，可以保留空间对称性、热力学可积性和诺特恒等式，并在稳定、非临界的本体状态下恢复完美的筛选。其非线性密度依赖性捕获了对闭合所错过的浓度依赖性相关性，包括强耦合时从增强到抑制的长波长数波动的交叉。该函数描述了未经训练的盐浓度下的密度分布，并预测了体积结构因子和长波长数响应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 预测非均质聚合物电解质的结构和响应需要对离子相关性的描述，该描述保留分子尺度的准确性，同时保持跨空间尺度和几何形状的可转移性。我们开发了一种适用于电解质的神经密度函数，可以保留空间对称性、热力学可积性和诺特恒等式，并在稳定、非临界的本体状态下恢复完美的筛选。其非线性密度依赖性捕获了对闭合所错过的浓度依赖性相关性，包括强耦合时从增强到抑制的长波长数波动的交叉。该函数描述了未经训练的盐浓度下的密度分布，并预测了体积结构因子和长波长数响应。仅根据分子动力学的平面密度和内力分布进行训练，该函数可以预测较大域和二维外部场中的离子结构。在相同的离子数据上，它比其他三种神经密度函数架构更准确，并且在四分之一的训练运行中保持其准确性，其中最佳替代方案的误差增长了约三分之二。空间可转移性为将分子相关性与更大尺度的连续预测联系起来提供了必要的基础。

articles.title: Direct Quantification of Molecular Helicity-Dependent Effective Magnetic Fields in Chiral Polypeptide/Ferromagnet Heterostructures
articles.title_zh: 手性多肽/铁磁体异质结构中分子螺旋性相关有效磁场的直接定量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12145v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chirality-Induced Spin Selectivity (CISS) refers to structural chirality governing spin transport in chiral systems, with experimental signatures reported in both transport experiments and photoemission. Beyond influencing transport, recent experiments indicate that adsorbed chiral molecules can influence the magnetic state of adjacent ferromagnetic layers, suggesting the existence of chirality-induced effects whose origin and quantitative characterization remain lacking. Here, we investigate chirality-induced long-range magnetic interactions in a hybrid molecular/ferromagnetic multilayer beyond the conventional direct transport coupling. We demonstrate the long-range nature by decoupling the adsorbed chiral molecules from the magnet using an insulating spacer. We show that self-assembled monolayers of chiral polypeptides with a helical structure can act on a ferromagnetic multilayer via an enantiomer-dependent effective magnetic field that may be mediated by chiral phonons through the insulating layer. Using Magneto-Optical Kerr Effect (MOKE) microscopy with on-chip reference regions free of molecules, we directly quantify this field by measuring precisely the reproducible shifts of the local hysteresis loops. The extracted effective field reverses sign for opposite enantiomers and correlates with the enantiomeric excess. These results provide a direct and quantitative link between molecular chirality and magnetic response in hybrid heterostructures, establishing an experimentally accessible benchmark for a CISS-related effect.
articles.abstract_zh: 手性诱导自旋选择性（CISS）是指控制手性系统中自旋输运的结构手性，在输运实验和光电发射中报告了实验特征。除了影响传输之外，最近的实验表明，吸附的手性分子可以影响相邻铁磁层的磁性状态，这表明手性诱导效应的存在，其起源和定量表征仍然缺乏。在这里，我们研究了混合分子/铁磁多层中手性诱导的长程磁相互作用，超越了传统的直接传输耦合。我们通过使用绝缘垫片将吸附的手性分子与磁体解耦来证明长程性质。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 手性诱导自旋选择性（CISS）是指控制手性系统中自旋输运的结构手性，在输运实验和光电发射中报告了实验特征。除了影响传输之外，最近的实验表明，吸附的手性分子可以影响相邻铁磁层的磁性状态，这表明手性诱导效应的存在，其起源和定量表征仍然缺乏。在这里，我们研究了混合分子/铁磁多层中手性诱导的长程磁相互作用，超越了传统的直接传输耦合。我们通过使用绝缘垫片将吸附的手性分子与磁体解耦来证明长程性质。我们证明，具有螺旋结构的手性多肽的自组装单层可以通过对映异构体依赖的有效磁场作用于铁磁多层，该磁场可能由手性声子通过绝缘层介导。使用磁光克尔效应 (MOKE) 显微镜和不含分子的片上参考区域，我们通过精确测量局部磁滞回线的可重复位移来直接量化该场。提取的有效场反转相反对映体的符号，并与对映体过量相关。这些结果提供了混合异质结构中分子手性和磁响应之间的直接定量联系，为 CISS 相关效应建立了实验上可访问的基准。

articles.title: Specialized machine learning force fields for materials dynamics
articles.title_zh: 用于材料动力学的专业机器学习力场
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12151v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) are transforming atomistic simulations by accessing unprecedented length and time scales. While pretrained equivariant graph neural networks achieve robust zero-shot performance for near-equilibrium properties across broad chemical spaces, their translation to complex materials dynamics remains fundamentally challenged by out-of-distribution reactive states, representation biases, and computational scaling limits. In this Review, we examine how physics-driven specialization extends the applicability of MLIPs to complex dynamical systems. We systematically evaluate the structural trade-offs in MLIP design: the undersampling of highly strained configurations, the prohibitive computational overhead of high-order message-passing architectures, and the necessity of nonlocal interactions for open and field-coupled systems. Through four demanding application contexts - electrified interfaces, compositionally fluctuating open systems, multiphase evolution, and large-scale fracture - we establish a framework for observable-specific validation. Highlighting the complementary roles of universal foundation models and task-specific potentials, we emphasize that targeted adaptations must be rigorously benchmarked against intended observables. We conclude with a roadmap for developing physically consistent, hardware-aware force fields that seamlessly connect electronic-structure accuracy to macroscopic materials phenomena.
articles.abstract_zh: 机器学习原子间势（MLIP）通过访问前所未有的长度和时间尺度正在改变原子模拟。虽然预训练的等变图神经网络在广泛的化学空间中实现了近平衡特性的鲁棒零样本性能，但它们向复杂材料动力学的转化仍然受到分布外反应状态、表示偏差和计算缩放限制的根本挑战。在这篇综述中，我们研究了物理驱动的专业化如何将 MLIP 的适用性扩展到复杂的动力系统。我们系统地评估了 MLIP 设计中的结构权衡：高度紧张配置的欠采样、高阶消息传递架构的令人望而却步的计算开销，以及开放和场耦合系统非局部交互的必要性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 机器学习原子间势（MLIP）通过访问前所未有的长度和时间尺度正在改变原子模拟。虽然预训练的等变图神经网络在广泛的化学空间中实现了近平衡特性的鲁棒零样本性能，但它们向复杂材料动力学的转化仍然受到分布外反应状态、表示偏差和计算缩放限制的根本挑战。在这篇综述中，我们研究了物理驱动的专业化如何将 MLIP 的适用性扩展到复杂的动力系统。我们系统地评估了 MLIP 设计中的结构权衡：高度紧张配置的欠采样、高阶消息传递架构的令人望而却步的计算开销，以及开放和场耦合系统非局部交互的必要性。通过四个要求严格的应用环境——电气化接口、成分波动的开放系统、多相演化和大规模断裂——我们建立了一个可观测特定验证的框架。我们强调通用基础模型和特定任务潜力的互补作用，强调有针对性的适应必须根据预期的可观察结果进行严格的基准测试。最后，我们提出了开发物理一致、硬件感知力场的路线图，将电子结构精度与宏观材料现象无缝连接。

articles.title: Orbital magnetic susceptibility and de Haas-van Alphen effect of a flat band from quantum geometry
articles.title_zh: 量子几何中平带的轨道磁化率和德哈斯-范阿尔芬效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12193v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A band that is exactly flat at zero magnetic field has zero velocity, a divergent effective mass, and no Fermi surface, so the standard theory of orbital magnetism does not apply. We show that the magnetic field generates an effective dispersion. In the expansion organized by the Moyal algebra of the noncommutative kinetic momenta, the band energy acquires a first-order shift B,M(mathbf k), set by the orbital moment of the Bloch state, and a second-order shift tfrac12X(mathbf k)B², whose gauge-invariant coefficient we obtain in closed form. These two functions, together with the Berry curvature Ω, fix the entire orbital response. The susceptibility is purely geometric, and for a generic isolated flat band it reproduces the established gauge-invariant response formula. With the chemical potential pinned to the flat band, the M=0 contour becomes an emergent Fermi surface, and bosonizing excitations in its vicinity yields a modified Lifshitz--Kosevich formula with level spacing quadratic in B. The phase shift of the oscillations is given jointly by the Berry phase around the emergent Fermi surface and X. When the band is narrow rather than exactly flat, the oscillation frequency crosses over, with a parameter-free profile, from the zero-field Fermi-surface area to the area of the M=0 contour. We verify our analytical findings numerically by exactly diagonalizing a flattened Chern lattice model.
articles.abstract_zh: 在零磁场下完全平坦的能带具有零速度、发散的有效质量并且没有费米面，因此轨道磁性的标准理论不适用。我们证明磁场产生有效的色散。在由非交换动动量的 Moyal 代数组织的展开中，能带能量获得由布洛赫态的轨道矩设置的一阶位移 B,M(mathbf k) 和二阶位移 tfrac12X(mathbf k)B²，我们以封闭形式获得其规范不变系数。这两个函数与贝里曲率 Ω 一起确定了整个轨道响应。磁化率是纯几何的，对于通用的隔离平带，它再现了已建立的规范不变响应公式。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在零磁场下完全平坦的能带具有零速度、发散的有效质量并且没有费米面，因此轨道磁性的标准理论不适用。我们证明磁场产生有效的色散。在由非交换动动量的 Moyal 代数组织的展开中，能带能量获得由布洛赫态的轨道矩设置的一阶位移 B,M(mathbf k) 和二阶位移 tfrac12X(mathbf k)B²，我们以封闭形式获得其规范不变系数。这两个函数与贝里曲率 Ω 一起确定了整个轨道响应。磁化率是纯几何的，对于通用的隔离平带，它再现了已建立的规范不变响应公式。当化学势固定在平带上时，M=0 等值线变成了涌现的费米面，其附近的玻色化激发产生了一个改进的 Lifshitz-Kosevich 公式，其能级间距在 B 中是二次的。振荡的相移由涌现的费米面周围的 Berry 相和 X 共同给出。当能带很窄而不是完全平坦时，振荡频率以无参数分布从零场费米面区域交叉到M=0 轮廓的面积。我们通过精确对角化展平陈晶格模型来验证我们的分析结果。

articles.title: A Universal Polybromide Melt Strategy for the Direct Conversion of Metals into Optoelectronic-Grade Bromide Perovskites
articles.title_zh: 将金属直接转化为光电级溴化物钙钛矿的通用多溴化物熔融策略
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12278v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Halide perovskite systems require specific metal oxidation states (M2+ or M+/M3+ pairs), limiting processing flexibility during traditional synthesis and posing stability challenges for multivalent metals like Sn, Cu, and Au. This work anchors a profound paradigm shift: a universal, single-step, organic-solvent free synthetic platform that directly converts stable elemental metal films into bromide perovskite and perovskite-related systems for a wide variety of (opto)electronic applications. The synthetic platform uses methylammonium polybromide melt (PBM) that reacts at room temperature with different elemental metals, including Pb, Sn, Au, and Cu, successfully transforming them into their respective Br-perovskite phases: MAPbBr3, MASnBr3, MA2Au2Br6, and MA2CuBr4. It is shown that the PBMs chemical activity can be tuned, and in situ X-ray diffraction captures in two cases transient intermediate phases during phase evolution. For Sn, which tends towards overoxidation to Sn4+ phase, changes in the PBMs composition coupled with a metallic Sn mediated comproportionation reaction allowed suppressing overoxidation, and formation of high quality MASnBr3 films under ambient conditions. Overall, oxidation and disproportionation potentials are found to be useful metrics for predicting M:PBM reaction outcomes. Industrially, this approach should be fully compatible with roll-to-roll infrastructure, providing a low-barrier pathway to scale next-generation optoelectronic technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 卤化物钙钛矿体系需要特定的金属氧化态（M2+ 或 M+/M3+ 对），限制了传统合成过程中的加工灵活性，并对 Sn、Cu 和 Au 等多价金属提出了稳定性挑战。这项工作锚定了深刻的范式转变：一种通用、单步、无有机溶剂的合成平台，可直接将稳定的元素金属薄膜转化为溴化物钙钛矿和钙钛矿相关系统，用于各种（光）电子应用。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 卤化物钙钛矿体系需要特定的金属氧化态（M2+ 或 M+/M3+ 对），限制了传统合成过程中的加工灵活性，并对 Sn、Cu 和 Au 等多价金属提出了稳定性挑战。这项工作锚定了深刻的范式转变：一种通用、单步、无有机溶剂的合成平台，可直接将稳定的元素金属薄膜转化为溴化物钙钛矿和钙钛矿相关系统，用于各种（光）电子应用。该合成平台使用多溴化甲基铵熔体（PBM），在室温下与不同的元素金属（包括Pb、Sn、Au和Cu）反应，成功地将它们转化为各自的Br-钙钛矿相：MAPbBr3、MASnBr3、MA2Au2Br6和MA2CuBr4。结果表明，PBM 的化学活性可以调节，并且原位 X 射线衍射捕获了相演化过程中的两种瞬态中间相。对于容易过度氧化成 Sn4+ 相的 Sn，PBM 成分的变化加上金属 Sn 介导的歧化反应可以抑制过度氧化，并在环境条件下形成高质量的 MASnBr3 薄膜。总体而言，发现氧化和歧化电位是预测 M:PBM 反应结果的有用指标。在工业上，这种方法应该与卷对卷基础设施完全兼容，为扩展下一代光电技术提供低障碍途径。

articles.title: Transducing quantum-spin-ice correlations into Weyl Fermi-arc transport at a synthetic Kondo lattice interface
articles.title_zh: 将量子自旋冰相关性转换为合成近藤晶格界面处的韦尔费米弧输运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12294v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum spin ice hosts collective excitations and quantum fluctuations that are largely electrically silent because the materials supporting them are insulating. Coupling this magnetic environment to surface-localized Weyl states offers a route to encode its correlations directly into Fermi-arc transport. Experimental access to this regime, however, has remained largely unexplored. Here, we realize a synthetic Kondo lattice interface between the Weyl semimetal Eu₂Ir₂O₇ and the quantum-spin-ice candidate Tb₂Ti₂O₇, and demonstrate that quantum-spin-ice correlations are imprinted on Weyl Fermi-arc transport. At ultra-low temperature, electronic transport evolves from a sixfold anisotropic response at low field into a twelvefold response over an intermediate field window, before entering a reentrant sixfold anisotropy at high field. No analogous twelvefold response occurs at the classical-spin-ice interface. The quantum--classical contrast shows that the same itinerant electronic channel acquires qualitatively different symmetry information when interacting with the quantum-fluctuating Tb moments, consistent with an interfacial coupling between the Weyl surface states and the transverse, multipolar degrees of freedom, in addition to the longitudinal, dipolar contribution. Our work establishes synthetic Kondo lattice interfaces as a route for transducing frustrated quantum magnetism with multipole correlations into distinct Weyl Fermi-arc transport responses.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子自旋冰具有集体激发和量子涨落，这些涨落在很大程度上是电安静的，因为支撑它们的材料是绝缘的。将这种磁性环境与表面局域外尔态耦合提供了一种将其相关性直接编码到费米弧输运中的途径。然而，对该制度的实验性访问在很大程度上仍未得到探索。在这里，我们实现了Weyl半金属Eu2Ir2O7和量子自旋冰候选Tb2Ti2O7之间的合成Kondo晶格界面，并证明量子自旋冰相关性印在Weyl费米弧输运上。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子自旋冰具有集体激发和量子涨落，这些涨落在很大程度上是电安静的，因为支撑它们的材料是绝缘的。将这种磁性环境与表面局域外尔态耦合提供了一种将其相关性直接编码到费米弧输运中的途径。然而，对该制度的实验性访问在很大程度上仍未得到探索。在这里，我们实现了Weyl半金属Eu2Ir2O7和量子自旋冰候选Tb2Ti2O7之间的合成Kondo晶格界面，并证明量子自旋冰相关性印在Weyl费米弧输运上。在超低温下，电子输运从低场下的六倍各向异性响应演变为中间场窗口上的十二倍响应，然后进入高场下的折返六倍各向异性。在经典自旋冰界面处没有发生类似的十二倍响应。量子经典对比表明，相同的巡回电子通道在与量子涨落 Tb 矩相互作用时获得性质不同的对称信息，这与除了纵向偶极贡献外，Weyl 表面态和横向多极自由度之间的界面耦合一致。我们的工作建立了合成的近藤晶格界面，作为将具有多极相关性的受挫量子磁性转换为不同的韦尔费米弧输运响应的途径。

articles.title: True vs false Fermi surfaces in the Pseudogap regime and their transformation with doping and temperature in the Hubbard Model
articles.title_zh: 赝能隙区域中的真费米面与假费米面及其在哈伯德模型中随掺杂和温度的变化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12339v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Exact diagrammatic quantum Monte Carlo (DiagMC) results for the nearest-neighbor Hubbard model motivate a closer study of the pseudogap. Using the improved two-particle self-consistent approach (TPSC+), we analyze Energy (EDC) and Momentum Distribution Curves (MDC) simultaneously. We show that Fermi-liquid terminology breaks down in the pseudogap regime, requiring a distinction between true and false Fermi surfaces and zero-energy quasiparticle (ZEQ) lines. A false Fermi surface has a momentum-space spectral maximum but a frequency-space depression at zero energy, while a false ZEQ line violates the standard quasiparticle condition partial Σ'(k,ω)/partial ω|ω₌₀<0.The pseudogap is driven by critical thermal spin fluctuations, which occur in two dimensions because of the Mermin-Wagner theorem. Commensurate fluctuations first open an antinodal pseudogap, leaving true Fermi arcs. With decreasing temperature, the Fermi surface evolves into hole- and electron-like false Fermi surfaces. Incommensurate fluctuations generate hot spots near the diagonal, where the pseudogap persists to the quantum critical point (QCP), whereas at kAN it disappears before the QCP doping. There, the spectrum has two precursor antiferromagnetic (AFM) bands, both in the unoccupied (ω>0) region. We benchmark TPSC+ against DiagMC results for the Matsubara spectral proxy -Im[G(k,iπ T)]/π. TPSC+ underestimates pseudogap suppression in the strong-interaction regime, reproducing DiagMC behavior at lower temperatures or doping. This proxy is equivalent to the spectral function with thermal broadening η=π T, which obscures features when π T is not the smallest energy scale. Using A(k,0), we find that hole-like Fermi surfaces emerge at any interaction strength at low temperature, even at weak coupling.
articles.abstract_zh: 最近邻哈伯德模型的精确图解量子蒙特卡罗 (DiagMC) 结果激发了对赝能隙的更深入研究。使用改进的双粒子自洽方法 (TPSC+)，我们同时分析能量 (EDC) 和动量分布曲线 (MDC)。我们证明了费米液体术语在赝能隙状态下被打破，需要区分真费米表面和假费米表面以及零能量准粒子（ZEQ）线。假费米面具有动量空间谱最大值，但在零能量处有频率空间凹陷，而假 ZEQ 线违反了标准准粒子条件部分 Σ'(k,ω)/部分 ω|ω₌₀0) 区域。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 最近邻哈伯德模型的精确图解量子蒙特卡罗 (DiagMC) 结果激发了对赝能隙的更深入研究。使用改进的双粒子自洽方法 (TPSC+)，我们同时分析能量 (EDC) 和动量分布曲线 (MDC)。我们证明了费米液体术语在赝能隙状态下被打破，需要区分真费米表面和假费米表面以及零能量准粒子（ZEQ）线。假费米面具有动量空间谱最大值，但在零能量处有频率空间凹陷，而假 ZEQ 线违反了标准准粒子条件部分 Σ'(k,ω)/部分 ω|ω₌₀0) 区域。我们将 TPSC+ 与 Matsubara 光谱代理 -Im[G(k,iπ T)]/π 的 DiagMC 结果进行基准测试。 TPSC+ 低估了强相互作用状态下的赝能隙抑制，在较低温度或掺杂下再现了 DiagMC 行为。该代理相当于具有热展宽 η=π T 的谱函数，当 π T 不是最小能量尺度时，它会掩盖特征。使用 A(k,0)，我们发现在低温下任何相互作用强度下，甚至在弱耦合下，都会出现类孔费米面。

articles.title: Short-Range Vector Spin Glasses: Parisi Hierarchies and Real-Space Ultrametricity
articles.title_zh: 短程矢量自旋玻璃：Pararisi 层次结构和实空间超度量性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12441v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Replica symmetry breaking (RSB) is the organizing principle of mean-field spin-glass theory, yet whether a continuous Parisi hierarchy can arise in a genuinely short-range system in finite spatial dimension remains unresolved. Here we introduce a disordered model of N-component vector spins on a D-dimensional hypercubic lattice, with random matrix couplings on nearest-neighbor links and random tensor couplings on elementary plaquettes. In the large-N limit, the model supports thermodynamically stable one-step, full, and one-full RSB phases, alongside replica-symmetric paramagnetic and ferromagnetic phases. We find that spatial locality constrains these ordered phases through two distinct infrared mechanisms. (i) Quenched random anisotropy destroys uniform ferromagnetism for D≤4 through an Imry-Ma mechanism. (ii) A continuous Parisi hierarchy gives rise to replica Goldstone modes whose gaplessness is protected by a Ward identity. At leading order in 1/N, these modes behave as a band of free spin waves, producing infrared-divergent fluctuations in D≤2 and a Mermin-Wagner instability of the continuously broken phase. Remarkably, the Parisi hierarchy also acquires a direct real-space interpretation. For two pure states with mutual overlap q, a characteristic length ξ(q) describes how far the differences between their frozen magnetization patterns remain correlated. Throughout a continuous sector of the Parisi hierarchy, ξ(q) is independent of temperature and decreases monotonically with q. The ultrametric organization of pure states is therefore accompanied by an ultrametric hierarchy of real-space correlation lengths: states that separate near the root of the Parisi tree differ through long-wavelength frozen patterns, whereas states that separate farther from the root differ only on progressively shorter scales.
articles.abstract_zh: 复制对称破缺（RSB）是平均场自旋玻璃理论的组织原理，但在有限空间维度的真正短程系统中是否可以出现连续的 Parisi 层次结构仍然悬而未决。在这里，我们引入了 D 维超立方晶格上 N 分量矢量自旋的无序模型，其中最近邻链接上的随机矩阵耦合和基本斑块上的随机张量耦合。在大 N 极限下，该模型支持热力学稳定的一步、全和一全 RSB 相，以及复制对称顺磁和铁磁相。我们发现空间局部性通过两种不同的红外机制限制这些有序相。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 复制对称破缺（RSB）是平均场自旋玻璃理论的组织原理，但在有限空间维度的真正短程系统中是否可以出现连续的 Parisi 层次结构仍然悬而未决。在这里，我们引入了 D 维超立方晶格上 N 分量矢量自旋的无序模型，其中最近邻链接上的随机矩阵耦合和基本斑块上的随机张量耦合。在大 N 极限下，该模型支持热力学稳定的一步、全和一全 RSB 相，以及复制对称顺磁和铁磁相。我们发现空间局部性通过两种不同的红外机制限制这些有序相。 (i) 淬火随机各向异性通过 Imry-Ma 机制破坏 D≤4 的均匀铁磁性。 (ii) 连续的帕里西等级制度产生了复制品戈德斯通模式，其无间隙性受到沃德身份的保护。在 1/N 的前导阶上，这些模式表现为自由自旋波带，产生 D≤2 的红外发散波动和连续破碎相的 Mermin-Wagner 不稳定性。值得注意的是，帕里西层次结构也获得了直接的真实空间解释。对于两个相互重叠 q 的纯态，特征长度 xi(q) 描述了它们的冻结磁化模式之间的差异保持相关的程度。在 Parisi 层次结构的连续扇区中， xi(q) 与温度无关，并且随 q 单调递减。因此，纯态的超度量组织伴随着实空间相关长度的超度量层次结构：在 Parisi 树根附近分离的态通过长波长冻结模式而不同，而远离根分离的态仅在逐渐较短的尺度上有所不同。

articles.title: Omnisolver: An extensible interface to Ising spin-glass and QUBO solvers: adding a distributed GPU brute-force plugin
articles.title_zh: Omnisolver：Ising 自旋玻璃和 QUBO 求解器的可扩展接口：添加分布式 GPU 强力插件
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.10542v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This software update extends Omnisolver with textttomnisolver-bruteforce, a first-class plugin for exact exhaustive search of QUBO and Ising instances on CUDA-enabled GPUs. The update contributes three components: packaging of the single-GPU brute-force kernel of [Computer Physics Communications 260, 107728, 2021] as a first-class Omnisolver plugin with a uniform Python and CLI interface, a Ray-based distributed framework that splits the search into 2k fixed-variable subproblems and dispatches them across multiple GPUs and hosts, with a controller that gathers and merges partial results, and numerical stabilization of the fast textttfloat32 ground-state path through compensated incremental updates, periodic exact energy re-anchoring, and best-buffer refresh. Stabilization activates automatically for N ≥ 40 leaving the public sampler API is unchanged. On dense random Ising instances we measure exhaustive solve times up to N=60 on 8× NVIDIA H100 (96 GB) GPUs, reaching approx!3.15 days at N=60 in close agreement with the empirical tN₊₁=2,t_N doubling rule, with the distributed sampler reaching the full approx!8× speedup over a single H100 from N!gtrsim!44 onwards. The plugin thereby serves as a practical ground-truth oracle for state-of-the-art classical heuristics such as the Simulated Bifurcation Machine.
articles.abstract_zh: 此软件更新通过 textttomnisolver-bruteforce 扩展了 Omnisolver，这是一个一流的插件，用于在支持 CUDA 的 GPU 上精确穷举搜索 QUBO 和 Ising 实例。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 此软件更新通过 textttomnisolver-bruteforce 扩展了 Omnisolver，这是一个一流的插件，用于在支持 CUDA 的 GPU 上精确穷举搜索 QUBO 和 Ising 实例。该更新贡献了三个组成部分：将 [计算机物理通信 260, 107728, 2021] 的单 GPU 暴力内核打包为具有统一 Python 和 CLI 接口的一流 Omnisolver 插件，基于 Ray 的分布式框架，将搜索拆分为 2k 固定变量子问题并将其分配到多个 GPU 和主机，并使用收集和合并部分结果的控制器，以及快速计算的数值稳定性textttfloat32 通过补偿增量更新、定期精确能量重新锚定和最佳缓冲区刷新实现基态路径。当 N ≥ 40 时，稳定性会自动激活，从而使公共采样器 API 保持不变。在密集随机 Ising 实例上，我们在 8× NVIDIA H100 (96 GB) GPU 上测量了高达 N=60 的详尽求解时间，在 N=60 时达到约 3.15 天，与经验 tN₊₁=2,t_N 倍增规则非常一致，分布式采样器从 N!gtrsim!44 开始比单个 H100 达到约 8× 加速。因此，该插件可以作为最先进的经典启发式（例如模拟分叉机）的实用真实预言。

articles.title: PXtal: Learning to Align Powder X-Ray Diffraction and Crystal Structures under Information Asymmetry across Modalities
articles.title_zh: PXtal：学习在跨模态信息不对称的情况下对齐粉末 X 射线衍射和晶体结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.10653v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Scientific multimodal learning commonly assumes that paired views are comparably informative. Powder X-ray diffraction (PXRD) makes this mismatch explicit: compressing a three-dimensional crystal structure into a one-dimensional diffraction pattern loses information and makes the pattern harder to connect to the crystal structure that produced it. We introduce PXtal, a framework for learning aligned PXRD and crystal representations under this physically imposed information asymmetry. PXtal uses Unbalanced Optimal Transport (UOT) to adapt the cross-modal coupling and coupling-level generalized Kullback-Leibler (GKL) divergence to supervise the full transport plan. Across six test sets, including four zero-shot transfer sets, PXtal consistently outperforms the baseline models in PXRD-to-crystal candidate retrieval, with the largest gains when PXRD patterns have close but crystallographically distinct nonpaired neighbors, meaning similar input patterns associated with different crystals. The resulting crystal and PXRD encoders transfer more effectively to downstream materials and crystallographic tasks. These results identify information asymmetry as a general design problem in scientific multimodal learning: alignment objectives should reflect what each modality preserves.
articles.abstract_zh: 科学的多模态学习通常假设成对的观点具有相对丰富的信息。粉末 X 射线衍射 (PXRD) 使这种不匹配变得明显：将三维晶体结构压缩为一维衍射图案会丢失信息，并使图案更难与产生它的晶体结构连接起来。我们介绍 PXtal，一个用于在这种物理强加的信息不对称下学习对齐的 PXRD 和晶体表示的框架。 PXtal 使用不平衡最优传输 (UOT) 来适应跨模态耦合和耦合级广义 Kullback-Leibler (GKL) 散度来监督整个传输计划。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 科学的多模态学习通常假设成对的观点具有相对丰富的信息。粉末 X 射线衍射 (PXRD) 使这种不匹配变得明显：将三维晶体结构压缩为一维衍射图案会丢失信息，并使图案更难与产生它的晶体结构连接起来。我们介绍 PXtal，一个用于在这种物理强加的信息不对称下学习对齐的 PXRD 和晶体表示的框架。 PXtal 使用不平衡最优传输 (UOT) 来适应跨模态耦合和耦合级广义 Kullback-Leibler (GKL) 散度来监督整个传输计划。在六个测试集（包括四个零样本传输集）中，PXtal 在 PXRD 到晶体候选检索方面始终优于基线模型，当 PXRD 图案具有紧密但晶体学上不同的非配对邻居（这意味着与不同晶体相关的相似输入图案）时，增益最大。由此产生的晶体和 PXRD 编码器可以更有效地传输到下游材料和晶体学任务。这些结果将信息不对称确定为科学多模式学习中的一般设计问题：调整目标应反映每种模式保留的内容。

articles.title: Thermodynamics of interacting magnetic chain molecules
articles.title_zh: 相互作用的磁链分子的热力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.10671v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study magnets composed of molecules with an arbitrary number m of magnetically active atoms in a chain configuration interacting with nearest-neighbor couplings. We derive the thermodynamics of a chain of spin-j SU(2) magnetic atoms using a mean-field approach and determine the equilibrium states and stability conditions. The system exhibits a rich phase structure with a cascade of ferromagnetic phase transitions, their number ranging from m, for maximal ferromagnets, to zero, for paramagnets, depending on the relative strengths of the couplings. In the presence of impurities (modified couplings) at the ends of the chain, boundary states emerge that coexist with the paramagnetic phase or the fully ferromagnetic phase. For long chains, a continuum approximation can be taken that clarifies the structure of the phases. In the continuum description, magnetized states at temperatures lower than the critical temperature at which they appear correspond to kink solitons.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究由具有任意数量 m 个磁活性原子的分子组成的磁体，这些原子呈链结构，与最近邻耦合相互作用。我们使用平均场方法推导了自旋 j SU(2) 磁性原子链的热力学，并确定了平衡状态和稳定条件。该系统表现出丰富的相结构，具有一系列铁磁相变，其数量范围从 m（最大铁磁体）到 0（顺磁体），具体取决于耦合的相对强度。当链末端存在杂质（改性耦合）时，会出现与顺磁相或全铁磁相共存的边界态。对于长链，可以采用连续体近似来阐明相的结构。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究由具有任意数量 m 个磁活性原子的分子组成的磁体，这些原子呈链结构，与最近邻耦合相互作用。我们使用平均场方法推导了自旋 j SU(2) 磁性原子链的热力学，并确定了平衡状态和稳定条件。该系统表现出丰富的相结构，具有一系列铁磁相变，其数量范围从 m（最大铁磁体）到 0（顺磁体），具体取决于耦合的相对强度。当链末端存在杂质（改性耦合）时，会出现与顺磁相或全铁磁相共存的边界态。对于长链，可以采用连续体近似来阐明相的结构。在连续统描述中，磁化态在低于临界温度的温度下出现，对应于扭结孤子。

articles.title: On linearity or non-linearity in machine learning for quantum chaotic dynamics
articles.title_zh: 量子混沌动力学机器学习中的线性或非线性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.10697v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Accurately simulating chaotic quantum many-body dynamics remains a major computational challenge for classical methods, due to the rapid buildup and spatial spreading of entanglement during the evolution. This raises the question of whether machine learning can provide an effective alternative for predicting quantum dynamics. We address this question by formulating quantum dynamics as a time-series forecasting problem, using a few-qubit PXP chain, realizable with Rydberg-atom arrays, as a benchmark. By varying the initial state, the system spans dynamical regimes ranging from ergodic behavior to quantum many-body scarring, providing a controlled setting for testing forecasting models across qualitatively different dynamics. We compare two contrasting architectures: an expressive nonlinear Transformer and DLinear, a simple linear forecasting model. The Transformer accurately predicts dynamics in the more ergodic regime, but its performance progressively deteriorates as the initial state approaches the scarred limit. In contrast, DLinear remains accurate across the entire family of initial states, with its main deviations consisting of small high-frequency oscillations that have little effect on the overall prediction error. Remarkably, these results show that observables generated by complex quantum many-body dynamics can be forecast with high accuracy through a simple linear mapping from past to future observations. This reveals that the complexity of the underlying quantum evolution need not translate into an equally complex forecasting problem.
articles.abstract_zh: 由于演化过程中纠缠的快速积累和空间扩散，准确模拟混沌量子多体动力学仍然是经典方法的主要计算挑战。这就提出了一个问题：机器学习是否可以为预测量子动力学提供有效的替代方案。我们通过将量子动力学表述为时间序列预测问题来解决这个问题，并使用可通过里德堡原子阵列实现的几个量子位 PXP 链作为基准。通过改变初始状态，该系统跨越了从遍历行为到量子多体疤痕的动态范围，为跨定性不同的动态测试预测模型提供了受控设置。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 由于演化过程中纠缠的快速积累和空间扩散，准确模拟混沌量子多体动力学仍然是经典方法的主要计算挑战。这就提出了一个问题：机器学习是否可以为预测量子动力学提供有效的替代方案。我们通过将量子动力学表述为时间序列预测问题来解决这个问题，并使用可通过里德堡原子阵列实现的几个量子位 PXP 链作为基准。通过改变初始状态，该系统跨越了从遍历行为到量子多体疤痕的动态范围，为跨定性不同的动态测试预测模型提供了受控设置。我们比较了两种截然不同的架构：富有表现力的非线性 Transformer 和 DLinear（一种简单的线性预测模型）。 Transformer 准确地预测了更遍历状态下的动态，但随着初始状态接近伤痕极限，其性能逐渐恶化。相比之下，DLinear 在整个初始状态族中保持准确，其主要偏差包括对整体预测误差影响很小的小型高频振荡。值得注意的是，这些结果表明，通过从过去到未来的观测的简单线性映射，可以高精度地预测由复杂的量子多体动力学产生的可观测值。这表明，潜在量子演化的复杂性不必转化为同样复杂的预测问题。

articles.title: Helicity decoupling ultrastrong Rabi splitting from quantum vacuum dressing
articles.title_zh: 量子真空敷料的螺旋度解耦超强拉比分裂
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.10944v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Polaritons and quantum vacuum dressing are usually regarded as intertwined consequences of ultrastrong light-matter coupling. Here we show that they can be controlled independently through helicity. We consider cyclotron resonance coupled to a chiral cavity supporting a single circular mode. When the helicity of the cavity field matches the cyclotron motion, energy is exchanged resonantly between light and matter, producing a large Rabi splitting and conventional polaritons, while the ground state remains the bare vacuum. Reversing the magnetic field reverses the cyclotron motion without changing the cavity. The same mode then couples through anomalous processes that create and annihilate light and matter excitations in pairs: the conventional polaritonic anticrossing disappears, while the ground state acquires squeezing and virtual excitations. These two regimes show that spectral hybridization and quantum vacuum dressing are distinct manifestations of ultrastrong coupling, and that a large Rabi splitting alone does not imply a dressed quantum vacuum. Helicity therefore provides a route to controlling polariton formation and quantum correlations as distinct resources in cavity quantum materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 极化子和量子真空敷料通常被认为是超强光与物质耦合的交织结果。在这里我们证明它们可以通过螺旋度独立控制。我们考虑与支持单圆模式的手性腔耦合的回旋加速器共振。当腔场的螺旋度与回旋加速器运动相匹配时，能量在光和物质之间共振交换，产生大的拉比分裂和传统的极化激元，而基态仍然是裸露的真空。反转磁场会反转回旋加速器的运动，而不改变腔体。然后，相同的模式通过异常过程耦合，成对地产生和湮灭光和物质激发：传统的极化子反交叉消失，而基态获得挤压和虚拟激发。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 极化子和量子真空敷料通常被认为是超强光与物质耦合的交织结果。在这里我们证明它们可以通过螺旋度独立控制。我们考虑与支持单圆模式的手性腔耦合的回旋加速器共振。当腔场的螺旋度与回旋加速器运动相匹配时，能量在光和物质之间共振交换，产生大的拉比分裂和传统的极化激元，而基态仍然是裸露的真空。反转磁场会反转回旋加速器的运动，而不改变腔体。然后，相同的模式通过异常过程耦合，成对地产生和湮灭光和物质激发：传统的极化子反交叉消失，而基态获得挤压和虚拟激发。这两种情况表明，光谱杂化和量子真空修饰是超强耦合的不同表现，并且单独的大拉比分裂并不意味着修饰的量子真空。因此，螺旋性提供了一种控制极化子形成和量子相关性作为腔量子材料中不同资源的途径。

articles.title: Analog quantum simulation of φ⁴ field theory with a superconducting transmission line
articles.title_zh: 使用超导传输线对 φ⁴ 场论进行模拟量子模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.11071v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Understanding the dynamics of interacting quantum fields remains a fundamental challenge. We propose a superconducting transmission line for analog quantum simulation of (1+1)-dimensional φ⁴ field theory. The transmission line comprises fluxonium-like circuit elements whose continuous and unbounded phase variables encode a scalar field without Hilbert-space truncation. Their anharmonic potentials provide strong interactions. Tuning the circuit parameters provides access to two distinct regimes. In the first, the transmission line emulates φ⁴ field theory with a single-well potential. We confirm this correspondence through lattice Monte Carlo calculations of the low-energy spectra of both the circuit and lattice φ⁴ theory. This regime enables scattering experiments between counter-propagating particle wave packets. The second parameter set yields a double-well potential that emulates φ⁴ theory in the symmetry-broken phase and hosts degenerate vacua. Interfaces between the two vacua form topological kinks, and the transmission line can simulate kink-antikink collisions. We present state preparation and measurement protocols for both collision experiments, enabling spatially resolved, real-time studies of particle and soliton scattering in an interacting quantum field theory.
articles.abstract_zh: 了解相互作用的量子场的动力学仍然是一个基本挑战。我们提出了一种用于 (1+1) 维 φ⁴ 场论的模拟量子模拟的超导传输线。传输线包括类似fluxium的电路元件，其连续且无界的相位变量对标量场进行编码，而无需希尔伯特空间截断。它们的非谐势提供了很强的相互作用。调整电路参数可以访问两种不同的状态。首先，传输线用单阱势来模拟 φ⁴ 场论。我们通过电路和晶格 φ⁴ 理论的低能谱的晶格蒙特卡罗计算证实了这种对应关系。这种机制使得能够在反向传播的粒子波包之间进行散射实验。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 了解相互作用的量子场的动力学仍然是一个基本挑战。我们提出了一种用于 (1+1) 维 φ⁴ 场论的模拟量子模拟的超导传输线。传输线包括类似fluxium的电路元件，其连续且无界的相位变量对标量场进行编码，而无需希尔伯特空间截断。它们的非谐势提供了很强的相互作用。调整电路参数可以访问两种不同的状态。首先，传输线用单阱势来模拟 φ⁴ 场论。我们通过电路和晶格 φ⁴ 理论的低能谱的晶格蒙特卡罗计算证实了这种对应关系。这种机制使得能够在反向传播的粒子波包之间进行散射实验。第二个参数集产生双阱势，模拟对称破缺相中的 φ⁴ 理论并容纳简并真空。两个真空之间的界面形成拓扑扭结，传输线可以模拟扭结-反扭结碰撞。我们提出了两个碰撞实验的状态准备和测量协议，从而能够在相互作用的量子场论中对粒子和孤子散射进行空间解析、实时研究。

articles.title: Time-Domain Analysis of Surface Acoustic Wave Magnetoelectric Sensors
articles.title_zh: 表面声波磁电传感器的时域分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.11421v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The transient response of surface acoustic wave sensors is important for understanding their dynamic behavior, propagation delay, and response to time-varying signals. In this work, the time-domain propagation characteristics of a magnetoelectric SAW sensor based on a multilayer Love-wave delay line are investigated using complementary numerical and experimental approaches. Time-domain analysis is employed to determine the delay time and to extract the phase and group velocities, while frequency-domain analysis provides an independent characterization of the wave dispersion. Both numerically and experimentally, the phase and group velocities are found to differ, reflecting the dispersion of the Love wave in the multilayer structure. At the operating frequency of 146 MHz, the simulated group velocity obtained from wave-field tracking agrees within 0.4% with the value determined from the frequency-domain dispersion relation. The simulated delay time and group velocity also show good agreement with experiment, with deviations of 2.7% in delay time and 0.9% in group velocity. These results demonstrate the consistency of the time- and frequency-domain analyses and provide a quantitative characterization of the transient propagation behavior of SAW sensors.
articles.abstract_zh: 表面声波传感器的瞬态响应对于理解其动态行为、传播延迟和对时变信号的响应非常重要。在这项工作中，使用互补的数值和实验方法研究了基于多层乐夫波延迟线的磁电 SAW 传感器的时域传播特性。时域分析用于确定延迟时间并提取相速度和群速度，而频域分析则提供波色散的独立表征。在数值和实验上，发现相速度和群速度不同，反映了多层结构中乐夫波的色散。在146 MHz的工作频率下，波场跟踪得到的模拟群速度与频域色散关系确定的值的吻合度在0.4%以内。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 表面声波传感器的瞬态响应对于理解其动态行为、传播延迟和对时变信号的响应非常重要。在这项工作中，使用互补的数值和实验方法研究了基于多层乐夫波延迟线的磁电 SAW 传感器的时域传播特性。时域分析用于确定延迟时间并提取相速度和群速度，而频域分析则提供波色散的独立表征。在数值和实验上，发现相速度和群速度不同，反映了多层结构中乐夫波的色散。在146 MHz的工作频率下，波场跟踪得到的模拟群速度与频域色散关系确定的值的吻合度在0.4%以内。模拟的延迟时间和群速度也与实验结果吻合良好，延迟时间的偏差为2.7%，群速度的偏差为0.9%。这些结果证明了时域和频域分析的一致性，并提供了 SAW 传感器瞬态传播行为的定量表征。

articles.title: Dielectric constant of holographic insulator from quantum geometry
articles.title_zh: 量子几何的全息绝缘体介电常数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.11635v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study dielectric properties of holographic insulators from the quantum geometry of the ground state. We realize the insulating state by the pseudoscalar interaction of holographic fermions and calculate the fermionic Green function to extract the effective hamiltonian. We then derive the quantum metric and Berry curvature to compute the transports and finally get the dielectric constant from the imaginary part of conductivity.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们从基态的量子几何结构研究全息绝缘体的介电特性。我们通过全息费米子的赝标量相互作用实现绝缘态，并计算费米子格林函数以提取有效哈密顿量。然后我们推导量子度量和贝里曲率来计算传输，最后从电导率的虚部得到介电常数。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们从基态的量子几何结构研究全息绝缘体的介电特性。我们通过全息费米子的赝标量相互作用实现绝缘态，并计算费米子格林函数以提取有效哈密顿量。然后我们推导量子度量和贝里曲率来计算传输，最后从电导率的虚部得到介电常数。

articles.title: Entanglement entropy and magic of ZX-diagrams
articles.title_zh: 纠缠熵和 ZX 图的魔力
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.12447v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Entanglement and non-stabilizerness are complementary resources underlying the complexity of quantum states, yet extracting either quantity from large quantum circuits generally requires exponentially scaling resources. In diagrammatic approaches to quantum computation, such as the ZX-calculus, both quantities likewise typically require expensive tensor contractions that are not native to graphical rewriting. Here we show that both entanglement and magic can be efficiently estimated directly from ZX-diagrams. Flow enables efficient extraction of a normal form separating a potentially extensively entangled graph-state backbone from non-Clifford Pauli gadgets. This structure yields additive upper and lower bounds on bipartite entanglement entropy, which we further tighten through a preprocessing procedure that removes or merges redundant non-Clifford contributions. The same normal form gives an upper bound on logarithmic stabilizer extent. We benchmark these methods in random unitary and monitored circuits, and a circuit combining Trotterized Hamiltonian evolution with Clifford layers, finding that the resulting bounds remain informative even at large qubit numbers, circuit depths, and internal spider counts. Our results provide scalable probes of entanglement and non-stabilizerness of ZX-diagrams and establish a bridge between ZX-calculus and quantum many-body resource characterization, with applications across quantum computing, quantum information, and condensed-matter physics.
articles.abstract_zh: 纠缠和非稳定剂是量子态复杂性背后的互补资源，但从大型量子电路中提取任一量通常需要指数级扩展的资源。在量子计算的图解方法中，例如 ZX 微积分，这两个量同样通常需要昂贵的张量收缩，而这对于图形重写来说并不是原生的。在这里，我们展示了可以直接从 ZX 图有效地估计纠缠和魔力。 Flow 能够有效地提取范式，将潜在广泛纠缠的图状态主干与非 Clifford Pauli 小工具分开。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 纠缠和非稳定剂是量子态复杂性背后的互补资源，但从大型量子电路中提取任一量通常需要指数级扩展的资源。在量子计算的图解方法中，例如 ZX 微积分，这两个量同样通常需要昂贵的张量收缩，而这对于图形重写来说并不是原生的。在这里，我们展示了可以直接从 ZX 图有效地估计纠缠和魔力。 Flow 能够有效地提取范式，将潜在广泛纠缠的图状态主干与非 Clifford Pauli 小工具分开。这种结构产生二分纠缠熵的加性上限和下限，我们通过预处理程序进一步收紧该上限和下限，该预处理程序删除或合并冗余的非 Clifford 贡献。相同的范式给出了对数稳定器范围的上限。我们在随机单一和受监控电路以及将 Trotterized Hamiltonian 进化与 Clifford 层相结合的电路中对这些方法进行了基准测试，发现即使在大量子位数、电路深度和内部蜘蛛计数的情况下，所得界限仍然具有信息性。我们的结果提供了 ZX 图的纠缠和非稳定性的可扩展探针，并在 ZX 微积分和量子多体资源表征之间建立了一座桥梁，其应用遍及量子计算、量子信息和凝聚态物理。

articles.title: Generalized Langevin equation and fluctuation-dissipation theorem for particle-bath systems in external oscillating fields
articles.title_zh: 外部振荡场中粒子浴系统的广义朗之万方程和涨落耗散定理
articles.abstract: arXiv:1802.09848v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The Generalized Langevin Equation (GLE) can be derived from a particle-bath Hamiltonian, in both classical and quantum dynamics, and provides a route to the (both Markovian and non-Markovian) fluctuation-dissipation theorem (FDT). All previous studies have focused either on particle-bath systems with time-independent external forces only, or on the simplified case where only the tagged particle is subject to the external time-dependent oscillatory field. Here we extend the GLE and the corresponding FDT for the more general case where both the tagged particle and the bath oscillators respond to an external oscillatory field. This is the example of a charged or polarisable particle immersed in a bath of other particles that are also charged or polarizable, under an external AC electric field. For this Hamiltonian, we find that the ensemble average of the stochastic force is not zero, but proportional to the AC field. The associated FDT reads as langle F_P(t)F_P(t')rangle=mk_BTν(t-t')+(γ e)²E(t)E(t'), where Fₚ is the random force, ν(t-t') is the friction memory function, and γ is a numerical prefactor.
articles.abstract_zh: 广义Langevin方程（ GLE ）可以从经典和量子动力学中的粒子-巴斯哈密顿方程导出，并提供了（马尔可夫和非马尔可夫）波动耗散定理（ FDT ）的路径。所有以前的研究都集中在仅具有时间无关外力的粒子浴系统上，或者集中在只有标记的粒子受到外部时间相关振荡场的简化情况下。在这里，我们扩展了GLE和相应的FDT ，用于更一般的情况，其中标记的粒子和槽振荡器都响应外部振荡场。这是在外部交流电场下浸入也带电或可极化的其他粒子浴中的带电或可极化粒子的示例。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 广义Langevin方程（ GLE ）可以从经典和量子动力学中的粒子-巴斯哈密顿方程导出，并提供了（马尔可夫和非马尔可夫）波动耗散定理（ FDT ）的路径。所有以前的研究都集中在仅具有时间无关外力的粒子浴系统上，或者集中在只有标记的粒子受到外部时间相关振荡场的简化情况下。在这里，我们扩展了GLE和相应的FDT ，用于更一般的情况，其中标记的粒子和槽振荡器都响应外部振荡场。这是在外部交流电场下浸入也带电或可极化的其他粒子浴中的带电或可极化粒子的示例。对于这个Hamiltonian ，我们发现随机力的集合平均值不是零，而是与AC场成比例。关联FDT读取为langle F_P (t) F_P (t ') rangle = mk_BTν (t-t') + (γ e) ² E (t) E (t ') ，其中F?为随机力， ν (t-t')为摩擦记忆函数， γ为数值预因子。

articles.title: Exciton-polariton condensate in the van der Waals magnet CrSBr
articles.title_zh: 范德华磁体 CrSBr 中的激子极化子凝聚态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2501.18233v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Van der Waals magnets are an emergent material class of paramount interest for fundamental studies in coupling light with matter excitations, which are uniquely linked to their underlying magnetic properties. Among these materials, the semiconducting magnet CrSBr is possibly a first playground where we can study simultaneously the interaction of photons, magnons, and excitons at the quantum level. Here we demonstrate a coherent macroscopic quantum phase, the bosonic condensation of exciton-polaritons, emerging in a CrSBr flake embedded in a fully tunable cryogenic open optical cavity. The Bose condensate is characterized by a highly non-linear threshold-like behavior, macroscopic occupation of the ground state and coherence manifests distinctly via its first and second order quantum correlations. We find that the condensate's non-linearity is highly susceptible to the magnetic order in CrSBr. Specially, it can encounter a sign change from attractive to repulsive interactions when the intrinsic antiferromagnetic order transforms to the forced ferromagnetic order. Our findings open a route towards magnetically controllable quantum fluids of light, and optomagnonic devices where spin magnetism is coupled to on-chip Bose-Einstein condensates.
articles.abstract_zh: 范德瓦尔斯磁铁是光与物质激发耦合的基础研究最感兴趣的新兴材料类别，物质激发与它们的潜在磁性有着独特的联系。在这些材料中，半导体磁体CrSBr可能是我们可以同时研究光子、磁子和激子在量子水平上的相互作用的第一个游乐场。在这里，我们演示了一个相干的宏观量子相，即激子-极化子的玻色凝聚，出现在嵌入完全可调谐的低温开放光学腔中的CrSBr薄片中。Bose凝聚体的特征是高度非线性的阈值样行为，基态和相干性的宏观占有通过其一阶和二阶量子相关性显而易见。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 范德瓦尔斯磁铁是光与物质激发耦合的基础研究最感兴趣的新兴材料类别，物质激发与它们的潜在磁性有着独特的联系。在这些材料中，半导体磁体CrSBr可能是我们可以同时研究光子、磁子和激子在量子水平上的相互作用的第一个游乐场。在这里，我们演示了一个相干的宏观量子相，即激子-极化子的玻色凝聚，出现在嵌入完全可调谐的低温开放光学腔中的CrSBr薄片中。Bose凝聚体的特征是高度非线性的阈值样行为，基态和相干性的宏观占有通过其一阶和二阶量子相关性显而易见。我们发现冷凝物的非线性对CrSBr中的磁序非常敏感。特别是，当本征反铁磁有序转变为强迫铁磁有序时，它可能会遇到从吸引到排斥相互作用的符号变化。我们的研究结果为磁控量子光流体和光磁器件开辟了一条途径，其中自旋磁性耦合到芯片上的玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体。

articles.title: Fermi lune and non-reciprocal transport in rhombohedral multilayer graphene
articles.title_zh: 菱形多层石墨烯中的费米月亮和非互易转运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2505.05414v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We develop a microscopic theory of Fermi-lune metals in rhombohedral multilayer graphene and investigate their non-reciprocal longitudinal transport. We show that tuning the layer number and displacement field drives Lifshitz transitions from circular to annular non-interacting Fermi surfaces accompanied by redistributions of electronic weight among layers. Combining renormalization-group corrections with unrestricted Hartree-Fock calculations, we further demonstrate how Coulomb interactions reconstruct the non-interacting annular Fermi surface into crescent-shaped Fermi lune through spontaneous breaking of time-reversal, mirror and rotation symmetries. We determine competing mean-field phases for four to nine layers and distinguish two types of transdimensional orbital magnetic orders. Beyond the Fermi-lune state that exhibits transdimensional anomalous Hall effect reported recently, we also identify a mirror-preserving Fermi-lune phase with spontaneous in-plane orbital magnetization but a symmetry-forbidden anomalous Hall response. The maximum calculated in-plane orbital moment increases approximately linearly with layer number. The asymmetric Fermi-velocity distributions of these states also lead to intrinsic non-reciprocal longitudinal transport. Measurements presented here in a nine-layer device show a non-reciprocal resistance ratio reaching 23% at a current magnitude of 17 nA. These results elucidate the formation mechanism, competing symmetries, and thickness dependence of Fermi-lune states, and connect their electronic structure to a longitudinal-transport signature beyond the previously reported anomalous Hall phenomenology.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们发展了菱形多层石墨烯中费米-月亮金属的微观理论，并研究了它们的非互易纵向运输。我们表明，调整层数和位移场驱动Lifshitz从圆形到环形非相互作用费米表面的过渡，伴随着电子重量在各层之间的重新分布。将重整化群校正与无限制的Hartree-Fock计算相结合，我们进一步演示了库仑相互作用如何通过自发打破时间反转、镜像和旋转对称性，将非相互作用的环形费米面重构为新月形费米月亮。我们确定四到九层的竞争平均场相位，并区分两种类型的跨维轨道磁阶。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们发展了菱形多层石墨烯中费米-月亮金属的微观理论，并研究了它们的非互易纵向运输。我们表明，调整层数和位移场驱动Lifshitz从圆形到环形非相互作用费米表面的过渡，伴随着电子重量在各层之间的重新分布。将重整化群校正与无限制的Hartree-Fock计算相结合，我们进一步演示了库仑相互作用如何通过自发打破时间反转、镜像和旋转对称性，将非相互作用的环形费米面重构为新月形费米月亮。我们确定四到九层的竞争平均场相位，并区分两种类型的跨维轨道磁阶。除了最近报告表现出跨维异常霍尔效应的费米-卢恩状态外，我们还确定了一个保持镜像的费米-卢恩相，具有自发的平面内轨道磁化，但具有禁止对称的异常霍尔响应。计算出的最大平面内轨道力矩随层数近似线性增加。这些状态的不对称费米速度分布也导致了固有的非互易纵向传输。此处以九层器件呈现的测量结果显示，在17 nA的电流幅度下，非互易电阻比达到23%。这些结果阐明了费米月亮态的形成机制、竞争对称性和厚度依赖性，并将其电子结构连接到先前报道的异常霍尔现象学之外的纵向传输特征。

articles.title: Symmetry tuning topological states of the axion insulator candidate EuIn₂As₂ by its noncollinear magnetic order
articles.title_zh: 轴离子绝缘体候选物EuIn ₂ As ₂的拓扑状态通过其非共线磁序的对称调谐
articles.abstract: arXiv:2505.22796v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Topological properties of quantum materials are intimately related to symmetry. Here, we tune the magnetic order of the axion insulator candidate EuIn₂As₂ from its broken-helix ground state to the field-polarized phase by applying an in-plane magnetic field. Using results from neutron diffraction and magnetization measurements with ab inito theory and symmetry analysis, we assume a commensurate magnetic ground state and predict how the field tunes the magnetic symmetry within individual magnetic domains and examine the resulting changes to the topological surface states and hinge states existing on edges shared by certain surfaces hosting gapped Dirac states. We predict complex field-tunable domain-specific hinge-state patterns, with some crystal surfaces undergoing a field induced topological phase transition. We further find that domain walls can have pinned hinge states when intersecting certain crystal surfaces, providing another channel for tuning the chiral-charge-transport pathways.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子材料的拓扑性质与对称性密切相关。在这里，我们通过施加平面内磁场，将轴离子绝缘体候选EuIn ₂ As ₂的磁序从其断螺旋基态调整为场极化相。利用中子衍射和磁化测量的结果，结合ab inito理论和对称性分析，我们假设了相应的磁基态，并预测磁场如何调谐单个磁畴内的磁对称性，并检查由此产生的拓扑表面状态和铰链状态的变化，这些状态存在于承载间隙狄拉克态的某些表面共享的边缘上。我们预测了复杂场可调域特定的铰链状态模式，其中一些晶体表面经历了场诱导的拓扑相变。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子材料的拓扑性质与对称性密切相关。在这里，我们通过施加平面内磁场，将轴离子绝缘体候选EuIn ₂ As ₂的磁序从其断螺旋基态调整为场极化相。利用中子衍射和磁化测量的结果，结合ab inito理论和对称性分析，我们假设了相应的磁基态，并预测磁场如何调谐单个磁畴内的磁对称性，并检查由此产生的拓扑表面状态和铰链状态的变化，这些状态存在于承载间隙狄拉克态的某些表面共享的边缘上。我们预测了复杂场可调域特定的铰链状态模式，其中一些晶体表面经历了场诱导的拓扑相变。我们进一步发现，当与某些晶体表面相交时，畴壁可以具有固定的铰链状态，为调节手性电荷传输途径提供了另一个通道。

articles.title: Tensor Network Representations for Intrinsically Mixed-State Topological Orders
articles.title_zh: 本征混合状态拓扑序的张量网络表示
articles.abstract: arXiv:2507.22989v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Tensor networks are an efficient platform for representing topological states of matter as well as computing both physical observables and information-theoretic quantities. We present a general protocol to construct tensor network representations for intrinsically mixed-state topological phases. Such phases naturally emerge in noisy long-range entangled quantum systems, and exhibit nontrivial topological phenomena without pure-state counterparts. The method exploits the isomorphism between anyon decoherence in the physical Hilbert space and anyon condensation in the corresponding Choi space. The protocol is applicable to a broad class of systems arising from decoherence of pure-state topological phases, where the incoherent noise creates excitations in the Choi space that have trivial monodromy with all excitations. Representative examples at renormalization group fixed points include m^a e^b decoherence in the Z_N toric code, decohered non-Abelian quantum double of S₃ as well as pure Z/X decoherence of arbitrary CSS codes. Another notable example is that of the mixed-state chiral semion, whose tensor network representation has no pure-state analogue. We then generalize the formalism beyond RG fixed points and, as an example, examine the decoherence transition in a Z₃ toric code channel that suffers from sign problem when mapped to a statistical mechanical model. Together, these results establish tensor networks as a natural platform for analyzing noisy intrinsically mixed-state topological matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 张量网络是表示物质拓扑状态以及计算物理可观测量和信息理论量的有效平台。我们提出了一种用于构建本质混合状态拓扑相位的张量网络表示的通用协议。这些相自然出现在嘈杂的远程纠缠量子系统中，并且在没有纯态对应物的情况下表现出非平凡的拓扑现象。该方法利用了物理Hilbert空间中任意离子退相干与相应Choi空间中任意离子缩合之间的同构。该协议适用于纯态拓扑相位退相干产生的广泛系统，其中非相干噪声在Choi空间中产生激励，这些激励在所有激励下具有微不足道的单调性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 张量网络是表示物质拓扑状态以及计算物理可观测量和信息理论量的有效平台。我们提出了一种用于构建本质混合状态拓扑相位的张量网络表示的通用协议。这些相自然出现在嘈杂的远程纠缠量子系统中，并且在没有纯态对应物的情况下表现出非平凡的拓扑现象。该方法利用了物理Hilbert空间中任意离子退相干与相应Choi空间中任意离子缩合之间的同构。该协议适用于纯态拓扑相位退相干产生的广泛系统，其中非相干噪声在Choi空间中产生激励，这些激励在所有激励下具有微不足道的单调性。重整化群不动点上的代表性例子包括Z_N扭曲码中的m ^ a e ^ b退相干、S的退相干非阿贝尔量子倍数以及任意CSS码的纯Z/X退相干。另一个值得注意的例子是混合态手性半子，其张量网络表示没有纯态模拟。然后，我们将形式主义推广到RG不动点之外，例如，研究了当映射到统计力学模型时遭遇符号问题的Z *环码通道中的退相干转换。这些结果共同建立了张量网络作为分析噪声固有混合态拓扑物质的自然平台。

articles.title: Spinning mixtures: nonreciprocity transfers chirality across scales in scalar densities
articles.title_zh: 纺丝混合物：非互易性在标量密度的尺度上传递手性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.07630v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Mixtures of chiral active particles provide a minimal setting where nonreciprocity and chirality intertwine to shape collective dynamics. Here we show that nonreciprocal interactions can generate and transfer chirality across scales even in theories formulated solely in terms of scalar densities. We introduce a minimal two-species continuum model in which nonreciprocity and chirality enter through local and nonlocal parts of the chemical potential, both contributions equally relevant in terms of the number of spatial gradients involved. At the coarse-grained level, chirality manifests as localized domains (called charges) with a finite curl of the interspecies nonreciprocal current. These chiral charges actively redistribute particles, strongly modifying the underlying nonreciprocal dynamics. Their interplay gives rise to distinct nonequilibrium steady states, including phase separation with persistent edge currents and a spatiotemporally disordered phase combining chiral and nonreciprocal signatures. Our results establish nonreciprocity as a generic mechanism for generating chiral dynamics in scalar mixtures.
articles.abstract_zh: 手性活性颗粒的混合物提供了一个最小的环境，其中非互易性和手性交织在一起，形成集体动力学。在这里，我们表明，非互惠相互作用可以跨尺度生成和传递手性，即使在仅以标量密度形式制定的理论中也是如此。我们引入了一个最小的两物种连续体模型，其中非互易性和手性通过化学势的局部和非局部部分进入，这两个贡献在所涉及的空间梯度数量方面同样相关。在粗粒度水平上，手性表现为局部域（称为电荷） ，具有种间非互易电流的有限卷曲。这些手性电荷主动地重新分布粒子，强烈地改变了潜在的非互易动力学。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 手性活性颗粒的混合物提供了一个最小的环境，其中非互易性和手性交织在一起，形成集体动力学。在这里，我们表明，非互惠相互作用可以跨尺度生成和传递手性，即使在仅以标量密度形式制定的理论中也是如此。我们引入了一个最小的两物种连续体模型，其中非互易性和手性通过化学势的局部和非局部部分进入，这两个贡献在所涉及的空间梯度数量方面同样相关。在粗粒度水平上，手性表现为局部域（称为电荷） ，具有种间非互易电流的有限卷曲。这些手性电荷主动地重新分布粒子，强烈地改变了潜在的非互易动力学。它们的相互作用产生了明显的非平衡稳态，包括具有持续边缘电流的相分离和结合手性和非互易特征的时空无序相位。我们的结果确立了非互易性作为在标量混合物中产生手性动力学的一般机制。

articles.title: Predictive Inorganic Synthesis based on Machine Learning using Small Data sets: a case study of Hydrodynamic Diameter-controlled Cu Nanoparticles
articles.title_zh: 基于小数据集的机器学习预测无机合成：流体动力学直径控制的铜纳米颗粒案例研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.16545v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Cu NPs have a broad applicability, yet their synthesis is sensitive to subtle changes in reaction parameters. This sensitivity, combined with the time- and resource-intensive nature of experimental optimization, poses a major challenge in achieving reproducible and size-controlled synthesis. While ML shows promise in materials research, its application is often limited by scarcity of large high-quality experimental data sets. This study explores ML to predict the DLS-derived hydrodynamic diameter of Cu NPs using a small data set of 25 syntheses. Latin Hypercube Sampling is used to efficiently cover the parameter space while creating the experimental data set. Ensemble regression models successfully predict hydrodynamic diameters with good predictive performance given the limited dataset. Since quantitative regression requires a unique DLS-derived hydrodynamic diameter, the regression model is restricted to mono-modal DLS distributions, while a complementary classification model identifies synthesis conditions for which quantitative prediction is applicable. Using equivalent out-of-sample validation, the ML and DoE models showed comparable generalization. The final ensemble model achieved an R2=0.74 compared to 0.60 for the DoE model, while retaining the complete synthesis parameter space, making it better suited for synthesis guidance. Additionally, classification models using both random forests and LLMs are evaluated to distinguish between large and small particles. These classification models exhibited only modest predictive performance, indicating that this small dataset is insufficient to fully exploit the capabilities of complex LLMs. Overall, this study demonstrates that carefully curated small data sets, paired with robust classical ML, can effectively support the synthesis of Cu NPs and highlights that for lab-scale studies, complex models like LLMs may offer limited benefits.
articles.abstract_zh: 铜NP具有广泛的适用性，但它们的合成对反应参数的微妙变化敏感。这种灵敏度，加上实验优化的时间和资源密集型性质，对实现可重复和尺寸控制的合成提出了重大挑战。虽然机器学习在材料研究方面显示出前景，但其应用往往受到大型高质量实验数据集稀缺的限制。本研究使用25个合成的小数据集探索ML以预测Cu NP的DLS衍生流体动力学直径。拉丁超立方体采样用于在创建实验数据集时有效地覆盖参数空间。在数据集有限的情况下，集成回归模型能够以良好的预测性能成功预测流体动力学直径。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 铜NP具有广泛的适用性，但它们的合成对反应参数的微妙变化敏感。这种灵敏度，加上实验优化的时间和资源密集型性质，对实现可重复和尺寸控制的合成提出了重大挑战。虽然机器学习在材料研究方面显示出前景，但其应用往往受到大型高质量实验数据集稀缺的限制。本研究使用25个合成的小数据集探索ML以预测Cu NP的DLS衍生流体动力学直径。拉丁超立方体采样用于在创建实验数据集时有效地覆盖参数空间。在数据集有限的情况下，集成回归模型能够以良好的预测性能成功预测流体动力学直径。由于定量回归需要独特的DLS衍生流体动力学直径，因此回归模型仅限于单模态DLS分布，而互补分类模型确定了定量预测适用的合成条件。使用等效的样本外验证， ML和DoE模型显示出可比较的泛化。最终的集成模型实现了R2 = 0.74 ，而DoE模型为0.60 ，同时保留了完整的合成参数空间，使其更适合合成指导。此外，还对同时使用随机森林和LLM的分类模型进行了评估，以区分大颗粒和小颗粒。这些分类模型仅表现出适度的预测性能，表明这个小数据集不足以充分利用复杂LLM的能力。总体而言，这项研究表明，精心策划的小数据集与强大的经典机器学习相结合，可以有效地支持Cu NP的合成，并强调对于实验室规模的研究， LLM等复杂模型可能提供的益处有限。

articles.title: Flat-band Ferromagnetism of SU(N) Hubbard Model on the Kagome Lattices
articles.title_zh: Kagome晶格上SU (N) Hubbard模型的平带铁磁性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.10549v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The kagome lattice, a well known example of the geometrically frustrated system, hosts a dispersionless flat band that offers a unique platform for studying correlation-driven quantum phenomena. At appropriate particle concentrations, the existence of a flat band allows a representation of percolation with nontrivial weights. In this work, we investigate the paramagnetic-ferromagnetic transition in the repulsive SU(N) Hubbard model on the kagome lattice within this percolation framework. In this representation, the model can be rigorously mapped to a classical N-state site-percolation problem on a triangular lattice, with the SU(N) symmetry reflected in the nontrivial weights. By large-scale Monte Carlo simulations for SU(3), SU(4), and SU(10) symmetries, we demonstrate that the critical particle concentration for ferromagnetism exceeds the standard percolation threshold and increases with N, indicating a strengthening of the effective entropic repulsion.
articles.abstract_zh: Kagome晶格是几何受挫系统的一个众所周知的例子，它拥有一个无色散的平坦带，为研究相关驱动的量子现象提供了一个独特的平台。在适当的粒子浓度下，平坦带的存在允许以非平凡的权重表示渗透。在这项工作中，我们研究了在这种渗透框架内kagome晶格上排斥SU (N) Hubbard模型中的顺磁-铁磁转变。在这种表示中，该模型可以严格映射到三角格上的经典N状态位点渗透问题， SU (N)对称性反映在非平凡权重中。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Kagome晶格是几何受挫系统的一个众所周知的例子，它拥有一个无色散的平坦带，为研究相关驱动的量子现象提供了一个独特的平台。在适当的粒子浓度下，平坦带的存在允许以非平凡的权重表示渗透。在这项工作中，我们研究了在这种渗透框架内kagome晶格上排斥SU (N) Hubbard模型中的顺磁-铁磁转变。在这种表示中，该模型可以严格映射到三角格上的经典N状态位点渗透问题， SU (N)对称性反映在非平凡权重中。通过SU (3)、SU (4)和SU (10)对称性的大规模蒙特卡罗模拟，我们证明了铁磁性的临界粒子浓度超过标准渗透阈值并随着N的增加而增加，这表明有效熵斥力的增强。

articles.title: Magnetic field induced phenomena in Kitaev spin liquids
articles.title_zh: 基塔耶夫自旋液体中的磁场诱发现象
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.14496v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum spin liquids (QSLs) host a variety of fractionalized particles. In Kitaev's paradigmatic honeycomb model a spin-tfrac12 fractionalizes into Z₂ flux due to emergent Z₂ gauge field and matter Majorana fermions. Although these excitations have well-defined dynamics in the integrable limit, their direct experimental identification is notoriously challenging: realistic materials inevitably host additional symmetry-allowed interactions that break integrability and hybridize gauge and matter sectors, while magnetic fields, which are often required to suppress competing order and stabilize a putative QSL regime, further entangle the responses of different fractionalized quasiparticles and may even drive the system into field-induced spin-liquid phases that are not adiabatically connected to the integrable limit. A prominent example is the quantum Majorana metal, in which the distinct dynamics of fractionalized Majorana fermions can become directly visible in scattering. This review highlights recent progress on these related questions: in which field-stabilized QSL regimes and nearby emergent phases, and under what conditions, can the response of a specific fractionalized quasiparticle be isolated and positively understood, thereby clarifying the existence and the experimental scope of putative spin liquids? We review the progress on these questions across Abelian, non-Abelian, and emergent quantum phases under magnetic field that are not perturbatively connected to the integrable limit. We connect these field-induced dynamical phenomena to concrete experimental observables, relevant for neutron scattering, resonant inelastic X-ray scattering, and pump-probe spectroscopy, techniques that are capable of identifying the nature of different magnetic-field-induced phases and resolving specific types of fractionalized particles, including Majoranas and Z₂ fluxes.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子自旋液体（ QSL ）含有多种分级粒子。在Kitaev的典型蜂窝模型中，由于出现Z ₂规范场和物质Majorana费米子，自旋tfrac12分解为Z ₂通量。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子自旋液体（ QSL ）含有多种分级粒子。在Kitaev的典型蜂窝模型中，由于出现Z ₂规范场和物质Majorana费米子，自旋tfrac12分解为Z ₂通量。虽然这些激发在可积极限中具有明确的动力学，但它们的直接实验识别是众所周知的挑战：现实材料不可避免地承载了额外的对称允许的相互作用，这些相互作用破坏了可积性并使仪表和物质扇区杂交，而通常需要抑制竞争秩序并稳定假定QSL机制的磁场进一步纠缠了不同分数化准粒子的响应甚至可能将系统驱动到场诱导的自旋液相中，这些自旋液相与可积极限没有绝热连接。一个突出的例子是量子马约拉纳金属，其中分数马约拉纳费米子的独特动力学可以在散射中直接可见。本综述重点介绍了这些相关问题的最新进展：在哪些场稳定的QSL机制和附近的紧急阶段，以及在什么条件下，可以隔离和积极理解特定分数化准粒子的响应，从而澄清假定的自旋液体的存在和实验范围？我们回顾了磁场下阿贝尔、非阿贝尔和涌现量子相在这些问题上的进展，这些问题与可积极限没有扰动联系。我们将这些场诱导的动力学现象与具体的实验观测数据联系起来，这些数据与中子散射、共振非弹性X射线散射和泵-探针光谱学有关，这些技术能够识别不同磁场诱导相的性质，并解决特定类型的分数化粒子，包括Majoranas和Z ₂通量。

articles.title: Equilibrium Thermochemistry and Crystallographic Morphology of Manganese Sulfide Nanocrystals
articles.title_zh: 硫化锰纳米晶的平衡热化学和晶体形貌
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.05420v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Manganese sulfide (MnS) is a p-type magnetic semiconductor whose physicochemical properties are sensitive to nanocrystal (NC) morphology, yet the thermodynamic driving forces governing morphology across MnS polymorphs remain poorly understood. Here, we use density functional theory (DFT) to predict the equilibrium morphologies of rock salt (RS), zinc blende (ZB), and wurtzite (WZ) MnS NCs as a function of the relative chemical potential of sulfur, Δ μS. Benchmarking against Heydunicodex2013Scuseriaunicodex2013Ernzerhof (HSE06) hybrid functional calculations reveals that the r²SCAN meta-generalized gradient approximation reproduces experimental lattice constants and thermochemical reaction energies but underestimates S-terminated polar surface energies by up to a factor of five; applying a Hubbard U correction (r²SCAN+U, U = 2.7 eV) to the Mn 3d states brings the results into close agreement with HSE06. Using the benchmarked r²SCAN+U framework with the Gibbsunicodex2013Wulff theorem, we predict that RS-MnS NCs favor nanocubes across nearly the entire stability window, ZB-MnS NCs transform from rhombic dodecahedra (Mn-rich) to polyhedra with 16 triangular faces (S-rich), and WZ-MnS NCs adopt rod-like morphologies with Δ μS-sensitive base truncation. Synthesized RS-MnS NCs confirm the predicted cubic morphology, and high-temperature oxidative solution calorimetry yields an apparent surface energy of 1.15 ± 0.38 J·m⁻², higher than the theoretical equilibrium value (0.42unicodex20130.43 J·m⁻²), which we attribute to high-index facet exposure, surface area uncertainty, and non-ideal surface configurations in real samples. This work establishes a framework for predicting the equilibrium morphologies of metal chalcogenide NCs.
articles.abstract_zh: 硫化锰（ MnS ）是一种p型磁性半导体，其物理化学性质对纳米晶（ NC ）形态敏感，但控制MnS多晶形态的热力学驱动力仍然知之甚少。在这里，我们使用密度泛函理论（ DFT ）来预测岩盐（ RS ）、锌共混物（ ZB ）和纤锌矿（ WZ ） MnS NC的平衡形态，作为硫的相对化学势ΔμS的函数。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 硫化锰（ MnS ）是一种p型磁性半导体，其物理化学性质对纳米晶（ NC ）形态敏感，但控制MnS多晶形态的热力学驱动力仍然知之甚少。在这里，我们使用密度泛函理论（ DFT ）来预测岩盐（ RS ）、锌共混物（ ZB ）和纤锌矿（ WZ ） MnS NC的平衡形态，作为硫的相对化学势ΔμS的函数。以Heydunicodex2013Scuseriaunicodex2013Ernzerhof （ HSE06 ）混合函数计算为基准，表明r ²扫描元广义梯度近似再现了实验晶格常数和热化学反应能，但低估了S端极表面能高达五倍；对Mn 3D状态应用哈伯德U校正（ r ²扫描+ U ， U = 2.7eV ）使结果与HSE06接近。使用具有Gibbsunicodex2013Wulff定理的基准r ² SCAN + U框架，我们预测RS-MnS NC在几乎整个稳定窗口中都倾向于纳米立方体， ZB-MnS NC从菱形十二面体（富Mn ）转变为具有16个三角形面（富S ）的多面体，而WZ-MnS NC采用具有Δ μS敏感基底截断的棒状形态。合成的RS-MnS NCs证实了预测的立方形貌，高温氧化溶液量热法产生的表观表面能为1.15 ± 0.38 J · m恤² ，高于理论平衡值（ 0.42 unicodex20130.43 J · m恤² ） ，我们将其归因于实际样品的高指数面暴露、表面积不确定性和非理想的表面构型。这项工作为预测金属硫化物NC的平衡形态建立了一个框架。

articles.title: Quantum-classical dynamics of Rashba spin-orbit coupling
articles.title_zh: Rashba自旋轨道耦合的量子经典动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.23758v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Mixed quantum-classical models are widely used to reduce the computational cost of fully quantum simulations. However, their general applicability across different classes of problems remains an open question. Here, we address this issue for systems featuring spin-orbit coupling. In particular, we study the interaction dynamics of quantum spin-1/2 and classical orbital momentum in one-dimensional models of Rashba nanowires. We tackle this problem by resorting to a new quantum-classical Hamiltonian model that, unlike conventional approaches, retains the Heisenberg principle and captures correlation effects beyond the common Ehrenfest method. Based on Koopman wavefunctions in classical mechanics, the new model was recently implemented numerically via a particle scheme -- the koopmon method -- which is extended here to treat spin-orbit coupling. We apply the koopmon method to study the quantum-classical dynamics of nanowire models, with and without the presence of a harmonic potential and in both Rashba-dominated (strong coupling) and Zeeman-dominated (weak coupling) regimes. Considering realistic semiconductor parameters, the results are contrasted with both fully quantum and quantum-classical Ehrenfest dynamics. In the absence of external potential, the koopmon method qualitatively reproduces the features of the fully quantum evolution for all coupling regimes. While it exhibits a slight loss in spin accuracy compared to Ehrenfest simulations, the latter fail to capture the orbital dynamics. In the presence of a harmonic potential, the koopmon scheme reproduces several features of full quantum dynamics with accuracy levels that are unachievable by the Ehrenfest model. We conclude by presenting a test case that exhibits the formation of cat-like states.
articles.abstract_zh: 混合量子经典模型被广泛用于降低全量子模拟的计算成本。然而，它们在不同类别问题上的普遍适用性仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。在这里，我们针对具有自旋轨道耦合的系统解决这个问题。特别是，我们研究了 Rashba 纳米线一维模型中量子自旋 1/2 和经典轨道动量的相互作用动力学。我们通过采用新的量子经典哈密顿模型来解决这个问题，与传统方法不同，该模型保留了海森堡原理并捕获了超出常见埃伦菲斯特方法的相关效应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 混合量子经典模型被广泛用于降低全量子模拟的计算成本。然而，它们在不同类别问题上的普遍适用性仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。在这里，我们针对具有自旋轨道耦合的系统解决这个问题。特别是，我们研究了 Rashba 纳米线一维模型中量子自旋 1/2 和经典轨道动量的相互作用动力学。我们通过采用新的量子经典哈密顿模型来解决这个问题，与传统方法不同，该模型保留了海森堡原理并捕获了超出常见埃伦菲斯特方法的相关效应。基于经典力学中的库普曼波函数，新模型最近通过粒子方案（koopmon 方法）以数值方式实现，该方法在此扩展以处理自旋轨道耦合。我们应用 koopmon 方法来研究纳米线模型的量子经典动力学，无论是否存在谐波势，以及 Rashba 主导（强耦合）和 Zeeman 主导（弱耦合）机制。考虑到实际的半导体参数，结果与全量子和量子经典埃伦菲斯特动力学进行了对比。在没有外部势的情况下，koopmon 方法定性地再现了所有耦合机制的完全量子演化的特征。虽然与 Ehrenfest 模拟相比，它在旋转精度方面略有损失，但后者未能捕获轨道动力学。在存在谐波势的情况下，koopmon 方案再现了全量子动力学的几个特征，其精度水平是 Ehrenfest 模型无法达到的。最后，我们提出了一个测试用例，展示了类似猫的状态的形成。

articles.title: Exact criteria for ground-state overlap dominance and dynamical quantum phase transitions
articles.title_zh: 基态重叠优势和动态量子相变的精确标准
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.11420v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: It was recently conjectured and verified for the transverse-field Ising model [Phys. Rev. B 113, 165102 (2026)] that, after a sudden quench within the same equilibrium phase, the initial ground state has its largest overlap with the final ground state. We show that this phase-based criterion is generally false, even in translationally invariant free-fermion systems. For Hamiltonians that factorize into independent 2× 2 momentum sectors, we derive the exact necessary-and-sufficient condition for ground-state overlap dominance: the initial and final sector Bloch vectors must have positive dot product for every momentum. This result proves the conjecture in classes where same-phase quenches enforce this geometric condition, but gives explicit same-phase counterexamples in Kitaev chains, where excited final eigenstates can dominate the overlap distribution. We further show that the same obstruction controls real-time Fisher-zero crossings, allowing dynamical quantum phase transitions without crossing an equilibrium phase boundary.
articles.abstract_zh: 最近对横向场伊辛模型进行了猜想和验证[Phys. Rev. B 113, 165102 (2026)]，在同一平衡相内突然淬灭后，初始基态与最终基态具有最大的重叠。我们证明，即使在平移不变的自由费米子系统中，这种基于相位的标准通常也是错误的。对于分解为独立的 2×2 动量扇区的哈密顿量，我们推导出基态重叠优势的确切充要条件：初始和最终扇区布洛赫向量对于每个动量必须具有正点积。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 最近对横向场伊辛模型进行了猜想和验证[Phys. Rev. B 113, 165102 (2026)]，在同一平衡相内突然淬灭后，初始基态与最终基态具有最大的重叠。我们证明，即使在平移不变的自由费米子系统中，这种基于相位的标准通常也是错误的。对于分解为独立的 2×2 动量扇区的哈密顿量，我们推导出基态重叠优势的确切充要条件：初始和最终扇区布洛赫向量对于每个动量必须具有正点积。这一结果证明了类中的猜想，其中同相淬灭强制了这种几何条件，但在基塔耶夫链中给出了明确的同相反例，其中激发的最终本征态可以主导重叠分布。我们进一步表明，相同的障碍物控制实时费舍尔零交叉，允许动态量子相变而不跨越平衡相边界。

articles.title: Proximitized Topological Insulator Charge Island Fabricated via In Situ Multi-Angle Stencil Lithography
articles.title_zh: 通过原位多角度模板光刻制造的近似拓扑绝缘体电荷岛
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.18736v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Hybrid superconductor-topological insulator (TI) nanostructures constitute a promising material platform for exploring proximity-induced superconductivity in systems with topologically protected surface states. A key obstacle has been the realization of clean and well-controlled superconductor-TI interfaces, as TI surfaces rapidly degrade under ambient conditions. Here, we introduce a fully in situ, multi-angle stencil lithography technique that enables the fabrication of proximitized charge islands in TIs. The approach combines selective area growth of (Bi,Sb)₂Te₃ nanoribbons with angle-controlled deposition of diffusion barriers, superconducting Al, and ultrathin oxide tunnel barriers, allowing scalable fabrication of hybrid nanostructures without post-growth processing. Low-temperature transport measurements reveal robust Coulomb blockade and a pronounced suppression of low-energy conductance, which vanishes with a magnetic field, consistent with proximity-induced superconductivity in the island. These results establish a versatile nanofabrication platform that enables access to previously unexplored TI-based hybrid quantum devices and opens new routes for investigating superconductivity in topological nanostructures.
articles.abstract_zh: 混合超导体-拓扑绝缘体（TI）纳米结构构成了一个有前途的材料平台，用于探索具有拓扑保护表面态的系统中的邻近诱导超导性。一个主要障碍是实现清洁且控制良好的超导体-TI 界面，因为 TI 表面在环境条件下会迅速降解。在这里，我们介绍了一种完全原位、多角度模板光刻技术，该技术能够在 TI 中制造邻近的电荷岛。该方法将 (Bi,Sb)2Te3 纳米带的选择性区域生长与扩散势垒、超导铝和超薄氧化物隧道势垒的角度控制沉积相结合，从而无需进行后生长处理即可大规模制造混合纳米结构。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 混合超导体-拓扑绝缘体（TI）纳米结构构成了一个有前途的材料平台，用于探索具有拓扑保护表面态的系统中的邻近诱导超导性。一个主要障碍是实现清洁且控制良好的超导体-TI 界面，因为 TI 表面在环境条件下会迅速降解。在这里，我们介绍了一种完全原位、多角度模板光刻技术，该技术能够在 TI 中制造邻近的电荷岛。该方法将 (Bi,Sb)2Te3 纳米带的选择性区域生长与扩散势垒、超导铝和超薄氧化物隧道势垒的角度控制沉积相结合，从而无需进行后生长处理即可大规模制造混合纳米结构。低温输运测量揭示了强大的库仑封锁和低能电导的明显抑制，低能电导随磁场消失，这与岛上邻近感应的超导性一致。这些结果建立了一个多功能纳米制造平台，可以访问以前未开发的基于 TI 的混合量子器件，并为研究拓扑纳米结构中的超导性开辟新途径。

articles.title: Grassmann time-evolving matrix product operators for fermionic impurities coupled to a superconducting bath
articles.title_zh: 与超导浴耦合的费米子杂质的格拉斯曼时间演化矩阵乘积算子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.23301v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The Grassmann time-evolving matrix product operator (GTEMPO) method, which represents the Feynman-Vernon influence functional as a temporal matrix product state, has been shown to be a flexible and potentially scalable solution for fermionic quantum impurity problems. In this work, we extend GTEMPO to solve fermionic impurity problems in the Nambu formalism, in which the impurity is coupled to a superconducting bath. A key insight is that by employing the Bogoliubov transformation for the superconducting bath, one could obtain the analytic expression of the Feynman-Vernon influence functional in a similar form to the case of a normal bath, after which the core algorithms of GTEMPO can be straightforwardly adapted. We demonstrate the accuracy of our method by benchmarking it against exact diagonalization in several exactly solvable cases, and against the continuous-time quantum Monte Carlo method using converged dynamical mean field theory (DMFT) iterations on the imaginary contour in the non-integrable case. In all cases, we perform both imaginary- and real-time calculations to illustrate the flexibility of our method. These results illustrate that our method could be potentially useful as an impurity solver in DMFT as well as its non-equilibrium extension for fermionic impurity problems in the Nambu formalism.
articles.abstract_zh: 格拉斯曼时间演化矩阵乘积算子 (GTEMPO) 方法将 Feynman-Vernon 影响函数表示为时间矩阵乘积状态，已被证明是解决费米子量子杂质问题的灵活且具有潜在可扩展性的解决方案。在这项工作中，我们扩展了 GTEMPO 来解决 Nambu 形式主义中的费米子杂质问题，其中杂质与超导浴耦合。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 格拉斯曼时间演化矩阵乘积算子 (GTEMPO) 方法将 Feynman-Vernon 影响函数表示为时间矩阵乘积状态，已被证明是解决费米子量子杂质问题的灵活且具有潜在可扩展性的解决方案。在这项工作中，我们扩展了 GTEMPO 来解决 Nambu 形式主义中的费米子杂质问题，其中杂质与超导浴耦合。一个关键的见解是，通过对超导浴采用 Bogoliubov 变换，可以获得与正常浴情况类似的 Feynman-Vernon 影响函数的解析表达式，之后可以直接调整 GTEMPO 的核心算法。我们通过在几个完全可解的情况下对精确对角化进行基准测试，以及在不可积情况下对虚轮廓使用收敛动态平均场理论（DMFT）迭代的连续时间量子蒙特卡罗方法来证明我们的方法的准确性。在所有情况下，我们都会执行虚计算和实时计算来说明我们方法的灵活性。这些结果表明，我们的方法可能作为 DMFT 中的杂质求解器以及南部形式主义中费米子杂质问题的非平衡扩展有用。

articles.title: Spin-orbit coupling effects in altermagnets: Interplay of weak spin and orbital ferromagnetism with relativistic splitting of electron states
articles.title_zh: 交变磁体中的自旋轨道耦合效应：弱自旋和轨道铁磁性与电子态相对论分裂的相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.01780v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The aim of the paper is to contribute to reaching a deeper understanding of the formation of relativistic effects in altermagnets. The focus of the paper is on the phenomena of weak ferromagnetism (WFM) and relativistic DFT calculations combined with the symmetry analysis on the basis of spin space groups. The consideration is performed on two different levels. On the first level, the atomistic magnetic structure of weak ferromagnetic state is calculated. Both spin and orbital atomic moments are taken into account. We study the dependence of the WFM moment on the strength of the SOC and obtain a peculiar nonmonotonous type of dependence. An interesting result is obtained in quasisymmetry (QS) calculation where only the component of the SOC collinear to the Néel vector is taken into account. In QS calculation the spin WFM is absent while the orbital WFM is present. This reveals a principal difference in the formation of the spin and orbital magnetic moments. On the second level, the study is focused on the properties of individual electron states. We introduce the notion of the magnetic structure of the electron state (MSES). It is shown how the collinear spin-MSESs of both metal and ligand atoms and compensated orbital-MSES of the ligand obtained in the nonrelativiatic calculation transform into complex noncollinear 3D MSESs of both spin and orbital nature. An important role in the formation of MSESs is played by the relativistic splitting of the accidental spin degeneracies at general bf k points filling the volume of the Brillouin zone. The formation of the regions of avoided crossings in the relativistic band structure is related to the nonmonotonous behavior of the WFM moment. The importance of the metal-ligand hybridization in the formation of the AM properties is discussed. Most of the calculations are performed for MnTe.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文的目的是有助于更深入地了解交流磁体中相对论效应的形成。论文的重点是弱铁磁性（WFM）现象和相对论DFT计算以及基于自旋空间群的对称性分析。考虑是在两个不同的层面上进行的。在第一级，计算弱铁磁态的原子磁结构。自旋和轨道原子矩都被考虑在内。我们研究了 WFM 矩对 SOC 强度的依赖性，并获得了一种特殊的非单调依赖性。在准对称 (QS) 计算中获得了一个有趣的结果，其中仅考虑与 Néel 矢量共线的 SOC 分量。在 QS 计算中，自旋 WFM 不存在，而轨道 WFM 存在。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文的目的是有助于更深入地了解交流磁体中相对论效应的形成。论文的重点是弱铁磁性（WFM）现象和相对论DFT计算以及基于自旋空间群的对称性分析。考虑是在两个不同的层面上进行的。在第一级，计算弱铁磁态的原子磁结构。自旋和轨道原子矩都被考虑在内。我们研究了 WFM 矩对 SOC 强度的依赖性，并获得了一种特殊的非单调依赖性。在准对称 (QS) 计算中获得了一个有趣的结果，其中仅考虑与 Néel 矢量共线的 SOC 分量。在 QS 计算中，自旋 WFM 不存在，而轨道 WFM 存在。这揭示了自旋磁矩和轨道磁矩形成的主要差异。在第二个层面上，研究的重点是单个电子态的性质。我们引入电子态磁结构（MSES）的概念。展示了在非相对论计算中获得的金属和配体原子的共线自旋 MSES 以及配体的补偿轨道 MSES 如何转化为自旋和轨道性质的复杂非共线 3D MSES。在填充布里渊区体积的一般 bf k 点处偶然自旋简并的相对论分裂在 MSES 的形成中发挥着重要作用。相对论能带结构中避免交叉区域的形成与 WFM 矩的非单调行为有关。讨论了金属-配体杂化在AM特性形成中的重要性。大多数计算都是针对 MnTe 进行的。

articles.title: Compositional and Magnetic Characterisation of Oblique Co and Fe Nanowire Structures Fabricated Using Focused Electron Beam Induced Deposition
articles.title_zh: 使用聚焦电子束诱导沉积制造的斜钴和铁纳米线结构的成分和磁性表征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.14673v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Focused electron beam induced deposition (FEBID) is an additive manufacturing technique uniquely suited for fabricating functional 3D nanostructures for a range of applications, including spintronic devices. However, the variation of growth dynamics associated with lateral movement of the electron beam results in structures with non-uniform composition when fabricating intricate 3D geometries. Herein, we measure changes in atomic composition and corresponding changes in magnetic induction in 3D ferromagnetic nanostructures with overhanging elements, e.g. bridges or arches. To investigate the effects of electron beam lateral movement, we fabricated Co and Fe nanowire (NW) structures with growth angle relative to the optic axis varying from 0deg to 90deg. The (scanning) transmission electron microscopy techniques of electron energy loss spectroscopy and off-axis electron holography were performed to map the NW elemental composition and magnetic induction as a function of NW growth angle. Comparison of the results reveals a reduction in metal content with increased growth angle in FEBID NWs. The magnitude of metal content reduction can be tuned by controlling electron beam parameters, and ferromagnetic NWs with approximately equal metal content at growth angles from 0deg to 60deg were fabricated by using the lowest viable electron beam voltage and the highest viable beam current to reduce the interaction volume and increase the metal content, respectively.
articles.abstract_zh: 聚焦电子束诱导沉积 (FEBID) 是一种增材制造技术，特别适合制造功能性 3D 纳米结构，适用于多种应用，包括自旋电子器件。然而，在制造复杂的 3D 几何形状时，与电子束横向运动相关的生长动力学变化会导致结构成分不均匀。在这里，我们测量了具有悬垂元素的 3D 铁磁纳米结构中原子组成的变化以及磁感应强度的相应变化，例如桥梁或拱门。为了研究电子束横向移动的影响，我们制造了 Co 和 Fe 纳米线 (NW) 结构，其相对于光轴的生长角度从 0 度到 90 度不等。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 聚焦电子束诱导沉积 (FEBID) 是一种增材制造技术，特别适合制造功能性 3D 纳米结构，适用于多种应用，包括自旋电子器件。然而，在制造复杂的 3D 几何形状时，与电子束横向运动相关的生长动力学变化会导致结构成分不均匀。在这里，我们测量了具有悬垂元素的 3D 铁磁纳米结构中原子组成的变化以及磁感应强度的相应变化，例如桥梁或拱门。为了研究电子束横向移动的影响，我们制造了 Co 和 Fe 纳米线 (NW) 结构，其相对于光轴的生长角度从 0 度到 90 度不等。采用电子能量损失谱和离轴电子全息术的（扫描）透射电子显微镜技术来绘制纳米线元素组成和磁感应强度与纳米线生长角度的函数关系。结果比较表明，FEBID NW 中金属含量随着生长角度的增加而减少。金属含量减少的幅度可以通过控制电子束参数来调节，并且通过使用最低可行电子束电压和最高可行束电流分别减少相互作用体积和增加金属含量，制备了在0°至60°生长角度下金属含量大致相等的铁磁纳米线。

articles.title: Frustration from Localized Zhang-Rice States: A Unified Theory of Doping-Driven Magnetic Transitions in Cuprates
articles.title_zh: 局部张-莱斯态的挫败：铜酸盐中掺杂驱动磁转变的统一理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.18453v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The microscopic mechanism by which doped holes disrupt the antiferromagnetic (AFM) order is one of the fundamental questions in cuprates.
