articles.title: Thermal Diffusivity in Metallic Nanowire Aerogels
articles.title_zh: 金属纳米线气凝胶的热扩散率
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.08874v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Metallic nanowire aerogels combine the functional properties of metals with the high porosity of aerogels. Here, Ag and Cu nanowire aerogels with densities of 20-500 mg cm-3 were synthesized by freeze casting and investigated using lock-in thermography during sequential mechanical compaction. Thermal transport depended strongly on nanowire diameter, with 30 nm Ag nanowires exhibiting substantially lower thermal diffusivity than 60 nm wires, likely due to enhanced surface scattering as the wire diameter approaches the electron mean free path in Ag. Surprisingly, increasing the aerogel density through mechanical compaction reduced the calculated thermal diffusivity by nearly 300x, opposite the conventional expectation that denser materials transport heat more efficiently. Further analysis showed that this decrease is dominated by the thickness term in the thermal diffusivity formalism, while the fitted transport coefficient changes comparatively little. The characteristic thermal diffusion timescale decreased only modestly during compaction, indicating that densification primarily collapses pore volume without fundamentally restructuring the conductive nanowire network. This behavior resembles topology-preserving densification, where large geometric compression produces comparatively small changes in the effective percolative transport pathway. These results show that nanowire aerogels cannot always be treated as homogeneous bulk media, because their macroscopic geometry and conductive network evolve differently during compaction.
articles.abstract_zh: 金属纳米线气凝胶结合了金属的功能特性和气凝胶的高孔隙率。在这里，通过冷冻铸造合成了密度为 20-500 mg cm-3 的银和铜纳米线气凝胶，并在顺序机械压实过程中使用锁定热成像进行了研究。热传输很大程度上取决于纳米线直径，30 nm 银纳米线的热扩散率明显低于 60 nm 线，这可能是由于当线直径接近银中的电子平均自由程时表面散射增强。令人惊讶的是，通过机械压实增加气凝胶密度使计算的热扩散率降低了近 300 倍，这与密度更大的材料更有效地传输热量的传统预期相反。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 金属纳米线气凝胶结合了金属的功能特性和气凝胶的高孔隙率。在这里，通过冷冻铸造合成了密度为 20-500 mg cm-3 的银和铜纳米线气凝胶，并在顺序机械压实过程中使用锁定热成像进行了研究。热传输很大程度上取决于纳米线直径，30 nm 银纳米线的热扩散率明显低于 60 nm 线，这可能是由于当线直径接近银中的电子平均自由程时表面散射增强。令人惊讶的是，通过机械压实增加气凝胶密度使计算的热扩散率降低了近 300 倍，这与密度更大的材料更有效地传输热量的传统预期相反。进一步分析表明，这种下降主要由热扩散率形式中的厚度项主导，而拟合的传输系数变化相对较小。在压实过程中，特征热扩散时间尺度仅适度下降，表明致密化主要使孔体积塌陷，而没有从根本上重组导电纳米线网络。这种行为类似于拓扑保持致密化，其中大的几何压缩在有效渗透传输路径中产生相对较小的变化。这些结果表明，纳米线气凝胶并不总是被视为均匀的本体介质，因为它们的宏观几何形状和导电网络在压实过程中发生了不同的变化。

articles.title: Remote magnon sensing detects the universal phase stiffness jump in Bi₂Sr₂CaCu₂O₈₊δ
articles.title_zh: 远程磁振子传感检测 Bi2Sr2CaCu2O₈₊δ 中的通用相位刚度跃变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.08934v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Phase stiffness governs macroscopic quantum coherence in superfluids and superconductors, providing a sensitive probe of condensate depletion, fluctuations, and phase transitions. However quantitative and spatially resolved measurements remain challenging. Here we report a contactless, local, all-optical measurement of superconducting phase stiffness using propagating antiferromagnetic magnons as remote sensors. In CrSBr, strong exciton-magnon coupling enables optical excitation and detection of magnon wavepackets and precise determination of their group velocity. When CrSBr is interfaced with underdoped Bi₂Sr₂CaCu₂O₈₊δ, we find that the magnon group velocity is substantially enhanced below the superconducting transition and quantitatively encodes the phase stiffness through Meissner screening currents. Using this capability, we identify a parallel-field-induced Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless transition through direct observation of the universal phase-stiffness jump, revealing a field-controlled route to expose intrinsic two-dimensional phase-ordering physics in a bulk cuprate. Our work establishes propagating magnons as local probes of superconducting electrodynamics and phase-coherent phenomena in low-dimensional quantum materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 相刚度控制着超流体和超导体中的宏观量子相干性，为凝聚态耗尽、波动和相变提供了灵敏的探针。然而，定量和空间分辨测量仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们报告了使用传播反铁磁磁振子作为远程传感器对超导相位刚度进行非接触式、局部、全光学测量。在 CrSBr 中，强激子-磁振子耦合能够实现磁振子波包的光学激发和检测以及其群速度的精确测定。当 CrSBr 与欠掺杂的 Bi2Sr2CaCu2O₈₊δ 界面时，我们发现磁振子群速度在超导转变以下显着增强，并通过迈斯纳屏蔽电流定量编码相刚度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 相刚度控制着超流体和超导体中的宏观量子相干性，为凝聚态耗尽、波动和相变提供了灵敏的探针。然而，定量和空间分辨测量仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们报告了使用传播反铁磁磁振子作为远程传感器对超导相位刚度进行非接触式、局部、全光学测量。在 CrSBr 中，强激子-磁振子耦合能够实现磁振子波包的光学激发和检测以及其群速度的精确测定。当 CrSBr 与欠掺杂的 Bi2Sr2CaCu2O₈₊δ 界面时，我们发现磁振子群速度在超导转变以下显着增强，并通过迈斯纳屏蔽电流定量编码相刚度。利用这种能力，我们通过直接观察普遍的相刚度跳跃来识别平行场诱导的 Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless 转变，揭示了一种场控制的路线，以揭示大块铜酸盐中固有的二维相序物理现象。我们的工作将传播磁振子建立为低维量子材料中超导电动力学和相位相干现象的局部探针。

articles.title: From continuum neural quantum states to effective lattice models: Fluctuating Wigner molecules in moiré superlattices
articles.title_zh: 从连续神经量子态到有效晶格模型：莫尔超晶格中波动的维格纳分子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.08955v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Effective descriptions of quantum materials rely on a separation of energy scales that identifies their low-energy degrees of freedom. When kinetic energy, lattice potential, and interactions compete, this hierarchy breaks down, and both the microscopic state and its effective description are unknown. Continuum neural quantum states (NQS) can find the ground state directly without projecting onto prescribed bands, orbitals, or spins, but their microscopic wavefunctions are difficult to interpret in terms of effective variables. Here, we introduce a wavefunction readout that maps the continuum NQS onto site-resolved charge and spin statistics, allowing effective degrees of freedom to emerge from the microscopic solution. Focusing on moiré transition metal dichalcogenides at filling ν = 3, the NQS reveals a low-spin ground state below the ferromagnetic crystal of spin-polarized Wigner molecules. Although the charge density retains triangular molecular motifs, our readout reveals significant charge fluctuations through bound nearest-neighbor doublon--hole pairs. Each molecular charge state has an inert spin-singlet core and rim electrons that carry the spin. Charge and spin fluctuations are therefore intertwined, with antiferromagnetic spin-correlations between sites, motivating an effective description by a spinful two-orbital Hubbard model. More generally, our results demonstrate a route from continuum wavefunctions to effective lattice models when competing scales preclude a controlled reduction.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子材料的有效描述依赖于能量尺度的分离，以识别其低能量自由度。当动能、晶格势和相互作用相互竞争时，这种层次结构就会崩溃，微观状态及其有效描述都是未知的。连续神经量子态（NQS）可以直接找到基态，而不需要投影到规定的能带、轨道或自旋上，但它们的微观波函数很难用有效变量来解释。在这里，我们引入了一种波函数读数，将连续体 NQS 映射到位点解析的电荷和自旋统计数据上，从而允许从微观解决方案中出现有效的自由度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子材料的有效描述依赖于能量尺度的分离，以识别其低能量自由度。当动能、晶格势和相互作用相互竞争时，这种层次结构就会崩溃，微观状态及其有效描述都是未知的。连续神经量子态（NQS）可以直接找到基态，而不需要投影到规定的能带、轨道或自旋上，但它们的微观波函数很难用有效变量来解释。在这里，我们引入了一种波函数读数，将连续体 NQS 映射到位点解析的电荷和自旋统计数据上，从而允许从微观解决方案中出现有效的自由度。 NQS 重点关注填充 ν = 3 时的莫尔过渡金属二硫化物，揭示了自旋极化维格纳分子的铁磁晶体下方的低自旋基态。尽管电荷密度保留了三角形分子图案，但我们的读数显示通过结合的最近邻双布朗空穴对存在显着的电荷波动。每个分子电荷态都有一个惰性自旋单线核心和携带自旋的边缘电子。因此，电荷和自旋涨落相互交织，位点之间存在反铁磁自旋相关性，从而激发了自旋双轨道哈伯德模型的有效描述。更一般地说，我们的结果展示了当竞争尺度排除受控还原时从连续波函数到有效晶格模型的路线。

articles.title: Probing magnetic interactions in real space via magnetic pair distribution function analysis
articles.title_zh: 通过磁对分布函数分析探测真实空间中的磁相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.08957v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Determining magnetic exchange interactions is vital for understanding the magnetic behavior of materials. The standard method for exchange interaction determination involves performing inelastic neutron scattering experiments on single crystals to measure spin wave dispersions from a long-range-ordered magnetic ground state. However, the influence of exchange interactions is not limited exclusively to spin waves in ordered states, but also governs magnetic behavior in all magnetic states, including the short-range spin correlations that persist into the paramagnetic regime. Exchange parameters have been successfully recovered in the past from energy-integrated diffuse neutron scattering data from paramagnets, indicating that the diffuse scattering and underlying short-range magnetic correlations are rich in information. Consequently, magnetic pair distribution function (mPDF) analysis, which directly probes short-range magnetic correlations in real space, is expected to be well suited for extracting exchange parameters from correlated paramagnets. Here, we demonstrate a robust mean-field theory approach incorporating the Onsager reaction field for determination of exchange parameters from the results of mPDF analysis. We successfully apply this approach to several relevant materials to recover exchange interaction values comparable to literature values.
articles.abstract_zh: 确定磁交换相互作用对于理解材料的磁性行为至关重要。交换相互作用测定的标准方法包括在单晶上进行非弹性中子散射实验，以测量长程有序磁基态的自旋波色散。然而，交换相互作用的影响不仅限于有序态的自旋波，而且还控制所有磁态的磁行为，包括持续到顺磁态的短程自旋相关性。过去已经成功地从顺磁体的能量积分漫中子散射数据中恢复了交换参数，这表明漫散射和潜在的短程磁关联信息丰富。因此，磁对分布函数（mPDF）分析直接探测真实空间中的短程磁相关性，预计非常适合从相关顺磁体中提取交换参数。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 确定磁交换相互作用对于理解材料的磁性行为至关重要。交换相互作用测定的标准方法包括在单晶上进行非弹性中子散射实验，以测量长程有序磁基态的自旋波色散。然而，交换相互作用的影响不仅限于有序态的自旋波，而且还控制所有磁态的磁行为，包括持续到顺磁态的短程自旋相关性。过去已经成功地从顺磁体的能量积分漫中子散射数据中恢复了交换参数，这表明漫散射和潜在的短程磁关联信息丰富。因此，磁对分布函数（mPDF）分析直接探测真实空间中的短程磁相关性，预计非常适合从相关顺磁体中提取交换参数。在这里，我们展示了一种结合 Onsager 反应场的稳健平均场理论方法，用于根据 mPDF 分析结果确定交换参数。我们成功地将这种方法应用于几种相关材料，以恢复与文献值相当的交换相互作用值。

articles.title: Phase diagram of a semiflexible magnetic polymer in three dimensions
articles.title_zh: 三维半柔性磁性聚合物的相图
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.08958v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study a semiflexible magnetic polymer in which each monomer carries a two-state spin, giving rise to coupled conformational, stiffness, and magnetic degrees of freedom. The model provides a minimal representation of nucleoprotein complexes in vivo, in which DNA bending rigidity and bridging proteins must be simultaneously accommodated. We employ Monte Carlo simulations on a face-centered-cubic (FCC) lattice, complemented by a variational free-energy upper-bound approach, to characterize the zero-field phase diagram as a function of bending stiffness and temperature. At low stiffness, we identify a first-order transition combining coil-to-globule collapse with a ferromagnetic-to-paramagnetic transition. At lower temperatures, an additional first-order transition separates the disordered globule from an ordered crystal characterized by nematic-like orientational order of the bond tangents. At high stiffness, the globule disappears, resulting in a direct first-order coil-to-crystal transition. These results demonstrate how chain stiffness and magnetic degrees of freedom couple to polymer conformation and reorganize the zero-field phase diagram. Our model connects the two limiting cases of flexible magnetic polymers and semiflexible homopolymers, the latter corresponding to the strong-field limit in which all spins are aligned.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一种半柔性磁性聚合物，其中每个单体都带有两种状态的自旋，从而产生耦合的构象、刚度和磁性自由度。该模型提供了体内核蛋白复合物的最小表示，其中必须同时适应 DNA 弯曲刚性和桥接蛋白。我们对面心立方 (FCC) 晶格采用蒙特卡罗模拟，并辅以变分自由能上限方法，将零场相图描述为弯曲刚度和温度的函数。在低刚度下，我们确定了将线圈到球体塌陷与铁磁到顺磁转变相结合的一阶转变。在较低温度下，额外的一阶转变将无序球体与有序晶体分开，其特征在于键切线的向列状取向顺序。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了一种半柔性磁性聚合物，其中每个单体都带有两种状态的自旋，从而产生耦合的构象、刚度和磁性自由度。该模型提供了体内核蛋白复合物的最小表示，其中必须同时适应 DNA 弯曲刚性和桥接蛋白。我们对面心立方 (FCC) 晶格采用蒙特卡罗模拟，并辅以变分自由能上限方法，将零场相图描述为弯曲刚度和温度的函数。在低刚度下，我们确定了将线圈到球体塌陷与铁磁到顺磁转变相结合的一阶转变。在较低温度下，额外的一阶转变将无序球体与有序晶体分开，其特征在于键切线的向列状取向顺序。在高刚度下，球体消失，导致直接的一阶线圈到晶体的转变。这些结果证明了链刚度和磁自由度如何与聚合物构象耦合并重新组织零场相图。我们的模型连接了柔性磁性聚合物和半柔性均聚物的两种极限情况，后者对应于所有自旋对齐的强场极限。

articles.title: Magnon Polarization Textures and Transport in Antiferromagnets and Altermagnets
articles.title_zh: 反铁磁体和交变磁体中的磁振子偏振纹理和输运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.09035v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Antiferromagnets (AFMs) host magnons that can exhibit fully circular, elliptic and linear polarizations of sublattice magnetization dynamics. We analyze theoretically different momentum-space magnon polarization textures and magnon transport in collinear AFMs and altermagnets (AMs). The sensitivity of the polarization texture to a magnon momentum direction determines two regimes of magnon polarization kinetics: The Dyakonov-Perel relaxation or its dephasing due to asynchronous Larmor precession. For an easy-axis AFM, magnetic field parallel to the Néel vector leads to the suppression of the magnetic dipolar interaction-induced Dyakonov-Perel relaxation, accompanied by the increase in the magnon spin-diffusion length and its counter-intuitive growth with temperature. For a perpendicular orientation, instead, relaxation of circular polarization of magnons is enhanced due to Larmor precession. Finally, extremely anisotropic relaxation of magnon polarization is predicted for AMs or AFMs having Dzyaloshinskii-Morya interaction.
articles.abstract_zh: 反铁磁体 (AFM) 中的磁振子可以表现出亚晶格磁化动力学的全圆形、椭圆形和线性极化。我们从理论上分析了共线 AFM 和交流磁体 (AM) 中不同的动量空间磁振子偏振纹理和磁振子输运。偏振纹理对磁振子动量方向的敏感性决定了磁振子偏振动力学的两种状态：Dyakonov-Perel 弛豫或其由于异步拉莫尔进动而导致的相移。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 反铁磁体 (AFM) 中的磁振子可以表现出亚晶格磁化动力学的全圆形、椭圆形和线性极化。我们从理论上分析了共线 AFM 和交流磁体 (AM) 中不同的动量空间磁振子偏振纹理和磁振子输运。偏振纹理对磁振子动量方向的敏感性决定了磁振子偏振动力学的两种状态：Dyakonov-Perel 弛豫或其由于异步拉莫尔进动而导致的相移。对于易轴 AFM，平行于 Néel 矢量的磁场会抑制磁偶极相互作用引起的 Dyakonov-Perel 弛豫，同时伴随着磁振子自旋扩散长度的增加及其随温度的反直觉增长。相反，对于垂直方向，磁振子圆偏振的弛豫由于拉莫尔进动而增强。最后，对于具有 Dzyaloshinskii-Morya 相互作用的 AM 或 AFM，预测磁振子极化的极度各向异性弛豫。

articles.title: Ambipolar metal-insulator transition in bilayer MoSe2
articles.title_zh: 双层 MoSe2 中的双极性金属-绝缘体转变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.09036v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: When Coulomb interactions dominate kinetic energy, dilute two-dimensional carriers form a Wigner solid. Both its melting and disorder-driven localization can drive density-tuned metal-insulator transitions, but their relative roles and interplay have been debated for decades. Atomically thin semiconductors offer a new test because transport and scanning tunneling microscopy can probe the same material, yet poor contacts impede transport where correlations are strongest. Here we introduce contact-free radio-frequency reflectometry that senses sheet resistance through capacitive gate coupling. It resolves the electron and previously inaccessible hole transitions in the same bilayer MoSe2 device, whose carriers share disorder but not mass. Their critical densities differ fourfold yet correspond to comparable Coulomb-to-kinetic-energy ratios, where tunneling microscopy finds solid-liquid coexistence. Magnetoresistance peaks sharply at each transition, reflecting a Pomeranchuk-like, field-driven expansion of the Wigner solid against the correlated liquid. Our results demonstrate interaction-driven transitions in high-quality two-dimensional semiconductors, opening quantitative transport in contact-limited systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 当库仑相互作用主导动能时，稀释的二维载流子形成维格纳固体。它的熔化和无序驱动的局域化都可以驱动密度调节的金属-绝缘体转变，但它们的相对作用和相互作用已经争论了几十年。原子薄半导体提供了一种新的测试，因为传输和扫描隧道显微镜可以探测相同的材料，但接触不良会阻碍相关性最强的传输。在这里，我们介绍了非接触式射频反射仪，它通过电容栅极耦合来感测薄层电阻。它解决了同一双层 MoSe2 器件中的电子和以前无法达到的空穴跃迁问题，该器件的载流子共享无序，但不共享质量。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 当库仑相互作用主导动能时，稀释的二维载流子形成维格纳固体。它的熔化和无序驱动的局域化都可以驱动密度调节的金属-绝缘体转变，但它们的相对作用和相互作用已经争论了几十年。原子薄半导体提供了一种新的测试，因为传输和扫描隧道显微镜可以探测相同的材料，但接触不良会阻碍相关性最强的传输。在这里，我们介绍了非接触式射频反射仪，它通过电容栅极耦合来感测薄层电阻。它解决了同一双层 MoSe2 器件中的电子和以前无法达到的空穴跃迁问题，该器件的载流子共享无序，但不共享质量。它们的临界密度相差四倍，但对应于可比较的库仑动能比，隧道显微镜发现固液共存。磁阻在每次转变时急剧达到峰值，反映了维格纳固体相对于相关液体的波美兰丘克式场驱动膨胀。我们的结果证明了高质量二维半导体中相互作用驱动的转变，开启了接触有限系统中的定量传输。

articles.title: Momentum-Locked Edge Excitons in 2D Molecular Crystals
articles.title_zh: 二维分子晶体中的动量锁定边缘激子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.09148v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In molecular crystals, molecular excitations can hybridize into collective Frenkel excitons. Here we show that doubly degenerate excitations in planar two-dimensional molecular crystals generate excitonic bands with nontrivial momentum-resolved topological characteristics and edge states appearing only for selected crystallographic terminations. Using a model inspired by aggregates of zinc phthalocyanine molecules deposited on insulating surfaces, we demonstrate that the existence of edge excitons depends sensitively on the crystallographic orientation of the boundary and is governed by the Zak phase of the underlying bulk bands. The resulting edge states exhibit momentum-locked elliptical polarization textures originating from the internal structure of the molecular excitations, potentially enabling directional optical coupling and excitation transport. Our results establish a route toward topological and polarization-textured excitonic states in two-dimensional molecular materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 在分子晶体中，分子激发可以杂化成集体弗伦克尔激子。在这里，我们证明平面二维分子晶体中的双简并激发会产生具有非平凡动量分辨拓扑特征的激子带，并且仅出现在选定的晶体学终止处的边缘态。使用受沉积在绝缘表面上的锌酞菁分子聚集体启发的模型，我们证明边缘激子的存在敏感地取决于边界的晶体取向，并受底层体带的 Zak 相控制。由此产生的边缘态表现出源自分子激发内部结构的动量锁定椭圆偏振纹理，有可能实现定向光学耦合和激发传输。我们的结果为二维分子材料中的拓扑和偏振织构激子态建立了一条途径。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在分子晶体中，分子激发可以杂化成集体弗伦克尔激子。在这里，我们证明平面二维分子晶体中的双简并激发会产生具有非平凡动量分辨拓扑特征的激子带，并且仅出现在选定的晶体学终止处的边缘态。使用受沉积在绝缘表面上的锌酞菁分子聚集体启发的模型，我们证明边缘激子的存在敏感地取决于边界的晶体取向，并受底层体带的 Zak 相控制。由此产生的边缘态表现出源自分子激发内部结构的动量锁定椭圆偏振纹理，有可能实现定向光学耦合和激发传输。我们的结果为二维分子材料中的拓扑和偏振织构激子态建立了一条途径。

articles.title: Multiorbital Anisotropy and Magnetic Excitations in Trilayer Nickelate Pr₄Ni₃O₁₀
articles.title_zh: 三层镍酸盐 Pr₄Ni₃O₁₀ 的多轨道各向异性和磁激发
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.09210v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Rare-earth substitution strongly modifies the structure, metallicity, and superconducting behavior of Ruddlesden-Popper (RP) nickelates, but its impact on their magnetic interactions remains unclear. Here, we combine x-ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS) and resonant inelastic x-ray scattering (RIXS) to resolve the multiorbital electronic structure and magnetic excitations of Pr₄Ni₃O₁₀. The absence of an overlapping rare-earth resonance provides direct access to the Ni L₃ edge, while polarization-dependent measurements at the Ni L- and O K-edges resolve distinct planar and out-of-plane Ni-O hybridization channels. Momentum-resolved RIXS reveals dispersive magnetic excitations that soften toward the incommensurate spin-density-wave wave vector. An effective spin-wave analysis yields a sizable intra-trilayer exchange coupling, comparable to the leading in-plane interactions and robust against rare-earth substitution. Our results identify the multilayer architecture, rather than rare-earth substitution alone, as a key control knob of the magnetic interactions in these materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 稀土替代强烈改变了 Ruddlesden-Popper (RP) 镍酸盐的结构、金属丰度和超导行为，但其对其磁相互作用的影响仍不清楚。在这里，我们结合 X 射线吸收光谱（XAS）和共振非弹性 X 射线散射（RIXS）来解析 Pr₄Ni₃O₁0 的多轨道电子结构和磁激发。由于不存在重叠的稀土共振，因此可以直接接触 Ni L₃ 边缘，而 Ni L 和 O K 边缘处的偏振相关测量则可以解析不同的平面和面外 Ni-O 杂化通道。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 稀土替代强烈改变了 Ruddlesden-Popper (RP) 镍酸盐的结构、金属丰度和超导行为，但其对其磁相互作用的影响仍不清楚。在这里，我们结合 X 射线吸收光谱（XAS）和共振非弹性 X 射线散射（RIXS）来解析 Pr₄Ni₃O₁0 的多轨道电子结构和磁激发。由于不存在重叠的稀土共振，因此可以直接接触 Ni L₃ 边缘，而 Ni L 和 O K 边缘处的偏振相关测量则可以解析不同的平面和面外 Ni-O 杂化通道。动量分辨 RIXS 揭示了色散磁激励，该激励会软化到不相称的自旋密度波波矢。有效的自旋波分析产生相当大的三层内交换耦合，与领先的面内相互作用相当，并且对稀土替代具有鲁棒性。我们的结果表明，多层结构（而不是单独的稀土替代）是这些材料中磁相互作用的关键控制旋钮。

articles.title: Quasicrystalline oxide interfaces by twisting SrTiO3 membranes
articles.title_zh: 通过扭转 SrTiO3 膜形成准晶氧化物界面
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.09222v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quasicrystals reveal that long-range order can exist without translational periodicity, but deterministic routes for designing strongly bonded quasicrystalline interfaces remain unexplored. Here, we show that such interfaces can be engineered by growing epitaxial SrTiO3 membranes on a sacrificial layer, releasing them, twisting them by prescribed angles, and bonding them onto a chosen substrate. SrTiO3 bilayers twisted by 45deg form an octagonal quasicrystalline interface with eight-fold rotational symmetry, whereas trilayers assembled with successive 30deg rotations form a dodecagonal interface with twelve-fold symmetry. Selected-area and nano-beam electron diffraction, multislice electron ptychography, atomic-resolution dark field imaging, Fourier analysis, and real-space tiling establish long-range quasicrystalline order with electronic reconstruction evident from electron energy-loss spectroscopy after annealing. Atomistic simulations based on machine-learned interatomic potentials show that octagonal order emerges as the bilayer twist angle approaches 45deg. Polarization-dependent X-ray absorption spectroscopy in 1.5 nm twisted bilayers reveals a twist-dependent electronic response, and terahertz-field-induced second-harmonic generation circular dichroism identifies a symmetry-dependent nonlinear optical response at the 45deg quasicrystalline condition. Twisted oxide membranes therefore provide an extendable route to engineer quasiperiodic order and couple it to interfacial bonding, orbital reconstruction, and nonlinear optical response in complex oxides.
articles.abstract_zh: 准晶体揭示了长程有序可以在没有平移周期性的情况下存在，但设计强键合准晶体界面的确定性途径仍未探索。在这里，我们表明，可以通过在牺牲层上生长外延 SrTiO3 膜、释放它们、按规定角度扭转它们，并将它们粘合到选定的基板上来设计这种界面。 SrTiO3双层扭转45°形成具有八重旋转对称性的八角形准晶界面，而连续30°旋转组装的三层形成具有十二重对称性的十二边形界面。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 准晶体揭示了长程有序可以在没有平移周期性的情况下存在，但设计强键合准晶体界面的确定性途径仍未探索。在这里，我们表明，可以通过在牺牲层上生长外延 SrTiO3 膜、释放它们、按规定角度扭转它们，并将它们粘合到选定的基板上来设计这种界面。 SrTiO3双层扭转45°形成具有八重旋转对称性的八角形准晶界面，而连续30°旋转组装的三层形成具有十二重对称性的十二边形界面。选区和纳米束电子衍射、多层电子叠层成像、原子分辨率暗场成像、傅里叶分析和实空间平铺建立了长程准晶有序，并通过退火后的电子能量损失光谱证明了电子重建。基于机器学习原子间势的原子模拟表明，当双层扭转角接近 45 度时，会出现八角形有序。 1.5 nm 扭曲双层中的偏振相关 X 射线吸收光谱揭示了扭曲相关的电子响应，太赫兹场诱导的二次谐波生成圆二色性识别了 45 度准晶条件下对称性相关的非线性光学响应。因此，扭曲氧化物膜提供了一条可扩展的途径来设计准周期秩序，并将其与复杂氧化物中的界面键合、轨道重建和非线性光学响应耦合。

articles.title: Influence of nonlocal excitonic optical response on in-plane exciton polaritons supported by monolayer transition-metal dichalcogenides
articles.title_zh: 非局域激子光学响应对单层过渡金属二硫属化物支持的面内激子极化子的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.09232v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Achieving nanoscale light confinement and long-range propagation is a central challenge in nanophotonics, with important implications for controlling molecular photophysical processes and energy transfer. Monolayer transition-metal dichalcogenides (TMDs) support in-plane exciton-polaritons (IPEPs), deeply subwavelength optical modes in the visible range. In this regime, electromagnetic fields vary on length scales comparable to the exciton size, making spatial nonlocality in the excitonic optical response essential. Here, we develop a microscopic theory of the nonlocal excitonic optical response and investigate the near-field properties of IPEPs in hexagonal boron nitride (hBN)-encapsulated monolayer WS₂. Combining a two-band massive Dirac fermion description with a generalized Mott-Wannier treatment, we derive a nonlocal electric susceptibility that accounts for both the center-of-mass and internal relative motion of excitons. Spatial nonlocality in the excitonic optical response shifts the polariton dispersion toward lower in-plane wavevectors compared with the results based on the local-response approximation. This reduces high-wavevector contributions and produces smoother near-field distributions that extend over larger lateral distances while retaining nanoscale confinement. Furthermore, at higher excitation energies, multiple exciton-polariton modes contribute at distinct wavevectors, and their relative contributions can be tuned by varying the thickness of the capping hBN layer. These insights elucidate the fundamental role of spatial nonlocality in the polaritonic properties of van der Waals heterostructures.
articles.abstract_zh: 实现纳米级光限制和长程传播是纳米光子学的一个核心挑战，对于控制分子光物理过程和能量转移具有重要意义。单层过渡金属二硫化物 (TMD) 支持面内激子极化 (IPEP)，即可见光范围内的深亚波长光学模式。在这种情况下，电磁场在与激子尺寸相当的长度尺度上变化，使得激子光学响应的空间非定域性至关重要。在这里，我们开发了非局域激子光学响应的微观理论，并研究了六方氮化硼 (hBN) 封装的单层 WS2 中 IPEP 的近场特性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 实现纳米级光限制和长程传播是纳米光子学的一个核心挑战，对于控制分子光物理过程和能量转移具有重要意义。单层过渡金属二硫化物 (TMD) 支持面内激子极化 (IPEP)，即可见光范围内的深亚波长光学模式。在这种情况下，电磁场在与激子尺寸相当的长度尺度上变化，使得激子光学响应的空间非定域性至关重要。在这里，我们开发了非局域激子光学响应的微观理论，并研究了六方氮化硼 (hBN) 封装的单层 WS2 中 IPEP 的近场特性。将双能带质量狄拉克费米子描述与广义莫特-万尼尔处理相结合，我们得出了非局域电化率，它可以解释激子的质心和内部相对运动。与基于局部响应近似的结果相比，激子光学响应中的空间非局域性使极化子色散向较低的面内波矢移动。这减少了高波矢量的贡献，并产生更平滑的近场分布，在更大的横向距离上延伸，同时保留纳米级的限制。此外，在较高的激发能量下，多种激子-极化子模式对不同的波矢做出贡献，并且可以通过改变六方氮化硼覆盖层的厚度来调整它们的相对贡献。这些见解阐明了空间非定域性在范德华异质结构的极化子特性中的基本作用。

articles.title: Superconducting Diode Effect due to the Inverse Spin Hall Effect in Josephson Junctions with Extrinsic Spin-Orbit Interaction
articles.title_zh: 约瑟夫森结中具有外自旋轨道相互作用的逆自旋霍尔效应引起的超导二极管效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.09248v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The spin density and Josephson current at equilibrium are studied numerically in a superconductor-normal metal-superconductor (SNS) junction with extrinsic spin-orbit interaction in the N segment. This system preserves structural inversion symmetry. We find that the Josephson current generates the spin Hall effect, resulting in an opposite spin density near the two edges of the N segment. We also find that a Zeeman magnetic field with gradient applied to the N segment generates an anomalous phase shift due to the inverse spin Hall effect, resulting in a diode effect when higher harmonics of the Josephson current are present. These results are consistent with those of a previous theoretical study based on diagrammatic perturbation theory. We find that the diode effect becomes more pronounced when stronger coupling between the N and S segments enhances the higher harmonics.
articles.abstract_zh: 在 N 段中具有外在自旋轨道相互作用的超导体-普通金属-超导体 (SNS) 结中，对平衡状态下的自旋密度和约瑟夫森电流进行了数值研究。该系统保留了结构反演对称性。我们发现约瑟夫森电流产生自旋霍尔效应，导致N段两个边缘附近的自旋密度相反。我们还发现，由于反自旋霍尔效应，施加到 N 段的梯度塞曼磁场会产生异常相移，从而在存在约瑟夫森电流的高次谐波时产生二极管效应。这些结果与之前基于图微扰理论的理论研究结果一致。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在 N 段中具有外在自旋轨道相互作用的超导体-普通金属-超导体 (SNS) 结中，对平衡状态下的自旋密度和约瑟夫森电流进行了数值研究。该系统保留了结构反演对称性。我们发现约瑟夫森电流产生自旋霍尔效应，导致N段两个边缘附近的自旋密度相反。我们还发现，由于反自旋霍尔效应，施加到 N 段的梯度塞曼磁场会产生异常相移，从而在存在约瑟夫森电流的高次谐波时产生二极管效应。这些结果与之前基于图微扰理论的理论研究结果一致。我们发现，当 N 段和 S 段之间更强的耦合增强高次谐波时，二极管效应变得更加明显。

articles.title: Delamination in Large REBCO Coils
articles.title_zh: 大型 REBCO 线圈中的分层
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.09308v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: REBCO coated conductors have been used in ultrahigh field magnets for condensed matter physics research, nuclear fusion, particle accelerators, and NMR applications. It is well known, however, that they are not mechanically strong against delamination due to their intrinsic layered structures. As a result, the delamination issue has become one of the major design challenges of REBCO magnet coils. As a part of the development of the 40 T all-superconducting magnet at the National High Magnetic Field Laboratory, USA, large-scale coils wound by two-in-hand REBCO conductor with turn-to-turn insulation was designed and tested at 4.2 K in an 11.4 T background magnetic field. We found REBCO degradations within the windings and at the crossover joints during the tests. The postmortem inspection found that the degradation was caused by delamination. The delamination appears on the surface of the conductor as bubbles which were subsequently studied by microscopy. Additionally, a similar bubble was found on a short sample by torque magnetometry. This supports the inference that the delamination bubbles found in coils are due to electromagnetic stress. In this paper, we present these findings. The implication of these findings for future magnet designs and the method of mitigation will be discussed.
articles.abstract_zh: REBCO 涂层导体已用于凝聚态物理研究、核聚变、粒子加速器和核磁共振应用的超高场磁体。然而，众所周知，由于其固有的层状结构，它们在机械上不具备抗分层的能力。因此，分层问题已成为REBCO磁体线圈的主要设计挑战之一。作为美国国家高磁场实验室40 T全超导磁体开发的一部分，设计了由匝间绝缘的两手REBCO导体绕制的大型线圈，并在11.4 T背景磁场中在4.2 K下进行了测试。在测试过程中，我们发现绕组内和交叉接头处的 REBCO 退化。尸检发现降解是由分层引起的。
articles.abstract_zh_full: REBCO 涂层导体已用于凝聚态物理研究、核聚变、粒子加速器和核磁共振应用的超高场磁体。然而，众所周知，由于其固有的层状结构，它们在机械上不具备抗分层的能力。因此，分层问题已成为REBCO磁体线圈的主要设计挑战之一。作为美国国家高磁场实验室40 T全超导磁体开发的一部分，设计了由匝间绝缘的两手REBCO导体绕制的大型线圈，并在11.4 T背景磁场中在4.2 K下进行了测试。在测试过程中，我们发现绕组内和交叉接头处的 REBCO 退化。尸检发现降解是由分层引起的。分层现象以气泡的形式出现在导体表面，随后通过显微镜进行研究。此外，通过扭矩磁力测定法在短样品上发现了类似的气泡。这支持了这样的推论：线圈中发现的分层气泡是由于电磁应力造成的。在本文中，我们介绍了这些发现。将讨论这些发现对未来磁体设计的影响和缓解方法。

articles.title: Polarized neutron diffraction with ex-situ ³He neutron spin filter and two-dimensional detector for noncollinear incommensurate magnetic order
articles.title_zh: 利用非原位 3He 中子自旋滤波器和二维探测器实现非共线不相称磁序的偏振中子衍射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.09345v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Polarized neutron scattering has been widely used for studying magnetic orders in condensed matter. A typical setup for this technique is a triple-axis spectrometer with a ferromagnetic single-crystal monochromator and analyzer, which is suited for point-by-point measurements within the horizontal scattering plane. However, this setup cannot fully meet the demands of recent studies on complex magnetic orders with emergent cross-correlated phenomena. For instance, multiferroics, magnetic skyrmions, and other topologically nontrivial magnetic orders tend to have incommensurate magnetic modulation vectors running along various directions in reciprocal space, which cannot be captured by measurements restricted to the horizontal scattering plane. To overcome these limitations, we have developed an experimental setup combining a ³He neutron spin filter (³He-NSF) and a two-dimensional (2D) detector, which enables us to analyze the polarization of neutrons scattered away from the horizontal plane. We also establish a data reduction procedure to convert the 2D intensity maps into three-dimensional intensity distributions in reciprocal space, correcting for the effect of imperfect ³He polarization. This method is applied to single-crystal diffraction measurements on the multiferroic material Mn₃WO₆, which exhibits complex incommensurate magnetic orders. We have successfully observed polarization-dependent intensities of out-of-plane incommensurate magnetic reflections, demonstrating the effectiveness of the present method for analyzing complex magnetic structures.
articles.abstract_zh: 偏振中子散射已广泛用于研究凝聚态物质中的磁序。该技术的典型设置是带有铁磁单晶单色仪和分析仪的三轴光谱仪，适用于水平散射平面内的逐点测量。然而，这种设置不能完全满足最近对具有新兴互相关现象的复杂磁序研究的需求。例如，多铁性、磁性斯格明子和其他拓扑上非平凡的磁序往往具有沿着互易空间中的各个方向运行的不相称的磁调制矢量，这些矢量无法通过仅限于水平散射平面的测量来捕获。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 偏振中子散射已广泛用于研究凝聚态物质中的磁序。该技术的典型设置是带有铁磁单晶单色仪和分析仪的三轴光谱仪，适用于水平散射平面内的逐点测量。然而，这种设置不能完全满足最近对具有新兴互相关现象的复杂磁序研究的需求。例如，多铁性、磁性斯格明子和其他拓扑上非平凡的磁序往往具有沿着互易空间中的各个方向运行的不相称的磁调制矢量，这些矢量无法通过仅限于水平散射平面的测量来捕获。为了克服这些限制，我们开发了一种实验装置，结合了氦中子自旋过滤器（^He-NSF）和二维（2D）探测器，这使我们能够分析远离水平面散射的中子的偏振。我们还建立了一个数据简化程序，将二维强度图转换为倒易空间中的三维强度分布，纠正不完美的 3He 偏振的影响。该方法适用于多铁性材料 Mn3WO6 的单晶衍射测量，该材料表现出复杂的不相称磁序。我们成功地观察到了面外不相称磁反射的偏振相关强度，证明了本方法分析复杂磁结构的有效性。

articles.title: Bottom-Up Prediction of Amorphous Poly(1,3-dioxolane) using Ab Initio Reactive Machine-Learning Force Fields
articles.title_zh: 使用Ab Initio反应机器学习力场自下而上预测无定形聚(1,3-二氧戊环)
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.09388v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Poly(1,3-dioxolane) (pDXL) is a chemically recyclable polyether that can be synthesized by living cationic ring-opening polymerization with precise control of chain length into the ultra-high-molecular-weight (UHMW) regime, where it acquires enhanced mechanical properties. Like most polymers, however, it has amorphous condensed-phase structure, and diffraction measurements alone cannot resolve the atomistic microstructure that underlies them. In this work, we predict the ensemble of the pDXL microstructures by applying a recently developed AI-accelerated ab initio bottom-up polymer structure prediction (AI²-BPSP) framework that simulates the living polymerization of pDXL under experimental synthetic conditions with machine-learning force fields trained within van der Waals-corrected hybrid density functional theory. Partitioning the predicted X-ray and neutron diffraction signal between the growing chain and the surrounding monomer resolves its dominant feature into two counteracting modes: a monomer contribution near q approx 1.5 Å⁻¹ that decays as monomer is consumed, and a polymer contribution near q approx 1.6 Å⁻¹ that is absent in oligomers and grows with chain length. This work paves the way to direct accuracy validation of these statistically significant, first-principles, and chain-length resolved diffraction predictions against experiments.
articles.abstract_zh: 聚(1,3-二氧戊环) (pDXL) 是一种化学可回收聚醚，可通过活性阳离子开环聚合反应合成，并精确控制超高分子量 (UHMW) 状态的链长，从而获得增强的机械性能。然而，与大多数聚合物一样，它具有非晶态凝聚相结构，仅靠衍射测量无法解析它们背后的原子微观结构。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 聚(1,3-二氧戊环) (pDXL) 是一种化学可回收聚醚，可通过活性阳离子开环聚合反应合成，并精确控制超高分子量 (UHMW) 状态的链长，从而获得增强的机械性能。然而，与大多数聚合物一样，它具有非晶态凝聚相结构，仅靠衍射测量无法解析它们背后的原子微观结构。在这项工作中，我们通过应用最近开发的人工智能加速从头开始的自下而上聚合物结构预测 (AI²-BPSP) 框架来预测 pDXL 微观结构的整体，该框架通过在范德华校正混合密度泛函理论中训练的机器学习力场模拟实验合成条件下 pDXL 的活性聚合。将预测的 X 射线和中子衍射信号在不断增长的链和周围单体之间进行划分，将其主要特征分解为两种抵消模式：q 约为 1.5 Å⁻1 附近的单体贡献，随着单体的消耗而衰减；而 q 约 1.6 Å⁻1 附近的聚合物贡献，在低聚物中不存在，并随链长而增长。这项工作为根据实验直接验证这些具有统计意义的第一原理和链长解析衍射预测的准确性铺平了道路。

articles.title: Quench dynamics and quantum flutter properties of one-dimensional attractive single-spin flipped Fermi gases
articles.title_zh: 一维吸引单自旋翻转费米气体的淬灭动力学和量子颤振特性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.09431v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Impurity nonequilibrium dynamics in quantum many-body systems is a frontier subject in ultracold-atom physics, which helps uncover microscopic mechanisms of polaron and collective excitation phenomena. Although repulsive interacting systems have been extensively investigated, attractive-interaction dynamics lacks systematic studies owing to intricate couplings among different states. We study a one-dimensional ideal Fermi gas containing an attractive spin-down impurity with initial momentum and analyze time evolution of interspin two-body correlations and impurity momentum. Using exact Bethe ansatz solutions, we simplify correlation matrix elements to finite sums for efficient calculations of eigenstate occupations and long-time dynamical evolution. In the weakly attractive regime, bound-state features appear when the total momentum is below or equal to the Fermi momentum, while mixed oscillatory behaviors arise at larger total momentum. The strongly attractive regime shows locally bound-state dominated dynamics with localized correlation peaks and scattering-induced Friedel-like oscillations. We characterize quantum flutter, the periodic oscillation of impurity momentum, and obtain consistent critical chemical potential values of the impurity via four independent Bethe ansatz approaches. This work clarifies quench dynamics and quantum flutter under attractive interactions, improves the understanding of nonequilibrium quantum many-body properties, and provides theoretical support for relevant ultracold-atom impurity experiments.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子多体系统中的杂质非平衡动力学是超冷原子物理学的前沿课题，有助于揭示极化子和集体激发现象的微观机制。尽管排斥相互作用系统已被广泛研究，但由于不同状态之间复杂的耦合，吸引相互作用动力学缺乏系统的研究。我们研究了包含具有初始动量的有吸引力的自旋向下杂质的一维理想费米气体，并分析了自旋间二体相关性和杂质动量的时间演化。使用精确的 Bethe ansatz 解，我们将相关矩阵元素简化为有限和，以便有效计算本征态占据和长期动态演化。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子多体系统中的杂质非平衡动力学是超冷原子物理学的前沿课题，有助于揭示极化子和集体激发现象的微观机制。尽管排斥相互作用系统已被广泛研究，但由于不同状态之间复杂的耦合，吸引相互作用动力学缺乏系统的研究。我们研究了包含具有初始动量的有吸引力的自旋向下杂质的一维理想费米气体，并分析了自旋间二体相关性和杂质动量的时间演化。使用精确的 Bethe ansatz 解，我们将相关矩阵元素简化为有限和，以便有效计算本征态占据和长期动态演化。在弱吸引力状态下，当总动量低于或等于费米动量时，会出现束缚态特征，而当总动量较大时，会出现混合振荡行为。强烈吸引的状态显示出局部束缚态主导的动力学，具有局部相关峰和散射引起的弗里德尔式振荡。我们表征了量子颤振，即杂质动量的周期性振荡，并通过四种独立的 Bethe ansatz 方法获得了一致的杂质临界化学势值。该工作阐明了吸引相互作用下的淬灭动力学和量子颤振，提高了对非平衡量子多体性质的理解，为相关超冷原子杂质实验提供了理论支持。

articles.title: Inhomogeneous cluster DMFT study on p-n junction Mott gap closing in Hubbard lattice
articles.title_zh: 哈伯德晶格中p-n结莫特能隙闭合的非均匀团簇DMFT研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.09453v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Mott gap closing induced by an external potential gradient is studied by considering the Hubbard model on a square lattice. Our model consists of hole- and electron-doped domains forming the p-n junction where the on-site potential varies smoothly across the interface. The effect of the potential drop direction, either along square edge or diagonal, is studied by describing the correlation effects of inhomogeneous 2x2 plaquette impurity clusters within a dynamical mean-field theory framework. It is found that the metallic phase is favored over the Mott insulators when the potential drop becomes comparable to the energy eigenvalue difference of an open 2x2 plaquette between the ground state and the first excited state. Given the same associated electric-field strength, the excitation energy is almost independent of the drop direction, which amounts ~0.35t at U=5.8t with the hopping parameter t. Upon insulator-to-metal transition, the correlated metal exhibits a coherent peak at zero energy whose intensity is greater for the drop direction along the square diagonal than along the edge. The main origin is attributed to the preserved degeneracy of two molecular orbitals for the former case, while it undergoes splitting in the energy levels for the latter. Our result is discussed regarding the experimentally measured Mott gap closing thresholds.
articles.abstract_zh: 通过考虑方形晶格上的哈伯德模型，研究了由外部电势梯度引起的莫特能隙闭合。我们的模型由形成 p-n 结的空穴和电子掺杂域组成，其中现场电势在界面上平滑变化。通过描述动态平均场理论框架内不均匀 2x2 板状杂质簇的相关效应，研究了沿方形边缘或对角线的潜在下降方向的影响。研究发现，当电势降与基态和第一激发态之间开路 2x2 板的能量本征值差相当时，金属相优于莫特绝缘体。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 通过考虑方形晶格上的哈伯德模型，研究了由外部电势梯度引起的莫特能隙闭合。我们的模型由形成 p-n 结的空穴和电子掺杂域组成，其中现场电势在界面上平滑变化。通过描述动态平均场理论框架内不均匀 2x2 板状杂质簇的相关效应，研究了沿方形边缘或对角线的潜在下降方向的影响。研究发现，当电势降与基态和第一激发态之间开路 2x2 板的能量本征值差相当时，金属相优于莫特绝缘体。给定相同的相关电场强度，激发能量几乎与液滴方向无关，在跳跃参数 t 的 U=5.8t 时，激发能量约为 0.35t。在绝缘体到金属的转变时，相关金属在零能量处表现出相干峰，其强度沿着方形对角线的液滴方向比沿着边缘的强度更大。前一种情况的主要起源归因于两个分子轨道保留的简并性，而后者的能级发生分裂。我们的结果是关于实验测量的莫特间隙闭合阈值进行讨论的。

articles.title: Deep learning driven framework for optimization of polycrystalline microstructures under competing strength requirements
articles.title_zh: 深度学习驱动框架，用于在竞争强度要求下优化多晶微观结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.09461v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Computational design of polycrystalline microstructures for enhanced mechanical performance requires repeated high-fidelity simulations over stochastic morphologies, rendering conventional crystal plasticity finite element (CPFE) approaches prohibitively expensive for optimization. Here, we develop a deep learning-driven framework for optimizing polycrystalline microstructures under competing quasi-static and dynamic performance requirements. A 3D U-Net surrogate maps polycrystalline copper microstructures directly to full-field velocity histories from plate-impact simulations, preserving the spatial and temporal resolution needed to evaluate dynamic performance and interrogate underlying wave interactions and failure mechanisms. The surrogate is coupled with stochastic microstructure generation and derivative-free optimization to efficiently navigate the design space. To monitor surrogate reliability during optimization, we introduce a distribution-consistent reliability region (DCRR) based on maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) to quantify distributional shift from the training data. The framework is demonstrated for multiple design problems, including constrained optimization of spall and yield strengths and inverse design. The optimal designs are validated using CPFE simulations with less than 3% prediction error across all optimization cases, while the surrogate-driven optimization reduces cumulative evaluation time by approximately four orders of magnitude compared with direct CPFE-based optimization. Although demonstrated here for the design of polycrystalline microstructures targeting spall and yield strengths, the framework is broadly applicable to optimization problems where high-fidelity full-field simulations are prohibitively expensive but spatially and temporally resolved response information is essential for evaluating, interpreting, and optimizing candidate designs.
articles.abstract_zh: 为了增强机械性能而进行的多晶微结构的计算设计需要对随机形态进行重复的高保真模拟，这使得传统的晶体塑性有限元 (CPFE) 方法的优化成本过高。在这里，我们开发了一个深度学习驱动的框架，用于在竞争的准静态和动态性能要求下优化多晶微观结构。 3D U-Net 代理将多晶铜微观结构直接映射到板块撞击模拟的全场速度历史，保留评估动态性能和询问潜在波相互作用和失效机制所需的空间和时间分辨率。该替代物与随机微观结构生成和无导数优化相结合，以有效地导航设计空间。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 为了增强机械性能而进行的多晶微结构的计算设计需要对随机形态进行重复的高保真模拟，这使得传统的晶体塑性有限元 (CPFE) 方法的优化成本过高。在这里，我们开发了一个深度学习驱动的框架，用于在竞争的准静态和动态性能要求下优化多晶微观结构。 3D U-Net 代理将多晶铜微观结构直接映射到板块撞击模拟的全场速度历史，保留评估动态性能和询问潜在波相互作用和失效机制所需的空间和时间分辨率。该替代物与随机微观结构生成和无导数优化相结合，以有效地导航设计空间。为了在优化过程中监控替代可靠性，我们引入了基于最大均值差异（MMD）的分布一致可靠性区域（DCRR），以量化训练数据的分布变化。该框架针对多个设计问题进行了演示，包括剥落和屈服强度的约束优化以及逆向设计。使用 CPFE 模拟对最优设计进行验证，所有优化案例的预测误差均小于 3%，而与直接基于 CPFE 的优化相比，代理驱动优化将累积评估时间减少了大约四个数量级。尽管此处演示的是针对散裂和屈服强度的多晶微结构设计，但该框架广泛适用于优化问题，其中高保真度全场模拟成本高昂，但空间和时间解析的响应信息对于评估、解释和优化候选设计至关重要。

articles.title: Predicting activation-barrier and plasticity-onset statistics in a model of glasses
articles.title_zh: 预测眼镜模型中的激活势垒和可塑性起始统计数据
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.09619v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A recently introduced anharmonic mean-field model unifiedly reproduced a broad range of low-temperature glass phenomena --- including harmonic nonphononic spectral properties, linear micromechanics and strongly driven elasto-plastic dynamics --- indicating that its underlying energy landscape is intrinsically glassy. Here, we apply a nonlinear modes framework to the model and derive analytic predictions for the asymptotic distributions of activation barriers p(ΔU)!sim!(ΔU)¹/⁴ and the external force needed for the onset of plasticity p(fᵣₘ c)sim fᵣₘ c²/³, for their extreme-value scaling and for langleΔUrangle beyond the asymptotic regime. These predictions are expected to equally apply to the mean-field model and to finite-dimensional glasses. We develop efficient algorithms for sampling minima and saddles of the model's glassy potential energy landscape, and quantitatively confirm the theoretical predictions. This progress is enabled by identifying a subset of collective degrees of freedom that are physically relevant for activated glassy dynamics, which like the theoretical predictions should apply to realistic glasses.
articles.abstract_zh: 最近推出的非谐波平均场模型统一再现了广泛的低温玻璃现象——包括谐波非声子光谱特性、线性微观力学和强驱动弹塑性动力学——表明其潜在的能量景观本质上是玻璃态的。在这里，我们将非线性模式框架应用于模型，并推导了激活势垒 p(ΔU)!sim!(ΔU)1/⁴ 的渐近分布以及塑性开始所需的外力 p(fᵣₘ c)sim fᵣₘ c²/3、其极值缩放和超出渐近状态的 langleΔUrangle 的分析预测。这些预测预计同样适用于平均场模型和有限维玻璃。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 最近推出的非谐波平均场模型统一再现了广泛的低温玻璃现象——包括谐波非声子光谱特性、线性微观力学和强驱动弹塑性动力学——表明其潜在的能量景观本质上是玻璃态的。在这里，我们将非线性模式框架应用于模型，并推导了激活势垒 p(ΔU)!sim!(ΔU)1/⁴ 的渐近分布以及塑性开始所需的外力 p(fᵣₘ c)sim fᵣₘ c²/3、其极值缩放和超出渐近状态的 langleΔUrangle 的分析预测。这些预测预计同样适用于平均场模型和有限维玻璃。我们开发了有效的算法来对模型的玻璃势能景观的最小值和鞍点进行采样，并定量地证实了理论预测。这一进展是通过识别与激活玻璃动力学物理相关的集体自由度的子集来实现的，就像理论预测一样，这应该适用于现实的玻璃。

articles.title: Correspondence between Asymptotic Quantum Many-Body Scars in Closed Systems and Diffusive Nambu-Goldstone Modes in Open Systems
articles.title_zh: 封闭系统中渐近量子多体疤痕与开放系统中扩散南部-戈德斯通模式的对应关系
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.09662v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hydrodynamic relaxation in open quantum many-body systems can be understood in terms of diffusive Nambu--Goldstone (NG) modes associated with strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking (SWSSB). Here, we find a common structure underlying weak ergodicity breaking in closed quantum systems and diffusive hydrodynamics in open quantum systems. We establish a spectral correspondence between the parent Hamiltonian of rainbow quantum many-body scar (RQMBS) states in closed systems and the effective Lindbladian of strongly dissipative open systems with strong U(1) symmetry and local charge-dephasing Lindblad operators. For broad classes of spin, fermionic, and bosonic systems, we construct asymptotic RQMBS (ARQMBS) states. Within the enlarged scar subspace, the parent Hamiltonian admits a local Rokhsar--Kivelson-type frustration-free decomposition. A single-mode variational construction gives an O(k²) upper bound on its lowest excitation energy and yields states satisfying the defining ARQMBS criteria: orthogonality, vanishing energy variance, and characteristic entanglement scaling. Under vectorization, RQMBS states are mapped to maximally mixed infinite-temperature states in fixed-charge sectors, which exhibit long-range SWSSB order under finite-density conditions. Assuming uniformly bounded positive transition rates, the effective Lindbladian has the same local projectors as the parent Hamiltonian but with positive transition-dependent weights, yielding two-sided spectral bounds and the same system-size scaling of their gaps. For uniform rates, the two operators are proportional to each other and their eigenmodes coincide. Therefore, an exact quadratic parent-Hamiltonian branch maps directly to a diffusive NG mode. Our results connect different mechanisms of slow relaxation in closed and open quantum many-body systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 开放量子多体系统中的流体动力学弛豫可以用与强弱自发对称破缺 (SWSSB) 相关的扩散南部-戈德斯通 (NG) 模式来理解。在这里，我们发现了封闭量子系统中弱遍历性破坏和开放量子系统中扩散流体动力学的共同结构。我们在封闭系统中彩虹量子多体疤痕 (RQMBS) 态的父哈密顿量与具有强 U(1) 对称性和局部电荷相移 Lindblad 算子的强耗散开放系统的有效 Lindblad 算子之间建立了光谱对应关系。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 开放量子多体系统中的流体动力学弛豫可以用与强弱自发对称破缺 (SWSSB) 相关的扩散南部-戈德斯通 (NG) 模式来理解。在这里，我们发现了封闭量子系统中弱遍历性破坏和开放量子系统中扩散流体动力学的共同结构。我们在封闭系统中彩虹量子多体疤痕 (RQMBS) 态的父哈密顿量与具有强 U(1) 对称性和局部电荷相移 Lindblad 算子的强耗散开放系统的有效 Lindblad 算子之间建立了光谱对应关系。对于大类自旋、费米子和玻色子系统，我们构建渐近 RQMBS (ARQMBS) 态。在扩大的疤痕子空间内，父哈密顿量承认局部 Rokhsar-Kivelson 型无挫败分解。单模变分结构给出了其最低激发能量的 O(k²) 上限，并产生满足定义 ARQMBS 标准的状态：正交性、能量方差消失和特征纠缠缩放。在矢量化下，RQMBS 状态被映射到固定电荷扇区中最大混合的无限温度状态，在有限密度条件下表现出长程 SWSSB 顺序。假设正跃迁率均匀有界，有效 Lindbladian 具有与父哈密顿量相同的局部投影，但具有正跃迁相关权重，产生两侧光谱边界和相同的系统尺寸缩放间隙。对于统一速率，两个算子彼此成比例并且它们的本征模态一致。因此，精确的二次父哈密尔顿分支直接映射到扩散 NG 模式。我们的结果将封闭和开放量子多体系统中不同的缓慢弛豫机制联系起来。

articles.title: Vanishing Altermagnetism and Emergent Ferromagnetism at the Two-Dimensional Limit of CrSb
articles.title_zh: CrSb 二维极限处消失的交变磁性和涌现的铁磁性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.09664v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnets offer a promising route to spintronic devices by combining spin-split electronic states with zero net magnetization, but how reduced dimensionality reshapes their magnetic order remains poorly understood. Here, we grow bilayer-thickness CrSb (0001) films directly on SrTiO3(001) substrates by molecular beam epitaxy and uncover an unexpected thickness-dependent magnetic transition. The one-bilayer films exhibit room-temperature ferromagnetism with strong perpendicular magnetic anisotropy, whereas ferromagnetism vanishes in two-bilayer films, contrasting sharply with the altermagnetic ground state of bulk CrSb. Density functional theory calculations reveal that the exposed Cr surface induces orbital rearrangement that strengthens intralayer ferromagnetic exchange while suppressing competing interlayer antiferromagnetic coupling, driving the dimensional crossover from altermagnetism to ferromagnetism. These findings establish dimensionality and surface termination as powerful controls of magnetic order and provide a platform for engineering ultrathin magnetic states for spintronic applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 交变磁体通过将自旋分裂电子态与零净磁化相结合，为自旋电子器件提供了一条有前途的途径，但降维如何重塑其磁序仍然知之甚少。在这里，我们通过分子束外延直接在 SrTiO3(001) 衬底上生长双层厚度的 CrSb (0001) 薄膜，并发现了意想不到的厚度依赖性磁转变。一层双层薄膜表现出具有强垂直磁各向异性的室温铁磁性，而双层薄膜中铁磁性消失，这与块体 CrSb 的交变磁基态形成鲜明对比。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 交变磁体通过将自旋分裂电子态与零净磁化相结合，为自旋电子器件提供了一条有前途的途径，但降维如何重塑其磁序仍然知之甚少。在这里，我们通过分子束外延直接在 SrTiO3(001) 衬底上生长双层厚度的 CrSb (0001) 薄膜，并发现了意想不到的厚度依赖性磁转变。一层双层薄膜表现出具有强垂直磁各向异性的室温铁磁性，而双层薄膜中铁磁性消失，这与块体 CrSb 的交变磁基态形成鲜明对比。密度泛函理论计算表明，暴露的 Cr 表面会引起轨道重排，从而增强层内铁磁交换，同时抑制竞争的层间反铁磁耦合，从而驱动从交磁性到铁磁性的维度交叉。这些发现将维度和表面终止确立为磁序的强大控制，并为自旋电子应用设计超薄磁态提供了平台。

articles.title: Ab-initio Investigation on h-Be3N2 Monolayer for Photocatalytic Hydrogen Evolution Reaction and Oxygen Evolution Reaction
articles.title_zh: h-Be3N2 单层光催化析氢反应和析氧反应的从头算研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.09719v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work, we have systematically investigated the structural stability, electronic properties, and photocatalytic performance of the 2D h-Be3N2 monolayer for water splitting application, utilizing a first-principles density functional theory. Electronic structure calculations based on the PBE functional reveal that h-Be3N2 is a direct band-gap semiconductor with a band gap value of 1.74 eV, making it well suited for visible-light-driven photocatalysis. Furthermore, the alignment of band-edges illustrates that h-Be3N2 has suitable redox potential that facilitate overall photocatalytic water splitting in neutral and alkaline environment. Conversely, in acidic condition, the position of valence band is an adequate to enable the OER, thereby leading to photocathodic behavior. At neutral pH, the HER process is still possible with the application of an external potential of 0.77 V. For the OER process, it is thermodynamically favourable only under strongly alkaline conditions, while an external potential of 0.43 V is needed to promote the reaction at neutral pH. These results clearly underscore the significant impact of solution pH and photogenerated charge carriers on the photocatalytic effectiveness of the h-Be3N2 monolayer. Furthermore, the study of H coverage indicates that the amount of H that adheres to the surface has a considerable impact on the efficiency of the HER in h-Be3N2. The favourable photocatalytic capabilities of the h-Be3N2 monolayer imply that it might be a viable option for upcoming solar-powered green hydrogen generation and may assist in realizing the goals of the National Green Hydrogen Mission by facilitating effective and sustainable hydrogen production.
articles.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们利用第一性原理密度泛函理论，系统地研究了用于水分解应用的二维 h-Be3N2 单层的结构稳定性、电子性能和光催化性能。基于 PBE 泛函的电子结构计算表明，h-Be3N2 是一种直接带隙半导体，带隙值为 1.74 eV，非常适合可见光驱动的光催化。此外，能带边缘的排列表明h-Be3N2具有合适的氧化还原电位，有利于中性和碱性环境中的整体光催化水分解。相反，在酸性条件下，价带的位置足以发生OER，从而导致光阴极行为。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在这项工作中，我们利用第一性原理密度泛函理论，系统地研究了用于水分解应用的二维 h-Be3N2 单层的结构稳定性、电子性能和光催化性能。基于 PBE 泛函的电子结构计算表明，h-Be3N2 是一种直接带隙半导体，带隙值为 1.74 eV，非常适合可见光驱动的光催化。此外，能带边缘的排列表明h-Be3N2具有合适的氧化还原电位，有利于中性和碱性环境中的整体光催化水分解。相反，在酸性条件下，价带的位置足以发生OER，从而导致光阴极行为。在中性pH下，施加0.77V的外部电势仍然可以进行HER过程。对于OER过程，仅在强碱性条件下在热力学上有利，而在中性pH下则需要0.43V的外部电势来促进反应。这些结果清楚地强调了溶液 pH 值和光生载流子对 h-Be3N2 单层光催化效果的显着影响。此外，H 覆盖率的研究表明，附着在表面的 H 量对 h-Be3N2 中的 HER 效率有相当大的影响。 h-Be3N2单层良好的光催化能力意味着它可能是即将到来的太阳能绿色氢发电的可行选择，并可能通过促进有效和可持续的氢生产来帮助实现国家绿色氢使命的目标。

articles.title: Anomalous Hall enhancement in fully compensated non-collinear antiferromagnetic Cr-doped Mn3Sn
articles.title_zh: 全补偿非共线反铁磁 Cr 掺杂 Mn3Sn 中的反常霍尔增强
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.09727v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The non-collinear antiferromagnet (AFM), Mn3Sn, exhibits ultrafast spin dynamics and negligible stray fields, making it a promising candidate for fast and energy-efficient spintronic devices. However, its practical applications remain limited by the relatively small Hall response compared with ferromagnets. Here, we demonstrate through both first-principles calculations and experiments that Cr-doping is a promising strategy to enhance the anomalous Hall transport in Mn3Sn without breaking the antiferromagnetic order. Our first-principles calculations reveal an effective Cr-doping window that enhances the anomalous Hall conductivity while largely preserving the host coplanar inverse triangular AFM order. Berry curvature and Wannier Hamiltonian analyses further reveal that Cr substitution amplifies the pre-existing Berry curvature hotspots through coordinated changes in the energy alignment, local interband gap, and Mn-derived orbital weight of the relevant bands. Experimentally, we have found that Cr doping not only supports our computational predictions (enhancement of the anomalous Hall conductivity), but also suppresses the transition to helical or spin-glass phases at low temperatures. These findings demonstrate that Cr-doping is an effective strategy for stabilizing the AFM order while simultaneously improving the anomalous Hall transport properties over a wide temperature range in Mn3Sn.
articles.abstract_zh: 非共线反铁磁体 (AFM) Mn3Sn 表现出超快的自旋动力学和可忽略不计的杂散场，使其成为快速、节能的自旋电子器件的有希望的候选者。然而，与铁磁体相比，其实际应用仍然受到霍尔响应相对较小的限制。在这里，我们通过第一性原理计算和实验证明，Cr 掺杂是一种有前景的策略，可以在不破坏反铁磁序的情况下增强 Mn3Sn 中的反常霍尔传输。我们的第一性原理计算揭示了一种有效的 Cr 掺杂窗口，它可以增强反常霍尔电导率，同时在很大程度上保留主体共面反三角 AFM 阶数。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 非共线反铁磁体 (AFM) Mn3Sn 表现出超快的自旋动力学和可忽略不计的杂散场，使其成为快速、节能的自旋电子器件的有希望的候选者。然而，与铁磁体相比，其实际应用仍然受到霍尔响应相对较小的限制。在这里，我们通过第一性原理计算和实验证明，Cr 掺杂是一种有前景的策略，可以在不破坏反铁磁序的情况下增强 Mn3Sn 中的反常霍尔传输。我们的第一性原理计算揭示了一种有效的 Cr 掺杂窗口，它可以增强反常霍尔电导率，同时在很大程度上保留主体共面反三角 AFM 阶数。贝里曲率和万尼尔哈密尔顿分析进一步揭示，Cr 取代通过相关能带的能量排列、局部带隙和 Mn 衍生轨道权重的协调变化，放大了预先存在的贝里曲率热点。通过实验，我们发现 Cr 掺杂不仅支持我们的计算预测（异常霍尔电导率的增强），而且还抑制了低温下向螺旋相或自旋玻璃相的转变。这些发现表明，Cr 掺杂是稳定 AFM 级数的有效策略，同时改善 Mn3Sn 在宽温度范围内的反常霍尔传输特性。

articles.title: Effect of uniform bond-charge order on longitudinal spin-susceptibility jump at a superconducting instability inside a magnetic phase
articles.title_zh: 均匀键电荷序对磁相内超导不稳定性纵向自旋磁化率跳跃的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.09799v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A previous work [H. Yamase and M. Zafur, Phys. Rev. B 103, 224527 (2021)] showed that the longitudinal spin susceptibility exhibits a jump when the superconductivity develops continuously inside a magnetic phase. That analysis employed a minimal model containing magnetic and superconducting interactions. However, in correlated-electron systems, both magnetic and bond-charge interactions originate from the same underlying spin-spin exchange interaction. We therefore extend the model by including the uniform bond-charge order to provide a more realistic description of the system. We find that the jump of the longitudinal spin susceptibility remains robust even in the presence of uniform bond-charge order, but the uniform bond-charge order quantitatively enhances the longitudinal spin susceptibility and the size of the jump at T_c.
articles.abstract_zh: 之前的作品[H. Yamase 和 M. Zafur，物理学家。 Rev. B 103, 224527 (2021)]表明，当超导性在磁相内连续发展时，纵向自旋磁化率会呈现跳跃。该分析采用了包含磁和超导相互作用的最小模型。然而，在相关电子系统中，磁相互作用和键电荷相互作用都源于相同的基础自旋-自旋交换相互作用。因此，我们通过包含统一的键电荷顺序来扩展模型，以提供对系统更真实的描述。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 之前的作品[H. Yamase 和 M. Zafur，物理学家。 Rev. B 103, 224527 (2021)]表明，当超导性在磁相内连续发展时，纵向自旋磁化率会呈现跳跃。该分析采用了包含磁和超导相互作用的最小模型。然而，在相关电子系统中，磁相互作用和键电荷相互作用都源于相同的基础自旋-自旋交换相互作用。因此，我们通过包含统一的键电荷顺序来扩展模型，以提供对系统更真实的描述。我们发现，即使存在均匀的键电荷顺序，纵向自旋敏感性的跳跃仍然很鲁棒，但均匀的键电荷顺序定量地增强了纵向自旋敏感性和 T_c 处的跳跃大小。

articles.title: Self-induced spin-orbit torque switching in a synthetic antiferromagnetic Co 2 MnGa /MnGa bilayer
articles.title_zh: 合成反铁磁 Co 2 MnGa /MnGa 双层中的自感自旋轨道扭矩切换
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.09885v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The large intrinsic spin current in magnetic Weyl semimetals (WSMs) provides a promising platform for spin-orbit torque (SOT) devices. Here, we demonstrate SOTdriven magnetization switching in a synthetic antiferromagnet (SAF) composed of a Co2MnGa(CMG)/MnGa bilayer. In this heavy metal-free structure, CMG film functions simultaneously as a spin current source and as a magnetic layer. Macrospin simulations confirm the self-induced switching mechanism in the bilayer. The SOT generated by CMG switches the MnGa layer, which in turn triggers the reversal of the CMG layer via strong antiferromagnetic exchange coupling. These results elucidate the spin dynamics in SAFs and provide a new pathway toward SOT devices with selfinduced magnetization switching.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁性外尔半金属 (WSM) 中的大本征自旋电流为自旋轨道扭矩 (SOT) 器件提供了一个有前景的平台。在这里，我们演示了由 Co2MnGa(CMG)/MnGa 双层组成的合成反铁磁体 (SAF) 中 SOT 驱动的磁化开关。在这种无重金属的结构中，CMG 薄膜同时充当自旋电流源和磁性层。 Macrospin 模拟证实了双层中的自感应切换机制。 CMG 产生的 SOT 切换 MnGa 层，进而通过强反铁磁交换耦合触发 CMG 层的反转。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁性外尔半金属 (WSM) 中的大本征自旋电流为自旋轨道扭矩 (SOT) 器件提供了一个有前景的平台。在这里，我们演示了由 Co2MnGa(CMG)/MnGa 双层组成的合成反铁磁体 (SAF) 中 SOT 驱动的磁化开关。在这种无重金属的结构中，CMG 薄膜同时充当自旋电流源和磁性层。 Macrospin 模拟证实了双层中的自感应切换机制。 CMG 产生的 SOT 切换 MnGa 层，进而通过强反铁磁交换耦合触发 CMG 层的反转。这些结果阐明了 SAF 中的自旋动力学，并为具有自感磁化翻转的 SOT 器件提供了一条新途径。

articles.title: Interaction-enhanced photon blockade and Bell-state protection in microwave-shielded polar molecules
articles.title_zh: 微波屏蔽极性分子中相互作用增强的光子封锁和贝尔态保护
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.09959v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Microwave shielding has recently emerged as a powerful tool for engineering interactions in ultracold polar molecules, yet its potential for controlling cavity quantum electrodynamics remains largely unexplored. Here, we investigate a molecular cavity quantum electrodynamics platform in which two microwave-shielded polar molecules are coupled to a single optical cavity mode and demonstrate that shielding-induced interactions provide a unified mechanism for both photon blockade and Bell-state protection. The anisotropic interaction reshapes the few-excitation spectrum by enhancing its anharmonicity, thereby suppressing multiphoton transitions and improving the single-photon purity by more than three orders of magnitude. The enhanced blockade is accompanied by the emergence of negative longitudinal spin correlations, revealing the interaction-induced suppression of simultaneous molecular excitations. We further show that the photon statistics are highly sensitive to the relative molecular configuration, with positional variations on the scale of the relative zero-point fluctuation substantially modifying the blockade performance. Beyond few-photon nonlinear optics, the same interaction protects an initially prepared molecular Bell state by dispersively decoupling molecular excitations from the lossy cavity mode, thereby suppressing cavity-mediated dissipation and slowing the fidelity decay. Our results establish microwave-shielded interactions as a unified interaction resource for engineering few-photon nonlinearities and protecting quantum states in molecular cavity-QED systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 微波屏蔽最近已成为超冷极性分子中工程相互作用的有力工具，但其控制腔量子电动力学的潜力在很大程度上仍未得到开发。在这里，我们研究了一个分子腔量子电动力学平台，其中两个微波屏蔽极性分子耦合到单个光学腔模式，并证明屏蔽引起的相互作用为光子封锁和贝尔态保护提供了统一的机制。各向异性相互作用通过增强少激发光谱的非谐性来重塑少激发光谱，从而抑制多光子跃迁并将单光子纯度提高三个数量级以上。封锁的增强伴随着负纵向自旋相关性的出现，揭示了相互作用引起的同时分子激发的抑制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 微波屏蔽最近已成为超冷极性分子中工程相互作用的有力工具，但其控制腔量子电动力学的潜力在很大程度上仍未得到开发。在这里，我们研究了一个分子腔量子电动力学平台，其中两个微波屏蔽极性分子耦合到单个光学腔模式，并证明屏蔽引起的相互作用为光子封锁和贝尔态保护提供了统一的机制。各向异性相互作用通过增强少激发光谱的非谐性来重塑少激发光谱，从而抑制多光子跃迁并将单光子纯度提高三个数量级以上。封锁的增强伴随着负纵向自旋相关性的出现，揭示了相互作用引起的同时分子激发的抑制。我们进一步表明，光子统计数据对相对分子构型高度敏感，相对零点波动范围的位置变化极大地改变了封锁性能。除了少光子非线性光学之外，相同的相互作用通过将分子激发与有损腔模式分散解耦来保护最初准备的分子贝尔态，从而抑制腔介导的耗散并减缓保真度衰减。我们的研究结果将微波屏蔽相互作用确立为一种统一的相互作用资源，用于工程少光子非线性和保护分子腔 QED 系统中的量子态。

articles.title: Topological and kinetic origins of fractional thermal conductance at the topological insulator--superconductor interface
articles.title_zh: 拓扑绝缘体-超导体界面处分数热导的拓扑和动力学起源
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.10011v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A recent experiment by Roy et al. (Nat. Commun. 17, 2853 (2026)) demonstrated a robust half-integer thermal conductance plateau, κ₀ T/2, at a bipolar (ν,ν')=(2,-1) junction in bilayer graphene, produced not by non-Abelian topology but by full equilibration of co-propagating electron and hole edge modes. We prove a theorem that fixes when the two origins can be told apart: under full thermal equilibration, the two-terminal thermal conductance of a network of chiral edge segments joined at ideal floating contacts is a rational function of the net chiral central charges of the segments alone, quantities pinned by the gravitational anomaly and invariant under arbitrary local boundary kinetics. The corollary is an impossibility statement: whenever two realizations present the same anomaly data to the same network, no thermal-conductance measurement can distinguish them. That the equilibrated (2,-1) value equals the central charge of a chiral Majorana mode is an arithmetic fact about one filling combination, but wherever such a coincidence occurs it is beyond the reach of thermometry, and the separation must come from the charge sector, which is not anomaly-pinned at a superconducting boundary. We develop the topological insulator-superconductor interface as the application: a vortex carries fractional charge e/4 from the θ = π magnetoelectric coupling, the boundary hosts a chiral Majorana mode of central charge 1/2, and a laterally adjacent integer quantum Hall (IQH) region supplies the kinetic realization. The Lorenz ratio (anomalous for the isolated Majorana boundary, L₀ / (1 + 4|νIQH|) in the composite device) and the excess shot noise (growing with B from e/4 vortex tunneling versus locked to IQH plateaus) together resolve the mechanism, provided the quantum Hall edge does not abut the superconductor.
articles.abstract_zh: Roy 等人最近的一项实验。 (Nat. Commun. 17, 2853 (2026)) 在双层石墨烯的双极 (ν,ν')=(2,-1) 结处展示了稳健的半整数热导平台 κ₀ T/2，该平台不是由非阿贝尔拓扑产生的，而是由共传播电子和空穴边缘模式的完全平衡产生的。我们证明了一个定理，该定理可以区分两个起源：在完全热平衡下，在理想浮动接触处连接的手性边缘片段网络的两端热导是片段的净手性中心电荷的有理函数，这些量由重力异常固定，并且在任意局部边界动力学下保持不变。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Roy 等人最近的一项实验。 (Nat. Commun. 17, 2853 (2026)) 在双层石墨烯的双极 (ν,ν')=(2,-1) 结处展示了稳健的半整数热导平台 κ₀ T/2，该平台不是由非阿贝尔拓扑产生的，而是由共传播电子和空穴边缘模式的完全平衡产生的。我们证明了一个定理，该定理可以区分两个起源：在完全热平衡下，在理想浮动接触处连接的手性边缘片段网络的两端热导是片段的净手性中心电荷的有理函数，这些量由重力异常固定，并且在任意局部边界动力学下保持不变。推论是一个不可能的陈述：每当两个实现向同一网络呈现相同的异常数据时，没有热导测量可以区分它们。平衡的 (2,-1) 值等于手性马约拉纳模式的中心电荷，这是关于一种填充组合的算术事实，但无论何时发生这种巧合，它都超出了测温的范围，并且分离必须来自电荷扇区，而电荷扇区并未异常固定在超导边界处。我们开发了拓扑绝缘体-超导体界面作为应用：涡旋携带来自 θ = π 磁电耦合的分数电荷 e/4，边界具有中心电荷 1/2 的手性马约拉纳模式，横向相邻的整数量子霍尔 (IQH) 区域提供动力学实现。洛伦兹比（复合器件中孤立的马约拉纳边界的异常，L₀ / (1 + 4|νIQH|)）和过量散粒噪声（随着 e/4 涡旋隧道效应的 B 增长，而不是锁定到 IQH 平台）共同解决了该机制，前提是量子霍尔边缘不邻接超导体。

articles.title: Screening of tensor properties by magnetic point group symmetries: The PythMPG code package
articles.title_zh: 通过磁点群对称性筛选张量属性：PythMPG 代码包
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.10024v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding the symmetry requirements that permit specific phenomena or physical effects is crucial in condensed matter physics for identifying candidate materials that exhibit one or more of these effects. To this end, screening tensor properties based on (magnetic) point-group symmetries is of particular interest. Here, we present the PythMPG code package, a tool designed for this purpose. Inspired by the MTENSOR utility of the Bilbao Crystallographic Server, PythMPG performs symmetry analysis in a self-contained way to determine which tensors, characterized by their Jahn symbols, are allowed for each magnetic point group and how many symmetry-allowed independent components each tensor possesses. We describe the structure of the code and present some illustrative examples.
articles.abstract_zh: 在凝聚态物理学中，了解允许特定现象或物理效应的对称性要求对于识别表现出一种或多种这些效应的候选材料至关重要。为此，基于（磁）点群对称性的筛选张量属性特别令人感兴趣。在这里，我们介绍 PythMPG 代码包，这是一个为此目的而设计的工具。受毕尔巴鄂晶体服务器的 MTENSOR 实用程序的启发，PythMPG 以独立的方式执行对称性分析，以确定每个磁点组允许使用哪些张量（以 Jahn 符号为特征），以及每个张量拥有多少个允许对称的独立分量。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在凝聚态物理学中，了解允许特定现象或物理效应的对称性要求对于识别表现出一种或多种这些效应的候选材料至关重要。为此，基于（磁）点群对称性的筛选张量属性特别令人感兴趣。在这里，我们介绍 PythMPG 代码包，这是一个为此目的而设计的工具。受毕尔巴鄂晶体服务器的 MTENSOR 实用程序的启发，PythMPG 以独立的方式执行对称性分析，以确定每个磁点组允许使用哪些张量（以 Jahn 符号为特征），以及每个张量拥有多少个允许对称的独立分量。我们描述了代码的结构并提供了一些说明性示例。

articles.title: Solphin: Photovoltaic efficiency analysis for bulk materials using Python
articles.title_zh: Solphin：使用 Python 对散装材料进行光伏效率分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.10028v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In the development of photovoltaic materials, computational simulation has become a important tool for reducing the time and cost of exploring novel materials, as well as providing insights that help drive improvements in efficiency through increasing fundamental understanding. We present Solphin, a Python package for the generation, post-processing and analysis of photovoltaic calculations from periodic solid state Density Functional Theory. We include the ability to calculate the photovoltaic Figure of Merit, detailed balance and spectroscopic limited maximum efficiency, alongside other analysis methods. Solphin has been built to improve the access, reproducibility and ease of evaluating the photovoltaic potential of a material in an efficient and user-friendly manner.
articles.abstract_zh: 在光伏材料的开发中，计算模拟已成为减少探索新型材料的时间和成本的重要工具，并提供见解，通过增加基本理解来帮助推动效率的提高。我们推出了 Solphin，这是一个 Python 包，用于根据周期性固态密度泛函理论生成、后处理和分析光伏计算。我们包括计算光伏品质因数、详细平衡和光谱有限最大效率以及其他分析方法的能力。 Solphin 旨在提高以高效且用户友好的方式评估材料光伏潜力的可访问性、可重复性和易用性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在光伏材料的开发中，计算模拟已成为减少探索新型材料的时间和成本的重要工具，并提供见解，通过增加基本理解来帮助推动效率的提高。我们推出了 Solphin，这是一个 Python 包，用于根据周期性固态密度泛函理论生成、后处理和分析光伏计算。我们包括计算光伏品质因数、详细平衡和光谱有限最大效率以及其他分析方法的能力。 Solphin 旨在提高以高效且用户友好的方式评估材料光伏潜力的可访问性、可重复性和易用性。

articles.title: Charge transport in two-dimensional conductors with hybrid three-component plasma
articles.title_zh: 利用混合三组分等离子体在二维导体中进行电荷传输
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.10060v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electron--hole plasma in two-dimensional systems has mainly been studied in two limiting cases: degenerate semimetals with parabolic bands and nondegenerate symmetric Dirac systems such as graphene. Here we investigate a different regime realized in a gapless HgTe quantum well: a multicomponent plasma where massless Dirac carriers coexist with thermally activated heavy holes from lateral valence-band valleys. Near charge neutrality, the resistance increases approximately as T², in sharp contrast to the nearly temperature-independent resistivity expected for a symmetric Dirac plasma. We show that once heavy holes are populated, charge neutrality pins the chemical potential above the Dirac point, leaving the Dirac electrons moderately degenerate while the heavy holes remain nondegenerate and obey Boltzmann statistics. The light electrons therefore scatter almost elastically from the heavy holes, allowing a relaxation-time treatment of interparticle transport. Using carrier densities from self-consistent band-structure calculations, we reproduce the data with a short-range electron--hole interaction in the weakly disordered limit, for which the conductivity scales as T⁻² and the excess resistivity is proportional to the heavy-hole density. In contrast, an unscreened Coulomb interaction would give a temperature-independent conductivity. The extracted interaction amplitude is of the expected Coulomb scale. These results establish near-critical HgTe quantum wells as a platform for interaction-driven transport in multicomponent systems combining degenerate massless and nondegenerate massive carriers.
articles.abstract_zh: 二维系统中的电子-空穴等离子体主要在两种极限情况下进行研究：具有抛物线带的简并半金属和非简并对称狄拉克系统（例如石墨烯）。在这里，我们研究了在无间隙 HgTe 量子阱中实现的不同状态：多组分等离子体，其中无质量狄拉克载流子与来自横向价带谷的热激活重空穴共存。接近电荷中性时，电阻大约以 T² 增加，这与对称狄拉克等离子体预期的几乎与温度无关的电阻率形成鲜明对比。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 二维系统中的电子-空穴等离子体主要在两种极限情况下进行研究：具有抛物线带的简并半金属和非简并对称狄拉克系统（例如石墨烯）。在这里，我们研究了在无间隙 HgTe 量子阱中实现的不同状态：多组分等离子体，其中无质量狄拉克载流子与来自横向价带谷的热激活重空穴共存。接近电荷中性时，电阻大约以 T² 增加，这与对称狄拉克等离子体预期的几乎与温度无关的电阻率形成鲜明对比。我们表明，一旦重空穴填充，电荷中性将化学势固定在狄拉克点之上，使狄拉克电子适度简并，而重空穴保持非简并并服从玻尔兹曼统计。因此，轻电子几乎从重空穴中弹性地散射，从而允许对粒子间传输进行弛豫时间处理。使用自洽能带结构计算中的载流子密度，我们在弱无序极限下重现了短程电子-空穴相互作用的数据，其中电导率按 T⁻² 缩放，过量电阻率与重空穴密度成正比。相反，未经屏蔽的库仑相互作用将产生与温度无关的电导率。提取的相互作用幅度具有预期的库仑尺度。这些结果将近临界 HgTe 量子阱建立为结合简并无质量和非简并质量载流子的多组分系统中相互作用驱动输运的平台。

articles.title: Universal orbital-coupling rules for hydrogen-defect interactions in bcc metals
articles.title_zh: bcc 金属中氢缺陷相互作用的通用轨道耦合规则
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.10063v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hydrogen-defect interactions control the performance of body-centered-cubic (bcc) metals. However, the complex variations among defects lead to various empirical models that lack transferability across defects. Here, we propose an orbital-coupling model, built on coordination number and interatomic distance, that quantifies the H solution energetics across nanovoids, vacancy loops and grain boundaries in bcc metals, and even predicts the potential-energy surfaces of H at nanovoids. Our model reveals an unconventional s-d coupling rule in the confined environment of defects: H-metal interactions exhibit a unique coordination-dependent law, whereas H-H interactions, deviating from the usually speculated s-s coupling, acquire the distance-decay law of H-metal coupling. This unusual rule proves essential to reproduce the experimentally observed bimodal profile of H desorption. Our electronic-structure-origin, unified model is thus crucial to understanding the nature of chemical bonds under constraint and engineering the H-tolerant materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 氢-缺陷相互作用控制体心立方（bcc）金属的性能。然而，缺陷之间复杂的变化导致各种经验模型缺乏跨缺陷的可移植性。在这里，我们提出了一种基于配位数和原子间距离的轨道耦合模型，该模型量化了 bcc 金属中纳米空隙、空位环和晶界的 H 溶液能量，甚至预测了纳米空隙处 H 的势能表面。我们的模型揭示了缺陷受限环境中非常规的 s-d 耦合规则：H-金属相互作用表现出独特的配位依赖定律，而 H-H 相互作用则偏离了通常推测的 s-s 耦合，获得了 H-金属耦合的距离衰减定律。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 氢-缺陷相互作用控制体心立方（bcc）金属的性能。然而，缺陷之间复杂的变化导致各种经验模型缺乏跨缺陷的可移植性。在这里，我们提出了一种基于配位数和原子间距离的轨道耦合模型，该模型量化了 bcc 金属中纳米空隙、空位环和晶界的 H 溶液能量，甚至预测了纳米空隙处 H 的势能表面。我们的模型揭示了缺陷受限环境中非常规的 s-d 耦合规则：H-金属相互作用表现出独特的配位依赖定律，而 H-H 相互作用则偏离了通常推测的 s-s 耦合，获得了 H-金属耦合的距离衰减定律。事实证明，这一不寻常的规则对于重现实验观察到的 H 解吸双峰曲线至关重要。因此，我们的电子结构起源统一模型对于理解约束下化学键的性质和设计耐氢材料至关重要。

articles.title: Percolation on interdependent one-dimensional long-range networks
articles.title_zh: 相互依赖的一维远程网络的渗透
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.10097v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the emergence of a mutual giant component in a multiplex network comprised of two one-dimensional long-range networks on a lattice. The probability that two nodes on one lattice, with a distance r between them, are connected with an edge falls algebraically with distance as Cr⁻⁽¹⁺σ⁾, where 0 < σ < 1 and 0 < C ≤ 1. A mutual giant component exists if C > C_cmul, where C_cmul(σ) is a critical value of C that is dependent on σ. We find rigorous lower bounds on C_cmul, and a tree approximation whose estimate of C_cmul agrees with simulations within 0.6% for σ ≤ 0.5. The multiplex network is significantly less stable than the single network case, as is evident by the larger value of C_cmul, which is up to 2.4 times the single-layer value. Our simulations indicate that the order of the transition depends on σ. For σ ≤ 0.35 the mutual giant component collapses abruptly, in a first-order phase transition, while for σ ≥ 0.4 the transition is continuous. When the dependency links connect random pairs of nodes, the transition is first order for all σ.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了由晶格上两个一维远程网络组成的多重网络中相互巨型组件的出现。一个晶格上的两个节点之间的距离为 r，通过边连接的概率随距离以代数方式下降 Cr⁻⁽1⁺σ⁾，其中 0 C_cmul，其中 C_cmul(σ) 是依赖于 σ 的 C 临界值。我们发现了 C_cmul 的严格下界，以及树近似，其 C_cmul 的估计与 σ ≤ 0.5 的模拟在 0.6% 以内一致。多路网络的稳定性明显低于单层网络的情况，C_cmul 的值较大（高达单层值的 2.4 倍）就可以看出这一点。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了由晶格上两个一维远程网络组成的多重网络中相互巨型组件的出现。一个晶格上的两个节点之间的距离为 r，通过边连接的概率随距离以代数方式下降 Cr⁻⁽1⁺σ⁾，其中 0 C_cmul，其中 C_cmul(σ) 是依赖于 σ 的 C 临界值。我们发现了 C_cmul 的严格下界，以及树近似，其 C_cmul 的估计与 σ ≤ 0.5 的模拟在 0.6% 以内一致。多路网络的稳定性明显低于单层网络的情况，C_cmul 的值较大（高达单层值的 2.4 倍）就可以看出这一点。我们的模拟表明，转变的顺序取决于 σ。当 σ ≤ 0.35 时，相互巨分量在一级相变中突然崩溃，而当 σ ≥ 0.4 时，转变是连续的。当依赖链接连接随机的节点对时，所有 σ 的转换都是一阶的。

articles.title: Gentle Floquet control of orbital Hall effect and orbital inverse Faraday effect
articles.title_zh: 轨道霍尔效应和轨道逆法拉第效应的温和 Floquet 控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.10109v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Floquet engineering controls material responses via a time-periodic electromagnetic drive. An important task in practise is to reduce the driving strengths required to implement Floquet protocols.We show that in systems with strong phase-space constraints, where the response is dominated by a small region of momentum space, the relative impact of a resonant Floquet drive is enhanced. We demonstrate this idea on the example of the orbital Hall effect, where equilibrium occupations restrict the interband coherence to a narrow momentum interval hbarΔ k. The ratio eE₀/(Ω₀hbarΔ k), where Ω₀ is the frequency of the drive, is considerable even at modest field amplitudes E₀, leading to a large relative change in the orbital Hall conductivity. Due to the non-trivial orbital texture, the circularly polarized drive induces an inverse orbital Faraday effect by magnetizing the electrons. We show that the corresponding susceptibility is controlled by the interband quantum metric that determines the resonant Floquet hybridization.
articles.abstract_zh: Floquet 工程通过时间周期电磁驱动来控制材料响应。实践中的一项重要任务是降低实现 Floquet 协议所需的驱动强度。我们表明，在具有强相空间约束的系统中，响应由动量空间的小区域主导，谐振 Floquet 驱动的相对影响得到增强。我们以轨道霍尔效应为例证明了这一想法，其中平衡占据将带间相干性限制在狭窄的动量区间 hbarΔ k 内。即使在适度的场振幅 E₀ 下，比率 eE₀/(Ω₀hbarΔ k)（其中 Ω₀ 是驱动频率）也相当大，导致轨道霍尔电导率发生较大的相对变化。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Floquet 工程通过时间周期电磁驱动来控制材料响应。实践中的一项重要任务是降低实现 Floquet 协议所需的驱动强度。我们表明，在具有强相空间约束的系统中，响应由动量空间的小区域主导，谐振 Floquet 驱动的相对影响得到增强。我们以轨道霍尔效应为例证明了这一想法，其中平衡占据将带间相干性限制在狭窄的动量区间 hbarΔ k 内。即使在适度的场振幅 E₀ 下，比率 eE₀/(Ω₀hbarΔ k)（其中 Ω₀ 是驱动频率）也相当大，导致轨道霍尔电导率发生较大的相对变化。由于不平凡的轨道结构，圆极化驱动器通过磁化电子来诱发反轨道法拉第效应。我们表明，相应的磁化率是由决定共振 Floquet 杂化的带间量子度量控制的。

articles.title: Progress and Prospect of AI in ARPES Workflow
articles.title_zh: ARPES工作流程中人工智能的进展与展望
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.10140v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is becoming an increasingly useful tool across the experimental sciences, including angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES), which routinely produces large, multidimensional datasets of electronic structure. Recent advances in AI and machine learning (ML) have opened new opportunities across the entire ARPES workflow, from automated sample preparation and real-time data acquisition to post-experiment data analysis and comparison with theoretical calculations. Despite this progress, a comprehensive review of ML applications, their capabilities, and reliability across the different stages of ARPES workflow is still lacking. In this review, we first introduce ML methods that are most relevant to experimentalists working in condensed matter physics and materials science. We then follow the ARPES workflow, reviewing existing ML applications at each step and discussing their advantages, limitations and potential for future development. We also examine the current ARPES data landscape, where several open databases are available but remain relatively small and fragmented compared with large, shared datasets such as ImageNet. Given these limitations, we suggest that the community focus on sharing pretrained models that can be further trained, adapted to specific tasks, and redistributed, while working toward a larger and standardized open ARPES dataset repository. Finally, we discuss our perspectives on the future of AI within the ARPES workflow using a six-level framework of laboratory automation, highlighting the opportunities and challenges in moving toward a fully autonomous, self-driving ARPES laboratory.
articles.abstract_zh: 人工智能 (AI) 正在成为整个实验科学中越来越有用的工具，包括角度分辨光电子能谱 (ARPES)，它通常会生成大型、多维的电子结构数据集。人工智能和机器学习 (ML) 的最新进展为整个 ARPES 工作流程带来了新的机遇，从自动化样品制备和实时数据采集到实验后数据分析以及与理论计算的比较。尽管取得了这些进展，但仍然缺乏对 ARPES 工作流程不同阶段的 ML 应用程序、其功能和可靠性的全面审查。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 人工智能 (AI) 正在成为整个实验科学中越来越有用的工具，包括角度分辨光电子能谱 (ARPES)，它通常会生成大型、多维的电子结构数据集。人工智能和机器学习 (ML) 的最新进展为整个 ARPES 工作流程带来了新的机遇，从自动化样品制备和实时数据采集到实验后数据分析以及与理论计算的比较。尽管取得了这些进展，但仍然缺乏对 ARPES 工作流程不同阶段的 ML 应用程序、其功能和可靠性的全面审查。在这篇综述中，我们首先介绍与凝聚态物理和材料科学领域的实验学家最相关的机器学习方法。然后，我们遵循 ARPES 工作流程，在每个步骤中审查现有的 ML 应用程序，并讨论它们的优势、局限性和未来发展的潜力。我们还研究了当前的 ARPES 数据格局，其中有几个可用的开放数据库，但与 ImageNet 等大型共享数据集相比仍然相对较小且分散。鉴于这些限制，我们建议社区重点共享可进一步训练、适应特定任务和重新分发的预训练模型，同时致力于建立更大、标准化的开放 ARPES 数据集存储库。最后，我们使用六级实验室自动化框架讨论了 ARPES 工作流程中人工智能的未来前景，强调了迈向完全自主、自动驾驶 ARPES 实验室的机遇和挑战。

articles.title: Lattice dynamics of disordered phases of silicon and spatially resolved computations of thermal conductivity
articles.title_zh: 硅无序相的晶格动力学和热导率的空间分辨计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.10165v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The lattice dynamics of disordered systems (amorphous solids, polymers and glasses) are often distinct from crystalline analogues. Examples include the "two-level systems" and the Boson peak. Here, we show that even the venerable material amorphous silicon offers new wrinkles: (1) realistic networks studied with DFT-quality interatomic potentials show the existence of harmonic modes exhibiting anomalously large root-mean-square variation in atomic positions, and (2) these dynamics determine the processes of heat transport. We correlate the atomic dynamics with transport using the site-projected thermal conductivity [C. Ugwumadu et. al Phys. Status Solidi B 263, e202500316 (2026)], and conjecture that these observations are relevant to other disordered systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 无序系统（无定形固体、聚合物和玻璃）的晶格动力学通常与晶体类似物不同。例子包括“两能级系统”和玻色子峰。在这里，我们证明，即使是古老的材料非晶硅也出现了新的问题：（1）用 DFT 质量的原子间势研究的现实网络表明存在谐波模式，这些谐波模式在原子位置上表现出异常大的均方根变化，并且（2）这些动力学决定了热传输过程。我们使用位点投影热导率将原子动力学与传输关联起来 [C.乌格乌马杜等。阿尔物理。

articles.title: Prediction of the thermal neutron response of grain-boundary impedance in Gd-doped ceria based on the radiation-ionic effect
articles.title_zh: 基于辐射离子效应预测掺Gd二氧化铈晶界阻抗热中子响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.10191v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The radiation-ionic effect was reported in 3 mol% Gd-doped CeO₂ (3GDC): under ⁶⁰Co gamma irradiation at 35 Gy/min, the grain-boundary (GB) ionic resistance of a bulk pellet decreased 680-fold at room temperature because radiation-generated electrons trapped at the GB core lower the space-charge potential. The effect has only been demonstrated with photons. Here the response of 3GDC to thermal neutrons is predicted. Neutrons are absorbed by ¹⁵⁷Gd (254 kb); about 50 keV per capture is deposited within 1 μm by conversion and Auger electrons, and Gd segregates to the GBs, so the energy is delivered to the interfaces that block ionic transport. This source term is expressed as a GB-effective generation rate and used in the Mott-Schottky/Seager framework calibrated on the published gamma data. The gamma temperature series fixes the temperature dependence of the single trap parameter (about 1.1 eV), and this calibration reproduces the trap parameter obtained from independent thin-film UV data at 400 ^circC. A thermal flux of 6×10⁹ cm⁻²s⁻¹ gives the same GB-effective generation rate as the 35 Gy/min calibration. At room temperature the predicted GB resistance ratio is about 150 (90% interval 100-290) at 10⁹ and about 1300 (900-2500) at 10¹⁰ cm⁻²s⁻¹; the response vanishes above 60 ^circC at 10⁹ and 80 ^circC at 10¹⁰. Because capture events are discrete, the continuous-source description holds only if the trapped charge of one event outlasts the next; this is met at 10¹⁰ and marginal at 10⁹, so the recovery time constant is the first quantity a neutron experiment should measure. Self-shielding is partly offset by Compton absorption of the capture photons; above 5 mol% Gd the response is limited by the weak dark barrier. Source parameters, sample geometry and controls needed to test the prediction are given.
articles.abstract_zh: 在 3 mol% Gd 掺杂的 CeO2 (3GDC) 中报告了辐射离子效应：在 35 Gy/min 的 ⁶⁰Co 伽玛辐射下，块状颗粒的晶界 (GB) 离子电阻在室温下降低了 680 倍，因为在 GB 核心处捕获的辐射产生的电子降低了空间电荷电势。这种效应仅通过光子得到证实。这里预测了 3GDC 对热中子的响应。中子被 157 Gd (254 kb) 吸收；
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在 3 mol% Gd 掺杂的 CeO2 (3GDC) 中报告了辐射离子效应：在 35 Gy/min 的 ⁶⁰Co 伽玛辐射下，块状颗粒的晶界 (GB) 离子电阻在室温下降低了 680 倍，因为在 GB 核心处捕获的辐射产生的电子降低了空间电荷电势。这种效应仅通过光子得到证实。这里预测了 3GDC 对热中子的响应。中子被 157 Gd (254 kb) 吸收；每次捕获约 50 keV 通过转换和俄歇电子沉积在 1 μm 内，并且 Gd 偏析到 GB，因此能量被传递到阻止离子传输的界面。该源项表示为 GB 有效生成率，并在根据已发布的伽马数据校准的 Mott-Schottky/Seager 框架中使用。伽马温度系列固定了单个陷阱参数（约 1.1 eV）的温度依赖性，并且该校准再现了从 400 ^circC 下的独立薄膜 UV 数据获得的陷阱参数。 6×10⁹cm⁻²s⁻1 的热通量可提供与 35 Gy/min 校准相同的 GB 有效生成速率。在室温下，预测的 GB 电阻比在 10⁹ 时约为 150（90% 区间 100-290），在 1010 cm-2s-1 时约为 1300（900-2500）；在 10⁹ 时，响应在 60 ^circC 以上消失；在 10^circC 时，响应在 10¹⁰ 超过 80 ^circC 时消失。由于捕获事件是离散的，因此只有当一个事件的俘获电荷持续时间超过下一个事件时，连续源描述才成立。这在 10¹⁰ 时满足，在 10⁹ 时达到临界值，因此恢复时间常数是中子实验应测量的第一个量。自屏蔽被捕获光子的康普顿吸收部分抵消；高于 5 mol% Gd 时，响应受到弱暗势垒的限制。给出了测试预测所需的源参数、样本几何形状和控制。

articles.title: Deterministic Vortex Generation from Coupled Trapped Polariton Condensate Triad
articles.title_zh: 耦合俘获极化子凝聚体三元组产生确定性涡旋
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.10251v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present the deterministic generation and all-optical switching of ternary topologically distinct vortex states in a triad of trapped exciton-polariton condensates with direct state readout from momentum-space emission distribution. Tuning the non-resonant pump power controls the sign of the dissipative coupling, selecting between a ferromagnetic in-phase state and two frustrated states with global phase winding. The zero-winding ferromagnetic state has unstructured far-field emission at low momenta and forms vortex-antivortex arrays at the Dirac points, reflecting the C₃v global symmetry. The two frustrated states of +-2pi winding can be activated on-demand by a control beam and produce different triangular emission patterns selectively localized at the K or K' points. Although all three states share identical real-space emission distributions, their momentum-space photoluminescence profiles distinguish them unambiguously, revealing the chirality without the need for interferometry. This enables on-demand orbital angular momentum control using a pump independent of resonant phase or OAM imprinting, establishing condensate triads as a compact platform for reconfigurable chiral light generation operating on a ternary logic basis.
