articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了捕获激子-极化子凝聚态三元组中三元拓扑不同涡旋态的确定性生成和全光切换，并从动量空间发射分布中直接读取状态。调节非谐振泵浦功率可控制耗散耦合的符号，在铁磁同相状态和具有全局相绕组的两个受抑状态之间进行选择。零缠绕铁磁态在低动量下具有非结构化远场发射，并在狄拉克点处形成涡旋-反涡旋阵列，反映了C₃v全局对称性。 +-2pi 绕组的两种受挫状态可以通过控制光束按需激活，并选择性地产生位于 K 或 K' 点的不同三角形发射图案。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了捕获激子-极化子凝聚态三元组中三元拓扑不同涡旋态的确定性生成和全光切换，并从动量空间发射分布中直接读取状态。调节非谐振泵浦功率可控制耗散耦合的符号，在铁磁同相状态和具有全局相绕组的两个受抑状态之间进行选择。零缠绕铁磁态在低动量下具有非结构化远场发射，并在狄拉克点处形成涡旋-反涡旋阵列，反映了C₃v全局对称性。 +-2pi 绕组的两种受挫状态可以通过控制光束按需激活，并选择性地产生位于 K 或 K' 点的不同三角形发射图案。尽管所有三种状态都具有相同的实空间发射分布，但它们的动量空间光致发光分布明确区分了它们，无需干涉测量即可揭示手性。这使得能够使用独立于谐振相位或OAM印记的泵来进行按需轨道角动量控制，从而将冷凝三元组建立为在三元逻辑基础上运行的可重构手性光产生的紧凑平台。

articles.title: Pseudospin Hall Transport Induced by Berry Curvature
articles.title_zh: 贝里曲率引起的赝自旋霍尔输运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.10376v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Pseudospin-1 Dirac systems exhibit unique physics distinct from conventional Dirac cones, such as flat-band crossings and non-Abelian characteristics, yet their topological transport properties have remained largely untapped in passive, time-reversal-invariant settings. Here we uncover an in-plane polarity of the Berry-curvature texture in a pseudospin-1 Dirac Hamiltonian, a previously unexplored geometric degree of freedom encoded in the sign-resolved distribution of Berry curvature despite zero net Berry flux, and reveal a new mechanics where Berry curvature induce pseudospin Hall behaviors in a system. We show that the oriented coupling between this momentum-space polarity and a real-space mass gradient governs a geometric selection rule that dictates the emergence of gapless pseudospin Hall modes. By engineering the intracell couplings of a four-site planar lattice, we independently program the Berry-curvature polarity and the spatial mass gradient without altering the host lattice symmetry. Acoustic experiments directly confirm this directional selection rule: reversing the mass gradient closes or reopens the dispersive gap, while pseudospin-selective source excitation launches counterpropagating pseudospin branches along arbitrary prescribed axes. Our work establishes quantum geometric polarity as a versatile tool for reconfigurable wave routing, sensing, and high-capacity quantum applications.
articles.abstract_zh: Pseudospin-1 狄拉克系统表现出与传统狄拉克锥体不同的独特物理特性，例如平带交叉和非阿贝尔特性，但其拓扑输运特性在被动、时间反转不变的环境中基本上尚未开发。在这里，我们揭示了赝自旋 1 狄拉克哈密顿量中贝里曲率纹理的面内极性，这是一种先前未探索的几何自由度，尽管净贝里通量为零，但编码在贝里曲率的符号解析分布中，并揭示了贝里曲率在系统中引起赝自旋霍尔行为的新机制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Pseudospin-1 狄拉克系统表现出与传统狄拉克锥体不同的独特物理特性，例如平带交叉和非阿贝尔特性，但其拓扑输运特性在被动、时间反转不变的环境中基本上尚未开发。在这里，我们揭示了赝自旋 1 狄拉克哈密顿量中贝里曲率纹理的面内极性，这是一种先前未探索的几何自由度，尽管净贝里通量为零，但编码在贝里曲率的符号解析分布中，并揭示了贝里曲率在系统中引起赝自旋霍尔行为的新机制。我们证明，动量空间极性与实空间质量梯度之间的定向耦合控制着几何选择规则，该规则决定了无间隙赝自旋霍尔模式的出现。通过设计四位点平面晶格的细胞内耦合，我们独立编程了贝里曲率极性和空间质量梯度，而不改变主晶格对称性。声学实验直接证实了这种方向选择规则：反转质量梯度会关闭或重新打开色散间隙，而赝自旋选择性源激发会沿任意指定轴发射反向传播的赝自旋分支。我们的工作将量子几何极性确立为可重构波路由、传感和高容量量子应用的通用工具。

articles.title: Magnetic Order from First-Principles Linear Response
articles.title_zh: 第一原理线性响应的磁序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.10412v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The magnetic order of a material is usually predicted by comparing the energies of trial spin configurations, a strategy that cannot reach orders outside the chosen set and rapidly becomes intractable as the number of magnetic sites grows. We show that the order can instead be identified directly from the paramagnetic state: the leading eigenmodes of its self-consistent magnetization response, obtained with spin--orbit coupling at arbitrary wavevector within the primitive cell, determine both the ordering wavevector and the pattern of moments, with no candidate configurations. With no prior assumption about the order, the method correctly reproduces the G-type stacking with out-of-plane moments in the altermagnet candidate KV₂Se₂O, the 3:1 ferrimagnetic tetrahedra of Cu₂OSeO₃, and the incommensurate spiral instability of monolayer NiI₂. Our results establish the response of the paramagnetic state as a predictive and unbiased route to assessing magnetic order, enabling systematic searches for complex magnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 材料的磁序通常通过比较试验自旋构型的能量来预测，这种策略无法达到所选组之外的序，并且随着磁性位点数量的增加而迅速变得棘手。我们表明，顺序可以直接从顺磁态识别：其自洽磁化响应的主要本征模式是通过原始单元内任意波矢量的自旋轨道耦合获得的，确定了排序波矢量和矩的模式，没有候选配置。在没有预先假设顺序的情况下，该方法正确地再现了候选互磁体 KV2Se2O 中具有面外矩的 G 型堆叠、Cu2OSeO3 的 3:1 亚铁磁四面体以及单层 NiI2 的不相称螺旋不稳定性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 材料的磁序通常通过比较试验自旋构型的能量来预测，这种策略无法达到所选组之外的序，并且随着磁性位点数量的增加而迅速变得棘手。我们表明，顺序可以直接从顺磁态识别：其自洽磁化响应的主要本征模式是通过原始单元内任意波矢量的自旋轨道耦合获得的，确定了排序波矢量和矩的模式，没有候选配置。在没有预先假设顺序的情况下，该方法正确地再现了候选互磁体 KV2Se2O 中具有面外矩的 G 型堆叠、Cu2OSeO3 的 3:1 亚铁磁四面体以及单层 NiI2 的不相称螺旋不稳定性。我们的结果将顺磁态的响应确立为评估磁序的预测性和公正途径，从而能够系统地搜索复杂磁体。

articles.title: Correlating DC SQUID Performance with the Location of Trapped Magnetic Flux Using Scanning SQUID Microscopy
articles.title_zh: 使用扫描 SQUID 显微镜将 DC SQUID 性能与捕获磁通量的位置关联起来
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.10442v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Holes in the ground planes of superconducting circuits, commonly referred to as moats, are known to be an effective means of mitigating the deleterious effects of residual magnetic flux in superconducting circuits. Previous studies have utilized scanning SQUID microscopy (SSM) to image the effectiveness of various moat geometries and the maximum magnetic fields where they no longer prevent vortices in the ground plane but have not directly correlated the location of flux with circuit performance measurements. In this study we employ SSM to image the effectiveness of various moat configurations in trapping unwanted flux near a DC SQUID, and when the moats are not effective, the location of vortices in the ground plane. During the same cooldown, and without disturbing the circuit, we measure the circuit performance to directly correlate this with the vortex location. We show that there are preferential pinning sites for fluxons regardless of moat configuration, demonstrating the utility of the SSM in provide feedback for circuit layout, modeling, and failure analysis.
articles.abstract_zh: 超导电路接地平面上的孔（通常称为护城河）已知是减轻超导电路中剩余磁通量有害影响的有效手段。先前的研究利用扫描 SQUID 显微镜 (SSM) 对各种护城河几何形状和最大磁场的有效性进行成像，在这些几何形状和最大磁场中，它们不再防止地平面中的涡流，但尚未将磁通量的位置与电路性能测量直接关联起来。在本研究中，我们采用 SSM 来成像各种护城河配置在捕获 DC SQUID 附近不需要的通量方面的有效性，以及当护城河无效时，地平面中涡流的位置。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 超导电路接地平面上的孔（通常称为护城河）已知是减轻超导电路中剩余磁通量有害影响的有效手段。先前的研究利用扫描 SQUID 显微镜 (SSM) 对各种护城河几何形状和最大磁场的有效性进行成像，在这些几何形状和最大磁场中，它们不再防止地平面中的涡流，但尚未将磁通量的位置与电路性能测量直接关联起来。在本研究中，我们采用 SSM 来成像各种护城河配置在捕获 DC SQUID 附近不需要的通量方面的有效性，以及当护城河无效时，地平面中涡流的位置。在相同的冷却时间内，在不干扰电路的情况下，我们测量电路性能，以直接将其与涡流位置相关联。我们证明，无论护城河配置如何，磁通子都有优先的钉扎位点，这证明了 SSM 在为电路布局、建模和故障分析提供反馈方面的实用性。

articles.title: Exact Excitation Spectra and Spectral Gaps of the Frustrated Spin-1/2 J₁-J₂ Model via Dual Spin-Sector Variational Quantum Eigensolvers
articles.title_zh: 通过双自旋扇区变分量子本征解算器的受抑自旋 1/2 J₁-J2 模型的精确激发谱和谱间隙
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.10454v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Finding excited states and excitation gaps in frustrated spin systems using Variational Quantum Eigensolvers (VQE) is complicated by state-ordering inversions. In the frustrated spin-1/2 J₁-J₂ Heisenberg model, standard single-sector algorithms like Variational Quantum Deflation (VQD) in S_z=0 fail when J₂/J₁ < 0.25. In this regime, the lowest-lying excitation in S_z=0 is a Triplet (S=1), which lies below the Excited Singlet (S=0). Standard deflation projects out the ground singlet and converges onto the Triplet state, misidentifying it as the Excited Singlet. Here, we present a Dual Spin-Sector VQE framework that resolves these state-ordering inversions across 1D spin chains and 2D rectangular lattices. By first optimizing the ground Triplet state in the S_z=1 sector (where singlet states cannot exist), mapping it into S_z=0 via the total spin-lowering operator S⁻ = sumᵢ Sᵢ⁻, and evaluating a dual-sector penalty cost function, we isolate the Excited Singlet (E_S) without variational ambiguity. Numerical state-vector simulations confirm exact convergence to machine precision with unit overlap fidelity. The method captures key physical features, including the gapless phase, the BKT critical point at J₂/J₁ approx 0.2411, the Majumdar-Ghosh dimer point (J₂/J₁ = 0.50), and the 2D non-magnetic frustrated regime (J₂/J₁ approx 0.40 - 0.60). Finite-shot sampling simulations and gate-scaling analytics up to N=100 qubits demonstrate the resource efficiency and shot resilience of the algorithm for near-term quantum execution.
articles.abstract_zh: 使用变分量子本征解算器 (VQE) 在受挫自旋系统中查找激发态和激发间隙由于状态排序反转而变得复杂。在受挫的自旋 1/2 J₁-J2 海森堡模型中，当 J2/J₁ < 0.25 时，标准单扇区算法（例如 S_z=0 中的变分量子紧缩 (VQD)）会失败。在此状态下，S_z=0 中的最低激发态是三重态 (S=1)，其位于激发单重态 (S=0) 下方。标准紧缩投射出地面单重态并收敛到三重态，将其错误地识别为激发单重态。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 使用变分量子本征解算器 (VQE) 在受挫自旋系统中查找激发态和激发间隙由于状态排序反转而变得复杂。在受挫的自旋 1/2 J₁-J2 海森堡模型中，当 J2/J₁ < 0.25 时，标准单扇区算法（例如 S_z=0 中的变分量子紧缩 (VQD)）会失败。在此状态下，S_z=0 中的最低激发态是三重态 (S=1)，其位于激发单重态 (S=0) 下方。标准紧缩投射出地面单重态并收敛到三重态，将其错误地识别为激发单重态。在这里，我们提出了一个双自旋扇区 VQE 框架，该框架解决了 1D 自旋链和 2D 矩形晶格中的这些状态排序反转。通过首先优化 S_z=1 扇区（其中单重态不可能存在）中的基三重态，通过总自旋降低算子 S⁻ = sumᵢ Sᵢ⁻ 将其映射到 S_z=0，并评估双扇区惩罚成本函数，我们在没有变分模糊的情况下隔离了激发单重态 (E_S)。数值状态向量模拟确认了机器精度与单位重叠保真度的精确收敛。该方法捕获了关键的物理特征，包括无间隙相、J2/J1 约 0.2411 处的 BKT 临界点、Majumdar-Ghosh 二聚点 (J2/J1 = 0.50) 和 2D 非磁性受挫状态 (J2/J1 约 0.40 - 0.60)。有限射击采样模拟和高达 N=100 量子位的门扩展分析证明了近期量子执行算法的资源效率和射击弹性。

articles.title: Effective-Geometry Rescaling and Universal Critical Behavior in the Anisotropic Three-State Potts Model on the Square Lattice
articles.title_zh: 方晶格上各向异性三态 Potts 模型中的有效几何重新标度和普遍临界行为
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.10467v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the two-dimensional anisotropic three-state Potts ferromagnet on the square lattice using Wolff single-cluster Monte Carlo simulations and finite-size scaling. For coupling ratios λ=J_y/Jₓ=0.5, 0.75, and 1, finite-size scaling of the correlation ratio yields critical behavior consistent with the two-dimensional three-state Potts universality class. The scaling of the leading Fisher zeros gives a correlation-length exponent consistent with ν=5/6, while their cumulative density is consistent with the expected specific-heat exponent α=1/3. We further characterize the anisotropy at criticality using directional correlation ratios Rₓ and R_y together with directional FK wrapping probabilities. For λ=0.5 on a physically square lattice, Rₓ and R_y approach distinct critical values while yielding a common correlation-length exponent. From the wrapping probabilities, we independently determine an effective aspect ratio ρₑ^square=0.6413(5), in close agreement with the theoretical value ρₑsquare,thsimeq0.64150030 obtained from the isoradial representation. Using the theoretical value to set the physical aspect ratio restores directional equivalence, Rₓsimeq R_y, and brings the overall correlation ratio toward the isotropic-square reference. The results show that spatial anisotropy changes the effective critical geometry without altering the bulk three-state Potts universality class.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们使用 Wolff 单簇蒙特卡罗模拟和有限尺寸缩放来研究方形晶格上的二维各向异性三态 Potts 铁磁体。对于耦合比 λ=J_y/Jₓ=0.5、0.75 和 1，相关比的有限尺寸缩放会产生与二维三态 Potts 普遍性类一致的关键行为。前导 Fisher 零点的缩放给出了与 ν=5/6 一致的相关长度指数，而它们的累积密度与预期比热指数 α=1/3 一致。我们使用方向相关比 Rₓ 和 R_y 以及方向 FK 包裹概率进一步表征临界点的各向异性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们使用 Wolff 单簇蒙特卡罗模拟和有限尺寸缩放来研究方形晶格上的二维各向异性三态 Potts 铁磁体。对于耦合比 λ=J_y/Jₓ=0.5、0.75 和 1，相关比的有限尺寸缩放会产生与二维三态 Potts 普遍性类一致的关键行为。前导 Fisher 零点的缩放给出了与 ν=5/6 一致的相关长度指数，而它们的累积密度与预期比热指数 α=1/3 一致。我们使用方向相关比 Rₓ 和 R_y 以及方向 FK 包裹概率进一步表征临界点的各向异性。对于物理方格上的 λ=0.5，Rₓ 和 R_y 接近不同的临界值，同时产生共同的相关长度指数。根据包裹概率，我们独立确定了有效长宽比 ρₑ^square=0.6413(5)，与从等径表示获得的理论值 ρₑsquare,thsimeq0.64150030 非常一致。使用理论值设置物理纵横比可恢复方向等效性 Rₓsimeq R_y，并使整体相关比接近各向同性平方参考。结果表明，空间各向异性改变了有效临界几何形状，而没有改变本体三态 Potts 普适性类别。

articles.title: Landau Theory for Non-relativistic Magnetism Beyond Altermagnetism
articles.title_zh: 超越交变磁学的非相对论磁学朗道理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.10523v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work we study phenomenological Landau theories of non-relativistic magnetic systems, generalizing work on the collinear case to coplanar and non-coplanar orders. Focusing on zero-wavevector (boldsymbolk=0) magnetic orders described by a single irreducible representation of the crystallographic point group, we construct the symmetry-allowed free energies to quartic order for all possible multi-dimensional irreducible ordering channels. We find distinct Landau theories for tetragonal, trigonal/hexagonal, and cubic symmetry. Similar to the case of spin-nematic fluids, we find two natural outcomes: a collapse to a lower-symmetry collinear phase or a genuinely coplanar or non-coplanar order where the order parameters form a mutually orthogonal set in spin space -- reminiscent of the A and B phases in {}³He. We show in general that this symmetry-broken phase realizes the spin space group associated with the spatial representation of the order parameter sharing the same parent space group as the paramagnetic phase. This provides a direct link between the Landau and spin space group approaches. We calculate key observables using this Landau approach, including net magnetization, spin conductivity, multipolar moments, and piezomagnetism, connecting our results to constraints from the underlying spin space group. Examples of coplanar and non-coplanar magnetic orders for each case are worked out in detail. Finally, we discuss the relationship of the lower-symmetry collinear phases to the usual collinear spin groups, as well as connections to atomic altermagnetism, superfluid {}³He and electronic nematic phases.
articles.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们研究非相对论磁系统的现象学朗道理论，将共线情况的工作推广到共面和非共面的顺序。着眼于由晶体学点群的单个不可约表示描述的零波矢（boldsymbolk = 0）磁序，我们为所有可能的多维不可约有序通道构造了对称允许的四次自由能。我们发现了四方、三方/六方和立方对称的不同朗道理论。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在这项工作中，我们研究非相对论磁系统的现象学朗道理论，将共线情况的工作推广到共面和非共面的顺序。着眼于由晶体学点群的单个不可约表示描述的零波矢（boldsymbolk = 0）磁序，我们为所有可能的多维不可约有序通道构造了对称允许的四次自由能。我们发现了四方、三方/六方和立方对称的不同朗道理论。与自旋向列流体的情况类似，我们发现了两种自然结果：塌陷为低对称性共线相或真正共面或非共面的有序，其中有序参数在自旋空间中形成相互正交的集合 - 让人想起 {}3He 中的 A 和 B 相。我们一般表明，这种对称破缺相实现了与序参数的空间表示相关的自旋空间群，与顺磁相共享相同的父空间群。这提供了朗道和自旋空间群方法之间的直接联系。我们使用这种朗道方法计算了关键的可观测量，包括净磁化强度、自旋电导率、多极矩和压磁性，将我们的结果与基础自旋空间群的约束联系起来。详细计算出了每种情况的共面和非共面磁阶示例。最后，我们讨论了低对称性共线相与常见共线自旋群的关系，以及与原子交变磁性、超流体 {}3He 和电子向列相的联系。

articles.title: High Bulk Modulus Pentamodes: the Three-Dimensional Metal Water
articles.title_zh: 高体积模量五模：三维金属水
articles.abstract: arXiv:2406.14502v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Despite significant advances in the field of phononic crystals, the development of acoustic metafluids that replicate the behaviour of liquids in three dimensions remains elusive. For instance, water - the quintessential pentamode (PM) material - has a bulk modulus two orders of magnitude higher than current state-of-the-art PMs. The need for a low shear modulus inherently conflicts with the desire of high bulk modulus and density. In this letter, we shed light on the limitations of existing PM geometries and propose an innovative shape for the links that constitute the network. Inspired by the kinematics of ropes, these links are constructed from thin fibres and demonstrate the potential to create PMs with properties akin to those of liquids. As a prime example, we present the design of the first metamaterial that fully deserves the name 3D metal water, since its acoustic properties in the low frequency regime are indistinguishable with water. Additionally, we highlight a shear band gap in the lattice dispersion diagram, and illustrate the influence of geometric parameters on the dynamic properties at higher frequencies. This novel design of metafluids holds promise for applications requiring anisotropic materials such as acoustic lenses, waveguides, and cloaks.
articles.abstract_zh: 尽管声子晶体领域取得了重大进展，但在三维空间中复制液体行为的声学元流体的开发仍然难以实现。例如，水 - 典型的五模 (PM) 材料 - 的体积模量比当前最先进的 PM 高两个数量级。对低剪切模量的需求本质上与高体积模量和密度的需求相冲突。在这封信中，我们阐明了现有 PM 几何形状的局限性，并为构成网络的链路提出了一种创新形状。受绳索运动学的启发，这些链接由细纤维构成，并展示了制造具有类似于液体特性的 PM 的潜力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 尽管声子晶体领域取得了重大进展，但在三维空间中复制液体行为的声学元流体的开发仍然难以实现。例如，水 - 典型的五模 (PM) 材料 - 的体积模量比当前最先进的 PM 高两个数量级。对低剪切模量的需求本质上与高体积模量和密度的需求相冲突。在这封信中，我们阐明了现有 PM 几何形状的局限性，并为构成网络的链路提出了一种创新形状。受绳索运动学的启发，这些链接由细纤维构成，并展示了制造具有类似于液体特性的 PM 的潜力。作为一个典型的例子，我们展示了第一个超材料的设计，它完全配得上 3D 金属水这个名字，因为它在低频范围内的声学特性与水没有区别。此外，我们在晶格色散图中突出显示了剪切带隙，并说明了几何参数对较高频率下动态特性的影响。这种新颖的元流体设计为需要各向异性材料的应用带来了希望，例如声透镜、波导和斗篷。

articles.title: Accelerating dynamic polarizability calculations of organic molecules using equivariant graph neural networks
articles.title_zh: 使用等变图神经网络加速有机分子的动态极化率计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.09389v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Predicting the dynamic polarizability tensor of organic molecules is essential for simulating light-matter interactions in optoelectronic devices, yet conventional quantum-chemical methods such as time-dependent density functional theory (TD-DFT) are computationally expensive and limit large-scale screening. We present an equivariant graph neural network architecture that predicts frequency-dependent, complex-valued dynamic polarizability tensors directly from readily available molecular information, such as 3D geometry and UV-vis spectra. The model learns to approximate the shape and magnitude of the dynamic polarizability tensor, capturing both dispersive and absorptive features that define the molecular optical response. We evaluate the model on molecules from both the QM9 dataset and the Harvard organic photovoltaic dataset using various metrics, including the earth mover's distance, which is suitable for comparing spectral quantities. For both datasets, the model successfully reproduces the main features of the dynamic polarizability tensor and generalizes across diverse molecules. To assess the applicability, we further validated the model using a downstream workflow to calculate the optical properties of organic photovoltaic devices. We used the model-predicted polarizabilities to perform device-level optical simulations, yielding charge carrier generation rates in agreement with TD-DFT-based results (R² = 0.94). Our approach offers a promising complement, or even an alternative, to conventional methods such as TD-DFT, enabling faster and more efficient screening of photoactive organic molecules for optoelectronic applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 预测有机分子的动态极化率张量对于模拟光电器件中的光与物质相互作用至关重要，但传统的量子化学方法（例如依赖时间的密度泛函理论（TD-DFT））计算成本昂贵，并且限制了大规模筛选。我们提出了一种等变图神经网络架构，可以直接根据现有的分子信息（例如 3D 几何结构和紫外可见光谱）预测频率相关的复值动态极化率张量。该模型学习近似动态偏振张量的形状和大小，捕获定义分子光学响应的色散和吸收特征。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 预测有机分子的动态极化率张量对于模拟光电器件中的光与物质相互作用至关重要，但传统的量子化学方法（例如依赖时间的密度泛函理论（TD-DFT））计算成本昂贵，并且限制了大规模筛选。我们提出了一种等变图神经网络架构，可以直接根据现有的分子信息（例如 3D 几何结构和紫外可见光谱）预测频率相关的复值动态极化率张量。该模型学习近似动态偏振张量的形状和大小，捕获定义分子光学响应的色散和吸收特征。我们使用各种指标（包括适合比较光谱量的推土机距离）评估来自 QM9 数据集和哈佛有机光伏数据集的分子模型。对于这两个数据集，该模型成功地再现了动态极化率张量的主要特征，并推广到不同的分子。为了评估其适用性，我们使用下游工作流程来计算有机光伏器件的光学特性，进一步验证了该模型。我们使用模型预测的极化率来执行器件级光学模拟，得到的电荷载流子生成速率与基于 TD-DFT 的结果一致 (R² = 0.94)。我们的方法为 TD-DFT 等传统方法提供了有希望的补充，甚至是替代方法，能够更快、更有效地筛选用于光电应用的光活性有机分子。

articles.title: Non-Hermitian Cooperation Induced Chern Insulator
articles.title_zh: 非厄米合作诱导陈绝缘子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.09413v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Conventional Chern insulators rely on breaking time-reversal symmetry via magnetic fields or synthetic gauge fields. Here we introduce a fundamentally different paradigm: a static lattice without any gauge field becomes a Chern insulator solely through the cooperation of two non-Hermitian ingredients: on-site loss and non-reciprocal coupling. Neither effect alone suffices; only their synergy opens a topological gap and gives rise to robust chiral edge states with a nonzero Chern number. The underlying mechanism originates from a non-Hermitian chiral molecule formed by the lossy sites, whose dynamically dominant mode carries an orbital angular momentum that effectively generates a synthetic flux after the fast-decaying degrees of freedom are eliminated. Our results establish non-Hermitian cooperation as a versatile resource for inducing Chern topology without external fields or temporal modulations, opening a new route to topological phases in open classical and quantum systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 传统的陈绝缘体依赖于通过磁场或合成规范场打破时间反转对称性。在这里，我们引入一个根本不同的范式：没有任何规范场的静态晶格仅通过两种非厄米成分的配合而成为陈绝缘体：现场损耗和非互易耦合。单独的效果还不够。只有它们的协同作用才能打开拓扑间隙并产生具有非零陈数的鲁棒手性边缘态。潜在的机制源于由有损位点形成的非厄米手性分子，其动态主导模式携带轨道角动量，在消除快速衰减的自由度后有效地产生合成通量。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 传统的陈绝缘体依赖于通过磁场或合成规范场打破时间反转对称性。在这里，我们引入一个根本不同的范式：没有任何规范场的静态晶格仅通过两种非厄米成分的配合而成为陈绝缘体：现场损耗和非互易耦合。单独的效果还不够。只有它们的协同作用才能打开拓扑间隙并产生具有非零陈数的鲁棒手性边缘态。潜在的机制源于由有损位点形成的非厄米手性分子，其动态主导模式携带轨道角动量，在消除快速衰减的自由度后有效地产生合成通量。我们的结果将非厄米合作确立为一种通用资源，无需外部场或时间调制即可诱导陈拓扑，为开放经典和量子系统中的拓扑相开辟了一条新途径。

articles.title: An extended deep energy method for thermo-mechanical crack propagation
articles.title_zh: 热机械裂纹扩展的扩展深能方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.09433v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Thermo-mechanical fracture couples transient heat conduction on a cracked domain with a crack that grows as the temperature and the displacement evolve. Neural energy solvers have been proposed for phase-field fracture and later extended to represent a sharp crack through the network input, but heat conduction on the cracked domain and crack propagation under the resulting thermal stresses have not yet been treated together in these solvers. We present an extended deep energy method for thermo-mechanical crack propagation in which the crack remains a sharp polyline. Two networks represent the temperature and the displacement and receive the crack through a scalar embedding function, discontinuous across the crack and smooth elsewhere, so that both fields can jump across it without a regularization length, and the displacement is enriched near the tip by the Williams expansion with trainable amplitudes. The two fields are obtained by minimizing an incremental conduction functional and the thermoelastic potential energy in a staggered sequence, with Monte Carlo integration on points stratified over background elements, densified near the tip and redrawn during training. The stress intensity factors are extracted by the interaction integral with the area term of Wilson and Yu and checked by a sweep of the contour radius, and the crack advances at the maximum hoop stress angle when the energy release rate of the kink reaches the critical value at the crack-tip temperature. On a stationary thermal edge crack the extracted stress intensity factor agrees with the published value to 0.11%, in a functionally graded shear test initiation agrees with an independent sharp-crack finite element solution to within one load step, and on a notched cruciform specimen the crack paths follow the published solutions under mechanical, thermal and combined loading.
articles.abstract_zh: 热机械断裂将裂纹域上的瞬态热传导与随着温度和位移的变化而生长的裂纹耦合起来。神经能量求解器已被提出用于相场断裂，后来扩展到通过网络输入表示尖锐裂纹，但这些求解器尚未同时处理裂纹域上的热传导和由此产生的热应力下的裂纹扩展。我们提出了一种用于热机械裂纹扩展的扩展深能方法，其中裂纹保持尖锐的折线。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 热机械断裂将裂纹域上的瞬态热传导与随着温度和位移的变化而生长的裂纹耦合起来。神经能量求解器已被提出用于相场断裂，后来扩展到通过网络输入表示尖锐裂纹，但这些求解器尚未同时处理裂纹域上的热传导和由此产生的热应力下的裂纹扩展。我们提出了一种用于热机械裂纹扩展的扩展深能方法，其中裂纹保持尖锐的折线。两个网络表示温度和位移，并通过标量嵌入函数接收裂纹，裂纹上不连续，而其他地方平滑，因此两个场都可以在没有正则化长度的情况下跳过裂纹，并且通过具有可训练振幅的威廉姆斯展开，在尖端附近丰富了位移。这两个场是通过最小化交错序列中的增量传导函数和热弹性势能而获得的，并对分层在背景元素上的点进行蒙特卡洛积分，在尖端附近致密并在训练期间重新绘制。通过与Wilson和Yu面积项的相互作用积分提取应力强度因子，并通过轮廓半径扫描进行检查，当扭结的能量释放率在裂纹尖端温度达到临界值时，裂纹在最大环向应力角处前进。在静态热边缘裂纹上，提取的应力强度因子与公布的值一致为 0.11%，在功能分级剪切测试中，初始裂纹与一个载荷步内的独立尖锐裂纹有限元解一致，而在有缺口的十字形样本上，裂纹路径在机械、热和组合载荷下遵循公布的解决方案。

articles.title: How Good Is DFT for Solid-Liquid Interfaces? A Comparison With the Random-Phase Approximation for Water on Graphene
articles.title_zh: DFT 对于固液界面有多好？与石墨烯上水的随机相近似的比较
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.09685v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Simulations of water at solid interfaces routinely disagree on basic properties, from contact angle to friction, depending on the model used, whether an empirical force field or a density functional theory (DFT) exchange-correlation (XC) approximation. Yet no accurate computational reference has been available to determine which, if any, is reliable. Here we assess XC approximations spanning the rungs of Jacob's Ladder against the random-phase approximation (RPA) at the graphene-water interface. Using machine-learned potentials (MLPs) trained on both DFT and RPA data, we achieve the extensive sampling required to characterize interfacial structure, wettability, friction, and vibrational sum-frequency generation spectra. We find that XC approximations disagree substantially with RPA and with each other. To make sense of this, we introduce a transferable, multi-observable scoring framework that distills each functional's agreement with RPA into a single measure. Six functionals emerge as reliable starting points for studies of graphene-water and other dispersion-dominated interfaces, namely B3LYP-D3(0), revPBE-D3(0), revPBE-D3(BJ), B97M-rV, r²SCAN, and revPBE0-D3(0). Notably, this ranking follows no simple rule based on functional family or rung of Jacob's Ladder. What does hold across functionals is that dynamical and spectroscopic properties tend to be harder for DFT to reproduce than structural ones, with direct consequences for functional selection. Our framework also offers a general strategy for benchmarking any atomistic model, including the new generation of foundational MLPs, against high-accuracy references at solid--liquid interfaces. Beyond simulation, this work identifies which models can be trusted to connect measured contact angles, friction, and vibrational spectra to the molecular structure behind them.
articles.abstract_zh: 固体界面处的水模拟通常在从接触角到摩擦等基本特性上存在分歧，具体取决于所使用的模型，无论是经验力场还是密度泛函理论 (DFT) 交换相关 (XC) 近似。然而，还没有准确的计算参考来确定哪一个（如果有的话）是可靠的。在这里，我们评估跨越雅各布天梯梯级的 XC 近似与石墨烯-水界面处的随机相位近似 (RPA)。使用在 DFT 和 RPA 数据上训练的机器学习势 (MLP)，我们实现了表征界面结构、润湿性、摩擦力和振动和频生成谱所需的广泛采样。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 固体界面处的水模拟通常在从接触角到摩擦等基本特性上存在分歧，具体取决于所使用的模型，无论是经验力场还是密度泛函理论 (DFT) 交换相关 (XC) 近似。然而，还没有准确的计算参考来确定哪一个（如果有的话）是可靠的。在这里，我们评估跨越雅各布天梯梯级的 XC 近似与石墨烯-水界面处的随机相位近似 (RPA)。使用在 DFT 和 RPA 数据上训练的机器学习势 (MLP)，我们实现了表征界面结构、润湿性、摩擦力和振动和频生成谱所需的广泛采样。我们发现 XC 近似值与 RPA 以及彼此之间存在很大差异。为了理解这一点，我们引入了一个可转移、多可观察的评分框架，该框架将每个功能与 RPA 的协议提炼为单个度量。六个泛函成为研究石墨烯-水和其他色散主导界面的可靠起点，即 B3LYP-D3(0)、revPBE-D3(0)、revPBE-D3(BJ)、B97M-rV、r²SCAN 和 revPBE0-D3(0)。值得注意的是，这个排名并不遵循基于功能族或雅各布阶梯的梯级的简单规则。泛函的特点是动态和光谱特性往往比结构特性更难用 DFT 重现，这对泛函的选择有直接影响。我们的框架还提供了一个通用策略，用于对任何原子模型（包括新一代基础 MLP）进行基准测试，以固液界面的高精度参考为基准。除了模拟之外，这项工作还确定了哪些模型可以信赖，可以将测量到的接触角、摩擦力和振动光谱与其背后的分子结构联系起来。

articles.title: Matching of signal, noise and hardware timescales for filtering and forecasting of correlated noise signals
articles.title_zh: 信号、噪声和硬件时间尺度的匹配，用于过滤和预测相关噪声信号
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.10037v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Physical reservoir computing exploits the nonlinear dynamics of physical systems to process time-dependent data with greater energy efficiency than conventional machine learning approaches. However, physical reservoirs have fixed intrinsic response timescales, whereas real-world signals combine deterministic and stochastic components across multiple timescales. Here we show, using a nanoporous niobium oxide reservoir, synthetic noisy signals and cryptocurrency-price volatility, that the relationship among noise correlation time, reservoir memory and forecast horizon determines whether correlated noise is filtered or predicted. Noise varying faster than the relevant reservoir memory and forecast horizon is averaged by the reservoir, whereas the temporal structure of slower-varying noise is sufficient for algorithmic forecasting. We introduce the reservoir memory horizon and forecasting regime index to distinguish these operating regimes. These contributions demonstrate that timescale matching can guide the encoding of input time series and development of physical reservoir architectures that filter, analyse and predict stochastic signal components across distinct temporal scales.
articles.abstract_zh: 物理油藏计算利用物理系统的非线性动力学来处理与时间相关的数据，其能源效率比传统的机器学习方法更高。然而，物理储层具有固定的固有响应时间尺度，而现实世界的信号在多个时间尺度上结合了确定性和随机分量。在这里，我们使用纳米多孔氧化铌储层、合成噪声信号和加密货币价格波动表明，噪声相关时间、储层记忆和预测范围之间的关系决定了相关噪声是否被过滤或预测。比相关水库内存和预测范围变化更快的噪声由水库进行平均，而变化较慢的噪声的时间结构足以进行算法预测。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 物理油藏计算利用物理系统的非线性动力学来处理与时间相关的数据，其能源效率比传统的机器学习方法更高。然而，物理储层具有固定的固有响应时间尺度，而现实世界的信号在多个时间尺度上结合了确定性和随机分量。在这里，我们使用纳米多孔氧化铌储层、合成噪声信号和加密货币价格波动表明，噪声相关时间、储层记忆和预测范围之间的关系决定了相关噪声是否被过滤或预测。比相关水库内存和预测范围变化更快的噪声由水库进行平均，而变化较慢的噪声的时间结构足以进行算法预测。我们引入油藏记忆层位和预测状态指数来区分这些运行状态。这些贡献表明，时间尺度匹配可以指导输入时间序列的编码和物理储层架构的开发，该架构可以过滤、分析和预测不同时间尺度上的随机信号分量。

articles.title: Directed swimming of Chlamydomonas reinhardtii near complex microstructures
articles.title_zh: 莱茵衣藻在复杂微结构附近的定向游动
articles.abstract: arXiv:2503.08376v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The locomotion of microorganisms near solid-liquid interfaces is of significant scientific interest due to its relevance in various natural and industrial contexts, including biofilm formation and marine biofouling. In this study, we investigate the swimming behavior of C. reinhardtii near a sinusoidal wave-like microstructure. Using fluorescence microscopy and a three-dimensional tracking technique, we observe that the swimming direction of C. reinhardtii is strongly influenced by the geometric constraints imposed by the microstructure. Our results reveal that cells preferentially accumulate at the valley of the microstructure rather than the peak and exhibit a directional swimming tendency in the vicinity of the microstructure. We attribute this behavior to a combination of the "memory effect" and hydrodynamic attraction. By modifying the geometry of the microstructure, we successfully achieve directed guidance of cell swimming, which demonstrates potential applications in micro and nanorobotics and antifouling technologies. This work provides alternative insights into the locomotion mechanisms of microorganisms near solid-liquid interfaces and underscores the potential for manipulating their behavior through microstructure design.
articles.abstract_zh: 微生物在固液界面附近的运动具有重要的科学意义，因为它与各种自然和工业环境（包括生物膜形成和海洋生物污垢）相关。在这项研究中，我们研究了莱茵衣藻在正弦波状微结构附近的游泳行为。使用荧光显微镜和三维跟踪技术，我们观察到莱茵衣藻的游动方向受到微观结构所施加的几何约束的强烈影响。我们的结果表明，细胞优先聚集在微结构的谷部而不是峰部，并且在微结构附近表现出定向游动趋势。我们将这种行为归因于“记忆效应”和水动力吸引力的结合。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 微生物在固液界面附近的运动具有重要的科学意义，因为它与各种自然和工业环境（包括生物膜形成和海洋生物污垢）相关。在这项研究中，我们研究了莱茵衣藻在正弦波状微结构附近的游泳行为。使用荧光显微镜和三维跟踪技术，我们观察到莱茵衣藻的游动方向受到微观结构所施加的几何约束的强烈影响。我们的结果表明，细胞优先聚集在微结构的谷部而不是峰部，并且在微结构附近表现出定向游动趋势。我们将这种行为归因于“记忆效应”和水动力吸引力的结合。通过修改微结构的几何形状，我们成功实现了细胞游动的定向引导，这展示了在微纳米机器人和防污技术中的潜在应用。这项工作为固液界面附近微生物的运动机制提供了另一种见解，并强调了通过微观结构设计来操纵其行为的潜力。

articles.title: Optimizing optimal transport: Role of final distributions in finite-time thermodynamics
articles.title_zh: 优化最佳传输：最终分布在有限时间热力学中的作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.11314v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Performing thermodynamic tasks within finite time while minimizing thermodynamic costs is a central challenge in stochastic thermodynamics. Here, we develop a unified framework for optimizing the thermodynamic cost of performing various tasks in finite time for overdamped Langevin systems. Conventional optimization of thermodynamic cost based on optimal transport theory leaves room for varying the final distributions according to the intended task, enabling further optimization. Taking advantage of this freedom, we use Lagrange multipliers to derive the optimal final distribution that minimizes the thermodynamic cost. Our framework applies to a wide range of thermodynamic tasks, including particle transport, thermal squeezing, and information processing such as information erasure, measurement, and feedback. Our results are expected to provide design principles for information-processing devices and thermodynamic machines that operate at high speed with low energetic costs.
articles.abstract_zh: 在有限时间内执行热力学任务，同时最小化热力学成本是随机热力学的核心挑战。在这里，我们开发了一个统一的框架，用于优化过阻尼朗之万系统在有限时间内执行各种任务的热力学成本。基于最优输运理论的传统热力学成本优化为根据预期任务改变最终分布留出了空间，从而实现进一步优化。利用这种自由度，我们使用拉格朗日乘子来导出最小化热力学成本的最佳最终分布。我们的框架适用于广泛的热力学任务，包括粒子传输、热挤压和信息处理（例如信息擦除、测量和反馈）。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在有限时间内执行热力学任务，同时最小化热力学成本是随机热力学的核心挑战。在这里，我们开发了一个统一的框架，用于优化过阻尼朗之万系统在有限时间内执行各种任务的热力学成本。基于最优输运理论的传统热力学成本优化为根据预期任务改变最终分布留出了空间，从而实现进一步优化。利用这种自由度，我们使用拉格朗日乘子来导出最小化热力学成本的最佳最终分布。我们的框架适用于广泛的热力学任务，包括粒子传输、热挤压和信息处理（例如信息擦除、测量和反馈）。我们的研究结果有望为以低能量成本高速运行的信息处理设备和热力学机器提供设计原理。

articles.title: Hidden Subsurface Oxygen Asymmetry Stabilizes Polaron Beneath the Polar CeO2(100) Surface
articles.title_zh: 隐藏的地下氧不对称性稳定了极性 CeO2(100) 表面下方的极化子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.11568v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Polar oxide surfaces often reconstruct to compensate their intrinsic electrostatic instability, yet identifying the atomic-scale structural motifs that govern such reconstructions and their coupling with localized electronic states remains challenging because oxygen configurations are difficult to resolve. Here, we show that a hidden asymmetric arrangement of subsurface oxygen atoms is intimately coupled with the reconstruction of the polar CeO2(100) surface and the formation of subsurface small polarons. Global structure search and deep potential molecular dynamics identify a previously unknown asymmetric (1*2) reconstruction, where subsurface oxygen asymmetry creates anisotropic Ce-O coordination environments and elongated Ce-O bonds, stabilizing localized Ce3+ small polarons beneath the surface. Enabled by oxygen-sensitive integrated differential phase contrast scanning transmission electron microscopy (iDPC-STEM), we directly visualize the predicted asymmetric subsurface oxygen configuration, while high-angle annular dark-field (HAADF) STEM resolves the accompanying asymmetric cerium arrangement and expanded interlayer spacing. These findings establish hidden subsurface oxygen asymmetry as a key structural motif coupling oxygen rearrangement, lattice reconstruction, and polaron localization, revealing a coupled oxygen-lattice-electron mechanism governing the evolution of polar oxide surfaces.
articles.abstract_zh: 极性氧化物表面通常进行重建以补偿其固有的静电不稳定性，但识别控制这种重建的原子尺度结构图案及其与局部电子态的耦合仍然具有挑战性，因为氧构型很难解析。在这里，我们证明了地下氧原子隐藏的不对称排列与极性 CeO2(100) 表面的重建和地下小极化子的形成密切相关。全局结构搜索和深势分子动力学确定了以前未知的不对称 (1*2) 重建，其中地下氧不对称创建了各向异性 Ce-O 配位环境和拉长的 Ce-O 键，稳定了表面下方的局部 Ce3+ 小极化子。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 极性氧化物表面通常进行重建以补偿其固有的静电不稳定性，但识别控制这种重建的原子尺度结构图案及其与局部电子态的耦合仍然具有挑战性，因为氧构型很难解析。在这里，我们证明了地下氧原子隐藏的不对称排列与极性 CeO2(100) 表面的重建和地下小极化子的形成密切相关。全局结构搜索和深势分子动力学确定了以前未知的不对称 (1*2) 重建，其中地下氧不对称创建了各向异性 Ce-O 配位环境和拉长的 Ce-O 键，稳定了表面下方的局部 Ce3+ 小极化子。通过氧敏感集成微分相衬扫描透射电子显微镜（iDPC-STEM），我们直接可视化预测的不对称地下氧构型，而高角度环形暗场（HAADF）STEM则解决了伴随的不对称铈排列和扩大的层间距。这些发现将隐藏的地下氧不对称性确定为耦合氧重排、晶格重构和极化子定位的关键结构基序，揭示了控制极性氧化物表面演化的氧-晶格-电子耦合机制。

articles.title: Scallop Theorem for Swimming in Anisotropic Fluids
articles.title_zh: 各向异性流体中游动的扇贝定理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.22249v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In isotropic fluids like water, micrometer-scale swimmers have evolved swim strokes to translate despite their tiny size. As described by Purcell in his Scallop Theorem, reciprocal motions, like those performed by a scallop, cannot drive swimming when inertial effects are absent, as is typical at micrometer length scales. Thus, microswimmers have evolved complex structures that can perform non-reciprocal swim strokes or body displacements to generate motion. Microswimmer dynamics in structured fluids differ fundamentally from those in isotropic fluids because of their inherent asymmetry. The orientation of elongated constituents and the topological defects that spontaneously form near microswimmers provide broken symmetries, even atequilibrium. This is sufficient for the dynamic disturbance of even the simplest isotropic swimmers to generate propulsion. We combine experiments on magnetically rotated colloids in nematic liquid crystals with analytic non-equilibrium solutions to formulate propulsion strategies for microswimmers in nematic fluids and determine how swimming velocity depends on the rotation rate, materials parameters, and forcing regimes. For example, we find that micro-scale spherical colloids swim effectively under continuous rotation and under reciprocal forcing.Thus, swim strokes that are ineffective in isotropic fluids are highly effective in nematic liquid crystals. In light of these observations, the Scallop Theorem is extended for structured fluids.
articles.abstract_zh: 在水等各向同性流体中，微米级的游泳者已经进化出了可以平移的泳姿，尽管它们的尺寸很小。正如珀塞尔在他的扇贝定理中所描述的，当不存在惯性效应时，往复运动（如扇贝进行的运动）无法驱动游泳，这在微米长度尺度上是典型的。因此，微型游泳者已经进化出复杂的结构，可以进行非往复的游泳动作或身体位移以产生运动。由于其固有的不对称性，结构流体中的微型游泳器动力学与各向同性流体中的微型游泳器动力学有根本的不同。细长成分的方向和在微型游泳器附近自发形成的拓扑缺陷提供了破缺的对称性，甚至是不平衡的。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在水等各向同性流体中，微米级的游泳者已经进化出了可以平移的泳姿，尽管它们的尺寸很小。正如珀塞尔在他的扇贝定理中所描述的，当不存在惯性效应时，往复运动（如扇贝进行的运动）无法驱动游泳，这在微米长度尺度上是典型的。因此，微型游泳者已经进化出复杂的结构，可以进行非往复的游泳动作或身体位移以产生运动。由于其固有的不对称性，结构流体中的微型游泳器动力学与各向同性流体中的微型游泳器动力学有根本的不同。细长成分的方向和在微型游泳器附近自发形成的拓扑缺陷提供了破缺的对称性，甚至是不平衡的。即使是最简单的各向同性游泳者的动态扰动也足以产生推进力。我们将向列液晶中磁旋转胶体的实验与解析非平衡解相结合，制定向列流体中微型游泳器的推进策略，并确定游泳速度如何取决于旋转速率、材料参数和受力方式。例如，我们发现微尺度球形胶体在连续旋转和相互作用力下有效地游动。因此，在各向同性流体中无效的游动在向列液晶中非常有效。根据这些观察结果，扇贝定理被扩展到结构流体。

articles.title: ²³Na-NMR study on the one-dimensional superoxide spin-chain compound NaO₂
articles.title_zh: 一维超氧化物自旋链化合物NaO2的Na-NMR研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.14505v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We report ²³Na-NMR study of the alkali superoxide NaO₂, a candidate one-dimensional quantum spin system. The Knight shift, linewidth, and spin-lattice relaxation rate 1/T₁ were investigated down to 0.3 K in magnetic fields up to 16 T. Below Tᵣₘ S₃ = 34 K, 1/T₁ exhibits thermally activated behavior, indicating the opening of a spin gap of Δ(10.1 rm T) simeq 38.0 K and Δ(3.55 rm T) simeq 46 K, The hyperfine coupling constant shows a sudden reduction across the structural transition at Tᵣₘ S₂ simeq 195 K, reflecting the development the pronounced one-dimensionality in the elctron structure. These results provide microscopic evidence that NaO₂ is a rare π-orbital-based one-dimensional spin chain that exhibits a spin-gapped ground state, consistent with a spin-Peierls-like instability.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们报告了碱金属超氧化物 NaO2（一种候选的一维量子自旋系统）的 23 Na-NMR 研究。在高达 16 T 的磁场中研究了低至 0.3 K 的奈特位移、线宽和自旋晶格弛豫率 1/T₁。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们报告了碱金属超氧化物 NaO2（一种候选的一维量子自旋系统）的 23 Na-NMR 研究。在高达 16 T 的磁场中研究了低至 0.3 K 的奈特位移、线宽和自旋晶格弛豫率 1/T₁。低于 Tᵣₘ S₃ = 34 K，1/T₁ 表现出热激活行为，表明自旋间隙打开为 Δ(10.1 rm T) simeq 38.0 K 和 Δ(3.55 rm T) simeq 46 K，超精细耦合常数显示在 Tᵣₘ S2 simeq 195 K 处的结构转变过程中突然减小，反映了电子结构中明显一维性的发展。这些结果提供了微观证据，证明 NaO2 是一种罕见的基于 π 轨道的一维自旋链，表现出自旋带隙基态，与自旋 Peierls 样不稳定性一致。

articles.title: Haerter-Shastry kinetic magnetism and metallicity in the triangular Hubbard model
articles.title_zh: 三角哈伯德模型中的 Haerter-Shastry 动磁和金属丰度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.18954v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The fermionic Hubbard model, when combined with frustration, associated with the breaking of particle-hole symmetry, harbors a rich phase diagram. Theoretical findings associated with the nature of magnetism and metallicity across this phase diagram are now being actively investigated in triangular Hubbard cold atom and solid-state (moiré) based emulators. Building on the theoretical work of Haerter and Shastry, we explore the impact of kinetically frustrated magnetism, a phenomenon where antiferromagnetic order emerges without any underlying magnetic interactions, at finite hole density. We numerically study the infinite-U triangular Hubbard model using the density matrix renormalization group algorithm and estimate the stability of the kinetically induced 120cⁱrc antiferromagnetic state to hole doping. Beyond the Haerter-Shastry regime, we find an intermediate phase with multimer (involving multiple correlated spins) stripes that eventually gives way to a paramagnet. We also find evidence of gapless charge excitations (metallicity) throughout the phase diagram for finite hole density. We discuss the implications at large, but finite, values of U/t, and investigate whether kinetic magnetism and superexchange collaborate or compete.
articles.abstract_zh: 费米子哈伯德模型与粒子空穴对称性破缺相关的挫折相结合，具有丰富的相图。目前正在基于三角形哈伯德冷原子和固态（莫尔条纹）的模拟器中积极研究与该相图的磁性和金属性性质相关的理论发现。在 Haerter 和 Shastry 的理论工作的基础上，我们探索了动力学受挫磁性的影响，这是一种在有限孔密度下，在没有任何潜在磁相互作用的情况下出现反铁磁有序的现象。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 费米子哈伯德模型与粒子空穴对称性破缺相关的挫折相结合，具有丰富的相图。目前正在基于三角形哈伯德冷原子和固态（莫尔条纹）的模拟器中积极研究与该相图的磁性和金属性性质相关的理论发现。在 Haerter 和 Shastry 的理论工作的基础上，我们探索了动力学受挫磁性的影响，这是一种在有限孔密度下，在没有任何潜在磁相互作用的情况下出现反铁磁有序的现象。我们使用密度矩阵重正化群算法对无限 U 三角哈伯德模型进行数值研究，并估计了动力学诱导的 120cⁱrc 反铁磁态对空穴掺杂的稳定性。除了哈特-沙斯特里体系之外，我们还发现了一个具有多聚体（涉及多个相关自旋）条纹的中间相，最终让位于顺磁体。我们还在整个相图中发现了有限空穴密度的无间隙电荷激发（金属性）的证据。我们讨论了 U/t 值的大范围但有限的含义，并研究动磁和超级交换是合作还是竞争。

articles.title: Peierls Transition and Magnetism in a Dirac Semimetal: CaMnBi₂
articles.title_zh: 狄拉克半金属中的 Peierls 转变和磁性：CaMnBi2
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.03721v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Dirac semimetals of the form AMnX₂ (A = alkaline-earth or divalent rare earth; X = Bi, Sb) host conducting square-net Dirac-electron layers of X atoms interleaved with antiferromagnetic MnX layers. Hypervalent pnictogen square nets have long been predicted to host an electronically driven Peierls instability, whereas low-temperature anomalies in CaMnBi₂ near T*sim 50~K have previously been discussed in terms of possible magnetic canting, TRS breaking, and a resulting Weyl-semimetal (WSM) state. Here we use polarized and unpolarized neutron diffraction, x-ray diffraction, and density functional theory (DFT) to investigate this transition in single-crystal CaMnBi₂. We observe a coupled structural/magnetic symmetry-lowering transition at T*=46(2) K from a tetragonal lattice with C-type antiferromagnetism to an orthorhombic phase with unit-cell doubling along the c axis, minimal impact on magnetism, and no measurable uniform spin canting (lesssim 2^circ). Superlattice peak intensities and the lattice distortion reveal a continuous second-order transition governed by a single primary order parameter. The refined displacement pattern corresponds to a zigzag bond-order-wave (BOW) modulation of in-plane Bi--Bi bonds, providing direct diffraction evidence for a Peierls-type instability of the Dirac-electron Bi layer anticipated by Hoffmann and co-workers [W. Tremel and R. Hoffmann, J. Am. Chem. Soc. 109, 124 (1987); G. A. Papoian and R. Hoffmann, Angew. Chem. Int. Ed. 39, 2408 (2000)]. These results identify the T* anomaly as an intrinsic Dirac-electron-driven Peierls/BOW transition of the Bi square net.
articles.abstract_zh: AMnX2 形式的狄拉克半金属（A = 碱土金属或二价稀土；X = Bi、Sb）含有与反铁磁 MnX 层交错的 X 原子的导电方网狄拉克电子层。长期以来，人们一直预测高价磷元素方网会存在电子驱动的 Peierls 不稳定性，而 T*sim 50~K 附近的 CaMnBi2 中的低温异常先前已根据可能的磁倾斜、TRS 断裂以及由此产生的 Weyl 半金属 (WSM) 态进行了讨论。
articles.abstract_zh_full: AMnX2 形式的狄拉克半金属（A = 碱土金属或二价稀土；X = Bi、Sb）含有与反铁磁 MnX 层交错的 X 原子的导电方网狄拉克电子层。长期以来，人们一直预测高价磷元素方网会存在电子驱动的 Peierls 不稳定性，而 T*sim 50~K 附近的 CaMnBi2 中的低温异常先前已根据可能的磁倾斜、TRS 断裂以及由此产生的 Weyl 半金属 (WSM) 态进行了讨论。在这里，我们使用偏振和非偏振中子衍射、X 射线衍射和密度泛函理论 (DFT) 来研究单晶 CaMnBi2 中的这种转变。我们在 T*=46(2) K 处观察到耦合的结构/磁对称性降低转变，从具有 C 型反铁磁性的四方晶格到晶胞沿 c 轴加倍的斜方晶相，对磁性的影响最小，并且没有可测量的均匀自旋倾斜 (lesssim 2^circ)。超晶格峰值强度和晶格畸变揭示了由单个初级参数控制的连续二阶跃迁。精细的位移模式对应于面内 Bi--Bi 键的锯齿形键阶波 (BOW) 调制，为 Hoffmann 及其同事预期的狄拉克电子 Bi 层的 Peierls 型不稳定性提供了直接衍射证据 [W. Tremel 和 R. Hoffmann，J. Am。化学。苏克。 109、124（1987）； G. A. Papoian 和 R. Hoffmann，Angew。化学。国际。埃德。 39, 2408 (2000)]。这些结果将 T* 异常识别为 Bi 方网的固有狄拉克电子驱动 Peierls/BOW 跃迁。

articles.title: Novel qubits in hybrid semiconductor-superconductor nanostructures
articles.title_zh: 混合半导体-超导体纳米结构中的新型量子位
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.23336v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Hybrid semiconductor-superconductor qubits have recently emerged as a promising alternative to traditional platforms, combining material advantages with device-level tunability. A defining feature is their gate-tunable Josephson coupling, enabling superconducting qubit architectures with full electric-field control and offering a path toward scalable, low-crosstalk quantum processors. This approach seeks to merge benefits of superconducting and semiconductor qubits, for instance by encoding quantum information in the spin of a quasiparticle occupying an Andreev bound state, thus combining long coherence times with fast, flexible control. Progress has accelerated through bottom-up engineering of Andreev states in coupled quantum dot arrays, leading to architectures such as minimal Kitaev chains hosting Majorana zero modes. In parallel, Hamiltonian-protected designs aim to enhance resilience against local noise and decoherence by exploiting superconducting phase dynamics and discrete charge or flux degrees of freedom. This article reviews recent theoretical and experimental advances in hybrid qubits, providing an overview of physical mechanisms, device implementations, and emerging architectures, with emphasis on their potential for (topologically) protected quantum information processing. While many designs remain at proof-of-concept stage, rapid progress suggests practical demonstrations may soon be achievable.
articles.abstract_zh: 混合半导体-超导量子位最近已成为传统平台的一种有前途的替代品，它将材料优势与器件级可调谐性相结合。一个决定性的特征是其栅极可调谐约瑟夫森耦合，可实现具有完全电场控制的超导量子位架构，并提供通向可扩展、低串扰量子处理器的途径。这种方法寻求融合超导和半导体量子位的优点，例如通过在占据安德烈夫束缚态的准粒子自旋中编码量子信息，从而将长相干时间与快速、灵活的控制结合起来。通过耦合量子点阵列中安德烈夫态的自下而上工程，进展加速，导致了诸如托管马约拉纳零模式的最小基塔耶夫链等架构。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 混合半导体-超导量子位最近已成为传统平台的一种有前途的替代品，它将材料优势与器件级可调谐性相结合。一个决定性的特征是其栅极可调谐约瑟夫森耦合，可实现具有完全电场控制的超导量子位架构，并提供通向可扩展、低串扰量子处理器的途径。这种方法寻求融合超导和半导体量子位的优点，例如通过在占据安德烈夫束缚态的准粒子自旋中编码量子信息，从而将长相干时间与快速、灵活的控制结合起来。通过耦合量子点阵列中安德烈夫态的自下而上工程，进展加速，导致了诸如托管马约拉纳零模式的最小基塔耶夫链等架构。与此同时，受哈密顿量保护的设计旨在通过利用超导相动力学和离散电荷或通量自由度来增强对抗局部噪声和退相干的弹性。本文回顾了混合量子位的最新理论和实验进展，概述了物理机制、设备实现和新兴架构，重点介绍了它们在（拓扑）受保护的量子信息处理方面的潜力。虽然许多设计仍处于概念验证阶段，但快速进展表明实际演示可能很快就能实现。

articles.title: Twist-angle-dependent quantum phase diagrams in twisted bilayer MoTe2
articles.title_zh: 扭转双层 MoTe2 中扭转角度相关的量子相图
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.16412v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Two-dimensional semiconducting moiré superlattices provide a highly tunable platform for investigating strongly correlated and topological quantum phases. As a prototypical example, twisted bilayer MoTe2 (tMoTe2) has been shown to host fractional topological phases at zero magnetic field. However, their evolution with twist angle and competition with other correlated quantum states remain largely unexplored. Here we report a systematic transport study of twist-angle-dependent phase diagrams in tMoTe2 across a range of 3.79deg-5.76deg, revealing an evolution from valley-polarized, fractional topological states to valley-degenerate correlated states and superconductivity. At relatively small twist angles, partially-filled Chern bands of tMoTe2 host fractional quantum anomalous Hall (FQAH) states following the Jain sequence, together with signatures of an anomalous composite Fermi liquid at moiré hole filling factor νh = 1/2. Increasing twist angle progressively suppresses fractional topological phases and reconstructs the half-filled Chern band into symmetry-breaking integer Chern insulating states. At νh = 1, we observe a transition from robust integer quantum anomalous Hall (IQAH) insulators at small angles to displacement-field-tuned, topologically trivial correlated insulators at larger angles. Remarkably, at twist angles above approximately 5.6deg, superconductivity emerges adjacent to the νh = 1 correlated insulator, with a phase diagram closely resembling that recently reported in twisted bilayer WSe2. Our results uncover a unified twist-angle-driven phase evolution linking fractional topology, symmetry breaking, magnetic order, and superconductivity, providing new insight into the emergent quantum phenomena in moiré systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 二维半导体莫尔超晶格为研究强相关和拓扑量子相提供了一个高度可调的平台。作为一个典型示例，扭曲双层 MoTe2 (tMoTe2) 已被证明在零磁场下具有分数拓扑相。然而，它们随扭转角的演化以及与其他相关量子态的竞争在很大程度上仍未被探索。在这里，我们报告了 tMoTe2 3.79deg-5.76deg 范围内扭转角相关相图的系统输运研究，揭示了从谷极化、分数拓扑态到谷简并相关态和超导性的演变。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 二维半导体莫尔超晶格为研究强相关和拓扑量子相提供了一个高度可调的平台。作为一个典型示例，扭曲双层 MoTe2 (tMoTe2) 已被证明在零磁场下具有分数拓扑相。然而，它们随扭转角的演化以及与其他相关量子态的竞争在很大程度上仍未被探索。在这里，我们报告了 tMoTe2 3.79deg-5.76deg 范围内扭转角相关相图的系统输运研究，揭示了从谷极化、分数拓扑态到谷简并相关态和超导性的演变。在相对较小的扭转角下，tMoTe2 的部分填充陈能带具有遵循 Jain 序列的分数量子反常霍尔 (FQAH) 态，以及莫尔空穴填充因子 νh = 1/2 下的异常复合费米液体的特征。增加扭转角逐渐抑制分数拓扑相，并将半填充的陈能带重建为对称破缺的整数陈绝缘态。在 νh = 1 时，我们观察到从小角度的鲁棒整数量子反常霍尔 (IQAH) 绝缘体到大角度的位移场调谐、拓扑平凡相关绝缘体的转变。值得注意的是，在扭曲角超过约 5.6 度时，超导性出现在 νh = 1 相关绝缘体附近，其相图与最近报道的扭曲双层 WSe2 中的相图非常相似。我们的结果揭示了一种统一的扭转角驱动的相位演化，将分数拓扑、对称破缺、磁序和超导性联系起来，为莫尔系统中出现的量子现象提供了新的见解。

articles.title: Thermodynamic signatures of spectral compression in weakly non-Hermitian Dirac fermions
articles.title_zh: 弱非厄米狄拉克费米子谱压缩的热力学特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.14150v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Non-Hermitian band descriptions capture how loss, gain, and environmental coupling reshape quantum matter, yet most experimental probes remain wave based or dynamical. Here we develop an equilibrium charge-response route to spectral compression in Dirac materials. In the real-spectrum regime, invariance of the particle-number operator under the similarity transformation makes the quantum capacitance exactly that of the Hermitian partner, so the whole non-Hermitian content is carried by the Petermann factor. In a minimal nonreciprocal graphene model, hopping imbalance suppresses the Dirac velocity, enhancing the low-energy density of states and the capacitance as an exceptional point is approached. At charge neutrality the capacitance stays linear in temperature, with its slope enhanced relative to the Hermitian value. A perpendicular magnetic field recasts the same compression as a collapse of the Landau-level ladder, drawing more levels into the thermal window. In two dimensions, the capacitance enhancement relative to the Hermitian partner coincides exactly with the Petermann factor, even though the two have entirely different origins. This relation provides a controlled starting point for extending equilibrium thermodynamic probes to non-Hermitian electronic systems with interactions, disorder, and reservoir coupling.
articles.abstract_zh: 非厄米能带描述捕捉了损耗、增益和环境耦合如何重塑量子物质，但大多数实验探针仍然基于波或动态。在这里，我们开发了狄拉克材料中光谱压缩的平衡电荷响应路线。在实谱体系中，相似变换下粒子数算子的不变性使得量子电容恰好是厄米伙伴的量子电容，因此整个非厄米内容由彼得曼因子承载。在最小不可逆石墨烯模型中，跳跃不平衡会抑制狄拉克速度，从而在接近异常点时增强态的低能量密度和电容。在电荷中性时，电容与温度保持线性关系，其斜率相对于埃尔米特值有所增强。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 非厄米能带描述捕捉了损耗、增益和环境耦合如何重塑量子物质，但大多数实验探针仍然基于波或动态。在这里，我们开发了狄拉克材料中光谱压缩的平衡电荷响应路线。在实谱体系中，相似变换下粒子数算子的不变性使得量子电容恰好是厄米伙伴的量子电容，因此整个非厄米内容由彼得曼因子承载。在最小不可逆石墨烯模型中，跳跃不平衡会抑制狄拉克速度，从而在接近异常点时增强态的低能量密度和电容。在电荷中性时，电容与温度保持线性关系，其斜率相对于埃尔米特值有所增强。垂直磁场重塑了与朗道能级阶梯塌陷相同的压缩，将更多能级引入热窗口。在二维中，相对于厄米特伙伴的电容增强与彼得曼因子完全一致，尽管两者具有完全不同的起源。这种关系为将平衡热力学探针扩展到具有相互作用、无序和储层耦合的非厄米电子系统提供了受控的起点。

articles.title: Phonon-mediated spin-spin interactions
articles.title_zh: 声子介导的自旋-自旋相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.14731v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Indirect long range interactions between localized magnetic moments are in metals mediated by itinerant electrons. In insulators and semi-conductor, such interactions need to be small, if not negligible, due to the absence of mediating carriers. The existence of magnetically ordered insulators, for instance, metal-oxides, is therefore an everlasting source for proposals of various mechanisms that may support the order. Here, phonon mediated interactions between localized magnetic moments is considered as a mechanism that can provide quantifiable symmetric and anti-symmetric anisotropic spin-spin interactions. It is demonstrated that while a symmetric anisotropic interaction exists for all types of phonons, the existence of anti-symmetric anisotropic interactions requires broken inversion symmetry. The latter mechanism may explain the weak ferromagnetic order observed in chiral, e.g., CuO and CoO compounds. Furthermore, the interaction is nearly independent of the temperature at low temperature while approaches a linear growth at high. Spatially, the interactions have an oscillatory power law decay with the inter-nuclei distance.
articles.abstract_zh: 金属中局部磁矩之间的间接长程相互作用是由流动电子介导的。在绝缘体和半导体中，由于不存在介导载流子，这种相互作用即使不能忽略，也必须很小。因此，磁有序绝缘体（例如金属氧化物）的存在是支持该顺序的各种机制建议的永恒来源。在这里，声子介导的局域磁矩之间的相互作用被认为是一种可以提供可量化的对称和反对称各向异性自旋-自旋相互作用的机制。结果表明，虽然所有类型的声子都存在对称各向异性相互作用，但反对称各向异性相互作用的存在需要破缺反演对称性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 金属中局部磁矩之间的间接长程相互作用是由流动电子介导的。在绝缘体和半导体中，由于不存在介导载流子，这种相互作用即使不能忽略，也必须很小。因此，磁有序绝缘体（例如金属氧化物）的存在是支持该顺序的各种机制建议的永恒来源。在这里，声子介导的局域磁矩之间的相互作用被认为是一种可以提供可量化的对称和反对称各向异性自旋-自旋相互作用的机制。结果表明，虽然所有类型的声子都存在对称各向异性相互作用，但反对称各向异性相互作用的存在需要破缺反演对称性。后一种机制可以解释在手性化合物（例如 CuO 和 CoO 化合物）中观察到的弱铁磁序。此外，在低温下相互作用几乎与温度无关，而在高温下则接近线性增长。在空间上，相互作用具有随核间距离的振荡幂律衰减。

articles.title: Proof of the absence of local conserved quantities in the Holstein model
articles.title_zh: 荷斯坦模型中不存在局部守恒量的证明
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.19606v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Absence of local conserved quantities, or nonintegrability, is often assumed when discussing various phenomena in quantum many-body systems, such as thermalization and transport. However, no concrete proof of this property is known in electron--phonon coupled systems, a typical setting for condensed matter physics. In this paper, we show that the one-dimensional Holstein model has no nontrivial local conserved quantities other than the Hamiltonian itself and the total fermion number operator. We further show that the absence of nontrivial local conserved quantities also holds for the more general Holstein--Hubbard model. We also establish the absence of nontrivial local conserved quantities in these models on higher-dimensional hypercubic lattices. Our result has accomplished an advance in nonintegrability proofs by expanding their scope to systems in which particles with different statistical properties are mixed.
articles.abstract_zh: 在讨论量子多体系统中的各种现象（例如热化和输运）时，通常假设不存在局部守恒量或不可积性。然而，在电子-声子耦合系统（凝聚态物理的典型设置）中，尚无这种性质的具体证据。在本文中，我们证明一维荷斯坦模型除了哈密顿量本身和总费米子数算子之外没有非平凡的局部守恒量。我们进一步表明，不存在非平凡局部守恒量也适用于更一般的 Holstein-Hubbard 模型。我们还在高维超立方晶格上的这些模型中确定了不存在非平凡局部守恒量。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在讨论量子多体系统中的各种现象（例如热化和输运）时，通常假设不存在局部守恒量或不可积性。然而，在电子-声子耦合系统（凝聚态物理的典型设置）中，尚无这种性质的具体证据。在本文中，我们证明一维荷斯坦模型除了哈密顿量本身和总费米子数算子之外没有非平凡的局部守恒量。我们进一步表明，不存在非平凡局部守恒量也适用于更一般的 Holstein-Hubbard 模型。我们还在高维超立方晶格上的这些模型中确定了不存在非平凡局部守恒量。我们的结果通过将其范围扩展到具有不同统计特性的粒子混合的系统，在不可积性证明方面取得了进步。

articles.title: Anharmonic Quantum Transport Analysis of Thermal Transport Anomalies in Ultrathin Silicon Nanowires
articles.title_zh: 超薄硅纳米线热传输异常的非谐波量子传输分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.26529v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Thermal transport in low-dimensional semiconductors is important for nanoelectronics, quantum devices, and thermoelectrics. Recent molecular dynamics (MD) studies reveal a nonmonotonic diameter dependence of thermal conductivity in ultrathin silicon nanowires (NWs), but classical MD is limited at low temperatures and under strong confinement. Here, we investigate this anomaly using anharmonic non-equilibrium Green's function (NEGF) simulations combined with density functional theory-trained neuroevolution potentials. All transport results are expressed as effective thermal conductivities (κₑff) for NW devices with a finite channel length of L=10 nm. At 300 K, κₑff decreases with diameter to minima at 6.24 and 5.50 nm for [001]- and [110]-oriented NWs, respectively. At 10 K, the corresponding minima occur at 7.33 and 5.50 nm. At room temperature, dominant momentum-conserving normal scattering relative to Umklapp processes enables Poiseuille-like hydrodynamic phonon flow that competes with boundary scattering. At cryogenic temperatures, Bose--Einstein statistics restrict heat transport to low-frequency confined acoustic-like modes. Comparison with the harmonic Landauer limit reveals a finite correction to κₑff from anharmonic phonon--phonon scattering. Classical MD neglects quantum suppression and overexcites high-frequency vibrations, leading to overestimated thermal conductivity in thinner, strongly confined NWs at low temperatures. The NEGF framework incorporates quantum statistics and anharmonic scattering, providing a quantum-mechanical description of thermal transport down to 10 K.
articles.abstract_zh: 低维半导体中的热传输对于纳米电子学、量子器件和热电学非常重要。最近的分子动力学 (MD) 研究揭示了超薄硅纳米线 (NW) 中热导率的非单调直径依赖性，但经典 MD 在低温和强约束下受到限制。在这里，我们使用非和谐非平衡格林函数（NEGF）模拟结合密度泛函理论训练的神经进化电位来研究这种异常现象。所有传输结果均表示为有限沟道长度 L=10 nm 的 NW 器件的有效热导率 (κₑff)。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 低维半导体中的热传输对于纳米电子学、量子器件和热电学非常重要。最近的分子动力学 (MD) 研究揭示了超薄硅纳米线 (NW) 中热导率的非单调直径依赖性，但经典 MD 在低温和强约束下受到限制。在这里，我们使用非和谐非平衡格林函数（NEGF）模拟结合密度泛函理论训练的神经进化电位来研究这种异常现象。所有传输结果均表示为有限沟道长度 L=10 nm 的 NW 器件的有效热导率 (κₑff)。在 300 K 时，对于 [001] 和 [110] 取向的纳米线，κₑff 随直径减小，分别在 6.24 和 5.50 nm 处达到最小值。在 10 K 时，相应的最小值出现在 7.33 和 5.50 nm 处。在室温下，相对于 Umklapp 过程的占主导地位的动量守恒法向散射能够实现与边界散射竞争的类泊肃叶流体动力声子流。在低温下，玻色-爱因斯坦统计将热传输限制在低频受限的类声模式。与谐波兰道尔极限的比较揭示了非谐波声子-声子散射对 κₑff 的有限修正。经典MD忽略了量子抑制并过度激发高频振动，导致低温下较薄、强约束的纳米线的热导率被高估。 NEGF 框架结合了量子统计和非谐波散射，提供低至 10 K 热传输的量子力学描述。

articles.title: Electrically driven Rabi dynamics of magnetic-field-induced corner states in a two-dimensional topological insulator
articles.title_zh: 二维拓扑绝缘体中磁场感应角态的电驱动拉比动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.28499v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study coherent electric manipulation of magnetic-field-induced localized states at a double kink of a helical edge in a HgTe/CdHgTe quantum well. An in-plane magnetic field opens a gap in the one-dimensional edge spectrum, while changes in the edge orientation generate localized in-gap states at the kinks. We show that, for suitable geometry and magnetic-field direction, two such states form an effective lithographically defined two-level subsystem. Using an edge-state model that includes both the localized levels and the fully propagating 1D edge states outside the magnetic-field-induced gap, we calculate the electric-dipole matrix elements and solve the time-dependent problem under resonant driving. The resulting dynamics exhibits Rabi oscillations with linear frequencies of 20--40~GHz for realistic parameters. We find that the propagating 1D edge states provide a leakage channel whose strength is strongly controlled by the driving amplitude: reducing the electric field suppresses leakage below the percent level while preserving GHz-scale coherent oscillations. These results establish a route from magnetic-field-induced corner-state physics to electrically driven two-level dynamics in a realistic two-dimensional topological-insulator edge geometry.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了 HgTe/CdHgTe 量子阱中螺旋边缘双扭结处磁场感应局域态的相干电操纵。面内磁场在一维边缘谱中打开一个间隙，而边缘方向的变化在扭结处产生局部间隙内状态。我们表明，对于合适的几何形状和磁场方向，两种这样的状态形成有效的光刻定义的两级子系统。使用包括局部能级和磁场感应间隙之外的完全传播一维边缘状态的边缘状态模型，我们计算电偶极子矩阵元素并解决谐振驱动下的时间相关问题。由此产生的动力学表现出拉比振荡，其线性频率为 20--40~GHz，适用于实际参数。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了 HgTe/CdHgTe 量子阱中螺旋边缘双扭结处磁场感应局域态的相干电操纵。面内磁场在一维边缘谱中打开一个间隙，而边缘方向的变化在扭结处产生局部间隙内状态。我们表明，对于合适的几何形状和磁场方向，两种这样的状态形成有效的光刻定义的两级子系统。使用包括局部能级和磁场感应间隙之外的完全传播一维边缘状态的边缘状态模型，我们计算电偶极子矩阵元素并解决谐振驱动下的时间相关问题。由此产生的动力学表现出拉比振荡，其线性频率为 20--40~GHz，适用于实际参数。我们发现传播的一维边缘态提供了一个泄漏通道，其强度受到驱动幅度的强烈控制：减小电场将泄漏抑制在百分比水平以下，同时保持 GHz 级相干振荡。这些结果建立了一条从磁场感应角态物理到现实二维拓扑绝缘体边缘几何结构中电驱动两能级动力学的路线。

articles.title: Skyrmion and meron phases induced by spin-phonon coupling
articles.title_zh: 自旋声子耦合诱导的斯格明子和米子相
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.02793v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In chiral magnets, magnetic skyrmions are typically stabilized by the competition between exchange and Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM) interactions under an external magnetic field, while the role of lattice degrees of freedom has received comparatively less attention. Here we study how spin-phonon (SP) coupling modifies magnetic interactions and the resulting spin textures in a two-dimensional skyrmion model in the square lattice. Using Monte Carlo simulations, we compare two simplified models describing the SP coupling: the Einstein site-phonon (ESP) and bond-phonon (BP) models. Integrating the lattice degrees of freedom, we obtain effective Hamiltonians for each SP model, which involve three-spin interactions and quadratic terms. In both cases, skyrmion crystals are stabilized in field regimes that are topologically trivial in the uncoupled model. Moreover, in certain regimes, the conventional triple-qv hexagonal skyrmion lattice is distorted into a double-qv square skyrmion lattice. Additionally, we find that, in the ESP model, strong phonon coupling affecting the exchange interactions drives the system from typical low-field helical phases to meron-antimeron crystals with no net chirality. Overall, our results show that lattice effects provide a simple mechanism to tune a wide variety of topological magnetic phases, ranging from typical skyrmion crystals to distorted arrangements of skyrmions, elongated bimerons and meron-antimeron phases.
articles.abstract_zh: 在手性磁体中，磁性斯格明子通常通过外部磁场下交换和 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM) 相互作用之间的竞争来稳定，而晶格自由度的作用受到的关注相对较少。在这里，我们研究自旋声子 (SP) 耦合如何改变方晶格中二维斯格明子模型中的磁相互作用以及由此产生的自旋纹理。使用蒙特卡罗模拟，我们比较了描述 SP 耦合的两个简化模型：爱因斯坦位点声子 (ESP) 和键声子 (BP) 模型。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在手性磁体中，磁性斯格明子通常通过外部磁场下交换和 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM) 相互作用之间的竞争来稳定，而晶格自由度的作用受到的关注相对较少。在这里，我们研究自旋声子 (SP) 耦合如何改变方晶格中二维斯格明子模型中的磁相互作用以及由此产生的自旋纹理。使用蒙特卡罗模拟，我们比较了描述 SP 耦合的两个简化模型：爱因斯坦位点声子 (ESP) 和键声子 (BP) 模型。对晶格自由度进行积分，我们获得了每个 SP 模型的有效哈密顿量，其中涉及三自旋相互作用和二次项。在这两种情况下，斯格明子晶体都在场状态下稳定，这在非耦合模型中拓扑微不足道。此外，在某些情况下，传统的三qv六方斯格明子晶格被扭曲成双qv方形斯格明子晶格。此外，我们发现，在 ESP 模型中，影响交换相互作用的强声子耦合驱动系统从典型的低场螺旋相转变为没有净手性的 meron-antitimer 晶体。总的来说，我们的结果表明，晶格效应提供了一种简单的机制来调整各种拓扑磁相，从典型的斯格明子晶体到斯格明子的扭曲排列、拉长的双聚子和聚子-反子相。

articles.title: Diffusive molecules share the 1/3 shot noise suppression of quantum conductors
articles.title_zh: 扩散分子共享量子导体的 1/3 散粒噪声抑制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.16783v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Electrical noise measurement, especially shot noise, which arises from the discreteness of charge, is an indispensable tool in quantum transport for probing the nature of charge carriers beyond simple conductance measurements. Diffusive conductors share a universal shot noise reduction of 1/3, a result obtained independently from quantum scattering theory, semi-classical kinetics, or by classical exclusion processes8. Until now, however, experimental tests of this universality have been limited to cryogenic conditions, leaving its origin incompletely understood. Here we show that ferrocene redox cycling in a microfluidic gap is a room temperature realization of this universality. We derive the full counting statistics of diffusing single-electron molecular shuttles and verify the predicted current noise experimentally, showing that the universal 1/3 shot noise suppression is recovered in the diffusion-limited regime. Our result identifies diffusion and sequential charge transfer as sufficient ingredients for this universal noise reduction, rather than quantum coherence, fermionic statistics or cryogenic conditions. We anticipate that this study will establish electrochemical microfluidics as a room-temperature platform for mesoscopic counting statistics and bring noise-based probes to molecular transport and reaction kinetics. Furthermore, this liquid-based quantum-inspired study will provide a novel insight on the yet to be understood links between quantum and biology.
articles.abstract_zh: 电噪声测量，尤其是由电荷离散性产生的散粒噪声，是量子传输中除简单电导测量之外探测电荷载流子性质不可或缺的工具。扩散导体的通用散粒噪声降低了 1/3，这是独立于量子散射理论、半经典动力学或经典排除过程获得的结果8。然而，到目前为止，这种普遍性的实验测试仅限于低温条件，其起源尚不完全清楚。在这里，我们表明微流体间隙中的二茂铁氧化还原循环是这种普遍性的室温实现。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电噪声测量，尤其是由电荷离散性产生的散粒噪声，是量子传输中除简单电导测量之外探测电荷载流子性质不可或缺的工具。扩散导体的通用散粒噪声降低了 1/3，这是独立于量子散射理论、半经典动力学或经典排除过程获得的结果8。然而，到目前为止，这种普遍性的实验测试仅限于低温条件，其起源尚不完全清楚。在这里，我们表明微流体间隙中的二茂铁氧化还原循环是这种普遍性的室温实现。我们导出了扩散单电子分子穿梭的完整计数统计数据，并通过实验验证了预测的电流噪声，表明在扩散限制范围内恢复了通用的 1/3 散粒噪声抑制。我们的结果表明扩散和顺序电荷转移是这种普遍降噪的充分成分，而不是量子相干性、费米子统计或低温条件。我们预计这项研究将建立电化学微流体作为介观计数统计的室温平台，并将基于噪声的探针引入分子输运和反应动力学。此外，这项基于液体的量子研究将为量子与生物学之间尚未被理解的联系提供新的见解。

articles.title: Beyond Pure Dephasing: Quantum Error Correction in Single Molecules Requires Multiple Spins
articles.title_zh: 超越纯相移：单分子中的量子纠错需要多次自旋
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.03318v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We propose multi-spin molecules as a viable architecture for fault-tolerant quantum computing. To this aim, we introduce a correction protocol handling both diagonal and off-diagonal errors, typically associated with dephasing and relaxation. The scheme is based on a hybrid encoding which combines dephasing-tolerant units suppressing the leading pure dephasing error into a multi-spin molecule implementing a multi-qubit code for residual off-diagonal errors. Our proposal leverages peculiar properties of molecular spins, i.e. the strong hierarchy between different errors and the possibility to engineer multi-spin molecules at the synthetic level. Moreover, it addresses the important issue of the loss of coherences in anharmonic systems subject to off-diagonal errors, which hampers their correction at the single spin level. Thanks to the huge suppression of dephasing by the first-level code, we numerically demonstrate the potential performance of this strategy even with a limited number of spins per logical unit.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出多自旋分子作为容错量子计算的可行架构。为此，我们引入了一种处理对角线和非对角线误差的校正协议，这些误差通常与移相和松弛相关。该方案基于混合编码，该编码将抑制主要纯失相误差的失相容忍单元组合成多自旋分子，实现针对残余非对角线误差的多量子位代码。我们的建议利用了分子自旋的特殊性质，即不同错误之间的强大层次结构以及在合成水平上设计多自旋分子的可能性。此外，它还解决了非调和系统中因非对角线误差而导致相干性损失的重要问题，这阻碍了它们在单自旋水平上的校正。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出多自旋分子作为容错量子计算的可行架构。为此，我们引入了一种处理对角线和非对角线误差的校正协议，这些误差通常与移相和松弛相关。该方案基于混合编码，该编码将抑制主要纯失相误差的失相容忍单元组合成多自旋分子，实现针对残余非对角线误差的多量子位代码。我们的建议利用了分子自旋的特殊性质，即不同错误之间的强大层次结构以及在合成水平上设计多自旋分子的可能性。此外，它还解决了非调和系统中因非对角线误差而导致相干性损失的重要问题，这阻碍了它们在单自旋水平上的校正。由于第一级代码对相移的巨大抑制，即使每个逻辑单元的旋转次数有限，我们也以数字方式证明了该策略的潜在性能。

articles.title: TUR Violation, Minimal Power Fluctuation, and Enhanced Efficiency
articles.title_zh: 违反 TUR、最小功率波动和更高效率
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.03366v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the performance characteristics of an active magneto gyrator that consists of an inertial charged active particle confined in a two-dimensional asymmetric parabolic potential coupled to two thermal baths maintained at two different temperatures and in the presence of a magnetic field applied perpendicular to the plane of motion. In contrast to the passive Brownian gyrator, where the power-efficiency trade-off imposes strict operational limits, the active magneto gyrator exhibits striking violations of this rule, allowing regimes in which both output power and efficiency increase simultaneously with load strength. Moreover, while the Thermodynamic Uncertainty Relation (TUR) predicts that highly efficient engines necessarily produce strongly fluctuating power, rendering the Brownian gyrator unusable as the efficiency approaches the Carnot bound, the active magneto gyrator circumvents this constraint. Specifically, it achieves high efficiency with minimal power fluctuations, thus defying the TUR. Remarkably, efficiency can even surpass the Carnot limit and approach 100%, without compromising stability. This condition cannot be achieved in the absence of either activity or a magnetic field. These results highlight the active magneto gyrator as a promising setup for designing stochastic heat engines that can transcend Carnot efficiency.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了主动磁回转器的性能特征，该主动磁回转器由限制在二维不对称抛物线势中的惯性带电活性粒子组成，耦合到保持在两种不同温度下的两个热浴，并且存在垂直于运动平面施加的磁场。与无源布朗回转器相比，其中功率效率权衡施加了严格的操作限制，有源磁电机回转器表现出明显违反这一规则，允许输出功率和效率与负载强度同时增加的状态。此外，虽然热力学不确定性关系（TUR）预测高效发动机必然会产生强烈波动的功率，导致布朗回转器在效率接近卡诺界限时无法使用，但主动磁电机回转器却规避了这一限制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了主动磁回转器的性能特征，该主动磁回转器由限制在二维不对称抛物线势中的惯性带电活性粒子组成，耦合到保持在两种不同温度下的两个热浴，并且存在垂直于运动平面施加的磁场。与无源布朗回转器相比，其中功率效率权衡施加了严格的操作限制，有源磁电机回转器表现出明显违反这一规则，允许输出功率和效率与负载强度同时增加的状态。此外，虽然热力学不确定性关系（TUR）预测高效发动机必然会产生强烈波动的功率，导致布朗回转器在效率接近卡诺界限时无法使用，但主动磁电机回转器却规避了这一限制。具体来说，它以最小的功率波动实现了高效率，从而超越了 TUR。值得注意的是，效率甚至可以超越卡诺极限并接近 100%，而不会影响稳定性。在没有活动或磁场的情况下无法实现这种条件。这些结果凸显了主动磁回转器作为设计可以超越卡诺效率的随机热机的有前景的设置。

articles.title: Spectrally Robust Photon-Pair Generation in Topological Waveguide Arrays
articles.title_zh: 拓扑波导阵列中光谱鲁棒的光子对生成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.23796v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Harnessing topological effects offers a route to protect quantum states of light from imperfections, potentially enabling more robust platforms for quantum information processing. This capability is particularly relevant for active photonic circuits that generate quantum light directly on-chip. However, the impact of topology on the spectral properties of parametric processes, crucial for scalable quantum photonic circuits, remains largely unexplored. Here, we address this question by investigating photon-pair generation via spontaneous parametric down-conversion (SPDC) in nonlinear waveguide arrays, combining experiment and theory. A systematic comparison of uniform, trivial, and topological Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) arrays reveals that only the topological configuration preserves a stable SPDC resonance spectrum under coupling disorder, with fluctuations in the resonance wavelength reduced by more than an order of magnitude. An analytical model captures the origin of this robustness in the band-structure properties of the interacting modes. Numerical analysis further shows that each SSH array can operate as a robust photon-pair source, enabling stable interference between multiple such sources and the generation of high-dimensional entangled states with high fidelity. These results establish nonlinear waveguide arrays as a promising platform for harnessing the interplay of topology and nonlinearity in quantum photonic circuits.
articles.abstract_zh: 利用拓扑效应提供了一种保护光量子态免受缺陷影响的途径，有可能为量子信息处理提供更强大的平台。此功能对于直接在芯片上生成量子光的有源光子电路尤其重要。然而，拓扑对参数化过程光谱特性的影响（对于可扩展的量子光子电路至关重要）在很大程度上仍未得到探索。在这里，我们通过结合实验和理论研究非线性波导阵列中自发参数下转换（SPDC）产生的光子对来解决这个问题。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 利用拓扑效应提供了一种保护光量子态免受缺陷影响的途径，有可能为量子信息处理提供更强大的平台。此功能对于直接在芯片上生成量子光的有源光子电路尤其重要。然而，拓扑对参数化过程光谱特性的影响（对于可扩展的量子光子电路至关重要）在很大程度上仍未得到探索。在这里，我们通过结合实验和理论研究非线性波导阵列中自发参数下转换（SPDC）产生的光子对来解决这个问题。对均匀、平凡和拓扑 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) 阵列的系统比较表明，只有拓扑结构才能在耦合无序下保持稳定的 SPDC 谐振光谱，谐振波长的波动减少了一个数量级以上。分析模型捕捉了相互作用模式的能带结构特性中这种鲁棒性的根源。数值分析进一步表明，每个 SSH 阵列都可以作为强大的光子对源运行，从而实现多个此类源之间的稳定干涉，并生成高保真度的高维纠缠态。这些结果将非线性波导阵列确立为利用量子光子电路中拓扑和非线性相互作用的有前途的平台。

articles.title: Using the wavelet transform to separate scales in the Schrödinger equation and subsequently derive the Boltzmann equation
articles.title_zh: 利用小波变换分离薛定谔方程中的尺度并随后推导玻尔兹曼方程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.21601v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Here we continue our investigation aimed at the derivation of the Boltzmann equation from the first principles of quantum mechanics. The key difficulty that we overcome in this manuscript is the incompatibility between traditional methods employed in the derivation of classical mechanics from quantum mechanics and methods used to describe transitions between quantum states due to interaction. Here we use a novel technique that is similar to the wavelet transform method that originally appeared in the context of signal processing. With this method, we can simultaneously work with slowly varying potentials that give rise to classical-like wave-function behaviour, motion along a prescribed trajectory, and sharp potentials that lead to behaviour that is best understood in terms of quantum transitions. Working with smooth potentials in this framework, we derive the Liouville equation from the Schrödinger equation. When using this method for sharp potentials, we naturally obtain the description of system dynamics in terms of a transition-rate matrix. The transition rates between system states, which characterize the process, are determined by Fermi's golden rule. We observe that, through the Liouville equation, we can deduce the non-collision part of the Boltzmann equation, and that, through the transition-rate matrix, we can deduce the collision integral. We combine the results to derive the Boltzmann equation, the main formula of physical kinetics.
articles.abstract_zh: 在这里，我们继续研究，旨在从量子力学的第一原理推导玻尔兹曼方程。我们在这份手稿中克服的关键困难是从量子力学推导经典力学所采用的传统方法与用于描述由于相互作用而产生的量子态之间的转变的方法之间的不兼容性。在这里，我们使用了一种类似于最初出现在信号处理背景下的小波变换方法的新技术。通过这种方法，我们可以同时处理缓慢变化的电势，这些电势会产生类似经典的波函数行为、沿着规定轨迹的运动，以及尖锐的电势，这些电势会导致最好用量子跃迁来理解的行为。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在这里，我们继续研究，旨在从量子力学的第一原理推导玻尔兹曼方程。我们在这份手稿中克服的关键困难是从量子力学推导经典力学所采用的传统方法与用于描述由于相互作用而产生的量子态之间的转变的方法之间的不兼容性。在这里，我们使用了一种类似于最初出现在信号处理背景下的小波变换方法的新技术。通过这种方法，我们可以同时处理缓慢变化的电势，这些电势会产生类似经典的波函数行为、沿着规定轨迹的运动，以及尖锐的电势，这些电势会导致最好用量子跃迁来理解的行为。在这个框架中使用平滑势，我们从薛定谔方程推导出刘维尔方程。当使用这种方法处理尖锐势时，我们自然会根据转移率矩阵获得系统动力学的描述。表征该过程的系统状态之间的转换率由费米黄金法则决定。我们观察到，通过刘维尔方程，我们可以推导出玻尔兹曼方程的非碰撞部分，并且通过转移率矩阵，我们可以推导出碰撞积分。我们结合这些结果推导出玻尔兹曼方程，这是物理动力学的主要公式。

articles.title: A derivation of the late-time volume law for local operator entanglement
articles.title_zh: 局域算子纠缠的后期体积定律的推导
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.25387v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Local Operator Entanglement (LOE) has emerged an indicator of quantum chaos in many-body systems. Numerical studies have shown that, in chaotic systems, LOE grows linearly in time and displays a volume-law behavior at late times, scaling proportionally with the number of local degrees of freedom. Despite extensive numerical evidence, complemented by analytical studies in integrable systems, a fully analytical understanding of the emergence of the volume law remains incomplete. In this paper, we contribute toward this goal by deriving a late-time expression for LOE in chaotic systems that exhibits volume-law scaling. Our derivation proceeds by expressing the late-time LOE in the Liouville eigenstate basis and relies on three main assumptions: a higher-order non-resonance condition for the Hamiltonian eigenenergies, the Eigenstate Thermalization Hypothesis (ETH) ansatz for the matrix elements of the initial local operator, and the replacement of Hamiltonian eigenstates with random states in the final expression for LOE. Under these assumptions, we obtain an explicit formula displaying volume-law scaling. Finally, we complement our analytical derivation with numerical simulations of the 1D mixed-field Ising model, testing the resulting formula and exploring the regime of validity of our assumptions.
articles.abstract_zh: 局域算子纠缠（LOE）已成为多体系统中量子混沌的指标。数值研究表明，在混沌系统中，LOE 随时间线性增长，并在后期表现出体积定律行为，与局部自由度的数量成比例缩放。尽管有大量的数值证据，并辅以可积系统的分析研究，但对体积定律出现的全面分析理解仍然不完整。在本文中，我们通过推导混沌系统中表现出体积定律缩放的 LOE 后期表达式来实现这一目标。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 局域算子纠缠（LOE）已成为多体系统中量子混沌的指标。数值研究表明，在混沌系统中，LOE 随时间线性增长，并在后期表现出体积定律行为，与局部自由度的数量成比例缩放。尽管有大量的数值证据，并辅以可积系统的分析研究，但对体积定律出现的全面分析理解仍然不完整。在本文中，我们通过推导混沌系统中表现出体积定律缩放的 LOE 后期表达式来实现这一目标。我们的推导通过在刘维尔本征态基础中表达后期 LOE 进行，并依赖于三个主要假设：哈密顿本征能的高阶非共振条件、初始局部算子的矩阵元素的本征态热化假说 (ETH) ansatz、以及在 LOE 的最终表达式中用随机状态替换哈密顿本征态。在这些假设下，我们获得了显示体积定律缩放的显式公式。最后，我们通过一维混合场伊辛模型的数值模拟来补充我们的分析推导，测试所得公式并探索我们假设的有效性体系。

articles.title: Rounding Almost Commuting Hamiltonians
articles.title_zh: 四舍五入几乎通勤哈密顿量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.26096v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Commuting Hamiltonians lie at the boundary between classical constraint satisfaction and quantum many-body physics, exhibiting rich quantum structure while remaining more tractable than general noncommuting models. In contrast, physical Hamiltonians are rarely exactly commuting, which naturally motivates the study of almost commuting Hamiltonians. Despite their relevance, the implications of approximate commutation are only poorly understood. In this work, we show how to efficiently approximate any almost commuting 2-local qubit Hamiltonian by a commuting one: we give a new locality-preserving algorithmic rounding technique that maps any 2-local Hamiltonian H=sumᵢ₌₁^m hᵢ with |[hᵢ,hⱼ]| ≤ ϵ to a nearby Hamiltonian hatH whose terms pair-wise commute, and which is within overall distance |H-hatH| = O(m,ϵ¹/³). As a consequence, we show that δ-approximations to the ground energy for ϵ-almost commuting 2-local qubit Hamiltonians lie in mathsfNP when δ gg mϵ¹/³, extending the classical containment well beyond the commuting setting. Finally, we present two applications of our rounding framework: Gibbs sampling and fast Hamiltonian simulation for almost commuting systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 通勤哈密顿量位于经典约束满足和量子多体物理之间的边界，表现出丰富的量子结构，同时比一般的非通勤模型更容易处理。相比之下，物理哈密顿量很少是完全通勤的，这自然激发了对几乎通勤哈密顿量的研究。尽管近似换向具有相关性，但人们对它的影响却知之甚少。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 通勤哈密顿量位于经典约束满足和量子多体物理之间的边界，表现出丰富的量子结构，同时比一般的非通勤模型更容易处理。相比之下，物理哈密顿量很少是完全通勤的，这自然激发了对几乎通勤哈密顿量的研究。尽管近似换向具有相关性，但人们对它的影响却知之甚少。在这项工作中，我们展示了如何通过交换量子位哈密顿量来有效地近似任何几乎交换的 2-局部量子位哈密顿量：我们给出了一种新的局部性保留算法舍入技术，该技术将任何 2-局部哈密顿量 H=sumᵢ₌₁^m hᵢ 映射为 |[hᵢ,hⱼ]| ≤ ϵ 到附近的哈密顿算子 hatH，其项成对交换，并且在总距离 |H-hatH| 内= O(m,ϵ1/3)。因此，我们表明，当 δ gg mϵ1/3 时，ε-几乎通勤 2-局部量子位哈密顿量对地面能量的 δ 近似位于 mathsfNP 中，将经典遏制远远超出了通勤设置。最后，我们提出了舍入框架的两个应用：吉布斯采样和几乎通勤系统的快速哈密顿模拟。

articles.title: Chiral Long-Range Order in three Euclidean Lattice Gross-Neveu Models
articles.title_zh: 三个欧几里得格子 Gross-Neveu 模型中的手性长程有序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.13075v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We prove the existence of Long-Range Order in a class of two-dimensional Euclidean lattice Gross-Neveu models with an even number of fermion flavors, covering three standard lattice discretizations, including naive and staggered fermions widely used in numerical studies. By performing a Hubbard-Stratonovich transformation, we map the fermionic systems to bosonic ones and establish Reflection Positivity for the resulting measures. Exploiting this structure, we combine Chessboard Estimates with a Peierls-type contour argument to prove Long-Range Order for the chirally charged fermion-mass bilinear overlineψψ at sufficiently small coupling and sufficiently large flavor number. Our analysis is robust with respect to the choice of lattice discretization and applies uniformly across different realizations of the same underlying continuum model. Moreover, we obtain uniform pointwise bounds on the bosonic two-point function, equivalently on the fermionic mass-mass correlator, showing that it is quantitatively controlled by the minimizers of the effective potential. This provides a fully rigorous and non-perturbative demonstration of Long-Range Order in lattice Gross-Neveu models and establishes a direct connection between the rigorous theory and its large-N (mean-field) predictions.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们证明了一类具有偶数费米子风格的二维欧几里得晶格 Gross-Neveu 模型中长程序的存在，涵盖了三种标准晶格离散化，包括数值研究中广泛使用的朴素费米子和交错费米子。通过执行哈伯德-斯特拉托诺维奇变换，我们将费米子系统映射到玻色子系统，并为所得测量建立反射正性。利用这种结构，我们将棋盘估计与 Peierls 型轮廓论证相结合，以证明在足够小的耦合和足够大的风味数下手性带电费米子质量双线性 overlineψψ 的长程有序。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们证明了一类具有偶数费米子风格的二维欧几里得晶格 Gross-Neveu 模型中长程序的存在，涵盖了三种标准晶格离散化，包括数值研究中广泛使用的朴素费米子和交错费米子。通过执行哈伯德-斯特拉托诺维奇变换，我们将费米子系统映射到玻色子系统，并为所得测量建立反射正性。利用这种结构，我们将棋盘估计与 Peierls 型轮廓论证相结合，以证明在足够小的耦合和足够大的风味数下手性带电费米子质量双线性 overlineψψ 的长程有序。我们的分析在晶格离散化的选择方面是稳健的，并且统一适用于同一底层连续体模型的不同实现。此外，我们在玻色子两点函数上获得了均匀的点向界限，等效于费米子质量-质量相关器，表明它是由有效势的最小值来定量控制的。这为格罗斯-奈芙模型中的长程有序提供了完全严格且非微扰的证明，并在严格理论与其大 N（平均场）预测之间建立了直接联系。

articles.title: Microwave-Free ¹³C Hyperpolarization of Diamond Particles Enabled by Magic Angle Spinning and NV Centers
articles.title_zh: 通过魔角纺和NV中心实现金刚石粒子的无微波¹ ³ C超极化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.07653v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Nuclear hyperpolarization from optically pumped color centers in solids offers an alternative to conventional microwave-driven dynamic nuclear polarization (DNP). Diamond can host the nitrogen vacancy (NV) center, whose ground spin state can be readily polarized by light at room temperature, making diamond a candidate platform for nuclear hyperpolarization. We report ¹³rm C nuclear hyperpolarization in randomly oriented diamond particles with sizes ranging from 0.2 to 2 μm, both at natural ¹³rm C abundance (1.1 %) and at 20 % isotopic enrichment, at magnetic fields of 7.1 T and 9.4 T. The protocol combines optical illumination with magic angle spinning (MAS) and does not require microwave irradiation. By investigating the nuclear polarization as a function of the MAS frequency between 0 and 6 kHz at the magnetic field of 7.1 T, we find maximum light-induced polarization enhancements of 280-fold for the isotopically enriched sample and 411-fold for the natural abundance sample. Under continuous illumination, steady-state absolute ¹³rm C polarization levels above 0.1 % are reached. A model involving optical pumping of NV centers and spin dynamics near level anticrossings (LACs) in three-spin clusters formed by NV, a substitutional nitrogen (P1) and ¹³rm C is used to describe these findings. The protocol strongly mitigates the effect of the anisotropy of the NV spin Hamiltonian, allowing more than 99.9% of NV orientations to participate in the polarization transfer process. These results represent a first step toward transferring nuclear polarization from diamond particles to external nuclei, with potential applications in sensitive and high-resolution NMR at room temperature.
