articles.abstract_zh_full: 在胶体中，形状或颗粒相互作用的各向异性可以引导组件远离紧密堆积的单层并转向更复杂的结构。在这项研究中，我们利用形状和相互作用各向异性来稳定三嵌段椭圆形颗粒的多孔表面组件，其表面在相反的极点上装饰有两个有吸引力的斑块。由此产生的结构显示出可调节程度的结晶戈薇序，通过淬火温度和/或改变化学势来控制。特别是，我们发现证据表明，戈薇晶格的成核是通过一步途径进行的，与球形三嵌段系统中广泛报道的两步途径相反，这使得三嵌段椭圆成为研究自组装途径如何随颗粒形状变化的有趣模型系统。除了有序的晶体结构之外，我们还发现了具有复杂内部几何形状的无序多孔网络。为了表征这一系列组件，我们引入了粒子补丁图，该图明确捕获了不同补丁处键的定位。粘合图案直接来自于这种表示，而我们识别为孔边界的环可以从图的平面嵌入中确定。我们通过人脸行走算法将所有环检测为平面嵌入中的人脸边界，这与环检测中使用的最短路径方法不同。与测量环路网络相对于选定环路尺寸的规律性的新的局部和全局顺序参数一起，该框架将微观键合图案与介观孔隙特性连接起来，并量化这些多孔组件的可调顺序。

articles.title: Quasiparticle-resolved variational theory of Andreev spin qubits
articles.title_zh: 安德烈夫自旋量子位的准粒子分辨变分理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.08557v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: An Andreev spin qubit stores a single unpaired spin, yet its coupling to the superconducting phase can be dominated by coherent virtual quasiparticle pairs. We develop a continuum variational description of the odd-parity doublet in a quantum-dot Josephson junction with Coulomb interaction and spin-dependent background tunneling. Retaining configurations with up to two Bogoliubov quasiparticles provides compact analytical expressions for energies and wavefunctions. We benchmark the results against numerical renormalization group calculations and identify sources of error. We obtain closed-form expressions for the conventional and spin-dependent Josephson couplings. Despite their small probability, two-quasiparticle configurations, through coherence with the zero-quasiparticle component, supply exactly half of the leading spin-dependent Josephson coupling even without Coulomb repulsion and dominate it as the repulsion grows. Spin-orbit-induced spin transfer between the dot and the leads produces a Josephson-current contribution that is common to both qubit states and finite at zero phase bias when the dot and lead Zeeman energies differ. We also map the localization of the virtual quasiparticles and the spin density in the leads. The results connect strongly correlated quantum-dot models to effective Hamiltonians used for Andreev-spin-qubit circuits and clarify how the wavefunction structure determines their couplings.
articles.abstract_zh: 安德烈夫自旋量子位存储单个不成对的自旋，但它与超导相的耦合可以由相干虚拟准粒子对主导。我们开发了具有库仑相互作用和自旋相关背景隧道效应的量子点约瑟夫森结中奇宇称双峰的连续变分描述。保留最多两个 Bogoliubov 准粒子的构型为能量和波函数提供了紧凑的解析表达式。我们根据数值重正化群计算对结果进行基准测试并确定误差源。我们获得了传统约瑟夫森耦合和自旋相关约瑟夫森耦合的闭合形式表达式。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 安德烈夫自旋量子位存储单个不成对的自旋，但它与超导相的耦合可以由相干虚拟准粒子对主导。我们开发了具有库仑相互作用和自旋相关背景隧道效应的量子点约瑟夫森结中奇宇称双峰的连续变分描述。保留最多两个 Bogoliubov 准粒子的构型为能量和波函数提供了紧凑的解析表达式。我们根据数值重正化群计算对结果进行基准测试并确定误差源。我们获得了传统约瑟夫森耦合和自旋相关约瑟夫森耦合的闭合形式表达式。尽管概率很小，但两个准粒子配置通过与零准粒子分量的相干，即使没有库仑斥力，也能提供恰好一半的主导自旋相关约瑟夫森耦合，并随着斥力的增长而占据主导地位。点和引线之间的自旋轨道引起的自旋转移产生约瑟夫森电流贡献，该贡献对于两个量子位态来说是共同的，并且当点和引线塞曼能量不同时在零相位偏置处是有限的。我们还绘制了虚拟准粒子的定位和引线中的自旋密度。结果将强相关的量子点模型与用于安德烈夫自旋量子位电路的有效哈密顿量联系起来，并阐明了波函数结构如何决定它们的耦合。

articles.title: Ghost rotationally invariant slave-boson approach to response functions
articles.title_zh: 响应函数的幽灵旋转不变从玻色子方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.08575v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose a finite-temperature Gaussian-fluctuation formalism for response functions within ghost rotationally invariant slave-boson (gRISB) theory and apply it to the two-dimensional Hubbard model. The gRISB magnetic phase boundary and static spin and charge susceptibilities capture the trends of dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT), significantly improving upon standard RISB and the random phase approximation (RPA). At the RISB level, our formalism recovers the Kotliar-Ruckenstein response. The dynamical susceptibilities resolve paramagnons, low-energy sound modes, and high-energy Hubbard excitations. Because they are evaluated directly on the real-frequency axis, the results avoid Matsubara truncation, stochastic sampling, and numerical analytic continuation. We also introduce a conserving quasiparticle approximation that expresses the response in terms of dressed Green's functions and vertex corrections.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了鬼旋转不变从玻色子 (gRISB) 理论中响应函数的有限温度高斯涨落形式，并将其应用于二维哈伯德模型。 gRISB 磁相界以及静态自旋和电荷磁化率捕捉了动态平均场理论 (DMFT) 的趋势，显着改进了标准 RISB 和随机相位近似 (RPA)。在 RISB 层面，我们的形式主义恢复了 Kotliar-Ruckenstein 响应。动力学磁化率解析了顺磁振子、低能声音模式和高能哈伯德激发。因为它们是直接在实频轴上评估的，所以结果避免了松原截断、随机采样和数值分析延续。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了鬼旋转不变从玻色子 (gRISB) 理论中响应函数的有限温度高斯涨落形式，并将其应用于二维哈伯德模型。 gRISB 磁相界以及静态自旋和电荷磁化率捕捉了动态平均场理论 (DMFT) 的趋势，显着改进了标准 RISB 和随机相位近似 (RPA)。在 RISB 层面，我们的形式主义恢复了 Kotliar-Ruckenstein 响应。动力学磁化率解析了顺磁振子、低能声音模式和高能哈伯德激发。因为它们是直接在实频轴上评估的，所以结果避免了松原截断、随机采样和数值分析延续。我们还引入了守恒准粒子近似，该近似用修饰格林函数和顶点校正来表达响应。

articles.title: Temperature dependence of spin-model parameters in ferrimagnets
articles.title_zh: 亚铁磁体中自旋模型参数的温度依赖性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.08582v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We compute the temperature dependence of effective spin-model parameters in two-sublattice ferrimagnets with antiparallel and inequivalent sublattice magnetizations using Green's-function theory. The effective intra- and intersublattice exchange interactions, together with the sublattice anisotropies, exhibit distinct thermal renormalizations arising from the different magnetic interactions and correlations of the two sublattices. Although these effective interaction parameters decrease monotonically with increasing temperature, their unequal renormalization produces a strongly nonmonotonic and polarization-dependent long-wavelength spin-wave response. In particular, the spin-wave exchange stiffness exhibits a strongly branch-dependent and nonmonotonic temperature dependence. One polarization develops an enhanced spin-wave stiffness in the vicinity of the angular momentum compensation region despite the monotonic thermal reduction of the underlying exchange interactions. The Green's-function predictions are in quantitative agreement with atomistic spin-dynamics simulations, which provide a numerical benchmark including thermally induced spin correlations within the underlying atomistic spin model. These results establish a direct connection between temperature-dependent atomistic interactions, long-wavelength spin-wave stiffness, and the effective parameters required for finite-temperature micromagnetic and multiscale modeling of ferrimagnetic materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们使用格林函数理论计算了具有反平行和不等亚晶格磁化强度的两个亚晶格亚铁磁体中有效自旋模型参数的温度依赖性。有效的子晶格内和子晶格间交换相互作用以及子晶格各向异性，表现出由两个子晶格的不同磁相互作用和相关性引起的独特的热重整化。尽管这些有效相互作用参数随着温度的升高而单调减小，但它们的不等重整化产生了强烈的非单调且依赖于偏振的长波长自旋波响应。特别是，自旋波交换刚度表现出强烈的分支依赖性和非单调温度依赖性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们使用格林函数理论计算了具有反平行和不等亚晶格磁化强度的两个亚晶格亚铁磁体中有效自旋模型参数的温度依赖性。有效的子晶格内和子晶格间交换相互作用以及子晶格各向异性，表现出由两个子晶格的不同磁相互作用和相关性引起的独特的热重整化。尽管这些有效相互作用参数随着温度的升高而单调减小，但它们的不等重整化产生了强烈的非单调且依赖于偏振的长波长自旋波响应。特别是，自旋波交换刚度表现出强烈的分支依赖性和非单调温度依赖性。尽管潜在的交换相互作用单调热减少，但一种偏振在角动量补偿区域附近产生增强的自旋波刚度。格林函数的预测与原子自旋动力学模拟在定量上一致，原子自旋动力学模拟提供了一个数值基准，包括基础原子自旋模型内的热致自旋相关性。这些结果在温度相关的原子相互作用、长波长自旋波刚度以及亚铁磁材料的有限温度微磁和多尺度建模所需的有效参数之间建立了直接联系。

articles.title: Nonlinear Curvature-Free Periodic Folding in Origami via Symmetry Classification of Linear Modes
articles.title_zh: 通过线性模式的对称分类实现折纸中的非线性无曲率周期性折叠
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.08635v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Broadly studied origami crease patterns such as the Miura-ori are capable of rigid folding that maintains their spatial periodicity. However, periodic crease patterns generically require additional creases and fold into quasi-cylindrical shapes. Here, using group theory, we show that the folding properties of such sheets are largely determined by their spatial symmetries, known as layer groups. Within each symmetry class, the allowed linear shape-periodic modes of sheets are constrained and classified by the irreducible representation they belong to. Such classification further gives a sufficient condition, containing a symmetry constraint and a topological constraint, for the existence of a nonlinear strain mode. In this way, familiar special cases are placed within a unified framework that connects symmetry, network topology, and deployability. Finally, we turn our classification results into a predictive design principle that enables the rapid design of novel sheets with prescribed properties.
articles.abstract_zh: 经过广泛研究的折纸折痕图案（例如 Miura-ori）能够进行刚性折叠，从而保持其空间周期性。然而，周期性折痕图案通常需要额外的折痕并折叠成准圆柱形形状。在这里，我们利用群论表明，此类纸张的折叠特性很大程度上取决于其空间对称性（称为层组）。在每个对称类中，片材允许的线性形状周期模式受到它们所属的不可约表示的约束和分类。这种分类进一步给出了非线性应变模式存在的充分条件，包含对称约束和拓扑约束。通过这种方式，熟悉的特殊情况被放置在连接对称性、网络拓扑和可部署性的统一框架内。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 经过广泛研究的折纸折痕图案（例如 Miura-ori）能够进行刚性折叠，从而保持其空间周期性。然而，周期性折痕图案通常需要额外的折痕并折叠成准圆柱形形状。在这里，我们利用群论表明，此类纸张的折叠特性很大程度上取决于其空间对称性（称为层组）。在每个对称类中，片材允许的线性形状周期模式受到它们所属的不可约表示的约束和分类。这种分类进一步给出了非线性应变模式存在的充分条件，包含对称约束和拓扑约束。通过这种方式，熟悉的特殊情况被放置在连接对称性、网络拓扑和可部署性的统一框架内。最后，我们将分类结果转化为预测设计原则，从而能够快速设计具有规定属性的新型板材。

articles.title: Phase-field insight into the nature of topological polarization structures in uniaxial ferroelectrics
articles.title_zh: 单轴铁电体拓扑极化结构性质的相场洞察
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.08687v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Uniaxial ferroelectrics have long served as benchmark systems for time-resolved studies of polarization evolution due to their simple 180-domain structure. However, recent experiments in these materials have revealed complex topological textures with enigmatic features, including the unexpected charge-free head-to-head and tail-to-tail domain walls which still wait for their consistent explanation. Here, we use a universal three-dimensional phase-field model to investigate the kinetics of domain structure development in triglycine sulfate, accounting for the monoclinic symmetry of its parent and ferroelectric phases. We show that isolated saddle-like polarization structures, interconnected saddle cascades, saddle lines and specific monkey saddles can form only when transverse degrees of freedom for spontaneous polarization are allowed in the polar plane of a uniaxial ferroelectric. The abundance and diversity of saddle-like structures at the early stages of domain ordering drives a far more effective compensation of bound charges at head-to-head and tail-to-tail domain walls than those predicted by single-component order parameter models. As domains coarsen and residual bound charges migrate toward the surfaces of the sample, the topological landscape simplifies, leaving behind only isolated saddle points. The present model successfully reproduces exotic structures observed experimentally in triglycine sulfate and lead germanate and reveals a domain topology that extends beyond the conventional Ising picture of uniaxial ferroelectrics. Although the mechanisms of bound-charge compensation are likely to be material-specific, similar topological structures may emerge in other uniaxial ferroelectrics. The general formulation of our phase-field model opens the way for future studies of such phenomena across a broader class of ferroelectric materials of arbitrary symmetry.
articles.abstract_zh: 由于其简单的 180 域结构，单轴铁电体长期以来一直作为极化演化时间分辨研究的基准系统。然而，最近对这些材料的实验揭示了具有神秘特征的复杂拓扑纹理，包括意想不到的无电荷头对头和尾对尾域壁，这些域壁仍在等待其一致的解释。在这里，我们使用通用的三维相场模型来研究硫酸三甘氨酸中域结构发展的动力学，解释其母相和铁电相的单斜对称性。我们证明，只有当单轴铁电体的极面允许自发极化的横向自由度时，才能形成孤立的鞍状极化结构、互连的鞍状级联、鞍线和特定的猴鞍。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 由于其简单的 180 域结构，单轴铁电体长期以来一直作为极化演化时间分辨研究的基准系统。然而，最近对这些材料的实验揭示了具有神秘特征的复杂拓扑纹理，包括意想不到的无电荷头对头和尾对尾域壁，这些域壁仍在等待其一致的解释。在这里，我们使用通用的三维相场模型来研究硫酸三甘氨酸中域结构发展的动力学，解释其母相和铁电相的单斜对称性。我们证明，只有当单轴铁电体的极面允许自发极化的横向自由度时，才能形成孤立的鞍状极化结构、互连的鞍状级联、鞍线和特定的猴鞍。在畴有序的早期阶段，鞍状结构的丰富性和多样性使得头对头和尾对尾畴壁处的束缚电荷补偿比单组分有序参数模型预测的更有效。随着磁域变粗，残余束缚电荷向样品表面迁移，拓扑景观变得简单，只留下孤立的鞍点。本模型成功地再现了在硫酸三甘氨酸和锗酸铅中实验观察到的奇异结构，并揭示了超出单轴铁电体传统伊辛图的域拓扑。尽管束缚电荷补偿的机制可能是特定于材料的，但类似的拓扑结构可能会出现在其他单轴铁电体中。我们的相场模型的一般公式为未来研究更广泛的任意对称铁电材料中的此类现象开辟了道路。

articles.title: Small Distortions, Big Polarization: Tetragonal BaTiO3 Nanoparticles for High-Performance Piezoelectric Nanogenerators
articles.title_zh: 小畸变，大极化：用于高性能压电纳米发电机的四方 BaTiO3 纳米颗粒
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.08762v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Lead-free ferroelectric BaTiO3 (BTO) nanoparticles with stabilized tetragonal distortion were synthesized via a ligand-assisted sol-gel method to serve as the active piezoelectric phase in high-performance hybrid piezoelectric nanogenerators (PENGs) operating with triboelectric synergy. XRD, Raman spectroscopy, and Pair Distribution Function (PDF) analysis confirmed pseudo-cubic tetragonal BTO nanoparticle, annealed at 900degC (BTO-900, ~54nm) and well-defined tetragonal BTO annealed at 1200degC (BTO-1200, ~104nm). Density Functional Theory (DFT) calculations confirmed enhanced Ti-O covalency, stronger Ti 3d-O 2p hybridization, narrower HOMO-LUMO gap, and improved dipole coherence in BTO-900, indicating superior ferroelectric polarization, piezoelectric activity, and charge retention. BTO-900-PDMS PENG device generated a high open-circuit voltage of ~100 V and stored ~29 μJ energy, and superior capacitor-charging performance of BTO-900, while the optimized BTO-1200 based device showed a higher power density of ~649 μW cm-2 and short-circuit current of ~181 μA. The superior performance of BTO-900 was attributed to enhanced defect-assisted charge trapping, interfacial polarization, and impedance-controlled charge retention. By coupling the intrinsic piezoelectric response of covalency-engineered tetragonal BTO with triboelectric charge generation at the BTO-PDMS interface, this work establishes nanoparticle size and bonding engineering as an effective route to high-output, lead-free piezoelectric nanogenerators for self-powered electronics.
articles.abstract_zh: 通过配体辅助溶胶-凝胶法合成了具有稳定四方畸变的无铅铁电 BaTiO3 (BTO) 纳米颗粒，作为具有摩擦电协同作用的高性能混合压电纳米发电机 (PENG) 中的活性压电相。 XRD、拉曼光谱和对分布函数 (PDF) 分析证实了伪立方四方 BTO 纳米颗粒，在 900 ℃ 下退火（BTO-900，~54 nm），并且在 1200 ℃ 下退火，具有明确的四方 BTO（BTO-1200，~104 nm）。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 通过配体辅助溶胶-凝胶法合成了具有稳定四方畸变的无铅铁电 BaTiO3 (BTO) 纳米颗粒，作为具有摩擦电协同作用的高性能混合压电纳米发电机 (PENG) 中的活性压电相。 XRD、拉曼光谱和对分布函数 (PDF) 分析证实了伪立方四方 BTO 纳米颗粒，在 900 ℃ 下退火（BTO-900，~54 nm），并且在 1200 ℃ 下退火，具有明确的四方 BTO（BTO-1200，~104 nm）。密度泛函理论 (DFT) 计算证实了 BTO-900 中 Ti-O 共价性增强、Ti 3d-O 2p 杂化更强、HOMO-LUMO 间隙更窄以及偶极子相干性改善，表明具有优异的铁电极化、压电活性和电荷保持能力。 BTO-900-PDMS PENG 器件产生约 100 V 的高开路电压并存储约 29 μJ 的能量，以及 BTO-900 优异的电容器充电性能，而优化的基于 BTO-1200 的器件表现出约 649 μW cm-2 的更高功率密度和约 181 μA 的短路电流。 BTO-900 的卓越性能归因于增强的缺陷辅助电荷捕获、界面极化和阻抗控制的电荷保留。通过将共价设计的四方 BTO 的固有压电响应与 BTO-PDMS 界面上的摩擦电荷产生相结合，这项工作将纳米颗粒尺寸和键合工程确立为用于自供电电子产品的高输出、无铅压电纳米发电机的有效途径。

articles.title: Geometric Photon-drag Effect in Unconventional Magnets
articles.title_zh: 非常规磁体中的几何光子拖曳效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.08767v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The photon-drag effect is a nonlinear optical phenomenon in which the finite momentum carried by incident photons is transferred to charge carriers, thereby generating a dc photocurrent even in systems with inversion symmetry. Within the density-matrix formalism in the velocity gauge, and accounting for nonvertical optical transitions driven by finite photon momentum, we derive the nonlinear injection and shift conductivities that characterize the photon-drag photogalvanic response. We investigate these photon-drag responses in unconventional pₓ-wave and dₓ^₂₋y^₂-wave magnets in the presence of Rashba spin-orbit coupling (RSOC), highlighting the distinct roles of symmetry and quantum geometry in shaping their nonlinear optical behavior. The key finding of our work is that, despite the broken inversion symmetry, the conventional photogalvanic response vanishes identically in the q=0 limit after Brillouin-zone integration in both unconventional magnetic phases, resulting in a nonlinear dc photocurrent entirely photon-drag driven. The two unconventional magnets exhibit qualitatively distinct responses governed by their symmetry properties: the p-wave magnet supports only linear injection and circular shift conductivities, whereas the d-wave altermagnet, which simultaneously breaks time-reversal and inversion symmetries, admits all linear and circular components. Our findings establish altermagnets as a promising platform for controlling symmetry-selective nonlinear photocurrents and may enable applications in polarization-sensitive photodetection, nonlinear optoelectronics, and quantum geometric photogalvanics.
articles.abstract_zh: 光子拖曳效应是一种非线性光学现象，其中入射光子携带的有限动量被转移到电荷载流子，从而即使在具有反演对称性的系统中也会产生直流光电流。在速度计的密度矩阵形式中，并考虑有限光子动量驱动的非垂直光学跃迁，我们推导了表征光子拖曳光电响应的非线性注入和位移电导率。我们研究了存在 Rashba 自旋轨道耦合 (RSOC) 的非常规 pₓ 波和 dₓ²₋y² 波磁体中的光子拖曳响应，强调了对称性和量子几何在塑造其非线性光学行为中的独特作用。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 光子拖曳效应是一种非线性光学现象，其中入射光子携带的有限动量被转移到电荷载流子，从而即使在具有反演对称性的系统中也会产生直流光电流。在速度计的密度矩阵形式中，并考虑有限光子动量驱动的非垂直光学跃迁，我们推导了表征光子拖曳光电响应的非线性注入和位移电导率。我们研究了存在 Rashba 自旋轨道耦合 (RSOC) 的非常规 pₓ 波和 dₓ²₋y² 波磁体中的光子拖曳响应，强调了对称性和量子几何在塑造其非线性光学行为中的独特作用。我们工作的主要发现是，尽管反演对称性被破坏，但在两个非常规磁相中进行布里渊区积分后，传统的光电响应在 q=0 极限下同样消失，从而产生完全由光子拖曳驱动的非线性直流光电流。这两种非常规磁体表现出由其对称性决定的性质不同的响应：p波磁体仅支持线性注入和圆位移电导率，而d波交替磁体同时打破时间反转和反转对称性，允许所有线性和圆分量。我们的研究结果将交变磁体确立为控制对称选择性非线性光电流的有前景的平台，并可能在偏振敏感光电检测、非线性光电子学和量子几何光电池中得到应用。

articles.title: Quantum twisting microscopy as a momentum-resolved probe of quantum geometry and sublattice symmetries
articles.title_zh: 量子扭转显微镜作为量子几何和亚晶格对称性动量分辨探针
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.08783v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In two-dimensional (2D) flat-band systems, as engineered, for instance, by stacking and twisting van der Waals materials, the momentum dependence of the Bloch states is a key factor in determining the interaction-induced emergence of different phases. Hence, methods of probing this form of ''quantum geometry'' are crucial to understanding these systems. Yet, extracting the momentum dependence of the underlying quantum geometric tensor from measurements is challenging in 2D. Here, we propose employing a quantum twisting microscope (QTM) with a sublattice-polarized tip to fill this gap. We show how expectation values of sublattice Pauli matrices can be probed across the scanned momentum path. This allows for the direct measurement of crucial symmetries characterizing the different candidate instabilities in graphene-based moiré systems. We furthermore show that the quantum metric component along the scan direction can also be extracted; the full quantum geometric tensor is also accessible, given that more than one sublattice polarization can be used. Our work illustrates the potential and extends the versatility of the QTM approach. If implemented in future experiments, this would provide unprecedented access to the symmetry signatures of the correlated phases and to the underlying quantum geometry in twisted bilayer graphene and related systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 在二维 (2D) 平带系统中，例如通过堆叠和扭曲范德华材料进行设计，布洛赫态的动量依赖性是确定相互作用引起的不同相出现的关键因素。因此，探测这种形式的“量子几何”的方法对于理解这些系统至关重要。然而，从测量中提取底层量子几何张量的动量依赖性在二维中具有挑战性。在这里，我们建议采用带有亚晶格偏振尖端的量子扭转显微镜（QTM）来填补这一空白。我们展示了如何在扫描动量路径上探测亚晶格泡利矩阵的期望值。这允许直接测量表征基于石墨烯的莫尔系统中不同候选不稳定性的关键对称性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在二维 (2D) 平带系统中，例如通过堆叠和扭曲范德华材料进行设计，布洛赫态的动量依赖性是确定相互作用引起的不同相出现的关键因素。因此，探测这种形式的“量子几何”的方法对于理解这些系统至关重要。然而，从测量中提取底层量子几何张量的动量依赖性在二维中具有挑战性。在这里，我们建议采用带有亚晶格偏振尖端的量子扭转显微镜（QTM）来填补这一空白。我们展示了如何在扫描动量路径上探测亚晶格泡利矩阵的期望值。这允许直接测量表征基于石墨烯的莫尔系统中不同候选不稳定性的关键对称性。我们还表明，沿着扫描方向的量子度量分量也可以被提取；如果可以使用多个亚晶格极化，则也可以获得完整的量子几何张量。我们的工作展示了 QTM 方法的潜力并扩展了其多功能性。如果在未来的实验中实现，这将为相关相的对称特征以及扭曲双层石墨烯和相关系统中的底层量子几何提供前所未有的途径。

articles.title: Algebraic Tensor Network Renormalization and Holographic duality
articles.title_zh: 代数张量网络重整化和全息对偶性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.08787v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Emergent generalized symmetries and the holographic principle play very important roles in understanding quantum phase transitions. In recent years, tensor-network renormalization with generalized symmetry and the corresponding fixed-point tensor formulation have been proposed as a discrete spacetime framework for reformulating conformal field theory. Nevertheless, a complete holographic formulation within this framework is still lacking, and the current formulation does not directly accommodate sector partition functions that are modular covariant in general. In this work, we formulate R-TNR, which builds the categorical constraints of a fusion category R into local tensor spaces and preserves these constraints under Loop-TNR. For suitable choices of R, the initial tensors constructed here flow under R-Loop-TNR to stable gapless fixed points. In the Ising, tricritical Ising, and three-state Potts conformal field theory examples, a broad range of initial parameters leads to the same gapless fixed point in each example. The method resolves conformal towers by anyon sector and yields scaling dimensions, conformal spins, and magnitudes of sector-resolved structure constants with extremely high accuracy compared to previous methods. These results realize a topological bootstrap based on stable symmetry-topological-order in which finite categorical and geometric input, together with an initial tensor that need not be fine-tuned, suffices to recover the infrared conformal field theory and its sector-resolved conformal data.
articles.abstract_zh: 涌现的广义对称性和全息原理在理解量子相变中发挥着非常重要的作用。近年来，具有广义对称性的张量网络重整化和相应的定点张量公式被提出作为重新表述共形场论的离散时空框架。然而，该框架内仍然缺乏完整的全息公式，并且当前的公式不能直接适应一般为模协变的扇区划分函数。在这项工作中，我们制定了 R-TNR，它将融合类别 R 的分类约束构建到局部张量空间中，并在 Loop-TNR 下保留这些约束。为了选择合适的 R，这里构建的初始张量在 R-Loop-TNR 下流向稳定的无间隙固定点。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 涌现的广义对称性和全息原理在理解量子相变中发挥着非常重要的作用。近年来，具有广义对称性的张量网络重整化和相应的定点张量公式被提出作为重新表述共形场论的离散时空框架。然而，该框架内仍然缺乏完整的全息公式，并且当前的公式不能直接适应一般为模协变的扇区划分函数。在这项工作中，我们制定了 R-TNR，它将融合类别 R 的分类约束构建到局部张量空间中，并在 Loop-TNR 下保留这些约束。为了选择合适的 R，这里构建的初始张量在 R-Loop-TNR 下流向稳定的无间隙固定点。在伊辛、三临界伊辛和三态波茨共形场论示例中，广泛的初始参数在每个示例中导致相同的无间隙固定点。该方法通过任意子扇区解析共形塔，并产生缩放尺寸、共形自旋和扇区解析结构常数的大小，与以前的方法相比，具有极高的精度。这些结果实现了基于稳定对称拓扑序的拓扑引导，其中有限的分类和几何输入以及不需要微调的初始张量足以恢复红外共形场理论及其扇区解析的共形数据。

articles.title: Kardar-Parisi-Zhang superdiffusion in chaotic quantum circuits
articles.title_zh: 混沌量子电路中的 Kardar-Parisi-Zhang 超扩散
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.07143v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We construct a family of chaotic brickwork quantum circuits exhibiting superdiffusive transport with dynamical exponent z=3/2 in the full Kardar--Parisi--Zhang (KPZ) universality class. This is enabled by the equilibrium current associated with a inhomogeneous conserved density having a nontrivial dependence on the chemical potential. Using nonlinear fluctuating hydrodynamics, we derive the propagation velocity, broadening scale, and universal scaling form of the charge correlation function from microscopic equilibrium properties. Tensor-network simulations of a two-site spin-1 (qutrit) circuit reproduce these parameter-free predictions, including the full stationary KPZ profile. We further construct a three-site spin-frac12 (qubit) circuit, where transport varies from diffusive to superdiffusive with the chemical potential, while long-lived coherent quasiparticles delay the convergence of the profile to the KPZ scaling form. Our results establish that KPZ superdiffusion in quantum systems is not restricted to fine-tuned integrable models.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一系列混沌砖砌量子电路，在完整的 Kardar-Parisi-Zhang (KPZ) 普适性类中表现出动态指数 z=3/2 的超扩散传输。这是通过与不均匀守恒密度相关的平衡电流实现的，该不均匀守恒密度对化学势具有非平凡的依赖性。利用非线性脉动流体动力学，我们从微观平衡性质推导出电荷相关函数的传播速度、展宽尺度和通用尺度形式。两站点 spin-1 (qutrit) 电路的张量网络模拟再现了这些无参数预测，包括完全平稳的 KPZ 轮廓。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们构建了一系列混沌砖砌量子电路，在完整的 Kardar-Parisi-Zhang (KPZ) 普适性类中表现出动态指数 z=3/2 的超扩散传输。这是通过与不均匀守恒密度相关的平衡电流实现的，该不均匀守恒密度对化学势具有非平凡的依赖性。利用非线性脉动流体动力学，我们从微观平衡性质推导出电荷相关函数的传播速度、展宽尺度和通用尺度形式。两站点 spin-1 (qutrit) 电路的张量网络模拟再现了这些无参数预测，包括完全平稳的 KPZ 轮廓。我们进一步构建了一个三位点自旋 frac12（量子位）电路，其中传输随化学势从扩散到超扩散变化，而长寿命的相干准粒子延迟了轮廓向 KPZ 标度形式的收敛。我们的结果表明，量子系统中的 KPZ 超扩散并不局限于微调可积模型。

articles.title: Decoupling Spectral Gaps from Entanglement Complexity in Quantum Annealing
articles.title_zh: 将光谱间隙与量子退火中的纠缠复杂性解耦
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.07144v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Exponentially small spectral gaps are the central obstacle to adiabatic quantum annealing, yet whether such bottlenecks demand correspondingly complex entanglement remains unclear. We show that gap scaling and entanglement complexity need not be linked. Conventional first-order transitions combine exponentially small gaps with bounded O(1) bipartite Schmidt rank, even though the critical states retain global multipartite correlations, while continuous transitions combine polynomially closing gaps with logarithmically growing entanglement. We show that each pairing can also be inverted: in a known first-order transition in a staggered-field antiferromagnetic Ising chain the gap closes polynomially despite bounded Schmidt rank, while we construct a mirror-twin manifold model whose gap closes exponentially even as its entanglement entropy grows logarithmically with system size. We derive bounds connecting Schmidt rank to Hamming-space geometry, and identify manifold density and connectivity as the ingredients that determine which combination occurs. These results show that entanglement complexity alone cannot characterize annealing difficulty, and point toward a broader search for quantum resources that capture the geometry of state evolution in Hilbert space.
articles.abstract_zh: 指数级的小光谱间隙是绝热量子退火的主要障碍，但此类瓶颈是否需要相应的复杂纠缠仍不清楚。我们表明，间隙缩放和纠缠复杂度不需要联系起来。传统的一阶跃迁将指数级小间隙与有界 O(1) 二分施密特秩相结合，即使临界状态保留全局多部分相关性，而连续跃迁将多项式闭合间隙与对数增长的纠缠相结合。我们证明了每个配对也可以反转：在交错场反铁磁伊辛链中的已知一阶跃迁中，尽管施密特等级有限，间隙仍以多项式闭合，而我们构建了一个镜像双流形模型，即使其纠缠熵随系统尺寸呈对数增长，其间隙也呈指数闭合。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 指数级的小光谱间隙是绝热量子退火的主要障碍，但此类瓶颈是否需要相应的复杂纠缠仍不清楚。我们表明，间隙缩放和纠缠复杂度不需要联系起来。传统的一阶跃迁将指数级小间隙与有界 O(1) 二分施密特秩相结合，即使临界状态保留全局多部分相关性，而连续跃迁将多项式闭合间隙与对数增长的纠缠相结合。我们证明了每个配对也可以反转：在交错场反铁磁伊辛链中的已知一阶跃迁中，尽管施密特等级有限，间隙仍以多项式闭合，而我们构建了一个镜像双流形模型，即使其纠缠熵随系统尺寸呈对数增长，其间隙也呈指数闭合。我们推导出将施密特等级与汉明空间几何连接起来的界限，并将流形密度和连通性确定为确定发生哪种组合的成分。这些结果表明，纠缠复杂性本身并不能表征退火难度，并指向更广泛地寻找捕获希尔伯特空间中状态演化几何形状的量子资源。

articles.title: Interacting multicomponent SU(N) magnets
articles.title_zh: 相互作用的多组分 SU(N) 磁体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.07157v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study magnets composed of molecules with atoms interacting via SU(N)-invariant two-body interactions. Atoms carry states transforming in generically different irreducible representations of SU(N), and the interaction strength between atoms depends on the specific atoms involved. We derive the thermodynamics of these magnets in the mean-field approach, and find that they can exhibit mixed ferro-antiferromagnetic behavior. We present a full analysis of the simplest nontrivial case of molecules consisting of two atoms in the spin-j representation of SU(2), which generalizes conventional magnetic systems, and derive its phase structure and transitions.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究由分子和原子通过 SU(N) 不变的二体相互作用相互作用组成的磁体。原子携带状态以一般不同的不可约表示 SU(N) 的形式转换，原子之间的相互作用强度取决于所涉及的特定原子。我们通过平均场方法推导了这些磁体的热力学，并发现它们可以表现出混合的铁反铁磁行为。我们对由 SU(2) 的自旋 j 表示中的两个原子组成的分子的最简单的非平凡情况进行了全面分析，它概括了传统的磁系统，并推导了其相结构和转变。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究由分子和原子通过 SU(N) 不变的二体相互作用相互作用组成的磁体。原子携带状态以一般不同的不可约表示 SU(N) 的形式转换，原子之间的相互作用强度取决于所涉及的特定原子。我们通过平均场方法推导了这些磁体的热力学，并发现它们可以表现出混合的铁反铁磁行为。我们对由 SU(2) 的自旋 j 表示中的两个原子组成的分子的最简单的非平凡情况进行了全面分析，它概括了传统的磁系统，并推导了其相结构和转变。

articles.title: Connectivity Controls Variational Accessibility in Symmetry-Preserving Quantum Circuits
articles.title_zh: 连接性控制保对称量子电路中的变分可访问性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.07173v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Designing expressive quantum circuits for the variational quantum eigensolver (VQE) is a central challenge in simulating interacting many-body systems. Even symmetry-preserving (SP) circuits need not access the full many-body symmetry sector. We demonstrate this explicitly for the spin-1/2 XXZ and Hubbard models, where Hamiltonian-inspired nearest-neighbor (NN) SP circuits generate restricted dynamical Lie algebras (DLAs). While these restricted manifolds can accurately represent the ground state near the free-fermion limits, J_z=0 for XXZ and U=0 for Hubbard, interactions expose inaccessible many-body directions and severely limit VQE performance even at large circuit depth. Remarkably, a minimal modification of the generator connectivity can reconstruct the full orthogonal DLA within all relevant symmetry sectors studied in this work. For XXZ model, the addition of it only one SP next-to-NN single-excitation connection triggers this dramatic reconstruction, whereas the Hubbard case requires a SP correlated double-excitation;--showing that the relevant connectivity can extend from the spatial lattice to many-body configuration space. This reconstruction enlarges the tangent space and accessibility of the energy-lowering Hamiltonian direction, leading to near-unit ground-state fidelity in VQE simulations. Our results establish a direct link between generator connectivity and variational accessibility and suggest a broader circuit-design principle: identify minimal symmetry-preserving generators that enlarge the accessible many-body space rather than increasing circuit depth alone. This perspective may have broader relevance for quantum many-body simulation at the interface of condensed-matter physics and quantum computing.
articles.abstract_zh: 为变分量子本征求解器 (VQE) 设计富有表现力的量子电路是模拟交互多体系统的一个核心挑战。即使是保对称（SP）电路也不需要访问完整的多体对称区域。我们针对自旋 1/2 XXZ 和 Hubbard 模型明确证明了这一点，其中受哈密顿量启发的最近邻 (NN) SP 电路生成受限动态李代数 (DLA)。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 为变分量子本征求解器 (VQE) 设计富有表现力的量子电路是模拟交互多体系统的一个核心挑战。即使是保对称（SP）电路也不需要访问完整的多体对称区域。我们针对自旋 1/2 XXZ 和 Hubbard 模型明确证明了这一点，其中受哈密顿量启发的最近邻 (NN) SP 电路生成受限动态李代数 (DLA)。虽然这些受限流形可以准确地表示自由费米子极限附近的基态，XXZ 的 J_z=0 和 Hubbard 的 U=0，但相互作用暴露了难以访问的多体方向，并严重限制了 VQE 性能，即使在大电路深度下也是如此。值得注意的是，对生成器连接的最小修改可以在本工作中研究的所有相关对称扇区内重建完整的正交 DLA。对于 XXZ 模型，仅添加一个紧邻 NN 的 SP 单激励连接即可触发这一戏剧性的重建，而 Hubbard 情况则需要 SP 相关的双激励；——表明相关连接可以从空间晶格扩展到多体配置空间。这种重建扩大了能量降低哈密顿方向的切线空间和可达性，从而在 VQE 模拟中实现近单位基态保真度。我们的结果在生成器连接性和变分可访问性之间建立了直接联系，并提出了更广泛的电路设计原则：确定最小的保持对称性的生成器，以扩大可访问的多体空间，而不是单独增加电路深度。这种观点可能与凝聚态物理和量子计算接口的量子多体模拟具有更广泛的相关性。

articles.title: Crossover of magnetodipole and electrodipole contributions in the broadband magneto-optics of bismuth-substituted iron garnets
articles.title_zh: 铋取代铁石榴石宽带磁光中磁偶极子和电偶极子贡献的交叉
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.07595v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This work presents a comprehensive macroscopic electrodynamic framework isolating the magnetodipole (MD) and electrodipole (ED) contributions to the magneto-optical effects in bismuth-substituted iron garnet. By rigorously incorporating the dispersive magnetic permeability tensor, the dominance of the MD mechanism in the terahertz (THz) gap is demonstrated. In the mid-infrared (MIR) to near-infrared (NIR) domain, a fundamental spectral crossover is revealed where the magnitudes of the MD and ED contributions exactly equalize, invalidating the widespread assumption that magnetic contributions vanish uniformly at infrared frequencies. Furthermore, it is shown that interfacial phase shifts uniquely dictate how these competing mechanisms project onto observable rotation and ellipticity, yielding an inverted spectral hierarchy between transmission (Faraday) and reflection (polar and longitudinal Kerr) geometries. Most notably, the transverse Kerr effect for s-polarized light is established to be exclusively driven by the off-diagonal magnetic permeability. While strictly zero under the conventional ED approximation, the s-polarized transverse Kerr effect emerges as a robust, free of the gyroelectric contribution probe of MD activity in the THz and MIR--NIR regimes, yielding a THz response two orders of magnitude larger than its p-polarized counterpart.
articles.abstract_zh: 这项工作提出了一个全面的宏观电动力学框架，隔离了磁偶极（MD）和电偶极（ED）对铋取代铁石榴石磁光效应的贡献。通过严格结合色散磁导率张量，证明了MD机制在太赫兹（THz）间隙中的主导地位。在中红外 (MIR) 到近红外 (NIR) 域中，揭示了基本光谱交叉，其中 MD 和 ED 贡献的幅度完全相等，从而使磁贡献在红外频率下均匀消失的广泛假设无效。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 这项工作提出了一个全面的宏观电动力学框架，隔离了磁偶极（MD）和电偶极（ED）对铋取代铁石榴石磁光效应的贡献。通过严格结合色散磁导率张量，证明了MD机制在太赫兹（THz）间隙中的主导地位。在中红外 (MIR) 到近红外 (NIR) 域中，揭示了基本光谱交叉，其中 MD 和 ED 贡献的幅度完全相等，从而使磁贡献在红外频率下均匀消失的广泛假设无效。此外，研究表明，界面相移独特地决定了这些竞争机制如何投射到可观察的旋转和椭圆度上，从而在透射（法拉第）和反射（极坐标和纵向克尔）几何形状之间产生倒置的光谱层次结构。最值得注意的是，s 偏振光的横向克尔效应被确定为完全由非对角线磁导率驱动。虽然在传统的 ED 近似下严格为零，但 s 偏振横向克尔效应在太赫兹和中红外-近红外区域中作为一种强大的、不受 MD 活动的陀螺电贡献的探针出现，产生的太赫兹响应比其 p 偏振对应物大两个数量级。

articles.title: Which alloy composition,what process parameters? Inferring the recipe from optimized metallic microstructure and texture
articles.title_zh: 哪些合金成分，哪些工艺参数？从优化的金属微观结构和织构推断配方
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.08165v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The mechanical properties of a metallic alloy are set by its microstructure and texture: the size and shape of its grains and the orientation of their crystals. That structure is in turn set by a recipe, the alloy composition together with the processing parameters. Alloy development runs this chain forwards, tuning the structure until a target property is met. Running it backwards, from an optimized structure to the recipe that would produce it, still relies on expert knowledge. We ask whether this backwards step can be learned. On an in-house dataset of 107 magnesium alloy extrusion conditions across 14 alloys, each with optical micrographs and an X-ray texture measurement, we compare three descriptors of microstructure and texture: conventional grain and texture statistics, a vision embedding from a pretrained image encoder, and a graph neural network on the grain network. Each is paired with prediction heads for two tasks: the alloy composition given the process (Task A), and the process parameters given the composition (Task B). Under 5-fold cross-validation, the conventional descriptors identify the correct alloy for 65% of held-out conditions, against 17% for always guessing the most common alloy, while the learned embeddings stay below 30%. The process parameters are recoverable but noisier: compared with using the composition alone, the microstructure roughly halves the temperature error. Because only a few alloys were cast and only a few press settings were used, both answers are discrete, and heads that pick from these known options, while respecting their order, worked better than heads that predict a free value.
articles.abstract_zh: 金属合金的机械性能由其微观结构和织构决定：晶粒的大小和形状以及晶体的取向。该结构又由配方、合金成分以及加工参数决定。合金开发向前推进这条链条，调整结构直到满足目标性能。逆向运行，从优化的结构到生产它的配方，仍然依赖于专业知识。我们问这种倒退的步骤是否可以学习。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 金属合金的机械性能由其微观结构和织构决定：晶粒的大小和形状以及晶体的取向。该结构又由配方、合金成分以及加工参数决定。合金开发向前推进这条链条，调整结构直到满足目标性能。逆向运行，从优化的结构到生产它的配方，仍然依赖于专业知识。我们问这种倒退的步骤是否可以学习。在 14 种合金的 107 种镁合金挤压条件的内部数据集上，每种条件都有光学显微照片和 X 射线纹理测量，我们比较了微观结构和纹理的三种描述符：传统的晶粒和纹理统计数据、来自预训练图像编码器的视觉嵌入以及晶粒网络上的图神经网络。每个预测头都与两个任务配对：给定工艺的合金成分（任务 A），以及给定成分的工艺参数（任务 B）。在 5 倍交叉验证下，传统描述符在 65% 的保留条件下识别出正确的合金，而始终猜测最常见合金的识别率只有 17%，而学习到的嵌入保持在 30% 以下。工艺参数是可恢复的，但噪音更大：与单独使用成分相比，微观结构将温度误差大致减半。因为只铸造了几种合金并且只使用了几种压力设置，所以两个答案都是离散的，并且从这些已知选项中挑选的头在尊重其顺序的同时比预测自由值的头工作得更好。

articles.title: OxiGen: Oxidation-State-Aware Crystal Generation
articles.title_zh: OxiGen：氧化态感知晶体生成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.08296v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Generative models have the potential to accelerate inorganic materials discovery by enabling inverse design, but generating experimentally realisable crystals remains challenging. Oxidation states are widely used to assess the compositional validity of crystals and guide inorganic materials discovery. While existing generative models for crystals can generate materials with charge-neutral oxidation-state assignments, they poorly reproduce the distributions of oxidation states observed in synthesised materials. To address this limitation, we propose OxiGen, an oxidation-state-aware crystal diffusion model that explicitly represents oxidation states during generation. OxiGen enforces global charge neutrality by construction using a structured output layer with exact inference over a finite-state automaton. Empirically, OxiGen substantially improves oxidation-state fidelity, generates the highest rate of stable, unique, and novel crystals among evaluated methods, and maintains high compositional validity even under property conditioning.
articles.abstract_zh: 生成模型有潜力通过逆向设计加速无机材料的发现，但生成实验上可实现的晶体仍然具有挑战性。氧化态广泛用于评估晶体的成分有效性并指导无机材料的发现。虽然现有的晶体生成模型可以生成具有电荷中性氧化态分配的材料，但它们很难再现在合成材料中观察到的氧化态分布。为了解决这个限制，我们提出了 OxiGen，一种氧化态感知晶体扩散模型，它明确地表示生成过程中的氧化态。 OxiGen 通过使用结构化输出层进行构建来强制实现全局电荷中性，并对有限状态自动机进行精确推理。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 生成模型有潜力通过逆向设计加速无机材料的发现，但生成实验上可实现的晶体仍然具有挑战性。氧化态广泛用于评估晶体的成分有效性并指导无机材料的发现。虽然现有的晶体生成模型可以生成具有电荷中性氧化态分配的材料，但它们很难再现在合成材料中观察到的氧化态分布。为了解决这个限制，我们提出了 OxiGen，一种氧化态感知晶体扩散模型，它明确地表示生成过程中的氧化态。 OxiGen 通过使用结构化输出层进行构建来强制实现全局电荷中性，并对有限状态自动机进行精确推理。根据经验，OxiGen 显着提高了氧化态保真度，在评估的方法中生成最高速率的稳定、独特和新颖的晶体，并且即使在性能调节下也能保持较高的成分有效性。

articles.title: Nematic order in monomer-dimer models of Heilmann and Lieb with lateral attraction in dimensions dge 2
articles.title_zh: Heilmann 和 Lieb 单体二聚体模型中的向列顺序，在维度 dge 2 中具有横向吸引力
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.08600v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study the d-dimensional generalization of Models II (d=2) and V (d=3) for liquid crystals introduced by Heilmann--Lieb (1979), which consists of dimers on the hypercubic lattice at chemical potential μ, interacting via a hard-core repulsion and a lateral attraction between parallel dimers with coupling constant b>0. For din2,3, these models were conjectured to exhibit liquid-crystalline order at low temperatures provided that μ+2(d-1)b>0. We establish nematic order for all dge 2 under the additional condition (4d-6)b>μ, which corresponds to the physical regime in which misaligned dimers are rare on scales comparable to the correlation length of the one-dimensional reference system. While the treatment of orientational order here follows the approach of our recent work on Model I, the proof of the absence of translational order relies on a custom implementation of cluster swapping in the sense of Sheffield (2005). Consequently, we deduce uniqueness of Gibbs measure and anisotropic exponential decay of correlations within each oriented phase.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了 Heilmann--Lieb (1979) 提出的液晶模型 II (d=2) 和 V (d=3) 的 d 维推广，该模型由化学势为 μ 的超立方晶格上的二聚体组成，通过耦合常数 b>0 的平行二聚体之间的硬核排斥和横向吸引力相互作用。对于 din2,3，推测这些模型在低温下表现出液晶有序性，前提是 μ+2(d-1)b>0。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了 Heilmann--Lieb (1979) 提出的液晶模型 II (d=2) 和 V (d=3) 的 d 维推广，该模型由化学势为 μ 的超立方晶格上的二聚体组成，通过耦合常数 b>0 的平行二聚体之间的硬核排斥和横向吸引力相互作用。对于 din2,3，推测这些模型在低温下表现出液晶有序性，前提是 μ+2(d-1)b>0。我们在附加条件 (4d-6)b>μ 下为所有 dge 2 建立了向列序，这对应于在与一维参考系统的相关长度相当的尺度上错位二聚体很少见的物理状态。虽然这里对方向顺序的处理遵循我们最近在模型 I 上的工作方法，但缺乏平移顺序的证明依赖于 Sheffield (2005) 意义上的簇交换的自定义实现。因此，我们推断出吉布斯测度的唯一性和每个定向相内相关性的各向异性指数衰减。

articles.title: Effective Theory of Ultrafast Skyrmion Nucleation
articles.title_zh: 超快斯格明子成核的有效理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2504.11013v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Laser-induced ultrafast skyrmion nucleation has been experimentally demonstrated in several materials. So far, atomistic models have been used to corroborate experimental results. However, such simulations do not provide a simple intuitive understanding of the underlying physics. Here, we propose a coarse-grained effective theory where skyrmions can be nucleated or annihilated by thermal activation over energy barriers. Evaluating these two processes during a heat pulse shows good agreement with atomistic spin dynamics simulations and experiments while drastically reducing computational complexity. Furthermore, the effective theory provides a direct guide for experimentally optimizing the number of nucleated skyrmions. Interestingly, the model also predicts a novel pathway for ultrafast annihilation of skyrmions. Our results pave the way for a deeper understanding of ultrafast nanomagnetism and the role of non-equilibrium physics.
articles.abstract_zh: 激光诱导超快斯格明子成核已在多种材料中得到实验证明。到目前为止，原子模型已被用来证实实验结果。然而，此类模拟并不能提供对底层物理的简单直观的理解。在这里，我们提出了一种粗粒度的有效理论，其中斯格明子可以通过能量势垒上的热激活而成核或湮灭。在热脉冲期间评估这两个过程显示出与原子自旋动力学模拟和实验的良好一致性，同时大大降低了计算复杂性。此外，该有效理论为实验优化有核斯格明子的数量提供了直接指导。有趣的是，该模型还预测了一种超快湮灭斯格明子的新途径。

articles.title: Direct measurement of coherent nodal and antinodal dynamics in underdoped Bi-2212
articles.title_zh: 直接测量欠掺杂 Bi-2212 中的相干节点和反节点动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.18524v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The physics of strongly correlated materials is deeply rooted in electron interactions and their coupling to low-energy excitations. Unraveling the competing and cooperative nature of these interactions is crucial for connecting microscopic mechanisms to the emergence of exotic macroscopic behavior, such as high-temperature superconductivity. Here we show that polarization-resolved multidimensional coherent spectroscopy (MDCS) is able to selectively drive and measure coherent Raman excitations in different parts of the Fermi surface, where the superconducting gap vanishes or is the largest (respectively called Nodal and Antinodal region) in underdoped Bi-2212. Our evidence reveal that in the superconducting phase, the energy of Raman excitations in the nodal region is anti-correlated with the energy of electronic excitations at sim1.6~eV, and both maintain coherence for over 44~fs. In contrast, excitations in the antinodal region show significantly faster decoherence (<18~fs) and no measurable correlations. Importantly, this long-lived coherence is specific to the superconducting phase and vanishes in the pseudogap and normal phases. This anti-correlation reveals a coherent link between the transition energy associated with the many body Cu-O bands and the energy of electronic Raman modes that map to the near-nodal superconducting gap. The different coherent dynamics of the nodal and antinodal excitations in the superconducting phase suggest that nodal fluctuations are protected from dissipation associated with scattering from antiferromagnetic fluctuations and may be relevant to sustaining the quantum coherent behaviour associated with high temperature superconductivity.
articles.abstract_zh: 强相关材料的物理学深深植根于电子相互作用及其与低能激发的耦合。揭示这些相互作用的竞争和合作性质对于将微观机制与高温超导等奇异宏观行为的出现联系起来至关重要。在这里，我们表明，偏振分辨多维相干光谱（MDCS）能够选择性地驱动和测量费米表面不同部分的相干拉曼激发，其中超导间隙消失或在欠掺杂的 Bi-2212 中最大（分别称为节点和反节点区域）。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 强相关材料的物理学深深植根于电子相互作用及其与低能激发的耦合。揭示这些相互作用的竞争和合作性质对于将微观机制与高温超导等奇异宏观行为的出现联系起来至关重要。在这里，我们表明，偏振分辨多维相干光谱（MDCS）能够选择性地驱动和测量费米表面不同部分的相干拉曼激发，其中超导间隙消失或在欠掺杂的 Bi-2212 中最大（分别称为节点和反节点区域）。我们的证据表明，在超导阶段，节点区域拉曼激发的能量与sim1.6~eV处的电子激发的能量反相关，并且两者在超过44~fs的时间内保持相干性。相反，波腹区域的激发显示出明显更快的退相干（<18~fs）并且没有可测量的相关性。重要的是，这种长期相干性是超导相特有的，并且在赝能隙和法向相中消失。这种反相关揭示了与多体 Cu-O 能带相关的跃迁能量和映射到近节点超导间隙的电子拉曼模式的能量之间的连贯联系。超导相中节点和反节点激发的不同相干动力学表明，节点波动受到保护，免受与反铁磁波动散射相关的耗散，并且可能与维持与高温超导相关的量子相干行为有关。

articles.title: Strong-coupling phases of conserved growth models are crumpled
articles.title_zh: 保守增长模型的强耦合阶段被破坏
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.04109v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We show that stochastically driven nonequilibrium conserved growth models admit generic strong coupling phases for sufficiently strong nonlocal chemical potentials underlying the dynamics. The models exhibit generic roughening transitions between perturbatively accessible weak coupling phases satisfying an exact relation between the scaling exponents in all dimensions d, and strong coupling phases. In dimensions at or below the critical dimension d_c, the latter phases are unstable and argued to be crumpled, and thus distinct from the well-known strong coupling rough phase of the Kardar-Parisi-Zhang equation in dimensions d≥ 2. At d_c, conventional spatiotemporal scaling in the weak coupling phase is logarithmically modulated and are exactly obtained.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们表明，随机驱动的非平衡守恒增长模型承认通用的强耦合相，以实现动力学基础上足够强的非局域化学势。该模型表现出可扰动访问的弱耦合阶段之间的通用粗糙化转变，满足所有维度 d 中的缩放指数与强耦合阶段之间的精确关系。在等于或低于临界尺寸 d_c 的尺寸中，后面的相位不稳定并被认为是皱缩的，因此与尺寸 d≥ 2 中众所周知的 Kardar-Parisi-Zhang 方程的强耦合粗糙相位不同。在 d_c 处，弱耦合相位中的传统时空尺度是对数调制的，并且是精确获得的。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们表明，随机驱动的非平衡守恒增长模型承认通用的强耦合相，以实现动力学基础上足够强的非局域化学势。该模型表现出可扰动访问的弱耦合阶段之间的通用粗糙化转变，满足所有维度 d 中的缩放指数与强耦合阶段之间的精确关系。在等于或低于临界尺寸 d_c 的尺寸中，后面的相位不稳定并被认为是皱缩的，因此与尺寸 d≥ 2 中众所周知的 Kardar-Parisi-Zhang 方程的强耦合粗糙相位不同。在 d_c 处，弱耦合相位中的传统时空尺度是对数调制的，并且是精确获得的。

articles.title: Synthetic areas spread in two-dimensional Superconducting Quantum Interference Filter Arrays
articles.title_zh: 二维超导量子干涉滤波器阵列中分布的合成区域
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.15020v5 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Superconducting Quantum Interference Devices (SQUIDs), formed by incorporating Josephson junctions into loops of superconducting material, are the backbone of many modern quantum sensing systems. It has been demonstrated that, by combining multiple SQUID loops into a two-dimensional (2D) array, it is possible to fabricate ultra-high-performing radio-frequency sensors. However, to function as absolute magnetometers, current-in-use arrays require the area of each SQUID loop in the array to be incommensurate. Doing so forbids the achievement of their full potential of performance, limited only by the standard quantum limit. This is because imposing incommensurability in the areas contrasts with optimised performance in each single SQUID loop. In this work, we report that by selectively inserting bare sections of a superconducting circuit with no Josephson junctions, 2D SQUID arrays can operate as an absolute magnetometer even when no physical area spread is applied. Based on a generalisation of currently available theories, a complete analytical formulation for the one-to-one correspondence between the distribution of these bare loops and what we call a synthetic areas spread is unveiled. This synthetic spread represents the equivalent physical spread of incommensurate SQUID loops that you would use to obtain the absolute Voltage-Magnetic Flux response if no bare loops were in use. Our work opens the way to a broader use of this technology for the fabrication of ultra-high-performance absolute quantum sensors. Our approach is also experimentally verified by fabricating several 2D Superconducting Quantum Interference Filter (SQIF) arrays incorporating bare superconducting loops and by demonstrating that they behave in alignment with what is suggested by our theory.
articles.abstract_zh: 通过将约瑟夫森结结合到超导材料回路中形成的超导量子干涉器件（ SQUID ）是许多现代量子传感系统的支柱。已经证明，通过将多个鱿鱼环组合成二维（ 2D ）阵列，可以制造超高性能的射频传感器。然而，为了充当绝对磁强计，当前使用的阵列要求阵列中每个SQUID环的面积是不相称的。这样做禁止实现其全部性能潜力，仅受标准量子极限的限制。这是因为在每个单个SQUID循环中，区域的不可通用性与优化的性能形成鲜明对比。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 通过将约瑟夫森结结合到超导材料回路中形成的超导量子干涉器件（ SQUID ）是许多现代量子传感系统的支柱。已经证明，通过将多个鱿鱼环组合成二维（ 2D ）阵列，可以制造超高性能的射频传感器。然而，为了充当绝对磁强计，当前使用的阵列要求阵列中每个SQUID环的面积是不相称的。这样做禁止实现其全部性能潜力，仅受标准量子极限的限制。这是因为在每个单个SQUID循环中，区域的不可通用性与优化的性能形成鲜明对比。在这项工作中，我们报告说，通过选择性地插入没有约瑟夫森结的超导电路的裸露部分，即使没有应用物理面积扩展， 2D SQUID阵列也可以作为绝对磁力计运行。基于对当前可用理论的概括，揭示了这些裸环的分布与我们所谓的合成区域扩散之间的一对一对应关系的完整分析公式。此合成扩展表示不相称SQUID环路的等效物理扩展，如果没有使用裸环路，您将使用该物理扩展来获得绝对电压-磁通量响应。我们的工作为更广泛地使用该技术制造超高性能绝对量子传感器开辟了道路。通过制造几个包含裸超导环路的2D超导量子干涉滤波器（ SQIF ）阵列，并通过证明它们的行为与我们的理论所建议的一致，我们的方法也得到了实验验证。

articles.title: Spiral states, first-order transitions and specific heat multipeak phenomenon in J₁-J₂-J₃ Ising model: A Wang-Landau algorithm study
articles.title_zh: 螺旋态、一阶跃迁和比热多峰现象在J -J ₂ -J Ising模型中： Wang-Landau算法研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.18724v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The classical J₁-J₂-J₃ Ising model on the honeycomb lattice is important for understanding frustrated magnetic phenomena in materials such as FePS₃ and Ba₂CoTeO₆, where diverse phases (e.g., striped, zigzag, armchair) and magnetization plateaus have been experimentally observed. To explain the experimental results, previous mean-field studies have explored its thermal phase transitions, identifying armchair phases and striped phases, but their limitations call for more reliable numerical investigations. In this work, we systematically revisit the classical (J₁)--(J₂)--(J₃) Ising model using the Wang--Landau algorithm; in strongly frustrated parameter regimes where the Wang--Landau sampling becomes difficult, we further employ parallel tempering and a two-replica cluster algorithm combined with population annealing. We find that the armchair (AC) phase, previously reported in mean-field and experimental studies, actually coexists with the spiral (SP) phase, with their combined degeneracy reaching 20-fold (4-fold for the AC states and 16-fold for the spiral states). The phase transitions and critical exponents are studied at different interaction values. We observe first-order phase transitions, continuous phase transitions, and even the multipeak phenomenon in frustrated systems. These results clarify the nature of phases and phase transitions in frustrated Ising systems and their exponents, and additionally provide inspiration for experimental efforts to search for the spiral state and the specific-heat multipeak phenomenon.
articles.abstract_zh: 蜂窝晶格上的经典J -J ₂ -J Ising模型对于理解FePS和Ba ₂ CoTeO等材料中的挫折磁现象非常重要，在这些材料中，实验观察到不同的相位（例如，条纹、锯齿形、扶手椅）和磁化平台。为了解释实验结果，之前的平均场研究已经探索了它的热相变，确定了扶手椅相位和条纹相位，但它们的局限性需要更可靠的数值研究。在这项工作中，我们使用Wang-Landau算法系统地重新审视了经典的(J恤) -- (J恤) -- (J恤) Ising模型；
articles.abstract_zh_full: 蜂窝晶格上的经典J -J ₂ -J Ising模型对于理解FePS和Ba ₂ CoTeO等材料中的挫折磁现象非常重要，在这些材料中，实验观察到不同的相位（例如，条纹、锯齿形、扶手椅）和磁化平台。为了解释实验结果，之前的平均场研究已经探索了它的热相变，确定了扶手椅相位和条纹相位，但它们的局限性需要更可靠的数值研究。在这项工作中，我们使用Wang-Landau算法系统地重新审视了经典的(J恤) -- (J恤) -- (J恤) Ising模型；在Wang-Landau采样变得困难的强挫败参数体系中，我们进一步采用并行回火和双复制集群算法结合种群退火。我们发现，先前在平均场和实验研究中报道的扶手椅（ AC ）阶段实际上与螺旋（ SP ）阶段共存，其组合简并性达到20倍（ AC状态为4倍，螺旋状态为16倍）。在不同的相互作用值下研究相变和临界指数。我们观察到一阶相变、连续相变，甚至是受挫系统中的多峰现象。这些结果澄清了受挫的Ising系统及其指数中相位和相变的本质，并为寻找螺旋态和比热多峰现象的实验工作提供了灵感。

articles.title: Demonstration of Robust Chiral Edge Transport in Field-Induced Chern Insulator MnBi2Te4 Devices with Engineered Geometric Defects
articles.title_zh: 具有工程几何缺陷的现场诱导Chern绝缘体MnBi2Te4器件中强大的手性边缘传输演示
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.03927v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Chiral edge states in Chern insulators are theoretically predicted to propagate unidirectionally along the sample boundary with inherent robustness against local perturbations, which manifests as the immunity to impurity-induced backscattering, a key factor for the development of robust, high-performance quantum devices. However, the direct experimental verification of the robustness of chiral edge states remains scarce. Here, we experimentally validate the robustness of the chiral edge states in MnBi2Te4 devices by introducing engineered geometric defects via atomic force microscopy (AFM) nanomachining. Specifically, under a moderate perpendicular magnetic field, the MnBi2Te4 devices exhibit the Chern insulator state, characterized by a quantized Hall plateau and simultaneously vanishing longitudinal resistance. To verify the robustness of this topological state, we modify the device geometry by creating a structural cut that reaches the substrate using AFM nanomachining. Remarkably, the quantization behavior survives this drastic modification. The robust nature of the chiral edge transport is further confirmed by two-terminal, three-terminal, and nonlocal measurements, demonstrating that the edge currents can survive the engineered cut. Our results provide strong evidence for the robustness of chiral edge states against geometric disruption and establish AFM nanomachining as a promising technique for topological quantum devices engineering.
articles.abstract_zh: 理论上预测Chern绝缘体中的手性边缘状态沿样品边界单向传播，具有对局部扰动的固有鲁棒性，这表现为对杂质诱导的后向散射的免疫力，这是开发鲁棒、高性能量子器件的关键因素。然而，手性边缘状态鲁棒性的直接实验验证仍然很少。在这里，我们通过原子力显微镜（ AFM ）纳米加工引入工程几何缺陷，实验验证了MnBi2Te4器件中手性边缘状态的鲁棒性。具体而言，在中等垂直磁场下， MnBi2Te4器件呈现Chern绝缘体状态，其特征在于量化霍尔平台，同时消失纵向电阻。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 理论上预测Chern绝缘体中的手性边缘状态沿样品边界单向传播，具有对局部扰动的固有鲁棒性，这表现为对杂质诱导的后向散射的免疫力，这是开发鲁棒、高性能量子器件的关键因素。然而，手性边缘状态鲁棒性的直接实验验证仍然很少。在这里，我们通过原子力显微镜（ AFM ）纳米加工引入工程几何缺陷，实验验证了MnBi2Te4器件中手性边缘状态的鲁棒性。具体而言，在中等垂直磁场下， MnBi2Te4器件呈现Chern绝缘体状态，其特征在于量化霍尔平台，同时消失纵向电阻。为了验证这种拓扑状态的鲁棒性，我们通过使用AFM纳米加工创建到达基板的结构切口来修改器件几何形状。值得注意的是，量化行为在这种剧烈的修改中幸存下来。两端、三端和非局部测量进一步证实了手性边缘传输的鲁棒性，证明边缘电流可以在工程切割中存活。我们的研究结果为手性边缘状态对几何破坏的鲁棒性提供了强有力的证据，并确立了AFM纳米加工作为拓扑量子器件工程的一种有前途的技术。

articles.title: Edge Currents Shape Condensates in Chiral Active Matter
articles.title_zh: 手性活性物质中的边缘电流形状凝聚物
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.20064v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Chiral active matter, which breaks both parity symmetry and time-reversal symmetry, is ubiquitous in living systems. Here, we introduce a minimal two-dimensional chiral active lattice gas by incorporating stochastic, biased local rotations. At low temperatures, the system coarsens into condensates with chiral orientations and faceted, crystal-like shapes. The interfaces align at characteristic angles with respect to the lattice axes and exhibit edge currents that are persistent, unidirectional, and angle-dependent. To generalise these findings, we propose a continuum theory by adding an active chiral edge current term to Model B, which reveals the essential role of active chiral transport in the interfacial dynamics of phase separation. Edge currents with n-fold symmetry produce condensates whose shapes resemble regular n-sided polygons. In the thin-interface limit, we construct an effective interface potential governing edge currents, from which the steady-state condensate geometry can be obtained, both in the lattice model and the continuum description.
articles.abstract_zh: 手性活性物质在生命系统中无处不在，它打破了奇偶对称性和时间反转对称性。在这里，我们通过结合随机、偏置的局部旋转来引入最小二维手性活性晶格气体。在低温下，系统粗化成具有手性取向和多面晶状形状的冷凝物。界面相对于晶格轴以特征角度对齐，并表现出持久、单向和角度相关的边缘电流。为了推广这些发现，我们提出了一个连续统理论，在模型B中添加了一个主动手性边缘电流项，揭示了主动手性转运在相分离界面动力学中的重要作用。具有n折对称性的边缘电流产生形状类似于规则n边多边形的凝聚体。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 手性活性物质在生命系统中无处不在，它打破了奇偶对称性和时间反转对称性。在这里，我们通过结合随机、偏置的局部旋转来引入最小二维手性活性晶格气体。在低温下，系统粗化成具有手性取向和多面晶状形状的冷凝物。界面相对于晶格轴以特征角度对齐，并表现出持久、单向和角度相关的边缘电流。为了推广这些发现，我们提出了一个连续统理论，在模型B中添加了一个主动手性边缘电流项，揭示了主动手性转运在相分离界面动力学中的重要作用。具有n折对称性的边缘电流产生形状类似于规则n边多边形的凝聚体。在薄界面极限中，我们构建了一个有效的界面势控制边缘电流，从中可以获得稳态凝聚态几何形状，无论是在晶格模型还是连续体描述中。

articles.title: The flow of local quantum fluids: Conservation laws and vertex corrections from many-body linear-response theory with local self-energy
articles.title_zh: 局部量子流体的流动：具有局部自能量的多体线性响应理论的守恒定律和顶点校正
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.02625v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In non-diffusive conduction regimes of strongly correlated quantum electron systems, electromagnetic perturbations simultaneously probe the electronic dynamics in time and space: the exchanged energy hbar ω excites retarded, i.e., frequency-dependent, many-body interactions, while the probing spatial modulation renders the response spatially nonlocal, i.e., dependent on the external wave vector vecq. This work derives the nonlocal electrodynamic response of such dynamical quantum fluids assuming local but frequency-dependent self-energies and particle-hole irreducible two-particle vertex functions, and preserving charge/mass conservation. The latter is ensured by Bethe-Salpeter equations for renormalized interaction vertices, entering the Kubo formalism for two-particle correlation functions (e.g., for density, currents, momentum, stress). Within such a framework, exact symmetry criteria for the absence of vertex corrections are inferred. In particular, vertex corrections vanish at q=0 for single-particle dispersions that are even and bare interaction vertices that are odd with respect to specific momentum-space point group transformations, including inversion for vector vertices, and mirror reflections or two- or higher-fold rotations for tensor vertices. If the dispersion is isotropic, vertex corrections vanish from the transverse part (perpvecq) of vectorial vertices (such as for electric/particle current) at any finite hbar ω and vecq. These cancellations extend to the full current-current correlation function for quadratic isotropic dispersion. Further symmetry breaking, multiband effects, and the additional imposition of momentum conservation, are discussed, with application to the Hall viscosity of Landau levels. Explicit expressions for generic nonlocal correlation functions are derived for Fermi liquids and non-Fermi liquids.
articles.abstract_zh: 在强相关量子电子系统的非扩散传导机制中，电磁扰动同时探测时间和空间的电子动力学：交换能量hbar ω激发延迟，即频率相关的多体相互作用，而探测空间调制使响应在空间上非局部，即依赖于外部波矢量向量。这项工作得出了这种动态量子流体的非局部电动力响应，假设局部但频率依赖的自能和粒子孔不可约双粒子顶点函数，并保持电荷/质量守恒。后者通过重新归一化相互作用顶点的Bethe-Salpeter方程得到保证，进入两粒子相关函数（例如，密度、电流、动量、应力）的Kubo形式。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在强相关量子电子系统的非扩散传导机制中，电磁扰动同时探测时间和空间的电子动力学：交换能量hbar ω激发延迟，即频率相关的多体相互作用，而探测空间调制使响应在空间上非局部，即依赖于外部波矢量向量。这项工作得出了这种动态量子流体的非局部电动力响应，假设局部但频率依赖的自能和粒子孔不可约双粒子顶点函数，并保持电荷/质量守恒。后者通过重新归一化相互作用顶点的Bethe-Salpeter方程得到保证，进入两粒子相关函数（例如，密度、电流、动量、应力）的Kubo形式。在这样的框架内，可以推断出缺少顶点校正的确切对称标准。特别是，对于相对于特定动量空间点组变换为奇数的偶数和裸交互顶点的单粒子色散，顶点校正在q = 0时消失，包括矢量顶点的反演，以及张量顶点的镜像反射或两倍或更高倍数的旋转。如果色散是各向同性的，则在任何有限hbar ω和vecq处，顶点校正从矢量顶点（例如电流/粒子电流）的横向部分（ perpvecq ）消失。这些抵消扩展到二次各向同性色散的全电流-电流相关函数。讨论了进一步的对称断裂、多带效应和额外的动量守恒，并将其应用于Landau水平的霍尔粘度。对于费米液体和非费米液体，导出了通用非局部相关函数的显式表达式。

articles.title: Nonlinear Schrodinger Equations for Dense Bose Fluid and He4 Film at Low Temperatures
articles.title_zh: 低温下致密Bose流体和He4薄膜的非线性薛定谔方程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.30704v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We have derived the nonlinear Schrodinger equation generalizing the Gross-Pitaevskii (GP) equa tion for dilute Bose gas. The derivation is based on the Hartree-Fock time-dependent mean-field theory with an arbitrary intermolecular interaction potential. It is shown that obtained nonlinear Schrodinger equation with appropriate redefinition of coefficients can be used for description of dense Bose fluid at low temperatures. We also present the Schrodinger type equation describing the superfluid component of helium in two fluid hydrodynamics. This approach leads to quantum correction for superfluid component of velocity in two fluid hydrodynamics. We also have derived the nonlinear Schrodinger equation for superfluid He4 film at low temperatures. It is shown that this Schrodinger type equation for superfluid He4 film leads to phonon-roton dispersion relation for elementary excitation at low temperatures.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们推导了非线性薛定谔方程，推广了稀释玻色气体的Gross-Pitaevskii (GP)方程。该推导基于具有任意分子间相互作用势的Hartree-Fock时间依赖平均场理论。结果表明，获得的非线性薛定谔方程和适当的系数重新定义可用于描述低温下的致密Bose流体。我们还提出了描述两种流体流体动力学中氦的超流体成分的薛定谔型方程。这种方法导致了两种流体流体动力学中速度的超流体成分的量子校正。我们还推导了低温下超流体He4薄膜的非线性薛定谔方程。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们推导了非线性薛定谔方程，推广了稀释玻色气体的Gross-Pitaevskii (GP)方程。该推导基于具有任意分子间相互作用势的Hartree-Fock时间依赖平均场理论。结果表明，获得的非线性薛定谔方程和适当的系数重新定义可用于描述低温下的致密Bose流体。我们还提出了描述两种流体流体动力学中氦的超流体成分的薛定谔型方程。这种方法导致了两种流体流体动力学中速度的超流体成分的量子校正。我们还推导了低温下超流体He4薄膜的非线性薛定谔方程。结果表明，超流体 He4 薄膜的薛定谔型方程可以导出低温下基本激发的声子-转子色散关系。

articles.title: Aharonov-Casher Chern bands for ultracold dark state atoms
articles.title_zh: 超冷暗态原子的Aharonov-Casher Chern波段
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.00207v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We consider the Aharonov-Casher (AC) condition for ultracold atoms adiabatically following the dark-state in a Λ-type atom-light coupling scheme. The AC condition establishes a relation between the geometric scalar potential and the synthetic magnetic field, resulting in a fully degenerate lowest Landau-level-like band in the adiabatic limit even if the magnetic field is inhomogeneous but has a proper sign. We derive a general requirement for the atom-light coupling under which the AC condition applies. The requirement holds if the Rabi frequencies of the Λ scheme are superpositions of plane waves with the appropriate amplitudes and phases. In particular, the Rabi frequencies made of N=3,,4,,6 fine tuned plane waves yield a smooth background magnetic field of definite sign, as well as an array of non-measurable Aharonov-Bohm flux singularities. Departing from the fine tuning, the latter singularities turn into narrow subwavelength patches of the magnetic field with an opposite sign, which broaden the lowest energy band. The lowest band is also broadened for the fine tuned situation due to deviation from the adiabatic approach because of the finite atom-light coupling strength. It is shown that a proper combination of the two imperfections (departure from fine tuning and finite atom-light coupling strength) can lead to a significant reduction of the width of the lowest band, which can be made almost completely flat and furthermore becomes characterized by a nearly perfect geometry needed for simulating the fractional Hall states.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们考虑了超冷原子的Aharonov-Casher （ AC ）条件，该条件遵循Ω型原子-光耦合方案中的暗态。交流条件建立了几何标量电位与合成磁场之间的关系，即使磁场不均匀但具有适当的符号，也会导致绝热极限中完全退化的最低朗道水平带。我们得出了适用交流条件的原子光耦合的一般要求。如果Ω方案的Rabi频率是具有适当振幅和相位的平面波的叠加，则该要求成立。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们考虑了超冷原子的Aharonov-Casher （ AC ）条件，该条件遵循Ω型原子-光耦合方案中的暗态。交流条件建立了几何标量电位与合成磁场之间的关系，即使磁场不均匀但具有适当的符号，也会导致绝热极限中完全退化的最低朗道水平带。我们得出了适用交流条件的原子光耦合的一般要求。如果Ω方案的Rabi频率是具有适当振幅和相位的平面波的叠加，则该要求成立。特别是，由N = 3, ,4, ,6微调平面波组成的Rabi频率产生了具有确定符号的平滑背景磁场，以及一系列不可测量的Aharonov-Bohm通量奇点。从微调开始，后者的奇点变成磁场的窄亚波长斑块，具有相反的符号，从而加宽了最低能带。由于有限的原子-光耦合强度，由于偏离绝热方法，在微调的情况下，最低频带也被加宽。研究表明，两个缺陷的适当组合（偏离微调和有限的原子-光耦合强度）可以导致最低频带宽度的显着减少，这可以几乎完全平坦，并且进一步以模拟分数霍尔态所需的近乎完美的几何形状为特征。

articles.title: Altermagnetism in MnF₂: Band Splitting and Its Physical Consequences
articles.title_zh: MnF ₂中的Altermagnetism ：能带分裂及其物理后果
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.01515v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: MnF₂ is widely regarded as a candidate altermagnet, but the magnitude and implications of its altermagnetic band splitting remain debated. Using electronic-structure calculations, we construct minimal models that capture the magnetic and electronic properties of MnF₂. These models show that the parameters governing the chiral magnon splitting and the spin splitting of the electronic bands are relatively small. Moreover, the electronic system lies in the strong-coupling regime, where most magnetic properties are controlled by the ratio t/U between the characteristic hopping amplitude t and the large on-site Coulomb repulsion U. Consequently, all exchange interactions scale as 1/U, so a small altermagnetic hopping δ t produces only a proportionally small exchange term. Upon doping, the altermagnetic contribution to the anomalous Hall effect is likewise suppressed, being smaller than the conventional (non-altermagnetic) contribution by a factor of order δ t/U. In contrast, the behavior of the conductivity tensor hatσ(ω) at hbar ω sim U differs qualitatively, because δ t enters the energies of interband optical transitions emphdirectly rather than through the reduced ratio δ t/U. This contribution strongly reshapes hatσ(ω), leading to a dramatic enhancement of the magneto-optical response.
articles.abstract_zh: MnF ₂被广泛认为是一种候选变磁体，但其变磁带分裂的幅度和影响仍然存在争议。使用电子结构计算，我们构建了捕获MnF ₂的磁性和电子特性的最小模型。这些模型表明，控制手性磁子分裂和电子带自旋分裂的参数相对较小。此外，电子系统处于强耦合状态，其中大多数磁性特性由特征跳变幅度t与大现场库仑排斥U之间的比率t/U控制。因此，所有交换相互作用均缩放为1/U ，因此小的变磁跳变δ t仅产生比例小的交换项。
articles.abstract_zh_full: MnF ₂被广泛认为是一种候选变磁体，但其变磁带分裂的幅度和影响仍然存在争议。使用电子结构计算，我们构建了捕获MnF ₂的磁性和电子特性的最小模型。这些模型表明，控制手性磁子分裂和电子带自旋分裂的参数相对较小。此外，电子系统处于强耦合状态，其中大多数磁性特性由特征跳变幅度t与大现场库仑排斥U之间的比率t/U控制。因此，所有交换相互作用均缩放为1/U ，因此小的变磁跳变δ t仅产生比例小的交换项。掺杂后，对异常霍尔效应的改变磁性贡献同样被抑制，比常规（非改变磁性）贡献小δ t/U的因子。相反， hbar ω sim U处的电导率张量hatσ （ ω ）的行为在定性上有所不同，因为δ t直接进入带间光跃迁的能量，而不是通过降低的比率δ t/U。这种贡献强烈地重塑了hatσ (ω) ，导致磁光响应的显着增强。

articles.title: An Extensible Agentic Framework for Expert-Level Automation of Atomistic Simulations
articles.title_zh: 用于原子模拟专家级自动化的可扩展Agentic框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.09422v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Traditionally, atomistic simulation has been constrained by the computational scaling limits of ab initio methods and the parameterization overhead of empirical force fields. The recent emergence of universal machine learning interatomic potentials has significantly mitigated these bottlenecks, offering near-quantum accuracy and generalizability across diverse chemical spaces at a fraction of the computational cost. However, this shift has relocated the bottleneck to the human dimension: time-consuming mechanical processes, such as input preparation and data analysis, now dominate the research lifecycle. We introduce Paimon, a Platform for Agentic Integration in Materials Optimization and Nanoscale-simulations. Through hundreds of trials on an expert-level liquid electrolyte simulation, we show that Paimon substantially improves the reliability of agentic workflows by suppressing silent errors: plausible yet physically incorrect results. Paimon accommodates a new capability without modifying the agents already present, which we demonstrate by integrating an externally developed scientific agent. As an agent harness for atomistic simulations, Paimon affords researchers a continuous, science-centric workflow throughout the entire simulation lifecycle.
articles.abstract_zh: 传统上，原子模拟一直受到从头方法的计算缩放限制和经验力场的参数化开销的限制。最近出现的通用机器学习原子间电位显著减轻了这些瓶颈，以很小的计算成本在不同的化学空间提供近量子精度和可推广性。然而，这种转变将瓶颈转移到了人类层面：投入准备和数据分析等耗时的机械过程现在占据了研究生命周期的主导地位。我们介绍了Paimon ，这是一个用于材料优化和纳米级模拟的代理集成的平台。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 传统上，原子模拟一直受到从头方法的计算缩放限制和经验力场的参数化开销的限制。最近出现的通用机器学习原子间电位显著减轻了这些瓶颈，以很小的计算成本在不同的化学空间提供近量子精度和可推广性。然而，这种转变将瓶颈转移到了人类层面：投入准备和数据分析等耗时的机械过程现在占据了研究生命周期的主导地位。我们介绍了Paimon ，这是一个用于材料优化和纳米级模拟的代理集成的平台。通过对专家级液体电解质模拟的数百次试验，我们表明Paimon通过抑制无声错误（合理但物理上不正确的结果）大大提高了代理工作流程的可靠性。Paimon在不修改现有药剂的情况下适应了一种新功能，我们通过整合外部开发的科学药剂来证明这一点。作为原子模拟的代理工具， Paimon在整个模拟生命周期中为研究人员提供了以科学为中心的连续工作流程。

articles.title: Symmetry Rules for Cavity Materials Engineering with Linearly Polarized Vacuum Fields
articles.title_zh: 具有线性极化真空场的腔体材料工程的对称性规则
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28745v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Cavity materials engineering, aiming to manipulate material properties by coupling to vacuum fluctuations inside a cavity, is a rapidly advancing field. Despite significant progress, most studies to date have focused on specific materials and cavity configurations. Here, through a comprehensive group-theoretical analysis, we establish general symmetry rules for cavity materials engineering with linearly polarized cavity photon modes. By analyzing the symmetry of the Pauli-Fierz Hamiltonian within the long-wavelength approximation, we provide a classification of the symmetry-breaking patterns induced by cavity modes for all crystallographic point groups. The power of this framework is then demonstrated by quantum-electrodynamical density functional theory calculations. In particular, we explain the distinct cavity-induced lifting of band degeneracies in cubic BaTiO₃ for different cavity mode configurations, and the cavity-modified infrared and Raman spectra of monolayer MoS₂ due to symmetry breaking. Our results highlight the central role of symmetry in cavity materials engineering and provide general guidelines for future studies in this field.
articles.abstract_zh: 空腔材料工程旨在通过与空腔内的真空波动耦合来操纵材料特性，是一个快速发展的领域。尽管取得了重大进展，但迄今为止的大多数研究都集中在特定的材料和腔体配置上。本文通过综合群论分析，建立了线偏振腔光子模态腔体材料工程的一般对称规律。通过分析Pauli-Fierz Hamiltonian在长波长近似中的对称性，我们为所有晶体点群提供了由空腔模式引起的对称性破坏模式的分类。然后通过量子电动力密度泛函理论计算证明了这个框架的力量。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 空腔材料工程旨在通过与空腔内的真空波动耦合来操纵材料特性，是一个快速发展的领域。尽管取得了重大进展，但迄今为止的大多数研究都集中在特定的材料和腔体配置上。本文通过综合群论分析，建立了线偏振腔光子模态腔体材料工程的一般对称规律。通过分析Pauli-Fierz Hamiltonian在长波长近似中的对称性，我们为所有晶体点群提供了由空腔模式引起的对称性破坏模式的分类。然后通过量子电动力密度泛函理论计算证明了这个框架的力量。特别地，我们解释了不同腔模配置下立方BaTiO *中不同腔诱导的带退化提升，以及由于对称断裂导致的单层MoS ₂的腔修饰红外光谱和拉曼光谱。我们的结果突出了对称性在腔体材料工程中的核心作用，并为该领域的未来研究提供了一般指导。

articles.title: Reentrance and temperature chaos in the p-spin Ising spin glass
articles.title_zh: P-自旋Ising自旋玻璃的再入和温度混沌
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23904v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Reentrant transitions and temperature chaos are two unusual properties of spin glasses. We recently established a general logical relation between these two phenomena [Phys. Rev. E 112, 044140 (2025)]. In the present paper, we provide an explicit example of this logical relation in the fully connected Ising p-spin glass with a ferromagnetic bias. By expanding the free energy around the triple point, we show analytically that the ferromagnetic--spin glass boundary is reentrant in the vicinity of the triple point throughout the examined range of finite p>2. It then follows from the above logical relation that there exists at least one pair of distinct temperatures in the spin glass phase for which the overlap of spin configurations vanishes. This is a necessary condition for temperature chaos, but it would be quite unusual for the overlap to vanish only for selected temperature pairs but not for others within a single spin glass phase. These results therefore strongly suggest the existence of temperature chaos in the sense that the overlaps of spin configurations vanish for all temperature pairs throughout the spin glass phase. Independent evidence for this behavior is provided by a two-temperature replica calculation.
articles.abstract_zh: 重入跃迁和温度混沌是自旋玻璃的两个不寻常的特性。我们最近在这两种现象之间建立了一般逻辑关系[Phys。修订版 E 112, 044140 (2025)]。在本文中，我们提供了具有铁磁偏置的全连接伊辛 p-自旋玻璃中这种逻辑关系的明确示例。通过扩展三相点周围的自由能，我们分析表明，在整个有限 p>2 的检查范围内，铁磁-自旋玻璃边界在三相点附近是可重入的。由上述逻辑关系可知，自旋玻璃相中存在至少一对不同的温度，在该温度下自旋构型的重叠消失。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 重入跃迁和温度混沌是自旋玻璃的两个不寻常的特性。我们最近在这两种现象之间建立了一般逻辑关系[Phys。修订版 E 112, 044140 (2025)]。在本文中，我们提供了具有铁磁偏置的全连接伊辛 p-自旋玻璃中这种逻辑关系的明确示例。通过扩展三相点周围的自由能，我们分析表明，在整个有限 p>2 的检查范围内，铁磁-自旋玻璃边界在三相点附近是可重入的。由上述逻辑关系可知，自旋玻璃相中存在至少一对不同的温度，在该温度下自旋构型的重叠消失。这是温度混沌的必要条件，但是重叠仅对于选定的温度对消失而对于单个自旋玻璃相内的其他温度对消失是很不寻常的。因此，这些结果强烈表明温度混沌的存在，即整个自旋玻璃相中所有温度对的自旋构型重叠都消失了。这种行为的独立证据是由两个温度复制计算提供的。

articles.title: Anderson localization in periodic elastic systems with random perturbations
articles.title_zh: 具有随机扰动的周期性弹性系统中的安德森定位
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.14410v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: This paper investigates Anderson localization in subwavelength elastic periodic systems with random perturbations. For the unperturbed system, we use layer potential techniques to reformulate the eigenvalue problem as boundary integral equations, and derive asymptotic formulas for the subwavelength eigenvalues. For perturbed systems, we apply the Floquet transform to obtain a periodic formulation and derive equations determining the resonant frequencies under general perturbations. Numerical experiments for perturbed periodic monomers and dimers agree with the theoretical predictions. We further demonstrate Anderson localization by increasing the strength and number of random perturbations. These results provide a mathematical foundation for understanding subwavelength localization in elastic metamaterials.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了具有随机扰动的亚波长弹性周期系统中的安德森定域性。对于无扰动系统，我们使用层势技术将特征值问题重新表述为边界积分方程，并推导出亚波长特征值的渐近公式。对于扰动系统，我们应用 Floquet 变换来获得周期公式并导出确定一般扰动下谐振频率的方程。扰动周期性单体和二聚体的数值实验与理论预测一致。我们通过增加随机扰动的强度和数量进一步证明安德森定位。这些结果为理解弹性超材料中的亚波长局域化提供了数学基础。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文研究了具有随机扰动的亚波长弹性周期系统中的安德森定域性。对于无扰动系统，我们使用层势技术将特征值问题重新表述为边界积分方程，并推导出亚波长特征值的渐近公式。对于扰动系统，我们应用 Floquet 变换来获得周期公式并导出确定一般扰动下谐振频率的方程。扰动周期性单体和二聚体的数值实验与理论预测一致。我们通过增加随机扰动的强度和数量进一步证明安德森定位。这些结果为理解弹性超材料中的亚波长局域化提供了数学基础。

articles.title: A General Framework for Gradient-Based Optimization of Superconducting Quantum Circuits using Qubit Discovery as a Case Study
articles.title_zh: 以量子位发现为案例研究的基于梯度的超导量子电路优化通用框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2408.12704v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Engineering the Hamiltonian of a quantum system is fundamental to the design of quantum systems. Automating Hamiltonian design through gradient-based optimization can dramatically accelerate this process. However, computing the gradients of eigenvalues and eigenvectors of a Hamiltonian--a large, sparse matrix--relative to system properties poses a significant challenge, especially for arbitrary systems. Superconducting quantum circuits offer substantial flexibility in Hamiltonian design, making them an ideal platform for this task. In this work, we present a comprehensive framework for the gradient-based optimization of superconducting quantum circuits, leveraging the SQcircuit software package. By addressing the challenge of calculating the gradient of the eigensystem for large, sparse Hamiltonians and integrating automatic differentiation within SQcircuit, our framework enables efficient and precise computation of gradients for various circuit properties or custom-defined metrics, streamlining the optimization process. We apply this framework to the qubit discovery problem, demonstrating its effectiveness in identifying qubit designs with superior performance metrics. The optimized circuits show improvements in a heuristic measure of gate count, upper bounds on gate speed, decoherence time, and resilience to noise and fabrication errors compared to existing qubits. While this methodology is showcased through qubit optimization and discovery, it is versatile and can be extended to tackle other optimization challenges in superconducting quantum hardware design.
articles.abstract_zh: 设计量子系统的哈密顿量是量子系统设计的基础。通过基于梯度的优化自动化哈密顿设计可以极大地加速这一过程。然而，计算哈密顿量（一个大型稀疏矩阵）的特征值和特征向量相对于系统属性的梯度提出了重大挑战，特别是对于任意系统。超导量子电路为哈密顿设计提供了极大的灵活性，使其成为执行此任务的理想平台。在这项工作中，我们利用 SQCircuit 软件包，提出了一个基于梯度的超导量子电路优化的综合框架。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 设计量子系统的哈密顿量是量子系统设计的基础。通过基于梯度的优化自动化哈密顿设计可以极大地加速这一过程。然而，计算哈密顿量（一个大型稀疏矩阵）的特征值和特征向量相对于系统属性的梯度提出了重大挑战，特别是对于任意系统。超导量子电路为哈密顿设计提供了极大的灵活性，使其成为执行此任务的理想平台。在这项工作中，我们利用 SQCircuit 软件包，提出了一个基于梯度的超导量子电路优化的综合框架。通过解决计算大型稀疏哈密顿量特征系统梯度的挑战，并将自动微分集成到 SQCircuit 中，我们的框架能够高效、精确地计算各种电路属性或自定义指标的梯度，从而简化优化过程。我们将该框架应用于量子位发现问题，证明其在识别具有卓越性能指标的量子位设计方面的有效性。与现有量子位相比，经过优化的电路在门数启发式测量、门速度上限、退相干时间以及抗噪声和制造错误方面都有所改进。虽然这种方法是通过量子位优化和发现来展示的，但它具有多种用途，并且可以扩展以解决超导量子硬件设计中的其他优化挑战。

articles.title: Plasmonic Metasurfaces for Magnetic Skyrmion Control via the Inverse Faraday Effect
articles.title_zh: 通过反法拉第效应控制磁性斯格明子的等离激元超表面
articles.abstract: arXiv:2503.23800v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Magnetic skyrmions hold immense promise for low-power spintronic memory, logic devices, and neuromorphic computing. However, existing optical and electrical manipulation schemes rely predominantly on local thermal excitation, rendering skyrmion nucleation inherently stochastic and lacking a non-destructive mechanism for targeted, on-demand erasure. Here, we demonstrate a deterministic, field-driven paradigm for the ultrafast, all-optical writing and erasing of magnetic skyrmion crystals using a magneto-plasmonic metasurface. By tailoring surface lattice resonances in a periodic nanodisk array, circularly polarized light excites giant super-circular optical spin densities that drive intense circulating drift photocurrents via the inverse Faraday effect, delivering synchronized picosecond magnetic field pulses directly to an adjacent chiral magnetic multilayer. Micromagnetic simulations reveal that a single optical pulse deterministically nucleates stable Neel skyrmions through a transient Bloch to Neel relaxation pathway governed by optical helicity and interfacial Dzyaloshinskii Moriya interaction. Crucially, reversing the incident light helicity allows on-demand reconfiguration of the topological state under a confining bias field, the inverted optomagnetic field unwinds pre-existing skyrmions to restore the uniform ground state, whereas at zero field it deterministically transforms an expanded skyrmion into a stable skyrmionium. By bypassing stochastic thermal cycles and achieving fully reversible topological control on picosecond timescales, this work bridges nanophotonics and magnetism, establishing a scalable foundation for high-speed, reconfigurable topological data storage and unconventional computing architectures.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁性斯格明子对于低功耗自旋电子存储器、逻辑器件和神经形态计算具有巨大的前景。然而，现有的光学和电操纵方案主要依赖于局部热激发，使得斯格明子成核本质上是随机的，并且缺乏用于有针对性的、按需擦除的非破坏性机制。在这里，我们展示了一种确定性的、场驱动的范例，用于使用磁等离子体超表面对磁性斯格明子晶体进行超快、全光写入和擦除。
authors: Tristan da Câmara Santa Clara Gomes
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁性斯格明子对于低功耗自旋电子存储器、逻辑器件和神经形态计算具有巨大的前景。然而，现有的光学和电操纵方案主要依赖于局部热激发，使得斯格明子成核本质上是随机的，并且缺乏用于有针对性的、按需擦除的非破坏性机制。在这里，我们展示了一种确定性的、场驱动的范例，用于使用磁等离子体超表面对磁性斯格明子晶体进行超快、全光写入和擦除。通过在周期性纳米盘阵列中定制表面晶格共振，圆偏振光激发巨大的超圆光学自旋密度，通过反法拉第效应驱动强烈的循环漂移光电流，将同步的皮秒磁场脉冲直接传递到相邻的手性磁性多层。微磁模拟表明，单个光脉冲通过由光学螺旋性和界面 Dzyaloshinskii Moriya 相互作用控制的瞬态布洛赫到尼尔弛豫路径，确定性地使稳定的尼尔斯格明子成核。至关重要的是，反转入射光螺旋性允许在限制偏置场下按需重新配置拓扑状态，反转光磁场使预先存在的斯格明子展开以恢复均匀基态，而在零场时，它确定性地将扩展的斯格明子转变为稳定的斯格明子。通过绕过随机热循环并在皮秒时间尺度上实现完全可逆的拓扑控制，这项工作将纳米光子学和磁性联系起来，为高速、可重新配置的拓扑数据存储和非常规计算架构奠定了可扩展的基础。

articles.title: Quantum Walks on Arbitrary Spatial Networks with Rydberg Atoms
articles.title_zh: 量子在里德伯原子的任意空间网络上行走
articles.abstract: arXiv:2507.21011v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Rydberg atoms provide a highly promising platform for quantum computation, leveraging their strong tunable interactions to encode and manipulate information in the electronic states of individual atoms. Key advantages of Rydberg atoms include scalability, reconfigurable connectivity, and native multi-qubit gates, making them particularly well-suited for addressing complex network problems. These problems can often be framed as graph-based tasks, which can be efficiently addressed using quantum walks. In this work, we propose a general implementation of staggered quantum walks with Rydberg atoms, with a particular focus on spatial networks. We also present an efficient algorithm for constructing the tessellations required for the staggered quantum walk. Finally, we demonstrate that our proposal achieves performance consistent with a quadratic speedup in spatial search algorithms.
articles.abstract_zh: 里德伯原子为量子计算提供了一个非常有前途的平台，利用它们强大的可调相互作用来编码和操纵单个原子电子态的信息。里德伯原子的主要优势包括可扩展性、可重新配置连接性和本机多量子位门，使它们特别适合解决复杂的网络问题。这些问题通常可以被构建为基于图的任务，可以使用量子行走来有效解决。在这项工作中，我们提出了用里德伯原子交错量子行走的一般实现，特别关注空间网络。我们还提出了一种有效的算法来构建交错量子行走所需的镶嵌。最后，我们证明我们的建议实现了与空间搜索算法的二次加速一致的性能。
