Track A measures single-cell entropy across division history and donor age, tests the division-rate–entropy coupling, and selects or induces low-entropy cells. Track R reverse-engineers the natural reproductive entropy partition: somatic-to-germline induction (PGCLC), induced meiosis, blockade of meiotic recombination for isogenicity, haploid stabilisation, gamete fusion, zygotic genome activation, and totipotency induction. Track C safely eliminates the centriole while preserving diploidy, inducing totipotency and direct differentiation without an embryo. Track T1 rejuvenates resident HSCs in situ by senolytic niche clearance and niche-signal restoration. The tracks share six identical procedures (totipotency induction, single-cell entropy verification, differentiation-inductor delivery, de-novo centriole biogenesis, genome-integrity gating, niche engraftment), which consolidate the experimental programme into a single coordinated pipeline.  Hypotheses. Eleven falsifiable hypotheses (H1–H5 with sub-hypotheses H4b–H4g) are pre-registered with explicit falsification criteria; automation (H6) is an engineering acceptance criterion rather than a biological hypothesis and is excluded from the hypothesis count and from multiple-comparison control; genome integrity and tumorigenicity are co-primary safety gates for every track.  Conclusions. A systematic search of the literature returns no direct test of entropy-selected autologous niche replacement, which we propose as the central, addressable gap. Each node is expressed as a measurable operation with a defined failure condition, negative results surface at the node where evidence is missing, and the programme is therefore suited to staged, high-risk/high-reward evaluation.

articles.title: Monetary Policy, Exchange Rate Shocks, and Asset Prices in a Small Open Frontier Economy: A Restricted-Sample, Multi-Horizon Distributional Analysis
articles.abstract: We examine how monetary policy shocks transmit to equity returns in Ghana, a frontier economy with a shallow, thinly traded exchange. A central methodological contribution of this paper is a restricted-sample design. We use only Ghana Stock Exchange Composite Index (GSE-CI) and Financial Stock Index (GSE-FSI) observations built from directly reported, independently verified index levels, rather than levels reconstructed by interpolation. This excludes 48 of 132 GSE-FSI months (January 2014 to December 2017) that would otherwise be deterministic by construction. GSE-CI analysis uses the full January 2014 to December 2024 window (N = 131 monthly returns). GSE-FSI analysis is restricted to February 2018 through December 2024 (N = 83 monthly returns, since the first return in the verified window still depends on an interpolated base level and is also dropped). Within this design we apply Zivot-Andrews structural-break unit root tests, Toda-Yamamoto augmented-VAR causality with Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate control, Bayesian quantile regression with an embedded spike-and-slab variable selection prior, structural VAR impulse responses and variance decomposition under a corrected recursive ordering, and continuous Morlet wavelet coherence benchmarked against Monte Carlo red-noise significance. The results tell a modest story. Policy rate shocks show no causal relationship with either index that survives multiple-testing correction, and account for 0.5 to 3.1 percent of twelve-month-ahead GSE-CI forecast error variance and 0.7 to 7.4 percent of GSE-FSI forecast error variance. Money supply growth is the one macro-financial variable with a causal link to GSE-CI that survives false discovery rate control. Oil price shocks carry meaningful posterior support for GSE-CI at upper (bullish) quantiles. Treasury bill rate changes carry posterior support for GSE-FSI at the tenth percentile, though this estimate rests on roughly eight effective observations and should be read as suggestive rather than conclusive. Wavelet coherence between policy shocks and equity returns rises with horizon in raw terms, but once benchmarked against an autoregressive red-noise null, only a small and non-monotonic share of that coherence is statistically distinguishable from noise, which weakens rather than supports a horizon-dependence claim. Taken together, these results indicate that Ghana’s equity market is loosely and unevenly coupled to the domestic policy rate, with global commodity prices and short-term funding costs playing a larger, more state-dependent role, and that claims about monetary transmission in thin frontier markets need index-construction and multiple-testing safeguards that are not always applied in this literature. JEL Classification Codes: E52; G10; G12; G15; C11; C32; O16; O55

articles.title: Diesel battery dispatch within a published fuel curve domain
articles.abstract: This computational study evaluates battery-assisted diesel dispatch while keeping every modeled generator-on operating point inside a published fuel table. A one-household load series is averaged hourly, restricted to complete observations and multiplied by 100 to create an explicitly synthetic power-scale benchmark. Four deterministic complete weeks, one from each quarter of 2007, provide 672 evaluated hours. Mechanical fuel-table points are mapped to electrical output using declared auxiliary and alternator assumptions. A mixed-integer model represents the nonconvex piecewise-linear fuel curve, generator starts, mutually exclusive battery charging and discharging, and cyclic state of charge. Batteries of 250, 500 and 1000 usable kWh are compared with a generator-only baseline that dissipates surplus power in a load bank to remain inside the same curve domain. Aggregate feasible-schedule fuel reductions are 55.8%, 60.5% and 61.7% respectively. Solver gaps are reported rather than interpreting every time-limited incumbent as an exact optimum. The results are conditional on the supplemental-load baseline, perfect hourly foresight and simplified conversion model; they do not establish field savings, economic payback or feasible transient control.

articles.title: A Hybrid-Asymmetrical Double-Slit Interference Experiment in the Near-Field Transition Pre-Fraunhofer Condition
articles.abstract: The paper presents the results of a quantum interference study using an asymmetrical double-slit experiment with a low-intensity laser beam, conducted in the single-photon approximation and the Fresnel near-field transition pre-Fraunhofer condition. In addition to the temporal separation achieved by recording each particle individually, the hybrid-asymmetrical double-slit design (in both width and height) also allows spatial separation of the first satellite diffraction bands created by each slit, thereby minimising the mixing background effects from the opposite slit. Isolating the satellite bands of a diffraction pattern from one of the two slits enables which-way identification of the quantum particle, contributing maximally to the path-distinguishability parameter D=1. Within these satellite bands, we observed interference fringes with reliability at their diffraction peaks for the wide slit and the narrow slit. After subtracting multiphoton-mixing interference noises V(mix), we obtain significant single-photon wave visibility values = 0.051±.009(stat.+sys.) and = 0.065±.009(stat.+sys.), respectively, at the wide-slit I1 and narrow-slit I2 diffraction bands. The results suggest the possibility of establishing an unusual correlation, D + V > 1, in which a significant number of photons exhibit both wave and particle properties simultaneously within the same experimental spectrum. This differs from the Copenhagen interpretation and therefore requires further explanation. PACS numbers: 03.65.-w, 03.65.Ta, 42.50.Xa

articles.title: Carbon dioxide removal enables climate planetary boundary compliance in cost-effective energy-industry transition pathways
articles.abstract: Several planetary boundaries have already been breached, including climate change. The 1.5°C climate target has been set and widely accepted as the main target. However, the safe and just climate planetary boundary has been identified at around 350 ppm atmospheric CO2 concentration and ca. +1 W m-2 radiative forcing, which can be translated into a 1.0°C level. In this research, we show pathways for the energy-industry transition until 2100 to reach the safe and just climate planetary boundary by deploying fossil fuel phase-out and large-scale carbon dioxide removal (CDR). We aim to quantify the energy and economic efforts required to rebalance Earth’s climate to 1.5°C and 1.0°C. We study several diverse CDR technology portfolios regarding their energy supply impact and expected financial burden. We find that raising ambitions to 1.0°C based on a highly electrified system with low-cost renewable electricity requires less than 5% additional primary energy compared to 1.5°C scenarios, including CDR portfolios heavily relying on direct air capture and carbon sequestration. The ratio of total annual system cost to gross domestic product (GDP) can be significantly reduced from 6% today to 1.5%, while raised ambitions to 1.0°C would require up to 0.25% of global GDP in addition.

articles.title: The oldest spiral Nogrobs (Polychaeta, Serpulidae) from the Pliensbachian/Toarcian boundary (Oujda Mountains, eastern Morocco)
articles.abstract: The rotulariid tube-dwelling polychaete Nogrobs (Tetralysis)zekkarensis sp. nov. (Family Serpulidae) occurs, together with a few other species of this family, in the uppermost Pliensbachian (Pleuroceras spinatum Zone) and lower Toarcian (Dactylioceras tenuicostatumZone) section at the locality Zekkara in the Oujda Mountains (northeastern Morocco). Here, tubes of these serpulids were collected from marls and marly limestones that were deposited on a shallow siliciclastic ramp on the southwestern margin of the Tethys Ocean. The tubes possess a distinctive spiral morphology and a two-layered microstructure. Our findings document that rotulariid serpulids originated at least during the latest Pliensbachian or earlier. Together with morphologically similar species and comparison of their microstructures from other localities of other geological ages, these specimens triggered a revision of systematics of the subgenera of the fossil serpulid genus Nogrobs. The old name Tetralysis is revived for a subgenus of obligatorily spiral Nogrobs species, in which at least most individuals follow the rotulariid morphogenetic countdown program during their ontogeny, i.e., the tube is attached to a firm substrate just during an early non-spiral stage, followed by a spiral which soon breaks free and shifts to a free-lying habit adapted to soft bottoms. Moreover, a new species name Nogrobs (Tetraditrupa) folkestonensisis introduced in order to replace its original name Serpula rustica, a junior homonym preoccupied by the same name of a different species. And the new genus name Annuloserpulais introduced for a group of established Early Jurassic serpulid species possessing plenty of annular peristomes.

articles.title: Proximity-induced charge density waves in a moiré heterobilayer
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.15775v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Twisted heterobilayers of two-dimensional materials have emerged as a platform for studying emergent phases of matter. In this work, we investigate charge density waves (CDW) in a twisted NbSe₂/MoSe₂ bilayer using first-principles calculations. We observe CDW formation in both layers, even though MoSe₂ does not feature a CDW in its monolayer form. Moreover, we find that the CDW is highly non-uniform with filled-center, hollow-center and hexagonal CDWs coexisting in the moiré unit cells of both layers. We assess different mechanisms of CDW formation in the MoSe₂ layer and conclude that the dominant one is the steric repulsion between Se atoms across the van der Waals gap. The strength of this effect is highly sensitive to the interlayer separation, which explains why the CDW amplitude in the MoSe₂ layer depends strongly on the local stacking arrangement. Our work demonstrates that novel broken-symmetry phases can be induced in twisted heterobilayers through proximity effects.

articles.title: Reply to "Comment on 'Topography of Fermi arcs in t-PtBi2 using high-resolution angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy'"
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.02239v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In a recent work [1] we demonstrated that the Fermi arcs in t-PtBi2 are indeed disconnected segments of the Fermi surface. We showed that the surface state band crosses EF between Weyl points and is has finite band gap at all other momenta until it merges with bulk bands. We did not find evidence of a superconducting gap in the spectra down to 3K. In recent Comment, Sergey Borisenko reanalyzed data from repository posted with our paper and concluded that a superconducting gap with i-wave symmetry is present in our data up to temperatures of 19K. We argue that this claim arises from incorrect identification of the location of Fermi arc and confusion between band gap and superconducting gap. This error was compounded by the fact that Author of the Comment analyzed data from interpolated images used for mapping the Fermi surface that are not suitable for extraction of energy gap on meV scale. This fact was previously communicated to the Author of the Comment during e-mail exchange. We maintain that our conclusion of absence of a superconducting gap above 3 K are valid and consistent with recent STM measurements performed on the same samples, which found surface superconductivity with Tc = 3K, below the temperature at which the data for our ARPES paper was measured.

articles.title: High-sensitivity vapor-cell quasi-dc atomic electric field sensor
articles.abstract: Author(s): Amy Damitz, George Burns, and Yuan-Yu Jau For electric field (E-field) sensing applications that require high sensitivity with very small sensing volume or high spatial resolution at low frequencies near dc, conventional electronic approaches suffer from low efficiency (due to small antenna size) and higher intrinsic noise. articles.title: Thawed Gaussian Ehrenfest dynamics
articles.abstract: Ehrenfest dynamics is a widely used mixed quantum–classical approach for nonadiabatic molecular dynamics, whereas thawed Gaussian wavepacket dynamics provides an efficient semiclassical description of adiabatic nuclear quantum dynamics. Here, we describe thawed Gaussian Ehrenfest dynamics (TGED), which unifies and generalizes these two methods to capture both electronic nonadiabaticity and nuclear quantum effects within a single framework. The fully variational formulation of TGED is derived by applying the time-dependent variational principle to a Hartree product of electronic and Gaussian nuclear wavepackets. Replacing the effective locally quadratic molecular potential obtained from this variational treatment by alternative effective locally quadratic potentials yields an infinite family of TGED methods, of which we present several members. We analyze the limiting cases of the general formalism and show, in particular, that it reduces to conventional Ehrenfest dynamics in the classical limit for the nuclei and to thawed Gaussian wavepacket dynamics in the absence of electronic coupling. Finally, we present explicit geometric integrators for the entire family of methods and identify the conditions under which the different approximations become exact.

articles.title: Are multiple proton transfers in (HCO 3 ) 2 (2−) dimers in kalicinite, KHCO 3 , coupled to vibrations of heavy atoms? A periodic DFT and LMP2 description
articles.abstract: For H-bonded (HCO 3 ) 2 (2−) dimers in the kalicinite crystal, KHCO 3 , the anharmonic coupling between the high-frequency νOH and low-frequency νσOO modes was studied by calculating the double-well potentials of the multiple (collective) intradimer double proton transfers at fixed and relaxed O⋯O interatomic distances using five different one-electron Hamiltonians, viz., Hartree–Fock, gradient-corrected PW91 and PBE, hybrid B3LYP(-D*), and Möller–Plesset with the second-order contribution to the correlation energy based on localized orbitals (LMP2). The strongly anharmonic shape of the resulting double-well potential, governing the energy spacings between vibrational levels, is shown to be very sensitive to the chosen combination of the one-electron and vibrational Hamiltonians. Numerical solutions of the one- and two-dimensional vibrational problem for the OH oscillators allowed us to evaluate transitions between tunnel-split doublets of the ground and the first excited vibrational levels. The best agreement with the low-temperature inelastic neutron scattering data for KHCO 3 is achieved by using the B3LYP-D* Hamiltonian for the collective proton transfer pathway, which is decoupled from the KHCO 3 crystal lattice. The influence of the chosen one-electron Hamiltonian on the accuracy of the calculation of the weakly anharmonic δOH, γOH, and νσOO modes is shown to be less dramatic. The shape of the νOH vs ROO dependence, calculated for KHCO 3 , semi-quantitatively captures the experimentally observed trend for OHO bonds in hydroxyl-bearing solids: a non-linear red shift of the νOH band with the O⋯O distance shortening; in addition, a reversal of the trend is predicted for extremely short O⋯O contacts: νOH rises again, indicating potential well narrowing when oxygens are pushed closer than ∼2.35 Å.

articles.title: Competing effects of Si and Mg doping on native point defects in yttrium aluminum garnet
articles.abstract: arXiv:2301.05170v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate how Si and Mg doping affect native point defects in yttrium aluminum garnet (YAG) by combining first-principles calculations with a thermodynamic model of defect equilibria. Formation energies and equilibrium concentrations of native defects, dopants, and defect complexes are obtained across the full range of oxygen chemical potentials relevant to ceramic sintering. Donor (Si) and acceptor (Mg) dopants are found to control native defect populations efficiently but in opposite directions: Si substantially raises cation-vacancy concentrations while suppressing oxygen vacancies, whereas Mg produces the reverse trend. Depending on dopant concentration and oxygen chemical potential, native vacancy concentrations vary by up to thirteen orders of magnitude. The concentration of isolated cation vacancies depends nonmonotonically on Si content, a consequence of Si-vacancy complex formation. Under Si-Mg co-doping, the two dopants compensate each other efficiently, giving rise to pronounced minima in both cation- and oxygen-vacancy concentrations when Si and Mg are present in equal amounts. These findings provide a microscopic basis for the pronounced sensitivity of YAG sintering behavior to the Si/Mg ratio, and show that balanced donor-acceptor co-doping is an effective strategy for controlling native defect populations in YAG.

articles.title: Adsorption energies and decomposition barrier heights for ethylene carbonate on the surface of lithium from cluster-based quantum chemistry
articles.abstract: For ethylene carbonate on the (100) surface of lithium, we calculate the adsorption energy in two binding motifs and the barrier height for a ring-opening decomposition reaction. We validate a scheme for producing results in the thermodynamic limit by correcting results obtained on finite lithium clusters containing only 40–100 atoms, which enables the use of hybrid density functionals, random-phase approximation, and correlated wavefunction theories, such as coupled-cluster theory and auxiliary-field quantum Monte Carlo. We find that the high-level theories agree to within 2–5 kcal/mol and can, therefore, serve as benchmarks for more affordable methods. Using our reference data, we demonstrate that generalized gradient approximation functionals, such as PBE, are not sufficiently accurate for reaction barrier heights, and we identify ω B97X-V as an especially promising functional for the interfacial chemistry of electrolyte solvents at lithium metal anodes.

articles.title: A harmonically coupled-anharmonic-oscillator approach for polyatomic chemistry modeling in DSMC
articles.abstract: Atmospheric entry processes are characterized by high-enthalpy gas flows in strong thermo-chemical non-equilibrium. Accurate simulations of such conditions remain challenging due to the extreme conditions and the complex influence of internal energy modes. In particular, the common assumption of uncoupled harmonic vibrations may break down, and excited internal energy states can directly influence reaction rates. Previously, anharmonic oscillator models have been developed by other authors to improve the accuracy of the Direct Simulation Monte Carlo (DSMC) method under such conditions. However, this extension has so far been limited to diatomic molecules. To increase the accuracy of the DSMC method in the open-source code PICLas, the anharmonic oscillator model is extended to include polyatomic species. The proposed model explicitly considers anharmonic effects and intramolecular energy redistribution. The vibrational degrees of freedom are treated in a local mode basis, in which anharmonic stretching modes are harmonically coupled by harmonic bending modes. The coupling allows for the redistribution of localized vibrational excitation. Dissociation can occur by the strong excitation of a stretching mode, and specific modes can be coupled to the reaction coordinate of the transition state in bimolecular exchange reactions. The newly developed model is evaluated by the comparison with high-fidelity calculations for a set of representative processes. Investigated are different dissociation reactions, which exhibit a high degree of energy redistribution, and the hydrogen-exchange reaction between methane and a hydrogen radical, in which only selected modes contribute to the reactive process. In addition, the recombination–dissociation equilibrium system has been investigated for methane.

articles.title: Hydrodynamics substantially affects induced structure formation in magnetic fluids
articles.title_zh: 流体动力学显着影响磁流体中诱导结构的形成
articles.abstract: Magnetorheological fluids consist of micrometer-sized magnetic particles in a carrier liquid. Sufficiently strong external magnetic fields lead to the formation of string-like particle aggregates. We demonstrate that hydrodynamic interactions, that is, mutual couplings via induced flows, play a substantial role during the structuring process. They support the formation of slender chains instead of more compact clusters in the absence of mutual hydrodynamic interactions between the particles. This fundamental insight is substantial from an application perspective, due to the enormous technical importance and potential of structured magnetorheological materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁流变流体由载液中的微米大小的磁性颗粒组成。足够强的外部磁场会导致线状颗粒聚集体的形成。我们证明了流体动力相互作用，即通过诱导流的相互耦合，在结构化过程中发挥着重要作用。在颗粒之间没有相互流体动力相互作用的情况下，它们支持细长链的形成，而不是更紧凑的簇的形成。由于结构化磁流变材料的巨大技术重要性和潜力，从应用角度来看，这一基本见解非常重要。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁流变流体由载液中的微米大小的磁性颗粒组成。足够强的外部磁场会导致线状颗粒聚集体的形成。我们证明了流体动力相互作用，即通过诱导流的相互耦合，在结构化过程中发挥着重要作用。在颗粒之间没有相互流体动力相互作用的情况下，它们支持细长链的形成，而不是更紧凑的簇的形成。由于结构化磁流变材料的巨大技术重要性和潜力，从应用角度来看，这一基本见解非常重要。

articles.title: Machine learning molecular dynamics for reaction rates of CO oxidation on Pt(111): Impact of site preference and oxygen coverage
articles.title_zh: Pt(111) 上 CO 氧化反应速率的机器学习分子动力学：位点偏好和氧覆盖度的影响
articles.abstract: The kinetics of elementary surface reactions lay the foundation of our understanding of heterogeneous catalysis. However, accurate determination of surface reaction rates is by no means a trivial task. A prominent example is the oxidation of CO on Pt(111), where accurate rate constants were determined recently by experiments, challenging the harmonic transition state theory based on the revised Perdew–Burke–Ernzerhof (RPBE) density functional. However, RPBE is known to predict the incorrect favorable adsorption site for CO on Pt(111), whereas a van der Waals-corrected functional (vdW-DF2) correctly describes this site preference. In addition, the experimental data were derived at a low oxygen coverage, which was not represented well by previous models using small supercells. In this work, we constructed a machine-learned potential energy surface (PES) using vdW-DF2 for the CO + O/Pt(111) system. Based on this vdW-DF2 PES, we performed reactive flux rate constant calculations through molecular dynamics with enhanced sampling and varying periodic supercell sizes. Our results show improved agreement with the experiment compared to earlier RPBE-based calculations. Furthermore, the oxidation rate constants are found to modestly decrease with the decreasing oxygen coverage due to minor increase in the barrier height.
articles.abstract_zh: 基本表面反应的动力学奠定了我们理解多相催化的基础。然而，准确测定表面反应速率绝非易事。一个突出的例子是 CO 在 Pt(111) 上的氧化，最近通过实验确定了准确的速率常数，挑战了基于修正的 Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof (RPBE) 密度泛函的调和过渡态理论。然而，已知 RPBE 预测 Pt(111) 上 CO 的错误有利吸附位点，而范德华校正泛函 (vdW-DF2) 正确描述了这种位点偏好。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基本表面反应的动力学奠定了我们理解多相催化的基础。然而，准确测定表面反应速率绝非易事。一个突出的例子是 CO 在 Pt(111) 上的氧化，最近通过实验确定了准确的速率常数，挑战了基于修正的 Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof (RPBE) 密度泛函的调和过渡态理论。然而，已知 RPBE 预测 Pt(111) 上 CO 的错误有利吸附位点，而范德华校正泛函 (vdW-DF2) 正确描述了这种位点偏好。此外，实验数据是在低氧覆盖率下得出的，之前使用小型超级电池的模型无法很好地体现这一点。在这项工作中，我们使用 vdW-DF2 为 CO + O/Pt(111) 系统构建了机器学习的势能面 (PES)。基于此 vdW-DF2 PES，我们通过增强采样和变化周期性超晶胞尺寸的分子动力学进行反应通量速率常数计算。与早期基于 RPBE 的计算相比，我们的结果表明与实验的一致性更高。此外，由于势垒高度的微小增加，氧化速率常数随着氧覆盖率的降低而适度降低。

articles.title: Electronic origin of ion-specific structural responses: The role of charge density and self-interaction error
articles.title_zh: 离子特异性结构响应的电子起源：电荷密度和自相互作用误差的作用
articles.abstract: Ab initio molecular dynamics provides a first-principles framework for aqueous systems but is limited in accuracy by self-interaction error (SIE) in exchange-correlation functionals. While SIE corrections are known to reduce the over-structured hydrogen bonding in bulk water, their impact on ion hydration remains unclear. Here, we employ machine learning molecular dynamics to systematically compare the Perdew–Burke–Ernzerhof functional with Tkatchenko–Scheffler–van der Waals dispersion correction and the strongly constrained and appropriately normed (SCAN) functional, thereby investigating the effects of different treatments of exchange-correlation (including SIE) on the hydration structure and electronic properties of Na + and Cl − in aqueous solutions. We find that the SCAN functional yields a more ordered and compact first hydration shell of Na + , while leaving the orientational distribution of water molecules largely unchanged. In contrast, for Cl − , the Cl–water correlation of the first hydration shell remains nearly unchanged, whereas the orientational distribution of surrounding water molecules is significantly modified. Charge density analysis reveals that these differences originate from ion-dependent electronic responses: the charge density is more localized around Na + under the SCAN description, strengthening Na + –water interactions, whereas Cl − is comparatively less affected. These results reveal that ion-specific hydration responses are governed by electronic structure effects, particularly charge-density differences associated with reduced SIE, and highlight the importance of accurate treatment of electronic structure in aqueous simulations.
articles.abstract_zh: 从头算分子动力学为水系统提供了第一原理框架，但其准确性受到交换相关泛函中的自相互作用误差 (SIE) 的限制。虽然已知 SIE 校正可以减少散装水中的过度结构化氢键，但它们对离子水合的影响仍不清楚。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue
articles.abstract_zh_full: 从头算分子动力学为水系统提供了第一原理框架，但其准确性受到交换相关泛函中的自相互作用误差 (SIE) 的限制。虽然已知 SIE 校正可以减少散装水中的过度结构化氢键，但它们对离子水合的影响仍不清楚。在这里，我们利用机器学习分子动力学系统地将Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof泛函与Tkatchenko-Scheffler-van der Waals色散校正以及强约束和适当规范（SCAN）泛函进行比较，从而研究不同交换相关处理（包括SIE）对水溶液中Na + 和Cl - 的水合结构和电子性质的影响。我们发现 SCAN 泛函产生了更加有序和紧凑的 Na + 第一水合壳，同时水分子的取向分布基本保持不变。相比之下，对于 Cl - ，第一水化壳的 Cl-水相关性几乎保持不变，而周围水分子的取向分布显着改变。电荷密度分析表明，这些差异源于离子依赖性电子响应：在SCAN描述下，电荷密度更集中在Na + 周围，加强了Na + -水相互作用，而Cl - 受到的影响相对较小。这些结果表明，离子特异性水合反应受电子结构效应的控制，特别是与减少的 SIE 相关的电荷密度差异，并强调了在水模拟中准确处理电子结构的重要性。

articles.title: Hierarchical Deep Counterfactual Regret Minimization
articles.title_zh: 分层深层反事实遗憾最小化
articles.abstract: Imperfect Information Games (IIGs) are used to model games under uncertainty or lack complete information. Counterfactual Regret Minimization (CFR) is one of the most successful families of algorithms for IIGs. The integration of skill-based strategy learning with CFR could potentially mirror more human-like decision-making and improve learning on complex IIGs. It enables the learning of a hierarchical strategy, wherein low-level components represent skills for solving subgames and the high-level component manages the transition between skills. In this paper, we introduce the first hierarchical version of Deep CFR (HDCFR), an innovative method that boosts learning efficiency in tasks involving extensively large state spaces and deep game trees. Notably, HDCFR enables learning with predefined (human) expertise and extracting skills transferable to similar tasks. We first present the algorithm and establish its theory in a tabular setting, including hierarchical CFR update rules and a variance-reduced Monte Carlo sampling extension for the model-free setting, where backtracking is infeasible. We then extend HDCFR to large-scale tasks via deep learning objectives that match the tabular targets under exact function fitting. Code: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/HDCFR_RUN-677B.
articles.abstract_zh: 不完美信息博弈（IIG）用于在不确定或缺乏完整信息的情况下对博弈进行建模。反事实遗憾最小化 (CFR) 是最成功的 IIG 算法系列之一。基于技能的策略学习与 CFR 的整合可能会反映出更加人性化的决策，并改善复杂 IIG 的学习。它能够学习分层策略，其中低级组件代表解决子游戏的技能，高级组件管理技能之间的转换。在本文中，我们介绍了 Deep CFR (HDCFR) 的第一个分层版本，这是一种创新方法，可以提高涉及大量状态空间和深度博弈树的任务的学习效率。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 不完美信息博弈（IIG）用于在不确定或缺乏完整信息的情况下对博弈进行建模。反事实遗憾最小化 (CFR) 是最成功的 IIG 算法系列之一。基于技能的策略学习与 CFR 的整合可能会反映出更加人性化的决策，并改善复杂 IIG 的学习。它能够学习分层策略，其中低级组件代表解决子游戏的技能，高级组件管理技能之间的转换。在本文中，我们介绍了 Deep CFR (HDCFR) 的第一个分层版本，这是一种创新方法，可以提高涉及大量状态空间和深度博弈树的任务的学习效率。值得注意的是，HDCFR 可以利用预定义的（人类）专业知识进行学习，并提取可转移到类似任务的技能。我们首先在表格设置中提出该算法并建立其理论，包括分层 CFR 更新规则和无模型设置的方差减少蒙特卡罗采样扩展，其中回溯是不可行的。然后，我们通过深度学习目标将 HDCFR 扩展到大规模任务，这些目标与精确函数拟合下的表格目标相匹配。代码：https://anonymous.4open.science/r/HDCFR_RUN-677B。

articles.title: Investigation of Dielectric Response and AC Conductivity of NiO/ZnO Nanocomposites for High-Frequency Dielectric Applications
articles.title_zh: 用于高频介电应用的 NiO/ZnO 纳米复合材料的介电响应和交流电导率研究
articles.abstract: The rapid development of wireless communication networks and microwave devices has increased the requirement for dielectric materials with improved electrical performance and low dielectric loss at high frequencies. In the current study, NiO nanoparticles, ZnO nanoparticles, and NiO/ZnO nanocomposites were synthesized using a chemical precipitation method. The structural characteristics of the synthesized materials were investigated by X-ray diffraction (XRD), which confirmed the formation of cubic NiO and hexagonal ZnO phases. The crystallite sizes of NiO, ZnO nanoparticles and the NiO/ZnO nanocomposite were found to be 30 nm, 20 nm, and 14.47 nm, respectively. Nitrogen adsorption–desorption showed that NiO/ZnO nanocomposite exhibited a higher specific surface area 41.827 m² g⁻¹ compared with 32.71 m² g⁻¹ for NiO nanoparticles, improved surface properties due to the synergistic interaction between NiO and ZnO. High-resolution transmission electron microscopy (HRTEM) confirmed particle sizes of approximately 25 nm for NiO and 18 nm for the NiO/ZnO. Dielectric studies demonstrated that both the dielectric constant and dielectric loss decrease with increasing frequency due to reduced interfacial and space-charge polarization effects. Among all samples, the NiO/ZnO nanocomposite exhibited the lowest dielectric loss (≈ 0.30 at 10⁶ Hz) and higher AC conductivity. These enhanced electrical properties arise from strong interfacial interactions between NiO and ZnO, making the nanocomposite a promising candidate for high-frequency dielectric and electronic applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 无线通信网络和微波器件的快速发展提高了对介电材料在高频下具有改善的电性能和低介电损耗的要求。在目前的研究中，采用化学沉淀法合成了NiO纳米粒子、ZnO纳米粒子和NiO/ZnO纳米复合材料。通过X射线衍射（XRD）研究了合成材料的结构特征，证实了立方NiO和六方ZnO相的形成。 NiO、ZnO 纳米颗粒和 NiO/ZnO 纳米复合材料的微晶尺寸分别为 30 nm、20 nm 和 14.47 nm。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 无线通信网络和微波器件的快速发展提高了对介电材料在高频下具有改善的电性能和低介电损耗的要求。在目前的研究中，采用化学沉淀法合成了NiO纳米粒子、ZnO纳米粒子和NiO/ZnO纳米复合材料。通过X射线衍射（XRD）研究了合成材料的结构特征，证实了立方NiO和六方ZnO相的形成。 NiO、ZnO 纳米颗粒和 NiO/ZnO 纳米复合材料的微晶尺寸分别为 30 nm、20 nm 和 14.47 nm。氮气吸附-脱附结果表明，NiO/ZnO纳米复合材料表现出更高的比表面积，为41.827 m² g-1，而NiO纳米粒子的比表面积为32.71 m2 g-1，由于NiO和ZnO之间的协同相互作用，表面性能得到改善。高分辨率透射电子显微镜 (HRTEM) 证实 NiO 的粒径约为 25 nm，NiO/ZnO 的粒径约为 18 nm。介电研究表明，由于界面和空间电荷极化效应的减少，介电常数和介电损耗都随着频率的增加而降低。在所有样品中，NiO/ZnO 纳米复合材料表现出最低的介电损耗（10⁶ Hz 时 ≈ 0.30）和更高的交流电导率。这些增强的电性能源于 NiO 和 ZnO 之间强大的界面相互作用，使纳米复合材料成为高频介电和电子应用的有希望的候选者。

articles.title: Novel Lytic Enterococcus Phage as a Biocontrol Strategy for Multidrug-Resistant Enterococcus faecalis Biofilms on Food-Contact Surfaces: Genomic and Functional Insights
articles.title_zh: 新型裂解性肠球菌噬菌体作为食品接触表面上多重耐药粪肠球菌生物膜的生物防治策略：基因组和功能见解
articles.abstract: Enterococcus faecalis is one of the most prevalent biofilm-forming bacteria that persists on dairy processing surfaces, posing significant food safety and health concern. In this study, two lytic bacteriophages, BV26 and BV34, were isolated and characterized from sewage for use as biocontrol for E. faecalis. Both types of phages belong to the family of Siphoviridae, as observed by transmission electron microscopy. The level of stability for the phage BV26 was evaluated to determine its potential biocontrol effectiveness at a wide range of pH levels (3 to 12), UV resistance, and thermal stability up to 50°C. Whole-genome sequencing of BV26 revealed their predicted coding sequences, with no detectable virulence or antimicrobial resistance genes, supporting its safety for biocontrol applications. Comparative genomic and phylogenetic analyses indicated that BV26 represents a distinct lineage among Enterococcus phages. BV26 was tested for anti-biofilm activity against planktonic and biofilm-bound E. faecalis. In microtiter-plate biofilm formation assays, the anti-biofilm effect of phage BV26 was most pronounced when BV26 was added at a multiplicity of infection of 100. In a dairy processing surface biofilm formation assay, BV26 decreased E. faecalis biofilm formation by more than 3 log₁₀ CFU/coupon after five days. These findings highlight the novelty and potential of phage BV26 as a safe, stable, and effective biocontrol agent for preventing and eliminating E. faecalis biofilms in dairy processing facilities.
articles.abstract_zh: 粪肠球菌是最常见的生物膜形成细菌之一，持续存在于乳制品加工表面，造成重大的食品安全和健康问题。在这项研究中，从污水中分离并鉴定了两种裂解性噬菌体 BV26 和 BV34，用于粪肠球菌的生物防治。通过透射电子显微镜观察到，两种类型的噬菌体都属于管病毒科。对噬菌体 BV26 的稳定性水平进行了评估，以确定其在广泛的 pH 水平（3 至 12）、抗紫外线性和高达 50°C 的热稳定性下的潜在生物防治效果。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 粪肠球菌是最常见的生物膜形成细菌之一，持续存在于乳制品加工表面，造成重大的食品安全和健康问题。在这项研究中，从污水中分离并鉴定了两种裂解性噬菌体 BV26 和 BV34，用于粪肠球菌的生物防治。通过透射电子显微镜观察到，两种类型的噬菌体都属于管病毒科。对噬菌体 BV26 的稳定性水平进行了评估，以确定其在广泛的 pH 水平（3 至 12）、抗紫外线性和高达 50°C 的热稳定性下的潜在生物防治效果。 BV26 的全基因组测序揭示了其预测的编码序列，没有可检测到的毒力或抗菌素耐药性基因，支持其生物防治应用的安全性。比较基因组和系统发育分析表明，BV26 代表肠球菌噬菌体中的独特谱系。测试了 BV26 对浮游和生物膜结合粪肠球菌的抗生物膜活性。在微量滴定板生物膜形成测定中，当以 100 的感染复数添加 BV26 时，噬菌体 BV26 的抗生物膜作用最为明显。在乳品加工表面生物膜形成测定中，五天后 BV26 使粪肠球菌生物膜形成减少超过 3 log10 CFU/优惠券。这些发现凸显了噬菌体 BV26 作为安全、稳定和有效的生物防治剂的新颖性和潜力，可用于预防和消除乳制品加工设施中的粪肠球菌生物膜。

articles.title: Influence of Deposition Conditions on Ferroelectric, Piezoelectric, and Leakage Characteristics in Cobalt-Doped CaBi₄Ti₄O₁₅ Thin Films Prepared using Pulsed Laser Deposition
articles.title_zh: 沉积条件对脉冲激光沉积钴掺杂CaBi₄Ti₄O₁₅薄膜铁电、压电和漏电特性的影响
articles.abstract: Lead-free Aurivillius ferroelectric materials have attracted considerable interest for high-temperature piezoelectric devices, non-volatile memories, and energy harvesting applications owing to their excellent thermal stability and environmental compatibility. Among these materials, CaBi₄Ti₄O₁₅ (CBT) exhibits promising ferroelectric properties; however, its functional performance is strongly influenced by deposition conditions and defect chemistry. In this study, 4 mol% cobalt-doped CaBi₄Ti₄O₁₅ (CBT-Co) thin films were deposited on Pt(111)/Ti/SiO₂/Si substrates by pulsed laser deposition (PLD) to investigate the influence of substrate temperature (600 and 700°C) and oxygen partial pressure (0.01, 0.05, and 0.10 mbar) on their structural, morphological, ferroelectric, piezoelectric, and electrical properties. The deposited films were characterized using X-ray diffraction (XRD), scanning electron microscopy (SEM), atomic force microscopy (AFM), piezoresponse force microscopy (PFM), polarization–electric field (P–E) hysteresis measurements, and current–voltage (I–V) analysis. The results demonstrate that deposition conditions significantly affect crystallinity, grain morphology, domain switching behavior, leakage current, and piezoelectric response. The film deposited at 600°C and 0.10 mbar exhibited the best overall ferroelectric performance, showing a remanent polarization of 6.17 µC cm⁻² and a coercive field of 148.8 kV cm⁻¹ at an applied voltage of 20 V, together with well-developed ferroelectric domains and improved polarization switching. In contrast, films deposited at higher substrate temperature exhibited larger coercive fields, indicating stronger domain pinning associated with microstructural evolution and oxygen-vacancy-related defects. The optimized deposition conditions also resulted in reduced leakage current and enhanced effective piezoelectric response, confirming the strong correlation between processing parameters and functional properties. These findings demonstrate that careful control of substrate temperature and oxygen partial pressure is crucial for tailoring the microstructure and enhancing the ferroelectric and piezoelectric performance of Co-doped CBT thin films. The present study provides valuable insights into the processing–structure–property relationships of Aurivillius thin films and offers an effective strategy for developing lead-free ferroelectric materials for advanced electronic and electromechanical applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 无铅 Aurivilius 铁电材料由于其优异的热稳定性和环境兼容性，在高温压电器件、非易失性存储器和能量收集应用中引起了极大的兴趣。在这些材料中，CaBi4Ti4O15（CBT）表现出有前景的铁电性能；然而，其功能性能受到沉积条件和缺陷化学的强烈影响。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 无铅 Aurivilius 铁电材料由于其优异的热稳定性和环境兼容性，在高温压电器件、非易失性存储器和能量收集应用中引起了极大的兴趣。在这些材料中，CaBi4Ti4O15（CBT）表现出有前景的铁电性能；然而，其功能性能受到沉积条件和缺陷化学的强烈影响。在这项研究中，通过脉冲激光沉积（PLD）在Pt（111）/Ti/SiO2/Si基底上沉积4mol%钴掺杂CaBi4Ti4O5（CBT-Co）薄膜，以研究基底温度（600和700°C）和氧分压（0.01、0.05和0.10 mbar）对其结构的影响，形态、铁电、压电和电特性。使用 X 射线衍射 (XRD)、扫描电子显微镜 (SEM)、原子力显微镜 (AFM)、压响应力显微镜 (PFM)、极化电场 (P-E) 磁滞测量和电流-电压 (I-V) 分析对沉积薄膜进行表征。结果表明，沉积条件显着影响结晶度、晶粒形态、畴切换行为、漏电流和压电响应。在 600°C 和 0.10 mbar 下沉积的薄膜表现出最佳的整体铁电性能，在 20 V 的施加电压下显示出 6.17 µC cm-2 的剩余极化度和 148.8 kV cm-1 的矫顽场，以及发达的铁电畴和改善的极化切换。相比之下，在较高基底温度下沉积的薄膜表现出更大的矫顽力场，表明与微观结构演化和氧空位相关缺陷相关的更强的磁畴钉扎。优化的沉积条件还减少了漏电流并增强了有效压电响应，证实了工艺参数和功能特性之间的强相关性。这些发现表明，仔细控制基底温度和氧分压对于调整 Co 掺杂 CBT 薄膜的微观结构和增强铁电和压电性能至关重要。本研究为 Aurivilius 薄膜的加工-结构-性能关系提供了宝贵的见解，并为开发用于先进电子和机电应用的无铅铁电材料提供了有效的策略。

articles.title: Dual-Mode Colorimetric-SERS Detection of Fenthion Pesticide with γ-Cyclodextrin-Capped Nanozymes
articles.title_zh: γ-环糊精封端纳米酶双模式比色 SERS 检测倍硫磷农药
articles.abstract: This study reports a multifunctional sensing platform that integrates molecular recognition by γ-cyclodextrin (γ-CD), nanozyme catalytic activity, and Raman enhancement within a single nanoparticle system for the detection of fenthion, a widely used organophosphate pesticide in agriculture. Unlike conventional single-mode assays, this sensor platform provides both colorimetric and SERS readouts, offering enhanced versatility and sensitivity. The γ-CD host–guest interaction drives nanoparticle aggregation upon fenthion binding, simultaneously suppressing peroxidase-like oxidation of 3,3′,5,5′‑tetramethylbenzidine and attenuating surface-enhanced Raman scattering (SERS) signals. The dual readouts enable quantitative analysis with detection limits of 7.8 ppb (SERS) and 0.618 ppm (colorimetric). Practical applicability was demonstrated in tomato samples, achieving a SERS detection limit of 0.18 ppm. This cost-effective dual-mode platform demonstrates the potential of γ-CD nanozymes for pesticide residue monitoring by combining simple colorimetric screening with more sensitive SERS-based quantification, offering a complementary approach for food safety and environmental surveillance applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究报告了一种多功能传感平台，该平台将 γ-环糊精 (γ-CD) 的分子识别、纳米酶催化活性和拉曼增强集成在单个纳米颗粒系统中，用于检测倍硫磷（农业中广泛使用的有机磷农药）。与传统的单模式检测不同，该传感器平台提供比色和 SERS 读数，从而增强了多功能性和灵敏度。 γ-CD主客体相互作用在倍硫磷结合时驱动纳米粒子聚集，同时抑制3,3',5,5'-四甲基联苯胺的过氧化物酶样氧化并减弱表面增强拉曼散射（SERS）信号。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本研究报告了一种多功能传感平台，该平台将 γ-环糊精 (γ-CD) 的分子识别、纳米酶催化活性和拉曼增强集成在单个纳米颗粒系统中，用于检测倍硫磷（农业中广泛使用的有机磷农药）。与传统的单模式检测不同，该传感器平台提供比色和 SERS 读数，从而增强了多功能性和灵敏度。 γ-CD主客体相互作用在倍硫磷结合时驱动纳米粒子聚集，同时抑制3,3',5,5'-四甲基联苯胺的过氧化物酶样氧化并减弱表面增强拉曼散射（SERS）信号。双读数可实现定量分析，检测限为 7.8 ppb (SERS) 和 0.618 ppm（比色法）。番茄样品中证明了其实际适用性，实现了 0.18 ppm 的 SERS 检测限。这种经济高效的双模式平台通过将简单的比色筛选与更灵敏的基于 SERS 的定量相结合，展示了 γ-CD 纳米酶在农药残留监测方面的潜力，为食品安全和环境监测应用提供了补充方法。

articles.title: Delayed-Gratification Deep Reinforcement Learning for Sample-Efficient Photonic Inverse Design
articles.title_zh: 用于样本高效光子逆设计的延迟满足深度强化学习
articles.abstract: Stepwise reinforcement learning (RL) performs an electromagnetic simulation after each structural change, so exploration in photonic inverse design is limited by high simulation costs. We propose delayed-gratification deep reinforcement learning (DG-DRL), which decouples reinforcement-learning decisions from simulation calls, so that a sequence of decisions covering all design variables requires only one simulation. The method combines variable-wise decisions, dynamic action masking, and delayed rewards. It excludes invalid options during design construction and calculates optical feedback after the complete structure is formed. We validate the method on three tasks: high-transmission structural-color films, near-field beam shaping, and freeform-grating beam steering. After 2,500 simulations, the number of valid designs and the color-gamut area obtained by DG-DRL in the 90–100% mean-transmittance range are 2.44 and 9.58 times those obtained by stepwise RL, respectively. For beam steering at 1100 nm and 70°, DG-DRL reaches a mean efficiency of 78.2% after 40,000 simulations, close to the 78.3% reported for RL in the literature after 2,000,000 simulations. The ablation further shows that introducing variable-wise decisions or delayed rewards alone reduces the mean efficiency of the baseline, whereas combining them increases it from 53.93% to 79.37%. These results show that jointly designing decision organization and reward timing can make more efficient use of simulation samples and provide an effective method for high-dimensional discrete photonic inverse design under limited simulation budgets.
articles.abstract_zh: 逐步强化学习（RL）在每次结构变化后都会执行电磁模拟，因此光子逆设计的探索受到高模拟成本的限制。我们提出延迟满足深度强化学习（DG-DRL），它将强化学习决策与模拟调用解耦，以便覆盖所有设计变量的一系列决策只需要一次模拟。该方法结合了变量决策、动态动作掩蔽和延迟奖励。它在设计施工期间排除无效选项，并在完整结构形成后计算光学反馈。我们在三个任务上验证了该方法：高透射结构彩色薄膜、近场光束整形和自由形状光栅光束控制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 逐步强化学习（RL）在每次结构变化后都会执行电磁模拟，因此光子逆设计的探索受到高模拟成本的限制。我们提出延迟满足深度强化学习（DG-DRL），它将强化学习决策与模拟调用解耦，以便覆盖所有设计变量的一系列决策只需要一次模拟。该方法结合了变量决策、动态动作掩蔽和延迟奖励。它在设计施工期间排除无效选项，并在完整结构形成后计算光学反馈。我们在三个任务上验证了该方法：高透射结构彩色薄膜、近场光束整形和自由形状光栅光束控制。经过 2500 次模拟后，DG-DRL 在 90-100% 平均透过率范围内获得的有效设计数量和色域面积分别是逐步 RL 获得的 2.44 和 9.58 倍。对于 1100 nm 和 70° 的波束控制，DG-DRL 在 40,000 次模拟后达到 78.2% 的平均效率，接近文献中报告的 RL 在 2,000,000 次模拟后的 78.3%。消融进一步表明，单独引入可变决策或延迟奖励会降低基线的平均效率，而将它们结合起来会将其从 53.93% 提高到 79.37%。这些结果表明，联合设计决策组织和奖励时序可以更有效地利用模拟样本，并为有限模拟预算下的高维离散光子逆设计提供有效方法。

articles.title: Multi-functional coating application of nano-TiO2 and Ti-MOFs on Workwear fabrics: Focus on thermal behavior, UV-resistant and functional properties
articles.title_zh: 纳米TiO2和Ti-MOFs在工作服面料上的多功能涂层应用：关注热行为、抗紫外线和功能性能
articles.abstract: Protecting workers' health and promoting sustainable development are essential for improving occupational productivity and fostering economic growth across industrial sectors. Accordingly, this study aimed to develop multifunctional coatings for workwear fabrics using titanium dioxide (TiO₂) nanoparticles and titanium-based metal–organic frameworks (Ti-MOFs) to enhance thermal insulation, ultraviolet (UV) protection, and other functional properties. A conventional workwear fabric composed of 70% flax and 30% polyester was first prepared. Subsequently, coatings of the titanium-based MOF NH₂-MIL-125(Ti) and TiO₂ nanoparticles were deposited onto the fabric using an ultrasonic-assisted in situ growth method. The thermal performance of the coated fabrics was evaluated through thermal transfer measurements (thermal conductivity and thermal resistance), thermal analysis (TGA and DTA), and thermal imaging, together with the determination of the ultraviolet protection factor (UPF). In addition, key functional properties, including abrasion resistance, tear resistance, tensile strength, air permeability, and water vapor transmission and moisture absorption, were assessed. The results demonstrated that, compared with the untreated fabric, TiO₂ nanoparticle-coated and Ti-MOF-coated fabrics exhibited reductions in thermal conductivity of 45.5% and 22.7%, respectively, accompanied by increases in thermal resistance of 31.9% and 7.3%, respectively. The UPF value increased from 25.3 for the untreated fabric to 74.27 and 42.22 for the TiO₂ nanoparticle-coated and Ti-MOF-coated fabrics, respectively, indicating a substantial improvement in ultraviolet protection. In contrast, the air permeability of the Ti-MOF-coated fabric decreased relative to that of the untreated sample. Overall, the TiO₂ nanoparticle coating demonstrated greater potential for improving the thermal insulation performance of workwear fabrics, whereas the Ti-MOF coating exhibited superior potential for enhancing ultraviolet protection. Nevertheless, further comprehensive investigations are required to validate the practical applicability and long-term performance of these multifunctional coatings under real occupational service conditions.
articles.abstract_zh: 保护工人健康和促进可持续发展对于提高职业生产力和促进各工业部门的经济增长至关重要。因此，本研究旨在使用二氧化钛 (TiO2) 纳米粒子和钛基金属有机框架 (Ti-MOF) 开发用于工作服织物的多功能涂层，以增强隔热、紫外线 (UV) 防护和其他功能特性。首先制备了由70%亚麻和30%涤纶组成的常规工作服面料。随后，使用超声波辅助原位生长方法将钛基 MOF NH2-MIL-125(Ti) 和 TiO2 纳米颗粒涂层沉积到织物上。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 保护工人健康和促进可持续发展对于提高职业生产力和促进各工业部门的经济增长至关重要。因此，本研究旨在使用二氧化钛 (TiO2) 纳米粒子和钛基金属有机框架 (Ti-MOF) 开发用于工作服织物的多功能涂层，以增强隔热、紫外线 (UV) 防护和其他功能特性。首先制备了由70%亚麻和30%涤纶组成的常规工作服面料。随后，使用超声波辅助原位生长方法将钛基 MOF NH2-MIL-125(Ti) 和 TiO2 纳米颗粒涂层沉积到织物上。通过热传递测量（热导率和热阻）、热分析（TGA 和 DTA）和热成像以及紫外线防护系数（UPF）的测定来评估涂层织物的热性能。此外，还评估了关键功能特性，包括耐磨性、抗撕裂性、拉伸强度、透气性、水蒸气透过性和吸湿性。结果表明，与未处理的织物相比，TiO2纳米颗粒涂层和Ti-MOF涂层织物的导热系数分别降低了45.5%和22.7%，同时热阻分别增加了31.9%和7.3%。 UPF 值从未经处理的织物的 25.3 分别增加到 TiO2 纳米颗粒涂层和 Ti-MOF 涂层织物的 74.27 和 42.22，表明紫外线防护能力显着提高。相反，Ti-MOF涂层织物的透气性相对于未处理的样品有所下降。总体而言，TiO2纳米粒子涂层在提高工作服织物的隔热性能方面表现出更大的潜力，而Ti-MOF涂层在增强紫外线防护方面表现出卓越的潜力。然而，需要进一步全面的研究来验证这些多功能涂层在真实职业使用条件下的实际适用性和长期性能。

articles.title: Comparative Numerical Analysis of Chemically Reactive MHD Functional Nanofluid Coating Flow over Cone and Wedge Geometries
articles.title_zh: 锥体和楔形几何形状上化学反应 MHD 功能纳米流体涂层流动的比较数值分析
articles.abstract: Coating flows of electro-conductive functional magnetic nanofluids external to both wedge and cone shapes embedded in porous media under external magnetic field modulation are investigated theoretically and numerically. Chemical reaction, thermal radiation, heat generation and activation energy effects are included in the mathematical model. Buongiorno’s two-component nanoscale model is deployed to evaluate mass diffusion phenomena of the nanoparticles under thermophoretic and Brownian motion effects. A separate species equation is included for reactive solute diffusion. By making use of suitable similarity transformation techniques, the original system of partial differential equations is reduced to a system of nonlinear ordinary differential equations with suitable wall and free stream boundary conditions. The MATLAB 'bvp4c' solver is used to numerically solve the nonlinear dimensionless ordinary differential boundary value problem. Verification with previous studies is included. The influence of key emerging parameters on velocity and temperature is displayed graphically. Response Surface Methodology (RSM) is then deployed to conduct statistical analysis and optimize the transport process for skin friction, Nusselt number (heat transfer rate), solutal Sherwood number (solute mass transfer rate) and nanoparticle Sherwood number. The results show that for both the cone and wedge geometries, flow acceleration is produced with decreasing Richardson numbers. Increasing Brownian motion parameter generates strong micro-convection currents in the base fluid, increasing the overall thermal conductivity and enhancing temperature and associated thermal boundary layer thickness. Increasing thermophoresis parameter intensifies thermal diffusion and elevates temperatures, reduces nanoparticle volume fraction and decreases nanoparticle species boundary layer thickness. An elevation in internal heat-generating and Rosseland radiation-conduction parameter both contribute significantly to the dramatic rise in temperature. With enhanced R² values of 98.56% for the cone and 99.04% for the wedge, the nanoparticle Sherwood number achieves a high level of prediction accuracy. The simulations are relevant to coating flows of biochemical engineering devices with functional nano-liquids.
articles.abstract_zh: 在外部磁场调制下，对嵌入多孔介质中的楔形和圆锥形外部的导电功能磁性纳米流体的涂层流动进行了理论和数值研究。数学模型中包含了化学反应、热辐射、发热和活化能效应。 Buongiorno 的双组分纳米级模型用于评估纳米粒子在热泳和布朗运动效应下的质量扩散现象。包括用于反应性溶质扩散的单独物质方程。通过利用合适的相似变换技术，将原始偏微分方程组简化为具有合适壁面和自由流边界条件的非线性常微分方程组。 MATLAB“bvp4c”求解器用于数值求解非线性无量纲常微分边值问题。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在外部磁场调制下，对嵌入多孔介质中的楔形和圆锥形外部的导电功能磁性纳米流体的涂层流动进行了理论和数值研究。数学模型中包含了化学反应、热辐射、发热和活化能效应。 Buongiorno 的双组分纳米级模型用于评估纳米粒子在热泳和布朗运动效应下的质量扩散现象。包括用于反应性溶质扩散的单独物质方程。通过利用合适的相似变换技术，将原始偏微分方程组简化为具有合适壁面和自由流边界条件的非线性常微分方程组。 MATLAB“bvp4c”求解器用于数值求解非线性无量纲常微分边值问题。包括与先前研究的验证。以图形方式显示关键新兴参数对速度和温度的影响。然后采用响应面法（RSM）对表面摩擦、努塞尔数（传热速率）、溶质舍伍德数（溶质传质速率）和纳米粒子舍伍德数进行统计分析和优化传输过程。结果表明，对于圆锥体和楔形几何形状，流动加速度随着理查森数的减小而产生。增加布朗运动参数会在基液中产生强烈的微对流电流，从而增加整体热导率并提高温度和相关的热边界层厚度。增加热泳参数会增强热扩散并升高温度，降低纳米颗粒体积分数并减小纳米颗粒物质边界层厚度。内部发热和罗瑟兰辐射传导参数的升高都对温度的急剧上升有显着影响。纳米颗粒舍伍德数的圆锥体 R² 值和楔形体 R² 值分别提高了 98.56% 和 99.04%，实现了高水平的预测精度。该模拟与功能性纳米液体的生化工程装置的涂层流动相关。

articles.title: Monolithic all-optical phase regenerator via parity-time symmetry
articles.title_zh: 通过奇偶时间对称性的单片全光相位再生器
articles.abstract: Optical phase represents a fundamental dimension of electromagnetic waves, where the elimination of phase noise is crucial in various applications. Kerr-mediated all-optical phase regeneration can mitigate noise on-the-fly but requires complicated and bulky phase-locking circuits to yield high-fidelity optical phase coherence. Extending this approach to practical applications, the challenges are to develop miniaturized regenerators without trading off performance, a critical barrier rooted in the fundamental conflict between the high-Q environment required for phase locking and the low-Q environment needed for high processing speed. Here we demonstrate a monolithic all-optical phase regenerator within an integrated coupled resonator, with processing rate exceeding the high-Q cavity linewidth by a factor of over 30. The key is exploiting Kerr-induced synchronization (KIS) as a passive, electronics-free phase-locking mechanism within a parity-time (PT) symmetric design, which simultaneously supports high-Q mode for KIS and low-Q mode for high-speed signal processing. Experimentally, phase regeneration at Gigabits per second rates is achieved using MHz-linewidth cavity, with phase distortion up to ± 45° fully regenerated to the back-to-back level. This work demonstrates a paradigm shift in optical phase regeneration from benchtop assemblies to a monolithic chip via non-Hermitian optics, opening new avenues for next-generation, densely integrated chip-scale photonic processors across communications, quantum technologies, sensing, and metrology.
articles.abstract_zh: 光相位代表电磁波的基本维度，其中相位噪声的消除在各种应用中至关重要。克尔介导的全光相位再生可以减轻动态噪声，但需要复杂且庞大的锁相电路来产生高保真光学相位相干性。将这种方法扩展到实际应用中，面临的挑战是在不牺牲性能的情况下开发小型化再生器，这是一个关键障碍，根源在于锁相所需的高 Q 环境与高处理速度所需的低 Q 环境之间的根本冲突。在这里，我们展示了集成耦合谐振器内的单片全光相位再生器，其处理速率超过高 Q 腔线宽 30 倍以上。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 光相位代表电磁波的基本维度，其中相位噪声的消除在各种应用中至关重要。克尔介导的全光相位再生可以减轻动态噪声，但需要复杂且庞大的锁相电路来产生高保真光学相位相干性。将这种方法扩展到实际应用中，面临的挑战是在不牺牲性能的情况下开发小型化再生器，这是一个关键障碍，根源在于锁相所需的高 Q 环境与高处理速度所需的低 Q 环境之间的根本冲突。在这里，我们展示了集成耦合谐振器内的单片全光相位再生器，其处理速率超过高 Q 腔线宽 30 倍以上。关键是利用克尔诱导同步 (KIS) 作为奇偶时间 (PT) 对称设计中的无源、无电子锁相机制，同时支持 KIS 的高 Q 模式和高速信号处理的低 Q 模式。实验上，使用 MHz 线宽腔实现了千兆位每秒速率的相位再生，相位失真高达 ± 45°，完全再生到背靠背水平。这项工作展示了光相位再生从台式组件到通过非厄米光学器件的单片芯片的范式转变，为跨通信、量子技术、传感和计量的下一代密集集成芯片级光子处理器开辟了新途径。

articles.title: The optimal injection energy for beam-driven proton–boron fusion lies above the 675 keV resonance
articles.title_zh: 束驱动质子-硼聚变的最佳注入能量位于 675 keV 共振以上
articles.abstract: Every non-thermal proton–boron-11 scheme now pursued places its fast ions at the 675 keV resonance of the ¹¹B(p,3α) cross section. The rate coefficient, however, is the product σ(E) v(E), and because the relative velocity grows as the square root of energy, the true maximum of the rate coefficient lies at 3.7 MeV. While this theoretical displacement governs ignition, a driven device is governed by a different, practically accessible quantity: the fusion yield integrated over the slowing-down history of the fast ion, weighted by the energy invested. We evaluate this engineering gain per unit injected energy analytically. We find that the optimum injection energy for a beam-driven device is 0.85 MeV, which is a little above the resonance but far below the 3.7 MeV kinematic ceiling. Injecting protons at 0.85 MeV rather than at the widely targeted 675 keV resonance raises the beam-driven gain per unit energy invested by 25 per cent. This improvement requires no new physics, no new confinement scheme, and no change of magnetic configuration — only a higher injector voltage.
articles.abstract_zh: 现在所追求的每一个非热质子-硼-11方案都将其快离子放置在 11B(p,3α) 截面的 675 keV 共振处。然而，速率系数是 σ(E) v(E) 的乘积，并且由于相对速度随着能量的平方根而增长，因此速率系数的真正最大值位于 3.7 MeV。虽然这种理论位移控制着点火，但驱动装置受到不同的、实际可获取的量控制：在快离子的减速历史上积分的聚变产率，由投入的能量加权。我们通过分析评估每单位注入能量的工程增益。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 现在所追求的每一个非热质子-硼-11方案都将其快离子放置在 11B(p,3α) 截面的 675 keV 共振处。然而，速率系数是 σ(E) v(E) 的乘积，并且由于相对速度随着能量的平方根而增长，因此速率系数的真正最大值位于 3.7 MeV。虽然这种理论位移控制着点火，但驱动装置受到不同的、实际可获取的量控制：在快离子的减速历史上积分的聚变产率，由投入的能量加权。我们通过分析评估每单位注入能量的工程增益。我们发现光束驱动装置的最佳注入能量为 0.85 MeV，略高于共振，但远低于 3.7 MeV 运动上限。以 0.85 MeV（而不是广泛目标的 675 keV 共振）注入质子可使每单位能量投入的束流驱动增益提高 25%。这种改进不需要新的物理原理，不需要新的限制方案，也不需要改变磁配置——只需要更高的喷射器电压。

articles.title: Physics-Informed Neural Network Framework for Predicting Compressive Strength of Coconut Fiber Reinforced Concrete
articles.title_zh: 用于预测椰子纤维增强混凝土抗压强度的物理信息神经网络框架
articles.abstract: Accurate prediction of compressive strength in coconut fiber reinforced concrete (CFRC) is essential for sustainable infrastructure design. While data-driven machine learning models offer high predictive accuracy, they often violate fundamental physical laws of cement hydration and composite mechanics, leading to unreliable extrapolations. This study presents a novel Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) framework that explicitly encodes concrete material physics including cement hydration kinetics, Abrams’ water-cement ratio law, recycled coarse aggregate (RCA) degradation effects, and fiber reinforcement efficiency, into the learning architecture. Using a comprehensive dataset of 586 experimental records compiled from 30 independent studies, the proposed PINN architecture integrates physics-engineered features (hydration factors, Abrams indices, fiber efficiency parameters, and RCA reduction coefficients) with a deep neural network regularized by physical monotonicity constraints. The PINN achieved an (:R²) of 0.9482, RMSE of 3.89 MPa, and MAPE of 8.69%, demonstrating comparable accuracy to gradient boosting ((:R²=0.9673)) while ensuring complete compliance with age-monotonicity constraints and significantly reduced violations of water-cement ratio and RCA replacement laws. SHAP-based explainability analysis reveals that the PINN correctly captures the diminishing returns of fiber content beyond optimal dosage (1.5–2.0%), consistent with micromechanical fiber bridging theory. The framework provides a trustworthy, interpretable, and physically consistent tool for CFRC mix design, enabling reliable extrapolation beyond the training domain.
articles.abstract_zh: 准确预测椰子纤维增强混凝土 (CFRC) 的抗压强度对于可持续基础设施设计至关重要。虽然数据驱动的机器学习模型提供了很高的预测准确性，但它们经常违反水泥水化和复合力学的基本物理定律，导致不可靠的外推。这项研究提出了一种新颖的物理信息神经网络（PINN）框架，该框架将混凝土材料物理（包括水泥水化动力学、艾布拉姆斯水灰比定律、再生粗骨料（RCA）降解效应和纤维增强效率）明确编码到学习架构中。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 准确预测椰子纤维增强混凝土 (CFRC) 的抗压强度对于可持续基础设施设计至关重要。虽然数据驱动的机器学习模型提供了很高的预测准确性，但它们经常违反水泥水化和复合力学的基本物理定律，导致不可靠的外推。这项研究提出了一种新颖的物理信息神经网络（PINN）框架，该框架将混凝土材料物理（包括水泥水化动力学、艾布拉姆斯水灰比定律、再生粗骨料（RCA）降解效应和纤维增强效率）明确编码到学习架构中。所提出的 PINN 架构使用从 30 项独立研究中编制的 586 条实验记录的综合数据集，将物理工程特征（水合因子、艾布拉姆斯指数、纤维效率参数和 RCA 折减系数）与由物理单调性约束正则化的深度神经网络集成在一起。 PINN 的 (:R²) 为 0.9482，RMSE 为 3.89 MPa，MAPE 为 8.69%，表现出与梯度提升 ((:R²=0.9673)) 相当的精度，同时确保完全符合龄期单调性约束，并显着减少违反水灰比和 RCA 替换定律的情况。基于 SHAP 的可解释性分析表明，PINN 正确捕获了超出最佳剂量 (1.5-2.0%) 的纤维含量的收益递减，与微机械纤维桥接理论一致。该框架为 CFRC 混合设计提供了一个值得信赖、可解释且物理一致的工具，能够在训练领域之外进行可靠的外推。

articles.title: Scientists uncover recurrent patterns within chaotic quantum behavior
articles.title_zh: 科学家发现混沌量子行为中的重复模式
articles.abstract: Many complex quantum systems rapidly lose the recognizable patterns of their initial states as their components interact. To describe patterns of regular and chaotic motion in specific systems, physicists can construct a mathematical map called an effective phase space.
articles.abstract_zh: 许多复杂的量子系统在其组件相互作用时很快就会失去其初始状态的可识别模式。为了描述特定系统中规则运动和混沌运动的模式，物理学家可以构建一个称为有效相空间的数学图。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 许多复杂的量子系统在其组件相互作用时很快就会失去其初始状态的可识别模式。为了描述特定系统中规则运动和混沌运动的模式，物理学家可以构建一个称为有效相空间的数学图。

articles.title: Molecular dynamics simulation and QM/MM study of IscB-ωRNA complex
articles.title_zh: IscB-ωRNA复合物的分子动力学模拟和QM/MM研究
articles.abstract: The CRISPR-Cas9 system’s gene-editing fidelity relies on the HNH nuclease domain’s ability to hydrolyze DNA via metal-ion catalysis. While IscB-ωRNA variants offer advantages for viral delivery due to their small size, their editing efficiency is much lower than that of Cas9. The understanding of how HNH-domain dynamics and metal-ion selection jointly control catalysis is essential for its rational improvement. Here, we employ molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, quantum mechanics/molecular mechanics (QM/MM) simulations, and free energy perturbations (FEP) to study the conformation dynamics of the IscB–ωRNA–target DNA complex and cation binding energy in the core HNH(IscB)–DNA region. Our MD simulations revealed that the IscB–ωRNA–DNA complex is overall stable. However, the core HNH(IscB)–DNA region shifts to a larger separation, consistent with recent findings of coupling between HNH motion and activation in IscB–ωRNA–DNA. However, the HNH domain motion may be decreased by Cas9-like H246D/H270N mutations. QM/MM and FEP studies found that three Cas9 activating ions, Mg 2+ , Mn 2+ , and Co 2+ , also have higher binding energy in the mutated HNH(IscB)–DNA region, suggesting that the catalytic efficiencies of IscB–ωRNA could be subjected to the balance between stabilizing ion binding and domain motions.
articles.abstract_zh: CRISPR-Cas9 系统的基因编辑保真度依赖于 HNH 核酸酶结构域通过金属离子催化水解 DNA 的能力。虽然 IscB-ωRNA 变体由于尺寸小而具有病毒传递的优势，但其编辑效率远低于 Cas9。了解 HNH 域动力学和金属离子选择如何共同控制催化对于其合理改进至关重要。在这里，我们采用分子动力学（MD）模拟、量子力学/分子力学（QM/MM）模拟和自由能扰动（FEP）来研究IscB-ωRNA-靶DNA复合物的构象动力学和核心HNH（IscB）-DNA区域的阳离子结合能。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue
articles.abstract_zh_full: CRISPR-Cas9 系统的基因编辑保真度依赖于 HNH 核酸酶结构域通过金属离子催化水解 DNA 的能力。虽然 IscB-ωRNA 变体由于尺寸小而具有病毒传递的优势，但其编辑效率远低于 Cas9。了解 HNH 域动力学和金属离子选择如何共同控制催化对于其合理改进至关重要。在这里，我们采用分子动力学（MD）模拟、量子力学/分子力学（QM/MM）模拟和自由能扰动（FEP）来研究IscB-ωRNA-靶DNA复合物的构象动力学和核心HNH（IscB）-DNA区域的阳离子结合能。我们的 MD 模拟表明 IscB-ωRNA-DNA 复合物总体稳定。然而，核心 HNH(IscB)-DNA 区域转向更大的间隔，这与 IscB-ωRNA-DNA 中 HNH 运动和激活之间耦合的最新发现一致。然而，HNH 结构域的运动可能会因 Cas9 样 H246D/H270N 突变而减少。 QM/MM和FEP研究发现，三种Cas9激活离子Mg 2+ 、Mn 2+ 和Co 2+ 在突变的HNH(IscB)–DNA区域中也具有较高的结合能，这表明IscB–ωRNA的催化效率可能受到稳定离子结合和结构域运动之间的平衡的影响。

articles.title: Probing protein structures in solution via concentration- and temperature-dependent small- and wide-angle x-ray scattering
articles.title_zh: 通过浓度和温度依赖性小角和广角 X 射线散射探测溶液中的蛋白质结构
articles.abstract: Understanding how biomolecules execute their functions requires knowledge not only of their static ground-state structures but also of the conformational dynamics, solvation, and intermolecular interactions that they sample under physiological conditions. High-resolution crystallography, the dominant source of atomic-resolution structures, captures the molecule within a rigid lattice that can favor particular conformations and is largely silent on the structural dynamics present in solution. Here, we develop temperature-dependent small- and wide-angle x-ray scattering as a probe of biomolecular structure, dynamics, and interactions in the solution phase and apply it to two well-characterized model proteins: the Villin headpiece subdomain and the GB3 domain. Concentration-dependent measurements over temperatures spanning supercooled (−16 °C) to fully unfolded (120 °C), extrapolated to infinite dilution, allow us to recover the forward-scattering intensity I0 ( T ), the radius of gyration Rg ( T ), and the real-space pair-distribution function p ( r , T ). Both Villin and GB3 exhibit at least two structurally distinct folded conformations and, when unfolded at high concentration (∼20 mg/ml), form transient dimers due to entanglement of the disordered peptide chains. Villin exhibits concentration-dependent dimerization of its folded structure and an anomalous loss of scattering power upon unfolding that we hypothesize arises from release of bound chlorides. Subtracting the fully disordered, high-temperature ensemble represented in p ( r , T max ) from all other curves generates Δ p ( r , T ) with sufficient spatial resolution to track the temperature dependence of secondary and tertiary structural features. These real-space fingerprints of the folds place stringent constraints on candidate atomic structures and may provide a solution-phase route to atomic-level understanding of biomolecular structure and dynamics under the physiological conditions in which they function.
articles.abstract_zh: 了解生物分子如何执行其功能不仅需要了解其静态基态结构，还需要了解它们在生理条件下采样的构象动力学、溶剂化和分子间相互作用。高分辨率晶体学是原子分辨率结构的主要来源，它捕获刚性晶格内的分子，该晶格有利于特定的构象，并且对溶液中存在的结构动力学基本上保持沉默。在这里，我们开发了温度依赖性小角度和广角 X 射线散射作为溶液相中生物分子结构、动力学和相互作用的探针，并将其应用于两个充分表征的模型蛋白：Villin headpiece 子域和 GB3 域。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue
articles.abstract_zh_full: 了解生物分子如何执行其功能不仅需要了解其静态基态结构，还需要了解它们在生理条件下采样的构象动力学、溶剂化和分子间相互作用。高分辨率晶体学是原子分辨率结构的主要来源，它捕获刚性晶格内的分子，该晶格有利于特定的构象，并且对溶液中存在的结构动力学基本上保持沉默。在这里，我们开发了温度依赖性小角度和广角 X 射线散射作为溶液相中生物分子结构、动力学和相互作用的探针，并将其应用于两个充分表征的模型蛋白：Villin headpiece 子域和 GB3 域。在过冷 (−16 °C) 到完全展开 (120 °C) 的温度范围内进行与浓度相关的测量，外推到无限稀释，使我们能够恢复前向散射强度 I0 ( T )、回转半径 Rg ( T ) 和实空间对分布函数 p ( r , T )。 Villin 和 GB3 均表现出至少两种结构上不同的折叠构象，并且当以高浓度（~20 mg/ml）展开时，由于无序肽链的缠结而形成瞬时二聚体。 Villin 的折叠结构表现出浓度依赖性二聚化，并且在展开时散射能力异常损失，我们假设这是由结合氯化物的释放引起的。从所有其他曲线中减去 p ( r , T max ) 中表示的完全无序的高温系综，生成具有足够空间分辨率的 Δ p ( r , T ) 来跟踪二级和三级结构特征的温度依赖性。这些折叠的真实空间指纹对候选原子结构施加了严格的限制，并可能为在其发挥作用的生理条件下生物分子结构和动力学的原子级理解提供解决方案。

articles.title: A trick of the tail: How electrostatics helps a DNA repair enzyme to localize on nucleosomes
articles.title_zh: 尾巴的技巧：静电如何帮助 DNA 修复酶定位在核小体上
articles.abstract: Electrostatic interactions are key to the recognition processes of proteins and DNA and have been previously documented for the action of repair enzymes. Uracil-DNA glycosylase (UDG) is the first in a sequence of enzymes that act in the base-excision repair process and whose task is the extraction of uracil bases from nuclear DNA. The question of how the molecule targets uracil bases in chromatin, in particular in the condensed protein–DNA complexes of nucleosomes, has only recently become a subject of detailed studies. Here, we predict that the presence of an arginine anchor motif on the N-terminal tail of UDG can favor its localization on nucleosomes by binding to their acidic patches on their top and bottom surfaces via electrostatic interactions. We argue that this mechanism could play a key role in the detection of uracil defects in nucleosomal DNA.
articles.abstract_zh: 静电相互作用是蛋白质和 DNA 识别过程的关键，之前已记录了修复酶的作用。尿嘧啶-DNA 糖基化酶 (UDG) 是在碱基切除修复过程中起作用的一系列酶中的第一个，其任务是从核 DNA 中提取尿嘧啶碱基。该分子如何靶向染色质中的尿嘧啶碱基，特别是核小体的浓缩蛋白-DNA复合物中的尿嘧啶碱基，这一问题直到最近才成为详细研究的主题。在这里，我们预测 UDG N 末端尾部存在的精氨酸锚定基序可以通过静电相互作用结合到其顶部和底部表面上的酸性斑块，从而有利于其在核小体上的定位。
