These results establish a direct link between Hamiltonian design, Hilbert-space network structure, and emergent non-ergodic dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 非遍历量子多体动力学提供了一条远离平衡态的持久量子相干性的途径，超出了热化统计力学的传统预期。大多数已知的例子都是通过直觉、类比或数值搜索来识别的，而不是通过系统的哈密顿设计。这使得在无序相互作用的量子多体系统中设计鲁棒的非遍历动力学的通用方法很少，特别是在更高的维度中，增强的连通性通常不利于遍历性破坏。在这里，我们使用本征态到哈密尔顿构造方法来系统地设计具有可调非遍历特性的二维量子自旋哈密顿量。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 非遍历量子多体动力学提供了一条远离平衡态的持久量子相干性的途径，超出了热化统计力学的传统预期。大多数已知的例子都是通过直觉、类比或数值搜索来识别的，而不是通过系统的哈密顿设计。这使得在无序相互作用的量子多体系统中设计鲁棒的非遍历动力学的通用方法很少，特别是在更高的维度中，增强的连通性通常不利于遍历性破坏。在这里，我们使用本征态到哈密尔顿构造方法来系统地设计具有可调非遍历特性的二维量子自旋哈密顿量。从共同的父模型和输入本征态开始，我们在方晶格上构建了两个目标哈密顿量，它们的相互作用几何形状不同：轴向与对角线。我们表明，由此产生的相互作用几何和耦合模式控制希尔伯特空间结构和动力学。轴向模型形成一个连接的希尔伯特空间网络，并通过抑制共振表现出各向异性驱动的从遍历行为到非遍历行为的交叉。相比之下，对角线模型表现出希尔伯特空间碎片，并且在其最大的不可约扇区中表现出量子多体疤痕动力学的特征，包括高度局域化、低纠缠本征态塔和长寿命相干复兴。这些结果在哈密顿设计、希尔伯特空间网络结构和新兴非遍历动力学之间建立了直接联系。

articles.title: From Energy-Force Weighting to Primal-Dual Optimization of Machine-Learned Interatomic Potentials
articles.title_zh: 从能量-力加权到机器学习原子间势的原始对偶优化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.00876v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Machine-learned interatomic potentials are commonly fitted by weighted-sum scalarization, which combines energy and force errors in a single loss. A nominal weight, however, identifies a potential only relative to the complete fitting protocol. We therefore treat energy--force balancing as a protocol-dependent problem of physical model selection. For fixed-basis atomic cluster expansion models of molten LiCl, liquid H₂O, and Si, the resulting scalarization paths contain dominated states at extreme weights. Their nondominated subsets depend on the solver, and the out-of-distribution Si path is nonmonotone. We replace direct weight selection by minimizing the regularized energy objective subject to an upper bound on the normalized force loss. Projected dual ascent adjusts the Lagrange multiplier from the force-constraint residual. A frozen-multiplier limited-memory quasi-Newton refinement then returns the final model. Across the three systems, the constrained procedure reaches the solver-matched low-error region and gives measured speedups of 6.7--8.9 over completed scalarization scans under the stated timing convention. Physical-property calculations show that first-shell geometry is comparatively insensitive to the selected balance, whereas transport and solid-state observables vary more strongly. These results identify the fitted model--protocol pair as the relevant object of energy--force model selection and support force-constrained fitting as an explicit selection rule.
articles.abstract_zh: 机器学习的原子间势通常通过加权和标量化来拟合，它将能量和力误差结合在一个损失中。然而，标称重量只能识别相对于完整验配协议的潜力。因此，我们将能量-力平衡视为物理模型选择的协议相关问题。对于熔融 LiCl、液态 H2O 和 Si 的固定基原子团簇膨胀模型，所得标量化路径包含极端重量下的主导态。它们的非支配子集取决于求解器，并且分布外 Si 路径是非单调的。我们通过最小化受归一化力损失上限影响的正则化能量目标来取代直接权重选择。预计双上升根据力约束残差调整拉格朗日乘数。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 机器学习的原子间势通常通过加权和标量化来拟合，它将能量和力误差结合在一个损失中。然而，标称重量只能识别相对于完整验配协议的潜力。因此，我们将能量-力平衡视为物理模型选择的协议相关问题。对于熔融 LiCl、液态 H2O 和 Si 的固定基原子团簇膨胀模型，所得标量化路径包含极端重量下的主导态。它们的非支配子集取决于求解器，并且分布外 Si 路径是非单调的。我们通过最小化受归一化力损失上限影响的正则化能量目标来取代直接权重选择。预计双上升根据力约束残差调整拉格朗日乘数。然后，冻结乘数有限内存拟牛顿细化返回最终模型。在这三个系统中，约束程序达到了与求解器匹配的低误差区域，并在规定的计时约定下比完成的标量化扫描提供了 6.7--8.9 的测量加速。物理性质计算表明，第一层几何形状对所选平衡相对不敏感，而输运和固态可观测量变化更大。这些结果将拟合模型-协议对识别为能量-力模型选择的相关对象，并支持力约束拟合作为显式选择规则。

articles.title: Vector chiral order and dynamical quantum phase transitions in an Ising chain with dimerized anisotropic Gamma interaction
articles.title_zh: 具有二聚各向异性伽玛相互作用的伊辛链中的矢量手性序和动态量子相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.01167v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We investigate a transverse-field Ising chain with dimerized anisotropic Gamma interactions and demonstrate that, both in the absence and presence of Ising interactions, the competition between Gamma anisotropy and the transverse field gives rise to vector chiral order and dynamical quantum phase transitions. The phase diagram comprises positive and negative vector chiral phases and a paramagnetic phase, characterized by the vector spin chirality and the vector chiral order parameter. In the absence of Ising interactions, we identify a gapless critical line that exhibits no finite-size drift, along which the spin-spin correlations and subsystem entanglement entropy display behavior distinct from that of Ising criticality. Furthermore, we find that the critical times of dynamical quantum phase transitions form periodic or aperiodic sequences, depending on the quench path. Our findings highlight how dimerized off-diagonal exchange enriches both equilibrium ordering and dynamical critical behavior in a quantum Ising chain.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了具有二聚化各向异性伽马相互作用的横向场伊辛链，并证明，无论是否存在伊辛相互作用，伽马各向异性和横向场之间的竞争都会引起矢量手性有序和动态量子相变。该相图包括正、负矢量手性相和顺磁相，其特征在于矢量自旋手性和矢量手性序参数。在没有伊辛相互作用的情况下，我们确定了一条无间隙临界线，它不表现出有限尺寸的漂移，沿着这条线，自旋-自旋相关性和子系统纠缠熵表现出与伊辛临界性不同的行为。此外，我们发现动态量子相变的临界时间形成周期性或非周期性序列，具体取决于淬灭路径。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了具有二聚化各向异性伽马相互作用的横向场伊辛链，并证明，无论是否存在伊辛相互作用，伽马各向异性和横向场之间的竞争都会引起矢量手性有序和动态量子相变。该相图包括正、负矢量手性相和顺磁相，其特征在于矢量自旋手性和矢量手性序参数。在没有伊辛相互作用的情况下，我们确定了一条无间隙临界线，它不表现出有限尺寸的漂移，沿着这条线，自旋-自旋相关性和子系统纠缠熵表现出与伊辛临界性不同的行为。此外，我们发现动态量子相变的临界时间形成周期性或非周期性序列，具体取决于淬灭路径。我们的研究结果强调了二聚化非对角交换如何丰富量子伊辛链中的平衡有序和动态临界行为。

articles.title: Rapid mixing of quantum spin chains at any finite temperature
articles.title_zh: 在任何有限温度下快速混合量子自旋链
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.01190v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We prove that a quasi-local quantum Gibbs sampler rapidly mixes to the Gibbs state of any 1D finite-range Hamiltonian at all finite temperatures in Oleft(log (n/ε)right) time. Each update traces out a contiguous block of constant length and reconstructs it using the Petz recovery map, following early proposals for quantum heat-bath Gibbs samplers by Kastoryano and Brandão~citekastoryano2016quantum. Our proof directly bounds the distance between the updated state and the target Gibbs state using quantum Wasserstein distance of order 1. We further provide O(polylog(n/ε)) depth of quantum circuits to prepare these Gibbs states. We hope these techniques will facilitate the analysis and design of other Gibbs samplers.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们证明了准局部量子吉布斯采样器在 Oleft(log (n/ε)right) 时间内在所有有限温度下快速混合到任何一维有限范围哈密顿量的吉布斯状态。每次更新都会追踪出一个恒定长度的连续块，并使用 Petz 恢复图重建它，遵循 Kastoryano 和 Brandão~citekastoryano2016quantum 提出的量子热浴吉布斯采样器的早期建议。我们的证明使用 1 阶量子 Wasserstein 距离直接限制更新状态和目标吉布斯状态之间的距离。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们证明了准局部量子吉布斯采样器在 Oleft(log (n/ε)right) 时间内在所有有限温度下快速混合到任何一维有限范围哈密顿量的吉布斯状态。每次更新都会追踪出一个恒定长度的连续块，并使用 Petz 恢复图重建它，遵循 Kastoryano 和 Brandão~citekastoryano2016quantum 提出的量子热浴吉布斯采样器的早期建议。我们的证明使用 1 阶量子 Wasserstein 距离直接限制更新状态和目标吉布斯状态之间的距离。我们进一步提供 O(polylog(n/ε)) 深度的量子电路来准备这些吉布斯状态。我们希望这些技术能够促进其他吉布斯采样器的分析和设计。

articles.title: EP-Flow: Disordered Crystal Structure Prediction without Site-Level Annotations
articles.title_zh: EP-Flow：无位点级注释的无序晶体结构预测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.01315v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Generative models have made rapid progress in ordered crystal structure prediction, yet many functional materials are intrinsically disordered, with substitutional mixing, vacancies, or interstitial species controlling their properties. Existing crystal generators either assume deterministic site occupations or require site-level disorder annotations, which are often unavailable when the chemical formula is the primary input. We formulate disordered crystal structure prediction through an Occupancy Distribution Matrix (ODM), a continuous site-by-species representation that unifies ordered crystals, solid solutions, vacancy disorder, and interstitial occupancy. A valid ODM must satisfy coupled site-wise occupancy, mass-conservation, and non-negativity constraints, placing each sample on a formula-dependent transportation polytope. We propose Entropic Polytope Flow (EP-Flow), a marginal-constrained flow matching framework that canonicalizes heterogeneous polytopes into a shared double-centered space, learns a marginal-preserving flow, and recovers feasible occupancies through a Sinkhorn inverse map. By jointly generating occupancies, fractional coordinates, and lattice parameters, EP-Flow achieves state-of-the-art performance on formula-conditioned disordered CSP benchmarks derived from COD and MPDS, substantially outperforming adapted ordered-crystal generators. Analyses further show that EP-Flow recovers sparse and chemically meaningful local disorder patterns rather than merely matching global composition statistics.
articles.abstract_zh: 生成模型在有序晶体结构预测方面取得了快速进展，但许多功能材料本质上是无序的，置换混合、空位或间隙物质控制着它们的性能。现有的晶体生成器要么假设确定的位点占用，要么需要位点级无序注释，当化学式是主要输入时，这些注释通常不可用。我们通过占据分布矩阵（ODM）制定无序晶体结构预测，这是一种连续的按物种表示，统一了有序晶体、固溶体、空位无序和间隙占据。有效的 ODM 必须满足耦合的位点占用、质量守恒和非负约束，将每个样本放置在依赖于公式的传输多胞体上。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 生成模型在有序晶体结构预测方面取得了快速进展，但许多功能材料本质上是无序的，置换混合、空位或间隙物质控制着它们的性能。现有的晶体生成器要么假设确定的位点占用，要么需要位点级无序注释，当化学式是主要输入时，这些注释通常不可用。我们通过占据分布矩阵（ODM）制定无序晶体结构预测，这是一种连续的按物种表示，统一了有序晶体、固溶体、空位无序和间隙占据。有效的 ODM 必须满足耦合的位点占用、质量守恒和非负约束，将每个样本放置在依赖于公式的传输多胞体上。我们提出了熵多面体流（EP-Flow），这是一种边缘约束流匹配框架，它将异构多面体规范化为共享双中心空间，学习边缘保持流，并通过 Sinkhorn 逆映射恢复可行占用。通过联合生成占据、分数坐标和晶格参数，EP-Flow 在源自 COD 和 MPDS 的公式条件无序 CSP 基准上实现了最先进的性能，大大优于自适应的有序晶体生成器。分析进一步表明，EP-Flow 恢复了稀疏且具有化学意义的局部无序模式，而不仅仅是匹配全局成分统计数据。

articles.title: SupraTITO: Transferable Generative Molecular Dynamics for Supramolecular Systems
articles.title_zh: SupraTITO：超分子系统的可转移生成分子动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.01381v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Peptide sequence governs both the structures formed through supramolecular assembly and the dynamics by which they emerge, but predicting either requires resolving slow collective processes among many interacting molecules. Molecular dynamics (MD) provides microscopic insight into these processes, yet the long timescales of assembly and the vast peptide sequence space make systematic exploration computationally demanding. We introduce SupraTITO, a transferable generative molecular dynamics (GenMD) framework for supramolecular systems, demonstrated through peptide self-assembly. SupraTITO learns transferable implicit transfer operators (TITO) conditioned on peptide sequence, molecular topology, and periodic geometry, allowing configurations to be propagated over physical intervals much longer than an MD integration step. On a comprehensive dipeptide benchmark, SupraTITO generalizes to held-out sequences and reproduces sequence-dependent structures and dynamics while maintaining molecular integrity over long rollouts. Compared with direct ensemble prediction trained on the same trajectory data, SupraTITO more accurately reproduces assembly structures while also resolving their temporal evolution. The learned dynamics generalize across peptide concentrations, including dilute conditions not represented during training. These results extend transferable GenMD to collective dynamics in periodic supramolecular systems and provide a foundation for modeling related processes beyond peptide assembly.
articles.abstract_zh: 肽序列控制着通过超分子组装形成的结构以及它们出现的动力学，但预测其中任何一个都需要解决许多相互作用分子之间缓慢的集体过程。分子动力学（MD）提供了对这些过程的微观洞察，但组装的长时间尺度和巨大的肽序列空间使得系统探索的计算要求很高。我们介绍了 SupraTITO，这是一种用于超分子系统的可转移生成分子动力学 (GenMD) 框架，通过肽自组装进行了演示。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 肽序列控制着通过超分子组装形成的结构以及它们出现的动力学，但预测其中任何一个都需要解决许多相互作用分子之间缓慢的集体过程。分子动力学（MD）提供了对这些过程的微观洞察，但组装的长时间尺度和巨大的肽序列空间使得系统探索的计算要求很高。我们介绍了 SupraTITO，这是一种用于超分子系统的可转移生成分子动力学 (GenMD) 框架，通过肽自组装进行了演示。 SupraTITO 学习以肽序列、分子拓扑和周期性几何为条件的可转移隐式转移算子 (TITO)，从而允许配置在比 MD 积分步骤长得多的物理间隔上传播。在全面的二肽基准上，SupraTITO 可以推广到保留序列并重现序列依赖性结构和动力学，同时在长期部署中保持分子完整性。与在相同轨迹数据上训练的直接集成预测相比，SupraTITO 更准确地再现装配结构，同时还解决了它们的时间演化问题。学到的动力学概括了肽浓度，包括训练期间未表示的稀释条件。这些结果将可转移的 GenMD 扩展到周期性超分子系统中的集体动力学，并为模拟肽组装之外的相关过程提供了基础。

articles.title: DSSYK, open ASEP/TASEP and 2d dilaton gravity at strong coupling
articles.title_zh: DSSYK、开放 ASEP/TASEP 和强耦合下的二维膨胀重力
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.01790v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We discuss the triality between stochastic growth models in the KPZ universality class, the DSSYK model, and low dimensional dilaton gravity. The TASEP model, which will be our primary focus, is identified with the strong-coupling limit of two-dimensional quantum gravity. The Hamiltonian of DSSYK and the transfer matrix of ASEP coincide up to an additive constant, and we derive the exact expression for the resolvent of the corresponding transfer matrix in ASEP on a finite interval. We also mention the relation of cumulants with the Tutte polynomial T(1,q) of the crossing graph dual to the chord diagram, which implies the relationship of the models considered with the Q=0 Potts model coupled with gravity. We further exploit the realization of all these models in terms of different versions of discrete and continuous random walks on two-dimensional manifolds, which parameterize the Hilbert spaces of the respective theories. The representation of TASEP as the growth model of heaps provides new insight into strong-coupling gravity, suggesting its interpretation as an emerging phenomenon. The new dualities between ASEP and q-TASEP models and heap models providing a useful growth interpretation have been developed.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们讨论了 KPZ 普适类中的随机增长模型、DSSYK 模型和低维膨胀引力模型之间的试验。 TASEP 模型将成为我们的主要关注点，它被认为具有二维量子引力的强耦合极限。 DSSYK 的哈密顿量与 ASEP 的传递矩阵在加性常数范围内重合，并推导了 ASEP 中相应传递矩阵在有限区间上求解的精确表达式。我们还提到了累积量与对偶弦图交叉图的 Tutte 多项式 T(1,q) 的关系，这暗示了用 Q=0 Potts 模型与重力耦合考虑的模型的关系。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们讨论了 KPZ 普适类中的随机增长模型、DSSYK 模型和低维膨胀引力模型之间的试验。 TASEP 模型将成为我们的主要关注点，它被认为具有二维量子引力的强耦合极限。 DSSYK 的哈密顿量与 ASEP 的传递矩阵在加性常数范围内重合，并推导了 ASEP 中相应传递矩阵在有限区间上求解的精确表达式。我们还提到了累积量与对偶弦图交叉图的 Tutte 多项式 T(1,q) 的关系，这暗示了用 Q=0 Potts 模型与重力耦合考虑的模型的关系。我们进一步利用二维流形上离散和连续随机游走的不同版本来实现所有这些模型，这些模型参数化了各自理论的希尔伯特空间。 TASEP 作为堆增长模型的表示提供了对强耦合引力的新见解，表明它是一种新兴现象的解释。 ASEP 和 q-TASEP 模型以及提供有用增长解释的堆模型之间的新对偶性已经开发出来。

articles.title: Stationarity and angular momentum conservation in pulsar spin noise
articles.title_zh: 脉冲星自旋噪声中的平稳性和角动量守恒
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.01929v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present an analysis of pulsar spin noise based on physically-motivated two-component models of spin wandering. We focus on two models, distinguished by their total angular momentum dynamics: a singular, nonstationary model with a diffusive total angular momentum, and a minimal, stationary model anchored on a conserved total angular momentum. We develop scalable Gaussian process methods and, using mock data, show that the two models are fully testable and distinguishable with full-state observations, i.e., simultaneous independent data on the crust and the superfluid rotational states. This paves a path to testing stationarity in pulsar spin noise, potentially achievable with joint continuous gravitational wave observations and radio timing of pulsars. However, robust inferences and predictions are harder to achieve, and depend on the priors and data quality, when only one component is observationally accessible.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了基于物理驱动的自旋漂移二分量模型的脉冲星自旋噪声分析。我们重点关注两个模型，它们的总角动量动力学有所不同：一个是具有扩散总角动量的奇异非平稳模型，另一个是基于守恒总角动量的最小平稳模型。我们开发了可扩展的高斯过程方法，并使用模拟数据表明，这两个模型是完全可测试的，并且可以通过全状态观测来区分，即关于地壳和超流体旋转状态的同时独立数据。这为测试脉冲星自旋噪声的平稳性铺平了道路，这有可能通过联合连续引力波观测和脉冲星射电授时来实现。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了基于物理驱动的自旋漂移二分量模型的脉冲星自旋噪声分析。我们重点关注两个模型，它们的总角动量动力学有所不同：一个是具有扩散总角动量的奇异非平稳模型，另一个是基于守恒总角动量的最小平稳模型。我们开发了可扩展的高斯过程方法，并使用模拟数据表明，这两个模型是完全可测试的，并且可以通过全状态观测来区分，即关于地壳和超流体旋转状态的同时独立数据。这为测试脉冲星自旋噪声的平稳性铺平了道路，这有可能通过联合连续引力波观测和脉冲星射电授时来实现。然而，当只有一个组件可观察到时，稳健的推论和预测更难以实现，并且取决于先验和数据质量。

articles.title: Thin-capping layer epitaxial quantum dots for near-field quantum photonics
articles.title_zh: 用于近场量子光子学的薄覆盖层外延量子点
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.02080v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Epitaxial quantum dots (QDs) are widely recognised as one of the best quantum light sources, given their good stability, brightness, quantum efficiency and coherence. To reach such properties, QDs are protected from potentially detrimental surface states by a relatively thick capping layer, typically exceeding 50nm. This prevents the implementation of near-field effects, like plasmonic-based ones, that can dramatically increase the light-matter interaction, since the control of the spontaneous emission dynamics and directionality of the emission can only occur if the emitter is in close proximity (typically tens of nanometers or less) from the metallic structures. In this work, we report the growth and optical characterisation of InAs/GaAs QDs with GaAs capping layer thickness of 10nm, 20nm, and a more standard 95nm. Remarkably, we observe emission linewidths up to 5 times smaller than previously reported, with unperturbed excitonic lifetimes. These results demonstrate that the epitaxial QD's high optical quality can be maintained even when the emitters are at reduced distances from the surface, opening the path for the exploration of near-field light-matter interactions with coherent and stable emitters, suitable for quantum technology applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 外延量子点（QD）因其良好的稳定性、亮度、量子效率和相干性而被广泛认为是最好的量子光源之一。为了达到这样的特性，量子点通过相对较厚的覆盖层（通常超过 50 nm）来保护免受潜在有害的表面态的影响。这阻止了近场效应的实现，例如基于等离激元的近场效应，这种效应可以显着增加光与物质的相互作用，因为只有当发射器距离金属结构很近（通常是数十纳米或更小）时，才能控制自发发射动力学和发射方向性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 外延量子点（QD）因其良好的稳定性、亮度、量子效率和相干性而被广泛认为是最好的量子光源之一。为了达到这样的特性，量子点通过相对较厚的覆盖层（通常超过 50 nm）来保护免受潜在有害的表面态的影响。这阻止了近场效应的实现，例如基于等离激元的近场效应，这种效应可以显着增加光与物质的相互作用，因为只有当发射器距离金属结构很近（通常是数十纳米或更小）时，才能控制自发发射动力学和发射方向性。在这项工作中，我们报告了 GaAs 覆盖层厚度为 10 nm、20 nm 和更标准的 95 nm 的 InAs/GaAs QD 的生长和光学表征。值得注意的是，我们观察到发射线宽比之前报道的小 5 倍，并且激子寿命不受干扰。这些结果表明，即使发射器与表面的距离减小，外延量子点也可以保持高光学质量，从而为探索相干且稳定的发射器的近场光与物质相互作用开辟了道路，适合量子技术应用。

articles.title: Strong Simulation of 1D Quantum Circuits via Reduced Transition Matrices
articles.title_zh: 通过简化的跃迁矩阵对一维量子电路进行强模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.02082v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Tensor networks are powerful tools for simulating quantum many-body systems, but the growth of spatial entanglement severely limits the direct evolution of pure states under chaotic unitary circuits. Here we consider a more targeted task: the approximate strong simulation of a specified output probability of a 1D chaotic brick-wall circuit at finite relative precision. Given input and output bit strings by and bx, we evaluate p(bx|by)=|brabxU(T)ketby|² using the Sweeping RTM algorithm, a transverse tensor-network contraction based on reduced transition matrices (RTMs). The algorithm compresses the left and right temporal boundary states jointly, seeking an output probability that converges across spatial cuts and as the bond dimension is increased. For chaotic one-dimensional brick-wall circuits at a fixed relative target precision, we find numerical evidence that the bond dimension required to obtain stable estimates grows subexponentially over the accessible time window. Our findings open a direct route to classical probability queries for chaotic quantum circuits, with potential applications to benchmarking and learning tasks.
articles.abstract_zh: 张量网络是模拟量子多体系统的强大工具，但空间纠缠的增长严重限制了混沌酉电路下纯态的直接演化。在这里，我们考虑一个更有针对性的任务：以有限相对精度对一维混沌砖墙电路的指定输出概率进行近似强模拟。给定输入和输出位串 by 和 bx，我们使用 Sweeping RTM 算法评估 p(bx|by)=|brabxU(T)ketby|²，这是一种基于简化转移矩阵 (RTM) 的横向张量网络收缩。该算法联合压缩左右时间边界状态，寻求在空间切割上以及随着键维数增加而收敛的输出概率。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 张量网络是模拟量子多体系统的强大工具，但空间纠缠的增长严重限制了混沌酉电路下纯态的直接演化。在这里，我们考虑一个更有针对性的任务：以有限相对精度对一维混沌砖墙电路的指定输出概率进行近似强模拟。给定输入和输出位串 by 和 bx，我们使用 Sweeping RTM 算法评估 p(bx|by)=|brabxU(T)ketby|²，这是一种基于简化转移矩阵 (RTM) 的横向张量网络收缩。该算法联合压缩左右时间边界状态，寻求在空间切割上以及随着键维数增加而收敛的输出概率。对于固定相对目标精度的混沌一维砖墙电路，我们发现了数值证据，表明获得稳定估计所需的键维数在可访问的时间窗口内呈次指数增长。我们的研究结果为混沌量子电路的经典概率查询开辟了一条直接途径，并具有在基准测试和学习任务中的潜在应用。

articles.title: A No-Go Theorem for Order-Two Clifford Electric-Magnetic Duality
articles.title_zh: 二阶克利福德电磁对偶性的不可行定理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.02097v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Electromagnetic duality in the toric code has order two at the level of anyon types and acts as a Hadamard-type logical transformation on the encoded quantum information. Here, we ask whether it can likewise be realized microscopically as an order-two Clifford operation. For the Z₂ toric code, we prove that any locality-preserving Clifford realization of electric-magnetic exchange cannot have order two. Our proof is fully general and requires neither translation symmetry with restricted families of system sizes nor a fixed pairing between vertex and plaquette stabilizers. Geometrically, the proof locally emulates the unavoidable crossing between electric and magnetic strings, similar to a cross-cap in a non-orientable manifold. Extending the problem to the Z_N toric code, we find that an order-two Clifford realization exists for odd N, whereas it is impossible for even N. Our results show that the group law of an emergent electromagnetic duality need not lift faithfully to its microscopic Clifford realization.
articles.abstract_zh: 环面码中的电磁对偶性在任意子类型级别具有二阶，并且充当编码量子信息的哈达玛型逻辑变换。在这里，我们询问是否可以同样在微观上将其实现为二阶 Clifford 运算。对于 Z2 复曲面码，我们证明了电磁交换的任何保局性 Clifford 实现都不可能具有二阶。我们的证明是完全通用的，既不需要系统尺寸受限系列的平移对称性，也不需要顶点稳定器和斑块稳定器之间的固定配对。从几何角度来看，证明局部模拟了电弦和磁弦之间不可避免的交叉，类似于不可定向流形中的交叉帽。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 环面码中的电磁对偶性在任意子类型级别具有二阶，并且充当编码量子信息的哈达玛型逻辑变换。在这里，我们询问是否可以同样在微观上将其实现为二阶 Clifford 运算。对于 Z2 复曲面码，我们证明了电磁交换的任何保局性 Clifford 实现都不可能具有二阶。我们的证明是完全通用的，既不需要系统尺寸受限系列的平移对称性，也不需要顶点稳定器和斑块稳定器之间的固定配对。从几何角度来看，证明局部模拟了电弦和磁弦之间不可避免的交叉，类似于不可定向流形中的交叉帽。将问题扩展到 Z_N 环面码，我们发现奇数 N 存在二阶 Clifford 实现，而偶数 N 则不可能。我们的结果表明，新兴电磁二象性的群定律不需要忠实地提升到其微观 Clifford 实现。

articles.title: Beyond Light Cones: State Preparation Complexity in Quantum Spin Glasses
articles.title_zh: 超越光锥：量子自旋玻璃的状态制备复杂性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.02166v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We introduce a method for studying state preparation complexity in dense quantum p-spin Hamiltonians on n qubits, going beyond bounds based only on circuit lightcones. The key input is the class's effective profile complexity, which is derived from the metric entropy of its Pauli profiles. These profiles record expectations of all Pauli operators supported on exactly p qubits. Classes with uniformly bounded quadratic effective profile complexity remain separated from the ground-state energy by a positive multiple of sqrt n for sufficiently large fixed p. At subquadratic effective profile complexity, the class cannot outperform a suitable benchmark class at leading order, with product states providing a universal benchmark. The proof combines an adaptation of a nonsymmetric quantum de Finetti theorem of Berta et al. (arXiv:1810.12197) with Gaussian process entropy bounds. Applying this framework, we show that attaining near-ground-state energy requires Ω(n²/log n) one- and two-qubit gates, even with arbitrary discardable ancillas. We also obtain depth-width tradeoffs, entanglement-depth and matrix product state bond-dimension lower bounds, and obstructions for both orientations at every fixed level of Parham's magic hierarchy (arXiv:2504.19966), with total circuit width O(n). In first-level reverse magic, a shallow circuit is followed by an unrestricted Clifford circuit. The latter can spread local observables across the system, preventing a direct application of small-lightcone bounds. For this first-level class, our bounds also allow arbitrarily many clean ancillas at fixed shallow-circuit depth. A sharper benchmark shows that Clifford+T circuits with o(n) T-gates have no leading-order energy advantage over product stabilizer states, even with unrestricted Clifford operations and arbitrary discardable ancillas.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们引入了一种研究 n 个量子位上密集量子 p-自旋哈密顿量的状态准备复杂性的方法，超越了仅基于电路光锥的界限。关键输入是类的有效轮廓复杂度，它源自其泡利轮廓的度量熵。这些配置文件记录了在 p 个量子位上支持的所有泡利算子的期望。对于足够大的固定 p，具有统一有界二次有效轮廓复杂度的类仍然与基态能量分开 sqrt n 的正倍数。在次二次有效轮廓复杂度下，该类无法超越领先顺序的合适基准类，而产品状态提供了通用基准。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们引入了一种研究 n 个量子位上密集量子 p-自旋哈密顿量的状态准备复杂性的方法，超越了仅基于电路光锥的界限。关键输入是类的有效轮廓复杂度，它源自其泡利轮廓的度量熵。这些配置文件记录了在 p 个量子位上支持的所有泡利算子的期望。对于足够大的固定 p，具有统一有界二次有效轮廓复杂度的类仍然与基态能量分开 sqrt n 的正倍数。在次二次有效轮廓复杂度下，该类无法超越领先顺序的合适基准类，而产品状态提供了通用基准。该证明结合了 Berta 等人的非对称量子 de Finetti 定理的改编。 (arXiv:1810.12197) 具有高斯过程熵界限。应用这个框架，我们表明，获得接近基态的能量需要 Ω(n²/log n) 一和两个量子位门，即使有任意可丢弃的辅助装置。我们还获得了深度-宽度权衡、纠缠深度和矩阵积态键维下界，以及 Parham 魔法层次结构 (arXiv:2504.19966) 的每个固定级别的两个方向的障碍物，总电路宽度为 O(n)。在第一级反向魔术中，浅层电路后面是无限制的克利福德电路。后者可以将局部可观测值传播到整个系统，从而防止直接应用小光锥边界。对于这个第一级类，我们的边界还允许在固定的浅电路深度上任意许多干净的辅助设备。更清晰的基准表明，即使具有不受限制的 Clifford 操作和任意可丢弃的辅助设备，具有 o(n) T 门的 Clifford+T 电路相对于乘积稳定器状态也没有前序能量优势。

articles.title: Investigation of Fe-Ag and Ag-Fe Interfaces in Ag-57Fe-Ag trilayer Using Nuclear Resonance Scattering under X-ray Standing Wave Conditions
articles.title_zh: X 射线驻波条件下利用核磁共振散射研究 Ag-57Fe-Ag 三层中的 Fe-Ag 和 Ag-Fe 界面
articles.abstract: arXiv:2502.06223v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Understanding the interfaces of layered nanostructures is key to optimizing their structural and magnetic properties for the desired functionality. In the present work, the two interfaces of a few nm thick Fe layer in Ag-57Fe-Ag trilayers are studied with a depth resolution of a fraction of a nanometer using x-ray standing waves (XSWs) generated by an underlying [W-Si]x10 multilayer (MLT) at an x-ray incident angle around the Bragg peak of the MLT. Interface selectivity in Ag-57Fe-Ag trilayers was achieved by moving XSW antinodes across the interfaces by optimizing suitable incident angles and performing depth-resolved nuclear resonance scattering (NRS) and X-ray fluorescence (XRF) measurements for magnetic and structural properties. The combined analysis revealed that the rms roughness of 57Fe-on-Ag and Ag-on-57Fe interfaces are not equal. The roughness of the 57Fe-on-Ag interface is 9.7 Angstrom, while that of the Ag-on-57Fe interface is 6.4 Angstrom. 57Fe isotope sensitive NRS revealed that hyperfine field (HFF) at both interfaces of 57Fe-on-Ag and Ag-on-57Fe interfaces are distinct, which is consistent with the difference in interface roughnesses measured as root mean square (RMS) roughness. Thermal annealing induces 57Fe diffusion into the Ag layer, and annealing at 325 C transforms the sample into a paramagnetic state. This behavior is attributed to forming 57Fe nanoparticles within the Ag matrix, exhibiting a paramagnetic nature. These findings provide deep insights into interface properties crucial for developing advanced nanostructures and spintronic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 了解层状纳米结构的界面是优化其结构和磁性以获得所需功能的关键。在目前的工作中，使用底层 [W-Si]x10 多层 (MLT) 产生的 X 射线驻波 (XSW) 以围绕 MLT 布拉格峰的 X 射线入射角，以几分之一纳米的深度分辨率研究了 Ag-57Fe-Ag 三层中几纳米厚的 Fe 层的两个界面。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 了解层状纳米结构的界面是优化其结构和磁性以获得所需功能的关键。在目前的工作中，使用底层 [W-Si]x10 多层 (MLT) 产生的 X 射线驻波 (XSW) 以围绕 MLT 布拉格峰的 X 射线入射角，以几分之一纳米的深度分辨率研究了 Ag-57Fe-Ag 三层中几纳米厚的 Fe 层的两个界面。 Ag-57Fe-Ag 三层膜中的界面选择性是通过优化合适的入射角并在界面上移动 XSW 波腹来实现的，并对磁性和结构特性进行深度分辨核磁共振散射 (NRS) 和 X 射线荧光 (XRF) 测量。综合分析表明，57Fe-on-Ag 和 Ag-on-57Fe 界面的均方根粗糙度不相等。 57Fe-on-Ag界面的粗糙度为9.7埃，而Ag-on-57Fe界面的粗糙度为6.4埃。 57Fe同位素敏感的NRS显示，57Fe-on-Ag和Ag-on-57Fe界面的超精细场（HFF）是明显的，这与以均方根（RMS）粗糙度测量的界面粗糙度的差异一致。热退火导致 57Fe 扩散到 Ag 层中，325°C 的退火将样品转变为顺磁性状态。这种行为归因于在 Ag 基质内形成 57Fe 纳米颗粒，表现出顺磁性。这些发现提供了对开发先进纳米结构和自旋电子器件至关重要的界面特性的深入见解。

articles.title: Sequential Circuits as Generalized Symmetry on the Lattice
articles.title_zh: 晶格上广义对称性的时序电路
articles.abstract: arXiv:2507.22394v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Generalized symmetry extends the usual notion of symmetry to ones that are of higher-form, acting on subsystems, non-invertible, etc. The concept was defined in the field theory context using the idea of topological defects. On the lattice, an immediate consequence is that a symmetry twist is moved across the system by a sequential quantum circuit. In this paper, we ask how to deduce the full, potentially non-invertible symmetry action from the unitary sequential circuit and how the connection to sequential circuit constrains the properties of the generalized symmetries. We find that for symmetries that contain the trivial symmetry operator as a fusion outcome, which we call annihilable symmetries, the sequential circuit fully determines the symmetry action and puts various constraints on their fusion. In contrast, for unannihilable symmetries, like those whose corresponding twist is the Cheshire string, a further one-dimensional sequential circuit is needed for the full description. Matrix product operator and tensor network operator representations play an important role in our discussion.
articles.abstract_zh: 广义对称将通常的对称概念扩展到更高形式的对称、作用于子系统的对称、不可逆的对称等。该概念是使用拓扑缺陷的思想在场论背景下定义的。在晶格上，直接的结果是对称性扭曲通过顺序量子电路在系统中移动。在本文中，我们询问如何从酉时序电路中推导出完整的、潜在不可逆的对称作用，以及与时序电路的连接如何限制广义对称性的属性。我们发现，对于包含平凡对称算子作为融合结果的对称性（我们称之为可湮灭对称性），时序电路完全决定了对称性行为，并对它们的融合施加了各种约束。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 广义对称将通常的对称概念扩展到更高形式的对称、作用于子系统的对称、不可逆的对称等。该概念是使用拓扑缺陷的思想在场论背景下定义的。在晶格上，直接的结果是对称性扭曲通过顺序量子电路在系统中移动。在本文中，我们询问如何从酉时序电路中推导出完整的、潜在不可逆的对称作用，以及与时序电路的连接如何限制广义对称性的属性。我们发现，对于包含平凡对称算子作为融合结果的对称性（我们称之为可湮灭对称性），时序电路完全决定了对称性行为，并对它们的融合施加了各种约束。相反，对于不可湮灭的对称性，比如那些相应的扭曲是柴郡弦的对称性，需要进一步的一维时序电路来进行完整的描述。矩阵乘积算子和张量网络算子表示在我们的讨论中发挥着重要作用。

articles.title: A Machine Learning Closure for Polymer Integral Equation Theory
articles.title_zh: 聚合物积分方程理论的机器学习闭包
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.11030v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Polymer reference interaction site model (PRISM) theory, a descendant of Ornstein-Zernike liquid state theory, is a powerful tool to predict the structure and thermodynamics of equilibrium polymer systems, but its accuracy and applicability can be limited in some important cases. Typically, these shortcomings are traced to the analytical closure relationships used to solve the integral equations. Here, we propose a machine learning (ML)-based closure relation trained on a dataset of coarse-grained molecular dynamics simulations of homopolymer melts and solutions. PRISM theory with the ML closure outperforms traditional atomic closures (e.g., Percus-Yevick) in predicting the structure of typical coarse-grained model systems. We also use the ML closure to accurately model the results of small-angle neutron scattering experiments. This ML-enhanced PRISM theory can therefore enable rapid soft materials discovery and design efforts.
articles.abstract_zh: 聚合物参考相互作用位点模型（PRISM）理论是 Ornstein-Zernike 液态理论的后代，是预测平衡聚合物体系的结构和热力学的有力工具，但其准确性和适用性在某些重要情况下可能受到限制。通常，这些缺点可以追溯到用于求解积分方程的解析闭包关系。在这里，我们提出了一种基于机器学习（ML）的闭合关系，在均聚物熔体和溶液的粗粒度分子动力学模拟数据集上进行训练。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 聚合物参考相互作用位点模型（PRISM）理论是 Ornstein-Zernike 液态理论的后代，是预测平衡聚合物体系的结构和热力学的有力工具，但其准确性和适用性在某些重要情况下可能受到限制。通常，这些缺点可以追溯到用于求解积分方程的解析闭包关系。在这里，我们提出了一种基于机器学习（ML）的闭合关系，在均聚物熔体和溶液的粗粒度分子动力学模拟数据集上进行训练。在预测典型粗粒度模型系统的结构方面，具有 ML 闭包的 PRISM 理论优于传统原子闭包（例如 Percus-Yevick）。我们还使用 ML 闭包对小角度中子散射实验的结果进行精确建模。因此，这种机器学习增强的 PRISM 理论可以实现快速软材料发现和设计工作。

articles.title: Electrical magnon spectroscopy with foundry-fabricated nanoscale magnetic tunnel junctions
articles.title_zh: 具有铸造厂制造的纳米级磁隧道结的电磁振子光谱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.19483v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Magnonics uses spin waves and their quanta, magnons, to carry and process information and offers new opportunities for computing and signal processing. Its integration with conventional electronics, however, requires scalable electrical interfaces for magnon readout. Here, we demonstrate electrical magnon spectroscopy using a 70-nm magnetic tunnel junction fabricated on a commercial 300-mm semiconductor production line. Dynamic dipolar fields generated by magnons in a magnetic vortex drive the free layer of the tunnel junction and are transduced into electrical signals through tunnelling magnetoresistance. By exploiting three-magnon splitting, we spectrally separate the magnon response from direct microwave excitation and resolve nonlinear magnon modes with linewidths down to 188 kHz at 3.59 GHz. The electrical measurements reveal spectral structure that remains unresolved in parallel Brillouin light scattering measurements. Our results establish foundry-fabricated magnetic tunnel junctions as nanoscale electrical interfaces for magnonic systems and provide a route towards their integration with semiconductor electronics.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁振学利用自旋波及其量子磁振子来携带和处理信息，并为计算和信号处理提供了新的机会。然而，它与传统电子设备的集成需要可扩展的电气接口来实现磁振子读出。在这里，我们使用在商业 300 毫米半导体生产线上制造的 70 纳米磁隧道结演示了电磁振子光谱。磁涡流中的磁振子产生的动态偶极场驱动隧道结的自由层，并通过隧道磁阻转换成电信号。通过利用三磁振子分裂，我们将磁振子响应与直接微波激励进行光谱分离，并解析线宽在 3.59 GHz 时低至 188 kHz 的非线性磁振子模式。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁振学利用自旋波及其量子磁振子来携带和处理信息，并为计算和信号处理提供了新的机会。然而，它与传统电子设备的集成需要可扩展的电气接口来实现磁振子读出。在这里，我们使用在商业 300 毫米半导体生产线上制造的 70 纳米磁隧道结演示了电磁振子光谱。磁涡流中的磁振子产生的动态偶极场驱动隧道结的自由层，并通过隧道磁阻转换成电信号。通过利用三磁振子分裂，我们将磁振子响应与直接微波激励进行光谱分离，并解析线宽在 3.59 GHz 时低至 188 kHz 的非线性磁振子模式。电测量揭示了并行布里渊光散射测量中仍未解决的光谱结构。我们的研究结果将铸造厂制造的磁隧道结建立为磁波系统的纳米级电气接口，并为其与半导体电子器件的集成提供了一条途径。

articles.title: Strain-induced Dynamic Spin-Phonon Coupling in Epitaxial RuO2 Films
articles.title_zh: 外延 RuO2 薄膜中应变诱导的动态自旋声子耦合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.23969v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Magnetic order parameters in altermagnets can couple to quantized lattice vibration via both piezomagnetic and magnetoelastic effects, leading to the renormalization of phonon dispersion. Here, we demonstrate photo-induced dynamic frequency modulation of THz phonons excited in anisotropically-strained epitaxial RuO2 thin films using ultrafast coherent phonon spectroscopy and time-resolved magneto-optic Kerr effect measurement. A coherent oscillation of a transverse acoustic phonon appears in the sub-THz range with increasing film thickness above 4 nm due to local dislocation arising from the anisotropic strain relaxation, which hosts large non-zero shear strain. Interestingly, this phonon mode exhibits a time-varying mode hardening below ~ 500 K. Furthermore, an optical phonon oscillation emerges in magnetization dynamics of the photo-induced non-equilibrium state, and it becomes significantly softened near the critical temperature, while there is no observable magneto-optic signal in fully-strain-relaxed films. Such notable dynamic frequency modulations in acoustic and optical phonons offer an opportunity to manipulate phonons in the THz range through the spin-phonon coupling controlled by epitaxial design, which can inspire the new class of altermagnetic applications in the ultrafast quantum opto-spintronics.
articles.abstract_zh: 交流磁体中的磁序参数可以通过压磁效应和磁弹性效应耦合到量子化晶格振动，从而导致声子色散的重正化。在这里，我们使用超快相干声子光谱和时间分辨磁光克尔效应测量，演示了在各向异性应变外延 RuO2 薄膜中激发的太赫兹声子的光致动态频率调制。随着薄膜厚度增加到 4 nm 以上，横向声子的相干振荡出现在亚太赫兹范围内，这是由于各向异性应变弛豫引起的局部位错，其中存在大的非零剪切应变。有趣的是，这种声子模式在~ 500 K以下表现出随时间变化的模式硬化。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 交流磁体中的磁序参数可以通过压磁效应和磁弹性效应耦合到量子化晶格振动，从而导致声子色散的重正化。在这里，我们使用超快相干声子光谱和时间分辨磁光克尔效应测量，演示了在各向异性应变外延 RuO2 薄膜中激发的太赫兹声子的光致动态频率调制。随着薄膜厚度增加到 4 nm 以上，横向声子的相干振荡出现在亚太赫兹范围内，这是由于各向异性应变弛豫引起的局部位错，其中存在大的非零剪切应变。有趣的是，这种声子模式在~ 500 K以下表现出随时间变化的模式硬化。此外，光致非平衡态的磁化动力学中出现光学声子振荡，并且在接近临界温度时显着软化，而在完全应变弛豫薄膜中没有可观察到的磁光信号。声学和光学声子中这种值得注意的动态频率调制提供了通过外延设计控制的自旋声子耦合来操纵太赫兹范围内的声子的机会，这可以激发超快量子光自旋电子学中的新型交磁应用。

articles.title: Aging and configurational memories at rough frictional interfaces
articles.title_zh: 粗糙摩擦界面的老化和构型记忆
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.14769v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Frictional interfaces retain distinct memories of how they were sheared and how long they have rested, yet rate-and-state descriptions typically compress these histories into a single state variable. Here we combine nanometer-per-second sliding experiments on rough multi-asperity contacts with different protocols to disentangle temporal and configurational memories at frictional onset. We identify a broad friction force peak associated with shear-driven reorganization of the load-bearing contact network. By contrast, holding a previously sheared system at rest in an arrested configuration produces a much narrower friction force peak that grows approximately logarithmically with hold time and relaxes over nanometer-scale slip distances. Configurational disorder without waiting regenerates only the broad peak, whereas waiting without configurational disorder generates only the aging peak. These results show that aging and configurational disorder write and read experimentally separable frictional memories, and that static friction is a protocol-dependent quantity rather than a fixed material property.
articles.abstract_zh: 摩擦界面保留了关于它们如何被剪切以及它们静止了多长时间的独特记忆，但速率和状态描述通常将这些历史压缩为单个状态变量。在这里，我们将粗糙多粗糙体接触上的纳米每秒滑动实验与不同的协议相结合，以解开摩擦开始时的时间和构型记忆。我们确定了与承载接触网络的剪切驱动重组相关的广泛摩擦力峰值。相比之下，将先前剪切的系统保持在静止状态会产生更窄的摩擦力峰值，该峰值随着保持时间近似对数增长，并在纳米级滑动距离上松弛。没有等待的构象紊乱仅再生宽峰，而没有构象紊乱的等待仅生成老化峰。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 摩擦界面保留了关于它们如何被剪切以及它们静止了多长时间的独特记忆，但速率和状态描述通常将这些历史压缩为单个状态变量。在这里，我们将粗糙多粗糙体接触上的纳米每秒滑动实验与不同的协议相结合，以解开摩擦开始时的时间和构型记忆。我们确定了与承载接触网络的剪切驱动重组相关的广泛摩擦力峰值。相比之下，将先前剪切的系统保持在静止状态会产生更窄的摩擦力峰值，该峰值随着保持时间近似对数增长，并在纳米级滑动距离上松弛。没有等待的构象紊乱仅再生宽峰，而没有构象紊乱的等待仅生成老化峰。这些结果表明，老化和构型紊乱可以写入和读取实验上可分离的摩擦记忆，并且静摩擦是一个依赖于协议的量，而不是固定的材料属性。

articles.title: Al₁₋ₓHfₓN Thin Films with Enhanced Piezoelectric Responses for GHz Surface Acoustic Wave Devices
articles.title_zh: 用于 GHz 表面声波器件的具有增强压电响应的 Al₁₋ₓHfₓN 薄膜
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.18970v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Ternary compounds obtained by alloying wurtzite AlN with transition metals have emerged as promising materials with significantly enhanced piezoelectric characteristics relative to binary AlN. The increased electromechanical coupling in these compounds boosts the performance of high-frequency acoustic devices. So far, progress has largely focused on Al₁₋ₓScₓN, which is costly and poorly compatible with complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor (CMOS) technologies. Here, we investigate aluminum hafnium nitride (Al₁₋ₓHfₓN) as a scalable and potentially CMOS-compatible alternative to Al₁₋ₓScₓN. Using reactive co-sputtering on both Si and sapphire substrates, we demonstrate wurtzite Al₁₋ₓHfₓN thin films (x ≤ 0.17) with strong c-axis texture and nearly isotropic lattice expansion upon Hf incorporation. X-ray absorption spectroscopy indicates cross-gap hybridization between N 2p and Hf 5d states, which can enhance the Born effective charge and, thereby, the piezoelectric response. Correspondingly, we observe a multifold enhancement in the piezoelectric coefficient, d₃₃, relative to AlN, despite increasing structural disorder in Al₁₋ₓHfₓN. Building on this finding, we demonstrate Al₁₋ₓHfₓN GHz surface acoustic wave (SAW) resonators that exhibit enhanced performance, as well as efficient excitation of bulk acoustic waves with low propagation losses. These results establish Al₁₋ₓHfₓN as a promising platform for next-generation high-frequency electromechanical devices, with prospects for further piezoelectric enhancements through improved epitaxy.
articles.abstract_zh: 通过将纤锌矿AlN与过渡金属合金化而获得的三元化合物已成为有前途的材料，相对于二元AlN，其压电特性显着增强。这些化合物中机电耦合的增强提高了高频声学设备的性能。到目前为止，进展主要集中在 Al₁₋ₓScₓN 上，这种材料成本高昂且与互补金属氧化物半导体 (CMOS) 技术兼容性差。在这里，我们研究氮化铝铪 (Al₁₋ₓHfₓN) 作为 Al₁₋ₓScₓN 的可扩展且潜在的 CMOS 兼容替代品。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 通过将纤锌矿AlN与过渡金属合金化而获得的三元化合物已成为有前途的材料，相对于二元AlN，其压电特性显着增强。这些化合物中机电耦合的增强提高了高频声学设备的性能。到目前为止，进展主要集中在 Al₁₋ₓScₓN 上，这种材料成本高昂且与互补金属氧化物半导体 (CMOS) 技术兼容性差。在这里，我们研究氮化铝铪 (Al₁₋ₓHfₓN) 作为 Al₁₋ₓScₓN 的可扩展且潜在的 CMOS 兼容替代品。通过在硅和蓝宝石衬底上进行反应共溅射，我们展示了纤锌矿 Al₁₋ₓHfₓN 薄膜 (x ≤ 0.17)，在 Hf 掺入后具有强 c 轴织构和近各向同性的晶格膨胀。 X射线吸收光谱表明N 2p 和Hf 5d 态之间的跨间隙杂化，这可以增强Born有效电荷，从而增强压电响应。相应地，尽管 Al₁₋ₓHfₓN 的结构无序性增加，但相对于 AlN，我们观察到压电系数 d₃₃ 成倍增加。基于这一发现，我们展示了 Al₁₋ₓHfₓN GHz 表面声波 (SAW) 谐振器，该谐振器表现出增强的性能，以及以低传播损耗有效激励体声波。这些结果使 Al₁₋ₓHfₓN 成为下一代高频机电器件的有前景的平台，并有望通过改进外延进一步增强压电性能。

articles.title: Theory of Out-of-Time-Ordered Transport
articles.title_zh: 乱序传输理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.11198v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We construct an effective field theory (EFT) that captures the universal behavior of out-of-time-order correlators (OTOCs) at late times in generic quantum many-body systems with conservation laws. The EFT hinges on a generalization of the strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking pattern adapted to out-of-time-order observables, and reduces to conventional fluctuating hydrodynamics when time-ordered observables are probed. We use the EFT to explain different power-law behavior observed in OTOCs at late times, and show that many OTOCs are entirely fixed by conventional transport data at leading order. Nevertheless, we show that a specific combination of OTOCs is sensitive to novel transport parameters, not visible in regular time-ordered correlators. We test our predictions in Hamiltonian and Floquet spin chains in one spatial dimension.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一种有效场论（EFT），它可以捕捉具有守恒定律的通用量子多体系统中后期乱序相关器（OTOC）的普遍行为。 EFT 取决于适用于无序可观测量的强到弱自发对称破缺模式的概括，并在探测时间顺序可观测量时简化为传统的脉动流体动力学。我们使用 EFT 来解释后期在 OTOC 中观察到的不同幂律行为，并表明许多 OTOC 完全由领先顺序的传统传输数据固定。尽管如此，我们表明 OTOC 的特定组合对新的传输参数敏感，这在常规时间排序相关器中不可见。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们构建了一种有效场论（EFT），它可以捕捉具有守恒定律的通用量子多体系统中后期乱序相关器（OTOC）的普遍行为。 EFT 取决于适用于无序可观测量的强到弱自发对称破缺模式的概括，并在探测时间顺序可观测量时简化为传统的脉动流体动力学。我们使用 EFT 来解释后期在 OTOC 中观察到的不同幂律行为，并表明许多 OTOC 完全由领先顺序的传统传输数据固定。尽管如此，我们表明 OTOC 的特定组合对新的传输参数敏感，这在常规时间排序相关器中不可见。我们在一个空间维度的哈密顿自旋链和 Floquet 自旋链中测试我们的预测。

articles.title: Comparing Hubbard parameters from linear-response theory and a Hartree-Fock-based approach
articles.title_zh: 比较线性响应理论中的 Hubbard 参数和基于 Hartree-Fock 的方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.16803v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Density-functional theory with on-site U and inter-site V Hubbard corrections (DFT+U+V) is widely used to predict properties of transition-metal and rare-earth compounds, but its accuracy depends critically on how these parameters are obtained. While they can be determined empirically, first-principles approaches offer better consistency, though their results can differ and a systematic comparison is lacking. Here, we compare two widely used approaches, linear-response theory (LRT) and the Hartree--Fock-based pseudohybrid functional formalism, applied to representative oxides (MnO, NiO, CoO, FeO, BaTiO₃, ZnO, and ZrO₂). For partially occupied transition-metal d states, both methods yield comparable U values, but they differ significantly for nearly empty or fully filled d shells. For O-2p states, LRT systematically predicts large U values (sim 10~eV), whereas the pseudohybrid approach gives system-dependent values. Even larger differences appear for the inter-site V: the former yields small values (<1~eV), while the latter gives larger values (sim 3~eV) due to its dependence on charge redistribution. We further show that the pseudopotential choice, which defines Hubbard projectors, affects the parameters and their agreement. Overall, while parallels between these two methods exist, they rely on different assumptions, leading to variations in predictions of material properties.
articles.abstract_zh: 采用位点 U 和位点间 V 哈伯德校正的密度泛函理论 (DFT+U+V) 广泛用于预测过渡金属和稀土化合物的性质，但其准确性主要取决于如何获得这些参数。虽然它们可以凭经验确定，但第一原理方法提供了更好的一致性，尽管它们的结果可能不同并且缺乏系统的比较。在这里，我们比较了两种广泛使用的方法，线性响应理论 (LRT) 和基于 Hartree--Fock 的伪混合泛函形式主义，应用于代表性氧化物（MnO、NiO、CoO、FeO、BaTiO₃、ZnO 和 ZrO2）。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 采用位点 U 和位点间 V 哈伯德校正的密度泛函理论 (DFT+U+V) 广泛用于预测过渡金属和稀土化合物的性质，但其准确性主要取决于如何获得这些参数。虽然它们可以凭经验确定，但第一原理方法提供了更好的一致性，尽管它们的结果可能不同并且缺乏系统的比较。在这里，我们比较了两种广泛使用的方法，线性响应理论 (LRT) 和基于 Hartree--Fock 的伪混合泛函形式主义，应用于代表性氧化物（MnO、NiO、CoO、FeO、BaTiO₃、ZnO 和 ZrO2）。对于部分占据的过渡金属 d 态，两种方法都会产生可比的 U 值，但对于几乎空或完全填充的 d 壳，它们存在显着差异。对于 O-2p 态，LRT 系统地预测大 U 值 (sim 10~eV)，而伪混合方法给出系统相关值。位点间 V 出现更大的差异：前者产生较小的值 (<1~eV)，而后者由于其依赖于电荷重新分布而给出较大的值 (sim 3~eV)。我们进一步表明，定义哈伯德投影仪的赝势选择会影响参数及其一致性。总体而言，虽然这两种方法之间存在相似之处，但它们依赖于不同的假设，导致材料特性的预测存在差异。

articles.title: Variational study of the magnetization plateaus in the spin-1/2 kagome Heisenberg antiferromagnet: An approach from vision transformer neural quantum states
articles.title_zh: 自旋 1/2 kagome 海森堡反铁磁体中磁化平台的变分研究：来自视觉变换器神经量子态的方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.12998v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We analyze the magnetization curve of the spin-1/2 kagome Heisenberg model in a magnetic field. Using state-of-the-art variational wave functions based on neural networks, we confirm the presence of robust magnetization plateaus at m=1/3, 5/9 and 7/9 of the saturation value, stabilized by a spontaneous symmetry breaking of lattice translations with a sqrt3× sqrt3 unit cell. Regarding the more challenging m=1/9 plateau, we find two competing valence bond crystals depending on the system size, both breaking translation as well as point group symmetries and with a larger 3× 3 unit cell. Such quantum states with local modulations of the magnetization average values could be observed experimentally in the near future.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们分析了自旋 1/2 kagome 海森堡模型在磁场中的磁化曲线。使用基于神经网络的最先进的变分波函数，我们确认在饱和值的 m=1/3、5/9 和 7/9 处存在鲁棒的磁化平台，并通过 sqrt3×sqrt3 晶胞的晶格平移的自发对称破缺来稳定。对于更具挑战性的 m=1/9 平台，我们发现了两个竞争的价键晶体，具体取决于系统尺寸，它们都破坏了平移和点群对称性，并且具有更大的 3×3 晶胞。这种具有磁化平均值局部调制的量子态可以在不久的将来通过实验观察到。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们分析了自旋 1/2 kagome 海森堡模型在磁场中的磁化曲线。使用基于神经网络的最先进的变分波函数，我们确认在饱和值的 m=1/3、5/9 和 7/9 处存在鲁棒的磁化平台，并通过 sqrt3×sqrt3 晶胞的晶格平移的自发对称破缺来稳定。对于更具挑战性的 m=1/9 平台，我们发现了两个竞争的价键晶体，具体取决于系统尺寸，它们都破坏了平移和点群对称性，并且具有更大的 3×3 晶胞。这种具有磁化平均值局部调制的量子态可以在不久的将来通过实验观察到。

articles.title: Superconducting orbital diode effect in SN bilayers
articles.title_zh: SN双层中的超导轨道二极管效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.09504v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study the superconducting diode effect (SDE) in a diffusive superconductor - normal metal (SN) bilayer subjected to an in-plane magnetic field. The supercurrent flows along the layers, perpendicular to the field. The SDE, manifested as an asymmetry in the critical (depairing) currents and kinetic inductance for opposite current directions, arises from an orbital mechanism due to the inhomogeneous distribution of the Meissner currents caused by a spatially varying superfluid density. Recently, Levichev et al. [Phys. Rev. B 108, 094517 (2023)] demonstrated the realization of this effect in such a structure, supporting numerical calculations for an ideal interface with an experiment. In this work, we investigate the influence of a nonideal interface with finite resistance on the SDE. Employing an analytical approach, we focus on limiting cases corresponding to weak intralayer inhomogeneities. We find that the strength of the SDE depends nonmonotonically on the interface resistance when the bilayer thickness is small compared to the coherence length. Remarkably, a nonideal interface can enhance the SDE compared to the ideal case. We also demonstrate that, in the vicinity of the phase transition, a regime of unidirectional superconductivity can be realized, in which superconductivity exists only within an interval of finite currents flowing in the same direction.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了受面内磁场影响的扩散超导体 - 普通金属 (SN) 双层中的超导二极管效应 (SDE)。超电流沿层流动，垂直于场。 SDE 表现为临界（配对）电流和相反电流方向的动感电感的不对称性，它是由于空间变化的超流体密度导致迈斯纳电流的不均匀分布而产生的轨道机制。最近，列维切夫等人。 [物理。 Rev. B 108, 094517 (2023)]演示了在这种结构中实现这种效应，支持通过实验对理想界面进行数值计算。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了受面内磁场影响的扩散超导体 - 普通金属 (SN) 双层中的超导二极管效应 (SDE)。超电流沿层流动，垂直于场。 SDE 表现为临界（配对）电流和相反电流方向的动感电感的不对称性，它是由于空间变化的超流体密度导致迈斯纳电流的不均匀分布而产生的轨道机制。最近，列维切夫等人。 [物理。 Rev. B 108, 094517 (2023)]演示了在这种结构中实现这种效应，支持通过实验对理想界面进行数值计算。在这项工作中，我们研究了具有有限电阻的非理想界面对 SDE 的影响。采用分析方法，我们专注于与弱层内不均匀性相对应的限制情况。我们发现，当双层厚度比相干长度小时，SDE 的强度非单调地依赖于界面电阻。值得注意的是，与理想情况相比，非理想界面可以增强 SDE。我们还证明，在相变附近，可以实现单向超导状态，其中超导仅存在于沿同一方向流动的有限电流的区间内。

articles.title: Dynamical spin-nematic correlation in a transverse field Ising chain with non-Hermitian Gamma interaction
articles.title_zh: 具有非厄米伽马相互作用的横向场伊辛链中的动态自旋向列相关
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.17700v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the effect of non-Hermitian Gamma interaction on the phase transitions and magnetic correlations for the transverse field Ising chain. We demonstrate that apart from the gapped antiferromagnetic and paramagnetic phases, there is a gapless phase induced by parity-time symmetry breaking, where the system exhibits long-range and short-range spin-nematic correlations in different regions divided by the quantum critical line determined from the correlation function and the subsystem entanglement entropy. Furthermore, we reveal that the parity-time symmetry breaking leads to the emergence of dynamical spin-nematic correlation, which also suggests a way of characterizing the spin-nematic map through non-equilibrium dynamics. Our findings show rich quantum phases stem from the competition among the Ising interaction, transverse field and non-Hermitian Gamma interaction, as well as providing a scheme for generating spin-nematic correlation in the spin chain.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究了非厄米伽马相互作用对横向场伊辛链的相变和磁相关性的影响。我们证明，除了有隙的反铁磁和顺磁相之外，还存在由宇称时间对称性破缺引起的无带隙相，其中系统在由相关函数和子系统纠缠熵确定的量子临界线划分的不同区域中表现出长程和短程自旋向列相关性。此外，我们揭示了宇称时间对称性破缺导致了动态自旋向列相关性的出现，这也提出了一种通过非平衡动力学来表征自旋向列图的方法。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了非厄米伽马相互作用对横向场伊辛链的相变和磁相关性的影响。我们证明，除了有隙的反铁磁和顺磁相之外，还存在由宇称时间对称性破缺引起的无带隙相，其中系统在由相关函数和子系统纠缠熵确定的量子临界线划分的不同区域中表现出长程和短程自旋向列相关性。此外，我们揭示了宇称时间对称性破缺导致了动态自旋向列相关性的出现，这也提出了一种通过非平衡动力学来表征自旋向列图的方法。我们的研究结果表明，丰富的量子相源于伊辛相互作用、横向场和非厄米伽马相互作用之间的竞争，并提供了在自旋链中产生自旋向列相关的方案。

articles.title: The odd-parity altermagnetism induced reconstruction of the Chern-insulating phase in Haldane-Hubbard model
articles.title_zh: 奇宇称交变磁力诱导 Haldane-Hubbard 模型中陈绝缘相的重建
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.25537v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Odd-parity altermagnetism(ALM) extends compensated collinear magnetism beyond the even-parity spin splitting of conventional altermagnets, but its role in correlated topological phases remains largely unexplored. Using the cluster slave-spin method, we show that the odd-parity ALM appearing in the ALM Chern-insulating phase of Haldane-Hubbard model significantly reconstructs the local topology in the conventional Chern-insulating phase, while the total Chern number remains unchanged compared to the Chern-insulating phase. The Berry curvature becomes spin and valley selective; zigzag ribbons develop chiral-symmetry-breaking edge states; while armchair ribbons remain inversion symmetric. The optical response mirrors this separation between the local reconstruction and the global topology: low-energy spectra are governed by quasiparticles near the gap, whereas the low-frequency Hall conductivity stays quantized, σᵣₘ Tᵤₚₐᵣᵣₒw(Ω→ 0)=σᵣₘ Tdₒwₙₐᵣᵣₒw(Ω→ 0)=e²/h. These results establish the Haldane-Hubbard model as a minimal correlated platform for odd-parity altermagnetic topology.
articles.abstract_zh: 奇宇称交变磁体（ALM）将补偿共线磁性扩展到传统交变磁体的偶宇称自旋分裂之外，但其在相关拓扑相中的作用在很大程度上仍未被探索。使用簇从自旋方法，我们发现 Haldane-Hubbard 模型的 ALM Chern 绝缘相中出现的奇奇偶 ALM 显着地重构了传统 Chern 绝缘相中的局部拓扑，而总 Chern 数与 Chern 绝缘相相比保持不变。贝里曲率变得自旋和谷选择性；之字形带形成手性对称性破缺的边缘态；而扶手椅丝带则保持倒置对称。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 奇宇称交变磁体（ALM）将补偿共线磁性扩展到传统交变磁体的偶宇称自旋分裂之外，但其在相关拓扑相中的作用在很大程度上仍未被探索。使用簇从自旋方法，我们发现 Haldane-Hubbard 模型的 ALM Chern 绝缘相中出现的奇奇偶 ALM 显着地重构了传统 Chern 绝缘相中的局部拓扑，而总 Chern 数与 Chern 绝缘相相比保持不变。贝里曲率变得自旋和谷选择性；之字形带形成手性对称性破缺的边缘态；而扶手椅丝带则保持倒置对称。光学响应反映了局部重建和全局拓扑之间的这种分离：低能谱由间隙附近的准粒子控制，而低频霍尔电导率保持量子化， σᵣₘ Tᵤₚₐᵣᵣₒw(Ω→ 0)=σᵣₘ Tdₒwₙₐᵣᵣₒw(Ω→ 0)=e²/h。这些结果将 Haldane-Hubbard 模型确立为奇宇称交变磁拓扑的最小相关平台。

articles.title: Minimum energy paths for defect annihilation in finite dodecagonal quasicrystal clusters
articles.title_zh: 有限十二角准晶簇中缺陷湮灭的最小能量路径
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.13253v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Defect repair in quasicrystals involves local structural rearrangements on a complex potential energy landscape. Here, we combine the string method with the spring pair method to compute a minimum energy path connecting a locally defective finite dodecagonal quasicrystal cluster to a locally repaired reference configuration in the Lennard-Jones--Gauss particle model. The computed path contains seven local minima connected through six transition states. A detailed analysis of one defective region resolves three successive stages: a phason flip, aggregation of neighboring shield-like defects, and decomposition of the aggregated motif. The phason flip restores the local outer-ring structure and relocates a shield-like defect into the interior. Subsequent collective rearrangements remove the defective motifs and yield a net decrease in the local interaction-energy measure together with an increase in local bond-orientational order. These results provide a microscopic description of a specific defect-repair pathway on the potential energy surface of a finite dodecagonal quasicrystal cluster.
articles.abstract_zh: 准晶体的缺陷修复涉及复杂势能景观上的局部结构重排。在这里，我们将弦法与弹簧对法相结合，计算连接局部有缺陷的有限十二边形准晶簇与 Lennard-Jones-Gauss 粒子模型中局部修复的参考配置的最小能量路径。计算的路径包含通过六个过渡状态连接的七个局部最小值。对一个缺陷区域的详细分析解决了三个连续阶段：相子翻转、邻近屏蔽状缺陷的聚合以及聚合基序的分解。相子翻转恢复了局部外环结构，并将盾状缺陷重新定位到内部。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 准晶体的缺陷修复涉及复杂势能景观上的局部结构重排。在这里，我们将弦法与弹簧对法相结合，计算连接局部有缺陷的有限十二边形准晶簇与 Lennard-Jones-Gauss 粒子模型中局部修复的参考配置的最小能量路径。计算的路径包含通过六个过渡状态连接的七个局部最小值。对一个缺陷区域的详细分析解决了三个连续阶段：相子翻转、邻近屏蔽状缺陷的聚合以及聚合基序的分解。相子翻转恢复了局部外环结构，并将盾状缺陷重新定位到内部。随后的集体重排消除了有缺陷的基序，并产生局部相互作用能量测量的净减少以及局部键取向顺序的增加。这些结果提供了有限十二边形准晶簇势能表面上特定缺陷修复途径的微观描述。

articles.title: Generalized Model Fractional Quantum Hall States on Lattices
articles.title_zh: 晶格上的广义模型分数量子霍尔态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.13978v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Model wavefunctions are essential for studying fractional quantum Hall (FQH) phases. They reveal the intricate connections between model FQH states, conformal field theory, Jack polynomials, and pseudopotential Hamiltonians. However, most model wavefunctions studied so far are in the continuum. In this work, we construct model wavefunctions and the corresponding exact parent Hamiltonians for the entire Zₖ Read--Rezayi series on a lattice. Our model wavefunctions obey a generalized clustering rule implemented on the lattice, which we find is encoded in the Macdonald polynomials providing a unified algebraic description of our lattice-specific model states. This ensures that the model states are exact zero-energy ground states of local density interactions and exhibit an infinitely large gap in the particle entanglement spectrum. Numerical studies of the Laughlin and Moore--Read series find the expected zero-mode and one-flux quasihole counting and positive energy gaps at the system sizes studied, and the available finite-size scaling suggests nonzero thermodynamic gaps. Tuning the model interaction range can drive a phase transition out of the FQH phase. Our work not only advances the theoretical understanding of the underlying mathematical structure of lattice model FQH states but also is potentially useful for designing exotic many-body phases in engineered quantum platforms.
articles.abstract_zh: 模型波函数对于研究分数量子霍尔 (FQH) 相位至关重要。它们揭示了模型 FQH 态、共形场论、Jack 多项式和赝势哈密顿量之间的复杂联系。然而，迄今为止研究的大多数模型波函数都是连续体。在这项工作中，我们为格子上的整个 Zₖ Read--Rezayi 级数构建了模型波函数和相应的精确父哈密顿量。我们的模型波函数遵循在晶格上实现的广义聚类规则，我们发现该规则被编码在麦克唐纳多项式中，为我们的晶格特定模型状态提供了统一的代数描述。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 模型波函数对于研究分数量子霍尔 (FQH) 相位至关重要。它们揭示了模型 FQH 态、共形场论、Jack 多项式和赝势哈密顿量之间的复杂联系。然而，迄今为止研究的大多数模型波函数都是连续体。在这项工作中，我们为格子上的整个 Zₖ Read--Rezayi 级数构建了模型波函数和相应的精确父哈密顿量。我们的模型波函数遵循在晶格上实现的广义聚类规则，我们发现该规则被编码在麦克唐纳多项式中，为我们的晶格特定模型状态提供了统一的代数描述。这确保了模型状态是局域密度相互作用的精确零能量基态，并且在粒子纠缠谱中表现出无限大的间隙。劳克林和摩尔-里德系列的数值研究发现了预期的零模式和一通量准空穴计数以及所研究的系统尺寸下的正能隙，并且可用的有限尺寸标度表明了非零热力学间隙。调整模型相互作用范围可以驱动 FQH 相的相变。我们的工作不仅增进了对晶格模型 FQH 态的基础数学结构的理论理解，而且对于在工程量子平台中设计奇异的多体相也具有潜在的用途。

articles.title: Thermodynamics of classifiers
articles.title_zh: 分类器的热力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.24365v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The rise of artificial intelligence has led to a growing demand for computational power. In this situation, energy-efficient computing methods are being actively investigated, which raises a fundamental question: what is the relationship between computational error and thermodynamic cost? Here, we derive the error-cost trade-off in the binary classifier by considering classification based on nonequilibrium thermodynamics. We derive trade-off relations showing that classification error cannot be lower than fundamental bounds set by thermodynamic quantities: entropy production, which measures irreversibility, and dynamical activity, which quantifies the activity of the system. Our results show that when entropy production or dynamical activity vanishes, the classification error reaches 1/2, equivalent to random guessing, whereas greater thermodynamic costs enable lower error. The results establish a quantitative trade-off in physical information processing, potentially leading to the development of energy-efficient computing devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 人工智能的兴起导致对计算能力的需求不断增长。在这种情况下，节能计算方法正在被积极研究，这就提出了一个基本问题：计算误差和热力学成本之间的关系是什么？在这里，我们通过考虑基于非平衡热力学的分类来得出二元分类器中的错误成本权衡。我们得出的权衡关系表明分类误差不能低于热力学量设定的基本界限：衡量不可逆性的熵产生和量化系统活动的动态活动。我们的结果表明，当熵产生或动态活动消失时，分类误差达到 1/2，相当于随机猜测，而更大的热力学成本可以降低误差。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 人工智能的兴起导致对计算能力的需求不断增长。在这种情况下，节能计算方法正在被积极研究，这就提出了一个基本问题：计算误差和热力学成本之间的关系是什么？在这里，我们通过考虑基于非平衡热力学的分类来得出二元分类器中的错误成本权衡。我们得出的权衡关系表明分类误差不能低于热力学量设定的基本界限：衡量不可逆性的熵产生和量化系统活动的动态活动。我们的结果表明，当熵产生或动态活动消失时，分类误差达到 1/2，相当于随机猜测，而更大的热力学成本可以降低误差。结果建立了物理信息处理的定量权衡，有可能导致节能计算设备的发展。

articles.title: Imaging Surface Magnetization in Altermagnetic MnTe Films
articles.title_zh: 交变磁性 MnTe 薄膜的表面磁化成像
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.25241v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Altermagnets with pronounced spin-splitting band structure, unconventional magnetic and crystal symmetries, and exotic magneto-transport properties have received immense interest in cutting-edge spintronics, materials science, and condensed matter physics research. Microscopic imaging of spontaneous magnetic domains and phases in altermagnets constitutes an important step for investigating their underlying material properties, mechanisms, and spin behaviors. Taking advantage of scanning-probe quantum microscopy, here we report nanoscale quantum sensing of a prototypical altermagnet candidate α-MnTe. We visualize evanescent magnetization and the associated magnetic domains in epitaxial MnTe films, which allows external magnetic fields to control the intrinsic altermagnetic order and configurations. By evaluating a series of MnTe films with different thicknesses down to the atomic scale, we further present evidence for the interfacial origin of the observed weak magnetization and show its correlation with the anomalous Hall effect in MnTe film. Our results advance the current understanding of emergent altermagnetism, providing insights into future material design of altermagnet-integrated spintronic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 具有明显自旋分裂能带结构、非常规磁性和晶体对称性以及奇异磁输运特性的交替磁体引起了尖端自旋电子学、材料科学和凝聚态物理研究的巨大兴趣。交流磁体中自发磁畴和相的显微成像是研究其潜在材料特性、机制和自旋行为的重要一步。利用扫描探针量子显微镜，我们在这里报告了原型交替磁体候选 α-MnTe 的纳米级量子传感。我们可视化外延 MnTe 薄膜中的瞬逝磁化强度和相关磁畴，这允许外部磁场控制内在的交变磁序和配置。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 具有明显自旋分裂能带结构、非常规磁性和晶体对称性以及奇异磁输运特性的交替磁体引起了尖端自旋电子学、材料科学和凝聚态物理研究的巨大兴趣。交流磁体中自发磁畴和相的显微成像是研究其潜在材料特性、机制和自旋行为的重要一步。利用扫描探针量子显微镜，我们在这里报告了原型交替磁体候选 α-MnTe 的纳米级量子传感。我们可视化外延 MnTe 薄膜中的瞬逝磁化强度和相关磁畴，这允许外部磁场控制内在的交变磁序和配置。通过在原子尺度上评估一系列不同厚度的 MnTe 薄膜，我们进一步提供了所观察到的弱磁化强度的界面起源的证据，并显示了其与 MnTe 薄膜中反常霍尔效应的相关性。我们的研究结果推进了当前对新兴交变磁体的理解，为未来交变磁体集成自旋电子器件的材料设计提供了见解。

articles.title: Tensor network study of deconfined quantum criticality in a one-dimensional spin-phonon model
articles.title_zh: 一维自旋声子模型中解禁量子临界性的张量网络研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.06605v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Deconfined quantum critical points (DQCPs) describe continuous transitions between ordered phases beyond the Landau paradigm. A simple example is the Néel antiferromagnet (AFM) to valence bond solid (VBS) transition in a 1D antiferromagnetic J₁-J₂ model. In analogy to the spin-Peierls instability of critical spin chains, DQCPs are predicted to be unstable towards lattice distortions below a critical phonon frequency. In this work, we use tensor network simulations to investigate this instability in the antiferromagnetic J₁-J₂ model coupled to lattice vibrations. We confirm the stability of DQCP for large phonon frequencies and demonstrate that the transition turns strongly first-order below a critical frequency. The instability is caused by a reduction of the Luttinger parameter due to spin-phonon interactions and we identify the effective theory of the behavior as the double sine-Gordon model. The same effective theory is known to describe the classical Ashkin-Teller model, which enables us to show that the critical endpoint is in the four-state Potts universality class. We argue based on non-linear bosonization that the sign of the double-frequency term is fixed, which provides a microscopic justification for the first-order transition. Furthermore, we provide quantitative numerical scaling results for the phonon spectral function, offering an experimental signature to probe DQCP-phonon coupling in low-dimensional materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 解禁量子临界点 (DQCP) 描述了超出朗道范式的有序相之间的连续转变。一个简单的例子是一维反铁磁 J1-J2 模型中的尼尔反铁磁体 (AFM) 到价键固体 (VBS) 的转变。与临界自旋链的自旋-佩尔斯不稳定性类似，DQCP 预计在低于临界声子频率时对晶格畸变不稳定。在这项工作中，我们使用张量网络模拟来研究与晶格振动耦合的反铁磁 J1-J2 模型中的这种不稳定性。我们确认了 DQCP 对于大声子频率的稳定性，并证明过渡在临界频率以下强烈转变为一阶。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 解禁量子临界点 (DQCP) 描述了超出朗道范式的有序相之间的连续转变。一个简单的例子是一维反铁磁 J1-J2 模型中的尼尔反铁磁体 (AFM) 到价键固体 (VBS) 的转变。与临界自旋链的自旋-佩尔斯不稳定性类似，DQCP 预计在低于临界声子频率时对晶格畸变不稳定。在这项工作中，我们使用张量网络模拟来研究与晶格振动耦合的反铁磁 J1-J2 模型中的这种不稳定性。我们确认了 DQCP 对于大声子频率的稳定性，并证明过渡在临界频率以下强烈转变为一阶。这种不稳定性是由自旋声子相互作用引起的 Luttinger 参数减小引起的，我们将这种行为的有效理论确定为双正弦戈登模型。已知相同的有效理论可以描述经典的 Ashkin-Teller 模型，这使我们能够证明关键端点位于四态 Potts 普遍性类别中。我们基于非线性玻色化认为双频项的符号是固定的，这为一阶跃迁提供了微观依据。此外，我们还提供了声子谱函数的定量数值缩放结果，为探测低维材料中的 DQCP-声子耦合提供了实验特征。

articles.title: Mass weighting algorithm optimizes Fourier-based physics-informed neural network in adhesive contact mechanics
articles.title_zh: 质量加权算法优化粘合接触力学中基于傅里叶物理的神经网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.04288v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) for elastic contact mechanics suffer from a spectral stiffness imbalance,that is, the elastic kernel grows linearly with wave number, causing short-wavelength modes to dominate gradient updates and stall convergence of the macroscopic deformation. We introduce a spectral preconditioning strategy that reweights loss gradients with respect to displacements in Fourier space before back-propagation, amplifying low wavenumber components through a mass weighting (MW) function while suppressing sub-grid noise via a built-in low-pass filter. Applied to adhesive line contact problems, the mass weighted PINN reaches machine-zero residual loss within 400 Adam iterations for specified benchmark, whereas the reference benchmark stalls at three orders of magnitude higher loss. The converged displacement and contact stress fields agree quantitatively with Green's function molecular dynamics (GFMD) solutions for both smooth Hertz contact at pressures spanning tension to compression and rough surfaces with roughness covering several decades of wavelength. The method operates directly on a uniform real-space grid, requires no explicit Green's function integration or quadrature rules, and is formulated entirely in terms of minimising a scalar energy function. Extension to two-dimensional rough surfaces is direct, as both the Fourier elastic energy and the spectral preconditioner depend only on the wave-number magnitude.
articles.abstract_zh: 用于弹性接触力学的物理信息神经网络（PINN）存在谱刚度不平衡的问题，即弹性核随波数线性增长，导致短波长模式主导梯度更新和宏观变形的失速收敛。我们引入了一种光谱预处理策略，该策略在反向传播之前根据傅里叶空间中的位移重新加权损失梯度，通过质量加权（MW）函数放大低波数分量，同时通过内置低通滤波器抑制子网格噪声。应用于粘合线接触问题时，质量加权 PINN 在指定基准的 400 Adam 迭代内达到机器零残余损耗，而参考基准在高出三个数量级的损耗时停滞不前。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 用于弹性接触力学的物理信息神经网络（PINN）存在谱刚度不平衡的问题，即弹性核随波数线性增长，导致短波长模式主导梯度更新和宏观变形的失速收敛。我们引入了一种光谱预处理策略，该策略在反向传播之前根据傅里叶空间中的位移重新加权损失梯度，通过质量加权（MW）函数放大低波数分量，同时通过内置低通滤波器抑制子网格噪声。应用于粘合线接触问题时，质量加权 PINN 在指定基准的 400 Adam 迭代内达到机器零残余损耗，而参考基准在高出三个数量级的损耗时停滞不前。收敛的位移和接触应力场与格林函数分子动力学 (GFMD) 解决方案在数量上一致，无论是在拉伸到压缩的压力下的平滑赫兹接触，还是粗糙度覆盖数十个波长的粗糙表面。该方法直接在均匀的实空间网格上运行，不需要明确的格林函数积分或求积规则，并且完全根据最小化标量能量函数来制定。扩展到二维粗糙表面是直接的，因为傅立叶弹性能和光谱预处理器仅取决于波数幅度。

articles.title: Majorana interface states in anisotropic and tilted Dirac and Weyl systems
articles.title_zh: 各向异性和倾斜狄拉克和韦尔系统中的马约拉纳界面态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.19707v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Anisotropy and cone tilt change how Majorana states propagate along an interface and decay away from it. We derive a two-dimensional Majorana surface Hamiltonian from a fully gapped three-dimensional superconductor, with the surface mass generated by the relative phase between triplet and singlet pairing. For a mass domain wall on this surface, we obtain the wave function, propagation velocity, and localization length of the resulting one-dimensional channel for a general invertible velocity tensor and an arbitrary wall orientation. The product of propagation speed and localization length is independent of wall orientation in the anisotropic model. For a smooth closed channel without a vortex, the propagation time around the wall determines the lowest excitation energy. For a tilted surface cone, the normal and parallel components of tilt affect confinement and propagation differently. We also solve a separate three-dimensional Weyl model with uniform singlet pairing and a reversing exchange field. In the regime supporting interface states, its bulk remains gapless. At zero chemical potential, two states confined perpendicular to the wall and propagating within its plane have the same dispersion over a finite momentum interval. Numerical diagonalization confirms the analytical energies and wave functions.
articles.abstract_zh: 各向异性和锥体倾斜改变了马约拉纳态沿着界面传播和远离界面的衰减方式。我们从完全有隙的三维超导体中推导出二维马约拉纳表面哈密顿量，其表面质量由三线态和单线态配对之间的相对相位产生。对于该表面上的质量畴壁，我们获得了一般可逆速度张量和任意壁方向的波函数、传播速度和所得一维通道的局域化长度。传播速度和定位长度的乘积与各向异性模型中的壁方向无关。对于没有涡流的平滑封闭通道，绕壁的传播时间决定了最低的激发能量。对于倾斜的表面锥体，倾斜的法向分量和平行分量对限制和传播的影响不同。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 各向异性和锥体倾斜改变了马约拉纳态沿着界面传播和远离界面的衰减方式。我们从完全有隙的三维超导体中推导出二维马约拉纳表面哈密顿量，其表面质量由三线态和单线态配对之间的相对相位产生。对于该表面上的质量畴壁，我们获得了一般可逆速度张量和任意壁方向的波函数、传播速度和所得一维通道的局域化长度。传播速度和定位长度的乘积与各向异性模型中的壁方向无关。对于没有涡流的平滑封闭通道，绕壁的传播时间决定了最低的激发能量。对于倾斜的表面锥体，倾斜的法向分量和平行分量对限制和传播的影响不同。我们还求解了一个具有均匀单线态配对和反向交换场的独立三维 Weyl 模型。在支持界面态的体系中，其体积仍然是无间隙的。在零化学势下，垂直于壁并在其平面内传播的两种状态在有限动量区间内具有相同的色散。数值对角化证实了解析能量和波函数。

articles.title: Asphericity lifts the degeneracy among ordering mechanisms on curved surfaces
articles.title_zh: 非球面性提高了曲面排序机制的简并性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27520v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Spherical surfaces conceal the one-body signature of particle organization: area-uniform, conductor, and curvature-weighted measures coincide there, so the ordering mechanism leaves no trace in the density. Hard spheres and Coulomb charges confined to the sphere thus produce identical mean densities, and distinctions between their particle arrangements appear only in many-body correlations. Aspherical deformation lifts this degeneracy, and we show that on an ellipsoid, different ordering mechanisms separate by virtue of a single exponent p of the distance from the shell center to its tangent plane. To leading order in deformation, the characteristic exponent p can be obtained both from the quadrupole of the spherical structure factor and from the radius of gyration. Two interaction families demonstrate how this can be realized in practice: the Riesz s-energy, whose limiting measure is determined by the power s and exhibits a transition at s=d=2, and the screened Coulomb potential, whose measure and thus the characteristic exponent are tuned continuously by the salt concentration. The value of the characteristic exponent p positions the arrangement of particles between the conductor and packing limits, and its response to a control parameter such as salt concentration can be used experimentally to identify the interaction family.
articles.abstract_zh: 球形表面隐藏了颗粒组织的一体特征：面积均匀、导体和曲率加权测量在那里重合，因此排序机制在密度中不会留下任何痕迹。因此，硬球和限制在球内的库仑电荷产生相同的平均密度，并且它们的粒子排列之间的区别仅出现在多体关联中。非球面变形提升了这种简并性，我们表明，在椭球体上，不同的排序机制凭借从壳中心到其切平面的距离的单个指数 p 来分离。对于变形的主阶，特征指数p既可以从球形结构因子的四极杆中获得，也可以从回转半径中获得。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 球形表面隐藏了颗粒组织的一体特征：面积均匀、导体和曲率加权测量在那里重合，因此排序机制在密度中不会留下任何痕迹。因此，硬球和限制在球内的库仑电荷产生相同的平均密度，并且它们的粒子排列之间的区别仅出现在多体关联中。非球面变形提升了这种简并性，我们表明，在椭球体上，不同的排序机制凭借从壳中心到其切平面的距离的单个指数 p 来分离。对于变形的主阶，特征指数p既可以从球形结构因子的四极杆中获得，也可以从回转半径中获得。两个相互作用族演示了如何在实践中实现这一点：Riesz s-能量，其限制测量由功率 s 决定，并在 s=d=2 处呈现跃迁；以及屏蔽库仑势，其测量和特征指数由盐浓度连续调节。特征指数 p 的值将粒子的排列定位在导体和填充极限之间，并且它对控制参数（例如盐浓度）的响应可以通过实验来识别相互作用族。

articles.title: Probing Antiferromagnetic Hysteresis on Programmable Quantum Annealers
articles.title_zh: 探测可编程量子退火器上的反铁磁磁滞
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.17779v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Using programmable analog quantum annealing processors, we implement a sampling-based magnetic hysteresis protocol to probe the counterintuitive notion of magnetic memory in antiferromagnetic models. A key component of this protocol responsible for the hysteresis is a transverse field, which enables state transitions, while the longitudinal magnetic field sweep is done via a longitudinal control field. We observe intriguing non-monotonic magnetization, alongside full saturation and reversal of the hysteresis curve, Barkhausen-like noise, as well as emergent magnetic domains mediated by quantum fluctuations that give rise to the magnetic memory effect in antiferromagnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 使用可编程模拟量子退火处理器，我们实现了基于采样的磁滞协议来探测反铁磁模型中磁存储器的反直觉概念。该协议负责磁滞的关键组成部分是横向场，它能够实现状态转换，而纵向磁场扫描是通过纵向控制场完成的。我们观察到有趣的非单调磁化，以及磁滞曲线的完全饱和和反转、类巴克豪森噪声，以及由量子涨落介导的新兴磁畴，从而在反铁磁体中产生磁记忆效应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 使用可编程模拟量子退火处理器，我们实现了基于采样的磁滞协议来探测反铁磁模型中磁存储器的反直觉概念。该协议负责磁滞的关键组成部分是横向场，它能够实现状态转换，而纵向磁场扫描是通过纵向控制场完成的。我们观察到有趣的非单调磁化，以及磁滞曲线的完全饱和和反转、类巴克豪森噪声，以及由量子涨落介导的新兴磁畴，从而在反铁磁体中产生磁记忆效应。

articles.title: Characterization of Feshbach resonances in ⁶Li-⁷Li using improved interaction potentials
articles.title_zh: 使用改进的相互作用势表征 ⁶Li-⁷Li 中的 Feshbach 共振
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.02361v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We characterize Feshbach resonances in all isotopologues of the Li-Li system with improved interaction potentials. Starting from spectroscopically accurate Morse/long-range (MLR) potential-energy curves for the singlet (X¹Σ⁺) and triplet (a³Σ⁺) electronic states of Li₂, we apply small phenomenological inner-wall adjustments (following Julienne and Hutson, Phys. Rev. A 89, 052715 (2014), arXiv:1404.2623v3) and fit the resulting potentials to threshold measurements for the ⁶Li-⁶Li and ⁷Li-⁷Li isotopologues, including binding energies, scattering lengths, and Feshbach resonance positions. Using the optimized potentials in coupled-channels scattering calculations, we predict and characterize s-wave Feshbach resonances in the ⁶Li-⁷Li isotopologue. In its lowest-energy hyperfine channel, all resonances are narrow (sim 0.01-0.1 G), strongly closed-channel dominated, and predominantly triplet in electronic spin character, in marked contrast to the homonuclear systems. These results provide a foundation for designing Raman optical-transfer pathways to produce ultracold Li₂ molecules in deeply bound rovibrational levels of both the X¹Σ⁺ and a³Σ⁺ potentials across all three isotopologues.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们表征了Li-Li系统所有同位素中具有改善的相互作用势的Feshbach共振。从Li ₂的单重态（ X ¹ Σ恤）和三重态（ a ³ Σ恤）的光谱精确的Morse/远程（ MLR ）势能曲线开始，我们应用了小的现象学内壁调整（遵循Julienne和Hutson ， Phys. Rev.A 89, 052715 (2014), arXiv: 1404.2623v3) ，并将所得电位拟合为恤锂同位素和恤锂同位素的阈值测量值，包括结合能、散射长度和费什巴赫共振位置。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们表征了Li-Li系统所有同位素中具有改善的相互作用势的Feshbach共振。从Li ₂的单重态（ X ¹ Σ恤）和三重态（ a ³ Σ恤）的光谱精确的Morse/远程（ MLR ）势能曲线开始，我们应用了小的现象学内壁调整（遵循Julienne和Hutson ， Phys. Rev.A 89, 052715 (2014), arXiv: 1404.2623v3) ，并将所得电位拟合为恤锂同位素和恤锂同位素的阈值测量值，包括结合能、散射长度和费什巴赫共振位置。利用耦合通道散射计算中的优化电位，我们预测并表征了S波Feshbach同位素中的Feshbach共振。在其能量最低的超细通道中，所有共振都是窄的（ sim 0.01-0.1 G ） ，强封闭通道占主导地位，电子自旋特性主要是三重态，与同核系统形成鲜明对比。这些结果为设计拉曼光传输路径以产生超冷Li ₂分子奠定了基础，这些分子在所有三个同位素分子中都具有X ¹ Σ恤和a ³ Σ恤势的深度捆绑振动水平。

articles.title: Fermionic Hamiltonian engineering with local control
articles.title_zh: 具有局部控制的费米子哈密顿工程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.17158v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Quantum simulators enable the exploration of complex quantum phenomena in condensed-matter systems by reproducing their dynamics on controllable quantum devices. However, experimental constraints often restrict the class of Hamiltonians that can be realized natively. Hamiltonian engineering addresses this limitation by expanding the set of accessible Hamiltonians beyond the fixed system Hamiltonian provided by the hardware. We introduce a framework for fermionic Hamiltonian engineering based on interleaving free evolution under the system Hamiltonian with a sequence of experimentally feasible local fermionic unitaries. The required sequences and free-evolution times are obtained efficiently through a linear program, enabling effective time evolution under a broad class of target Hamiltonians. In particular, our method realizes arbitrary complex tunnelling coefficients, constrained only by the connectivity of the underlying system Hamiltonian. We further show that symmetries of the Hamiltonian engineering task can be exploited to drastically reduce the cost of computing the control parameters, and that errors arising from finite pulse times can be compensated within the same framework through a simple modification of the linear program. To our knowledge, this is the first automated method to realize locally tunable artificial gauge fields in interacting fermionic lattice models using only site-resolved energy shifts as control. We demonstrate the method by engineering the dynamics of interacting Fermi-Hubbard chains with complex tunnelling coefficients and of the Harper-Hofstadter model on a 1088-mode lattice. For the latter, we exploit the translation symmetry of the model to determine a provably optimal six-pulse sequence that produces the desired dynamics independent of the lattice size.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子模拟器通过在可控量子设备上再现凝聚态系统的动力学，能够探索凝聚态系统中复杂的量子现象。然而，实验约束常常限制可以本地实现的哈密顿量的类别。哈密顿量工程通过将可访问的哈密顿量集扩展到硬件提供的固定系统哈密顿量之外来解决这一限制。我们引入了一种费米子哈密顿工程框架，该框架基于哈密顿量系统下的交错自由演化与一系列实验上可行的局部费米酉。通过线性程序有效地获得所需的序列和自由演化时间，从而能够在广泛的目标哈密顿量下实现有效的时间演化。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子模拟器通过在可控量子设备上再现凝聚态系统的动力学，能够探索凝聚态系统中复杂的量子现象。然而，实验约束常常限制可以本地实现的哈密顿量的类别。哈密顿量工程通过将可访问的哈密顿量集扩展到硬件提供的固定系统哈密顿量之外来解决这一限制。我们引入了一种费米子哈密顿工程框架，该框架基于哈密顿量系统下的交错自由演化与一系列实验上可行的局部费米酉。通过线性程序有效地获得所需的序列和自由演化时间，从而能够在广泛的目标哈密顿量下实现有效的时间演化。特别是，我们的方法实现了任意复杂的隧道系数，仅受底层系统哈密顿量的连通性约束。我们进一步表明，可以利用哈密顿工程任务的对称性来大幅降低计算控制参数的成本，并且可以通过对线性程序的简单修改在同一框架内补偿由有限脉冲时间引起的误差。据我们所知，这是第一个仅使用位点解析能量位移作为控制来在相互作用的费米子晶格模型中实现局部可调谐人工规范场的自动化方法。我们通过设计具有复杂隧道系数的相互作用费米-哈伯德链和 1088 模式晶格上的哈珀-霍夫施塔特模型的动力学来演示该方法。对于后者，我们利用模型的平移对称性来确定可证明的最佳六脉冲序列，该序列可产生独立于晶格尺寸的所需动力学。

articles.title: Primordial Magnetogenesis from Killing Vector Fields
articles.title_zh: 杀死矢量场的原始磁生成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.00299v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Papapetrou showed that the covariant derivative of a Killing vector field satisfies Maxwell's equations in vacuum. We extend Papapetrou's result to show that the covariant derivative of a Killing vector field satisfies Maxwell's equations in non-vacuum backgrounds as well, if we allow electromagnetic currents of purely geometric origin. We postulate that every Killing vector field gives rise to a physical electromagnetic field and, in a non-vacuum background, a physical electromagnetic current---hereafter called Killing electromagnetic field and Killing electromagnetic current, respectively. We show that the Killing electromagnetic field of the flat FLRW universe comprises a Killing magnetic field and a rotational Killing electric field; we derive an upper bound on the Killing magnetic field and find that the upper bound is consistent with the current upper bound on the cosmic magnetic field. We show that the time-like Killing vector of the Schwarzschild spacetime gives rise to a radial Killing electric field. We also show that in the weak field regime---and far from the matter distribution---the back reaction of the radial Killing electric field changes the Schwarzschild metric to Reissner-Nordstrddotmboxom metric; our calculation yields the converse of Wald's result. Next, drawing upon Rainich's work on Rainich-Riemann manifolds, we discuss the etiological question of how a physical electromagnetic field can arise out of geometry; we also argue that detection of the Killing electric field of flat FLRW spacetime may be within current experimental reach. Finally, we discuss the relevance of Killing electromagnetic currents and the aforementioned transmutation of Schwarzschild spacetime to Reissner-Nordstrom spacetime, to Misner and Wheeler's program of realizing ``charge without charge''.
articles.abstract_zh: Papapetrou 证明了 Killing 矢量场的协变导数满足真空中的麦克斯韦方程组。我们扩展了帕帕佩特鲁的结果，表明如果我们允许纯几何起源的电磁电流，则杀伤矢量场的协变导数在非真空背景下也满足麦克斯韦方程组。我们假设每个杀伤矢量场都会产生一个物理电磁场，并且在非真空背景下会产生一个物理电磁流——以下分别称为杀伤电磁场和杀伤电磁流。我们证明了平坦FLRW宇宙的杀伤电磁场包括杀伤磁场和旋转杀伤电场；我们推导了杀伤磁场的上限，发现该上限与当前宇宙磁场的上限一致。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Papapetrou 证明了 Killing 矢量场的协变导数满足真空中的麦克斯韦方程组。我们扩展了帕帕佩特鲁的结果，表明如果我们允许纯几何起源的电磁电流，则杀伤矢量场的协变导数在非真空背景下也满足麦克斯韦方程组。我们假设每个杀伤矢量场都会产生一个物理电磁场，并且在非真空背景下会产生一个物理电磁流——以下分别称为杀伤电磁场和杀伤电磁流。我们证明了平坦FLRW宇宙的杀伤电磁场包括杀伤磁场和旋转杀伤电场；我们推导了杀伤磁场的上限，发现该上限与当前宇宙磁场的上限一致。我们证明，史瓦西时空的类时杀伤矢量会产生径向杀伤电场。我们还表明，在弱场状态下——并且远离物质分布——径向杀伤电场的逆反应将史瓦西度规改变为 Reissner-Nordstrddotmboxom 度规；我们的计算结果与 Wald 的结果相反。接下来，利用 Rainich 在 Rainich-Riemann 流形方面的工作，我们讨论物理电磁场如何从几何中产生的病因学问题；我们还认为，对平坦 FLRW 时空的杀伤电场的探测可能在当前的实验范围内。最后，我们讨论了杀死电磁电流和上述史瓦西时空到赖斯纳-诺德斯特姆时空的嬗变，以及米斯纳和惠勒实现“不带电荷的电荷”计划的相关性。

articles.title: Rapid Vacuum Response Calculations for Non-axisymmetric Plasma Geometries
articles.title_zh: 非轴对称等离子体几何形状的快速真空响应计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.00536v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a fast, open-source calculation of the vacuum response matrix and surface inductance in non-axisymmetric geometries capable of running with up to 10⁵ boundary points in tens of seconds on a laptop. Ideal magneto-hydrodynamic (MHD) stability modeling for free boundary modes requires the perturbed vacuum energy. We extend the VACUUM code to non-axisymmetric geometries in the new Julia implementation of the Generalized Perturbed Equilibrium Code, combining a collocation approach to the boundary integral equations with a high-order singularity correction scheme. The correction is recast into explicit quadrature weights acting on the collocation values, which allows the corrected operator to be assembled explicitly rather than applied to a given surface field, and the structure of that matrix under field-period and stellarator symmetry is then exploited to reduce storage and solve cost. We find that the vacuum response matrix converges at fourth order or greater in the grid spacing, reaching a given accuracy on a coarser grid than previous implementations without the high-order method. The non-axisymmetric calculation converges to the axisymmetric VACUUM result for a tokamak and the CAS3D result for a W7-X stellarator equilibrium. This work enables fast free boundary ideal MHD stability and perturbed equilibrium calculations in stellarators.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种快速、开源的非轴对称几何形状的真空响应矩阵和表面电感计算方法，能够在笔记本电脑上在数十秒内运行多达 10⁵ 边界点。自由边界模式的理想磁流体动力学 (MHD) 稳定性建模需要扰动真空能量。我们在广义扰动平衡码的新 Julia 实现中将 VACUUM 代码扩展到非轴对称几何，将边界积分方程的搭配方法与高阶奇点校正方案相结合。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一种快速、开源的非轴对称几何形状的真空响应矩阵和表面电感计算方法，能够在笔记本电脑上在数十秒内运行多达 10⁵ 边界点。自由边界模式的理想磁流体动力学 (MHD) 稳定性建模需要扰动真空能量。我们在广义扰动平衡码的新 Julia 实现中将 VACUUM 代码扩展到非轴对称几何，将边界积分方程的搭配方法与高阶奇点校正方案相结合。校正被重新转换为作用于配置值的显式正交权重，这允许显式地组装校正算子而不是应用于给定的表面场，然后利用场周期和仿星器对称性下的该矩阵的结构来减少存储和求解成本。我们发现真空响应矩阵在网格间距中以四阶或更高阶收敛，与之前没有使用高阶方法的实现相比，在更粗糙的网格上达到了给定的精度。非轴对称计算收敛到托卡马克的轴对称 VACUUM 结果和 W7-X 仿星器平衡的 CAS3D 结果。这项工作实现了仿星器中快速自由边界理想 MHD 稳定性和扰动平衡计算。

articles.title: Electronic Symmetry and Femtosecond Coherence Dynamics of Renner-Teller-Mixed Neutral Vibronic States in Carbon Dioxide
articles.title_zh: 二氧化碳中Renner-Teller混合中性振动态的电子对称性和飞秒相干动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2610.00565v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: When non-adiabatic coupling mixes electronic states of a molecule, vibronic states of different electronic symmetry become interleaved across the same spectral region. The symmetry of these states cannot be accessed in conventional spectroscopy due to orientation averaging. We show that molecular-frame angular signatures, which are preserved even when states with different symmetry overlap in energy, can be used to resolve them. Using vacuum-ultraviolet transient absorption spectroscopy of aligned carbon dioxide molecules, we separate two electronically distinct classes of vibronic states (A' and A'') that arise from Renner-Teller splitting of the ¹Δᵤ state. We reconstruct molecular-frame anisotropy continuously across the vibronic manifold showing that the anisotropy crosses over from perpendicular to parallel transition character and maps the interleaved electronic symmetry landscape. By scanning the femtosecond delay between the VUV and a near-infrared pulse through temporal overlap, we measure symmetry-dependent coherence dephasing times of these states and find that the parallel (A') states dephase faster than the perpendicular (A'') states. We attribute this to faster departure of the A' wavepacket from the Franck-Condon region due to the distinct topology of the A' excited-state surface.
