This approach provides theoretical support and technical guidance for the multiobjective, comprehensive optimisation of MFRAC mix proportions and similar engineering problems.

articles.title: Optimizing the fluoride removal from water using a novel adsorbent prepared from Waste Cerastoderma edule shell with Kinetic, Equilibrium, and Thermodynamic studies
articles.abstract: Conversion of waste materials into useful resource is emerging and development of a low-cost adsorbent from waste materials into useful adsorbent for defluoridation of water is no exception. The present research developed a new chemical-thermal activated adsorbent from calcium carbonate rich marine waste. Cerastoderma Edule shell material for defluoridation of water. Taguchi’s L16 orthogonal array is applied to optimize the adsorption process for maximum (F-) removal from water. Analysis of mean using S/N ratios, provided optimum values of process parameters as temperature 30°C, initial (F-) concentration 20 ppm, dosage 4 g/L, pH 3, and contact time of 60 minutes for maximum removal efficiency of 94% with adsorbent capacity as 4.8 mg/g. Analysis of variance revealed the percentage contribution of parameters as Temperature 5.24%; Initial F concentration 16.78%; pH 25.49%; Dose 18.81%; and contact time 11.45%, showing pH as the most contributing parameter. For better understating of adsorption process using waste Cerastoderma Edule shell adsorbent, equilibrium, kinetics and thermodynamic studies are also conducted on optimum conditions. Equilibrium studies revealed it better fit to Freundlich isotherm signifying that the process involved multilayer adsorption on a heterogeneous surface. Best fitting kinetic model pseudo-second order and the thermodynamic analysis revealed that the process was spontaneous, endothermic, and entropy driven, favouring higher temperatures. For adsorbent material characterization, SEM and EDS tests indicate the adsorption (F-) on the adsorbent material, while FTIR test revealed that the other surface functional groups remained similar through adsorption process. The present adsorbent developed from marine waste Cerastoderma Edule shell is effective for defluoridation.

articles.title: Electro-Fenton Oxidation to test the values of COD in the treatment of oily wastewater of petroleum refinery
articles.abstract: Petroleum refinery wastewater contains organic pollutants that resist conventional treatment. This study applied Response Surface Methodology with Box Behnken Design to optimize the electro-Fenton process for chemical oxygen demand (COD) removal. Three operational factors were systematically varied: applied voltage, total dissolved solids, and conductivity. A cubic polynomial model emerged as statistically significant, explaining 99.97% of observed variance in COD removal. The results reveal an unexpected relationship between operational parameters and treatment efficiency that contradicts conventional assumptions about maximizing voltage and conductivity. Optimal conditions diverge substantially from apparent maximum values, suggesting a delicate balance between oxidant generation and competing side reactions. The developed model provides quantitative guidance for parameter optimization in electrochemical wastewater treatment, with practical implications for refinery operations seeking enhanced COD removal efficiency.

articles.title: The digital readiness paradox in luxury hospitality: Psychological tensions in contactless guest experiences
articles.abstract: The integration of contactless technologies in luxury hotels enhances efficiency but can cause psychological discomfort and emotional detachment among guests. This study, conducted at the Kigali Marriott Hotel in Rwanda, employs the Technology Readiness Index (TRI 2.0), emotional labor theory, and a mixed-methods approach, involving 290 guests and 15 staff members. Results show that while 85.5% of guests value technological efficiency, 77.2% feel overwhelmed, 71.0% prefer human interaction, 70.4% worry about data privacy, and 74.5% fear system unreliability. Staff observations confirm these tensions, with 80% noting frequent guest requests for digital key assistance and 73% observing preferences for staff-mediated check-in. The study introduces the "Digital Readiness Paradox"—the coexistence of technological enthusiasm and emotional dependence on interpersonal reassurance. These findings highlight the neglected emotional and psychological dimensions of digital hospitality. Regression analyses reveal that technology-related attitudes do not significantly predict overall satisfaction, suggesting a decoupling of utilitarian evaluation from emotional experience. The study contributes to emotional labor theory by introducing the concept of "digital emotional labor"—the design and deployment of technological systems to elicit feelings of being cared for, attended to, and valued. Practical implications include recommendations for measuring technology anxiety beyond adoption metrics, providing guest choice between digital and human-mediated services, designing interfaces for anxiety reduction, investing in staff digital competencies, and implementing transparent privacy communication frameworks. The findings are particularly relevant to luxury hospitality contexts in emerging economies, where digital infrastructure development may outpace digital literacy, creating unique psychological tensions that require nuanced management approaches.

articles.title: Explaining Safety Is Not Enforcing Safety: Longitudinal Articulation–Application Gaps Across Consumer AI Surfaces
articles.abstract: Consumer AI assistants are often evaluated using isolated prompts or final outputs, even though safety-relevant behavior unfolds across multi-turn trajectories. We reconstructed an archival corpus spanning four deployed assistant vendor families to examine whether safety constraints articulated by an assistant remained behaviorally compatible with later responses after contextual reframing. Because the historical archive was exploratory and failure-seeking, the analysis characterizes documented trajectories rather than estimating prevalence or comparing vendor robustness. Following provenance reconstruction and de-duplication, the author and a second human coder independently coded 12 purposively selected analytic episodes using a frozen trajectory-level codebook. Pre-adjudication agreement on the primary application-compatibility outcome was 75.0% (9/12; Cohen’s κ≈0.633), with no direct divergence-versus-compatibility reversals. After transcript-level adjudication, six episodes were divergent, one was partial or ambiguous, two were compatible, and three were not applicable to the articulation–application comparison. These counts describe only the selected analytic set. Within this set, one candidate explicit articulation-to-divergence case from each vendor family retained its classification after independent coding and adjudication, while two explicit articulation-to-compatibility episodes remained compatible under repeated pressure. This finding validates selected cases rather than estimating cross-vendor frequency. Across the archived trajectories examined, explaining a safety boundary and applying it later emerged as separable observable behaviors. The study does not establish a shared hidden mechanism, harmful informational uplift, vendor rankings, or causal language or surface effects.

articles.title: Geographic Sensitivity of COVID-19 Outcomes: A Multiscale Analysis of Temporal and Spatial Non-Stationarity in the Contiguous United States
articles.abstract: Background COVID-19 showed pronounced geographic variation across the United States, yet most county-level analyses summarize it in one cumulative outcome and fit a single global model, assuming the county-outcome association was stable in time and constant in space. We relax both. Methods We assembled a dataset covering 3,103 US counties, linking daily reported COVID-19 cases and deaths, January 2020 to March 2023, to 43 socio-environmental and resilience predictors assembled and checked against primary sources. Deaths were modeled as counts with a population offset using negative binomial regression, cumulatively and within seven calendar windows. Prediction was assessed by spatially blocked cross-validation, non-stationarity by spatial-lag, geographically weighted (GWR) and multiscale geographically weighted (MGWR) regression models and a coordinate-permutation test, and age by indirect standardization. Results County composition rather than county size carried the predictive information. Out-of-sample deviance explained for cumulative mortality was 0.455 for the 43 factors against 0.106 for population size alone, and for cases 0.214 against 0.005. The size-mortality association nonetheless reversed. Size alone gave an IRR per SD of log population of 1.478 (95% CI 1.410 to 1.550) between January and May 2020, and 0.802 to 0.883 in the six later windows (each P < 0.001). Adjusting for size and all 43 factors left the gradient non-significant in six of seven windows, so the size association does not persist under adjustment. MGWR fitted better than GWR (corrected AIC 5670.2 against 5772.9) cumulatively and in all seven windows, though neither improved out-of-sample prediction. On 950 coordinate permutations only ultraviolet exposure (Holm-adjusted P = 0.009) and household composition and disability (P = 0.017) exceeded chance variation under family-wise correction, and physical inactivity under false-discovery-rate control alone; the intercept and population-size surfaces did not. Conclusions County-level COVID-19 mortality is predicted out of sample by socio-environmental composition rather than county size, and its geography was not fixed: the size gradient reversed after the first wave, and a cumulative estimate is dominated by the later regime. This helps explain why single-period summaries have struggled to find consistent county-level predictors. Holm-adjusted permutation testing reversed the bandwidth-only reading for four of six surfaces.

articles.title: Carbon Nanodots Modulate Ciprofloxacin Adsorption onto Polylactic Acid Microplastics in Aquatic Environments: Behavior and Mechanistic Insights
articles.abstract: To investigate the influence of carbon dots (CDs) on the adsorption behavior of ciprofloxacin (CIP) by microplastics, willow leaves were used as a carbon source to synthesize CDs via a hydrothermal method, which were subsequently employed to modify polylactic acid (CDs-PLA). The materials were characterized by transmission electron microscopy (TEM), scanning electron microscopy (SEM), and Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR). Batch adsorption experiments were conducted to evaluate the adsorption performance and underlying mechanisms of both CDs and CDs-PLA toward CIP. The adsorption process was analyzed using the pseudo-second-order kinetic model, as well as the Langmuir and Freundlich isotherm models. The results demonstrated that the synthesized CDs exhibited a uniform spherical morphology with an average particle size of 5.95 ± 0.07 nm, an ordered surface lattice, and abundant oxygen-containing functional groups including C = O, –OH, –COOH, and C–O–C. The adsorption of CIP onto both PLA and CDs-PLA followed the pseudo-second-order kinetic model and was well described by the Langmuir and Freundlich isotherm models, displaying both monolayer and multilayer adsorption characteristics, with chemisorption as the predominant mechanism.

articles.title: Local order average-atom interatomic potentials
articles.abstract: This article describes an extension to the effective average-atom method for random alloys to account for local ordering (short-range order) effects by utilizing information from partial radial distribution functions. The new Local Order Average-Atom (LOAA) method is rigorously derived based on statistical mechanics arguments and validated for non-stoichiometric binary 2D hexagonal crystals and 3D FeNiCr and NiAl alloys whose ground state is obtained through Monte Carlo sampling. Material properties for these alloys computed from atomistic simulations using standard interatomic potentials (IPs) exhibit a strong dependence on local ordering that is captured by simulations with effective LOAA IPs, but not the original AA method. The advantage of LOAA is that it requires smaller system sizes to achieve statistically converged results and therefore enables the simulation of complex materials, such as high-entropy alloys, at a fraction of the computational cost of standard IPs.

articles.title: Stable and transferable exchange–correlation potentials via machine-learned density-independent mapping
articles.abstract: We present a machine-learning framework, density-independent mapping for exchange–correlation, for incorporating XC effects into density functional theory via a density-independent mapping from the external potential to the XC potential. By predicting the ground-state XC potential in a one-shot manner and holding it fixed throughout the self-consistent field (SCF) procedure, the approach entirely eliminates the need to evaluate the XC potential on the iteratively updated electron density, thereby enhancing numerical stability and efficiency. The model is implemented using kernel ridge regression and trained on a set of small neutral closed-shell molecular systems, representative of common chemical bonding motifs, achieving the predictive accuracy of hybrid functionals—with energy errors on the order of 10 −3 kcal/mol—while bypassing expensive, iterative density-dependent XC evaluations during SCF. Further validation through infrared spectral predictions, molecular dynamics simulations, and structural perturbation tests demonstrates robust performance and reasonable transferability. This work establishes that machine-learned density-independent mapping represents a practical pathway for designing stable and transferable XC potentials.

articles.title: Accurate electron affinities from anion HOMO energies within the self-consistent random phase approximation
articles.abstract: Density functional calculations of small anions using the self-consistent random phase approximation (scRPA) optimized effective potential method are presented. scRPA calculations provide bound anions with the negative of the highest occupied molecular orbital (HOMO) energy closely matching the electron affinity of the corresponding neutral systems. For a benchmark of small atomic and molecular anions, electron affinities calculated as the negatives of HOMO energies from scRPA calculations are substantially more accurate than those from calculations with local, semilocal, global hybrid, and even range-separated hybrid exchange-correlation functionals, such as the well-established LC- ω PBE functional considered as an example. The superior performance of the scRPA method compared to conventional Kohn–Sham (KS) approaches lies in its ability to provide a closer approximation to the exact KS potential. Specifically, scRPA exchange-correlation potentials exhibit the correct −1/ r asymptotic behavior and closely resemble the exact exchange-correlation potential in the molecular region. In addition to the standard scRPA method, we also explored the hybrid scRPA (hscRPA) approach, which incorporates a fraction of nonlocal Hartree–Fock exchange. The hscRPA method addresses convergence challenges that may arise in standard scRPA calculations associated with a vanishing HOMO–LUMO gap. At the same time, hscRPA also provides bound anions with accurate HOMO energies.

articles.title: Time-dependent quantum dynamics of NO(X) + Ar: Rotational excitation pathways and comparison with mixed quantum/classical theory
articles.abstract: We present time-dependent quantum wavepacket simulations of inelastic NO(X) + Ar collisions using the Multi-Configurational Time-Dependent Hartree (MCTDH) method. The computed state-to-state cross sections and opacity functions agree well with time-independent close-coupled calculations. The time-dependent populations and rotational couplings provide a dynamical perspective on the well-known propensity behavior of this near-homonuclear system. In particular, they reveal how the established interplay between parity-conserving Δ j = 2 and parity-breaking Δ j = 1 coupling pathways develops during the collision to produce the inverse propensity. A particular emphasis is placed on comparison with mixed quantum/classical theory (MQCT), which previously offered a time-resolved, trajectory-based interpretation of the inverted rotational-population pattern. By broadening the time-dependent MQCT rotational populations to reflect the quantum packet’s inherent spread in arrival times, we recover the broad sequence of parity-dependent growth seen in MCTDH, although the detailed long-time populations of individual channels differ somewhat between the two methods. Nevertheless, the wavepacket dynamics support the broad mechanistic interpretation obtained from MQCT while providing a rigorous account of the coupling and excitation process.

articles.title: A QM/MM calculation to identify a low frequency mode that causes anharmonic vibrational coupling in green fluorescent protein
articles.abstract: The bright fluorescence of green fluorescent protein (GFP) from Aequorea victoria arises from the excited state proton transfer (ESPT) of its p -hydroxybenzylidene imidazolinone chromophore in the binding pocket. Recent ultrafast Raman studies have observed vibrational coupling between a low frequency mode (∼100 cm −1 ) and the phenolic CH bend (∼1140 cm −1 ) of the chromophore in the ESPT, spurring a debate over the assignment of the low frequency mode, its importance in the reaction, and the vibrational coupling mechanism. We performed a hybrid quantum mechanics/molecular mechanics calculation to analyze the vibrational modes of GFP below 300 cm −1 . We identified one low-frequency mode (128 cm −1 ) with a strong anharmonic coupling that can modulate the resonance Raman intensity of the phenolic CH bend. The low frequency mode corresponds to phenolic twisting, which is unlikely to promote ESPT directly.

articles.title: Suppression of superconductivity and electrostatic side gate tuning in high mobility SrTiO₃ surface electron gas
articles.abstract: Author(s): Dickson Boahen, Sushant Padhye, Gayan De Silva, Eshanvi Rao, and Evgeny Mikheev Two-dimensional systems in which electrons travel long distances without colliding (scattering) with defects are important for building quantum devices and circuits with interesting emergent physics. Such a system would be especially valuable if it were also superconducting and could be cleanly patterned into devices smaller than the average distance between electron scattering events. Combining all the above in a single material is difficult, and strontium titanate is one of the few material platforms where this could plausibly be achieved. In this work, the authors explored a promising approach to pattern and tune electron density on strontium titanate surfaces using hydrogen plasma and side gate voltages. They observed clean electron transport, with scattering lengths near 1-2 microns. But surprisingly, superconductivity was completely suppressed, even in the electron density range where it is typically robust in similar systems with stronger scattering. These results raise an important open question: why do clean electron transport and superconductivity in this material appear to be working against each other? [Phys. Rev. articles.title: Thermally Tunable Cascaded Silicon Microring Notch Filters: A Reproducible Transfer-Matrix and Robustness Study
articles.abstract: Cascaded microring resonators provide a compact route to spectrally selective filtering, but useful designs must retain extinction and spectral placement under thermal drift and fabrication variation. This work develops a fully reproducible transfer-matrix study of a two-ring silicon notch filter in the 1550-nm band. The model combines round-trip attenuation, bus-ring self-coupling, radius mismatch, silicon thermo-optic response, and independent effective-index perturbations. A nominal design is evaluated over 290–330 K, coupling amplitude 0.90–0.98, and second-ring radius 10.02–10.14 um. A 1000-realization Monte Carlo analysis then propagates radius, coupling, and effective-index uncertainty into notch wavelength, extinction ratio, linewidth, and loaded quality factor. The central result is not a single optimized geometry but a robustness map: deep extinction occurs only in a narrower coupling-radius region than wavelength placement alone would suggest, while thermal tuning remains approximately linear over the investigated interval. The accompanying code, raw CSV outputs, fixed random seed, and protocol permit independent reproduction and extension. The analysis identifies practical design tradeoffs between notch depth, linewidth, thermal sensitivity, and tolerance to manufacturing uncertainty without claiming experimental validation.

articles.title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Incommensurate Fractional Volterra-Lotka Systems: Forward Solutions, Memory Asymmetry, and Inverse Parameter Recovery
articles.title_zh: 不相称分数Volterra-Lotka系统的物理知情神经网络：前向解、记忆不对称和逆参数恢复
articles.abstract: Fractional extensions of the classical Lotka-Volterra competition model invariablyimpose a single Caputo order on both species, an assumption that is mathematicallyconvenient yet ecologically unjustified: two organisms with different life historiesand habitat dependencies need not encode population memory at the same rate.We study the incommensurate coupled system in which species u and v are governedby Caputo operators of distinct orders α1 ̸= α2, respectively. Because the uniformpower-of-tα structure that underlies the power-series method of Yu and Feng [15] nolonger holds when the two orders differ, we turn instead to physics-informed neural networks(PINNs). Species-specific L1-scheme stencils are embedded as independent termsin the PINN training loss, producing a mesh-free solver valid across the whole time intervalof interest rather than only near t = 0. Three objectives drive the study. First, weverify that the PINN reproduces the commensurate power-series benchmark of [15] to amean absolute error of 2.3×10−3. Second, we show that memory asymmetry (α1 ̸= α2)generates dynamics absent from commensurate models: in particular, a nominally mutualisticparameter pair (C1,C2 > 0) can produce an apparent amensalistic outcomewhen the fractional orders differ substantially, a phenomenon we term a memory-inducedrole transition. Third, we demonstrate that all eight system unknowns—growth rates,intraspecific-limitation parameters, coupling coefficients, and both fractional orders—canbe recovered jointly from thirty noisy population observations with relative errors below3.5%. Numerical experiments are reported for all six classical ecological interactiontypes.

articles.title: Quasi-Static Near-Field Magnetic Shielding and Bloch Wave Analysis of 1D Periodic Layered Media
articles.title_zh: 一维周期性层状介质的准静态近场磁屏蔽和Bloch波分析
articles.abstract: Near-field magnetic shielding is crucial for minimizing electromagnetic interference in wireless power transfer systems. This paper presents a numerically stabilized Transfer Matrix Method, combined with the Hankel transform and Bloch wave theory, to evaluate planar one-dimensional periodic magnetic-dielectric shields under low-frequency quasi-static conditions. The analysis reveals that periodic stratification effectively bypasses the physical saturation ceiling of approximately 57.3 decibels observed in uniform bulk slabs. This results in a practical 10 decibel shielding gain at a compact profile of 8 unit cells, achieving a total of 59.5 decibels compared to 49.5 decibels for an equivalent solid slab. Moreover, periodic stratification enables continuous, non-saturating decibel growth exceeding 100 decibels at a cell count of 100. Wavenumber spectral analysis demonstrates that sub-wavelength anisotropy at a relative permeability of 3300 establishes a 28.7-fold effective spatial decay rate multiplier, leading to exponential internal field attenuation. Additionally, a 57.5-fold effective wave impedance contrast dictates boundary reflection across the primary coil excitation spectrum. By transforming bulk reluctance decay into cumulative exponential spatial field attenuation, periodic stratification significantly outperforms solid bulk materials in low-profile shielding applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 近场磁屏蔽对于最大限度地减少无线电力传输系统中的电磁干扰至关重要。本文提出了一种数值稳定的转移矩阵法，结合汉克尔变换和布洛赫波理论，来评估低频准静态条件下的平面一维周期性磁介质屏蔽。分析表明，周期性分层有效地绕过了在均匀散装板中观察到的约57.3分贝的物理饱和度上限。这导致在8个单位电池的紧凑型剖面上实际获得10分贝的屏蔽增益，总共达到59.5分贝，而同等实心板则为49.5分贝。此外，周期性分层可在细胞计数为100时实现超过100分贝的连续、非饱和分贝生长。

articles.title: Variability-Aware Memristor Circuit for Hierarchical Bayesian Temporal Sampling
articles.title_zh: 用于分层贝叶斯时间采样的可变性感知忆阻器电路
articles.abstract: Bayesian neural networks (BNNs) require hardware capable of storing and sampling probabilistic synaptic weights. While population coding exploits device-to-device (D2D) variability to encode weight distributions, temporal sampling instead requires controlled and reproducible stochastic fluctuations, making its hardware implementation particularly challenging. Here, we demonstrate a memristor-based temporal-coding circuit that combines three analog memristor devices per synaptic weight to encode its mean and standard deviation with an externally injected white-noise source for sample generation. A dedicated fluctuation-amplification stage provides controllable temporal stochasticity, while a hierarchical training algorithm explicitly models device-to-device variability and temporal noise to ensure robust Bayesian inference under hardware non-idealities. On the MIT-BIH arrhythmia classification task, the proposed approach achieves a 2.7-fold reduction in memory footprint compared with an equivalent population-coding implementation, while preserving Bayesian inference accuracy and uncertainty estimates.
articles.abstract_zh: 贝叶斯神经网络（ BNN ）需要能够存储和采样概率突触权重的硬件。虽然群体编码利用设备到设备（ D2D ）的可变性来编码权重分布，但时间采样相反需要受控和可重复的随机波动，使其硬件实现特别具有挑战性。在这里，我们演示了一种基于忆阻器的时间编码电路，该电路将每个突触权重的三个模拟忆阻器器件结合起来，以编码其均值和标准偏差，并使用外部注入的白噪声源进行样本生成。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 贝叶斯神经网络（ BNN ）需要能够存储和采样概率突触权重的硬件。虽然群体编码利用设备到设备（ D2D ）的可变性来编码权重分布，但时间采样相反需要受控和可重复的随机波动，使其硬件实现特别具有挑战性。在这里，我们演示了一种基于忆阻器的时间编码电路，该电路将每个突触权重的三个模拟忆阻器器件结合起来，以编码其均值和标准偏差，并使用外部注入的白噪声源进行样本生成。专用波动放大阶段提供可控的时间随机性，而分层训练算法显式建模设备到设备的可变性和时间噪声，以确保硬件非理想性下的鲁棒贝叶斯推理。在MIT-BIH心律失常分类任务上，与等效群体编码实现相比，所提出的方法实现了内存占用减少2.7倍，同时保持了贝叶斯推断精度和不确定性估计。

articles.title: Coal-Gangue Detection and Pose Estimation Method Based on DRD- YOLOv11n
articles.title_zh: 基于DRD的煤矸石检测和位姿估计方法-YOLOv11n
articles.abstract: To deal with difficult feature extraction and single-dimensional information caused by poor sorting conditions and various target shapes, this paper puts forward a coal-gangue detection and pose estimation method based on DRD-YOLOv11n. First, to avoid the checkerboard effect, we add the DySample operator for dynamic upsampling into the feature fusion network. It takes the place of common interpolation and carries out dynamic feature resampling with low computing cost. Second, to reduce noise from dust and light and strengthen detailed features, we put a residual enhancement module before the detection head. It uses depthwise separable convolution and the SE attention module to complete effective feature extraction. Besides, to realize accurate positioning of objects of different sizes, we combine multi-dimensional attention and make use of the geometric deformation of the DCNv3 operator to rebuild a dynamic detection head based on DCNv3. Finally, to offer accurate grasping positions for the mechanical claw, a post-processing module for pose estimation is set up. We use the minimum area bounding rectangle (MABR) fitting and exponential moving average (EMA) time filtering. With the separating axis theorem, we build a dynamic safety zone to calculate stable rotation angles and ensure safe grabbing. The test results show that on the coal and gangue dataset, compared with the original YOLOv11n, the improved DRD-YOLOv11n only has a model weight of 5.1 MB. Its mAP50-95 reaches 85.6%, which is 0.6% higher than the baseline. The F1 score is 95.1%, also rising by 0.6%. The number of parameters is cut down by 6%, and the detection speed reaches 114 frames per second.After adding pose estimation, the grabbing success rate of the mechanical claw for long strip objects rises from 60% to 90%, and the overall safe grabbing rate is guaranteed even under crowded working conditions.While keeping the model lightweight, this method balances detection accuracy and speed. Besides, the newly added modules solve the problem of low positioning accuracy. It provides key support and theoretical reference for the practical engineering use of sorting robots.
articles.abstract_zh: 针对分选条件差、目标形状多样造成的特征提取困难、信息单维等问题，提出了一种基于DRD-YOLOv11n的煤矸石检测和位姿估计方法。首先，为了避免棋盘效应，我们将用于动态上采样的DySample运算符添加到特征融合网络中。它取代了常见的插值，以较低的计算成本进行动态特征重采样。其次，为了减少灰尘和光线的噪音并增强细节功能，我们在检测头之前放置了一个残留增强模块。它使用深度可分离卷积和SE注意模块来完成有效的特征提取。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 针对分选条件差、目标形状多样造成的特征提取困难、信息单维等问题，提出了一种基于DRD-YOLOv11n的煤矸石检测和位姿估计方法。首先，为了避免棋盘效应，我们将用于动态上采样的DySample运算符添加到特征融合网络中。它取代了常见的插值，以较低的计算成本进行动态特征重采样。其次，为了减少灰尘和光线的噪音并增强细节功能，我们在检测头之前放置了一个残留增强模块。它使用深度可分离卷积和SE注意模块来完成有效的特征提取。此外，为实现不同尺寸物体的精确定位，结合多维关注，利用DCNv3算子的几何变形，重建基于DCNv3的动态检测头。最后，为了提供机械爪的精确抓取位置，设置了一个用于姿态估计的后处理模块。我们使用最小面积边界矩形（ MABR ）拟合和指数移动平均（ EMA ）时间滤波。利用分离轴定理，建立动态安全区，计算稳定的旋转角，确保安全抓取。测试结果表明，在煤和矸石数据集上，与原始YOLOv11n相比，改进的DRD-YOLOv11n仅具有5.1 MB的模型权重。其mAP50-95达到85.6% ，比基线高出0.6%。F1得分为95.1% ，也上升了0.6%。参数数量减少6% ，检测速度达到每秒114帧，加上位姿估计后，机械爪对长条形物体的抓取成功率从60%提高到90% ，即使在拥挤的工作条件下也能保证整体安全抓取率，在保持模型轻量的同时，该方法平衡了检测精度和速度。此外，新增模块解决了定位精度低的问题。为分拣机器人的实际工程应用提供关键支撑和理论参考。

articles.title: Study on the Oil Film Flow Field in Hydrostatic Bearings of Friction Welding Spindles
articles.title_zh: 摩擦焊主轴静压轴承油膜流场研究
articles.abstract: Addressing the issue of thermal failure in closed hydrostatic bearings of the spindle in heavy-duty inertial friction welding machines under extreme operating conditions, this paper takes a 1,000-tonne machine as its subject and employs the equivalent rectangularisation method for sector-shaped oil chambers, combined with CFD simulation, to analyse the oil film temperature and pressure fields under full-load upsetting force and at rotational speeds of 100–500 r/min. The results indicate that the high-temperature zones are located at the outlet of the oil seal and at the corners; temperatures on both the pressure side and the back-pressure side rise significantly with rotational speed, with the corners identified as the primary risk points for thermal failure. Under constant-flow oil supply, the pressures on both sides stabilise at 33–34 MPa and 7.8–8.2 MPa, respectively; the load-bearing capacity is insensitive to rotational speed, whilst the thermal load on the pressure side is significantly higher than that on the back-pressure side. Experimental validation confirms the reliability of the simulation method. This study provides a basis for optimising bearing design and implementing thermal prevention measures.
articles.abstract_zh: 针对重型惯性摩擦焊机主轴闭式静压轴承在极端工况下的热失效问题，以千吨级机床为对象，采用扇形油室等效矩形化方法，结合CFD仿真，对满载镦粗力、转速100~500 r/min下的油膜温度和压力场进行分析。结果表明，高温区位于油封出口处和拐角处；压力侧和背压侧的温度随着转速的增加而显着升高，角落被确定为热故障的主要风险点。恒流量供油时，两侧压力分别稳定在33~34 MPa和7.8~8.2 MPa；承载能力对转速不敏感，而压力侧的热负荷明显高于背压侧的热负荷。

articles.title: Reassessing the pursuit of refractory high-entropy alloys for extreme environments
articles.title_zh: 重新评估对极端环境下的难熔高熵合金的追求
articles.abstract: Nature Reviews Materials, Published online: 01 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41578-026-00969-5 The recent report of an oxide-dispersion-strengthened Ta alloy retaining appreciable tensile strength above 2,000 °C raises a provocative question: do we still need refractory high-entropy alloys? This Comment argues that their value lies in enabling multiple tolerance mechanisms for extreme environments and proposes shifting the design focus from maximizing compositional complexity to deploying the right complexity, in the right form, for the right mechanism.
articles.abstract_zh: 最近关于氧化物弥散强化 Ta 合金在 2,000 °C 以上仍保持相当大的拉伸强度的报告提出了一个具有争议性的问题：我们还需要难熔高熵合金吗？该评论认为，它们的价值在于为极端环境启用多种容忍机制，并建议将设计重点从最大化组合复杂性转移到以正确的形式为正确的机制部署正确的复杂性。

articles.title: Hidden Angular Momentum Loop Currents in Symmetric Crystals
articles.title_zh: 对称晶体中隐藏的角动量环路电流
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.38317v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Loop-current order has been invoked to explain unconventional electronic phases, with the crystal lattice usually regarded as a passive host for the underlying collective dynamics. Here we show that circulating currents can originate in the lattice itself, sustained by quantum and thermal fluctuations. We develop a microscopic description of angular momentum exchange that separates transfer between sites from crystalline restoring torques and reveals how circulation can emerge in a symmetry-preserving equilibrium state. In a two-dimensional elastic lattice preserving time-reversal, inversion, and fourfold rotational symmetries, we uncover opposite current loops on neighboring plaquettes while the mean angular momentum vanishes at every site. These currents are sustained by zero-point fluctuations in the phonon vacuum and persist at finite temperature. We trace their origin to directional elastic interactions in locally symmetry-lowered environments, with the higher crystal symmetry organizing the resulting currents into a compensated pattern of circulation. Our results extend the physics of equilibrium loop currents to lattice dynamics, revealing that elastic geometry can organize fluctuations into persistent angular momentum circulation without electronic or magnetic order, external driving, or spontaneous symmetry breaking.
articles.abstract_zh: 环流顺序已被用来解释非常规电子相，晶格通常被视为潜在集体动力学的被动主体。在这里，我们证明循环电流可以起源于晶格本身，由量子和热波动维持。我们开发了角动量交换的微观描述，将位点之间的传递与晶体恢复扭矩分开，并揭示了循环如何出现在保持对称的平衡状态。在保持时间反转、反转和四重旋转对称性的二维弹性晶格中，我们发现相邻斑块上存在相反的电流环，而平均角动量在每个位置都消失。这些电流由声子真空中的零点涨落维持，并在有限温度下持续存在。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 环流顺序已被用来解释非常规电子相，晶格通常被视为潜在集体动力学的被动主体。在这里，我们证明循环电流可以起源于晶格本身，由量子和热波动维持。我们开发了角动量交换的微观描述，将位点之间的传递与晶体恢复扭矩分开，并揭示了循环如何出现在保持对称的平衡状态。在保持时间反转、反转和四重旋转对称性的二维弹性晶格中，我们发现相邻斑块上存在相反的电流环，而平均角动量在每个位置都消失。这些电流由声子真空中的零点涨落维持，并在有限温度下持续存在。我们将其起源追溯到局部对称性降低的环境中的定向弹性相互作用，较高的晶体对称性将产生的电流组织成补偿的循环模式。我们的研究结果将平衡环电流的物理学扩展到晶格动力学，揭示了弹性几何结构可以将涨落组织成持续的角动量循环，而无需电子或磁序、外部驱动或自发对称性破缺。

articles.title: Ab initio calculated diamagnetic and paramagnetic susceptibility of carbonate minerals
articles.title_zh: 从头计算碳酸盐矿物的抗磁和顺磁磁化率
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.38451v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The anisotropy of magnetic susceptibility (AMS) is a widely used tool to infer rock fabrics, yet quantitative interpretation is limited by sparse single-crystal magnetic properties for rock-forming minerals and by the difficulty of separating intrinsic diamagnetism from impurity-related magnetism. Here we use density-functional theory (DFT) combined with perturbation theory to compute the diamagnetic susceptibility and AMS of calcite-group carbonates (calcite, magnesite, and dolomite) and to quantify the additional paramagnetic contribution from transition-metal doping. For pure calcite, the calculated susceptibility and its anisotropy are in good agreement with published single-crystal measurements, validating the ab initio approach for diamagnetic phases. We provide improved intrinsic diamagnetic reference values for magnesite and dolomite, for which experimental susceptibilities are commonly affected by magnetic impurities. To address impurity effects explicitly, we model Fe and Mn substitution in calcite using supercells. The computed spin moments reproduce expected high-spin states (Fe²⁺, S=2; Mn²⁺, S=5/2) and yield a susceptibility anisotropy per Fe concentration that matches the experimental slope. The strong anisotropy is primarily governed by an orbital contribution tied to the crystallographic c-axis rather than by spin-orbit coupling, highlighting orbital magnetisation as a key but numerically challenging ingredient for modelling of paramagnetic AMS in carbonates.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁化率各向异性（AMS）是一种广泛使用的推断岩石结构的工具，但定量解释受到造岩矿物稀疏的单晶磁性以及难以将固有抗磁性与杂质相关磁性分开的限制。在这里，我们使用密度泛函理论 (DFT) 与微扰理论相结合来计算方解石族碳酸盐（方解石、菱镁矿和白云石）的抗磁化率和 AMS，并量化过渡金属掺杂的额外顺磁贡献。对于纯方解石，计算的磁化率及其各向异性与已发表的单晶测量结果非常一致，验证了抗磁相的从头计算方法。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁化率各向异性（AMS）是一种广泛使用的推断岩石结构的工具，但定量解释受到造岩矿物稀疏的单晶磁性以及难以将固有抗磁性与杂质相关磁性分开的限制。在这里，我们使用密度泛函理论 (DFT) 与微扰理论相结合来计算方解石族碳酸盐（方解石、菱镁矿和白云石）的抗磁化率和 AMS，并量化过渡金属掺杂的额外顺磁贡献。对于纯方解石，计算的磁化率及其各向异性与已发表的单晶测量结果非常一致，验证了抗磁相的从头计算方法。我们为菱镁矿和白云石提供了改进的固有抗磁性参考值，这些材料的实验磁化率通常受到磁性杂质的影响。为了明确解决杂质影响，我们使用超级电池对方解石中的 Fe 和 Mn 替代进行建模。计算出的自旋矩再现了预期的高自旋态（Fe²⁺，S=2；Mn²⁺，S=5/2），并产生与实验斜率相匹配的每 Fe 浓度的磁化率各向异性。强各向异性主要由与晶体 c 轴相关的轨道贡献决定，而不是由自旋轨道耦合决定，这凸显了轨道磁化强度是碳酸盐中顺磁性 AMS 建模的关键但在数值上具有挑战性的因素。

articles.title: Stress-based structure optimization for a range-separated hybrid van der Waals density functional
articles.title_zh: 范围分离混合范德华密度泛函的基于应力的结构优化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.38478v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Complex matter, often partly soft and pliable, is the generic form of material systems. We must therefore generally call on density functional theory (DFT) to first predict the atomic structure before we can use it to also characterize (expected) properties. A recent range-separated hybrid (RSH) van Waals density functional (vdW-DF), `vdW-DF2-ahbr' (abbreviated AHBR) [PRX 12, 041003 (2022)], shows promise as a high-accuracy predictor of both binding energies and structure, from molecules to solids. However, the present implementation in Quantum Espresso (QE) does not, in our experience, support robust stress-based unit-cell optimization of RSHs. Here we document and illustrate work enabling practical AHBR-based complex-matter discovery: We port the AHBR XC functional to the Vienna Ab Initio Simulation Package (VASP) where use of stress-based DFT optimization is already stable also for RSHs. We test the implementation by comparing high-accuracy AHBR-QE and AHBR-VASP predictions of non-covalent molecular interactions and for structure and cohesion of simple bulk structures. We also illustrate and test the use of the new AHBR-VASP implementation to predict and understand (atomic and anti-ferromagnetic) structure in distorted-rocksalt metal monoxides. Finally, we illustrate use for complex-soft-matter discovery by predicting motifs for layer stacking in the C2N covalent-organic framework (COF) system [Nat. Commun. 6, 6486 (2015)].
articles.abstract_zh: 复杂物质，通常部分柔软且柔韧，是材料系统的通用形式。因此，我们通常必须首先利用密度泛函理论（DFT）来预测原子结构，然后才能使用它来表征（预期）属性。最近的范围分离杂化 (RSH) 范瓦尔斯密度泛函 (vdW-DF)“vdW-DF2-ahbr”（缩写 AHBR）[PRX 12, 041003 (2022)] 显示出作为从分子到固体的结合能和结构的高精度预测器的前景。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 复杂物质，通常部分柔软且柔韧，是材料系统的通用形式。因此，我们通常必须首先利用密度泛函理论（DFT）来预测原子结构，然后才能使用它来表征（预期）属性。最近的范围分离杂化 (RSH) 范瓦尔斯密度泛函 (vdW-DF)“vdW-DF2-ahbr”（缩写 AHBR）[PRX 12, 041003 (2022)] 显示出作为从分子到固体的结合能和结构的高精度预测器的前景。然而，根据我们的经验，目前 Quantum Espresso (QE) 中的实现并不支持 RSH 的稳健的基于应力的单位单元优化。在这里，我们记录并说明了实现基于 AHBR 的实用复杂物质发现的工作：我们将 AHBR XC 功能移植到维也纳从头算仿真包 (VASP)，其中基于应力的 DFT 优化的使用对于 RSH 来说也已经稳定。我们通过比较非共价分子相互作用以及简单本体结构的结构和内聚力的高精度 AHBR-QE 和 AHBR-VASP 预测来测试实施情况。我们还说明和测试了如何使用新的 AHBR-VASP 实现来预测和理解扭曲岩盐金属一氧化物中的（原子和反铁磁）结构。最后，我们通过预测 C2N 共价有机框架 (COF) 系统中的层堆叠图案来说明复杂软物质发现的用途 [Nat.交流。 6、6486（2015）]。

articles.title: Results of Classical and Nonclassical theories of nucleation for ordering transition in barium titanate
articles.title_zh: 钛酸钡有序转变成核的经典和非经典理论结果
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.38481v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Results of classical and nonclassical approach to nucleation at the ordering phase transition in barium titanate are presented. A nonclassical nucleation model is applied to the first-order paraelectric cubic phase to ferroelectric tetragonal phase transition in barium titanate is considered.
articles.abstract_zh: 介绍了钛酸钡有序相变成核的经典和非经典方法的结果。将非经典成核模型应用于钛酸钡中的一阶顺电立方相到铁电四方相变。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 介绍了钛酸钡有序相变成核的经典和非经典方法的结果。将非经典成核模型应用于钛酸钡中的一阶顺电立方相到铁电四方相变。

articles.title: Single-particle detection of the Néel transition in LaCrO₃ microcrystals via widefield nitrogen-vacancy center magnetic imaging
articles.title_zh: 通过宽场氮空位中心磁成像单粒子检测 LaCrO₃ 微晶中的尼尔跃迁
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.38529v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Rare-earth orthochromites exhibit rich, chemically tunable magnetic behavior, making them attractive for temperature sensing and temperature-dependent switching applications. Realizing this potential requires understanding how synthesis conditions and particle morphology influence the underlying Cr³⁺ magnetic ordering. Orthochromite magnetism has traditionally been characterized by ensemble techniques such as neutron diffraction and SQUID magnetometry, which report only averaged magnetic properties and cannot access particle-level information. Here we use widefield nitrogen-vacancy (NV) magnetometry to image the stray magnetic fields of individual LaCrO₃ microcrystals produced via molten salt synthesis, resolving the antiferromagnetic Néel transition in single particles. Of the 18 particles measured between 278 and 298 K, five show a clear onset of magnetization near the ensemble Néel temperature, four show no measurable magnetic signal, and nine display temperature-independent signatures consistent with localized magnetic impurities undetected by ensemble measurements. Below the Néel temperature, particle magnetization remains fixed under a rotating in-plane field, consistent with canted antiferromagnetic ordering rather than paramagnetism, while repeated thermal cycling shows that the magnetic field pattern varies between cooldowns with certain features recurring at the same locations, consistent with micron-scale structurally pinned antiferromagnetic domains in which the sign of the weak ferromagnetic moment is set independently each time they pass through the Néel transition. These results establish single-particle NV magnetometry as a sensitive probe of magnetic ordering and domain structure in individual microcrystals, a key step toward correlating individual particle morphology and defect structure with magnetic ordering in orthochromites.
articles.abstract_zh: 稀土正铬铁矿表现出丰富的、化学可调的磁性行为，使其对温度传感和温度相关开关应用具有吸引力。实现这一潜力需要了解合成条件和颗粒形态如何影响潜在的 Cr3⁺ 磁有序。传统上，正铬铁矿的磁性是通过中子衍射和 SQUID 磁力测量等系综技术来表征的，这些技术仅报告平均磁特性，无法获取颗粒级信息。在这里，我们使用宽场氮空位（NV）磁力测量仪对通过熔盐合成产生的单个 LaCrO₃ 微晶的杂散磁场进行成像，解决了单个颗粒中的反铁磁尼尔转变。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 稀土正铬铁矿表现出丰富的、化学可调的磁性行为，使其对温度传感和温度相关开关应用具有吸引力。实现这一潜力需要了解合成条件和颗粒形态如何影响潜在的 Cr3⁺ 磁有序。传统上，正铬铁矿的磁性是通过中子衍射和 SQUID 磁力测量等系综技术来表征的，这些技术仅报告平均磁特性，无法获取颗粒级信息。在这里，我们使用宽场氮空位（NV）磁力测量仪对通过熔盐合成产生的单个 LaCrO₃ 微晶的杂散磁场进行成像，解决了单个颗粒中的反铁磁尼尔转变。在 278 至 298 K 之间测量的 18 个粒子中，有 5 个在系综尼尔温度附近显示出明显的磁化起始，4 个显示没有可测量的磁信号，9 个显示与系综测量未检测到的局部磁性杂质一致的与温度无关的特征。在尼尔温度以下，粒子磁化强度在旋转面内场下保持固定，与倾斜的反铁磁有序而不是顺磁性一致，而重复的热循环表明，磁场模式在冷却之间变化，并且在相同位置重复出现某些特征，与微米级结构钉扎反铁磁域一致，其中弱铁磁矩的符号在每次通过尼尔跃迁时独立设置。这些结果确立了单颗粒 NV 磁力测量作为单个微晶中磁有序和磁域结构的敏感探针，这是将单个颗粒形态和缺陷结构与正铬矿中磁有序相关联的关键一步。

articles.title: Enabling Domain-Specific Atomistic Models: A Machine Learning Potential for the Solid Acid Family
articles.title_zh: 实现特定领域的原子模型：固体酸系列的机器学习潜力
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.38531v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine-learned interatomic potentials trained across the periodic table have made atomistic simulation broadly accessible, and specializing them to a single compound class is widely expected to improve accuracy. Yet examples remain scarce, and fewer still surpass universal models in speed or reach a higher level of electronic-structure theory. Here we present a potential that is universal within the class of water-free solid-state hydrogen-bond network mediated proton conductors rather than across chemistry and a database of 4.4 million first-principles configurations spanning 55 materials. It surpasses leading general-purpose potentials across this domain, recovering measured activation energies and the ordering of anion rotational dynamics that those models miss; agreement on static structure does not imply agreement on transport. Accuracy falls for compositions far from the training set but stays competitive for close structural relatives, and a higher level of electronic-structure theory is reached with a few hundred additional configurations per material. We further introduce a compact variant carrying a fifth of the parameters, faster still and yet more accurate than every general-purpose model tested. It sustains more than a quarter of a million atoms on a single graphics processor, placing grain boundaries and the transition into the highly conducting phase within reach, and making a quantum treatment of the protons affordable. Reference accuracy and accessible system size thus become largely independent, offering a template for other compound classes.
articles.abstract_zh: 在整个元素周期表中训练的机器学习原子间势使得原子模拟变得更加容易实现，并且人们普遍期望将它们专门针对单个化合物类别以提高准确性。然而例子仍然很少，而且在速度上超越通用模型或达到电子结构理论更高水平的例子仍然很少。在这里，我们提出了一种在无水固态氢键网络介导的质子导体类中普遍存在的潜力，而不是在化学领域中普遍存在的潜力，以及涵盖 55 种材料的 440 万个第一原理配置的数据库。它超越了该领域领先的通用潜力，恢复了这些模型遗漏的测量活化能和阴离子旋转动力学的顺序；
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在整个元素周期表中训练的机器学习原子间势使得原子模拟变得更加容易实现，并且人们普遍期望将它们专门针对单个化合物类别以提高准确性。然而例子仍然很少，而且在速度上超越通用模型或达到电子结构理论更高水平的例子仍然很少。在这里，我们提出了一种在无水固态氢键网络介导的质子导体类中普遍存在的潜力，而不是在化学领域中普遍存在的潜力，以及涵盖 55 种材料的 440 万个第一原理配置的数据库。它超越了该领域领先的通用潜力，恢复了这些模型遗漏的测量活化能和阴离子旋转动力学的顺序；对静态结构的一致并不意味着对传输的一致。远离训练集的成分的准确性会下降，但对于结构密切的亲戚来说仍然具有竞争力，并且通过每种材料的数百个附加配置可以达到更高水平的电子结构理论。我们进一步引入了一个紧凑的变体，它携带五分之一的参数，比测试的每个通用模型更快、更准确。它在单个图形处理器上支持超过 25 万个原子，使晶界和向高导电相的转变触手可及，并使质子的量子处理变得经济实惠。因此，参考精度和可访问的系统尺寸在很大程度上变得独立，为其他复合类别提供了模板。

articles.title: Theory of criticality-enabled U(1) symmetry breaking in a class of 1+1D systems
articles.title_zh: 一类 1+1D 系统中临界性 U(1) 对称性破缺理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.38581v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present an analytic theory of the recently proposed phenomenon of spontaneous U(1) symmetry breaking at 1+1D Lifshitz quantum critical points. The low-energy field theory contains two periodic scalars θ and φ, with a Berry phase coupling that makes θ canonically conjugate to the U(1) charge density partialₓ φ. Within a controlled large-N limit, we demonstrate that the U(1)-charged phase vertex eⁱβθ develops long-range order, while the conjugate vertex eⁱβφ decays as a stretched exponential, loglangle eⁱβφ⁽x⁾ e⁻ⁱβφ⁽⁰⁾ranglepropto-|β|⁴/³|x|²/³. Going beyond the large-N limit, we give an analytic argument that the Lifshitz field theory supports U(1) long-range order provided its dynamical exponent satisfies z≠1, a condition strongly supported by existing calculations. We test these predictions using finite-size and infinite-system DMRG in an itinerant-fermion chain with U(1) rtimes Z₂ symmetry. At the Z₂ ferromagnetic transition, the spin sector of the chain maps to the Lifshitz field theory. Consistent with analytic predictions, the U(1)-charged spin-nematic bond operator Sᵢ⁺Sᵢ₊₁⁺ exhibits long-range order, while the electron Green's function shows stretched-exponential decay. Together, these results elucidate the mechanism and consequences of criticality-enabled U(1) symmetry breaking in 1+1D.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了最近提出的 1+1D Lifshitz 量子临界点自发 U(1) 对称破缺现象的解析理论。低能场理论包含两个周期标量 θ 和 φ，以及 Berry 相耦合，使 θ 与 U(1) 电荷密度偏ₓ φ 正则共轭。在受控的大 N 限制内，我们证明了 U(1) 带电相顶点 eⁱβθ 发展出长程有序，而共轭顶点 eⁱβφ 以拉伸指数、对数角度 eⁱβφ⁽x⁾ e⁻ⁱβφ⁽⁰⁾ranglepropto-|β|⁴/3|x|²/3 的形式衰减。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了最近提出的 1+1D Lifshitz 量子临界点自发 U(1) 对称破缺现象的解析理论。低能场理论包含两个周期标量 θ 和 φ，以及 Berry 相耦合，使 θ 与 U(1) 电荷密度偏ₓ φ 正则共轭。在受控的大 N 限制内，我们证明了 U(1) 带电相顶点 eⁱβθ 发展出长程有序，而共轭顶点 eⁱβφ 以拉伸指数、对数角度 eⁱβφ⁽x⁾ e⁻ⁱβφ⁽⁰⁾ranglepropto-|β|⁴/3|x|²/3 的形式衰减。超越大 N 限制，我们给出了一个解析论证，即 Lifshitz 场论支持 U(1) 长程序，前提是其动态指数满足 z≠1，这是现有计算强烈支持的条件。我们在具有 U(1) rtimes Z2 对称性的巡回费米子链中使用有限尺寸和无限系统 DMRG 来测试这些预测。在 Z2 铁磁转变处，链的自旋扇区映射到 Lifshitz 场论。与分析预测一致，U(1)带电的自旋向列键算子 Sᵢ⁺Sᵢ₊₁⁺ 表现出长程有序，而电子格林函数表现出拉伸指数衰减。总之，这些结果阐明了 1+1D 中临界性 U(1) 对称性破缺的机制和后果。

articles.title: Three-Dimensional Shankar Skyrmions in Frustrated Antiferromagnets
articles.title_zh: 受挫反铁磁体中的三维香卡斯格明子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.38624v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We formulate a continuum theory for three-dimensional (3D) Shankar skyrmions in frustrated chiral antiferromagnets (AFs) and derive the conditions for metastable finite-size π₃(SO(3)) solitons. A Derrick--Hobart scaling analysis shows that exchange, Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya interaction (DMI), anisotropy, and frustration can balance to set a finite equilibrium size. We identify two microscopic routes to this common topological and stabilization framework: intrinsic rotation-frame order in noncollinear AFs and an S³ extension of an amplitude-softened Néel field. In the latter, the smooth four-component texture projects onto a Néel field containing a spatially separated pair of oppositely charged Bloch points. Numerical minimization yields metastable monopole textures, while the effective dynamics identifies coherent breathing oscillations as their characteristic finite-frequency collective mode. Our results provide a microscopic framework for the statics and dynamics of Shankar skyrmions and identify frustrated chiral AFs as promising hosts of 3D non-Abelian topological textures.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们制定了受抑手性反铁磁体 (AF) 中三维 (3D) 香卡斯格明子的连续介质理论，并推导了亚稳态有限尺寸 π₃(SO(3)) 孤子的条件。 Derrick-Hobart 尺度分析表明，交换、Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用 (DMI)、各向异性和挫折可以平衡以设定有限的平衡大小。我们确定了通往这种常见拓扑和稳定框架的两条微观途径：非共线 AF 中的固有旋转框架顺序和幅度软化尼尔场的 S3 扩展。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们制定了受抑手性反铁磁体 (AF) 中三维 (3D) 香卡斯格明子的连续介质理论，并推导了亚稳态有限尺寸 π₃(SO(3)) 孤子的条件。 Derrick-Hobart 尺度分析表明，交换、Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用 (DMI)、各向异性和挫折可以平衡以设定有限的平衡大小。我们确定了通往这种常见拓扑和稳定框架的两条微观途径：非共线 AF 中的固有旋转框架顺序和幅度软化尼尔场的 S3 扩展。在后者中，平滑的四分量纹理投影到包含一对空间上分离的带相反电荷的布洛赫点的尼尔场上。数值最小化产生亚稳态单极纹理，而有效动力学将相干呼吸振荡识别为其特征有限频率集体模式。我们的结果为香卡斯格明子的静力学和动力学提供了微观框架，并将受挫的手性 AF 识别为 3D 非阿贝尔拓扑纹理的有希望的宿主。

articles.title: Optical observation of interlayer spin correlation
articles.title_zh: 层间自旋相关性的光学观察
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.38825v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spin correlations govern numerous collective behaviors of quantum materials, underpinning exotic phenomena such as unconventional superconductivity and topological magnetism. In layered materials, the interlayer spin correlation is important because it characterizes the magnetic ground state and determines spin transport across the interface. Yet interlayer spin correlations have remained hard to measure directly, leaving one of the most basic quantities of two-dimensional magnetism out of experimental reach. Here we provide the first direct optical probe of interlayer spin correlations, using two-magnon Raman scattering in the van der Waals antiferromagnet (AFM) CrSBr, in remarkable agreement with a microscopic spin-wave model without any fitting parameter. Moreover, the two-magnon channel switches on only in the AFM state and vanishes when a magnetic field takes the crystal to a ferromagnetic state. We furthermore establish an exciton-mediated variant of the technique, where tuning the laser near the exciton resonance enhances the signal roughly tenfold due to the exciton's large oscillator strength. Magnon-pair Raman spectroscopy thus opens a direct optical window into interlayer spin correlations in van der Waals magnets, extendable to twisted bilayers and proximity-coupled heterostructures.
articles.abstract_zh: 自旋相关性控制着量子材料的众多集体行为，支撑着非常规超导和拓扑磁性等奇异现象。在层状材料中，层间自旋相关性很重要，因为它表征磁性基态并决定跨界面的自旋输运。然而，层间自旋相关性仍然难以直接测量，使得二维磁性的最基本量之一超出了实验范围。在这里，我们使用范德华反铁磁体 (AFM) CrSBr 中的双磁振子拉曼散射，提供了第一个层间自旋相关性的直接光学探针，与没有任何拟合参数的微观自旋波模型非常一致。此外，双磁振子通道仅在 AFM 状态下开启，并在磁场将晶体带入铁磁状态时消失。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自旋相关性控制着量子材料的众多集体行为，支撑着非常规超导和拓扑磁性等奇异现象。在层状材料中，层间自旋相关性很重要，因为它表征磁性基态并决定跨界面的自旋输运。然而，层间自旋相关性仍然难以直接测量，使得二维磁性的最基本量之一超出了实验范围。在这里，我们使用范德华反铁磁体 (AFM) CrSBr 中的双磁振子拉曼散射，提供了第一个层间自旋相关性的直接光学探针，与没有任何拟合参数的微观自旋波模型非常一致。此外，双磁振子通道仅在 AFM 状态下开启，并在磁场将晶体带入铁磁状态时消失。我们还建立了该技术的激子介导的变体，其中在激子共振附近调谐激光，由于激子的大振荡器强度而将信号增强了大约十倍。因此，磁振子对拉曼光谱为范德华磁体中的层间自旋相关性打开了一个直接光学窗口，可扩展到扭曲双层和邻近耦合异质结构。

articles.title: Quantum quenches of scar states in the Affleck-Kennedy-Lieb-Tasaki model via Clifford augmented tensor network simulation
articles.title_zh: 通过 Clifford 增强张量网络模拟 Affleck-Kennedy-Lieb-Tasaki 模型中疤痕态的量子淬灭
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.38848v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Clifford augmented methods have emerged as a powerful technique to simulate quantum circuits and many-body systems by exploiting the stabiliser structure found in said systems, whilst additionally enabling one to readily quantify the non-stabilizerness (i.e. magic) present. In this work, we utilise a qudit Clifford augmented simulation method to probe the presence of magic in the Affleck-Kennedy-Lieb-Tasaki (AKLT) model, finding that its ground state and scar states are highly magical as quantified by their Stabiliser Rényi Entropy (SRE). Nevertheless, owing to its low entanglement structure, these states are still readily expressible as a Clifford augmented Matrix Product State with low bond-dimension and moreover may be time-evolved using the Clifford augmented time-dependent variational principle (TDVP) algorithm. We utilise Clifford augmented TDVP to study the string order dynamics in the scar states of the AKLT model after a quench within the Haldane phase to the anti-ferromagnetic Heisenberg Hamiltonian. We observe that there is a decay of string order following the quench, which is more pronounced with increasing bimagnon number. This finding highlights the sensitivity of string order in the AKLT scar states to symmetry-preserving quenches, even when the initial and final Hamiltonians belong to the same topological phase.
articles.abstract_zh: Clifford 增强方法已成为一种强大的技术，通过利用系统中发现的稳定器结构来模拟量子电路和多体系统，同时还使人们能够轻松量化存在的非稳定器（即魔法）。在这项工作中，我们利用 Qudit Clifford 增强模拟方法来探测 Affleck-Kennedy-Lieb-Tasaki (AKLT) 模型中魔法的存在，发现其基态和疤痕状态非常神奇，正如其稳定器 Rényi 熵 (SRE) 所量化的那样。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Clifford 增强方法已成为一种强大的技术，通过利用系统中发现的稳定器结构来模拟量子电路和多体系统，同时还使人们能够轻松量化存在的非稳定器（即魔法）。在这项工作中，我们利用 Qudit Clifford 增强模拟方法来探测 Affleck-Kennedy-Lieb-Tasaki (AKLT) 模型中魔法的存在，发现其基态和疤痕状态非常神奇，正如其稳定器 Rényi 熵 (SRE) 所量化的那样。然而，由于其低纠缠结构，这些状态仍然很容易表示为具有低键维数的克利福德增广矩阵积状态，而且可以使用克利福德增广依赖时间变分原理（TDVP）算法进行时间演化。我们利用 Clifford 增强 TDVP 研究 AKLT 模型疤痕状态下的弦序动力学，该模型在 Haldane 相内淬灭至反铁磁海森堡哈密顿量后。我们观察到，淬灭后弦序发生衰减，随着双磁振子数量的增加，这种衰减更加明显。这一发现强调了 AKLT 疤痕态中的弦序对对称性保持猝灭的敏感性，即使初始和最终的哈密顿量属于相同的拓扑相。

articles.title: First-Principles Study of Two-Dimensional CeN: Interplay between Structural Stability, Electronic Structure, and Magnetism
articles.title_zh: 二维 CeN 的第一性原理研究：结构稳定性、电子结构和磁性之间的相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.38942v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work, the structural stability, and the electronic and magnetic properties of a novel CeN monolayer derived from the (111) surface of bulk rock salt CeN are investigated using first-principles calculations. Dimensional reduction produces substantial changes in the local atomic environment, decreasing the Ce-N coordination from sixfold in the bulk to threefold in the monolayer and shortening the Ce-N bond length, while preserving an essentially planar hexagonal structure. Moreover, the electronic and magnetic properties are significantly modified, which may be useful for practical applications. Both ferromagnetic (FM) and antiferromagnetic (AFM) configurations were investigated and found to be strongly bound, with the FM state slightly lower in energy. The magnetic moments are predominantly localized on the Ce atoms and mainly originated from the Ce 4f states. The electronic structure also exhibits a pronounced dependence on magnetic ordering, highlighting the connection between localized 4f states and the spin-dependent electronic properties of the system. In addition, the calculated elastic properties confirm the mechanical stability of the monolayer, while phonon calculations support its dynamical stability. Ab initio molecular dynamics simulations further indicate that the two-dimensional structure preserves its integrity under finite-temperature conditions. Overall, these results demonstrate that dimensional reduction significantly modifies the structural, electronic, and magnetic behavior of CeN without compromising the stability of the resulting two-dimensional lattice. The combination of structural robustness, localized Ce 4f magnetism, and spin-dependent electronic properties make the CeN monolayer an interesting system for further exploration in two-dimensional magnetism and spin-dependent applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，利用第一性原理计算研究了源自块状岩盐 CeN（111）表面的新型 CeN 单层的结构稳定性以及电子和磁性。尺寸减小会导致局域原子环境发生显着变化，将 Ce-N 配位从块体中的六倍减少到单层中的三倍，并缩短 Ce-N 键长，同时保留基本平面的六方结构。此外，电子和磁性能得到显着改变，这可能对实际应用有用。研究了铁磁（FM）和反铁磁（AFM）构型，发现它们具有很强的束缚性，FM态的能量略低。磁矩主要集中在 Ce 原子上，并且主要源自 Ce 4f 态。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在这项工作中，利用第一性原理计算研究了源自块状岩盐 CeN（111）表面的新型 CeN 单层的结构稳定性以及电子和磁性。尺寸减小会导致局域原子环境发生显着变化，将 Ce-N 配位从块体中的六倍减少到单层中的三倍，并缩短 Ce-N 键长，同时保留基本平面的六方结构。此外，电子和磁性能得到显着改变，这可能对实际应用有用。研究了铁磁（FM）和反铁磁（AFM）构型，发现它们具有很强的束缚性，FM态的能量略低。磁矩主要集中在 Ce 原子上，并且主要源自 Ce 4f 态。电子结构还表现出对磁有序的明显依赖性，突出了局域 4f 态与系统自旋相关电子特性之间的联系。此外，计算的弹性特性证实了单层的机械稳定性，而声子计算则支持其动态稳定性。从头算分子动力学模拟进一步表明，二维结构在有限温度条件下保持其完整性。总的来说，这些结果表明，尺寸减小显着改变了 CeN 的结构、电子和磁性行为，而不会影响所得二维晶格的稳定性。结构鲁棒性、局域 Ce 4f 磁性和自旋相关电子特性的结合使 CeN 单层成为进一步探索二维磁性和自旋相关应用的有趣系统。

articles.title: Reference-Measure Freedom of the Effective Hamiltonian: From Stochastic Thermodynamics to the Macroscopic Limit
articles.title_zh: 有效哈密顿量的参考测量自由度：从随机热力学到宏观极限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.38994v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The effective Hamiltonian (EH), also referred to as the potential of mean force or free-energy landscape, is widely used to describe equilibrium properties and slow dynamics in chemical and softmatter systems. However, the conventional EH has been argued to be ill-defined because it does not transform as a scalar under a change of coordinates. Here, we show that this apparent problem originates from an implicit change of the reference measure (gauge) with respect to which the equilibrium probability density is defined. We formulate the equilibrium measure and the Fokker--Planck equation (FPE) intrinsically on the manifold of slow variables and show that an EH is a scalar function defined with respect to a chosen gauge. Different EHs, including the conventional EH and the diffusion-dependent EH recently proposed in a Riemannian formulation, thus provide different gauge representations of the same intrinsic equilibrium measure and stochastic dynamics. We further show that the gauge choice has an operational meaning: different restraint protocols for the slow variables select different reference measures. Finally, when the equilibrium measure obeys a large-deviation principle in a macroscopic limit, differences among EHs associated with subleading gauges become subleading relative to the large-deviation speed. The leading part of the EH is then determined by the gauge-independent large-deviation rate function, and the corresponding deterministic dynamics is likewise gauge independent.
articles.abstract_zh: 有效哈密顿量 (EH)，也称为平均力势或自由能景观，广泛用于描述化学和软物质系统中的平衡特性和慢动力学。然而，传统的 EH 被认为是不明确的，因为它在坐标变化下不会转换为标量。在这里，我们表明，这个明显的问题源于定义平衡概率密度的参考测量（量规）的隐式变化。我们在慢变量流形上本质上制定了平衡测度和福克-普朗克方程 (FPE)，并表明 EH 是相对于所选规范定义的标量函数。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 有效哈密顿量 (EH)，也称为平均力势或自由能景观，广泛用于描述化学和软物质系统中的平衡特性和慢动力学。然而，传统的 EH 被认为是不明确的，因为它在坐标变化下不会转换为标量。在这里，我们表明，这个明显的问题源于定义平衡概率密度的参考测量（量规）的隐式变化。我们在慢变量流形上本质上制定了平衡测度和福克-普朗克方程 (FPE)，并表明 EH 是相对于所选规范定义的标量函数。不同的 EH，包括传统的 EH 和最近在黎曼公式中提出的扩散相关 EH，因此提供了相同内在平衡测量和随机动力学的不同规范表示。我们进一步表明，规范的选择具有操作意义：慢变量的不同约束协议选择不同的参考措施。最后，当平衡测度在宏观极限下遵循大偏差原理时，与次领先轨距相关的EH之间的差异相对于大偏差速度而言变得次领先。然后，EH 的主导部分由与规范无关的大偏差率函数确定，并且相应的确定性动力学同样与规范无关。

articles.title: Interdependent-Network Criticality without a Second Network: Cascading Collapse of the Joule-Coupled Insulator-Metal Transition in VO₂
articles.title_zh: 没有第二个网络的相互依存网络临界性：VO2 中焦耳耦合绝缘体-金属转变的级联崩溃
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.39155v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: When driven by a large enough electric field or current, the insulating state of vanadium dioxide (VO₂) typically collapses abruptly into the metallic state (the insulator-metal transition, IMT) following a brief incubation delay. These incubation delays, typically lasting microseconds or less, have been analyzed predominantly through macroscopic electro-thermal modeling, providing little statistical insight into the transition dynamics. Here, we investigate the electrically driven IMT in a two-dimensional VO₂ lattice and demonstrate that the material behaves as a complex, interdependent network despite being a single structural entity. Because metallic domains dissipate significantly more Joule heat than insulating regions, each switching event raises the Joule heating of the network, resulting in network dependency and triggering a cascading chain reaction. Combining time-resolved resistance measurements with a Joule-coupled resistor-network model and interdependent-network theory, we observe an abrupt (first-order) transition preceded by an anomalously long incubation plateau lasting thousands of seconds. During this metastable plateau, an effective branching factor of the switching activity approaches unity at criticality, and the plateau lifetime diverges with exponent ζ=1/2; the order parameter scales with exponent β=1/2. These signatures coincide with those predicted for interdependent networks, indicating that dissipative Joule coupling alone can drive mixed-order catastrophic cascades in a single-network correlated-oxide system.
articles.abstract_zh: 当受到足够大的电场或电流驱动时，二氧化钒 (VO2) 的绝缘态通常会在短暂的孵化延迟后突然塌陷为金属态（绝缘体-金属转变，IMT）。这些孵化延迟通常持续微秒或更短，主要通过宏观电热模型进行分析，几乎无法提供对转变动态的统计洞察。在这里，我们研究了二维 VO2 晶格中的电驱动 IMT，并证明该材料尽管是单一结构实体，但其行为却表现为复杂的、相互依赖的网络。由于金属域比绝缘区域耗散更多的焦耳热，因此每次切换事件都会增加网络的焦耳热，从而导致网络依赖性并触发级联链式反应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 当受到足够大的电场或电流驱动时，二氧化钒 (VO2) 的绝缘态通常会在短暂的孵化延迟后突然塌陷为金属态（绝缘体-金属转变，IMT）。这些孵化延迟通常持续微秒或更短，主要通过宏观电热模型进行分析，几乎无法提供对转变动态的统计洞察。在这里，我们研究了二维 VO2 晶格中的电驱动 IMT，并证明该材料尽管是单一结构实体，但其行为却表现为复杂的、相互依赖的网络。由于金属域比绝缘区域耗散更多的焦耳热，因此每次切换事件都会增加网络的焦耳热，从而导致网络依赖性并触发级联链式反应。将时间分辨电阻测量与焦耳耦合电阻网络模型和相互依赖网络理论相结合，我们观察到突然的（一阶）转变，之后是持续数千秒的异常长的孵化平台。在这个亚稳态平台期间，开关活动的有效分支因子在临界点接近一致，并且平台寿命以指数 ze=1/2 发散；阶次参数以指数 β=1/2 缩放。这些特征与对相互依赖的网络的预测一致，表明仅耗散焦耳耦合就可以驱动单网络相关氧化物系统中的混合级灾难性级联。

articles.title: Spectroscopic Evidence for Nontrivial Band Topology in Superconducting FeTe/MnTe Heterostructure
articles.title_zh: 超导 FeTe/MnTe 异质结构中非平凡能带拓扑的光谱证据
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.39161v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: FeTe has long been regarded as a nonsuperconducting antiferromagnetic metal with trivial band topology, but recent advances in stoichiometry control have begun to challenge this picture. Here we use higher-order epitaxy on zinc-blende MnTe to stabilize near-stoichiometric FeTe with strongly suppressed interstitial Fe and a superconducting transition onset near 13 K. Angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy reveals markedly enhanced quasiparticle coherence, well-defined Fe-derived hole bands, and a nearly two-dimensional Dirac-cone-like state near the Fermi level. First-principles calculations identify an inversion between odd- and even-parity bands, yielding nontrivial Z₂ topology and a Dirac surface state consistent with experiment. These results elucidate the intrinsic electronic structure of stoichiometric superconducting FeTe and provide evidence for nontrivial band topology, positioning FeTe/MnTe as a promising platform for exploring topological superconductivity.
articles.abstract_zh: FeTe 长期以来一直被认为是一种具有平凡能带拓扑的非超导反铁磁金属，但化学计量控制的最新进展开始挑战这一观点。在这里，我们在闪锌矿 MnTe 上使用高阶外延来稳定近化学计量的 FeTe，并强烈抑制间隙 Fe 和在 13 K 附近开始的超导转变。角分辨光电子能谱显示出明显增强的准粒子相干性、明确的 Fe 衍生空穴带以及费米能级附近的近二维狄拉克锥状态。第一原理计算确定了奇数和偶数奇偶校验带之间的反转，产生了非平凡的 Z2 拓扑和与实验一致的狄拉克表面态。
articles.abstract_zh_full: FeTe 长期以来一直被认为是一种具有平凡能带拓扑的非超导反铁磁金属，但化学计量控制的最新进展开始挑战这一观点。在这里，我们在闪锌矿 MnTe 上使用高阶外延来稳定近化学计量的 FeTe，并强烈抑制间隙 Fe 和在 13 K 附近开始的超导转变。角分辨光电子能谱显示出明显增强的准粒子相干性、明确的 Fe 衍生空穴带以及费米能级附近的近二维狄拉克锥状态。第一原理计算确定了奇数和偶数奇偶校验带之间的反转，产生了非平凡的 Z2 拓扑和与实验一致的狄拉克表面态。这些结果阐明了化学计量超导 FeTe 的固有电子结构，并为非平凡能带拓扑提供了证据，使 FeTe/MnTe 成为探索拓扑超导性的有前途的平台。

articles.title: Spin Birefringence and Spin Polarized Transmission across p-wave Altermagnetic Heterostructure
articles.title_zh: 自旋双折射和跨 p 波交变磁异质结构的自旋偏振传输
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.39174v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper investigates electron transport properties across N/AM interface or N/AM/N heterojunction. Based on Hamiltonians in the three regions, general wave functions are proposed and combined linear equations are constructed. Reflection and transmission coefficients as well as spin polarizatioin of the altermagnet heterostructure are obtained. When electron incident from normal metal to altermagnet, it is scattered and split into + branch and _ branch transmitting into altermagnet zone with separate refractive angles. Total internal reflection might happen to + branch. Critical angle of total reflection is determined by incident conditions and properties of AM material. In the heterostructure case, spin-up and spin-down electrons transmitted with same propagation directions but different transmission probabilities. Transmission and polarization periodically change with length of the junction. Exchange field and spin-splitting strength have pronounced effect on spin-polarized transmittance while the effect of spin-orbit coupling is quite small. Optimized system can be found by tuning parameters of the AM material. This study will lay the theoretical groundwork for experimental research on spin-selective outputs and spintronic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了 N/AM 界面或 N/AM/N 异质结的电子传输特性。基于三个区域的哈密顿量，提出了一般波函数并构造了组合线性方程。获得了交流磁体异质结构的反射和透射系数以及自旋极化。当电子从普通金属入射到交变磁体时，它被散射并分裂成+分支和_分支，传输到具有不同折射角的交变磁体区域。全内反射可能发生在+分支上。全反射的临界角由入射条件和增材制造材料的特性决定。在异质结构情况下，自旋向上和自旋向下的电子以相同的传播方向传输，但传输概率不同。传输和偏振随着结的长度而周期性地变化。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文研究了 N/AM 界面或 N/AM/N 异质结的电子传输特性。基于三个区域的哈密顿量，提出了一般波函数并构造了组合线性方程。获得了交流磁体异质结构的反射和透射系数以及自旋极化。当电子从普通金属入射到交变磁体时，它被散射并分裂成+分支和_分支，传输到具有不同折射角的交变磁体区域。全内反射可能发生在+分支上。全反射的临界角由入射条件和增材制造材料的特性决定。在异质结构情况下，自旋向上和自旋向下的电子以相同的传播方向传输，但传输概率不同。传输和偏振随着结的长度而周期性地变化。交换场和自旋分裂强度对自旋偏振透射率有显着影响，而自旋轨道耦合的影响很小。通过调整增材制造材料的参数可以找到优化的系统。该研究将为自旋选择性输出和自旋电子器件的实验研究奠定理论基础。

articles.title: Tunability of the structural and magnetic transition in kagome material: PrIr₃B₂
articles.title_zh: Kagome 材料中结构和磁转变的可调性：PrIr₃B2
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.39175v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report the temperature and pressure tunability of an unusual structural transformation associated with a two-step metal-insulator-metal (MIM) transition in the kagome lattice compound PrIr₃B₂ using synchrotron X-ray powder diffraction. At ambient conditions of temperature and pressure, the monoclinic (C2/m) and the hexagonal (P6/mmm) phases coexist as twinned structure in the crystal. As the temperature (pressure) is decreased (increased), PrIr₃B₂ converts fully to monoclinic structure at T = 280 K (at ambient pressure) and P = 1.2 GPa (at room temperature). Temperature dependence of the monoclinic structure at ambient pressure presents complex evolution of lattice parameters with weak but clearly discernable anomalies at SIsim 250 K and SIsim 110 K, which are correlated with the second MIM transition and the linear to nonlinear temperature-dependent resistivity crossover, respectively. These anomalies are likely due to some charge order state causing a partially gapped Fermi surface. The magnetic phase diagram of PrIr₃B₂ is also investigated from anisotropic measurements. At 10 K, a superzone gap opens near the antiferromagnetic transition, which does not close even in the polarized state. From the tunability of the crystal structure and magnetic and electronic ground state, promising electronic orders are indicated in this kagome metallic magnet.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们使用同步加速器 X 射线粉末衍射报告了 Kagome 晶格化合物 PrIr₃B2 中与两步金属-绝缘体-金属 (MIM) 转变相关的不寻常结构转变的温度和压力可调性。在环境温度和压力条件下，单斜晶（C2/m）和六方晶（P6/mmm）相以孪晶结构共存于晶体中。随着温度（压力）降低（升高），PrIr₃B2 在 T = 280 K（环境压力）和 P = 1.2 GPa（室温）时完全转变为单斜结构。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们使用同步加速器 X 射线粉末衍射报告了 Kagome 晶格化合物 PrIr₃B2 中与两步金属-绝缘体-金属 (MIM) 转变相关的不寻常结构转变的温度和压力可调性。在环境温度和压力条件下，单斜晶（C2/m）和六方晶（P6/mmm）相以孪晶结构共存于晶体中。随着温度（压力）降低（升高），PrIr₃B2 在 T = 280 K（环境压力）和 P = 1.2 GPa（室温）时完全转变为单斜结构。环境压力下单斜晶结构的温度依赖性呈现出晶格参数的复杂演化，在 SIsim 250 K 和 SIsim 110 K 下具有微弱但清晰可辨别的异常，这分别与第二个 MIM 转变和线性到非线性温度相关电阻率交叉相关。这些异常可能是由于某些电荷有序状态导致费米表面部分有间隙造成的。 PrIr₃B2 的磁相图也通过各向异性测量进行了研究。在 10 K 时，超区带隙在反铁磁转变附近打开，即使在极化状态下也不会关闭。从晶体结构以及磁基态和电子基态的可调性来看，这种戈薇金属磁体显示出有前途的电子序。

articles.title: Exact analytic solutions of classical time crystals
articles.title_zh: 经典时间晶体的精确解析解
articles.abstract: arXiv:2609.39201v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present examples of classical time crystals (in a parabolic potential for the position) that admit simple exact analytic solutions. The kinetic energy in these crystals is piecewise parabolic as a function of speed and is minimised at nonzero values of the speed. The solutions are periodic, while the speed acquires definite periodic discontinuities. The solutions are stable along the branches where the action is lower. We also examine the classical time crystal with quartic kinetic energy. We show how the quartic kinetic energy can be emulated by a piecewise parabolic one, leading to accurate and transparent solutions.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出了经典时间晶体的例子（在该位置的抛物线势），它允许简单的精确解析解。这些晶体中的动能作为速度的函数呈分段抛物线形，并且在速度的非零值处最小化。解是周期性的，而速度则具有一定的周期性不连续性。沿着作用较低的分支，解是稳定的。我们还研究了具有四次动能的经典时间晶体。我们展示了如何通过分段抛物线来模拟四次动能，从而获得准确且透明的解决方案。
